困坐圍城
奪回城巿
歐克蠻人在城內四處肆虐。殺死所有歐克蠻人，並將其建築物全數摧毀。迴轉砲塔可以進行升級，在對付載具將更加得心應手。
en_text: The Orks have overrun the city. Kill every one of the Orks and destroy all of their buildings. Turrets can be upgraded to work better against vehicles.

tc_text: 兄弟們，這座城市已經落入歐克蠻人的手中了!但是我們絕不會讓他們得逞，一定要奮戰到底，直到殺光斬盡每個歐克蠻人為止!
en_text: Brothers, the Orks have overrun the city! This transgression shall not stand. We will fight until the last Ork is dead.

tc_text: 幹得好，各位弟兄!我們已將歐克蠻人逼出城牆外。這座城市再度屬於我們了。
en_text: Well done Brothers! We've pushed the Orks beyond the walls. The city is ours once again.

tc_text: 占領戰略位置
歐克蠻人在圍牆內部建造了異教的建築物，請全數焚毀。請留意那些企圖奪回戰略位置的歐克蠻人。
en_text: The Orks have built their heretical structures within these walls. Burn them down. Look out for the Orks attempting to recapture the Strategic Points

tc_text: 這些歐克蠻人還牢牢地握有這城市戰略位置的掌控權，我們一定要攻破他們的防守，斬斷他們的供給來源。
en_text: The Orks maintain an iron grip on the city's Strategic Points. We must break their hold and deny the Orks their supplies.

tc_text: 很好!我們已成功占領戰略位置。剩下來要做的就是固守它們，直到歐克蠻人的蹤跡完全自此城市中消失。
en_text: Excellent! We've managed to secure the Strategic Points. All that remains is to hold on to them until the Orks are expunged from the city.

tc_text: 燒死這些異星怪物吧!現在他們殘留的那些邪惡建築物，都只剩下這牆後邊的那些了。
en_text: Burn wretched xenos! That's the last of their sorry structures to be found within these walls.

tc_text: 摧毀歐克蠻人軍營
歐克蠻人已經開始在城巿內部建造軍營。請全數摧毀這些軍營。別讓歐克蠻人在城內有任何立足之地。
en_text: The Orks have begun constructing Da Boy Hutz and Mek Shops within the city walls. Destroy them! Keep the Orks from solidifying their hold on the city.

tc_text: 該死的歐克蠻人將他們那惡毒的建築物，都建造在這城牆之內了。如果想要重新奪回這城市的控制權，我們就一定要摧毀這些建築物!
en_text: The blasted Orks have built their infernal structures within the city walls. Destroying these structures is vital if we are to regain control over the city.

tc_text: 找出失聯部隊
我們失去與神聖機器殿堂 (我們的載具設施) 的聯繫。想辦法重新取得聯繫並給予協助。找到機器殿堂之後，鞏固並防禦他們所在的區域。
en_text: We've lost touch with a sacred Machine Cult, our vehicle facility, somewhere in the city. Re-establish contact and give them assistance. Once you find the Machine Cult, secure it and defend the area.

tc_text: 可惡啊，真倒楣!有個神聖的機器殿堂不小心被誤射，降落在這城市的某處了。我們一定要找回這建築物，並救出所有的倖存者。
en_text: Blast and damnation! A sacred Machine Cult has misfired and landed somewhere within the city. We must recover the structure and any survivors.

tc_text: 讚美偉大的帝皇啊!這機器殿堂竟然還完好無損。現在一定要趕快派遣一隊機器奴工，立刻完成殿堂的建造工程。
en_text: Emperor be praised! The Machine Cult is still intact. We must get a Servitor to finish its construction immediately.

tc_text: 建立防禦
你現在已經可以取得迴轉砲塔了。面對大型的歐克蠻人部隊時，迴轉砲塔可以提供絕佳的防禦。請建造至少四座迴轉砲塔。
en_text: You now have access to Bolter Turrets. Turrets will provide excellent defense against the Ork hordes. Build at least 4 turrets.

tc_text: 護送倖存者
一隊帝國坦克雖然已經抵達，但是卻受到了嚴重損傷。歐克蠻人可是急切地想要摧毀這些坦克。你必須至少將一半的坦克隊，安全地護送回要塞。
en_text: A group of Imperial tanks have arrived and are damaged. The Orks are very keen on trying to destroy them. At least half of the group must make it back to the fortress safely.

tc_text: 動作快啊，兄弟們!帝國坦克隊受到了嚴重損傷，就快要被歐克蠻人攻陷了。我們一定要將至少一半的坦克隊，安全地護送回要塞。
en_text: Brothers, quickly! Those Imperial tanks are damaged and are about to be overwhelmed by the Orks. We must ensure at least half of the group make it back to the fortress safely.

tc_text: 等到修復以後，這些坦克就可以加入我們作戰的行列，一同抵抗歐克蠻人了。但是現在，先讓他們休息休息，恢復士氣再說。
en_text: Once repaired, these tanks will serve us well in our fight against the Orks. But for now, let their spirits rest.

tc_text: 殺害歐克戰爭頭目並完全摧毀他的基地
en_text: Kill the Warboss and destroy his entire base

tc_text: 我們一定要阻止歐克蠻人的行動。先找出並殺害他們的戰爭頭目，然後再將他們所有的建築物摧毀，這樣就可以永久地將他們掃蕩出深淵星了。
en_text: We will stop the Orks in their tracks. Find the Warboss and destroy him, and destroy all of his buildings to ensure they are cleansed from Tartarus once and for all.

tc_text: 攻擊歐克蠻人並殲滅他們的戰爭頭目
en_text: Assault the Orks and eliminate their Warboss

tc_text: 清查歐克蠻人區域並建立基地
en_text: Cleanse the area of Orks and establish a base

tc_text: 在對歐克戰爭頭目展開攻擊前，我們一定要先建立自己的基地。有了基地，才能從那裡派遣更多軍隊前往作戰。現在，讓我們摧毀這懸崖山谷下所有的歐克星建築物，並將歐克蠻人趕盡殺絕吧!
en_text: Before we can assault the Warboss we must establish a base from which to bring more troops to the battle. Destroy all Ork structures and kill all Orks that are in the valley under the cliff.

tc_text: 摧毀這懸崖山谷下所有歐克星建築物，並將歐克蠻人趕盡殺絕。
en_text: Destroy all Ork structures and kill all Orks that are in the valley under the cliff.

tc_text: 摧毀鐵皮越野車頭目
有個歐克星的頭目，在這高原上建立了一個基地，阻擋我們直接前往攻擊歐克戰爭頭目。因此我們必須先摧毀這個基地，才能對歐克戰爭頭目展開最後的攻擊。現在就摧毀高原上所有的歐克星建築物吧!
en_text: There is an Ork Clan that has established a base on the plateau between us and the Warboss. They must be destroyed before we can launch a final assault on the Warboss. Destroy all Ork structures on the plateau.

tc_text: 摧毀第二個歐克基地
尋找其他路線

為了確保能迅速取得增援，我們應該在歐克戰爭頭目的附近，建立一個基地。所以，請建造第二個堡壘吧。
en_text: In order to ensure ready access to reinforcements we should establish a base closer to the Warboss. Construct a second Stronghold.

老大，我們已經都準備好了!
可悲的人類啊，你們的死期到了!
en_text: Dem humies is in for a good stompin'! Dis is gonna be da best fight o' dere miserable lives!

tc_text: 你得在這次戰爭中將他們全數殺光。
en_text: Just make sure it's the last fight of their lives.

tc_text: 人類，我是不會聽命於你的。
en_text: I don't take orderz from you, humie.

tc_text: 我們已經遵守我方承諾了，不是嗎？你們想要攻打一顆新的行星，我們就提供一顆行星給你們。
en_text: We've held up our side of the bargain, have we not? You wanted a new planet to wage war on, we have given it to you.

tc_text: 你們想要和帝國最英勇的星際戰士對決，他們就出現了。我們甚至提供武器和帝國坦克給你們，讓你們在戰場上使用。
en_text: You wanted to face the Imperium's greatest warriors, the Space Marines. They are here. We've even provided you with weapons and Imperial tanks to use on the battlefield.

tc_text: 我們只希望你們能分散帝國軍隊的注意力，別讓他們發現我們在這裡的行動。
en_text: And all we ask in return is that you keep the Imperials distracted from our operations here.

tc_text: 雖然你說話算話，但並不表示你有權對歐克蠻人發號施令。
en_text: You'ze kept your word, but dat still don't means you can order da Orks around.

tc_text: 請接受我的道歉。我們已將最後一批武器交付給你們的「僕人」掌管。
en_text: My apologies. We've delivered the last of the weaponry. They are in the hands of your 'servants'.

tc_text: 現在我們必須離開了。算我拜託你們，儘量分散帝國防衛軍的注意力，越久越好。
en_text: We'll take our leave now. I... respectfully request that you keep the Marines busy for as long as you can.

tc_text: 哼!何止分散他們的注意力？我們要殺光他們!
en_text: Bah! We'll keep 'em more than busy. We'll keep dem dead!

tc_text: 對這些怪物卑躬屈膝，真令我感到作嘔。
en_text: The thought of kowtowing to these 'creatures' disgusts me.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人不過是我們利用的工具，而且還是相當好用的工具。
en_text: The Orks are a tool, nothing more, and quite an effective one I might add.

tc_text: 或許吧，但是把我方武器交給這些難以捉摸的外星怪物，實在令我不太放心。
en_text: Perhaps, but I dislike providing such unpredictable aliens with our own weaponry.

tc_text: 巴爾大人，歐克蠻人一點也不難捉摸。可以確定的是，他們有一天一定會背叛我們的。但只要我們持續提供敵人給他們，滿足他們的嗜血慾望，他們就會乖乖聽話。
en_text: Lord Bale, Orks are not unpredictable. Quite the contrary, you can rely on them to turn against you. But they will honor our agreement as long as we provide them with enemies to satiate their battle lust.

tc_text: 如果我們用威嚇手法強迫他們遵守約定，展現我方的強大力量，或許他們就不敢背叛我們了。
en_text: If we intimidated them into doing our bidding, showed them our strength, they would take pause before betraying us.

tc_text: 這種不知恐懼為何物的種族，是不吃這一套的。別再煩惱歐克蠻人的事了，趁著他們與帝國軍隊的戰爭尚未結束，快完成我們的工作，盡快離開這裡。
en_text: You cannot intimidate something that knows no fear. Trouble yourself no longer with the Orks. We will have what we came for and be gone before they finish with the Imperials and turn on us.

tc_text: 為何我們得與人類談判，而不是一口氣殺了他們？
en_text: Why'z we talkin' wit dem humies instead a fightin' wit dem?

tc_text: 這些混沌軍團手無縛雞之力，對你們來說毫無挑戰性。如果他們像歐克蠻人一樣強大，就不需要我們為他們賣命了。等我們打了勝仗後，再回來這裡解決他們。
en_text: Dem smelly Chaos-boyz iz weak, not nearly enuff of a challenge for da boyz. If dey were strong like Orkz, dey wouldn't need us ta fight for 'em. We'll take dere gunz and dere help and when we'ze done choppin' up all da humies we'll come back here and chop dem up as well.

tc_text: 坦塞斯弟兄？
他和米卡魯斯弟兄一起葬身在烈火之中，他們燒得只剩下灰燼，就算基因器官也無法挽回。
en_text: Burned beyond recovery of his geneseed, along with Brother Mikaelus. Nothing was left of them save for ash. They burned from the inside out.

tc_text: 還有什麼需要回報的嗎？
歐克蠻人的大頭目已經被殺死了，但我們看到一艘運輸艦自該區撤離。艦長大人，那艘運輸艦上有著八角星記號。
en_text: The Ork Warboss has been destroyed, but we saw a dropship leave the area. Captain, she bore the eight-pointed star.

tc_text: 那是混沌軍團的「毀滅之力」記號 …
en_text: The Mark of the Ruinous Powers of Chaos...

tc_text: 混沌軍團？他們現在怎麼會出現在這裡？
en_text: The Forces of Chaos? Here? Now?

tc_text: 混沌軍團過去曾在深淵星上發動數次黑暗聖戰，歐克蠻人和這些叛教徒同時出現，也未免太巧合了。但是，我相信偵查兵是不會看錯的。
en_text: Tartarus has endured several Black Crusades led by the terrible Chaos champions, however, it seems too convenient that Orks and these heretics are here at the same time. But I trust the eyes of our scouts.

tc_text: 伊沙多，你發現了什麼不尋常的事嗎？
不，一切正常。
如果坦塞斯弟兄的死代表了什麼的話，想必是混沌軍團有巫師隨行，為他們施行了隱身魔法，特別是所有背景早就因為歐克蠻人的關係而呈現一片靜止。
en_text: But if the nature of Brother Tanthius's demise is any indication, then they would have a sorcerer with them who would be capable of masking their presence, especially with all the background static caused by the Orks.

tc_text: 啊，我們的座上佳賓終於出現了。
這位是？
審判官墨德凱‧托斯。他負責捍衛帝皇神聖的話語和意志。
en_text: Inquisitor Mordecai Toth, protector of the Emperor's divine word and will.

tc_text: 他是來這裡發號施令的嗎？
en_text: Is he here to take command?

tc_text: 審判官可說握有無限的權力。沒錯，凡是帝國子民都必須服從他的命令，從巿井小民到行星官員都一樣，但是 --
en_text: An Inquisitor may have near-unlimited power. Yes, he can commission the service of any Imperial citizen, from peasant to planetary governor, but--

tc_text: 我是不會將星際戰士的指揮權交給他的，就算他是審判官也一樣!
en_text: I shall not cede command of my Space Marines to him, Inquisitor or not!

tc_text: 那他來這裡幹嘛？他懷疑我們之中有異端的存在嗎？
en_text: Then why is he here? Does he suspect one of us of heresy?

tc_text: 他是審判官。在審判官的眼中，每個人都可能是異端。
en_text: He is an Inquisitor. They suspect everyone of heresy.

tc_text: 如果混沌軍團要想染指這個世界，那麼他勢必要現身，我們必須將所見所聞據實以告。
en_text: If Chaos taints this world then that explains his presence. We must share with him what we discovered.

tc_text: 托斯審判官，歡迎來到深淵星。
根據衛星影像顯示，歐克蠻人正在本區大量集結。我們必須占領一處據點，並建立基地，才有機會殺死歐克蠻人頭目和他的黨羽。
en_text: Orbital imagery shows a heavy concentration of Orks in the area. We must secure a location, and establish a base before destroying the Warboss and his Clan.

tc_text: 請將旋風坦克的聖火和星際戰士突擊兵的跳躍背包搭配使用。
en_text: Combine the holy fire of the Whirlwinds with the jump packs of our Assault Marines.

tc_text: 請清查本區。
根據我方偵查小隊回報，歐克蠻人頭目就在附近不遠之處。
en_text: Our scouts report the Warboss is in the vicinity of this location.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人頭目和我軍之間，似乎有第二批歐克蠻人部隊正在集結。他們在這塊高原上擁有強大的防禦能力。
en_text: It seems a second Ork Clan has gathered between us. They are heavily defended on this plateau.

tc_text: 若要前進到歐克蠻人頭目所在的位置，必須先殲滅這批歐克蠻人部隊。
en_text: They must be eliminated to clear a path to the Warboss.

tc_text: 他們來了!
啊啊啊啊!
精密策畫不是歐克蠻人的作戰風格。我們必須另訂作戰策略才行。
en_text: Subtlety is certainly not an Ork trait. We will need to find an alternate route.

tc_text: 我們會在此地建造一座前導基地，讓星際戰士可以隨時補充必要裝備。若要確實拿下歐克蠻人頭目的性命，將會需要許多座前導基地。
en_text: We will establish a forward base at this location to facilitate ready access to Space Marines. We will need many to ensure the Warboss is dead and buried.

tc_text: 我們必須越過這些橋樑，才能抵達歐克蠻人據點。
en_text: We need to cross these bridges if we are to reach the Orks.

tc_text: 看看那隻怪物!我聽過有關這類怪物的傳說，這還是我第一次親眼目睹。弟兄們，集中火力，務必殺死這隻怪物。
en_text: Look at that monstrosity! I have heard legends of such beasts, but I have never seen one. Men, concentrate your fire, we must take this creature down.

tc_text: 我們必須消滅歐克蠻人的炮兵部隊。在軍用禮拜堂研發熱熔炸彈。
en_text: We need to take out the Ork artillery. Research Melta Bombs at the Chapel-Barracks.

tc_text: 很好!熱熔炸彈的清查工作已經完成。星際戰士突擊兵們現在可以利用熱熔炸彈的轟炸能力，摧毀歐克蠻人的砲兵坦克!
en_text: Excellent! Melta Bomb research is complete. Assault Marines can now use their Melta Bomb ability to destroy those Ork artillery tanks!

tc_text: 謝謝你，艦長大人，不過我們已經沒空說客套話了。你必須帶著你的手下馬上離開深淵星!
en_text: Thank you, Captain, but we have little time for courtesies. You and your men must leave Tartarus. Now!

tc_text: 馬納波冷巿的抵抗行動相當成功。歐克蠻人趁我們防備不週時發動攻擊，但我們並非毫無準備。我再也不會低估這些外星怪物的實力了。
en_text: The defense of the city of Magna Bonum was a success. The Orks caught us off our guard, but not un-prepared. I will not underestimate these aliens again.

tc_text: 顯然他們已將首要目標轉向首都，因此正朝首都全速前進。我很少看過有任何軍事部隊能以如此迅捷的速度前進。我讀過報告，指出歐克蠻人部隊擅長迅速進攻，但不知道他們的行動可以如此協同一致。似乎有些不知名的慾望或本能，正在驅策著這裡的歐克蠻人前進。
en_text: It is clear now that their primary push was towards the capital city, and they have moved in to attack with a speed I have rarely seen a military force capable of achieving. I have read reports of Ork clans who focus on fast strikes, but I did not realize they could be so coordinated. It is as if something is driving the Orks here, some unknown desire or instinct.

tc_text: 負責防禦這座城巿的帝國防衛軍被歐克蠻人打得落花流水，而且將無法在 24 小時之內獲得任何補給。歐克蠻人很快就會發動下一波攻擊行動。據偵查兵回報，一批新的歐克蠻人部隊正在距城巿 50 公里遠處集結，人數遠較先前攻擊馬納波冷巿的歐克蠻人部隊為多。另外，根據當地人民回報，這批歐克蠻人的頭目是一隻遠較其餘歐克蠻人來得巨大且狡滑的歐克蠻人頭目。
en_text: The Imperial Guard regiments watching over the city are decimated, and will not be re-supplied for at least 24 hours. The Orks will renew their attacks far sooner. Our scouts are reporting a force massing 50 kilometers from the city that dwarfs the group that attacked Magna Bonum, and reports from civilians speak of a mighty Ork who leads them, bigger and more cunning than the rest.

tc_text: 首都一旦淪陷，整顆行星的命運將岌岌可危。我絕不允許這樣的事發生。
en_text: If the capital city falls, this planet will not be far behind. I cannot allow this to occur.

tc_text: 摧毀異星人
跟隨著敵人的蹤跡，一探此開墾地點的究竟。
en_text: Bring the Force Commander and the Librarian to the end of the path to discover the reason for the excavation.

tc_text: 跟著敵人的蹤跡走到最後吧。帶著軍隊司令與智庫館長，一同探究敵人開墾的真正意圖。
en_text: Make your way to the end of the trail. Bring the Force Commander and the Librarian to discover the reason for the excavation.

tc_text: 跟隨著敵人的蹤跡，一探此開墾地點的究竟。
en_text: Follow the trail, and discover the true intent behind this excavation.

tc_text: 摧毀任何位於路線上的神靈族魍道關口。
en_text: Destroy any Eldar Webway Gates that lie in your path.

tc_text: 神靈族正利用魍道關口進行運輸，所以摧毀所有的魍道關口吧!
en_text: The Eldar are using the Webway Gates as a means of transportation. Destroy all of the Webway Gates.

tc_text: 摧毀任何位於路線上的神靈族網路傳輸。
en_text: Destroy any Eldar Webways that lie in your path.

tc_text: 摧毀歐克蠻人與他們的基地。
en_text: Destroy the Orks and their base.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人已經玷污了這個區域，我們可不能留下任何一個餘孽，快清查掃蕩他們吧!
en_text: The Orks have managed to infect this area as well. We cannot afford to leave an enemy at our backs. Cleanse them.

tc_text: 摧毀歐克蠻人。
避開暗黑死神的埋伏。
暗黑死神已經在懸崖上一個絕佳的攻守地點部署完畢。建議你使用犀牛運輸坦克隊通過山谷，並對暗黑死神發動攻擊。
en_text: The Dark Reapers have established a tactically superior position on top of the cliffs. Recommend using Rhino Troop Transports to move through the valley and engage the Dark Reapers in Assault.

tc_text: 暗黑死神已經在懸崖上一個絕佳的攻守地點部署完畢。建議你使用犀牛運輸坦克隊通過山谷，並對暗黑死神發動攻擊。
en_text: The Dark Reapers have established a tactically superior position on top of the cliffs. Recommend using Rhino Troop Transports to move through the valley and engage the Dark Reapers in Assault.

異變風暴會把我們困在這裡一個月，甚至是一個世紀之久。3 天後異變風暴就會抵達此處。我們不能冒險留在這裡。我們必須撤出深淵星。
en_text: This Warp Storm could trap us here for a month or for a century. We can not risk staying here. We must evacuate Tartarus before it arrives in three days time.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍和聖艦隊可以加入疏散行動。血鴉部隊則有更迫切的事情需要處理。
en_text: The Imperial Guard and Holy Fleet can attend to the evacuation. The Blood Ravens have more pressing matters to contend with.

tc_text: 例如？
我相信混沌軍團已經在這裡建立一股勢力。
en_text: I believe agents of Chaos have taken strong root here.

tc_text: 我沒有看到任何跡象。
就算深淵星上真有混沌軍團出現，與其犧牲更多生命與他們對戰，不如任由他們和歐克蠻人一起留在這顆行星上。對混沌軍團和歐克蠻人來說，這已經是最悲慘的一種結局方式了。
en_text: Even so, were there a Chaos presence on Tartarus, it is better we leave them here with the Orks than waste more lives fighting them. We could wish no worse fate for either of our enemies than to be trapped with the other.

tc_text: 但是我們必須立刻離開這裡。現在就走。
en_text: But we must leave here. Now.

tc_text: 這點交給我和幾位弟兄決定就好。我們必須利用這 3 天的時間來處理一些問題，並釐清幾項疑點。你倒是可以利用我們的運輸車，來加快疏散程序。
en_text: That is a matter for my Brothers and I to decide. We will use these three days to settle our affairs and satisfy our suspicions. Meanwhile, you have our transports to facilitate evacuation.

tc_text: 布姆上校，我和艦長有些信念方面的歧異必須解決。不介意的話，請你先迴避一下。
en_text: Colonel Brom. The Captain and I must attend to matters of faith. If you would leave us, please.

tc_text: 可是這件事和我也有關係 --
en_text: But surely this involves me as --

tc_text: 恕我無法把話說得太白。我用了「請」這個字，其實是要你立刻離開。
en_text: Forgive me for not being clear on the matter. I said please when in fact I meant, now.

tc_text: 這件事和他的確有關。你必須給他最起碼的尊重才是。
en_text: This does involve him, you should have shown him a modicum of respect.

tc_text: 艦長，你在自己的家鄉塞利尼行星上發現了大規模的異端活動，是吧？
en_text: Captain. You uncovered extensive heresy on your home-world. Cyrene, was it?

tc_text: 那件事和深淵星這裡發生的事情一點關係也沒有 --
en_text: That has nothing to do with the events here on Tartarus --

tc_text: 但我相信兩者是有關的。當時你要求審判團在你的行星上採取滅種行動，徹底撲殺行星上的全數人口，而我們也照辦了 --
en_text: But I believe they do. You requested the Inquisition undertake an Exterminatus, the destruction of your planet's entire populace, which we obliged --

tc_text: 我仍然看不出來…
艦長，我並不是在質疑你的忠誠度。但我必須確定你在塞利尼行星上的行動並未影響到你的判斷能力。
en_text: Captain. I am not questioning your loyalty. But I must wonder if your actions on Cyrene have not affected your judgment.

tc_text: 我話說得或許並不得體。我只是擔心你誤以為自己看到了實際上並不存在的混沌軍團。我會這麼問，也是為了評斷你對帝皇的忠誠度... 你必須將帝國的利益置於你個人的... 戰略考量之前。
en_text: Perhaps that was a... poor choice of words. I merely fear that you might see Chaos where it does not exist. I ask that as a loyal subject of the Emperor... you serve the Imperium's interests before your own... agenda.

tc_text: 艦長，審判官或許無權用這種口氣對你說話，但他或許是對的。即將到來的風暴會把我們的敵人困在這裡，讓他們自相殘殺。
en_text: Captain, that Inquisitor had no right to speak to you in such manner, but perhaps he is right. The coming storm will trap our enemies here where they can consume one another.

tc_text: 如果混沌星際戰士趕在風暴來襲之前，就逃出這個星系呢？我們不能利用這種不尋常的現象做為藉口，來逃避我們的敵人和責任。我們必須找出混沌星際戰士在這裡出現的原因。
en_text: And what if the Forces of Chaos escape the system before the storm? No. We will not use this freak occurrence as an excuse to avoid our enemies, or our responsibility. They are here for a reason, and we will discover that reason.

tc_text: 我們將會追隨你的腳步，艦長大人。直到永遠。
en_text: We are with you, Brother-Captain. As always.

tc_text: 這些人類出動了強大的兵力，正朝你一步步走來。在你看到他們的身影之前，應該已經聽到他們沈重的腳步聲，並嗅到他們身上的氣味。
en_text: The humans are coming your way in full force. You should hear their heavy feet long before you see them. And smell them long before that.

tc_text: 偉大的審判官絲毫不認為這裡有混沌軍團存在。帝國能找到如此敏覺的人日夜看守大門，真是太幸運了。
en_text: So the good Inquisitor senses no Chaos here. How fortunate for the Imperium that such keen-eyed eagles stand vigil over her gates.

tc_text: 這些神靈族在這裡召喚了什麼黑暗生物？
en_text: What dark crafts have these Eldar invoked?

tc_text: 沒有，至少不是在這裡。混沌軍團把這名可憐的帝國護衛軍拿來當做活祭品。
en_text: None, at least not here. The servants of Chaos sacrificed this poor Guardsman themselves.

tc_text: 他們的目的是什麼，伊薩多？
我也不知道。不過我相信祭壇是一個標記，是地圖中的一個航點，可以將人帶往其他目的地。大部份文字都遭人破壞了。無論混沌軍團前來此地尋找的是什麼東西，祭壇都免不了要舉行血祭，甚至是活人祭。
en_text: I know not. I believe the altar is a marker, a waypoint in a map that leads elsewhere. Someone defaced many portions of text. Regardless of what Chaos seeks here, the altar requires a sacrifice of blood, or more likely, a life.

tc_text: 伊薩多弟兄，你有一個小時的時間研究祭壇。請依照慣例，將每件事記錄下來，然後焚毀祭壇，以免我們遭到玷污。
en_text: Brother Isador, you have an hour to study the altar. Document everything as is our tradition, then burn it lest its taint infect us all.

tc_text: 但是加百列，這裡有許多值得學習的事物。我們實在不應該急著 --
en_text: But Gabriel, there is much to learn from here. We should not be too eager to --

tc_text: 有什麼好學習的？除了誤導和誘騙的伎倆以外，混沌軍團還能教你什麼？我看不出來這裡的任何事物對我們的進展有任何幫助。
en_text: Learn what? Chaos does not teach, it misleads and it betrays. There is nothing to learn here save for our next course.

tc_text: 這些運輸車已經˙˙˙因不明原因損毀了。快點修復它吧，而且動作要快。
en_text: These transports have been... damaged somehow. Make the repairs, and be quick.

tc_text: 好啊，伊薩多弟兄。看看你在造什麼反，居然故意破壞自己的交通工具？艦長大人的命令如此明確，你竟敢將這些神器藏匿起來？
en_text: Well, well, Brother Isador. What betrayal have you wrought? Disabling your own vehicles? Harboring artifacts despite your good Captain's instructions?

tc_text: 加百列無法理解 -- 他看不出來這座祭壇的重要性。
en_text: Gabriel does not understand -- he does not appreciate the significance of this.

tc_text: 但我能夠理解。
住嘴，你這個叛教徒。以帝皇和同胞之名，一旦讓我知道你的企圖，我就會利用它來對付你。
en_text: Quiet, heretic. Once I find what you seek, I will use it against you, for the glory of the Emperor and my Brothers.

tc_text: 看來你想要和我一決高下，好證明自己的力量和價值是吧？那就來吧。我在柯拉茲山上等你。
en_text: You wish to deal me a harsh blow, to prove your strength and worth? Then come to me. I wait at Mount Korath.

tc_text: 別擔心，巫師。我一定會赴約的。
en_text: Have no fear, sorcerer. I will be there.

tc_text: 是歐克蠻人!立刻攻擊他們!
等等... 他們不是在攻擊，而是在逃跑…
en_text: Wait... they weren't attacking, they were fleeing...

tc_text: 究竟是什麼東西讓歐克蠻人感到恐懼？
en_text: What could inspire fear in an Ork?

tc_text: 衛星空照圖顯示有運輸艦在鄰近地區降落。艦長大人，我們發現了一條通道，顯然是有人在這裡挖出來的。
en_text: Orbital Command has indicated the Drop Ship landed in this general proximity. We have discovered a path Captain, it's obvious someone has been digging here.

tc_text: 是歐克蠻人挖的嗎？
我從來沒有看過歐克蠻人如此用心地完成一項工程。
en_text: I've never seen an Ork lend such a careful hand to a task.

tc_text: 既然不是歐克蠻人，那就一定是混沌軍團了。
en_text: If it wasn't Orks, then it must be the forces of Chaos.

tc_text: 我們沿著這條通道前進，看看隱藏在幕後的真相到底是什麼。
en_text: We will follow this path and discover the truth behind what has transpired here.

tc_text: 神靈族!
或許是我們搞錯了。出現在這裡的可能並不是混沌軍團。
en_text: Perhaps we were mistaken about the presence of the Forces of Chaos?

tc_text: 管他是神靈族還是混沌軍團，我都一定會找出真相。繼續前進。
en_text: Be it Eldar or Chaos, I will have answers either way. Press on.

tc_text: 是暗黑死神!立即撤退!
立刻出動偵查小隊。他們的狙擊步槍必定能夠打擊這些外星人的士氣，並讓我們在傷亡人數最少的情況下徹底殲滅他們。
en_text: Bring up the Scouts. Their sniper rifles will be sure to break the spirits of these aliens and allow us to close and destroy them with minimal losses.

tc_text: 至少我們可以確定，歐克蠻人和神靈族並未結盟。
en_text: At least we know that the Orks and Eldar are not in league together.

tc_text: 敵人互相攻擊時，不代表他們並未結盟，而可能只是缺乏榮譽感的一種表現。
en_text: When one enemy attacks another it does not mean they aren't in league, just that they are living up to their lack of honour.

tc_text: 缺乏榮譽感的人，不配活在這世上。
en_text: And those who lack honour deserve death.

tc_text: 這裡有些不對勁。這些歐克蠻人屍體看來不像是帝國軍隊的所作所為。我們必須小心前進。
en_text: Something is not right here. These Ork bodies do not look like they were dispatched by Imperial hands. We must proceed with caution.

tc_text: 我們需要犀牛運輸坦克，讓我們能毫髮無傷地通過此地，同時攻擊懸崖上的暗黑死神。
en_text: We need Rhino Transport Tanks. They will allow us to get through unscathed and attack the Dark Reapers on those cliffs above.

tc_text: 如果我們能在這附近建造第二座基地，將有利於我方對敵軍發動攻擊。
en_text: Establishing a secondary base near this location will give us a forward position with which to engage the enemy.

tc_text: 我們已將歐克蠻人趕出此地，並擊敗他們的戰爭頭目，但這場戰爭距離結束還有很長一段時間。歐克蠻人仍然威脅要攻佔幾個人口集中的地區；依照他們集結的規模看來，要擊敗所有這星球上的帝國防衛軍力並非不可能。我們除了爭取到一些時間以外，可以說是毫無所獲。
en_text: The Orks have been repelled and their Warboss has been defeated, but this war is far from over. The Orks still threaten to overcome several major population centers, and could mass more than a large enough force to overwhelm the Imperial armies present on the planet. We have bought time, nothing more.

tc_text: 但這已經不是最重要的問題了。我方偵查兵已經找到明確證據，證明混沌勢力 － 即「終極敵手」 － 有在這個行星上明顯活動的跡象。無論他們藏身何處，我們都得與他們正面對決。只要他們出現在此地，我們就必須將他們揪出來，並徹底殲滅他們!
en_text: But this is no longer a primary concern. Our scouts have recovered evidence that the Forces of Chaos, the Great Enemy, may be operating on this planet, right under our very noses. We must face this foe wherever they stand. If there is even a chance that they are here we must seek them out and destroy them!

tc_text: 托斯審判官要求我們立刻離開這座行星。我固然服膺他提出的理由，但是他的職權再大，也絕對沒有權力對星際戰士中隊發號施令。我必須承認，他的出現令我十分不悅，特別是我的家鄉塞利尼行星上才剛發生這些事件沒多久。審判官擅於喚起別人的罪惡感，但我現在最不需要的就是罪惡感。
en_text: Inquisitor Toth is demanding that we leave the planet. But of all the powers his position grants him commandeering a Space Marine Company is not one of them. I must admit that I find his presence unwelcome so soon after the events on my homeworld of Cyrene. Inquisitors have a way of inflaming a guilty conscience, and that I do not need right now.

tc_text: 新領導人
進入虎口
建立基地
找個好地點，建立基地以管理這個區域。
en_text: Find a good location to establish a base of operations in this area.

tc_text: 要小心神靈族的埋伏，他們隨時都可能發動突襲。
en_text: Beware of Eldar treachery. An ambush could be waiting around every turn.

tc_text: 前往探勘地點
為何混沌星要派遣軍隊到這個星球？這是我們一定要弄清楚的。我們相信他們曾經到過這裡，但是原因我們並不清楚。不過答案就在北方那個探勘地點，讓我們前往該處一探究竟吧!
en_text: We must discover why the forces of Chaos are on this planet. We believe they visited this location, but we do not know why. Our answers lie at the dig site to the North. We must reach it!

tc_text: 神靈族就在這裡。雖然他們不可能與混沌軍隊結盟，但是看來卻是決心要阻止我們。要隨時小心戒備。
en_text: We know the Eldar are here. They are unlikely allies for the Forces of Chaos, but nevertheless they seem determined to stop us. Be on your guard.

tc_text: 阻止爆破部隊
神靈族竟然想要銷毀所有證據，不讓我們知道混沌軍團在此區域停留的目的!我們必須要摧毀掌管爆破行動的先知領導團，阻止他們消滅證據!
en_text: The Eldar are trying to destroy all evidence of Chaos in this area! We must stop them by destroying the Seer Council which is overseeing the demolition operation!

tc_text: 時間緊迫啊!我們得在他們銷毀所有混沌證據之前，先摧毀這個部隊!
en_text: There is not much time! We must destroy this squad before they can destroy all evidence of Chaos.

tc_text: 摧毀神靈族基地
這區域裡一定有神靈族的作戰基地，要是發現了任何這樣的基地，可要馬上摧毀它!我們一定要剷除所有的異星人!
en_text: The Eldar must have field bases in the area. If you encounter them, they must be destroyed! Exterminate the xenos!

tc_text: 神靈族十分奸詐狡滑，所以他們的基地一定是設在隱密難尋的地點。
en_text: Eldar are masters of deceit and trickery, so their bases may lie in hidden locations.

tc_text: 摧毀魍道關口
神靈族是利用一種稱為「魍道關口」的建築物，迅速地將步兵運送到戰場上。所以要是發現了任何魍道關口，務必摧毀它，好削弱他們的行動力。
en_text: The Eldar use structures called Webway Gates to transport infantry quickly across the battlefield. Destroy any you find to limit their mobility.

tc_text: 摧毀越多的魍道關口，能夠運送神靈族加入戰場的地點就越少。
en_text: Destroying Webway Gates will limit the directions that the Eldar can attack you from.

tc_text: 任務 6 - 開始
任務 6 - 基地位置
任務 6 - 摧毀傳輸門
任務 6 - 已摧毀神靈族基地
任務 6 - 已摧毀傳輸門
血鴉部隊第三連隊
法師馬加攻擊部隊
必爾坦攻擊部隊
葛里斯諾克加頭目
深淵星護衛隊
偉大的法師啊!正如你所預言的一般，人類正穿越那道斜坡。他們正一步步踏入我們的陷阱中。
en_text: Exalted Farseer. The humans are moving, traversing the slope as you predicted. They are walking into our trap.

tc_text: 是的，但務必謹記在心：絕不可以對星際戰士發動突襲。他們會預期在每個彎道都有敵兵埋伏。如果你發動突襲行動，只是讓他們證明自己的懷疑是正確的。
en_text: Yes, but you can never ambush a Space Marine. Remember that. They expect treachery at every turn; you can only validate their suspicions.

tc_text: 你的命令是？
我們已將人類困在這條通道中，正如同他們已將我們困在我們的通道中一般。他們知道自己正在步入圈套之中，因此可能會想要拖我們一起下水。現在，我們只能扮演好自己的角色，並祈禱我們的演技夠好。
en_text: We have locked the humans into this path as they have locked us into ours. They know they enter a gauntlet, and they will likely drag us into it as well. Now, we play our parts and pray that we are the better actors.

tc_text: 你確定嗎？
沒錯。祭壇告訴我們，我們必須前往柯拉茲山的隘口。怎麼，你懷疑我的判斷是嗎？
en_text: Yes. The pass to Mount Korath, this is where the altar said we must go. Why, do you question my findings?

tc_text: 我無意質疑你的能力，館長大人，但是就戰術而言，這樣的判斷令我難以接受。畢竟柯拉茲山隘口是適合發動突襲的絕佳位置。
en_text: I do not question your abilities, Brother Librarian, but I do question their tactical sense. That mountain pass is the perfect location for an ambush.

tc_text: 聽聽看，他的話中充滿了不信任感。他可能在背後喚你變種人，表面上卻畏懼你的神格和力量。快安撫這個不成熟的傢伙。
en_text: Listen to the distrust in his voice. He probably calls you mutant behind your back, but he fears your divinity, your power. You must put the child at ease.

tc_text: 我不否認這看起來像是陷阱，不過這更是證明了我們的敵人就藏身在前方。
en_text: I do not deny that this is likely a trap, which is all the more proof that our enemy lies in this direction.

tc_text: 有道理，我的老友。請跟在我身後，並保持警戒。我不容許任何錯誤發生。
en_text: Very true, old friend. Stay alert, and follow my lead. I want no mistakes.

tc_text: 明白。
偵查小隊，你們抵達預定地點了嗎？
是的，大人。我們發現了第一批神靈族的所在位置。
en_text: Yes, My Lord. We have discovered the location of the first Eldar forces.

tc_text: 我們必須先想辦法殲滅這批神靈族攻擊部隊，再尋找適當地點規劃作戰策略。
en_text: We must find a way to overcome this Eldar strike force before we can scout out a good location to stage our field operations.

tc_text: 無畏機兵可以擊毀這些落石。請利用無畏機兵的近距離戰鬥能力，將這些落石自通道上清除。
en_text: The Dreadnought can destroy these fallen rocks. Utilize the Dreadnought’s close combat abilities to clear the rocks from the path.

tc_text: 這棟建築物是「魍道關口」。神靈族會利用它，在不同的位置之間迅速移動。
en_text: This structure is a Webway Portal. The Eldar use them to quickly travel from one location to another.

tc_text: 為了限制神靈族的行動能力，一旦發現任何魍道關口，都必須加以摧毀。
en_text: We must destroy any Webway Portals we find to limit the Eldar’s mobility.

tc_text: 這裡十分適合建立作戰基地。 (聲音自無線電傳出) 加百列呼叫怒禱號戰艦，請鎖定我的所在位置，並準備棄守總部。 (暫停) 立刻行動!
en_text: This is a good location to establish a field base. Gabriel to The Litany of Fury, lock on my location and prepare to drop HQ now.

tc_text: 現在作戰基地已經建造完成，我們得繼續徒步穿越隘口。請留意敵人的頑強抵抗，行動務求謹慎，並隨時保護作戰基地的安全。
en_text: Now that we have established our field base we must continue through the mountain pass on foot. Expect heavy resistance, make sure you move cautiously, and keep the field base protected at all times.

tc_text: 大人，我已經依照你的命令抵達這裡了。
en_text: My Lord, I have arrived at your request.

tc_text: 我們需要你們協助掩護東方隘口。這裡發生的戰事可能會引來附近的歐克蠻人部隊。我們將無法應付更多歐克蠻人部隊的介入。
en_text: We need you to cover the Eastern Pass. The combat that is occurring here will likely attract the Ork forces nearby. We cannot afford their interference.

tc_text: 我明白了。請放心地將這個隘口交給帝國防衛軍來防守。我們絕不會讓任何歐克蠻人通過這個隘口。
en_text: I understand. You can count on the Imperial Guard to hold this pass. No Orks will get by us.

tc_text: 如果有任何最新狀況，請立刻讓我知道。可能的話，我也會在歐克蠻人對你們發動攻擊時提供必要的支援。
en_text: Keep me apprised of the situation. If possible I will provide you assistance if the Orks attack.

tc_text: 是的，大人。
感謝帝皇，你們終於出現了!我以為指揮官忘記我們還待在這兒!
en_text: Thank the Emperor you’re here! I think Command forgot about us.

tc_text: 你們在這裡待了多久？
en_text: How long have you been here?

tc_text: 大約一個星期。
你們獨力在這裡防衛了一個星期？
en_text: You held this position for a week, by yourselves?

tc_text: 是的，大人。我們看到一些相當不尋常的事情。我們這就帶你去看!
en_text: Yes, my lord. We’ve seen some pretty freaky stuff, too. Come on! We’ll show you!

tc_text: 艦長大人，這座山似乎因為某些原因而變得十分不穩定。可能會發生更多的地震活動。
en_text: Brother-Captain, something has caused this mountain to become unstable. More seismic activity is likely.

tc_text: 這些狡猾的外星人渣!他們可以將作戰基地隱藏起來，讓我們的手下怎樣找也看不見。
en_text: Treacherous alien scum! They can hide their field bases in plain sight of our men.

tc_text: 但是他們仍逃不出我們的雙眼。凡是指揮部隊，像我或是智庫館長，都能識破隱藏的敵方部隊或基地。有士官隨行的隊伍，也能識破隱藏的敵人。
en_text: But not from our eyes. Brothers, to locate hidden units or bases utilize a commander unit, like myself, or the Librarian. Squads equipped with Sergeants can also detect hidden enemies.

tc_text: 艦長大人，衛星偵察的結果顯示，前方有大批神靈族集結。他們似乎正準備炸毀一處開鑿地點。
en_text: Brother-Captain, orbital reconnaissance has discovered a large group of Eldar ahead. They appear to be rigging an excavation site with explosives.

tc_text: 看來他們想要炸毀該處來湮滅一切祕密。
en_text: It appears they are trying to collapse the site, burying whatever may lie there.

tc_text: 毫無疑問，他們正準備要湮滅自己的瀆神行徑。我們絕不容許此事發生。我們必須徹底殲滅位於開鑿地點的所有神靈族。
en_text: Trying to cover up their blasphemous work, no doubt. We cannot allow this to happen. We must eliminate the Eldar at the excavation site.

tc_text: 我們仍持續挖出神靈族的炸藥和爆破引信，但我們不敢貿然搬動它們。我們拆下他們的引爆裝置，然而就異星科技而言，這已經是我的能力極限了。
en_text: We are still unearthing more Eldar explosives and demolition charges, but we dare not move them. We did replace their triggering mechanisms, however, that is all I care to do with such xeno-tech.

tc_text: 這會是他們設下的陷阱嗎？
應該不是。從炸藥放置的方式看來，他們似乎打算要炸毀這個區域，將這裡的標記和附近的人全都埋到地底下。
en_text: No. By the placement of the charges, it is likely they planned to collapse this area, burying the marker and anyone near it.

tc_text: 他們失敗了。伊薩多，研究一下這裡的標記，看看它會將我們帶往何處。
en_text: They failed. Isador, study the marker and see where it leads us next.

tc_text: 艦長大人，托斯審判官到了。
我一點也不驚訝。
是的，艦長，這景象著實令人吃驚。但我從來沒說過這顆行星上沒有混沌軍團的蹤跡。我當時說的是：不論是誰在這裡出現，即將到來的異變風暴都會徹底解決他們。我們最好不要待在這裡，和他們走上同一條路。
en_text: Yes, Captain, it is an impressive sight, but I never claimed Chaos had not set foot on this planet before. I said that if something were here, the impending warp storm would eliminate that threat. Best we not remain to share its fate.

tc_text: 審判官，我先前已經說過，血鴉部隊會待在這裡，直到最後一刻。我們會利用最後兩、三天的時間，找出這道謎題的答案。
en_text: And as I explained, Inquisitor, the Blood Ravens will remain until the last possible moment. Until that happens, in two or three days hence, I plan on pursuing this riddle.

tc_text: 艦長，我無意... 質疑你為血鴉部隊制訂的決策。但是連上校的帝國防衛軍都被捲入你個人的使命中 --
en_text: Captain, I do not… presume to question your decisions concerning the Blood Ravens. But when it comes to employing the Colonel’s Imperial Guard in your quest --

tc_text: 我個人的使命!？這已經不是你第一次指控我追求個人利益了!徹底消滅混沌軍團或其他異端，不僅是我的職責，也是你的責任。
en_text: My quest?!? Yet again you accuse me of pursuing my personal interests! It is my duty, and yours, to expunge any scent of heresy or Chaos.

tc_text: 你已經逾越職權了。
審判官，你也一樣。帝國防衛軍不是上校一個人的。他們的生命屬於帝皇所有。若非經過帝皇授權，我也不敢擅自利用帝國防衛軍來對抗黑暗勢力，並於光榮的聖戰中一舉殲滅他們。
en_text: As do you, Inquisitor. It is not the 'Colonel’s Imperial Guard'. Their lives belong to the Emperor. It is by his mandate and will that I use the Imperial Guard against the forces of disorder and elevate them in the glory of holy battle.

tc_text: 我現在才明白，我來這裡根本就是一個錯誤。如果您想要走上毀滅之路，我當然阻止不了你，但我絕不允許你將我們一起拖下水。
en_text: I see now that coming here was a mistake. If you are set on a path that will lead you to destruction I can do nothing to stop you, but I won’t allow you to drag us down with you.

tc_text: 根據審查命令，深淵星目前是由我負責掌管。這行星上的所有資源和軍事行動，都歸我一人管轄。艦長，從現在起，你和你的手下必須靠你們自己了。
en_text: By Inquisitorial edict I am taking control of the planet Tartarus. All requests for planetary resources, including its military, will go through me. Captain, from this point on you and your men are on your own.

tc_text: 在托斯審判官的命令下，所有居民開始集體撤出深淵星。就算天時地利人和樣樣具備，這樣的行動仍可能招致災難。我聽到的消息指出，當民眾開始集體撤往兩座主要的太空港口時，爆發了大規模的集體恐慌。歐克蠻人部隊對運輸隊伍和徒步前進的百姓發動攻擊。在無法集中軍力的情況下，帝國防衛軍為了抵禦歐克蠻人進攻人口稠密的地區，只能不斷葬送自己的寶貴性命。他們都是誓死為帝皇效忠的戰士。
en_text: Under the orders of Inquisitor Toth the citizens of Tartarus have begun a mass exodus of the planet. Such an action can lead to disaster in the best of situations, but the reports reaching my ears are ones of planet-wide hysteria as the population makes its pilgrimage to the two main spaceports. Convoys of transports and civilians on foot are being plagued by attacks from Ork forces. Stretched thin, the Imperial Guard is barely keeping order in the major population centers, sacrificing their lives long enough to hold back the green tide of the Orks. They are truly warriors of the Emperor.

tc_text: 我多麼希望自己也能參與他們的神聖行動，但我也和他們一樣，有自己的神聖職責必須履行。我們已經找到混沌勢力在深淵星上活動的證據。伊薩多在一座異端祭壇上找到證據，指出混沌勢力可能正在前往柯拉茲山的途中。柯拉茲山是一座古老的山脈，附近有許多歐克蠻人。
en_text: I wish for nothing more than to be able to join them in this noble cause, but I cannot deny my duty any more than they can deny theirs. We have found proof that the Forces of Chaos are operating on the planet of Tartarus. Isador has found evidence on a blasphemous altar that indicates they may be headed towards Mt. Korath, an old mountain located dangerously close to an area of heavy Ork activity.

tc_text: 我已要求布姆上校派出帝國防衛軍的一支分團，前來掩護我們前進。知道上校的部隊已經自顧不暇之後，我十分後悔自己提出這樣的要求，但是這裡確實有更重要的事情要辦。
en_text: I have requested a regiment of Imperial Guard from Colonel Brom to help cover our approach. I regret asking when the Colonel's forces are already stretched to the breaking point, but there are greater things at stake now.

tc_text: 獻祭
佔領紀念碑
在這個神靈族護衛的紀念碑中，有個稱為「鑰匙」的瀆神工藝品。請先擴展勢力範圍，佔領所有的戰略位置，以取得城市的控制權，接著取得那個標記，然後摧毀所有的神靈族反抗勢力。
en_text: The Eldar are protecting a monument that contains a blasphemous artifact known as The Key. Regain control of the city by expanding and capturing all Strategic Points in the area, then get to that marker, and destroy any Eldar resistance.

tc_text: 神靈族絕對不會讓我們輕易地踏上這片土地。所以一定要確實地建立起堅強的防禦，最好能在更前面的地方，設立第二個基地。
en_text: The Eldar will make us pay for every foot of ground. Make sure you establish a strong defense, and possibly a secondary base in an advanced position.

tc_text: 摧毀戰神分身
戰神分身這個怪物，是個來自異變星的瀆神惡魔。我們絕不能讓這惡魔任意踐踏帝國的土地，快摧毀他吧!
en_text: The Avatar is a monstrosity, a blasphemous Daemon from the Warp. It cannot be allowed to walk on Imperial soil. Destroy it!

tc_text: 若是採取近身作戰的話，戰神分身會擁有絕對的優勢，所以與他作戰時，最好保持一定的距離。還有，因為他受傷後可以很快地癒合，因此一定要持續地攻擊他，不讓他有喘息的機會。
en_text: The Avatar excels at close combat, so try to engage it at range. Keep the pressure on, as it will heal damage quickly.

tc_text: 防守帝國遺址
聖羅孚‧馬爾市是為了紀念聖羅孚‧馬爾聖人而命名的，它同時也是深淵星所有教徒的聖地。好好地利用你所擁有的最精良部隊，保衛這珍貴的遺址吧!
en_text: The city of St. Lloovre Marr, dedicated to the saint of the same name, is the heart of all religion on the planet Tartarus. Secure its precious Relics to justify the requisition of your strongest troops.

tc_text: 請仔細地查看地圖，總共有三個遺址。
en_text: Search the map thoroughly. There are 3 Relics to find.

tc_text: 取得橋樑掌控權
要前往攻擊神靈族，必須通過這條河流。而過河的唯一方法，就是這道北方橋。所以我們一定要先佔領橋前面的戰略位置，並固守二分鐘以上，這樣才有足夠的時間取得橋樑的掌控權，並將閘門放下。
en_text: The Northern bridge is the only location where we can cross the river and reach the Eldar. We must capture the Strategic Point in front of the bridge and hold it for 2 minutes. This will allow us the time to override the bridge controls and lower the gates.

tc_text: 請派遣步兵團佔領這個戰略位置。別忘了要保持警戒，提防神靈族的反擊。
en_text: Use infantry to capture the Strategic Point. Brace yourself for an Eldar counter-attack.

tc_text: 任務 7 - 開始
任務 7 - 摧毀戰神分身
任務 7 - 已摧毀戰神分身
任務 7 - 佔領遺址
任務 7 - 已佔領遺址
任務 7 - 已通過橋樑
任務 7 - 橋樑目標
血鴉部隊第三連隊
法師馬加攻擊部隊
必爾坦攻擊部隊

我們已經別無選擇了，只剩一條路可以走。明白我對你的要求了嗎？
en_text: Our choices are gone. We have but one recourse left. Do you understand what is asked of you?

tc_text: 既然我是無條件付出，你也就不用「要求」了，法師。我的生命是屬於你的。
en_text: You cannot ask that which I offer freely, Farseer. My life is yours.

tc_text: 偉大的勇者，從現在起，你的生命屬於所有神靈族。
en_text: It belongs to all Eldar now, brave one.

tc_text: 你即將成為全軍的表率!
en_text: You will become the war-cry made manifest!

tc_text: 敵人的鮮血玷污了我們的雙手，但是戰爭尚未結束。我們或許不能說服人類放棄他們的目標，但我們也絕不允許任何人找出埋藏在這裡的神器。
en_text: The blood of many foes stains our hands, but there shall be more to come. We cannot dissuade the humans from their course and we cannot allow anyone to find what lies buried here.

tc_text: 本軍已完成集結，準備全力應戰。
en_text: The host is assembled and we fully commit ourselves to the battle.

tc_text: 你是我們之中最優秀的人。希望蓋拉‧門夏‧凱因挑選你做為他的轉生宿主。
en_text: You are the best of us. May Kaela Mensha Khaine find you worthy of becoming his Avatar.

tc_text: 這樣人類就會死得適得其所了!
en_text: Then the humans shall have the death they seek!

tc_text: 慢了這麼久 -- 你還欠我們一把鑰匙，辛吉!偽帝皇的爪牙和神靈族將會在城內決戰 --
en_text: This delay -- you cost us the Key, Sindri! The False Emperor’s lackeys and Eldar will battle for the city --

tc_text: 巴爾大人，在你的威望之下，他們就像是一群無足輕重的蠢蛋一樣。我只需要你一點點的耐心。你很快就會明白，一切事情都在依照你我的計劃進行。請不要失去信心。目前為止，我有做錯任何事情嗎？
en_text: They are naught but hapless fools before your might, Lord Bale. Surely a modicum of patience is in order here. Matters progress to your benefit and my devices. You will see. Have faith. Have I led you astray thus far?

tc_text: 沒有，可是如果你失敗的話 --
en_text: No, but if you fail me in this--

tc_text: 是的，如果失敗的話，我就有苦頭吃了。請你們準備好，待我一下令就展開行動。
en_text: Yes, yes, then my suffering shall be great. Just be ready to move when I instruct.

tc_text: 再過不久，鑰匙就是我的了。
en_text: Just a bit longer, and then the Key will be mine.

tc_text: 離目標越來越近了。兄弟們，小心警戒!
en_text: You are approaching the objective. On your guard, brothers.

tc_text: 有埋伏!是該死的異星怪物!
鑰匙就在這座紀念碑中，目前仍為神靈族所把持。
en_text: The Key is located in this monument, which is currently held by the Eldar.

tc_text: 我們必須穿越城巿，抵達這座紀念碑，並將鑰匙從這些狡猾的外星人手中奪走。
en_text: We must find our way through the city to the monument and take it from these treacherous aliens.

tc_text: 一處帝國遺址!
我們絕不允許這些珍貴的遺址落入敵人手中。根據傳言，這附近共有三處遺址。
en_text: We cannot allow these precious Relics to fall into enemy hands. There are 3 Relics rumored to be located in the area.

tc_text: 派出步兵團，儘可能地占領這些遺址。方法就和占領戰略位置一樣。
en_text: Capture them if at all possible. They can be captured by infantry in the same way Strategic Points are captured.

tc_text: 那是什麼鬼東西？!
由狡猾的神靈族召喚出來的惡魔，又叫做「戰神分身」。
en_text: A Daemon conjured by the treacherous Eldar. It is called an Avatar.

tc_text: 我們絕不允許這個惡魔任意踐踏帝國的土地。各位弟兄們，我們必須立刻摧毀它，但是請小心，絕對不可低估這傢伙。
en_text: We cannot allow this abomination to walk on Imperial soil. Destroy it, but be wary Brothers, it will be an enemy to be reckoned with.

tc_text: 「戰神分身」被我們消滅了。神靈族的精神指標遭到破壞，想必他們的士氣也會大受打擊。幹得好，各位弟兄!
en_text: The Avatar is destroyed. The Eldar will not fight so fiercely now that their symbol of war is vanquished. Well done, my Brothers!

tc_text: 神靈族已為這座橋設下防禦，並關上大門。
en_text: The Eldar have fortified this bridge, and closed the gate.

tc_text: 為了跨越這座橋，我們必須占領並固守這座橋上的戰略位置達兩分鐘之久。
en_text: In order to get through we must capture and hold the Strategic Point on the bridge for 2 minutes.

tc_text: 如此一來，我們才有足夠時間修改控制室的電路，並打開大門。
en_text: This will give us enough time to re-work the gatehouse circuitry and open the gates.

tc_text: 這裡十分適合建造第二座基地。
en_text: This would be an excellent location for a secondary base.

tc_text: 這個區域共有三處遺址，我們已經全數占領。透過這些遺址，我們便能合法徵召最菁英的帝皇部隊。
en_text: We have captured all 3 Relics in this area. Relics justify the requisition of the Emperor’s finest troops.

tc_text: 我們現在可以在衛星收發站徵召終極戰士。請妥善運用終極戰士，他們在戰場上可說是所向無敵。
en_text: We may now requisition Terminators at the Orbital Relay structure. Use these units well. They are almost unstoppable on the field of battle.

tc_text: 就在這附近了。你也感覺到它的力量了，對吧？
en_text: It lies within reach now. You sense its power, do you not?

tc_text: 你還認為自己有力量利用它來對付我嗎？現在你的障礙只剩下那名法師了。
en_text: Still think you have the strength to use it against me? All that stands in your way is that Farseer.

tc_text: 殺了我吧，消滅我的肉體，讓我的名字隨風消逝 -- 但請仍記住我的話。將我腳下的神器埋到地底深處，免得我們所有人的存在遭到註銷。眼前我倆或許相互為敵，事實上我們擁有一個更強大的共同敵人。
en_text: Kill me, obliterate my body and cast my name to the wind -- but you must heed me. Bury that which lies beneath my feet. It will undo us all. I may be your enemy in this, but we both have a greater foe.

tc_text: 別聽她的話，加百列。我們必須立刻殺死這隻「外星人」。
en_text: Do not listen, Gabriel. We must destroy this ‘alien’.

tc_text: 在她的話中，有許多值得我們學習的事情。
en_text: She knows much, much we need to learn.

tc_text: 她不過是個滿口謊言的騙子!別聽她的話，加百列!
en_text: What could she offer but lies! Do not trust her, Gabriel!

tc_text: 鑰匙!
不!去你的!
外星人，那個人是誰？他偷了什麼？
en_text: Who was that, alien? What did he steal!?

tc_text: 一把鑰匙。一條血腥通道的最後一步。
en_text: A key. The last step along a bloody path.

tc_text: 用來開什麼門的鑰匙？
註銷我們所有人的存在。
別再製造謎語了!
他偷了一把鑰匙，通往這個世界的陰暗倒影，通往表層之下的邪惡與恐怖。
en_text: He stole a key, a key to the shadows of this world, to the evil horror that lies within.

tc_text: 快告訴我這把鑰匙的作用!
en_text: Tell me what this key does!

tc_text: 你居然不知道？看來你的審判官瞞了你不少事情。他知道答案，去問他吧。
en_text: You do not know? Your Inquisitor keeps you on a short leash. He knows. Ask him.

tc_text: 你竟敢出言誹謗帝皇的忠臣。
en_text: How dare you speak ill of the Emperor’s loyal subject.

tc_text: 打從他抵達這裡的第一天起，他就已經明白一切了，或者恕我直言 -- 他根本沒離開過這裡。他趕在異變風暴襲來的前幾天突然出現，你不覺得實在太巧了嗎？還有，我又是怎麼知道他這個人的？人類，眼前的一切紛擾，不是你們可以獨力應付的。但是我們可以互相協助，共同阻止混沌勢力達成他們的目的。
en_text: He has known since he arrived, or should I say -- he never left. Do you not think it convenient he appeared from nowhere and landed on the cusp of a warp storm? Or that I know him already? Human, you are caught in events beyond your reckoning. But we can help one another and stop the forces of Chaos from succeeding.

tc_text: 你的作戰技能令我印象深刻，外星人。不過，就算我們的目標一致，我也不能冒險讓你有機會背叛我們。我已經浪費太多時間在你身上了…
en_text: You fought well, alien, and while we share common goals, I cannot risk your betrayal in this matter. You have squandered enough of my attentions….

tc_text: 不!不管情況變好或變壞，我和他的命運都已經分不開了。
en_text: No! For better or worse, we are locked in our course now, him and I.

tc_text: 你們的敵人已經在達湳巿區完成佈局，不過他們不會在那裡待太久。相信你也知道，我們的軍力太弱，無法與之交戰。
en_text: Your enemies have taken position in the Danaan city-sector. They will not remain there long. We are too weak to fight them. You have seen to that.

tc_text: 我們已經佔領了控制橋樑的戰略位置，接著要做的，是防禦敵人的攻擊，固守這個位置。
en_text: We've captured the Strategic Point controlling the bridge. Now we must hold it against the enemy.

tc_text: 只要再多固守橋樑戰略位置一分鐘就好了!兄弟們，罩子放亮點!
en_text: We only need to hold the bridge point for one more minute. Stay vigilant, brothers.

tc_text: 我們已經佔領了橋樑，現在要放下閘門了。
en_text: We have captured the bridge. The gates will now be lowered.

tc_text: 要前往紀念碑，我們得先找出過河的方法。
en_text: To reach the monument we need to find a way across the river.

tc_text: 神靈族應該已經將絕大部分過河的橋樑給摧毀了，但是他們一定會留下一個完好的橋自己使用，我們一定要找出那座橋在哪裡!
en_text: The Eldar have likely destroyed most of the bridges crossing the river, but they would leave at least one intact. We must find that bridge.

tc_text: 戰神分身正在撤退!
神靈族的出現，對我來說完全是一個謎。我過去曾和這些狡滑的外星人交手過， 卻從來沒弄懂過他們的行為。這點著實令我感到不安。歐克蠻人是較令我尊敬的敵人。他們再怎麼野蠻殘暴，至少還保有一種扭曲的榮譽感。他們願意和敵人在戰場上正面對決，但神靈族似乎鄙視這世間的一切事物。與神靈族對決，簡直像是在對迷霧和陰影開槍一樣。
en_text: The appearance of the Eldar is a complete mystery to me. I have dealt with these treacherous aliens in the past, and have never seen rhyme nor reason to their actions. It is unnerving. I prefer the Ork as an opponent. For all their brutality there is a twisted form of honor with the Orks. They meet their opponent on the field of battle, but the Eldar seem to have contempt for all. Fighting them is like shooting at mist and shadows.

tc_text: 關於混沌軍團挖掘出來的標記，伊薩多花了好幾個小時，才破解了標記上的神祕刻印，同時明白他們在找的究竟是什麼東西。他宣稱他們在找的是某種形式的鑰匙，卻無法確定他們想用這把鑰匙來開啟什麼。這已經不重要了。只要我們確定混沌軍團正在找這把鑰匙，那就夠了。這把鑰匙埋在聖羅孚‧馬爾這座荒城的地底下。
en_text: Isador spent hours interpreting the runes on the marker that was unearthed by the Forces of Chaos and has discovered what they seek. He claims it is some form of key, but to unlock what he is unsure. Never mind, it is enough that the Chaos Forces seek it. The Key lies in the ruined city of St. Lloovre Marr.

tc_text: 獻祭
阻止混沌軍團解開鑰匙的封印
en_text: Stop the Chaos before they are able to release the Key.

tc_text: 混沌軍隊想在那曾經神聖的神殿中，舉行一場邪惡儀式，以解開鑰匙的封印。我們必須立刻阻止他們。
en_text: The Chaos Forces are attempting to release the Key by performing a dark ritual on it in that once sacred temple. They must be stopped.

tc_text: 阻止混沌軍團解開鑰匙的封印
en_text: Stop the Chaos before they are able to release the Key.

tc_text: 派遣援軍前往前哨站，以免混沌軍隊攻下前哨站。
en_text: Reinforce the outpost before it is overwhelmed by Chaos forces.

tc_text: 前哨站絕對不能失守。快派遣軍隊前往前哨站，佔領那裡的建築物。要想越過那道難以通過的裂縫，我們必須讓星際戰士突擊小隊跳躍過去，或是利用軍用禮拜堂內終極戰士的深入攻擊能力，或者，也可以使用衛星收發站軍隊的投射能力。
en_text: The outpost must not fall. Get troops across to the Outpost and capture the structures there. To get across the impassible chasm we must jump Assault Marines across, or use the Deep Strike capability of the Terminators on the Chapel-Barracks, or the Drop Pod ability of our troops on the Orbital Relay.

tc_text: 派遣援軍前往前哨站，以免混沌軍隊攻下前哨站。
en_text: Reinforce the outpost before it is overwhelmed by Chaos forces.

tc_text: 請使用載具摧毀禮拜堂大門。
en_text: Use vehicles to destroy the Chapel Doors.

tc_text: 這個門曾經屬於偉大的神殿，現在經過強化之後，具有很強的防禦能力，只有最強大的武器，才能夠穿破這些大門。請使用地獄火無畏機兵和獵食者坦克摧毀這些大門。
en_text: The doors to that once great temple are heavily reinforced and defended. Only the strongest of weapons will be able to penetrate them. Use Hellfire Dreadnoughts and Predators to destroy the doors.

tc_text: 請使用載具摧毀禮拜堂大門。
en_text: Use vehicles to destroy the chapel doors.

tc_text: 清查叛變的帝國守衛軍。
帝國守衛軍已經投向混沌軍團的陣營了!快清查掃蕩這些叛徒!
en_text: The Imperial Guard have turned to Chaos! Cleanse them!

tc_text: 清查叛變的帝國守衛軍。
清查禮拜堂的混沌印記。
en_text: Cleanse the Chaos Taint at the Chapel.

tc_text: 曾經盛極一時的禮拜堂，已經遭到了混沌軍隊的玷污。我們一定要從這原先是聖地的地方，將這些玷污清除乾淨。快摧毀混沌軍隊吧!
en_text: The once great Chapel has been tainted by the forces of Chaos. They must be cleansed from this once Holy land. Destroy the Chaos Forces.

tc_text: 清查叛變的帝國守衛軍。
禮拜堂
任務 8 - 任務開始
任務 8 - 摧毀禮拜堂大門
任務 8 - 摧毀帝國守衛軍
任務 8 - 已清查混沌軍隊
任務 8 - 已救回前哨站
任務 8 - 前哨站幾乎已摧毀
血鴉部隊第三連隊
阿爾發軍團異端戰士
血鴉部隊第三連隊支援小隊
阿爾發軍團惡魔引擎
可惡的帝國守衛軍
大人，血鴉部隊正從南方逼進。
en_text: My Lord, Blood Ravens approach from the South.

tc_text: 他們何以能夠如近接近？!
en_text: How did they get so close!?!

tc_text: 大人，他們不過是些惹人厭的蒼蠅罷了。我們手中握有鑰匙，又有充裕的軍力，足以將血鴉部隊阻擋在屍體堆成的人牆之外。所以，我們大可安心地完成這場儀式。
en_text: My Lord. These flies are minor annoyances. We have the Key and ample bodies to imprison the Blood Ravens behind a wall of corpses while we complete the ceremony.

tc_text: 你的保證絲毫無法讓我安心，辛吉。
en_text: Your assurances leave me cold, Sindri.

tc_text: 每次事情發生轉折，最後總是證明我的話是對的，大人。我們目前再安全也不過了 --
en_text: Events have proven my words true at every turn, My Lord. We are not in danger --

tc_text: 這些事情只是證明你實在太幸運了，巫師。你這種令人倒胃的樂觀精神究竟是打哪兒來的？
en_text: Events have proven you fortunate, Sorcerer. To what do you owe this present bout of nauseous optimism?

tc_text: 我們剛收到一則新訊息，巴爾大人。我們有一批新的盟友，隨時準備背叛血鴉部隊並投靠我們。
en_text: We have received a message, Lord Bale. We have a new ally who is more than ready to betray the Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 太好了。就讓我們準備迎接這一切，同時把這個白痴拖下去處理掉。
en_text: Excellent. Prepare for what is to come. And dispose of this idiot.

tc_text: 為什麼？我做錯了什麼事？
因為你愚蠢到私下透露壞消息給巴爾大人知道。我們這裡不容許笨蛋的存在。
en_text: You were stupid enough to personally deliver ill news to Lord Bale. And we cannot abide stupidity.

tc_text: 馬歇爾弟兄，請說。
混沌星際戰士軍團在地面製造了一道將城巿撕成兩半的裂縫，並占領了一座神殿。艦長，這場戰爭很快就會波及我們。
en_text: The Chaos forces have rent an impassible chasm through the center of the city, and have taken up position in a temple. The battle is upon us Captain.

tc_text: 我們很快就會趕到你們的所在位置。請守住那道裂縫，神殿交給我來處理。
en_text: We are arriving at your position momentarily. Hold the chasm, I will deal with the temple.

tc_text: 遵命。
除非是帝皇本人要我受苦，否則我是感受不到疼痛的。
en_text: You are finished Apothecary. Had the Emperor not intended I suffer, then I would feel no pain.

tc_text: 托斯審判官已經遵照你的要求抵達了。
en_text: Inquisitor Toth has arrived at your request.

tc_text: 我方偵查兵怎麼說？
en_text: And what do our scouts say?

tc_text: 禁衛團的聲東擊西策略相當成功，而混沌領主和他的手下也都逃跑了。但是我們目前仍在追蹤他們的行動，並審問我們所捉到的禁衛團叛徒。
en_text: The Guard's distraction was a success, the Chaos Lord and his host escaped. We are, however, tracking their movements, and 'questioning' some of the traitor Guard that we captured.

tc_text: 我居然沒有看出這件最重要的事？我簡直是瞎了!
en_text: How could I not have seen this? How is it I am blind when it matters the most?

tc_text: 你指的是這些禁衛團的叛徒，還是在你的家鄉塞利尼行星上的滅種行動？
en_text: Are you referring to these traitorous Guardsmen, or the destruction of your homeworld, Cyrene?

tc_text: 早在罪惡擴散之前，我就應該要發現的。然而，這麼長的一段時間，我就像瞎了一樣。在審判團的緊急命令下，我親手毀滅了自己的家鄉，眼睜睜看著這麼多無辜的百姓在神聖的火焰風暴中葬送性命。現在... 我又來到這裡，走上另一道門階，手中再度握著一把劊子手的斧頭。
en_text: I should have seen the rot before it spread. Instead, I was blind for far too long. I put my own world to the torch. I killed with the Inquisition's eager sanction and watched too many innocents die in a holy firestorm. And yet... here I am again, at yet another doorstep, with the executioner's blade in my very hand.

tc_text: 一顆不允許任何疑惑存在的心是十分可貴的，加百列。或許我們能藉此找出... 我們兩個人都需要的真理。
en_text: Blessed is the mind too small for doubt, Gabriel. Perhaps there is truth in there... for the both of us.

tc_text: 我仍然堅信不移，我的老友。我仍然相信黃金王座的至高權力，以及帝國血統的純潔無瑕…
en_text: I still believe, old friend. I believe in the sovereign might of the Golden Throne and in the purity of the Imperium...

tc_text: 但是，你已經不再相信你自己了。
en_text: But, you have lost faith in yourself.

tc_text: 我只相信我親眼看見的事物，伊薩多。
en_text: Only in what I see, Isador. Only in what I see.

tc_text: 那麼，你親眼看到了什麼，艦長？
en_text: And what is it that you see, Captain?

tc_text: 我看到一堆叛徒和騙子，只關心自己的信念，置帝皇的意志於不顧。
en_text: I see conspirators and liars more concerned with their own agenda than the will of Emperor.

tc_text: 這種話是嚇不倒我的，艦長。
en_text: I am not so easily cowed by such displays, Captain.

tc_text: 你對我撒謊，讓我的手下平白無故犠牲!
en_text: You lied to me and cost me men!

tc_text: 至少他們死的時候，血液仍是純淨的!如果你得靠反唇相譏來消除罪惡感的話，那麼他們的死亡顯然是由你造成的!我早就警告過你，要你離開深淵星，避開即將到來的異變風暴。
en_text: Better they die, their blood pure! If you feel warranted in handing out recriminations, then their deaths are on your head! I warned you to leave this world, to leave Tartarus for the warp storm.

tc_text: 你仍然沒說實話，審判官。我已經知道，早在我們抵達以前，你就已經在這裡了。
en_text: Your words still ring untrue, Inquisitor. I know you were here before we arrived.

tc_text: 我不習慣向別人解釋我的動機，艦長。但是，你說的沒錯，在你們抵達以前，我就已經在這裡了，為的是要找出那些讓我每晚惡夢連連的邪惡事物。
en_text: I am not in the habit of explaining my actions, Captain. But, yes. I was here before you arrived, stalking after horrors to strip my nights of their dreams.

tc_text: 和混沌軍團所尋找的邪惡事物完全相同。
en_text: The same horrors that the legions of Chaos seek.

tc_text: 在深淵星上是沒有所謂的巧合的，艦長。只有這場風暴，才能將忠實信徒和異端區分開來。
en_text: On Tartarus, there are no coincidences, Captain. There is only the storm that winnows the faithful from the heretic.

tc_text: 托斯，我們是忠實信徒嗎？我們是帝皇的忠誠子民嗎？且讓我們揚棄歧見。他們來這裡的目的是什麼，托斯？你來這裡的目的又是什麼？
en_text: Are we faithful men, Toth? Good servants of the Emperor? It is time for us to put aside our differences. What do they seek, Toth? What do you seek, here?

tc_text: 這是一顆遭到詛咒的行星，艦長。數千年前，一件屬於古老邪惡力量的神器被遺留在這裡。幾個世紀以來，混沌星際戰士軍團一直在這裡尋找這件神器，卻一直無法拼湊出完整的答案。
en_text: This world is cursed, Captain. Thousands of years ago an artifact of ancient, evil power was lost here. The forces of Chaos seek this artifact. They've sought it for centuries, but have never held all the pieces of the puzzle.

tc_text: 現在他們終於找到答案了。
一支帝國探勘隊伍在地底發現第一道標記，這個消息不知為何傳到敵人耳中。他們對整個行星瞭若指掌，再加上第一道標記，要找其他線索只是時間問題。
en_text: An Imperial excavation team uncovered the first marker, and word somehow got to the enemy. With the knowledge of the exact planet, and the first marker, it was a simple matter to uncover the remainder.

tc_text: 現在，他們只差最後一道線索，就能將這件神器從地底挖掘出來。
en_text: Now they have the last piece necessary, a key to unearth the artifact itself.

tc_text: 這件神器到底是什麼？
一顆名叫「詛咒之石」的石頭。石頭裡禁錮了一隻無比邪惡的生物，也就是混沌本身。這顆石頭中禁錮的是一隻具有無比力量的惡魔。
en_text: A stone. Called the Maledictum. It contains a creature of great evil, a creature of Chaos itself. The stone imprisons a daemon, one of untold power.

tc_text: 深淵星的居民怎麼可能不知道這件事？這些神器就埋在他們自己的城巿底下。
en_text: How is it possible that the citizens of Tartarus did not know this? These artifacts lay buried beneath their own cities.

tc_text: 據我推測，「詛咒之石」中的惡魔雖然遭到禁錮，卻仍然保有一定的力量。它仍然可以透過幻象和讓人發瘋的力量來影響人們。
en_text: From what I surmise, the daemon within the Maledictum may be imprisoned, but it is not powerless. It can still influence people with visions and madness.

tc_text: 根據《Registratum Malfeas》中的古文記載，無數年前，在星際戰士軍團剛成軍不久時，一場異變風暴曾經襲捲這座星系。那場風暴讓這顆行星上的居民全都發瘋了。
en_text: The ancient text in the Registratum Malfeas speaks of a warp storm that visited this system at an age when many Space Marine Chapters were still young. The storm drove the inhabitants of this planet insane.

tc_text: 受到惡魔的影響，他們將標記隱藏起來，並將「詛咒之石」埋在地底下，以免被像我這樣的獵人找到。當殖民者回到這個世界時，他們對這裡的危險一無所覺。
en_text: Under the daemon's influence, they hid the markers and buried the Maledictum, to protect it against hunters like myself. When colonists returned to this world they remained ignorant of the perils.

tc_text: 他們在這塊邪惡的土地上大興土木，完全不知道地底埋了什麼東西。
en_text: They built over the dark places, never knowing what lay beneath.

tc_text: 那麼神靈族呢？他們前來尋找這股力量，是為了自己嗎？
en_text: And the Eldar? Did they seek this power for themselves?

tc_text: 不。當時就是他們最先將惡魔禁錮起來的。神靈族不希望任何人得知這顆石頭的下落，因此才會干涉我們尋找這顆石頭的行動。
en_text: No. It was they who imprisoned the daemon in the first place. The Eldar fiercely safeguard knowledge of the stone against all others, going so far as to interfere in our efforts to find it.

tc_text: 神靈族是混沌軍團最古老的敵人，所以他們將自己視為唯一能夠抵抗這顆石頭的邪惡影響的人種。我們已經領教過他們這種傲慢自大的態度了。
en_text: As Chaos' most ancient enemy, they see themselves as the only capable defense against its influence. And we have paid for their arrogance.

tc_text: 我相信我們仍有時間能夠遏止這場災難。
en_text: I assume there is still time to avert disaster.

tc_text: 災難已經發生了。「詛咒之石」的力量能讓人發瘋，也能讓忠實的信徒背叛。如你所見，這件事已經發生在許多帝國防衛軍隊員和當地居民身上了。你和你的手下也已經受到影響，我可以感覺得到。
en_text: This is already a disaster. The power of the Maledictum is enough to turn the faithful and drive men mad. Many of the Imperial Guard and local population have already turned, as you've seen. It's affecting you and your men as well, I can feel it.

tc_text: 「詛咒之石」正在召喚異變風暴入侵這個星系，打算把我們和它一起困在這裡。如此一來，我們就得全部屈服在它的邪惡意志之下。這也是為什麼我一直催促你離開的原因，而且我到現在仍如此堅持。
en_text: It is calling the Warp Storm to eclipse this system. It wants to trap us here, with it, so it can force even the best of us to serve its twisted will. This is why I encouraged you to leave. Why I still encourage it.

tc_text: 你知道我辦不到。我是不會向邪惡的力量屈服的!
en_text: You know I cannot do that. I will not shrink away in the face of evil!

tc_text: 我也一樣。夠了，該是我們停止爭論，一同並肩作戰的時候了。只有團結一致，我們才有機會找出這顆「詛咒之石」，並將其消滅。
en_text: I would do no less. Enough. Let us end this bickering and face our enemy united. Together we have a better chance of finding, and destroying the Maledictum.

tc_text: 真是一群廢物。你一個人就能獨自駕馭的力量，也能把他們嚇成這樣。
en_text: They are weak, terrified of the power that you alone are strong enough to control.

tc_text: 它是你的了!
只要伸出手，它就是你的了!
但是他們居然想要消滅它，一群無知的笨蛋!
en_text: But they mean to destroy it, those small-minded fools!

tc_text: 想想你能用它為帝皇做多少好事!
en_text: Think of the good you could do in the name of the Emperor!

tc_text: 想想你將會擁有多大的力量!
en_text: Think of the power you could wield!

tc_text: 只要伸出手，它就是你的了!
en_text: It is all yours, for the taking.

tc_text: 詛咒之石… 是… 我的。
這些叛教徒在搞什麼鬼？
en_text: What foul acts are these heathens involved in?

tc_text: 他們正在舉行一場儀式，準備解開鑰匙的封印。我們必須立刻阻止他們。
en_text: They are performing a ceremony to release the Key from its bindings. We must stop them.

tc_text: 沒錯，我們必須衝破神殿大門。唉，那座神殿曾經如此榮耀。看來他們製造了一道將整座城巿撕成兩半的裂縫，將我們阻擋在另一邊。
en_text: Yes. We will need to break down the mighty doors of that once glorious temple. It appears they have rent a chasm across the city, stopping us from reaching the other side.

tc_text: 這裡有一座設有「機器殿堂」的前哨站。我們可以在此取得即將派上用場的載具。
en_text: An outpost with Machine Cults located here gives us access to the vehicles we will surely require.

tc_text: 快去占領那座前哨站，並阻止這場儀式!
en_text: Secure the outpost, and stop that ceremony!

tc_text: 報告艦長，我們已經占領前哨站了。
這座神殿的大門具有無比堅固的設計，只有最強力的衝擊才能攻破。
en_text: The doors to this temple were designed to stop all but the most violent impacts.

tc_text: 若要攻破這座大門，我們必須利用地獄火和獵食者坦克的威力。
en_text: To bring them down, we will need the power of Hellfire's and Predators.

tc_text: 衝破大門了!快!趁他們還沒完成儀式之前阻止他們!
en_text: The doors are broken! With haste! Stop them before they can finish!

tc_text: 大人!帝國防衛軍抵達這裡了。
en_text: Sir! The Imperial Guard have arrived.

tc_text: 勝利是我們的了... 等等…
他們為何不發動攻擊？這算是什麼技倆？星際戰士，立刻解決這些叛教徒!
en_text: Why do they not attack? What betrayal is this? Space Marines, cleanse these heretics!

tc_text: 在裂縫對面的第二個基地就快要被摧毀了!我們得趕快提供支援，現在就要!
en_text: Our secondary base across the chasm is about to be destroyed! We must provide assistance, now!

tc_text: 禮拜堂大門已經沒那麼堅固了!
en_text: The Chapel doors have been weakened!

tc_text: 禮拜堂大門已經撐不了多久了!
en_text: The Chapel doors will not hold much longer!

tc_text: 我們的終極敵人在千鈞一髮之際，從我們手中奪走了那把鑰匙。傲慢的神靈族真是該死。要不是我們奪取鑰匙的過程有所延遲，我們早就成功阻止他們獲得毀滅力量了。我們仍然不知道這把鑰匙的功用為何。據神靈族的女巫表示，托斯審判官握有這一切的答案。如果這是真的話，那他可有得解釋了，至少他得解釋一下，為何他要刻意隱瞞那些可以讓我們更輕易打敗混沌軍團的資訊。難道他已經墮落了嗎？真令人無法想像一位帝國審判官竟會墮落於渾沌。
en_text: The Great Enemy managed to steal the Key from out of our very grasp. Damn the Eldar and their arrogance. Had we not been delayed in reaching the Key we could have denied the ruinous powers their prize. We still have no idea what this Key does. According to the Eldar witch Inquisitor Toth holds these answers. If this is true then he has a good deal to explain, the least of which is not why he would withhold information that could allow us to better fight the Forces of Chaos. Could he be tainted? The thought is unimaginable.

tc_text: 更重要的是，我們現在知道自己面對的不只是混沌邪教徒而已，而是一整個混沌星際戰士叛軍團，也就是數萬年前背叛帝皇的那批星際戰士。幸好我們的偵查兵曾跟蹤他們的巫師及其隨扈回到他們的作戰基地，地點與我們目前的所在位置十分接近。我已經等不及要將這些瀆神的叛徒送上黃泉之路了。
en_text: Even more concerning, we now know that we face more than mere Chaos Cults, but members of an actual Traitor Legion, the very Marines who turned against our Emperor some ten millennia ago. Luckily our scouts were able to track their Sorcerer and his entourage back to their base of operations. It is located not far from our current position. I relish in the opportunity to bring death to these blasphemous traitors.

en_text: Four Relics encircle the Sacred Temple. We must take these back from the foul forces of Chaos if we are to find victory this day.

tc_text: 我們一定要從邪惡的巴爾大人軍隊手中，奪回這四個遺址的掌控權!不奪回就誓不罷休!
en_text: We must rest control of the four Relics from the vile forces of Lord Bale! We can not stop until they are ours!

tc_text: 摧毀混沌基地
只要能夠摧毀阿爾發軍團的電力供給基地，一定就能奪回這四個遺址。
en_text: If we can destroy the Alpha Legion's power base, the Relics are sure to fall.

tc_text: 這些遺址一定都有極堅強的防禦，但是只要能夠破壞阿爾發軍團的基礎設施，他們就絕對不是我們的對手!
en_text: The Relics are sure to be well defended. If we cripple the Alpha Legion's infrastructure, they will be no match for our might.

tc_text: 固守遺址
我們已經成功地佔領了遺址!現在只要能固守遺址，就能破解阿爾發軍團的魔法。
en_text: The Relics are ours! We must hold on to them to break the Alpha Legion's spell.

tc_text: 雖然已經佔領了遺址，但是戰爭還沒結束。我們要給審判官一點時間，讓他破解混沌巫師的邪惡魔法。
en_text: The Relics have been secured but the fight is not over. We must give the Inquisitor time to penetrate the Chaos Sorcerer's foul enchantments.

深淵星巳經失去控制，超過百分之六十的人口已經落入了歐克蠻人的勢力，剩下的帝國防衛軍正準備做最後的抵抗去保護從深淵星逃出的難民。我們在羅孚-馬爾遇到的反叛帝國防衛軍並不是唯一的背叛者，接近百分之ニ十五的防衛軍已經背叛了他們昔日的戰友，形成瘋狂的血教徒組織來伏擊和分散敵人。顯然的，我曾經看過了混沌勢力對人心的影響，但從未同時影響如此多人。帝國艦隊已佔頜了軌道，而血鴉部隊擁有戰艦和戰艦「怒禱號」，他們等待我派運輸機去載所有的血鴉部隊。我們已經準備離開這個天數已盡的星球，在我們行動之前有幾件事必需先做。我們要阻止那混沌勢力，並摧毀詛咒之石，誓死達成任務。
en_text: Tartarus is a planet gone mad. Over 60% of the population has fallen to the Ork forces, and what's left of the Imperial Guard are fighting a desperate losing battle to protect those that remain as they leave the planet. The traitor Imperial Guard we encountered in Lloovre Marr are not the only ones. Nearly 25% of the Guard has treacherously turned on their former comrades, forming maniacal blood cults that ambush and carve up their fellow guardsmen. Certainly I have seen the powers of Chaos affect the minds of men, but never so many at once, and never so quickly. The Imperial Navy holds orbit, and the Blood Ravens' own Battle Barge, the Litany of Fury, awaits a call from me to send transports to pick up all Blood Raven forces on a moment's notice. We are prepared to leave this doomed planet, but before we go there are things we must do first. Put a stop to the Forces of Chaos, and destroy the Maledictum, or die trying.

艦長已經前去鞏固南方防線的安全，並將攻破敵方主要防衛的工作交給我們。
en_text: The Captain has gone to secure the southern flank and left it to us to breach the main defenses.

tc_text: 我們絕不能讓他失望，明白嗎？
en_text: We will not fail him, is this understood?

tc_text: 帝皇萬歲!
我們已經登陸了。現在必須占領並鞏固這個位置，然後開始和敵人對決。
en_text: We have made landfall. Let us secure this location and then take the fight to the enemy.

tc_text: 我軍已經順利登陸。現在必須立刻占領並鞏固這個位置。我們可以以此地為據點，對神殿發動第二次攻擊，並阻止混沌軍團將「詛咒之石」從地底挖掘出來。只希望我們來得不算太遲。
en_text: We have made landfall. Secure this location immediately. From here we can launch our second assault upon the Temple, and stop the Forces of Chaos from uncovering the Maledictum. I only pray that we are not too late.

tc_text: 防衛隊絕不能被打倒。如果讓混沌軍團佔領這些設施，我們將無法為帝國防衛軍補充軍備!
en_text: Do not let the Defense Force get overwhelmed. If Chaos captures the facility, we’ll lose the ability to replenish the Guardsmen ranks!

tc_text: 小心!這是陷阱!
en_text: Look out it is a trap!

tc_text: 那是混沌領主!把他交給我吧!
en_text: There is the Chaos Lord! Leave him to me!

tc_text: 在通往權力的道路上…
...總是免不了犧牲和痛苦。那些為了追求權力而不惜付出自己鮮血的人，終將獲得宇宙的回報。
en_text: ...and pain. The universe rewards those willing to spill their life’s blood for the promise of power.

tc_text: 辛吉!
大人，怎麼了？!
帝國防衛軍叛軍已經戰敗了。
en_text: The Traitor Imperial Guardsmen have fallen.

tc_text: 這麼快？我以為他們可以撐得更久一點。
en_text: So quickly, I expected them to last a bit longer.

tc_text: 他們之中有些人背叛了我們，轉而投靠血鴉部隊。從現在起，我們已和他們分道揚鑣。
en_text: Some of them have betrayed our position to the Blood Ravens. They are on their way here, now.

tc_text: 繼續禱告。我一會兒就回來。
en_text: Continue chanting. I shan't be long.

tc_text: 你提到的情況是神的旨意，大人。一切都在按照計劃進行中。待我將最後這道障礙除去後，你就會親眼看到我們的計劃一一實現。
en_text: The circumstances you mention are divine providence, My Lord. Everything is as planned. Once I dispense with this last obstacle, you will have that which we have plotted and schemed to achieve.

tc_text: 但是，如果星際戰士趕在我們蒙受「神的旨意」眷顧之前抵達呢？
en_text: And if the Space Marines should arrive before 'providence' graces us?

tc_text: 那麼，我們便應該扮演好主人的角色，為他們提供一頓血腥饗宴。我們必須不計代價，阻止他們前來干擾我們。這場儀式十分複雜，容不得一點差錯。
en_text: Then we shall play the good hosts and indulge them in a bloody feast. At all costs, however, keep them from interfering. This is a delicate process that can not well afford any more interruptions.

tc_text: 還有，容我向你建議，請務必傾全力對付血鴉部隊。他們對這場儀式的貢獻無人能及，特別是我們雙方如此接近時。
en_text: And, might I advise you throw everything at the Blood Ravens. Everything. Their every contribution in this matter is paramount, especially when we are so close.

tc_text: 剛才說到哪裡？嗯，通往權力的路上，總免不了犧牲。
en_text: Now, where were we? Ah yes… power demands sacrifice.

tc_text: 相信你們已經明白我們的敵人是誰，以及我們是為何而戰。在幾個帝國防衛軍團員的協助下，我們將對神殿發動雙面夾擊。這幾個團員對帝皇仍然忠心耿耿。我們必須阻止敵人將「詛咒之石」挖掘出來。
en_text: Now you know what we fight and why. We will launch a two-pronged assault against the Temple with the help of several Guardsmen units who remain loyal to the Emperor. We must stop our adversaries from uncovering the Maledictum.

tc_text: 跟我來吧。你們有新的命令。我們知道一條通往神殿內部的祕道。別告訴別人…
en_text: Come with me. You have new orders. We know of a hidden way into the Temple. Tell no one else...

tc_text: ...這是個驚喜。
辛吉!辛吉!!!
巴爾大人…
儀式失敗了，保護石頭的封印仍未解除。但這早就是我意料中事。我們需要舉行一場更大規模的活祭。
en_text: The ritual failed to break the protective seal guarding the stone. But then, I already anticipated it would not work. In fact, I counted on it. We require a larger sacrifice.

tc_text: 時候到了。放開他。
好大的膽子，你這個巫師!
大人。請別忘記…
...在通往權力的道路上，總是免不了犧牲。在此由衷感謝你的犧牲。
en_text: ...all power demands sacrifice. Thank you for yours.

tc_text: 如同我承諾過的一般，只要伸出手，它就是你的了。
en_text: There it is, as I promised. Yours for the taking.

tc_text: 老友？
消滅智庫館長伊薩多這名叛徒
伊薩多弟兄已經淪為混沌邪惡力量的爪牙。我們絕不會坐視他的背叛行為。請立刻消滅他。
en_text: Brother Isador has fallen to the evil of Chaos. His traitorous actions will not go unpunished. Destroy him.

tc_text: 刺殺伊薩多
徹底殲滅混沌星際戰士軍團
en_text: Destroy all of the Chaos forces

tc_text: 混沌星際戰士軍團已經徹底玷污了這片土地。請將他們全數消滅。
en_text: Chaos forces have fully tainted this land. Destroy them all.

tc_text: 刺殺伊薩多

只有軍隊司令加百列才有膽識與超級惡魔血神恐虐正面對峙，並保住性命。請命令軍隊司令攻擊並剷除這名恐怖的嗜血狂魔。
en_text: Only the Force Commander Gabriel has the will to stand face to face with the Greater Daemon of Khorne and live. Order the Force Commander to attack and slay the horrendos Bloodthirster.

有什麼消息嗎，士官？
混沌星際戰士已經撤退到這座城巿中，並挖掘壕溝進行防衛。真要發生什麼事，也一定是發生在這裡。
en_text: The Chaos Marines retreated to this city and entrenched themselves. Whatever is to happen, will happen here.

tc_text: 艦長呢？
他一心只想要復仇，不管我說什麼，都無法平息他的憤怒。
en_text: I would call him starved for vengeance, but my words are inadequate to encompass his fury.

tc_text: 立刻完成準備。我們已經浪費太多時間，也已經為此付出代價。
en_text: Make ready. We have wasted enough time, and suffered for it.

tc_text: 這點我同意，但我們對敵人一無所知，也不明白他們的意圖為何。巴爾不過是某個人利用的工具。巴爾叫他「辛吉」。
en_text: Agreed, but we know nothing of our enemy or his intentions. Bale was someone’s pawn. Sindri, he called him.

tc_text: 我擔心的不是辛吉，而是依薩多。他已經墮落了... 我將會親自處理他的。
en_text: Sindri is not my concern. Isador is. He has fallen... and he will find me at his doorstep.

tc_text: 現在你總算明白我的初衷了。我得承認，發現墮落的人是伊薩多時，真是讓我大吃一驚。
en_text: Now you know the full weight of my original concerns. I must admit, I was surprised that it was Isador who succumbed.

tc_text: 我明白。你原本懷疑的是我。
沒錯。你非得具有鐵石一般的心腸，才能忍心將自己的家園和親人付之一炬。我感覺到你的心中有混沌的種粹正在發芽，而你又似乎過度急著想要揭開這顆行星的祕密。
en_text: It takes either steel or rot to willingly condemn your own world, your very family, to the torch. I sensed the seed of Chaos in your midst and you seemed too eager to uncover this planet's secrets.

tc_text: 但我太專注於你道德方面的瑕疵，以致於我忽視了伊薩多才是真正的罪惡源頭。
en_text: But I was so certain the taint stemmed from you that I failed to notice its true source in Isador.

tc_text: 我錯了，艦長。
這件事情可以留到以後再討論，審判官。現在我們必須全力對付眼前的敵人。
en_text: We will discuss the matter another time, Inquisitor. For now, we have an enemy who demands our ministrations.

tc_text: 是你允許我拿走這顆石頭的。你還真是個傻瓜，居然如此信守承諾。但我決定把詛咒之石帶走。畢竟你的力量太弱，承受不起這顆石頭的恩賜。現在，我就要利用它的力量來毀滅你。
en_text: You allowed me to take the stone. You were true to your word, and for that, you are a fool. Better I keep the Maledictum with me. You are too weak to stomach its gifts. And now I will use its power to destroy you.

tc_text: 巴爾大人就和你一様愚蠢，以為我毫無反擊能力，以為情況全在自己的掌握之中。
en_text: Lord Bale was likewise foolish in believing me defenseless, believing himself in control.

tc_text: 快讓它停下來!
歐克蠻人自以為他們的能力在我之上。但我必須利用他們的傲慢自大，來謀取我的利益。
en_text: The Orks thought more of their abilities then they did of me. But I relied on their arrogance at my benefit alone.

tc_text: 求求你!
至於你嘛，你居然敢背信於我，所以我應該要立刻取你性命，以免你對我造成更大的威脅。
en_text: You, however. You hold promise, and for that I should let you die before you prove too great a threat.

tc_text: 不過我已經在你身上投下了這麼多心血。再者，就算再給你一百年的時間，你也無法阻止我取得我應有的榮耀。我現在必須開始準備了。如果你還有餘力的話，就快去除掉你那位艦長吧。
en_text: But I have invested too much effort into you. And, had you a century to prepare, you would still be too late to stop me from achieving my glory. Now, I must prepare. Attend to the Captain's demise, if you are capable.

tc_text: 你憑什麼認為我會聽你的話？
en_text: What makes you think I will do your bidding?

tc_text: 你沒有其他選擇。你的艦長是個鍥而不捨的人，你比任何人都更清楚這點。你不久之後就得和他正面對決，而這對我來說實在太有利了。
en_text: You have little choice. Your Captain is quite tenacious; you more than anyone know that. You will have to deal with him, and that benefits me.

tc_text: 對了，謝謝你提供詛咒之石給我。
en_text: Oh, and thank you for delivering the Maledictum.

tc_text: 你不能在這個時候背棄我!
我當然可以，而且也正打算這麼做。至少我替你找了一些陪葬品…
en_text: But I can, and I do. At least I leave you in good company...

tc_text: 現在就向我證明你的價值吧!快去釋放你弟兄們體內流著的鮮血!快去釋放他們的鮮血... 並奉獻給血神!!!
en_text: Now prove yourself worthy! Go, spill the blood of those who were your brothers! Spill the Blood! BLOOD.. FOR THE BLOOD GOD!!!

tc_text: 你真是愚蠢，加百列。你明知自己不是我的對手。
en_text: You are a fool, Gabriel. You know you are no match for me.

tc_text: 在所有弟兄當中，為何偏偏是你？你不應如此軟弱的!
en_text: Of all my Brothers, why you? You were stronger than this!

tc_text: 沒錯，我的力量遠超過你的想像。我的一舉一動，連宇宙都為之震顫。連諸神都知道我的名字!
en_text: I am stronger than you ever imagined. I can feel the universe tremble at my approach. Even the GODS know my name!

tc_text: 沒有人會記得你叫什麼名字的，叛徒。我以性命擔保!
en_text: No one will remember you, traitor. I will see to that!

tc_text: 太可悲了!在你的意志遭到疑惑籠罩之前，你曾是何其崇高的一個人。後來你居然在塞利尼行星上執行審判，也不管對方有罪或無罪，一律格殺勿論。你這個既悲慘又沒用的笨蛋!屠殺數百萬人、背叛自己親人的感受如何？
en_text: Pathetic! You were great once, before doubt addled your will. Before you rendered judgment on Cyrene. Before you murdered the innocent and guilty, all in one stroke. You weak, sorry fool! How does it feel to have slain millions? To have betrayed your own family?

tc_text: 我並未背叛任何人!
無辜的人死去，是為了保有人性的尊嚴。我終結了他們的苦難，正如同我即將終結你的苦難一般。
en_text: Innocents die so that humanity may live. I ended their suffering, as I will end yours.

tc_text: 我無法置信… 我居然被你打敗了。加百列，我真是大錯特錯。我以為我已將強大到能夠駕馭它的力量。我不過是想要使用這股力量，為帝國做一些好事。請你一定要明白這一點。請讓我有機會彌補自己的錯誤，請給我贖罪的機會。
en_text: You have beaten me. I cannot believe it. I was wrong, Gabriel. So wrong. I thought I was strong, strong enough to control it. I wanted to use the power for good, for the Imperium. You must see that. You must give me the chance to make amends, to seek redemption.

tc_text: 如果你想要的是贖罪的機會，那麼我現在就賜給你吧。
en_text: If redemption is what you seek then that is what I will give you.

tc_text: 這就是叛徒的下場。給我仔細聽好，絕對不要意圖謀反，否則最後就是這樣的下場。
en_text: This is the fate of traitors. Remember this, and do not stray. If you do, I will be ready to render you the same service.

tc_text: 帝皇... 他到底被什麼樣的惡魔給附身了？
en_text: By the Emperor... what foul daemon has he summoned?

tc_text: 弟兄們!我們一起出發，將這隻惡魔送回地獄中吧!
en_text: To me Brothers! Let us send this spawn back where it belongs!

tc_text: 初次見到智庫館長伊薩多‧艾奇歐時，我還只是個下士，手下連一個小兵也沒有。我當時已為帝皇效命三十年了，卻還未取得資深軍官的榮譽。我見識過智庫館長及其學徒的能力，但是論及天賦、才能和決心，無人能與伊薩多相比。接著我又在戰場上發現，除了上述優點以外，他的知識和智慧同樣無人能及。他真是個了不起的人。他的名字將會永存於世。
en_text: I first met the Librarian Isador Akios when I was still a Battle Brother with no men at my command. Over 30 years in service and I had not even attained veteran status. I had seen the power of the Librarians and their neophytes, but none who wielded the kind of raw power, ability, and will that Isador possessed. In battle I discovered that these traits were matched only by his knowledge and wisdom. He was truly a great man. He will be missed.

tc_text: 現在我就要去消滅這股佔據伊薩多心智的邪惡力量。帝皇，請賜給我力量。
en_text: Now I go to destroy the traitorous individual who inhabits Isador's form. Emperor give me strength.

tc_text: 昔日老友

深淵星已形同一片焦土。這裡的人民不是早已撤離，就是慘死在歐克蠻人的刀口下。城巿只剩下斷垣殘壁，到處都是熊熊火焰。地面已經被異星人、叛徒和叛教徒的鮮血所玷污，再也無法恢復原本的純淨。除了瀆神的異教徒，以及即將消滅他們的英勇的星際戰士以外，這裡已經什麼都不剩了。在這黑暗的一刻，在這黑暗的星球上，我們仍然不會放過帝皇的敵人。我們將會讓他們明白，即使身處黑暗的地獄，我們仍不容許異端的存在，現在不會，永遠也不會。
en_text: The planet of Tartarus is ravaged. Its population has fled or died under the foot of the Ork. Its cities are smashed and burning. It's very ground is irrevocably tainted with the blood of aliens, traitors, and cultists. There is nothing left, nothing but blasphemous heathens, and the mighty space marines who will destroy them. In this dark place, in this dark hour, we will stand against the enemies of the Emperor. And they will know that not even here on this desecrated infernal rock will we suffer the existence of the heretic. Not now. Not ever.

tc_text: 消滅歐克蠻人
歐克蠻人也捲入了這場戰事之中，讓情況更加混亂。雖然歐克蠻人絕對不是混沌軍團的盟友，卻會對我們構成妨礙。
en_text: As if the madness wasn't enough, the Orks have joined the fray. While they are no friend of Chaos, they will only get in our way.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人？這真是太瘋狂了!弟兄們，全世界都與我們為敵!請使出全力，別讓這些噁心的怪物有活命的機會!
en_text: Orks? What is this insanity! Brothers, the world is against us! Steal yourselves and let no foul beast survive!

tc_text: 深淵星巳被破壞，行星上的人全都被惡土星人殺掉或逃到其他星球。所有城市都被戰火摧毀。地面上的東西都被外星人，叛國賊和異教份子破壞到不可回復原狀的地步。行星上已什麽也沒有剩下來了；只剩下一個被褻瀆了的天堂。但是非凡的星際戰士將會把它消滅。在這黑暗的地方，黑暗的時刻，我們將會挺身抵抗帝皇的敵人。他們將會知道我們不能容忍在這片已被褻瀆了的邪惡的土地上沉淪。現在不會，永遠也不會。
en_text: The planet of Tartarus is ravaged. Its population has fled or died under the foot of the Ork. Its cities are smashed and burning. Its very ground is irrevocably tainted with the blood of aliens, traitors, and cultists. There is nothing left, nothing but blasphemous heathens, and the mighty space marines who will destroy them. In this dark place, in this dark hour, we will stand against the enemies of the Emperor. And they will know that not even here on this desecrated infernal rock will we suffer the existence of the heretic. Not now. Not ever.

「詛咒之石」固然賦予惡魔王子辛吉前所未有的力量，但我們仍有獲勝的機會。
en_text: The Maledictum grants the Daemon Prince Sindri unheard of power, but we shall yet be victorious.

tc_text: 堅定不移的信念，以及帝皇的庇佑，是我們對付這些惡魔最有力的武器。
en_text: Pure hearts and the Emperor’s Word are more than a match for these abominations.

tc_text: 詛咒之石的力量對我是起不了任何作用的，惡魔!我對帝皇的忠誠不是你能想像的。
en_text: The Maledictum holds no power over me, daemon! My belief in the Emperor is too strong.

tc_text: 請將我置於惡魔王子身旁。只要有我在場，他的力量就會減弱。
en_text: Keep me near the Daemon Prince. He is weakened by my presence.

tc_text: 這陣干擾就像是異變風暴的導航臺一樣，讓它能夠提早抵達。
en_text: This disturbance is acting like a beacon for the warp storm, accelerating its arrival.

tc_text: 我們的時間不多了。我們必須假設辛吉已經釋放了惡魔。
en_text: We have little time left. We must assume Sindri has released the daemon.

tc_text: 那我們的目標就再明確不過了。我們必須消滅這隻惡魔。哪怕我們的軍備再困窘，惡魔都無法小覷我們的士氣。
en_text: Then our course is clear. We must destroy it. However meager our armaments are today, the daemon will not find our hearts lacking.

tc_text: 我知道。艦長，我相信你。拿去吧…
en_text: I know. I believe you, Captain. Here…

tc_text: 這是什麼？
一把惡魔之鎚：「驚天鎚」。我們一心只想著要消滅石頭中的惡魔，卻沒考慮到要使用什麼工具才能達成我們的目標。
en_text: A Daemonhammer: God-Splitter. We have always intended to destroy the daemon within the stone. Would we not appear the fools without the means to dispense our wills?

tc_text: 你、你要把這東西交給我？
en_text: You, you entrust this artifact to me?

tc_text: 你是我心目中最適合使用這把驚天鎚與惡魔對決的人選。另外，或許只是我的預感，我相信這場戰爭將由你劃下句點，而不是我。
en_text: I can think of no better champion to wield God-Splitter against the daemon. And, you can call it a premonition, but I believe you will end this fight, not I.

tc_text: 你還在想伊薩多那名叛徒。我審判過的人數遠超過你的想像，艦長。相信我，你不需要替其他人的墮落或意志不堅負責。測試他們的忠誠度，並非我們的工作。我們的職責，只是在他們墮落時，代替帝皇行使正義而已。
en_text: You are thinking of the traitor, Isador. I render judgment on more people than you can imagine, Captain. Trust me, you are not responsible for the failings, or strengths, of others. It is not our lot to test their purity. We merely dispense the Emperor’s justice when they fail.

tc_text: 神靈族。他們的軍力已經如此薄弱，卻仍然想要孤注一擲…
en_text: The Eldar. If they are this desperate to waste their already meager forces

tc_text: 這表示事態十分嚴重。快準備好吧。你即將踏上前所未有的血腥戰場。
en_text: Then matters are truly dire. Prepare yourself. You are about to enter a battlefield unlike any other.

tc_text: 只差一步!差一步就要成功了，可惡!!
en_text: Almost! Almost!! A moment more, damn you!!!

tc_text: 太好了!它朝我們過來了!
親眼目睹我登基的那一刻吧!
人類!不要摧毀那顆石頭!你會害死所有人的!
en_text: Human! Do not destroy the stone! You will doom us all!

tc_text: 別聽她的話，艦長!快摧毀那顆石頭，免得又有人因為它而墮落!
en_text: Ignore her, Captain! Destroy the stone before it leads others to ruin!

tc_text: 你不知道自己正在做什麼!
en_text: You know not what you do!

tc_text: 我們絕不允許這種事發生!快阻止他!
en_text: We cannot allow this! Take this human down!

tc_text: 不!
笨蛋!你將會害死所有人的。
en_text: FOOL! You have damned us all.

tc_text: 幹得好，艦長。
弟兄們，我們得加緊行動。再不趕快的話，艦隊就會把我們留在這裡了。
en_text: Let us bid haste, Brothers. The fleet is about to depart and leave us stranded.

tc_text: 我自由了。真是多謝你了。
en_text: I am free. You have my thanks.

tc_text: 惡魔，還不趕快現身!
我很快就會現身的。在那之前，先向世人宣佈我重返世界的消息。
en_text: I will. Soon. Until then, go forth and spread word of my return.

tc_text: 我可不是你的爪牙，你這個惡魔!
en_text: I am not your herald, warp-spawn!

tc_text: 你不是？釋放我的人明明是你呀。
en_text: Are you not? You released me.

tc_text: 不!我把石頭摧毀了!
是的，如果你太早摧毀那顆石頭的話，可能我就真的被你給消滅了。事實上，你們的每一次獻祭，都促成我的釋放。
en_text: Yes, and had you done so sooner, you might well have vanquished me. Instead, you contributed to my release with your every sacrifice.

tc_text: 獻祭？什麼獻祭？
這整顆行星就是一座祭壇哪，人類，是血神恐恩的祭壇。辛吉安排歐克蠻人前來入侵，因為他知道星際戰士絕不會坐視不理。每次死亡都是一場獻祭，並進一步促成我的釋放。我必須說，你們的獻祭真是又華美又豐碩。伊薩多、巴爾，還有辛吉他自己 -- 若是沒有這麼多祭品，我到現在可能仍在禁錮之中。為了感謝你將我釋放出來，我決定暫時饒你一命。
en_text: This planet was an altar, human, to the Blood God Khorne. Sindri arranged the Ork invasion knowing Space Marines would come to end their threat. Every death was a sacrifice toward my release, and I must say, your contributions were many and magnificent. Isador, Bale, and finally Sindri himself -- without so many offerings, I would have remained trapped. I thank you. I will spare your life, for now.

tc_text: 是的... 快逃走吧，我很快就會前去索取你們性命的!
en_text: Yes…. Flee and know I will soon come to claim you all!

tc_text: 那就來吧，你將會發現一場審判正在等著你。你從禁錮中逃脫出來，只是即將踏上徹底毀滅之路而已。現在我終於看清你的真面目了。
en_text: Then come and find your judgment waiting. You have escaped captivity, only to face annihilation. I know you now.

我會撕裂那些傢伙！
砍殺時間！

咱們走吧！

打倒他們！
如果你覺得你夠強悍，就到這裡來試試身手！

tc_text: 工藝世界對我歌唱，我衷心回應它。

tc_text: 派我去建造。
我的音樂是全世界賴以建造的柱子。

tc_text: 我們被命運塑造，我們也塑造命運。

tc_text: 要我演奏音樂嗎？
en_text: Shall I play the music, here then?

tc_text: 帶我到能夠呼叫冥骨的地方。
en_text: Take me to where I may call forth the wraithbone.

tc_text: 給我一個準備接受神靈族之禮的地方。
en_text: Show me a place that is ready to receive the gift of the Eldar.

tc_text: 我的音樂會塑造鬼魂骨。

tc_text: 我要從變異裡把他召喚出來。

tc_text: 你會得到你要求的東西。

tc_text: 在創造之樂的作用下，沒有任何東西能夠保持不變。

tc_text: 看哪，它隨著我的演奏而改變。

tc_text: 渾沌軍團，向我屈服吧！

tc_text: 不要輕視我，蠕蟲！
en_text: Do not trifle with me, worm

tc_text: 逆我者…將亡。

我方已有能力建立機器奴工。請透過堡壘加以建立。
en_text: Servitors are available, they can be built from the Stronghold.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立偵察兵星際戰士。請透過堡壘加以建立。
en_text: Scout Marines are available, they can be built from the Stronghold.

tc_text: 我方已獲得建立星際戰士戰略小隊的能力。請透過軍用禮拜堂進行徵召。
en_text: We have been granted access to build Tactical Marines, they can be called in from the Chapel-Barracks.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立星際戰士突擊小隊。請透過軍用禮拜堂加以建立。
en_text: Assault Marines are now available to us, they can be built from the Chapel-Barracks.

tc_text: 藥劑師已在待命中，隨時可以照顧我方傷患。請透過神聖殿堂加以建立。
en_text: Apothecaries are standing by to tend to our wounded. Build them at the Sacred Artifact.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立具有瞬間移動能力的終極戰士。他們會出現在軍用禮拜堂。
en_text: Terminators are now available for Deep Striking. They can be found at the Chapel-Barracks.
