tc_text: 忠心耿耿的顝顱探測器隨時可以加入我方陣營。他們會出現在監聽哨。
en_text: The all telling eyes of the Skull Probes are with us. Find them on our Listening Posts.

tc_text: 我方已有能力使用犀牛運輸坦克。請透過機器殿堂加以建立。
en_text: Rhino Transports are now available. Build them at the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 我方已有能力使用靈活快速的反重力浮艇。它們會出現在軍用禮拜堂。
en_text: We can make use of the speed and agility of the Land Speeders. Find them at the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 令人敬畏的無畏機兵正在待命中。請透過機器殿堂加以建立。
en_text: The revered Dreadnoughts are standing by. Build them at the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立具有長程砲擊能力的旋風坦克。請透過機器殿堂加以建立。
en_text: Whirlwinds and their long range artillery are being made available. Build them from the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 我方已有能力使用威力強大的獵食者坦克。請透過機器殿堂加以建立。
en_text: Mighty Predator Tanks are now at our disposal. Build them from the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立威力強大的掠奪者坦克。請透過機器殿堂召喚它們出來為我方效勞。
en_text: We have been blessed by the power of the Land Raiders. Seek the privilege of their service at the Machine Cult.

tc_text: 我方已有能力發動「軌道轟炸」。就讓那些腦袋空空的敵人嚇得屁滾尿流吧!
en_text: Orbital Bombardment is now available. Let it begin, and let begin the tremors in our enemies hollow hearts.

tc_text: 我方已具備爆裂手榴彈的研發能力。
en_text: Frag Grenade research is now available.

tc_text: 我方已具備偵察滲透技能的研發能力。
en_text: Scout Infiltration research is now available.

tc_text: 我方已具備熱熔炸彈的研發能力。
en_text: Melta Bomb research is now available.

tc_text: 我方已具備「戰嚎」的研發能力。
我方已具備熱熔炸彈的研發能力。
en_text: Melta Bomb research is now available.

tc_text: 我方已具備將堡壘升級為修道院的能力。
en_text: We can now upgrade our Stronghold to a Monastery.

tc_text: 我方已有能力將修道院升級為修道院要塞。
en_text: We can now upgrade our Monastery to a Fortress Monastery.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立軍用禮拜堂。請出動機器奴工加以建立。
en_text: The Chapel-Barracks has been made available to us. Use Servitors to requisition it.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立兵工廠並生產威力強大的重型武器。
en_text: The Armory and all power of heavy weapons is now available.

tc_text: 我方已具備建立重型爆彈槍砲塔的能力。請運用智慧，將它們置於最佳的防禦地點。
en_text: Heavy Bolter Turrets have been made available to us. Be sure to place their defensive power wisely.

tc_text: 我方已有能力將迴轉砲塔升級為火箭迴轉砲塔。升級之後，我方將能夠抵禦來自敵方絕大多數載具的威脅。
en_text: Turrets can now be upgraded to Missile Turrets. These will be able to hold against almost any vehicle threat well.

tc_text: 我方已有能力生產地雷，用來埋設在敵軍行經的途中。
en_text: Land mines are now available for placement in our enemies paths.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立機器殿堂。請建立機器殿堂來生產載具。
en_text: The Machine Cult is ready to be requisitioned. Build it to gain access to vehicles.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立神聖殿堂。請建立神聖殿堂來獲取強大的技能。
en_text: The Sacred Artifact will now be available to us. Construct it and we will have access to powerful abilities.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立衛星收發站。衛星收發站提供的機動能力可以讓我們立於不敗之地。
en_text: The Orbital Relay is ready for construction. With the mobility it will grant us we cannot fail.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建造電漿發電機。請建造電漿發電機來提供我方所需要的能源。
en_text: Plasma Generators are available. We must build them in order to gain the power we will require for our efforts.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建造熱流電漿發電機。請建造熱流電漿發電機來提供更充裕的能源。
en_text: Thermo Plasma Generators are available. They will provide us greater access to power.

tc_text: 我方已有能力建立堡壘。
en_text: We are now able to build Strongholds.

tc_text: 我方已經能夠透過軍用禮拜堂建立具有瞬間移動能力的星際戰士突擊小隊。
en_text: Assault Terminators are now available for Deep Strike from the Chapel-Barracks.

tc_text: 歡迎來到「破曉之戰」教學關卡。只要仔細聆聽我所說的話，並閱讀出現在此訊息方塊中的文字，你就會成為這場戰略遊戲的箇中高手。
en_text: Welcome to the Dawn of War tutorial. By listening to me and reading the text that appears in this message box, you will learn how to play a Skirmish game.

tc_text: 滑鼠是瀏覽戰況時最主要的工具。除了可以選取部隊、建築物之外，滑鼠還可以用來下達命令。
en_text: The mouse is your primary method of surveying the battle, selecting units and structures, and issuing orders.

tc_text: 滑鼠可以用來控制視角。「視角」指的是你目前檢視戰場所採取的角度。
en_text: The mouse controls the camera. The camera represents your current view of the battlefield.

tc_text: 使用滑鼠轉動視角
en_text: Pan the camera using the mouse

tc_text: 請使用滑鼠來控制自己檢視戰場時所採用的視角。只要將滑鼠游標移到螢幕邊緣，就能進行視角轉動。
en_text: Use your mouse to control your view of the battlefield. You can pan by moving the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要將滑鼠游標移到螢幕邊緣，就能進行視角轉動。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To pan the camera, simply move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen. Do this now.

tc_text: 請使用 ALT 鍵旋轉視角
en_text: Rotate the camera using the 'ALT' key

tc_text: 若要旋轉視角，請按住 ALT 鍵，並開始移動滑鼠。
en_text: To rotate the camera, press the ALT key and move the mouse.

tc_text: 提示文字
若要以不同的角度檢視戰場，只要按住 ALT 鍵並移動滑鼠，就能開始旋轉視角。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To rotate the camera to gain a different view of the battle, press the 'ALT' key, and move your mouse. Do this now.

tc_text: 縮放視角
只要將滑鼠滾輪向前滾動，即可縮放視角。
en_text: Zoom the camera by spinning the mouse-wheel forward.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要將滑鼠滾輪向前滾動，即可將視角朝著自己想要檢視的事物拉近。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: You can zoom in on something to see it up close by spinning the mouse-wheel forward. Do this now.

tc_text: 將視野重設為預設檢視
只要按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵，即可將視野重設為本遊戲的預設檢視。
en_text: Press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard to return the camera to the game's default view.

tc_text: 提示文字
若要將視野重設為本遊戲的預設檢視，請按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To return the camera to the game's default view, press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好!你已將視野恢復為本遊戲預設的檢視方式。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to its default playing view.

tc_text: 透過視野的縮放、轉動、旋轉，你便能採取自己想要的任何角度來檢視戰場。
en_text: By panning, rotating, and zooming the camera in and out, you can get whatever view of the battlefield you wish.

tc_text: 讓你的基地成為視角的中心
en_text: Center the camera on your base

tc_text: 按鍵盤上的 Home 鍵，即可讓你的基地成為視角的中心。
en_text: Press the 'Home' key on your keyboard to center the camera on your base.

tc_text: 只要按鍵盤上的 Home 鍵，便能立將將視角自戰場上的任何地方切回你的基地。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To quickly return the camera to your base from anywhere on the battlefield, press the 'Home' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好!你己將視角切回你的基地。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to your base.

tc_text: 選取堡壘
只要在堡壘上按一下滑鼠左鍵，即可將其選取起來。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵，是將其選取起來的一貫方法。
en_text: Left-click the Stronghold to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要用滑鼠左鍵按一下部隊或建築物，即可將其選取起來。現在請前往你的基地，並將堡壘選取起來。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Stronghold.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經學會如何在本遊戲中選取部隊和建築物。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.

tc_text: 建立一支星際戰士偵察小隊
將堡壘選取起來之後，便能開始建立星際戰士偵察小隊。你可以隨時透過堡壘建立偵察兵星際戰士。他們是鞏固戰略位置和探索週遭環境的第一步。
en_text: Select your Stronghold and build a Scout Marine Squad. Scout Marines are always available from the Stronghold. They are the first step to securing Strategic Points and exploring.

tc_text: 「星際戰士偵察小隊」提示文字
選取堡壘之後，螢幕右下角便會出現「星際戰士偵察小隊」圖示。現在請按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Stronghold and look for the Scout Marine Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 這時你會注意到小橫條正在逐漸填滿。你可以透過這個「進度橫條」看出某項工作還要多久才能完成。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一支星際戰士偵察小隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Scout Marine Squad.

tc_text: 佔領戰略位置
若要佔領戰略位置，請出動星際戰士偵察小隊。佔領並鞏固戰略位置之後，我方將會獲得更多軍備。
en_text: Use a Scout Marine Squad to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 「佔領」提示文字
只要用右鍵按一下某個戰略位置，即可命令星際戰士偵察小隊前去占領該戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Scout Marine Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 戰略位置位於戰場上具有高度戰略價值的區域之中。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 在戰場上占領並控制戰略位置，即為提升軍備資源的方法。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 占領戰略位置需要花費一些時間。在進度橫條滿格以前，請勿移開正在占領戰略位置的部隊，否則你將無法控制該戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領這個戰略位置!你必須繼續占領其他戰略位置以取得更多軍備資源，用來建立更多部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is ours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 建立機器奴工
請使用你的堡壘來建立機器奴工。當你想要建立其他建築物時，便需要用到機器奴工。你可以隨時透過堡壘建立機器奴工。
en_text: Use your Stronghold to build a Servitor. Servitors are required to build additional structures. Servitors are always available from the Stronghold.

tc_text: 「機器奴工」提示文字
請選取我方堡壘，並建立一支機器奴工。
en_text: Select your Stronghold and build a Servitor.

tc_text: 當你想要建立其他建築物時，便需要用到機器奴工。你可以隨時透過堡壘建立機器奴工。
en_text: Servitors are required to build additional structures. Servitors are always available from the Stronghold.

tc_text: 機器奴工已經抵達!機器奴工是星際戰士的建造部隊。每當你要建立新的建築物時，便需要用到機器奴工。
en_text: The Servitor has arrived! Servitors are the Space Marines' builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Servitor.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建造你的基地你需要一支機器奴工。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Servitor.

tc_text: 建立一座監聽哨
你必須使用自己的機器奴工來建立監聽哨。一旦將監聽哨建立於某個戰略位置上方，便能確保該戰略位置的安全性，使其免於遭到敵人攻佔，同時還能提升該戰略位置所生產的軍備數量。
en_text: You must use your Servitor to build a Listening Post. Listening Posts are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increasing the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取機器奴工，並在我方已占領的戰略位置上建立一座監聽哨。
en_text: Select the Servitor and build a Listening Post on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 監聽哨除了能夠鞏固戰略位置的防守能力，還能提升戰略位置的軍備生產速率。
en_text: The Listening Post fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置已經受到嚴密防護，敵人難以攻佔。你應該要繼續在我方已佔領的所有戰略位置上建立監聽哨。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Listening Posts on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 建立一座軍用禮拜堂
請使用你的機器奴工來建立一座軍用禮拜堂。軍用禮拜堂可以用來建立組成我方軍隊基礎骨幹的星際戰士小隊。此外，在軍用禮拜堂建造完成之後，還能開始生產最新種類的部隊和建築物。
en_text: Use your Servitor to build a Chapel-Barracks. The Chapel-Barracks is used to build Space Marine squads, who will form the backbone of your army. Creating a Chapel-Barracks will also unlock new kinds of squads and buildings.

tc_text: 「軍用禮拜堂」提示文字
選取我方的機器奴工，並建立一座軍用禮拜堂。
en_text: Select your Servitor and build a Chapel-Barracks structure.

tc_text: 「軍用禮拜堂」是一種建築物，可以用來建立更為進階的星際戰士步兵部隊。
en_text: The Chapel-Barracks is the structure where you can build more advanced Space Marine infantry units.

tc_text: 很好!軍用禮拜堂已經建造完成。
建立一支星際戰士小隊
請選取我方的軍用禮拜堂，並建立一支星際戰士小隊。「星際戰士小隊」是一種攻擊力強且充滿鬥志的部隊。透過研發計劃完成升級之後，他們可以用來對付任何威脅。此外，他們還具有佔領戰略位置的能力!
en_text: Select your Chapel-Barracks and build a Space Marine Squad. Space Marine Squads are powerful and resilient, and with research they can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 請選取我方的軍用禮拜堂，並建立一支星際戰士小隊。這批優秀的戰士將會組成我方軍隊的基礎骨幹。
en_text: Select your Chapel-Barracks and build a Space Marine Squad. These elite warriors will form the core of your military force.

tc_text: 很好!星際戰士小隊是你的全方位戰鬥部隊。他們是一種攻擊力強且充滿鬥志的部隊。透過研發計劃完成升級之後，他們可以用來對付任何威脅。此外，他們還具有佔領戰略位置的能力!
en_text: Excellent! Space Marine Squads are your all-purpose fighting force. They are powerful and resilient and, with research, can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 建立一名軍隊司令
請選取軍用禮拜堂，並建立一名軍隊司令。軍隊司令的能力遠較一般戰士來得強大，並能擔任軍隊的領導人物。不久之後在科技樹系中將會出現新的研發計劃，你可以透過這些研發計劃為軍隊司令進行升級，賦予他強大的技能。
en_text: Select the Chapel-Barracks and build a Force Commander. The Force Commander is much more powerful than your average warrior and acts as a hero for your army. You can upgrade him with powerful abilities through research available later in the tech tree.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取軍用禮拜堂，並建立一名軍隊司令。軍隊司令將會擔任我方軍隊的領導人物。
en_text: Select the Chapel-Barracks and build a Force Commander. The Force Commander acts as a hero for your army.

tc_text: 軍隊司令是身經百戰的資深戰士，具有無可匹敵的戰鬥技能。在他的帶領之下，你的軍隊將會步上勝利之路。
en_text: The Force Commander is a veteran of thousands of battles, and his combat prowess is unrivalled. He will lead your force to victory.

tc_text: 很好!軍隊司令已經抵達。軍隊司令雖然沒有佔領戰略位置的能力，卻是一名戰鬥經驗豐富且身經百戰的戰士，在升級之後將會具有極為強大的技能。
en_text: Excellent! The Force Commander has arrived. The Force Commander cannot capture points but is a skilled warrior who can be upgraded with powerful abilities.

tc_text: 在你建立更多設施並完成更多研發計劃之後，便能進一步建立星際戰士的其他指揮部隊。
en_text: The Space Marines' other commander unit will become available as you build more facilities and unlock more research.

tc_text: 將軍隊司令加入一支小隊中
en_text: Attach your Force Commander to a squad

tc_text: 選取我方的軍隊司令，再按一下「加入」按鈕，然後選取你想要讓軍隊司令加入的小隊即可。
en_text: Select your Force Commander, click the Attach button, and select the squad you want to attach him to.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取一名軍隊司令，再按一下「加入」按鈕。接著，請選取一支星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Force Commander and click the Attach button. Now, select a Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 當軍隊司令加入該小隊時，隊員將會重新排列位置，以挪出空間給這名令人敬畏的領導者。
en_text: Notice how when the Force Commander joins the squad, they rearrange themselves to make room for their esteemed leader.

tc_text: 星際戰士小隊會因為軍隊司令的加入而大幅提升戰力，但軍隊司令也具有強大的獨立作戰能力。
en_text: This Space Marine Squad is greatly enhanced by the addition of the Force Commander, but he can also fight effectively on his own.

tc_text: 若要讓軍隊司令脫離部隊，只要將該小隊選取起來，再按一下「脫離」圖示即可。「脫離」圖示的位置和「加入」圖示相同。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon.

tc_text: 為堡壘進行升級
現在是為堡壘 (你的總部) 進行升級的時候了。完成修道院升級的研發工作之後，你就可以開始為自己的星際戰士小隊徵召領導者，並讓兵工廠生產更好的武器。
en_text: It is time to upgrade the Stronghold, your headquarters. By researching the Monastery upgrade, you will gain access to Squad Leaders for your Space Marine Squads and better weapons from the Armory.

tc_text: 請選取堡壘，並按一下「修道院升級」圖示。
en_text: Select the Stronghold and click the Monastery Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 我們必須將堡壘升級為修道院，才能開始為部隊徵召領導者，並完成其他更先進的研發選項和建築物。
en_text: We must upgrade the Stronghold to a Monastery to gain access to Squad Leaders and other powerful research options and structures.

tc_text: 領導者是經驗豐富的戰士，可以加入部份星際戰士小隊之中。若要擊敗敵人，你需要仰仗強而有力的領導者。
en_text: Leaders are highly skilled warriors that can be added to some Space Marine squads. You will need strong leaders if you are to defeat your enemies.

tc_text: 修道院已經建造完成!現在你可以開始為部份星際戰士小隊加入士官。
en_text: The Monastery is complete! You can now add Sergeants to some of your Space Marine squads.

tc_text: 為星際戰士小隊加入一名士官
en_text: Add a Sergeant to your Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 你可以為某些部隊 (例如星際戰士小隊) 加入一名領導者。士官可以提振部隊士氣。請選取一支小隊，再按一下「新增領導者：士官」圖示，即可建立一名士官。
en_text: Some squads, like Space Marine Squads, can add a Leader. Sergeants provide an excellent boost to the squad's morale. Select a squad, then click the Add Leader: Sergeant icon to build a Sergeant.

tc_text: 選取一支星際戰士小隊，再按一下「新增領導者：士官」圖示。
en_text: Select a Space Marine Squad and click the Add Leader: Sergeant icon.

tc_text: 士官是英勇的領導者，能夠提升自己所屬部隊的戰力和士氣。在士官的激勵之下，星際戰士將能立下更為卓越的功勳。
en_text: Sergeants are valiant leaders that improve the combat ability and morale of the squad they are part of. They will inspire your Marines to greater feats of heroism.

tc_text: 很好!你的士官已經抵達。請注意，士官屬於小隊的一部份，而且無法自小隊中脫離。
en_text: Excellent! Your Sergeant has arrived. Note that your Sergeants are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 建立一座兵工廠
你必須出動機器奴工，才能建立兵工廠。完工之後，兵工廠將能為我方部隊生產特殊的武器。
en_text: You must use your Servitor to build an Armory. Once complete, the Armory will grant you access to special weapons for your squads.

tc_text: 請選取我方的機器奴工，並立即建立一座兵工廠。
en_text: Select your Servitor and build an Armory now.

tc_text: 你必須建立兵工廠，才能進行武器升級。你可以為小隊配備各式各樣的武器，讓他們做好與各種不同類型敵人作戰的準備。
en_text: You must build an Armory in order to access weapon upgrades. Squads can be equipped with a variety of weaponry, allowing you to prepare them against different enemy types.

tc_text: 很好!兵工廠已經開始運作。
為你的星際戰士小隊進行武器升級
en_text: Upgrade your Space Marine Squad's weaponry

tc_text: 你的步兵小隊可以透過兵工廠獲得重型武器。請將星際戰士小隊的武器升級為重型爆彈槍。
en_text: The Armory unlocks access to heavy weaponry for your infantry squads. Upgrade a Space Marine Squad with Heavy Bolters.

tc_text: 「武器升級」提示
將星際戰士小隊選取起來，再按一下「升級：重型爆彈槍」圖示，即可為其中一名小隊成員進行升級。
en_text: Select your Space Marine Squad and click the Upgrade: Heavy Bolter icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 請注意，其中一名小隊成員的手中將會出現重型爆彈槍。任何一種武器升級都可以透過相同的程序完成。
en_text: Notice a Heavy Bolter appears in one of your squad member's hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 一開始小隊只有二個部隊的武器能夠升級為重型武器。隨著兵工廠完成進一步的研發計劃，能夠升級的部隊數目也會隨之提升。
en_text: Initially you can only upgrade 2 units of your total squad with heavy weapons. By doing further research at the Armory you can unlock the capability to upgrade more.

tc_text: 很好。你已經為星際戰士小隊完成武器升級。你可以為戰場上任何地點的部隊進行武器升級，為他們提供適合用來對付敵人的武器。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Space Marine Squad. You can upgrade your squads anywhere on the battlefield to weapons that are well suited to counter your enemy.

tc_text: 建立一座電漿發電機
請出動你的機器奴工建立一座電漿發電機。電漿發電機提供了特殊的部隊、武器、載具、建築物和技能所需要的電力。電力是你必須在「破曉之戰」遊戲中管理的第二種資源。
en_text: Use your Servitor to build a Plasma Generator. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取你的機器奴工，並建立一座電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Servitor and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 部份建築物、載具和研發計劃需要電力才能運作。在電漿發電機建造完成之後，你的軍隊將會獲得日常所需的電力。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Plasma Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 你的電漿發電機數目越多，電力資源的累積速度也會越快。
en_text: The more Plasma Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 電力來了!電漿發電機將會以固定的速率持續生產電力。請注意，每座堡壘所能建造的電漿發電機數目都具有一定的上限。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Stronghold.

tc_text: 強化星際戰士小隊的戰力
請使用「增援」功能為你的星際戰士小隊加入新的部隊。若部隊中有部份部隊不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰場上的任何地點使用增援功能，為該部隊補充部隊數目。
en_text: Use the Reinforce function to add units to your Space Marine Squad. You can Reinforce anywhere in the battlefield to replenish your squads if some of your units fall in battle.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取一支星際戰士小隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Select a Space Marine Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的部隊戰力提升至最高。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness.

tc_text: 一旦有星際戰士不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a brother Space Marine falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 你可以多按幾次「增援隊伍」按鈕，將隊伍的戰力提升至最高。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經強化了星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 建立另一支星際戰士小隊，並進行升級
en_text: Build and upgrade another Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 請建立另一支星際戰士小隊，將其戰力強化至最高，再為該小隊進行升級，使其取得二種特殊武器，並加入一名新的領導者。
en_text: Build another Space Marine Squad, Reinforce it to full strength, Upgrade it with 2 special weapons, and Add a Leader.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取我方的軍用禮拜堂，並建立另一支星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Chapel-Barracks and build another Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 你的作戰基地所具有的後勤補給可以支援一定數目的部隊，而你在特定時間所能支援的部隊數目稱為「部隊上限」。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你目前的部隊上限會顯示在螢幕頂端的「資源區域」中。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 一旦達到部隊上限，你便無法繼續徵召其他部隊。因此在建立部隊的同時，請務必隨時注意自己的部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional squads, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 你可以藉由建立特定的建築物，或是透過研發計劃進行升級，來提升自己的部隊上限，但是部隊上限有一個絕對最高值，無法超越。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building certain structures and researching upgrades, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 很好!你已經成功建立一支星際戰士小隊並將其戰力提升至最高。若要發動有效攻擊，請嘗試同時建立數支星際戰士小隊，並將他們的戰力全部增援至最高，再透過升級來為各小隊提供特殊的武器和一名士官。
en_text: Excellent! You have built a Space Marine Squad and brought it to full strength. To mount an effective attack, you should try to have several Space Marine Squads, fully Reinforced to maximum strength and Upgraded with special weapons and a Sergeant.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置
en_text: Capture and Secure more Strategic Points

tc_text: 為了確保軍備資源 (也就是你的主要資源) 不虞匱乏，你必須占領並固守更多戰略位置。請占領三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立監聽哨。
en_text: To make sure you have enough of your main resource, Requisition, you need to capture and secure more Strategic Points. Capture 3 Strategic Points and build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派出星際戰士小隊在我方基地周圍進行地圖探勘，並沿路占領途中發現的戰略位置。你必須占領三個戰略位置，才能達成這項目標。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your Space Marine Squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置，是確保我方軍備資源不虞匱乏的最佳方式。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 請務必出動機器奴工在已占領的戰略位置上建立監聽哨，如此才能鞏固戰略位置，使其免於遭受敵人攻佔。
en_text: Make sure you use your Servitor to build Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立了監聽哨。戰略位置的奪取和固守是擊敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Listening Posts on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置
「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家將能取得勝利。現在就請占領一個關鍵位置吧。
en_text: Critical Locations are points on the map that represent areas of critical strategic importance. In some multiplayer games, capturing one or more of these points can win you the game. Capture one now.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派出部隊占領一個關鍵位置。「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置的方式和占領戰略位置完全相同。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領並固守一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家便能取得勝利!凡是我方固守的關鍵位置，也能為我方軍隊生產軍備資源。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一個關鍵位置。請注意，你無法在關鍵位置上建立監聽哨。你必須透過其他途徑來固守關鍵位置。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Listening Posts built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 占領遺址
「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。固守遺址之後，就能開始為我方軍隊建立最佳的部隊和載具。
en_text: Relics are sacred points of great value. Holding Relics will allow you access to your army's best units and vehicles.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派出一支部隊占領一處遺址。「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 固守遺址之後，就能開始為你的軍隊建立最佳的部隊和載具。若要確保自己能夠運用最先進的科技，請全力固守遺址!
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一處遺址。你可以建立監聽哨，以鞏固我方已占領的遺址。你也可以占領敵方的遺址，使其喪失建立最佳部隊以及運用最先進科技的能力。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 建立一座機器殿堂
請出動你的機器奴工建立一座機器殿堂。機器殿堂可以用來建立載具。載具十分強悍，遠較尚未升級的步兵來得有力量。
en_text: Use your Servitor to build a Machine Cult. The Machine Cult is used to build vehicles. Vehicles are tough and much stronger than non-upgraded infantry.

tc_text: 提示文字
請出動你的機器奴工建立一座機器殿堂。
en_text: Use your Servitor to build a Machine Cult.

tc_text: 就像步兵部隊必須透過軍用禮拜堂加以建立一般，載具則須透過機器殿堂加以建立。
en_text: Just like the Chapel-Barracks is used to build infantry units, the Machine Cult is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 載具十分強悍，面對尚未升級的敵方步兵時，幾乎是刀槍不入。載具會組成我方軍隊的一個基本環節，而且能用來攜帶強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 請注意，你的作戰基地只能支援一定數目的載具。這種限制稱為「載具上限」。就像部隊上限一樣，一旦達到載具上限，你就無法繼續建立更多的載具。若要提升載具上限，請透過堡壘進行科技研發計劃。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap. Just like Squad Cap, once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can research technology at your Stronghold that will increase your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 很好!你已經順利建立一座機器殿堂。現在你可以開始透過這座機器殿堂建立威力強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Machine Cult. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 若要在「破曉之戰」中提升自己所能徵召的部隊數目，請按一下堡壘上方的研發項目。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field in Dawn of War, you click on the research items located on your Stronghold.

tc_text: 你已經達到自己所能徵召的部隊上限。為了要將自己的部隊戰力發揮到極致，請務必將這些部隊的戰力增援至最高。若你先前曾做了不明智的決定，請按鍵盤上的 Delete 鍵，終結自己不需要的部隊。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them. If you have invested unwisely, you can press the 'Delete' button on your keyboard to terminate unwanted squads.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經完成本教學關卡的學習課程。
en_text: Congratulations! You've completed the learning session of the tutorial.

tc_text: 現在是你發揮所學的時候了。請透過實戰經驗，學習如何有效控制部隊，並逐漸累積實力，以徹底殲滅敵人!
en_text: It is time to put what you have learned to work. Take control of the force and build up your strength so you can crush your enemy!

tc_text: 請出動步兵部隊占領戰略位置，並命令機器奴工在戰略位置上建立監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points and Servitors to build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 請持續建造建築物，並持續進行研發計劃，以提升自己的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 請建立更多的部隊和載具。為了提升自己的部隊上限和載具上限，請務必透過研發計劃完成相關升級。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure you research upgrades that will increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 在這個戰場上取得勝利之後，請前往其他戰場，與敵人一決高下。除非你已徹底殲滅敵人，否則這場戰爭將永無終止之日。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 尋求掩護
請選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移入掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」提示
遭受敵方火力攻擊時，某些類型的地形可以為你的部隊提供保護。這就是所謂的「掩護」。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 請選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移往掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」能夠為你的部隊提供額外的防禦能力，使其變得更難對付，因而十分有用。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 要找到能提供掩護能力的地形並不困難 -- 當你通過城巿內部的大型彈坑，或是叢林內部的濃密植被時，滑鼠游標發生變化之處即為掩護區域。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 將部隊移入掩護區域中時，你將會注意到部隊上方出現了小型的「掩護」圖示。這個圖示代表該部隊的防禦能力向上提升。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好!你的部隊已經進入掩護區域。你的部隊一旦進入掩護區域內部，敵人就難以射擊，因此遭受長程攻擊時受到的傷害也會隨之減低。請善加利用掩護區域，為我方取得戰略優勢，以有效制敵。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你很快就會熟練這些能夠協助你殲滅敵軍的進階概念!
en_text: Very good! You are mastering advanced concepts that will help you to annihilate your enemies!

tc_text: 選取一支部隊之後，請注意該部隊的體力指數上方將會出現一道藍色的橫條。這道藍色橫條代表了該部隊的士氣指數。
en_text: Select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just under the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 「士氣」代表我方部隊的戰力。你可以將士氣想成是專注力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的綜合指數。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 本遊戲中有許多武器會同時折損士氣和體力指數。當部隊的士氣有所折損時，藍色小橫條的指數便會下降，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 士氣指數過低時，部隊便會潰散。潰散的部隊不但會失去戰鬥意願，戰力也會大幅下降。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 不過，即使部隊已經潰散，你仍然能夠對其進行控制。你可以自行決定要讓潰散的部隊繼續戰鬥，或是撤退到後方重新累積戰力。此外，某些特殊部隊具有提升部隊士氣的技能。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength. Also, certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 若能妥善利用士氣，你將能更輕鬆地擊敗敵人。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies.

tc_text: 你可以藉由打擊敵人的士氣讓他們喪失戰力，以便更輕而易舉地殲滅敵人。如此一來，即使是小型部隊，只要裝備精良，也能擊敗人數眾多的敵方軍隊。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 請記住，戰術和策略常會扭轉一場戰爭的成敗。請妥善運用這項知識，才能在戰場上嚐到勝利的滋味!
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 請記住，遭受敵人攻擊時，整個部隊都會受到傷害。當部隊受到的傷害累積到一定程度時，就會折損一個部隊。
en_text: Remember, a squad takes damage as a whole. When enough damage has been inflicted on the squad, a unit will die.

tc_text: 若你在戰鬥期間失去任何部隊，請透過「增援」功能，為你的部隊恢復完整的戰力。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 在戰鬥期間，請隨時留意部隊的體力指數，並請經常使用增援功能，讓你的部隊保持最高戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 請記住，持有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你的部隊將不再持有該項武器。這時你必須為該部隊進行升級，才能重新取得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 顯示於螢幕左下角的菱形畫面即為你的「小地圖」。
en_text: The diamond-shaped display in the lower left-hand corner of your screen is your Mini-map.

tc_text: 小地圖提供的重要資訊能夠協助你在戰爭中取得勝利。
en_text: The Mini-map provides important information that will help you win battles.

tc_text: 小地圖的功用包括：查看我方部隊和建築物的所在位置、迅速瀏覽戰場、下達快速命令等。
en_text: You can use the Mini-map to see where your units and structures are located, to quickly scan the battlefield, to issue quick orders, and so on.

tc_text: 只要在小地圖中按一下任何地點，視角便會立刻切換至該地點。當你需要迅速瀏覽戰場以制定戰略決策時，這個功能將會非常有用。
en_text: Clicking anywhere in the Mini-map will move your camera to that location. This is useful when you need to survey the battlefield quickly, to make tactical decisions.

tc_text: 請隨時留意你的小地圖。你可以透過小地圖，看到目前無法在檢視畫面中顯示的部隊正面臨何種情況。
en_text: Keep an eye on your Mini-map. It will help you see what is happening to units that you cannot currently see in your view screen.

tc_text: 戰場上的所有戰略位置，以及其他具有戰略價值的項目，都會顯示於小地圖中。
en_text: The Mini-map displays the locations of all Strategic Points on the battlefield, as well as other items of strategic importance.

tc_text: 若某個區域出現「戰爭迷霧」，且現場沒有我方的部隊或建築物存在，你就無法看到當地的情況。只要命令我方部隊進入該區域，「戰爭迷霧」就會隨之消散。
en_text: Fog of War prevents you from seeing things where you do not have a presence. As you move units into an area, the Fog of War will be lifted.

tc_text: 若該區域有我方的建築物存在，「戰爭迷霧」也會失去作用。
en_text: When you have structures built in an area, the Fog of War in that area will remain revealed.

tc_text: 「礦渣區」是集中隱藏在行星地表下方的能源。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 請在礦渣區上建造一座熱流電漿發電機，以取得大量的電力資源。
en_text: Build a Thermo-Plasma Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 只要迅速瀏覽一下自己的小地圖，你就會發現一些表示礦渣區的小點。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 你可以出動機器奴工，在礦渣區上建造熱流電漿發電機。
en_text: Servitors can build Thermo-Plasma Generators on Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 透過「增援」功能為小隊加入一名新的部隊時，該小隊會開始重新排列位置，以挪出空間給最新加入的部隊。這是因為小隊會集體行動，如同單一部隊一樣。
en_text: Notice how each time a squad is Reinforced and a unit arrives, the squad rearranges itself to accomodate the new arrival. This is because squads work together as a unit.

tc_text: 收到移動和攻擊等命令時，小隊會整齊劃一地展開行動。這就是小隊的力量，讓你能夠更輕鬆地在戰場上控制為數眾多的個別部隊。
en_text: A squad responds to commands, such as move and attack, in harmony. This is the strength of the squad, and it allows you to control a large number of units on the battlefield more easily.

tc_text: 請記住，提升軍備資源的方法就是固守戰略位置。一旦軍備資源匱乏，你就無法建立自己需要的部隊，而且會失去自己在戰場上的優勢。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requsition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 決定建築物的建造地點時，部份建築物周圍會出現白色的光環。這就是所謂的「控制區域」。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能在控制區域內部建立，而某些特定的建築物 (例如監聽哨) 則可以在控制區域以外的地點建立。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Listening Posts, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你想要為某座新建築物決定建造位置時，如果四處移動該建築物的話，建築物的顏色將會從紅色變為綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its colour changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 變成綠色時，代表你可以將建築物置於該處，並展開建造工作。
en_text: A Green colour indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 隱藏工作列
只要按一下位於工作列中上方邊緣的骷髏頭圖示，就可以將工作列隱藏起來。現在就嘗試將工作列隱藏起來吧。
en_text: You can hide the taskbar by clicking on the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar. Try hiding the taskbar now.

tc_text: 請按一下位於工作列中上方邊緣的骷髏頭圖示，將工作列隱藏起來。
en_text: Hide the taskbar by clicking the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar.

tc_text: 將工作列隱藏起來之後，你會發現小地圖並不會隨之消失。
en_text: When the taskbar is hidden, you will notice the Mini-Map stays revealed.

tc_text: 如果要下達命令或是為小隊進行升級時，你可以取消工作列的隱藏狀態，或是使用「快速鍵」。
en_text: To issue commands and upgrade your squads you can either unhide the taskbar or use the 'hotkeys'.

tc_text: 只要再按一下骷髏頭圖示，就可以取消工作列的隱藏狀態。
en_text: To return to the full taskbar, simply click the Skull icon again.

tc_text: 下達「集合點」命令
只要選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面，即可下達「集合點」命令。
en_text: To issue a Rally Point command, select any building that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 你已成功地下達一道「集合點」命令。只要選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面，即可下達「集合點」命令。
en_text: You've just issued a Rally Point command. You did this by selecting a structure capable of building squads or vehicles and right-clicking the ground nearby.

tc_text: 現在就來嘗試下達「集合點」命令吧。
en_text: Let's issue a Rally Point command.

tc_text: 請選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面。
en_text: Select any structure that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 下達「集合點」命令時，你會注意到真實世界中出現了一面旗幟。只要該棟建築物仍處於選取狀態，這面旗幟就會一直顯示在畫面上。
en_text: When you issue a Rally Point command, you will notice a flag appears in the world. This flag will be visible whenever you have the structure selected.

tc_text: 凡是透過該棟建築物建立的所有部隊或載具在建立完成之後，就會自動前往「集合點」集合。
en_text: Any squads or vehicles that are built from that structure will automatically gather at the Rally Point when they are built.

tc_text: 現在讓我們來檢視「目標」選單。
en_text: Now we will bring up the Objective Menu.

tc_text: 「目標」選單會提供一份清單，列出本遊戲為你指派的所有主要和次要目標。只要將滑鼠游標移到目標上方，即可取得各項目標的說明。
en_text: The Objective Menu provides you a list of all the Primary and Secondary Objectives assigned to you by the game. Mouse over the Objectives to get the description of each.

tc_text: 很好!你可以隨時按一下上方選單列中的 OBJ 按鈕，以檢視「目標」選單。
en_text: Excellent! Anytime you want to refer to the Objectives Menu, click on the OBJ button on the upper menu bar.

tc_text: 關閉任務視窗
當你熟悉任務視窗時，選取「關閉」鈕回到教學關卡。
en_text: When you are familiar with the Objective Screen, click on the Close button to return to the Tutorial.

tc_text: 記住，如果你不確定接下來要做什麼，你應該持續注意你的目前任務。
en_text: Remember, if you aren't sure what you need to do next you should always check your current Objectives.

tc_text: 要檢查你的任務，按一下上方選單列中的 OBJ 按鈕。
en_text: To check your Objectives, click on the OBJ button on the upper menu bar.

tc_text: 建立一輛犀牛運輸坦克
請選擇我方的機器殿堂，並建立一輛犀牛運輸坦克。
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Rhino Transport.

tc_text: 請選擇我方的機器殿堂，並建立一輛犀牛運輸坦克。
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Rhino Transport.

tc_text: 犀牛運輸坦克是星際戰士的基本步兵載具，行動迅速，並配有精良的裝甲設備，因此十分適合用來載運步兵部隊，並在戰場上迅速移動。
en_text: The Rhino Transport is the Space Marine's basic infantry transport. Exceptionally fast and well armoured, it is an excellent way to quickly move your infantry around the battlefield.

tc_text: 很好!現在你已經具有一輛犀牛運輸坦克。你可以嘗試讓步兵部隊進入犀牛運輸坦克之中，方法是先選取部隊，再用右鍵按一下犀牛運輸坦克。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Rhino. You can try loading infantry into the Rhino Transport by selecting the squad and right-clicking on it.

tc_text: 若要讓部隊離開犀牛運輸坦克，請按一下犀牛運輸坦克工作列上的「解編」圖示。
en_text: To unload the squad, click on the Unload icon on the Rhino Transport's taskbar.

tc_text: 建立一輛旋風坦克
請選取我方的機器殿堂，並建立一輛旋風坦克
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Whirlwind.

tc_text: 請選取我方的機器殿堂，並建立一輛旋風坦克
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Whirlwind.

tc_text: 旋風坦克是一種炮擊戰車，準確度不高，卻能造成毀滅性的區域性破壞。凡是遭到旋風坦克炮火擊中的步兵和建築物，都將化為烏有。
en_text: Whirlwind artillery vehicles have a devestating but inaccurate area attack that can send infantry flying and pound buildings into dust.

tc_text: 很好!旋風坦克除了可以像一般部隊一樣進行攻擊以外，還能針對特定地點進行炮擊，方法是先按一下旋風坦克工作列上的「地面攻擊」圖示，再用左鍵按一下戰場上的特定位置即可。
en_text: Excellent! Your Whirlwind can attack like a normal unit, or you can click the Ground Attack icon on the Whirlwind's taskbar and left-click the battlefield to fire the artillery at a specific location.

tc_text: 建立一部無畏機兵
選取我方的機器殿堂，並建立一部無畏機兵
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Dreadnought.

tc_text: 選取我方的機器殿堂，並建立一部無畏機兵。
en_text: Select your Machine Cult and build a Dreadnought.

tc_text: 無畏機兵是危險的人形機器，其近身戰鬥能力特別令人畏懼；經過升級之後，還能進行威力強大的遠程攻擊。
en_text: Dreadnoughts are dangerous mechanical walkers. They are feared in close combat and can be upgraded to have powerful ranged attacks.

tc_text: 很好!無畏機兵是致命的殺人機器，可以用來打擊步兵士氣、粉碎載具，並協助你擊敗敵人。
en_text: Excellent! Your Dreadnought is a lethal killing machine that can break infantry Morale, crush vehicles and help you defeat your enemy.

tc_text: 星際戰士具有許多載具選項。請為你的堡壘進行升級、占領遺址，並累積軍備及電力資源，以建立各式。
en_text: The Space Marines have many vehicle options. Upgrade your Stronghold, capture Relics and stockpile Requisition and Power Resources to build them all.

tc_text: 請隨時留意自己的載具上限。一旦達到自己所能支援的載具上限，你將無法繼續徵召載具。
en_text: Don't forget to keep an eye on your Vehicle Cap. You cannot field more vehicles than you can support with your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 歡迎來到「破曉之戰」教學關卡。只要仔細聆聽我所說的話，並閱讀出現在此訊息方塊中的文字，你便會成為這場戰略遊戲的箇中高手。
en_text: Welcome to the Dawn of War tutorial. By listening to me and reading the text that appears in this message box, you will learn how to play a Skirmish game.

tc_text: 滑鼠是瀏覽戰況時最主要的工具。除了可以選取部隊、建築物之外，滑鼠還可以用來下達命令。
en_text: The mouse is your primary method of surveying the battle, selecting units and structures, and issuing orders.

tc_text: 滑鼠可以用來控制視角。「視角」指的是你目前檢視戰場所採取的角度。
en_text: The mouse controls the camera. The camera represents your current view of the battlefield.

tc_text: 使用滑鼠轉動視角
en_text: Pan the camera using the mouse

tc_text: 請使用滑鼠來控制自己檢視戰場時所採用的視角。只要將滑鼠游標移到螢幕邊緣，就能進行視角轉動。
en_text: Use your mouse to control your view of the battlefield. You can pan by moving the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要將滑鼠游標移到螢幕邊緣，就能進行視角轉動。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To pan the camera, simply move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen. Do this now.

tc_text: 請使用 ALT 鍵旋轉視角
en_text: Rotate the camera using the 'ALT' key

tc_text: 若要旋轉視角，請按住 ALT 鍵，並開始移動滑鼠。
en_text: To rotate the camera, press the ALT key and move the mouse.

tc_text: 提示文字
若要以不同的角度檢視戰場，只要按住 ALT 鍵並移動滑鼠，就能開始旋轉視角。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To rotate the camera to gain a different view of the battle, press the 'ALT' key, and move your mouse. Do this now.

tc_text: 縮放視角
只要將滑鼠滾輪向前滾動，即可縮放視角。
en_text: Zoom the camera by spinning the mouse-wheel forward.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要將滑鼠滾輪向前滾動，即可將視角朝著自己想要檢視的事物拉近。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: You can zoom in on something to see it up close by spinning the mouse-wheel forward. Do this now.

tc_text: 將視野重設為預設檢視
只要按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵，即可將視野重設為本遊戲的預設檢視。
en_text: Press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard to return the camera to the game's default view.

tc_text: 提示文字
若要將視野重設為本遊戲的預設檢視，請按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵。現在就試試看吧。
en_text: To return the camera to the game's default view, press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好!你已將視野恢復為本遊戲預設的檢視方式。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to its default playing view.

tc_text: 透過視野的縮放、轉動、旋轉，你便能採取自己想要的任何角度來檢視戰場。
en_text: By panning, rotating, and zooming the camera in and out, you can get whatever view of the battlefield you wish.

tc_text: 選取歐克殖民區
只要在歐克殖民區上按一下滑鼠左鍵，即可將其選取起來。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵，是將其選取起來的一貫方法。
en_text: Left-click the Settlement to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要用滑鼠左鍵按一下部隊或建築物，即可將其選取起來。現在請前往你的基地，並將歐克殖民區選取起來。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Settlement.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經學會如何在本遊戲中選取部隊和建築物。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.

tc_text: 建立一支斧兵小隊部隊
將歐克殖民區選取起來之後，便能開始建立斧兵小隊部隊。你可以隨時透過歐克殖民區建立斧兵小隊。他們是鞏固戰略位置和探索週遭環境的第一步。
en_text: Select your Settlement and build a Slugga Boy Squad. Slugga Boyz are always available from the Settlement. They are the first step to securing Strategic Points and exploring.

tc_text: 「斧兵小隊部隊」提示文字
將歐克殖民區選取起來之後，螢幕右下角便會出現「斧兵小隊部隊」圖示。現在請按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Settlement and look for the Slugga Boy Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 這時你會注意到小橫條正在逐漸填滿。你可以透過這個「進度橫條」看出某項工作還要多久才能完成。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一支斧兵小隊部隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Slugga Boy Squad.

tc_text: 佔領戰略位置
若要佔領戰略位置，請出動斧兵小隊部隊。佔領並鞏固戰略位置之後，我方將會獲得更多軍備。
en_text: Use a Slugga Boy Squad to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 「佔領」提示文字
只要用右鍵按一下某個戰略位置，即可命令斧兵小隊部隊前去占領該戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Slugga Boy Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 戰略位置位於戰場上具有高度戰略價值的區域之中。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 在戰場上占領並控制戰略位置，即為提升軍備資源的方法。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 占領戰略位置需要花費一些時間。在進度橫條滿格以前，請勿移開正在占領戰略位置的部隊，否則你將無法控制該戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領這個戰略位置!你必須繼續占領其他戰略位置以取得更多軍備資源，用來建立更多部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is ours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 建立一支歐克小鬼頭部隊
請使用你的歐克殖民區來建立歐克小鬼頭部隊。當你想要建立其他建築物時，便會需要用到歐克小鬼頭部隊。你可以隨時透過歐克殖民區建立歐克小鬼頭部隊。
en_text: Use your Settlement to build a Gretchin Squad. Gretchin Squads are required to build additional structures. Gretchin Squads are always available from the Settlement.

tc_text: 「歐克小鬼頭部隊」提示文字
請選取我方的歐克殖民區，並建立一支歐克小鬼頭部隊。
en_text: Select your Settlement and build a Gretchin Squad.

tc_text: 當你想要建立其他建築物時，便會需要用到歐克小鬼頭部隊。你可以隨時透過歐克殖民區建立歐克小鬼頭部隊。
en_text: Gretchin Squads are required to build additional structures. Gretchin Squads are always available from the Settlement.

tc_text: 歐克小鬼頭部隊已經抵達!歐克小鬼頭部隊是歐克蠻人的建造部隊。每當你想要建立新的建築物時，便會需要用到歐克小鬼頭部隊。
en_text: The Gretchin Squad has arrived! Gretchin Squads are the Orks' builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Gretchin Squad.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建造你的基地你需要一支小鬼頭部隊。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Gretchin Squad.

tc_text: 建立一座歐克蠻人監聽哨
你必須使用自己的歐克小鬼頭部隊來建立歐克蠻人監聽哨。一旦將歐克蠻人監聽哨建立於某個戰略位置上方，便能確保該戰略位置的安全性，使其免於遭到敵人攻佔，同時還能提升該戰略位置所生產的軍備數量。
en_text: You must use your Gretchin Squad to build Da Listening Post. Da Listening Posts are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increase the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取歐克小鬼頭部隊，並在我方已占領的戰略位置上建立一座歐克蠻人監聽哨。
en_text: Select the Gretchin Squad and build Da Listening Post on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人監聽哨除了能夠鞏固戰略位置的防守能力，還能提升戰略位置的軍備生產速率。
en_text: Da Listening Post fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置已經受到嚴密防護，敵人難以進攻。你應該要繼續在我方已佔領的所有戰略位置上建立歐克蠻人監聽哨。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Da Listening Posts on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 建立一座小子營房
請使用你的歐克小鬼頭部隊來建立一座小子營房。小子營房可以用來建立組成我方軍隊基礎骨幹的槍手小隊。此外，在小子營房建造完成之後，還能開始生產最新種類的部隊和建築物。
en_text: Use your Gretchin Squad to build Da Boyz Hut. Da Boyz Hut is used to build Shoota Boy Squads, who will form the backbone of your army. Creating Da Boyz Hut will also unlock new kinds of squads and buildings.

tc_text: 「小子營房」提示文字
選取我方的歐克小鬼頭部隊，並建立一座小子營房。
en_text: Select your Gretchin Squad and build Da Boyz Hut structure.

tc_text: 「小子營房」是一種建築物，可以用來建立更為進階的歐克蠻人步兵部隊。
en_text: Da Boyz Hut is the structure where you can build more advanced Ork infantry units.

tc_text: 很好!小子營房已經建造完成。
en_text: Excellent, Da Boyz Hut is finished.

tc_text: 建立一支槍手小隊
請選取小子營房，並建立一支槍手小隊。「槍手小隊」是一種攻擊力強且充滿鬥志的部隊。透過研發計劃完成升級之後，他們可以用來對付任何威脅。此外，他們還具有佔領戰略位置的能力!
en_text: Select Da Boyz Hut and build a Shoota Boy Squad. Shoota Boy Squads are powerful and resilient, and with research they can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 請選取我方的小子營房，並建立一支槍手小隊。這批優秀的戰士將會組成我方軍隊的基礎骨幹。
en_text: Select Da Boyz Hut and build a Shoota Boy Squad. These elite warriors will form the core of your military force.

tc_text: 很好!槍手小隊是你的全方位戰鬥部隊。他們是一種攻擊力強且充滿鬥志的部隊。透過研發計劃完成升級之後，他們可以用來對付任何威脅。此外，他們還具有佔領戰略位置的能力!
en_text: Excellent! Shoota Boy Squads are your all-purpose fighting force. They are powerful and resilient and, with research, can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 建立一名惡霸技師
請選取小子營房，並建立一名惡霸技師。惡霸技師的能力遠較一般戰士來得強大，並能擔任我方軍隊的領導人物。不久之後在科技樹系中將會出現新的研發計劃；你可以透過這些研發計劃為惡霸技師進行升級，賦予他強大的技能。
en_text: Select Da Boyz Hut and build a Big Mek. The Big Mek is much more powerful than your average warrior and acts as a hero for your army. You can upgrade him with powerful abilities through research available later in the tech tree.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取小子營房，並建立一名惡霸技師。惡霸技師將會擔任我方軍隊的領導人物。
en_text: Select Da Boyz Hut and build a Big Mek. The Big Mek acts as a hero for your army.

tc_text: 惡霸技師是身經百戰的資深戰士，具有無可匹敵的戰鬥技能。在他的帶領之下，我方軍隊將會步上勝利之路。
en_text: The Big Mek is a veteran of thousands of battles, and his combat prowess is unrivalled. He will lead your force to victory.

tc_text: 很好!惡霸技師已經抵達。惡霸技師雖然沒有佔領戰略位置的能力，卻是一名戰鬥經驗豐富且身經百戰的戰士，在升級之後將會具有極為強大的技能。
en_text: Excellent! The Big Mek has arrived. The Big Mek cannot capture points but is a skilled warrior who can be upgraded with powerful abilities.

tc_text: 在你建立更多設施並完成更多研發計劃之後，便能進一步建立歐克蠻人的其他指揮部隊。
en_text: The Orks' other commander unit will become available as you build more facilities and unlock more research.

tc_text: 將惡霸技師加入小隊之中
en_text: Attach your Big Mek to a squad

tc_text: 選取一名惡霸技師，再按一下「加入」按鈕，然後選取你想要讓惡霸技師加入的小隊即可。
en_text: Select your Big Mek, click the Attach button, and select the squad you want to attach him to.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取一名惡霸技師，再按一下「加入」按鈕。接著，請選取一支槍手小隊。
en_text: Select your Big Mek and click the Attach button. Now, select a Shoota Boy Squad.

tc_text: 當惡霸技師加入該小隊時，隊員將會重新排列位置，以挪出空間給這名令人敬畏的頭目。
en_text: Notice how when the Big Mek joins the squad, they rearrange themselves to make room for their esteemed leader.

tc_text: 槍手小隊會因為惡霸技師的加入而大幅提升戰力，但惡霸技師也具有強大的獨立作戰能力。
en_text: This Shoota Boy Squad is greatly enhanced by the addition of the Big Mek, but he can also fight effectively on his own.

tc_text: 若要讓惡霸技師脫離部隊，只要將該小隊選取起來，再按一下「脫離」圖示即可。「脫離」圖示的位置和「加入」圖示相同。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon.

tc_text: 為歐克殖民區進行升級
現在是為歐克殖民區 (你的總部) 進行升級的時候了。完成歐克蠻人要塞升級的研發工作之後，你就可以開始建立戰爭頭目和史估革巨獸等強而有力的部隊。
en_text: It is time to upgrade the Settlement, your headquarters. By researching the Orky Fort upgrade, you will gain access to powerful units such as the Warboss and Squiggoth.

tc_text: 請選取歐克殖民區，並按一下「歐克蠻人要塞升級」圖示。
en_text: Select the Settlement and click the Orky Fort Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 我們必須將歐克殖民區升級為歐克蠻人要塞，才能開始進行高階研發選項，同時建立強而有力的部隊。
en_text: We must upgrade the Settlement to a Orky Fort to gain access to high level research options and powerful units.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人要塞的防禦能力遠較歐克殖民區來得強大。
en_text: The Orky Fort also has much stronger defenses than the Ork Settlement.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人要塞已經建造完成!現在你可以開始建立戰爭頭目和史估革巨獸等強而有力的部隊。
en_text: The Orky Fort is complete! You can now build powerful units such as the Warboss and the Squiggoth.

tc_text: 為槍手小隊加入一名歐克老大隊長
en_text: Add a Nob Leader to your Shoota Boy Squad

tc_text: 你可以為某些部隊 (例如槍手小隊) 加入一名領導者。歐克老大隊長可以提振部隊士氣。請選取一支小隊，再按一下「新增領導者：歐克老大隊長」圖示，即可建立一名歐克老大隊長。
en_text: Some squads, like Shoota Boy Squads, can add a Leader. Nob Leaders provide an excellent boost to the squad's morale. Select a squad, then click the Add Leader: Nob Leader icon to build a Nob Leader.

tc_text: 選取一支槍手小隊，再按一下「新增領導者：歐克老大隊長」圖示。
en_text: Select a Shoota Boy Squad and click the Add Leader: Nob Leader icon.

tc_text: 歐克老大隊長是英勇的戰士，能夠提升自己所屬部隊的戰力和士氣。在歐克老大隊長的激勵之下，歐克蠻人將能立下更為卓越的功勳。
en_text: Nob Leaders are valiant fighters that improve the combat ability and morale of the squad they are part of. They will inspire your Orks to greater feats of heroism.

tc_text: 很好!你的歐克老大已經抵達。請注意，歐克老大屬於部隊的一部份，而且無法自部隊中脫離。
en_text: Excellent! Your Nob Leader has arrived. Note that your Nob Leaders are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 建立改造槍工廠
你必須出動歐克小鬼頭部隊，才能建立改造槍工廠。完工之後，改造槍工廠將能為我方部隊生產特殊的武器。
en_text: You must use your Gretchin Squad to build a Pile O Gunz!. Once complete, the Pile O Gunz! will grant you access to special weapons for your squads.

tc_text: 請選取我方的歐克小鬼頭部隊，並立即建立一座改造槍工廠。
en_text: Select your Gretchin Squad and build a Pile O Gunz! now.

tc_text: 你必須建立一座改造槍工廠，才能進行武器升級。你可以為部隊配備各式各樣的武器，讓他們做好與各種不同類型的敵人作戰的準備。
en_text: You must build a Pile O Gunz! in order to access weapon upgrades. Squads can be equipped with a variety of weaponry, allowing you to prepare them against different enemy types.

tc_text: 很好!改造槍工廠已經開始運作。
en_text: Excellent, the Pile O Gunz! is operational.

tc_text: 為槍手小隊進行武器升級
en_text: Upgrade your Shoota Boy Squad's weaponry

tc_text: 你的步兵小隊可以透過改造槍工廠獲得重型武器。請將槍手小隊的武器升級為火焰槍。
en_text: The Pile O Gunz! unlocks access to heavy weaponry for your infantry squads. Upgrade a Shoota Boy Squad with Burnas.

tc_text: 「武器升級」提示
將槍手小隊選取起來，再按一下「升級：火焰槍」圖示，即可為其中一名成員進行升級。
en_text: Select your Shoota Boy Squad and click the Upgrade: Burnas icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 請注意，其中一名成員的手中將會出現火焰槍。任何一種武器升級都可透過相同的程序完成。
en_text: Notice a Burna appears in one of your squad member's hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 整個部隊一開始只有二個部隊的武器能夠升級為重型武器。隨著改造槍工廠完成進一步的研發計劃，能夠升級的部隊數目也會隨之提升。
en_text: Initially you can only upgrade 2 units of your total squad with heavy weapons. By doing further research at the Pile O Gunz! you can unlock the capability to upgrade more.

tc_text: 很好。你已經為槍手小隊完成武器升級。你可以為戰場上任何地點的小隊進行武器升級，為他們提供適合用來對付敵人的武器。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Shoota Boy Squad. You can upgrade your squads anywhere on the battlefield to weapons that are well suited to counter your enemy.

tc_text: 建立一座發電廠
請出動你的歐克小鬼頭部隊建立一座發電廠。發電廠提供了特殊部隊、武器、載具、建築物和技能所需要的電力。電力是你必須在「破曉之戰」遊戲中管理的第二種資源。
en_text: Use your Gretchin Squad to build a Generator. Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取你的歐克小鬼頭部隊，並建立一座發電廠。
en_text: Select your Gretchin Squad and build a Generator.

tc_text: 部份建築物、載具和研發計劃需要電力才能運作。在發電廠建造完成之後，你的軍隊將會獲得日常所需的電力。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 你的發電廠數目越多，電力資源的累積速度也會越快。
en_text: The more Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 電力來了!發電廠將會以固定的速率持續生產電力。請注意，每座歐克殖民區所能建造的發電廠數目都具有一定的上限。
en_text: You now have Power! Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Generators can be built per Settlement.

tc_text: 強化槍手小隊的戰力
請使用「增援」功能為你的槍手小隊加入新的部隊。若部隊中有部份部隊不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰場上的任何地點使用強化功能，為該部隊補充部隊數目。
en_text: Use the Reinforce function to add units to your Shoota Boy Squad. You can Reinforce anywhere in the battlefield to replenish your squads if some of your units fall in battle.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取一支槍手小隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Select a Shoota Boy Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的小隊戰力提升至最高。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness.

tc_text: 一旦有歐克蠻人不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that an Ork falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 你可以多按幾次「增援隊伍」按鈕，將隊伍的戰力提升至最高。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經強化了槍手小隊的戰力。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Shoota Boy Squad.

tc_text: 建立另一支槍手小隊，並進行升級
en_text: Build and upgrade another Shoota Boy Squad

tc_text: 請建立另一支槍手小隊，將其戰力強化至最高，再為該小隊進行升級，使其取得二種特殊武器，並加入一名新的領導者。
en_text: Build another Shoota Boy Squad, Reinforce it to full strength, Upgrade it with 2 special weapons, and Add a Leader.

tc_text: 提示文字
請選取我方的小子營房，並建立另一支槍手小隊。
en_text: Select Da Boyz Hut and build another Shoota Boy Squad.

tc_text: 你的作戰基地所具有的後勤補給可以支援一定數目的部隊，而你在特定時間所能支援的部隊數目稱為「部隊上限」。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你目前的部隊上限會顯示在螢幕頂端的「資源區域」中。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 一旦達到部隊上限，你便無法繼續徵召其他部隊。因此在建立部隊的同時，請務必隨時注意自己的部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional squads, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 你可以藉由建立特定的建築物，或是透過研發計劃進行升級，來提升自己的部隊上限，但是一定會有一個固定的部隊上限，你無法超越。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building certain structures and researching upgrades, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 很好!你已經成功建立一支槍手小隊，並將其戰力提升至最高。若要發動有效攻擊，請嘗試同時建立數支槍手小隊，並將他們的戰力全部增援至最高，再透過升級來為各小隊提供特殊的武器和一名歐克老大。
en_text: Excellent! You have built a Shoota Boy Squad and brought it to full strength. To mount an effective attack, you should try to have several Shoota Boy Squads, fully Reinforced to maximum strength and Upgraded with special weapons and a Nob Leader.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置
en_text: Capture and Secure more Strategic Points

tc_text: 為了確保軍備資源 (也就是你的主要資源) 不虞匱乏，你必須占領並固守更多戰略位置。請占領三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立歐克蠻人監聽哨。
en_text: To make sure you have enough of your main resource, Requisition, you need to capture and secure more Strategic Points. Capture 3 Strategic Points and build Da Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派出槍手小隊在我方基地周圍進行地圖探勘，並沿路占領途中發現的戰略位置。你必須占領三個戰略位置，才能達成這項目標。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your Shoota Boy Squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置，是確保我方軍備資源不虞匱乏的最佳方式。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 請務必出動歐克小鬼頭部隊在已占領的戰略位置上建立歐克蠻人監聽哨，如此才能鞏固戰略位置，使其免於遭受敵人攻佔。
en_text: Make sure you use your Gretchin Squad to build Da Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已占領了三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立了歐克蠻人監聽哨。戰略位置的奪取和固守是擊敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Da Listening Posts on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置
「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家將能取得勝利。現在就請嘗試占領一個關鍵位置。
en_text: Critical Locations are points on the map that represent areas of critical strategic importance. In some multiplayer games, capturing one or more of these points can win you the game. Capture one now.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派出我方部隊占領一個關鍵位置。「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置的方式和占領戰略位置完全相同。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領並固守一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家便能取得勝利!凡是我方固守的關鍵位置，也能為我方軍隊生產軍備資源。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一個關鍵位置。請注意，你無法在關鍵位置上建立歐克蠻人監聽哨。你必須透過其他途徑來固守關鍵位置。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Da Listening Posts built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 占領遺址
「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。固守遺址之後，就能開始為我方軍隊建立最佳的部隊和載具。
en_text: Relics are sacred points of great value. Holding Relics will allow you access to your army's best units and vehicles.

tc_text: 提示文字
請派一支小隊去占領一處遺址。「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 固守遺址之後，就能開始為你的軍隊建立最佳的部隊和載具。若要確保自己能夠運用最先進的科技，請全力固守遺址!
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一處遺址。你可以建立歐克蠻人監聽哨，以鞏固我方已占領的遺址。你也可以占領敵方的遺址，使其喪失建立最佳部隊以及運用最先進科技的能力。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Da Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 建立一座技師工廠
請出動你的歐克小鬼頭部隊建立一座技師工廠。技師工廠可以用來建立載具。載具十分強悍，遠較尚未升級的步兵來得有力量。
en_text: Use your Gretchin Squad to build Da Mek Shop. The Da Mek Shop is used to build vehicles. Vehicles are tough and much stronger than non-upgraded infantry.

tc_text: hint text
請出動你的歐克小鬼頭部隊建立一座技師工廠。
en_text: Use your Gretchin Squad to build a Da Mek Shop.

tc_text: 就像步兵部隊必須透過小子營房加以建立一般，載具則須透過技師工廠加以建立。
en_text: Just like Da Boyz Hut is used to build infantry units, Da Mek Shop is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 載具十分強悍，面對尚未升級的敵方步兵時，幾乎是刀槍不入。載具會組成我方軍隊的一個基本環節，而且能用來攜帶強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 請注意，你的作戰基地只能支援一定數目的載具。這種限制稱為「載具上限」。就像部隊上限一樣，一旦達到載具上限，你就無法繼續建立更多的載具。若要提升載具上限，請透過歐克殖民區進行科技研發計劃。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap. Just like Squad Cap, once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can research technology at your Settlement that will increase your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 很好!你已經順利建立一座技師工廠。現在你可以開始透過這座技師工廠建立威力強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have Da Mek Shop. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 若要在「破曉之戰」中提升自己所能徵召的部隊數目，請按一下歐克殖民區上方的研發項目。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field in Dawn of War, you click on the research items located on your Settlement.

tc_text: 你已達到自己所能徵召的部隊上限。為了要將自己的部隊戰力發揮到極致，請務必將這些部隊的戰力增援至最高。若你先前曾做了不明智的決定，請按鍵盤上的 Delete 鍵，以終結自己不需要的部隊。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them. If you have invested unwisely, you can press the 'Delete' button on your keyboard to terminate unwanted squads.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經完成本教學關卡的學習課程。
en_text: Congratulations! You've completed the learning session of the tutorial.

tc_text: 現在是你發揮所學的時候了。請透過實戰經驗，學習如何有效控制部隊，並逐漸累積實力，以徹底殲滅敵人!
en_text: It is time to put what you have learned to work. Take control of the force and build up your strength so you can crush your enemy!

tc_text: 請出動步兵部隊占領戰略位置，並命令歐克小鬼頭部隊在戰略位置上建立歐克蠻人監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points, and Gretchin Squads to build Da Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 請持續建造建築物，並持續進行研發計劃，以提升自己的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 請建立更多的部隊和載具。為了提升自己的部隊上限和載具上限，請務必透過研發計劃完成相關升級。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure you research upgrades that will increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 在這個戰場上取得勝利之後，請前往其他戰場，與敵人一決高下。除非你已徹底殲滅敵人，否則這場戰爭將永無終止之日。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 尋求掩護
請選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移入掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」提示
遭受敵方火力攻擊時，某些類型的地形可以為你的部隊提供保護。這就是所謂的「掩護」。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 請選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移往掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」能夠為你的部隊提供額外的防禦能力，使其變得更難對付，因而十分有用。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 要找到能提供掩護能力的地形並不困難 -- 當你通過城巿內部的大型彈坑，或是叢林內部的濃密植被時，滑鼠游標發生變化之處即為掩護區域。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 將部隊移入掩護區域中時，你將會注意到部隊上方出現了小型的「掩護」圖示。這個圖示代表該部隊的防禦能力向上提升。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好!你的部隊已經進入掩護區域。你的部隊一旦進入掩護區域內部，敵人就難以射擊，因此遭受長程攻擊時受到的傷害也會隨之減低。請善加利用掩護區域，為我方取得戰略優勢，以有效制敵。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你很快就會熟練這些能夠協助你殲滅敵軍的進階概念!
en_text: Very good! You are mastering advanced concepts that will help you to annihilate your enemies!

tc_text: 選取一支部隊之後，請注意該部隊的體力指數上方將會出現一道藍色的橫條。這道藍色橫條代表了該部隊的士氣指數。
en_text: Select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just under the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 「士氣」代表我方部隊的戰力。你可以將士氣想成是專注力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的綜合指數。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 本遊戲中有許多武器會同時折損士氣和體力指數。當小隊的士氣有所折損時，藍色小橫條的指數便會下降，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 士氣指數過低時，小隊便會潰散。潰散的小隊不但會失去戰鬥意願，戰力也會大幅下降。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 不過，即使小隊已經潰散，你仍然能夠對其進行控制。你可以自行決定要讓潰散的小隊繼續戰鬥，或是撤退到後方重新累積戰力。此外，某些特殊部隊具有提升小隊士氣的技能。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength. Also, certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 若能妥善利用士氣指標，你將能更輕鬆地擊敗敵人。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies.

tc_text: 你可以藉由打擊敵人的士氣讓他們喪失戰力，以便更輕而易舉地殲滅敵人。如此一來，即使是小型部隊，只要裝備精良，也能擊敗人數眾多的敵方軍隊。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 請記住，戰術和策略常會扭轉一場戰爭的成敗。請妥善運用這項知識，才能在戰場上嚐到勝利的滋味!
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 請記住，遭受敵人攻擊時，整個小隊都會受到傷害。當小隊受到的傷害累積到一定程度時，便會折損一個部隊。
en_text: Remember, a squad takes damage as a whole. When enough damage has been inflicted on the squad, a unit will die.

tc_text: 若你在戰鬥期間失去任何部隊，請透過「增援」功能，為你的小隊恢復完整的戰力。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 在戰鬥期間，請隨時留意小隊的體力指數，並請經常使用增援功能，讓你的小隊保持最高戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 請記住，持有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你的小隊將不再持有該項武器。這時你必須為該小隊進行升級，才能重新取得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 顯示於螢幕左下角的菱形畫面即為你的「小地圖」。
en_text: The diamond-shaped display in the lower left-hand corner of your screen is your Mini-map.

tc_text: 小地圖提供的重要資訊能夠協助你在戰爭中取得勝利。
en_text: The Mini-map provides important information that will help you win battles.

tc_text: 小地圖的功用包括：查看我方部隊和建築物的所在位置、迅速瀏覽戰場、下達快速命令等。
en_text: You can use the Mini-map to see where your units and structures are located, to quickly scan the battlefield, to issue quick orders, and so on.

tc_text: 只要在小地圖中按一下任何地點，視角便會立刻切換至該地點。當你需要迅速瀏覽戰場以制定戰略決策時，這個功能將會非常有用。
en_text: Clicking anywhere in the Mini-map will move your camera to that location. This is useful when you need to survey the battlefield quickly, to make tactical decisions.

tc_text: 請隨時留意你的小地圖。你可以透過小地圖，看到目前無法在檢視畫面中顯示的部隊正面臨何種情況。
en_text: Keep an eye on your Mini-map. It will help you see what is happening to units that you cannot currently see in your view screen.

tc_text: 戰場上的所有戰略位置，以及其他具有戰略價值的項目，都會顯示於小地圖中。
en_text: The Mini-map displays the locations of all Strategic Points on the battlefield, as well as other items of strategic importance.

tc_text: 若某個區域出現「戰爭迷霧」，且現場沒有我方的部隊或建築物存在，你就無法看到當地的情況。只要命令我方部隊進入該區域，「戰爭迷霧」就會隨之消散。
en_text: Fog of War prevents you from seeing things where you do not have a presence. As you move units into an area, the Fog of War will be lifted.

tc_text: 若該區域有我方的建築物存在，「戰爭迷霧」也會失去作用。
en_text: When you have structures built in an area, the Fog of War in that area will remain revealed.

tc_text: 「礦渣區」是集中隱藏在行星地表下方的能源。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 請在礦渣區上建造一座大型發電廠，以取得大量的電力資源。
en_text: Build a Bigga Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 只要迅速瀏覽一下自己的小地圖，你就會發現一些表示礦渣區的小點。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 你可以出動歐克小鬼頭部隊，在礦渣區上建造大型發電廠。
en_text: Gretchin Squads can build Bigga Generators on Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 透過「增援」功能為某個小隊加入一名新的部隊時，該小隊會開始重新排列位置，以挪出空間給最新加入的部隊。這是因為小隊會集體行動，如同單一部隊一樣。
en_text: Notice how each time a squad is Reinforced and a unit arrives, the squad rearranges itself to accomodate the new arrival. This is because squads work together as a unit.

tc_text: 收到移動和攻擊等命令時，小隊會整齊劃一地展開行動。這就是小隊的力量，讓你能夠更輕鬆地在戰場上控制為數眾多的個別部隊。
en_text: A squad responds to commands, such as move and attack, in harmony. This is the strength of the squad, and it allows you to control a large number of units on the battlefield more easily.

tc_text: 請記住，提升軍備資源的方法就是固守戰略位置。一旦軍備資源匱乏，你就無法建立自己需要的部隊，而且會失去自己在戰場上的優勢。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requsition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 決定建築物的建造地點時，部份建築物周圍會出現白色的光環。這就是所謂的「控制區域」。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能在控制區域內部建立，而某些特定的建築物 (例如歐克蠻人監聽哨) 則可以在控制區域以外的地點建立。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Da Listening Posts, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你想要為某座新建築物決定建造位置時，如果四處移動該建築物的話，建築物的顏色將會從紅色變為綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its colour changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 變成綠色時，代表你可以將建築物置於該處，並展開建造工作。
en_text: A Green colour indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 隱藏工作列
只要按一下位於工作列中上方邊緣的骷髏頭圖示，就可以將工作列隱藏起來。現在就嘗試將工作列隱藏起來吧。
en_text: You can hide the taskbar by clicking on the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar. Try hiding the taskbar now.

tc_text: 請按一下位於工作列中上方邊緣的骷髏頭圖示，將工作列隱藏起來。
en_text: Hide the taskbar by clicking the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar.

tc_text: 將工作列隱藏起來之後，你會發現小地圖並不會隨之消失。
en_text: When the taskbar is hidden, you will notice the Mini-Map stays revealed.

tc_text: 需要下達命令或是為小隊進行升級時，你可以取消工作列的隱藏狀態，或是使用「快速鍵」。
en_text: To issue commands and upgrade your squads you can either unhide the taskbar or use the 'hotkeys'.

tc_text: 只要再按一下骷髏頭圖示，就可以取消工作列的隱藏狀態。
en_text: To return to the full taskbar, simply click the Skull icon again.

tc_text: 下達「集合點」命令
只要選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面，即可下達「集合點」命令。
en_text: To issue a Rally Point command, select any building that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 你已成功地下達一道「集合點」命令。只要選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面，即可下達「集合點」命令。
en_text: You've just issued a Rally Point command. You did this by selecting a structure capable of building squads or vehicles and right-clicking the ground nearby.

tc_text: 現在就來嘗試下達「集合點」命令吧。
en_text: Let's issue a Rally Point command.

tc_text: 請選擇任何一棟具有部隊或載具生產能力的建築物，再用右鍵按一下附近的地面。
en_text: Select any structure that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 下達「集合點」命令時，你會注意到真實世界中出現了一面旗幟。只要該棟建築物仍處於選取狀態，這面旗幟就會一直顯示在畫面上。
en_text: When you issue a Rally Point command, you will notice a flag appears in the world. This flag will be visible whenever you have the structure selected.

tc_text: 凡是透過該棟建築物建立的所有部隊或載具在建立完成之後，就會自動前往「集合點」集合。
en_text: Any squads or vehicles that are built from that structure will automatically gather at the Rally Point when they are built.

tc_text: 現在讓我們來檢視「目標」選單。
en_text: Now we will bring up the Objective Menu.

tc_text: 「目標」選單會提供一份清單，列出本遊戲為你指派的所有主要和次要目標。只要將滑鼠游標移到目標上方，即可取得各項目標的說明。
en_text: The Objective Menu provides you a list of all the Primary and Secondary Objectives assigned to you by the game. Mouse over the Objectives to get the description of each.

tc_text: 很好!你可以隨時按一下上方選單列中的 OBJ 按鈕，以檢視「目標」選單。
en_text: Excellent! Anytime you want to refer to the Objectives Menu, click on the OBJ button on the upper menu bar.

tc_text: 關閉任務視窗
當你熟悉任務視窗時，選取「關閉」鈕回到教學關卡。
en_text: When you are familiar with the Objective Screen, click on the CLOSE button to return to the Tutorial.

tc_text: 建立一輛鐵皮戰車
請選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一輛鐵皮戰車。
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Trukk.

tc_text: 請選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一輛鐵皮戰車。
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Trukk.

tc_text: 鐵皮戰車是歐克蠻人的基本步兵載具，行動迅速，並配有精良的裝甲設備，因此十分適合用來載運步兵部隊，並在戰場上迅速移動
en_text: The Trukk is the Ork's basic infantry transport. Exceptionally fast and well armoured, it is an excellent way to quickly move your infantry around the battlefield.

tc_text: 很好!現在你已經具有一輛鐵皮戰車。你可以嘗試讓步兵部隊進入鐵皮戰車之中，方法是先選取部隊，再用右鍵按一下鐵皮戰車。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Trukk. You can try loading infantry into the Trukk by selecting the squad and right-clicking on it.

tc_text: 若要讓部隊離開鐵皮戰車，請按一下鐵皮戰車工作列上的「解編」圖示。
en_text: To unload the squad, click on the Unload icon on the Trukk's taskbar.

tc_text: 建立一輛坦克贓車
請選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一輛坦克贓車
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Looted Tank.

tc_text: 請選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一輛坦克贓車
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Looted Tank

tc_text: 坦克贓車是一種炮擊戰車，準確度不高，卻能造成毀滅性的區域性破壞。凡是遭到坦克贓車炮火擊中的步兵和建築物，都將化為烏有。
en_text: Looted Tank artillery vehicles have a devestating but inaccurate area attack that can send infantry flying and pound buildings into dust.

tc_text: 很好!坦克贓車除了可以像一般部隊一樣進行攻擊以外，還能針對特定地點進行炮擊，方法是先按一下坦克贓車工作列上的「地面攻擊」圖示，再用左鍵按一下戰場上特定的位置即可。
en_text: Excellent! Your Looted Tank can attack like a normal unit, or you can click the Ground Attack icon on the Looted Tank's taskbar and left-click the battlefield to fire the artillery at a specific location.

tc_text: 建立一架鐵罐機器人
選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一架鐵罐機器人
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Killa Kan.

tc_text: 選取我方的技師工廠，並建立一架鐵罐機器人。
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Killa Kan.

tc_text: 鐵罐機器人是危險的人形機器，其近身戰鬥能力特別令人畏懼；經過升級之後，還能進行威力強大的遠程攻擊。
en_text: Killa Kans are dangerous mechanical walkers. They are feared in close combat and can be upgraded to have powerful ranged attacks.

tc_text: 很好!鐵罐機器人是致命的殺人機器，可以用來打擊步兵士氣、粉碎載具，並協助你擊敗敵人。
en_text: Excellent! Your Killa Kan is a lethal killing machine that can break infantry Morale, crush vehicles and help you defeat your enemy.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人具有許多載具選項。請為你的歐克殖民區進行升級、占領遺址，並累積軍備及電力資源，以建立各式載具。
en_text: The Orks have many vehicle options. Upgrade your Settlement, capture Relics and stockpile Requisition and Power Resources to build them all.

tc_text: 請隨時留意自己的載具上限。一旦達到自己所能支援的載具上限，你將無法繼續徵召載具。
en_text: Don't forget to keep an eye on your Vehicle Cap. You cannot field more vehicles than you can support with your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 建立「吼吼!」戰旗
出動歐克小鬼頭部隊建立「吼吼!」戰旗。
en_text: Use a Gretchin Squad to build a Waaagh! Banner.

tc_text: 請選取一支歐克小鬼頭部隊，並建立「吼吼!」戰旗。
en_text: Select a Gretchin Squad and build a Waaagh! Banner.

tc_text: 建立「歐克大隊集結」的第一步是呼叫歐克蠻人前來集合。
en_text: The first step to gathering an Ork Mob is calling in the Orks.

tc_text: 對歐克蠻人來說，「吼吼!」戰旗的好處還真不少。除了可以提升歐克蠻人的資源生產效率、提升部隊及載具上限，升級之後還能提供更精良的防禦設備。
en_text: Waaagh! Banners provide many benefits to the Orks. They increase the rate of the Ork resource, they increase Squad and Vehicle Cap, and they can be upgraded for even better defense.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一道「吼吼!」戰旗。「吼吼!」戰旗是成功建立「歐克大隊集結」的重要關鍵。總而言之，不斷生產就對了!
en_text: Excellent! You have a Waaagh! Banner. Waaagh! Banners are key to the success of an Ork Mob. It never hurts to build more!

tc_text: 建立一名戰爭頭目
選取我方的歐克殖民區，並建立一名戰爭頭目。
en_text: Select your Ork Settlement and build a Warboss.

tc_text: 選取我方的歐克殖民區，並建立一名戰爭頭目
en_text: Select your Settlement and build a Warboss

tc_text: 當你召集的歐克蠻人達到一定的數目時，便是召喚戰爭頭目的時候。
en_text: When you've amassed a sizeable number of Orks, it's time to call in a Warboss.

tc_text: 戰爭頭目是最龐大、最陰險的歐克蠻人，而且明顯比一般指揮部隊還要強悍。
en_text: The Warboss is the biggest and baddest of the Orks, and is significantly tougher than your average commander.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一名戰爭頭目。現在是讓他帶隊攻擊並殲滅眼前所有敵人的時候。
en_text: Excellent! You have a Warboss. It's now time to lead the charge and destroy all that stand before you.

tc_text: 建立一隻史估革巨獸
選取技師工廠，並建立一隻史估革巨獸。
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Squiggoth.

tc_text: 選取技師工廠，並建立一隻史估革巨獸。
en_text: Select Da Mek Shop and build a Squiggoth.

tc_text: 一批精銳的「歐克大隊集結」需要一輛良好的載具，才能相得益彰。
en_text: A proper Ork mob needs a proper transport.

tc_text: 「史估革巨獸」不是普通的載具。它同時也是具有毀滅性的武器平台，以及所向無敵的殺人機器。除了可以將整支敵方部隊吞入腹中，也能用雙腳將敵人踩得粉身碎骨。
en_text: A Squiggoth is much more than just a transport. It is a devastating weapon platform and an unstoppable killing machine, just as able to eat an enemy squad as it is to trample it beneath its feet.

tc_text: 史估革巨獸啊!史估革巨獸幾乎是刀槍不入。它的體力指標高得驚人，並具有強大的裝甲設備，最適合用來載運大批歐克蠻人，同時對敵人發動猛烈攻擊。
en_text: Ahh the Squiggoth! The Squiggoth is nigh unstoppable. With its incredibly high Health and armour, it is the perfect beast for your Orks to rally around as they charge the enemy.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人的主要力量在於吼!，也是歐克大隊集結在戰場上的主力。
en_text: The Ork race is all about the power of the Waaagh!, which is the power of the Ork Mob on the battlefield.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人所仰賴的是歐克蠻人在歐克大隊集結中的數量，除了研發計劃和升級設施之外，還能開放生產更好更大的部隊、武器和載具。
en_text: The Orks rely on the number of Orks in the Mob, in addition to Researches and Add-ons, to unlock better and bigger units, weapons, and vehicles.

tc_text: 除了軍備和力量之外，歐克蠻人還具有他們自己獨特的資源，稱為歐克蠻人資源，以建立「吼吼!」戰旗來增加其資源。
en_text: In addition to Requisition and Power, the Orks have their own unique resource, called Ork Resource, increased by building Waaagh! Banners.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人的科技仰賴著歐克蠻人的資源數量和部隊上限的總額。你擁有愈多的歐克蠻人，你在歐克大隊集結所能得到的武器就愈精良。
en_text: Ork technology is dependent on the amount of Ork Resource plus the total Squad Cap. The more Orks you have, the better weapons your Mob can get their hands on.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人是一支野蠻殘暴的種族。唯有當他們手上的戰斧插進敵人的胸膛時，才能滿足他們的戰鬥慾。
en_text: The Ork race is a brutal and savage one. Their lust for battle is quenched only by sinking their axe into an opponent's chest!

tc_text: 一般來說，歐克蠻人擅長近身戰鬥勝過長程戰鬥。就算是最瘦弱的歐克蠻人，他們的砍殺技巧也比任何一個星際戰士來得厲害。
en_text: In general, Orks are much better at Melee combat than they are at Ranged. Even the weakest Ork is better than a Space Marine when it comes to chopping.

tc_text: 因為歐克蠻人在戰場中喜歡衝鋒陷陣，所以常會死在敵人的戰火之下。因此，對歐克蠻人部隊來說，將力量增援到最高點，是特別重要的。
en_text: Because Orks like to charge into battle, they often take a lot of casualties from enemy fire. Because of this, it is especially important for Ork Squads to Reinforce to full strength.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人可以透過歐克蠻人小隊數量和歐克蠻人載具的支援取得真正的優勢。
en_text: The Ork race achieves true domination through sheer numbers of Ork squads, with the support of Ork vehicles.

tc_text: 當你的部隊未達關鍵數量時，有時保護你的歐克蠻人是有必要的。
en_text: Sometimes it is necessary to protect your Orks when your forces have not reached critical mass.

tc_text: 大部份的歐克蠻人建築物可以讓你用來戍守歐克蠻人，加上槍的保護，用來守衛日漸增長的歐克大隊集結特別有效。
en_text: Most Ork buildings allow you to Garrison Orks inside them, and since they are bristling with guns, this makes a very effective defense for your growing Ork mob.
