tc_text: 歐克小鬼頭可以免費進行增援，並能有效轉移敵軍部隊的注意力。把歐克小鬼頭當成肉盾，用他們來保護體型壯碩的歐克蠻人。
en_text: Gretchin Squads, or Grotz, can reinforce themselves for free and make a good distraction for enemy troops. Run Gretchin Squads ahead of your Orks as a meat shield, drawing enemy fire away from your bigger Orks.

tc_text: 別期待歐克小鬼頭能在戰鬥中久撐，他們是比較傾向於犧牲的角色。
en_text: Don't expect Grotz to last long in combat, but the sacrifice can be well worth it.

tc_text: 歐克小鬼頭也可以縮短建造建物的時間，歐克小鬼頭的數量愈多，建造的時間就愈短。
en_text: Grotz also decrease the time it takes to build structures, depending on how large your Gretchin Squad is.

tc_text: 觀迎來到「破曉之戰」教學關卡。請一邊聽我說，一邊參考訊息方塊中的文字，如此你便能學會如何進行小戰鬥遊戲。
en_text: Welcome to the Dawn of War tutorial. By listening to me and reading the text that appears in this message box, you will learn how to play a Skirmish game.

tc_text: 滑鼠是你用來調查戰鬥、選取部隊和建物，以及下令的主要工具。
en_text: The mouse is your primary method of surveying the battle, selecting units and structures, and issuing orders.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來控制鏡頭。鏡頭所顯示的是戰場的最新畫面。
en_text: The mouse controls the camera. The camera represents your current view of the battlefield.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來做畫面取景的動作。
en_text: Pan the camera using the mouse

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來控制戰場的畫面。你可以將滑鼠指標移動到畫面邊緣，以進行取景的動作。
en_text: Use your mouse to control your view of the battlefield. You can pan by moving the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
要進行畫面取景的動作，只要將滑鼠指標移動到畫面邊緣就可以了。現在就試試。
en_text: To pan the camera, simply move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen. Do this now.

tc_text: 利用 ALT 鍵來旋轉鏡頭。
en_text: Rotate the camera using the 'ALT' key

tc_text: 要旋轉鏡頭，請按 ALT 鍵，並移動滑鼠。
en_text: To rotate the camera, press the ALT key and move the mouse.

tc_text: 提示文字
要旋轉鏡頭以檢視不同的戰鬥畫面，請按 ALT 鍵，並移動你的滑鼠。現在就試試。
en_text: To rotate the camera to gain a different view of the battle, press the 'ALT' key, and move your mouse. Do this now.

tc_text: 縮放鏡頭
向前轉動你的滑鼠滾輪來縮放鏡頭。
en_text: Zoom the camera by spinning the mouse-wheel forward.

tc_text: 提示文字
你可以向前轉動滑鼠輪來放大某樣東西以便看得更清楚。現在就試試。
en_text: You can zoom in on something to see it up close by spinning the mouse-wheel forward. Do this now.

tc_text: 將鏡頭設為原來的預設值
在你的鍵盤上按下 Backspace 鍵，可將鏡頭恢復到遊戲原來的預設檢視。
en_text: Press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard to return the camera to the game's default view.

tc_text: 提示文字
要將鏡頭恢復到遊戲的預設檢視，請按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵。現在就試試。
en_text: To return the camera to the game's default view, press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好，你已經將鏡頭恢復到遊戲的預設檢視。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to its default playing view.

tc_text: 藉由取景、旋轉，以及縮放鏡頭的這些動作，你可以隨意觀看戰場上任一角度的畫面。
en_text: By panning, rotating, and zooming the camera in and out, you can get whatever view of the battlefield you wish.

tc_text: 選取魍道聯集
按一下左鍵以選取魍道聯集。在部隊或建築物上面按一下左鍵是不變的選取方式。
en_text: Left-click the Webway Assembly to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
要選取一個部隊或建築物，只要在上面按一下滑鼠左鍵就可以了。到你的基地上，並選取魍道聯集。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你已經學會如何在遊戲中選取部隊和建築物了。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.

tc_text: 建立守護戰士部隊
選取你的魍道聯集並建立一支守護戰士部隊。守護戰士部隊是魍道聯集中的常駐部隊。他們是用來防守戰略位置和探索的第一步。
en_text: Select your Webway Assembly and build a Guardian Squad. Guardian Squads are always available from the Webway Assembly. They are the first step to securing Strategic Points and exploring.

tc_text: 守護戰士部隊提示文字
選取你的魍道聯集並在畫面右下角的位置找出守護戰士部隊圖示。現在按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Webway Assembly and look for the Guardian Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 請注意這個慢慢填滿的小長條。這個進度列是用來告訴你生產進度完成的程度。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有一支守護戰士部隊了。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Guardian Squad.

tc_text: 佔領戰略位置
利用一支守護戰士部隊來佔領一個戰略位置。佔領並防守戰略位置，可以獲得更多的軍備資源。
en_text: Use a Guardian Squad to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 佔領提示文字
在戰略位置上按右鍵，以命令守護戰士部隊佔領這個戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Guardian Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 戰略位置是戰場中具有高度戰略價值的位置。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 佔領並控制戰場上的戰略位置是你增加軍備資源的方法。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 佔領一個戰略位置需要時間。在進度列未填滿前請勿將負責佔領的小隊從戰略位置上移開，否則你將無法控制這個戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好!現在這個戰略位置是你的了!你必須繼續佔領更多的戰略位置以獲得更多的軍備資源，進而建立更多的部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is yours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 建立吟骨者
利用你的魍道聯集來建立一個吟骨者。要產生吟骨者需要建立額外的建築物。吟骨者是魍道聯集中的常駐部隊。
en_text: Use your Webway Assembly to build a Bonesinger. Bonesingers are required to build additional structures. Bonesingers are always available from the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 吟骨者提示文字
選取你的魍道聯集並建立一個吟骨者。
en_text: Select your Webway Assembly and build a Bonesinger.

tc_text: 必須使用吟骨者來建造其它的建築物。你隨時可以透過魍道聯集來生產吟骨者。
en_text: Bonesingers are required to build additional structures. Bonesingers are always available from the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 吟骨者已經產生了!吟骨者是神靈族的建造部隊。只要你想建造一個新的建築物，就必須利用吟骨者。
en_text: The Bonesinger has arrived! Bonesingers are the Eldar builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Bonesinger.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建造你的基地你需要一個吟骨者。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Bonesinger.

tc_text: 建立監聽神龕
你必須利用你的吟骨者來建立一個監聽神龕。監聽神龕是用來防守戰略位置、讓它不致遭受敵人入侵奪取的一個方法，並能增加軍備資源的總額。
en_text: You must use your Bonesinger to build a Listening Shrine. Listening Shrines are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increasing the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取吟骨者並在已佔領的戰略位置上建立一個監聽神龕。
en_text: Select the Bonesinger and build a Listening Shrine on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 監聽神龕不但可以加強防禦你的戰略位置，同時還能增加你的軍備等級。
en_text: The Listening Shrine fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置現在已能防止敵人的報復。你應該繼續在你的戰略位置上都建立一個監聽神龕。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Listening Shrines on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 建立神態次元關口
利用你的吟骨者建立一個神態次元關口。建立一個神態次元關口可以開放生產新型的小隊。
en_text: Use your Bonesinger to build an Aspect Portal. Building an Aspect Portal unlocks new kinds of squads to build.

tc_text: 神態次元關口提示文字
選取你的吟骨者，並建立一個神態次元關口。
en_text: Select your Bonesinger and build an Aspect Portal structure.

tc_text: 神態次元關口可以讓你用來建立更先進的神靈族步兵部隊。
en_text: The Aspect Portal is the structure where you can build more advanced Eldar infantry units.

tc_text: 很好，神態次元關口已經完成了。神態次元關口可以讓你用來建立強大的神靈族步兵小隊，還有神靈族指揮部隊，法師。
en_text: Excellent, the Aspect Portal is finished. The Aspect Portal grants access to the best of the Eldar infantry squads, as well as the Eldar's commander unit, the Farseer.

tc_text: 建立遊俠部隊
選取你的神態次元關口，並建立一支遊俠部隊。遊俠部隊力量強大且鬥志高昂，他們可透過研究計劃加以升級，成為一支攻無不克的軍隊。他們同時具有佔領戰略位置的功能。
en_text: Select your Aspect Portal and build a Ranger Squad. Ranger Squads are powerful and resilient, and with research they can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 選取你的神態次元關口，並建立一支遊俠部隊。遊俠部隊和星際戰士小隊相似，但是他們龐大的小隊數量及大量的長步槍，用在打擊敵方士氣時特別有效。
en_text: Select your Aspect Portal and build a Ranger Squad. Ranger Squads are similar to the Space Marine Scout Squads, but their larger squad size and greater number of Long Rifles make them much more effective at breaking enemy Morale.

tc_text: 很好!遊俠部隊雖可打擊敵方的士氣，但無法抵檔敵人強大的火力。他們比較適合用來滲透、支援，以及佔領戰略位置。
en_text: Excellent! Ranger Squads can be devastating to enemy Morale but do not stand up well to intense enemy fire. They are best used for stealth, support, and for capturing Strategic Points.

tc_text: 建立先知法師
選取神態次元關口並建立一個先知法師。先知法師比一般戰士的力量更為強大，在軍隊中扮演著英雄的角色。你可以透過稍後在科技進程中所出現的研發計畫來幫她升級，以得到更強大的力量。
en_text: Select the Aspect Portal and build a Farseer. The Farseer is much more powerful than your average warrior and acts as a hero for your army. You can upgrade her with powerful abilities through research available later in the tech tree.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取神態次元關口並建立一個先知法師。先知法師在軍隊裡所扮演的是英雄的角色。
en_text: Select the Aspect Portal and build a Farseer. The Farseer acts as a hero for your army.

tc_text: 先知法師是一個力量強大的巫師。當她的心靈攻擊的力量不及其他指揮官時，她的心靈能力就會補其不足，帶領你的軍隊取得勝利。
en_text: The Farseer is a powerful psychic. While her physical attacks are not as powerful as those of other commanders, her psychic abilities more than make up for this. She will lead your force to victory.

tc_text: 很好，先知法師已經產生了。法師無法佔領戰略位置，但是她天賦異稟、具有許多強大能力，且能經由研發計畫以取得更多能力。
en_text: Excellent! The Farseer has arrived. The Farseer cannot capture points but is a gifted psychic with many powerful abilities, gaining even more with research.

tc_text: 將你的先知法師加入一支小隊。
en_text: Attach your Farseer to a squad

tc_text: 選取你的先知法師，按一下加入按鈕，並選取你想讓他加入的小隊。
en_text: Select your Farseer, click the Attach button, and select the squad you want to attach him to.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的先知法師，按一下加入按鈕。現在，選取一支遊俠部隊。
en_text: Select your Farseer and click the Attach button. Now, select a Ranger Squad.

tc_text: 很好!注意看先知法師加入小隊時所發生的變化，大家重新整隊，挪出空間給他們尊敬的領袖。
en_text: Excellent! Notice how when the Farseer joins the squad, they rearrange themselves to make room for their esteemed leader.

tc_text: 要讓領袖脫離這支小隊，只要選取該小隊，然後按一下脫離圖示。脫離圖示和加入圖示的位置是一樣的。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon.

tc_text: 建立靈魂神龕
利用吟骨者來建立一個靈魂神龕
en_text: Use your Bonesinger to build a Soul Shrine.

tc_text: 選取你的吟骨者並建立一個靈魂神龕。這是進化神靈族科技等級的方法。
en_text: Select your Bonesinger and build a Soul Shrine. This is how you advance the Eldar technology level.

tc_text: 靈魂神龕屬於一項研發設施。建立靈魂神龕讓你可以開放生產大量的新部隊和新能力。
en_text: The Soul Shrine is a research facility. Building it allows you to unlock a great number of new units and abilities.

tc_text: 很好!靈魂神龕已經完成。這代表神靈族已準備迎接下一階段的挑戰。
en_text: Excellent! The Soul Shrine is complete. This signifies the Eldar are ready for the next stage of their preparations for war.

tc_text: 增加一個巫師到你的遊俠部隊
en_text: Add a Warlock to your Ranger Squad

tc_text: 某些小隊，例如遊俠部隊，可以增加一位領袖。巫師可以大大提高小隊的士氣。選取一支小隊，然後按一下增加領袖：巫師圖示，以建立一個巫師。
en_text: Some squads, like Ranger Squads, can add a Leader. Warlocks provide an excellent boost to the squad's morale. Select a squad, then click the Add Leader: Warlock icon to build a Warlock.

tc_text: 選取一支遊俠部隊，按一下增加領袖：巫師圖示。
en_text: Select a Ranger Squad and click the Add Leader: Warlock icon.

tc_text: 巫師是英勇的領袖，他們可以改善小隊的戰鬥能力和士氣，更能激勵你神靈族的英雄氣慨。
en_text: Warlocks are valiant leaders that improve the combat ability and morale of the squad they are part of. They will inspire your Eldar to greater feats of heroism.

tc_text: 很好!你的巫師已經產生了。要注意的是，你的巫師是小隊的一部份，所以無法脫離小隊。
en_text: Excellent! Your Warlock has arrived. Note that your Warlocks are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 研發戰亂動員
要達到科技的下一層級，及建造載具的能力，你必須選取靈魂神龕，並研發戰亂動員。
en_text: To reach the next level of technology and the ability to build vehicles, you must select the Soul Shrine and research Mobilize for War.

tc_text: 要達到能夠建造載具的這一層級，我們首先必須研發靈魂神龕的戰亂動員。
en_text: To reach the stage where we can build vehicles, we must first research Mobilize for War located on the Soul Shrine.

tc_text: 很好!研發已完成。你現在可以建立神靈族的載具建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The research is complete. You now have access to the Eldar vehicle structure.

tc_text: 建立電漿發電場
利用你的吟骨者來建立一個電漿發電場。電漿發電場提供特殊部隊、武器、載具、建築物及能力所需的電力。電力是你在「破曉之戰」必須掌控的第二種資源。
en_text: Use your Bonesinger to build a Plasma Generator. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的吟骨者並建立一個電漿發電場。
en_text: Select your Bonesinger and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 某些建築物、載具，以及研發計畫，需要電力才能運作。建立一個電漿發電場可以提供讓你軍隊正常運作的電力。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Plasma Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 擁有愈多的電漿發電場，電力資源的增加速度就會愈快。
en_text: The more Plasma Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 你現在已經有電力了!電漿發電場將會以一定的速度繼續製造電力。要注意的是，每一個魍道聯集中電漿發電場的數量是有限制的。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 強化你的遊俠部隊
利用增援功能來為你的遊俠部隊增加部隊。如果有一些部隊死在戰場上，你可以在戰場上任何地點增援你的小隊。
en_text: Use the Reinforce function to add units to your Ranger Squad. You can Reinforce anywhere in the battlefield to replenish your squads if some of your units fall in battle.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取一支遊俠部隊，按一下增援小隊按鈕，以為你的小隊增加新的部隊。
en_text: Select a Ranger Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 增援是調派額外軍隊將小隊戰力提升到最高點的一個動作。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness.

tc_text: 如果你的其中一名神靈族戰士被敵人殺死，你便可以在戰鬥中使用增援功能。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that one of your Eldar warriors is killed by the enemy.

tc_text: 你可以連續按好幾次增援小隊按鈕，讓小隊的戰力提升到最高點。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你已經增援了你的遊俠部隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Ranger Squad.

tc_text: 建立並升級另一支遊俠部隊
en_text: Build and upgrade another Ranger Squad

tc_text: 建立一支遊俠部隊，將它的戰力增援到最高點，賦予二項特殊武器以作為升級，並增加一個領袖。
en_text: Build another Ranger Squad, Reinforce it to full strength, Upgrade it with 2 special weapons, and Add a Leader.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的神態次元關口，建立另一支遊俠部隊。
en_text: Select your Aspect Portal and build another Ranger Squad.

tc_text: 你的戰場基地能提供一定數量的資源給你的小隊。這個你所能支援的小隊數量稱為你的部隊上限。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你可以在畫面上方的資源區看到你最新的部隊上限指數。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 當你的部隊上限指數達到最高時，你就無法請來額外的小隊，所以當你在擴大軍隊時要注意看著這個地方。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional squads, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 你可以藉由建立某些特定的建築物和研發升級，來增加你的部隊上限，但是還是有一個最大限度在。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building certain structures and researching upgrades, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 很好!你不但建立了一支遊俠部隊，更將它的戰力提升到最高點。為了讓戰力能有效發揮，你應該同時擁有多支遊俠部隊，並將它們的戰力增援到最高點，賦予特殊武器以升級，並加派一位巫師來領導他們。
en_text: Excellent! You have built a Ranger Squad and brought it to full strength. To mount an effective attack, you should try to have several Ranger Squads, fully Reinforced to maximum strength and Upgraded with special weapons and a Warlock.

tc_text: 佔領更多戰略位置，並加以防守
en_text: Capture and Secure more Strategic Points

tc_text: 為了確保你有足夠的主要資源及軍備，你需要佔領更多的戰略位置並加以防守。佔領三個戰略位置並在上面建立監聽神龕。
en_text: To make sure you have enough of your main resource, Requisition, you need to capture and secure more Strategic Points. Capture 3 Strategic Points and build Listening Shrines on them.

tc_text: 提示文字
派出遊俠部隊在你的基地附近探索，沿途佔領所遇到的戰略位置。要完成這個目標你必須佔領三個戰略位置。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your Ranger Squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 要確保擁有足夠軍備資源的最佳方式，就是佔領戰略位置並加以防守。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 一定要讓你的吟骨者在每個已佔領的戰略位置上加蓋監聽神龕，以防止敵人奪取。
en_text: Make sure you use your Bonesinger to build Listening Shrines on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了三個戰略位置並加蓋監聽神龕。拿下並守住戰略位置是打敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Listening Shrines on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 佔領關鍵位置
關鍵位置是地圖上具有決定性重要戰略地位的區域。在某些多人模式的遊戲當中，佔領一個以上的這類位置，可以幫你在遊戲中取得勝利。現在就去佔領一個吧。
en_text: Critical Locations are points on the map that represent areas of critical strategic importance. In some multiplayer games, capturing one or more of these points can win you the game. Capture one now.

tc_text: 提示文字
利用小隊來佔領一個關鍵位置。關鍵位置是地圖上具有決定性重要戰略地位的區域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 你可以用佔領戰位置的方式來佔領關鍵位置。在某些多人模式的遊戲中，佔領並加以防守一個以上的關鍵位置可以幫你在遊戲中取得勝利!你也可以從你所控制的關鍵位置中取得軍備。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了一個關鍵位置。要注意的是，關鍵位置無法加蓋監聽神龕，你必須想其他的辦法來防守。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Listening Shrines built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 佔領遺址
遺址是具有高度價值的神聖地點。守住遺址可以讓你獲得更佳的軍隊部隊和載具。
en_text: Relics are sacred points of great value. Holding Relics will allow you access to your army's best units and vehicles.

tc_text: 提示文字
利用一支小隊來佔領一個遺址。遺址是具有高度價值的神聖地點。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 守住遺址可以讓你獲得更佳的軍隊部隊及載具。守好這些遺址，以確保你能擁有最佳的科技。
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了一個遺址。你可以建立監聽神龕來加強防禦已佔領的遺址。你也可以佔領對手的遺址以防止他們使用他們的最佳部隊及科技。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Shrines to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 建立後援次元關口
利用你的吟骨者來建立一個後援次元關口。我們要利用後援次元關口來建立載具。
en_text: Use your Bonesinger to build a Support Portal. The Support Portal is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 提示文字
利用你的吟骨者來建立一個後援次元關口。
en_text: Use your Bonesinger to build a Support Portal.

tc_text: 後援次元關口是神靈族用來製造載具的建築物。就像神態次元關口一樣，我們一樣也要研發它的神態石升級設施來開放生產的載具。
en_text: The Support Portal is the vehicle-producing structure for the Eldar race. Just like the Aspect Portal, it too has Aspect Stone Add-ons that must be researched to unlock vehicles.

tc_text: 載具非常堅韌且非一般未經升級的步兵所能攻破。它們是軍隊的基礎，並可以攜帶火力強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 要注意的是，你的作戰基地只能容納一定數量的載具，稱為載具上限。就和部隊上限一樣，達到上限時，就無法建立更多的載具，你可以透過魍道聯集的研發科技來增加你的載具上限。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap. Just like Squad Cap, once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can research technology at your Webway Assembly that will increase your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 很好!你現在已經有了一個後援次元關口。你可以在這個建築物建立強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Support Portal. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 要增加遊戲中你可以派出的小隊數量，按一下魍道聯集上的研發項目。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field in Dawn of War, you click on the research items located on your Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 你已經達到可以派出的小隊數量極限。確定你已將小隊戰力增援到最高點，達到充分利用的效果。如果你覺得投資不慎，可以在鍵盤上按一下刪除鍵，將不要的小隊解雇。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them. If you have invested unwisely, you can press the 'Delete' button on your keyboard to terminate unwanted squads.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你已經完成教學關卡的課程。
en_text: Congratulations! You've completed the learning session of the tutorial.

tc_text: 現在是將你的所學加以應用的時候了。掌管好你的軍隊，並擴大你的力量，將敵人擊潰。
en_text: It is time to put what you have learned to work. Take control of the force and build up your strength so you can crush your enemy!

tc_text: 利用步兵部隊來佔領戰略位置，並利用吟骨者在戰略位置上加蓋監聽神龕。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points, and Bonesingers to build Listening Shrines on them.

tc_text: 繼續建造建築物，完成研發計劃，增加你的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 建立額外的小隊和載具。務必針對能夠增加你的部隊上限和載具上限的研發項目進行研究。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure you research upgrades that will increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 征服一個又一個戰場，擊敗你的敵人，不然戰爭是不會結束的。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 尋求掩護
選取你其中一支步兵小隊，將他們移動到掩護的位置。掩護區上面註有標記，不管是在小地圖或世界地圖都可以看得到它。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 掩護提示
某些地形可以提供小隊躲開敵人的炮火，稱為掩護。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 選取你其中一支步兵小隊，將他們移動到掩護的位置。掩護區上面註有標記，不管是在小地圖或世界地圖都可以看得到它。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 掩護非常好用，它可以增加小隊的防禦能力，不致於讓敵人輕易取得性命。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 地形中的掩護很容易發現 -- 當你的滑鼠游標經過城市中的大彈坑，或叢林中的大片樹葉時，此時游標便會產生變化。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 你會注意到當你將你的小隊移動到掩護區時，上頭就會出現一個小的掩護圖示。這表示他們的防禦能力增加了。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好!你的小隊現在已經在掩護裡。掩護中的部隊很難被瞄準擊中，並且在長程攻擊中傷害較輕微。好好利用掩護以在對戰中取得戰術上的優勢。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已掌握更進一步的概念，它有助你殲滅你的敵人!
en_text: Very good! You are mastering advanced concepts that will help you to annihilate your enemies!

tc_text: 選取一支小隊，並留心小隊體力指數上方的藍色小長條。這藍色小長條所代表的是小隊的士氣。
en_text: Select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just under the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 士氣代表部隊在戰鬥中所能發揮的戰力，它有如智力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的組合。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 遊戲中有各種不同的武器不但會損害體力指數，也會打擊士氣。當小隊的士氣受到打擊時，藍色小長條就會減少，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 當小隊的士氣過低時，這支小隊就會潰散。一支潰不成軍的小隊失去戰鬥意願，其戰力也會降到最低。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 你還是可以控制潰散的小隊。你可以選擇讓他們繼續留在戰鬥中或撤退以補充力量。某些部隊具有增加小隊士氣的能力。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength. Also, certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 士氣是擊退敵人的有效武器。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies.

tc_text: 藉由打擊敵人的士氣，你會讓他們失去戰力，很容易就能取得他們的性命。這樣一來，一支小而精的部隊也可以以小擊大。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 記住，戰術和戰略是戰鬥中的重要關鍵。要善加利用這個道理以在戰場中取得勝利!
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 記住，小隊所受的傷會影響全體，當一支小隊損害到一定程度時，一個部隊就會因此陣亡。
en_text: Remember, a squad takes damage as a whole. When enough damage has been inflicted on the squad, a unit will die.

tc_text: 如果你在戰鬥中失去任何部隊，你可以利用增援功能，將小隊戰力再度發揮到極致。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 留心戰鬥中小隊的力量變化。經常運用增援功能，盡量讓小隊充份發揮戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 記住，當一支具有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你同時也會失去那項武器。這時你就必須替小隊升級，以再度獲得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 畫面左下角的菱形畫面就是你的小地圖。
en_text: The diamond-shaped display in the lower left-hand corner of your screen is your Mini-map.

tc_text: 小地圖提供克敵制勝的重要資訊。
en_text: The Mini-map provides important information that will help you win battles.

tc_text: 你可以利用小地圖觀看部隊和建築物的位置、快速掃瞄整個戰場，以及下達命令等等。
en_text: You can use the Mini-map to see where your units and structures are located, to quickly scan the battlefield, to issue quick orders, and so on.

tc_text: 在小地圖任意一處按一下，鏡頭就會移動到該處。當你需要快速調查整個戰場、決定戰術運用時，此時這個功能就能發揮其效果。
en_text: Clicking anywhere in the Mini-map will move your camera to that location. This is useful when you need to survey the battlefield quickly, to make tactical decisions.

tc_text: 隨時留意你的小地圖，它可以讓你知道部隊的現狀，和那些在檢視畫面中看不到的問題。
en_text: Keep an eye on your Mini-map. It will help you see what is happening to units that you cannot currently see in your view screen.

tc_text: 小地圖顯示出戰場上所有戰略位置的所在處，以及其他具有戰略重要性的東西。
en_text: The Mini-map displays the locations of all Strategic Points on the battlefield, as well as other items of strategic importance.

tc_text: 戰爭迷霧會在你不在場的地方出現，進而影響你的視覺。當你移動部隊到某個區域時，戰爭迷霧就會散開。
en_text: Fog of War prevents you from seeing things where you do not have a presence. As you move units into an area, the Fog of War will be lifted.

tc_text: 就算你在某個區域建有建築物，戰爭迷霧仍然會出現。
en_text: When you have structures built in an area, the Fog of War in that area will remain revealed.

tc_text: 礦渣區是地表下的能量集中點。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 在礦渣區上建立一個熱流電漿發電機以獲取大量的電能。
en_text: Build a Thermo-Plasma Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 快速瀏覽一下你的小地圖，圖上的小圓點就是礦渣區的所在處。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 吟骨者可以在礦渣區上建立熱流電漿發電機。
en_text: Bonesingers can build Thermo-Plasma Generators on Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 注意看當一個部隊產生時，小隊增援後所產生的變化，小隊會自動重新整隊來接納他們的加入。這是因為小隊的行動都是一致的。
en_text: Notice how each time a squad is Reinforced and a unit arrives, the squad rearranges itself to accomodate the new arrival. This is because squads work together as a unit.

tc_text: 小隊接到類似移動和攻擊的指令，其行動都是協調一致的。這就是小隊的力量，讓你可以在戰場中更輕易的控制數量龐大的部隊。
en_text: A squad responds to commands, such as move and attack, in harmony. This is the strength of the squad, and it allows you to control a large number of units on the battlefield more easily.

tc_text: 記住，守住戰略位置能增加你的軍備資源。沒有足夠的軍備資源，就無法建立所需的軍力，在戰場中克敵制勝。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requsition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 當你決定在某處建立建築物時，請注意看，你的建築物附近就會出現白色環狀物。這就是所謂的控制區域。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能建造在控制區域以內的範圍，其他的建築物，像是監聽神龕，可以建造在其他地點。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Listening Shrines, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你要擺放一個新的建築物時，你在移動它的時候，它的顏色就會從紅色轉成綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its colour changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 綠色代表該建築物可以擺放在該處，如此建造工作也將開始。
en_text: A Green colour indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 隱藏工具列
你可以在能力列中上邊緣的位置按一下頭骨圖示。現在就試試看把能力列隱藏起來。
en_text: You can hide the taskbar by clicking on the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar. Try hiding the taskbar now.

tc_text: 按一下能力列中上邊緣的頭骨圖示，以隱藏能力列。
en_text: Hide the taskbar by clicking the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar.

tc_text: 當能力列呈隱藏狀態時，你會發現小地圖還在。
en_text: When the taskbar is hidden, you will notice the Mini-Map stays revealed.

tc_text: 不管下達命令還是將小隊升級，你可以叫出能力列或利用快速鍵。
en_text: To issue commands and upgrade your squads you can either unhide the taskbar or use the 'hotkeys'.

tc_text: 要恢復完整的能力列，只要再按一下頭骨圖示就可以了。
en_text: To return to the full taskbar, simply click the Skull icon again.

tc_text: 下達集合點指令
要下達一個集合點指令，先選取任何一個能生產小隊或載具的建築物，然後在附近的地面上按一下右鍵。
en_text: To issue a Rally Point command, select any building that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 你剛剛已經下達了一個集合點指令了。藉由選取一個可以建立小隊或載具的建築物，並在附近的地面上按右鍵，就能辦到這一點。
en_text: You've just issued a Rally Point command. You did this by selecting a structure capable of building squads or vehicles and right-clicking the ground nearby.

tc_text: 我們來下達一個集合點指令吧。
en_text: Let's issue a Rally Point command.

tc_text: 選取任何可以生產小隊或載具的建築物，並在附近的地面上按一下右鍵。
en_text: Select any structure that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 當你下達一個集合點指令時，你會發現，世界地圖上會出現一支旗子。不管何時只要你選取了該棟建築物，這支旗子就會出現。
en_text: When you issue a Rally Point command, you will notice a flag appears in the world. This flag will be visible whenever you have the structure selected.

tc_text: 只要在該棟建築所建立的小隊或載具，當他們建立好時，就會自動在該集合點集合。
en_text: Any squads or vehicles that are built from that structure will automatically gather at the Rally Point when they are built.

tc_text: 現在我們要叫出目標選單。
en_text: Now we will bring up the Objective Menu.

tc_text: 目標選單上面會列出所有遊戲指派給你的主要和次要目標。滑鼠指在目標上就會有詳細的描述。
en_text: The Objective Menu provides you a list of all the Primary and Secondary Objectives assigned to you by the game. Mouse over the Objectives to get the description of each.

tc_text: 很好!只要你想要參考目標選單時，就在上層功能表列的目標按鈕上按一下。
en_text: Excellent! Anytime you want to refer to the Objectives Menu, click on the OBJ button on the upper menu bar.

tc_text: 關閉任務視窗
當你熟悉任務視窗時，選取「關閉」鈕回到教學關卡。
en_text: When you are familiar with the Objective Screen, click on the CLOSE button to return to the Tutorial.

tc_text: 建立獵鷹重力坦克
選取你的後援次元關口並建造一部獵鷹重力坦克。
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Falcon Grav Tank.

tc_text: 選取你的後援次元關口並建造一部獵鷹重力坦克。
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Falcon Grav Tank.

tc_text: 獵鷹重力坦克是神靈族的基本步兵載具。它的移動速度非常快，且具有相當強韌的鋼板，可以載著你的步兵在戰場上來去自如。
en_text: The Falcon Grav Tank is the Eldar's basic infantry transport. Exceptionally fast and well armoured, it is an excellent way to quickly move your infantry around the battlefield.

tc_text: 很好!你現在已經有了一部獵鷹重力坦克。你可以選取一支小隊，按下右鍵，試著將步兵載入獵鷹重力坦克裡。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Falcon Grav Tank. You can try loading infantry into the Falcon Grav Tank by selecting the squad and right-clicking on it.

tc_text: 要讓小隊離開載具，在獵鷹重力坦克的能力列上按一下解編圖示就可以了。
en_text: To unload the squad, click on the Unload icon on the Falcon Grav Tank's taskbar.

tc_text: 建造焰晶坦克
選取你的後援次元關口並建造一部焰晶坦克。
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Fire Prism.

tc_text: 選取你的後援次元關口並建造一部焰晶坦克。
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Fire Prism.

tc_text: 焰晶坦克的砲火猛烈但準確性不佳，它可以將步兵炸飛，還能將建築物炸成灰燼。
en_text: Fire Prism artillery vehicles have a devestating but inaccurate area attack that can send infantry flying and pound buildings into dust.

tc_text: 很好!你的焰晶坦克可以像一般部隊一樣攻擊，或者你可以按一下焰晶坦克能力列上的地面攻擊圖示，並在戰場上按左鍵，以在特定的地點上發射出火砲。
en_text: Excellent! Your Fire Prism can attack like a normal unit, or you can click the Ground Attack icon on the Fire Prism's taskbar and left-click the battlefield to fire the artillery at a specific location.

tc_text: 建立冥靈君王
選取你的後援次元關口，建立一個冥靈君王
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Wraithlord.

tc_text: 選取你的後援次元關口，建立一個冥靈君王。
en_text: Select your Support Portal and build a Wraithlord.

tc_text: 冥靈君王是一種危險的機器人。他們在近身攻擊中所向無敵，並可以透過升級以增加他們的長程攻擊。
en_text: Wraithlords are dangerous mechanical walkers. They are feared in close combat and can be upgraded to have powerful ranged attacks.

tc_text: 很好!你的冥靈君王是一具能打擊步兵士氣的致命殺人機器，並能摧毀載具，協助你打擊敵人。
en_text: Excellent! Your Wraithlord is a lethal killing machine that can break infantry Morale, crush vehicles and help you defeat your enemy.

tc_text: 神靈族有許多載具選項。升級你的魍道聯集、佔領遺址、儲存軍備及電力資源，以建立所有的載具。
en_text: The Eldar have many vehicle options. Upgrade your Webway Assembly, capture Relics and stockpile Requisition and Power Resources to build them all.

tc_text: 別忘了留意你的載具上限，超過了這個上限，你就無法建造更多的載具。
en_text: Don't forget to keep an eye on your Vehicle Cap. You cannot field more vehicles than you can support with your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 神靈族步兵和「破曉之戰」的其他種族很不一樣
en_text: Eldar infantry are very different than the other races in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 不同類型的神靈族步兵有不同的專長。
en_text: Different types of Eldar infantry specialize in countering various threats.

tc_text: 要建立某些神靈族步兵需要先研發神態石。神態石只能解除在神態次元關口所研發的相關步兵種類之鎖定，而無法全面解除所有關口的鎖定。
en_text: Some Eldar infantry require you to research Aspect Stones first. Aspect Stones only unlock the associated infantry type at the Aspect Portal where they are researched, not globally across all portals.

tc_text: 建立魍道關口
選取一個吟骨者，並建立一個魍道關口。
en_text: Select a Bonesinger and build a Webway Gate.

tc_text: 選取一個吟骨者，並建立一個魍道關口。
en_text: Select a Bonesinger and build a Webway Gate.

tc_text: 神靈族仰賴魍道關口所賦予的幾項功能：擴大控制區域，增加部隊上限及載具上限，以及快速變換步兵小隊的位置。
en_text: Eldar depend on Webway Gates for many reasons: they expand the Control Zone, they add to the Squad and Vehicle Cap, and they allow for the fast relocation of infantry squads.

tc_text: 很好!魍道關口已經完成，你必須建立魍道關口來支援你的軍隊。
en_text: Excellent! The Webway Gate is finished. You must build Webway Gates to support your army.

tc_text: 你可以選取任何一支小隊，並在魍道關口上按右鍵，將你的步兵戍守在魍道關口內。之後，你可以在任何已經選取的魍道關口上按卸載圖示，將小隊從戰場上其他的魍道關口離開。
en_text: You can garrison infantry inside a Webway Gate by selecting any squad and right-clicking on the gate. You can then unload the squad from ANY other gate on the battlefield by clicking the Unload icon on any selected Webway Gate.

tc_text: 魍道關口可以建立重力平台。重力平台的功能有如可移動的迴轉砲台，且重力平台-光束長槍是對付載具的有效武器。
en_text: Webway Gates can build Grav Platforms. Grav Platforms function as moveable turrets and the Brightlance Grav Platform is excellent against vehicles.

tc_text: 如果你選取了神態次元關口，你會發現有各種不同的升級設施，稱為神態石。
en_text: If you select the Aspect Portal you will notice several different types of Add-on's, called Aspect Stones.

tc_text: 某些特別的神靈族步兵小隊必須經由研發這些神態石才能開放生產。
en_text: Certain special Eldar infantry squad types must be unlocked by researching these Aspect Stones.

tc_text: 建立狂嚎女妖部隊
選取神態次元關口並研發狂嚎女妖神態石升級設施。完成後，你便可以在神態次元關口建立一支狂嚎女妖部隊。
en_text: Select the Aspect Portal and research the Banshee Aspect Stone Add-on. When that is finished you can build a Howling Banshee Squad from that Aspect Portal.

tc_text: 我們來建立一支狂嚎女妖部隊吧。選取神態次元關口，並研發狂嚎女妖神態石升級設施。當研發完成時，你便可以建立一支狂嚎女妖部隊。
en_text: Let's build a Howling Banshee Squad. Select the Aspect Portal and research the Banshee Aspect Stone Add-on. When the research is finished, you can build a Howling Banshee Squad.

tc_text: 狂嚎女妖是近身戰鬥的專家，就連強大的星際戰士也不是她們的對手。
en_text: The Howling Banshees are terrifying close-combat specialists that can tie up and decimate even the mighty Space Marines.

tc_text: 很好!狂嚎女妖部隊已經完成。狂嚎女妖擅長近身戰鬥，是對付步兵的利器。
en_text: Excellent! The Howling Banshee Squad is complete. Howling Banshees are perfect for close combat against enemy infantry.

tc_text: 建立暗黑死神部隊
選取神態次元關口並研發暗黑死神神態石升級設施。完成後你便可以在神態次元關口建立一支暗黑死神部隊。
en_text: Select the Aspect Portal and research the Reaper Aspect Stone Add-on. When that is finished you can build a Dark Reaper Squad from that Aspect Portal.

tc_text: 我們來建立一支暗黑死神部隊吧。選取神態次元關口，並研發暗黑死神神態石升級設施。當研發完成時，你便可以建立一支暗黑死神部隊。
en_text: Let's build a Dark Reaper Squad. Select the Aspect Portal and research the Reaper Aspect Stone Add-on. When the research is finished, you can build a Dark Reaper Squad.

tc_text: 很好!暗黑死神是致命的長程攻擊神射手，擅於重創像星際戰士這般強大的裝甲步兵。
en_text: The Dark Reapers are deadly long-range marksmen that excel at killing heavily armoured infantry like the mighty Space Marines.

tc_text: 很好!暗黑死神擅於長程攻擊，很適合用來對付星際戰士和終極戰士這一類的重型步兵。
en_text: Excellent! Dark Reapers are ideal for ranged attacks on heavy infantry like Space Marine Squads and Terminators.

tc_text: 建立次元蜘蛛部隊
選取神態次元關口並研發次元蜘蛛神態石升級設施。完成後你便可以在神態次元關口建立一支次元蜘蛛部隊。
en_text: Select the Aspect Portal and research the Spider Aspect Stone Add-on. When that is finished you can build a Warp Spider Squad from that Aspect Portal.

tc_text: 我們來從神態次元關口建立一支次元蜘蛛部隊吧。研發次元蜘蛛神態石升級設施，然後建立一支次元蜘蛛部隊。
en_text: Let's build a Warp Spider Squad from the Aspect Portal by researching the Warp Spider Aspect Stone Add-on and then building a Warp Spider Squad.

tc_text: 次元蜘蛛本身便具有瞬間移動能力，可以在地圖上快速移動。
en_text: The Warp Spiders have powerful teleporters integrated into their armour that allow them to teleport quickly about the map.

tc_text: 次元蜘蛛部隊除了用來對付輕裝步兵之外，他們還可以經由升級以對付載具和摧毀建築物。
en_text: In addition to the Warp Spider Squads' main use as a light infantry counter, they can be upgraded to handle vehicles and destroy buildings.

tc_text: 很好!次元蜘蛛部隊擅於對付像歐克蠻人的斧兵小隊和邪教徒此類的輕裝步兵。
en_text: Excellent! Warp Spider Squads are best at dealing death to light infantry like Ork Slugga Boyz and Cultists.

tc_text: 神靈族是一支屬於機動性十足的種族。
en_text: The Eldar are a very mobile race.

tc_text: 許多神靈族步兵都具有迅速移動的能力，讓他們能在長距離中快速行動。
en_text: Many Eldar infantry have the Fleet of Foot ability that grants them greater speed over long distances.

tc_text: 大部份的神靈族載具、次元蜘蛛部隊、甚至是魍道關口，都能進行各種形式的跳躍和瞬間移動。神靈族擅於在戰場中快速移動。
en_text: Most Eldar vehicles, the Warp Spider Squads, and even the Webway Gates allow for various forms of Jumping and Teleportation. The Eldar excel at moving quickly around the battlefield.

tc_text: 建立戰神分身
戰神分身是神靈族的活神仙。戰神分身要在神態次元關口建立。要建立戰神分身，你必須研發所有在神態次元關口和後援次元關口的神態石升級設施。
en_text: The Avatar is a living god for the Eldar race. The Avatar is built from the Aspect Portal. To build the Avatar you must research ALL of the Aspect Stone Add-ons on both the Aspect Portal and the Support Portal.

tc_text: 我們就來建立一個戰神分身吧。首先你必須研發在神態次元關口和後援次元關口的所有神態石升級設施。完成之後，選取神態次元關口，建立戰神分身。
en_text: Let's build an Avatar. You must first research all of the Aspect Stone Add-ons on the Aspect Portal and Support Portal. When that is complete, select the Aspect Portal and build the Avatar.

tc_text: 戰神分身需花費相當多的資源，但因為它力量非常強大，所以值得。
en_text: The Avatar costs a significant amount of resources but is well worth it for its strength in combat.

tc_text: 很好，戰神分身已經完成了。戰神分身是神靈族最厲害的活武器，只要它走過的地方，無一倖免。勇往直前，攻無不克。
en_text: Excellent! The Avatar is finished. The Avatar is the Eldar's ultimate living weapon. It will destroy all in its path. Go forth and conquer.

tc_text: 觀迎來到「破曉之戰」教學關卡。請一邊聽我說，一邊參考訊息方塊中的文字，如此你便能學會如何進行小戰鬥遊戲。
en_text: Welcome to the Dawn of War tutorial. By listening to me and reading the text that appears in this message box, you will learn how to play a Skirmish game.

tc_text: 滑鼠是你用來調查戰鬥、選取部隊和建物，以及下令的主要工具。
en_text: The mouse is your primary method of surveying the battle, selecting units and structures, and issuing orders.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來控制鏡頭。鏡頭所顯示的是戰場的最新畫面。
en_text: The mouse controls the camera. The camera represents your current view of the battlefield.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來做畫面取景的動作。
en_text: Pan the camera using the mouse

tc_text: 利用滑鼠來控制戰場的畫面。你可以將滑鼠指標移動到畫面邊緣，以進行取景的動作。
en_text: Use your mouse to control your view of the battlefield. You can pan by moving the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
要進行畫面取景的動作，只要將滑鼠指標移動到畫面邊緣就可以了。現在就試試。
en_text: To pan the camera, simply move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen. Do this now.

tc_text: 利用 ALT 鍵來旋轉鏡頭。
en_text: Rotate the camera using the 'ALT' key

tc_text: 要旋轉鏡頭，請按 ALT 鍵，並移動滑鼠。
en_text: To rotate the camera, press the ALT key and move the mouse.

tc_text: 提示文字
要旋轉鏡頭以檢視不同的戰鬥畫面，請按 ALT 鍵，並移動你的滑鼠。現在就試試。
en_text: To rotate the camera to gain a different view of the battle, press the 'ALT' key, and move your mouse. Do this now.

tc_text: 縮放鏡頭
向前轉動你的滑鼠滾輪來縮放鏡頭。
en_text: Zoom the camera by spinning the mouse-wheel forward.

tc_text: 提示文字
你可以向前轉動滑鼠輪來放大某樣東西以便看得更清楚。現在就試試。
en_text: You can zoom in on something to see it up close by spinning the mouse-wheel forward. Do this now.

tc_text: 將鏡頭設為原來的預設值
在你的鍵盤上按下 Backspace 鍵，可將鏡頭恢復到遊戲原來的預設檢視。
en_text: Press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard to return the camera to the game's default view.

tc_text: 提示文字
要將鏡頭恢復到遊戲的預設檢視，請按鍵盤上的 Backspace 鍵。現在就試試。
en_text: To return the camera to the game's default view, press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好，你已經將鏡頭恢復到遊戲的預設檢視。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to its default playing view.

tc_text: 藉由取景、旋轉，以及縮放鏡頭的這些動作，你可以隨意觀看戰場上任一角度的畫面。
en_text: By panning, rotating, and zooming the camera in and out, you can get whatever view of the battlefield you wish.

tc_text: 選取褻瀆堡壘
按一下左鍵以選取褻瀆堡壘，在部隊或建築物上面按一下左鍵是不變的選取方式。
en_text: Left-click the Desecrated Stronghold to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
要選取一個部隊或建築物，只要在上面按一下滑鼠左鍵就可以了。到你的基地上，並選取褻瀆堡壘。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Desecrated Stronghold.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你剛剛學會如何在遊戲中選取部隊和建築物的方法。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.

tc_text: 建立邪教徒部隊
選取你的褻瀆堡壘並建立一支邪教徒部隊。邪教徒部隊是褻瀆堡壘中的常駐部隊。他們是用來防守戰略位置和探索的第一步。
en_text: Select your Desecrated Stronghold and build a Cultist Squad. Cultist Squads are always available from the Desecrated Stronghold. They are the first step to securing Strategic Points and exploring.

tc_text: 邪教徒部隊提示文字
選取你的褻瀆堡壘並在畫面右下角的位置找出褻瀆堡壘圖示。現在按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Desecrated Stronghold and look for the Cultist Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 請注意看這個慢慢填滿的小長條。這個進度列是用來告訴你完成的進度到哪邊了。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有一支邪教徒部隊了。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Cultist Squad.

tc_text: 佔領戰略位置
利用一支邪教徒部隊來佔領一個戰略位置。佔領並防守戰略位置，可以獲得更多的軍備資源。
en_text: Use a Cultist Squad to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 佔領提示文字
在戰略位置上按右鍵，以命令邪教徒部隊佔領這個戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Cultist Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 戰略位置是戰場中具有高度戰略價值的位置。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 佔領並控制戰場上的戰略位置是你增加軍備資源的方法。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 佔領一個戰略位置需要時間。在進度列未填滿前請勿將負責佔領的小隊從戰略位置上移開，否則你將無法控制這個戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好!現在這個戰略位置是你的了!你必須繼續佔領更多的戰略位置以獲得更多的軍備資源，進而建立更多的部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is ours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 建立叛教徒
利用你的褻瀆堡壘來建立一個叛教徒。要產生叛教徒需要建立額外的建築物。叛教徒是褻瀆堡壘中的常駐部隊。
en_text: Use your Desecrated Stronghold to build a Heretic. Heretics are required to build additional structures. Heretics are always available from the Desecrated Stronghold.

tc_text: 叛教徒提示文字
選取你的褻瀆堡壘並建立一個叛教徒。
en_text: Select your Desecrated Stronghold and build a Heretic.

tc_text: 要產生叛教徒需要建立額外的建築物。叛教徒是褻瀆堡壘中的常駐部隊。
en_text: Heretics are required to build additional structures. Heretics are always available from the Desecrated Stronghold.

tc_text: 叛教徒已經產生了!叛教徒是混沌軍團的建造部隊。只要你想建造一個新的建築物，就必須利用叛教徒。
en_text: The Heretic has arrived! Heretics are the Chaos' builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Heretic.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建造你的基地你需要一個叛教徒。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Heretic.

tc_text: 建立監聽哨
你必須利用你的叛教徒來建立一個監聽哨。監聽哨是防守戰略位置，讓它不致遭受敵人入侵奪取的一個方法，並能增加軍備資源的總額。
en_text: You must use your Heretic to build a Listening Post. Listening Posts are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increasing the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取叛教徒並在已佔領的戰略位置上建立一個監聽哨。
en_text: Select the Heretic and build a Listening Post on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 監聽哨不但可以加強防禦你的戰略位置，同時還能增加你的軍備等級。
en_text: The Listening Post fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置現在已能防止敵人的報復。你應該繼續在你的占略位置上都建立一個監聽哨。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Listening Posts on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 建立混沌神殿
利用你的叛教徒來建立一個混沌神殿。混沌神殿是用來建立星際戰士的，他們會成為你軍隊中的主幹。建立混沌神殿還可以開放生產的新型小隊和建築物。
en_text: Use your Heretic to build a Chaos Temple. The Chaos Temple is used to build Chaos Space Marines, who will form the backbone of your army. Creating a Chaos Temple will also unlock new kinds of squads and buildings.

tc_text: 混沌神殿提示文字
選取你的叛教徒，並建立一個混沌神殿。
en_text: Select your Heretic and build a Chaos Temple structure.

tc_text: 混沌神殿可以讓你用來建立更先進的混沌軍團步兵部隊。
en_text: The Chaos Temple is the structure where you can build more advanced Chaos infantry units.

tc_text: 很好，混沌神殿已經完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Chaos Temple is finished.

tc_text: 建立混沌星際戰士小隊
en_text: Build a Chaos Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 選取你的混沌神殿，並建立一支混沌星際戰士小隊。混沌星際戰士小隊力量強大且鬥志高昂，他們可透過研究計劃加以升級，成為一支攻無不克的軍隊。他們同時具有佔領戰略位置的功能!
en_text: Select your Chaos Temple and build a Chaos Space Marine Squad. Chaos Space Marine Squads are powerful and resilient, and with research they can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 選取你的混沌神殿，並建立一支混沌星際戰士小隊。這些精英戰士將是軍隊的核心。
en_text: Select your Chaos Temple and build a Chaos Space Marine Squad. These elite warriors will form the core of your military force.

tc_text: 很好!混沌星際戰士小隊是你全方位的武力。他們力量強大且鬥志高昂，可透過研究計劃加以升級，成為一支攻無不克的軍隊。他們同時具有佔領戰略位置的功能!
en_text: Excellent! Chaos Space Marine Squads are your all-purpose fighting force. They are powerful and resilient and, with research, can be upgraded to counter almost any threat. They can also capture Strategic Points!

tc_text: 建立混沌領主
選取混沌神殿並建立一個混沌領主。混沌領主比一般戰士的力量更為強大，在軍隊中扮演著英雄的角色。你可以透過稍後在科技進程中所出現的研發計畫來幫他升級，以得到更強大的力量。
en_text: Select the Chaos Temple and build a Chaos Lord. The Chaos Lord is much more powerful than your average warrior and acts as a hero for your army. You can upgrade him with powerful abilities through research available later in the tech tree.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取混沌神殿並建立一個混沌軍團。混沌領主在軍隊裡所扮演的是英雄的角色。
en_text: Select the Chaos Temple and build a Chaos Lord. The Chaos Lord acts as a hero for your army.

tc_text: 混沌領主身經百戰，無人可與之匹敵，他會帶領你的軍隊取得勝利。
en_text: The Chaos Lord is a veteran of thousands of battles and his combat prowess is unrivalled. He will lead your force to victory.

tc_text: 很好!混沌領主已經產生了。混沌領主無法佔領戰略位置，但是他是一個身懷絕技的戰士，且能經由研發計畫以取得更多能力。
en_text: Excellent! The Chaos Lord has arrived. The Chaos Lord cannot capture points but is a skilled warrior who can be upgraded with powerful abilities.

tc_text: 當你建立更多的設施，解除更多鎖定的研發計畫時，混沌軍團的其他指揮部隊就會陸續可用。
en_text: The Chaos' other commander unit will become available as you build more facilities and unlock more research.

tc_text: 將你的混沌領主加入一支小隊。
en_text: Attach your Chaos Lord to a squad

tc_text: 選取你的混沌領主，按一下加入按鈕，並選取你想讓他加入的小隊。
en_text: Select your Chaos Lord, click the Attach button, and select the squad you want to attach him to.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的混沌領主，按一下加入按鈕。現在，選取一支混沌星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Chaos Lord and click the Attach button. Now, select a Chaos Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 注意看混沌領主加入小隊時所發生的變化，大家重新整隊，挪出空間給他們尊敬的領袖。
en_text: Notice how when the Chaos Lord joins the squad, they rearrange themselves to make room for their esteemed leader.

tc_text: 這支混沌星際戰士小隊會因為混沌領主的加入而變得更強大，然而混沌領主的獨自戰鬥能力也是有目共睹的。
en_text: This Chaos Space Marine Squad is greatly enhanced by the addition of the Chaos Lord, but he can also fight effectively on his own.

tc_text: 要讓領袖脫離這支小隊，只要選取該小隊，然後按一下脫離圖示。脫離圖示和加入圖示的位置是一樣的。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon.

tc_text: 升級褻瀆堡壘
該是升級褻瀆堡壘的時候了，褻瀆堡壘也是你的總部。藉由將褻瀆要塞研發升級，你可以建立混沌星際戰士小隊的領袖，並從混沌兵工廠獲得更精良的武器。
en_text: It is time to upgrade the Desecrated Stronghold, your headquarters. By researching the Desecrated Fortress upgrade, you will gain access to Squad Leaders for your Chaos Space Marine Squads and better weapons from the Chaos Armory.

tc_text: 選取褻瀆堡壘然後按一下褻瀆要塞升級圖示。
en_text: Select the Desecrated Stronghold and click the Desecrated Fortress Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 我們必須將褻瀆堡壘升級為褻瀆要塞以開放生產小隊領袖和其他強大的研發選項及建築物。
en_text: We must upgrade the Desecrated Stronghold to a Desecrated Fortress to gain access to Squad Leaders and other powerful research options and structures.

tc_text: 領袖是技藝高超的戰士，可以加入混沌星際戰士小隊中。要打敗敵人的話，你需要力量強大的領袖。
en_text: Leaders are highly skilled warriors that can be added to some Chaos Space Marine Squads. You will need strong leaders if you are to defeat your enemies.

tc_text: 褻瀆要塞完成了!你現在可以將混沌軍官加入你的混沌星際戰士小隊中。
en_text: The Desecrated Fortress is complete! You can now add Aspiring Champions to your Chaos Space Marine Squads.

tc_text: 增加一個混沌軍官到你的混沌星際戰士小隊
en_text: Add an Aspiring Champion to your Chaos Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 某些小隊，例如混沌星際戰士小隊，可以增加一位領袖。混沌軍官可以大大增加小隊的士氣。選取一支小隊，然後按一下增加領袖：混沌軍官圖示，以建立一個混沌軍官 。
en_text: Some squads, like Chaos Space Marine Squads, can add a Leader. Aspiring Champions provide an excellent boost to the squad's morale. Select a squad, then click the Add Leader: Aspiring Champion icon to build an Aspiring Champion.

tc_text: 選取一支混沌星際戰士小隊，按一下增加領袖：混沌軍官圖示。
en_text: Select a Chaos Space Marine Squad and click the Add Leader: Aspiring Champion icon.

tc_text: 混沌軍官是英勇的領袖，他們可以改善小隊的戰鬥能力和士氣，更能激勵你星際戰士的英雄氣慨。
en_text: Aspiring Champions are valiant leaders that improve the combat ability and morale of the squad they are part of. They will inspire your Marines to greater feats of heroism.

tc_text: 很好!你的混沌軍官已經產生了。要注意的是，你的混沌軍官是小隊的一部份，所以無法脫離小隊。
en_text: Excellent! Your Aspiring Champion has arrived. Note that your Aspiring Champion is part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 建立混沌軍團兵工廠
你必須利用你的叛教徒來建立一個混沌軍團兵工廠。一旦完成之後，混沌軍團兵工廠就能開放生產特殊武器給你的小隊。
en_text: You must use your Heretic to build a Chaos Armory. Once complete, the Chaos Armory will grant you access to special weapons for your squads.

tc_text: 現在就選取你的叛教徒並建立一個混沌軍團兵工廠。
en_text: Select your Heretic and build a Chaos Armory now.

tc_text: 你必須建立一個混沌軍團兵工廠以得到更多升級的武器。小隊可以裝備各種不同的武器，讓他們可以應付各種類型的敵人。
en_text: You must build a Chaos Armory in order to access weapon upgrades. Squads can be equipped with a variety of weaponry, allowing you to prepare them against different enemy types.

tc_text: 很好，混沌軍團兵工廠已經在運作了。
en_text: Excellent, the Chaos Armory is operational.

tc_text: 升級你的混沌星際戰士小隊武器
en_text: Upgrade your Chaos Space Marine Squad's weaponry

tc_text: 混沌兵工廠可以開放生產用於步兵小隊的重型武器。並可賦予混沌星際戰士小隊重型爆彈槍將他們升級。
en_text: The Chaos Armory unlocks access to heavy weaponry for your infantry squads. Upgrade a Chaos Space Marine Squad with Heavy Bolters.

tc_text: 武器升級提示
選取你的混沌星際戰士小隊，按一下升級：重型爆彈槍圖示，以升級一名小隊成員的武器。
en_text: Select your Chaos Space Marine Squad and click the Upgrade: Heavy Bolter icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 注意看，你一名小隊成員手上拿著一把重型爆彈槍。這個步驟可以應用在其他武器的升級上。
en_text: Notice a Heavy Bolter appears in one of your squad member's hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 一開始你只能將小隊中的兩名部隊升級，賦予他們重型武器。藉由在混沌兵工廠的進一步研發，你可以開放生產，幫更多部隊做升級。
en_text: Initially you can only upgrade 2 units of your total squad with heavy weapons. By doing further research at the Chaos Armory you can unlock the capability to upgrade more.

tc_text: 很好，你已將你的混沌星際戰士小隊升級。你可以在戰場的任一角落，因應敵人的角色，而作出適當的武器升級。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Chaos Space Marine Squad. You can upgrade your squads anywhere on the battlefield to weapons that are well suited to counter your enemy.

tc_text: 建立電漿發電場
利用你的叛教徒並建立一個電漿發電場。某些建築物、載具，以及研發計畫，需要電力才能運作。電力是你在「破曉之戰」遊戲中所必須掌握的第二項資源。
en_text: Use your Heretic to build a Plasma Generator. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的異教徒並建立一個電漿發電場。
en_text: Select your Heretic and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 某些建築物、載具，以及研發計畫，需要電力才能運作。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Plasma Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 擁有愈多的電漿發電場，電力資源的增加速度就會愈快。
en_text: The more Plasma Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 你現在已經有電力了!電漿發電場將會以一定的速度繼續製造電力。要注意的是，每一個褻瀆堡壘電漿發電場的發電量是有限制的。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Desecrated Stronghold.

tc_text: 增援你的混沌星際戰士小隊
en_text: Reinforce your Chaos Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 利用增援功能來為你的混沌星際戰士小隊增加部隊。如果有部隊在戰鬥中陣亡，你可以在戰場任意地點進行增援，以補充你的小隊。
en_text: Use the Reinforce function to add units to your Chaos Space Marine Squad. You can Reinforce anywhere in the battlefield to replenish your squads if some of your units fall in battle.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取一支混沌星際戰士小隊，按一下增援小隊按鈕，以為你的小隊增加新的部隊。
en_text: Select a Chaos Space Marine Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 增援是調派額外軍隊將小隊戰力提升到最高點的一個動作。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness.

tc_text: 如果你其中一名混沌軍團被敵人殺死，你便可以在戰鬥中使用增援功能。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a Chaos Space Marine falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 你可以連續按好幾次增援小隊按鈕，讓小隊的戰力提升到最高點。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你已經增援了你的混沌星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Chaos Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 建立並升級另一支混沌星際戰士小隊
en_text: Build and upgrade another Chaos Space Marine Squad

tc_text: 建立一支混沌星際戰士小隊，將它的戰力增援到最高點，賦予兩項特殊武器以作為升級，並增加一個領袖。
en_text: Build another Chaos Space Marine Squad, Reinforce it to full strength, Upgrade it with 2 special weapons, and Add a Leader.

tc_text: 提示文字
選取你的混沌神殿，建立另一支混沌星際戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Chaos Temple and build another Chaos Space Marine Squad.

tc_text: 你的戰場基地能提供一定數量的資源予你的小隊。這個你所能支援的小隊數量稱為你的部隊上限。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你可以在畫面上方的資源區看到你最新的部隊上限指數。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 當你的部隊上限指數達到最高時，你就無法請來額外的小隊，所以當你在擴大軍隊時要注意看著這個地方。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional squads, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 你可以藉由建立某些特定的建築物和研發升級，來增加你的部隊上限，但是還是有一個最大限度在。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building certain structures and researching upgrades, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 很好!你不但建立了一支混沌星際戰士小隊還將它的戰力提升到最高點。為了讓戰力能有效發揮，你應該同時擁有多支混沌星際戰士小隊，並將它們的戰力增援到最高點，賦予特殊武器以升級，最後再加派一位混沌軍官來領導他們。
en_text: Excellent! You have built a Chaos Space Marine Squad and brought it to full strength. To mount an effective attack, you should try to have several Chaos Space Marine Squads, fully Reinforced to maximum strength and Upgraded with special weapons and an Aspiring Champion.

tc_text: 佔領更多戰略位置，並加以防守
en_text: Capture and Secure more Strategic Points

tc_text: 為了確保你有足夠的主要資源及軍備，你需要佔領更多的戰略位置並加以防守。佔領三個戰略位置並在上面建立監聽哨。
en_text: To make sure you have enough of your main resource, Requisition, you need to capture and secure more Strategic Points. Capture 3 Strategic Points and build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 提示文字
派出混沌星際戰士小隊在你的基地附近探索，沿途佔領所遇到的戰略位置。要完成這個目標你必須佔領三個戰略位置。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your Chaos Space Marine Squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 要確保擁有足夠軍備資源的最佳方式，就是佔領戰略位置並加以防守。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 一定要讓你的叛教徒在每個已佔領的戰略位置上加蓋監聽哨，以防止敵人奪取。
en_text: Make sure you use your Heretic to build Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了三個戰略位置並加蓋監聽哨。拿下並守住戰略位置是打敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Listening Posts on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 佔領關鍵位置
關鍵位置是地圖上具有決定性重要戰略地位的區域。在某些多人模式的遊戲當中，佔領一個以上的這類位置，可以幫你在遊戲中取得勝利。現在就去佔領一個吧。
en_text: Critical Locations are points on the map that represent areas of critical strategic importance. In some multiplayer games, capturing one or more of these points can win you the game. Capture one now.

tc_text: 提示文字
利用小隊來佔領一個關鍵位置。關鍵位置是地圖上具有決定性重要戰略地位的區域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 你可以用佔領戰位置的方式來佔領關鍵位置。在某些多人模式的遊戲中，佔領並加以防守一個以上的關鍵位置可以幫你在遊戲中取得勝利!你也可以從你所控制的關鍵位置中取得軍備。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了一個關鍵位置。要注意的是，關鍵位置無法加蓋監聽哨，你必須想其他的辦法來防守。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Listening Posts built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 佔領遺址
遺址是具有高度價值的重要地點。守住遺址可以讓你獲得更佳的軍隊部隊和載具。
en_text: Relics are sacred points of great value. Holding Relics will allow you access to your army's best units and vehicles.

tc_text: hint text
利用一支小隊來佔領一個遺址。遺址是具有高度價值的神聖地點。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 守住遺址可以讓你獲得更佳的軍隊部隊及載具。守好這些遺址，以確保你能擁有最佳的科技。
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領了一個遺址。你可以建立監聽哨來加強防禦已佔領的遺址。你也可以佔領對手的遺址以防止他們使用他們的最佳部隊及科技。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 建立機器坑
利用你的叛教徒來建立一個機器坑。我們要利用機器坑來建立載具。
en_text: Use your Heretic to build a Machine Pit. The Machine Pit is used to build vehicles. Vehicles are tough and much stronger than non-upgraded infantry.

tc_text: 提示文字
利用你的叛教徒來建立一個機器坑。
en_text: Use your Heretic to build a Machine Pit.

tc_text: 機器坑是神靈族用來製造載具的建築物。就像混沌神殿用來建立步兵部隊的道理一樣。
en_text: Just like the Chaos Temple is used to build infantry units, the Machine Pit is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 載具非常堅韌且非一般未經升級的步兵所能攻破。它們是軍隊的基礎，並可以攜帶火力強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 要注意的是，你的作戰基地只能容納一定數量的載具，稱為載具上限。就和部隊上限一樣，達到上限時，就無法建立更多的載具，你可以透過褻瀆堡壘的研發科技來增加你的載具上限。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap. Just like Squad Cap, once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can research technology at your Desecrated Stronghold that will increase your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 很好!你現在已經有了一個機器坑。你可以在這個建築物建立強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Machine Pit. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 要增加遊戲中你可以派出的小隊數量，按一下褻瀆堡壘上的研發項目。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field in Dawn of War, you click on the research items located on your Desecrated Stronghold.

tc_text: 你已經達到可以派出的小隊數量極限。確定你已將小隊戰力增援到最高點，達到充分利用的效果。如果你覺得投資不慎，可以在鍵盤上按一下刪除鍵，將不要的小隊解雇。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them. If you have invested unwisely, you can press the 'Delete' button on your keyboard to terminate unwanted squads.

tc_text: 恭喜你!你已經完成教學關卡的課程。
en_text: Congratulations! You've completed the learning session of the tutorial.

tc_text: 現在是將你的所學加以應用的時候了。掌管好你的軍隊，並擴大你的力量，將敵人擊潰。
en_text: It is time to put what you have learned to work. Take control of the force and build up your strength so you can crush your enemy!

tc_text: 利用步兵部隊來佔領戰略位置，並利用異教徒在戰略位置上加蓋監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points, and Heretics to build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 繼續建造建築物，完成研發計劃，增加你的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 建立額外的小隊和載具。務必研發能夠提高部隊上限和載具上限的升級項目。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure you research upgrades that will increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 征服一個又一個戰場，擊敗你的敵人，不然戰爭是不會結束的。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 接管
選取你其中一支步兵小隊，將他們移動到掩護的位置。掩護區上面註有標記，不管是在小地圖或世界地圖都可以看得到它。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 掩護提示
某些地形可以提供小隊躲開敵人的炮火，稱為掩護。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 選取你其中一支步兵小隊，將他們移動到掩護的位置。掩護區上面註有標記，不管是在小地圖或世界地圖都可以看得到它。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 掩護非常好用，它可以增加小隊的防禦能力，不致於讓敵人輕易取得性命。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 地形中的掩護很容易發現 -- 當你的滑鼠游標經過城市中的大彈坑，或叢林中的大片樹葉時，此時游標便會產生變化。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 你會注意到當你將你的小隊移動到掩護區時，上頭就會出現一個小的掩護圖示。這表示他們的防禦能力增加了。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好!你的小隊現在已經在掩護裡。掩護中的部隊很難被瞄準擊中，並且在長程攻擊中傷害較輕微。好好利用掩護以在對戰中取得戰術上的優勢。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已掌握更進一步的概念，它有助你殲滅你的敵人!
en_text: Very good! You are mastering advanced concepts that will help you to annihilate your enemies!

tc_text: 選取一支小隊，並留心小隊體力指數上方的藍色小長條。這藍色小長條所代表的是小隊的士氣。
en_text: Select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just under the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 士氣代表部隊在戰鬥中所能發揮的戰力，它有如智力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的組合。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 遊戲中有各種不同的武器不但會損害體力指數，也會打擊士氣。當小隊的士氣受到打擊時，藍色小長條就會減少，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 當小隊的士氣過低時，這支小隊就會潰散。一支潰不成軍的小隊失去戰鬥意願，其戰力也會降到最低。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 你還是可以控制潰散的小隊。你可以選擇讓他們繼續留在戰鬥中或撤退以補充力量。某些部隊具有增加小隊士氣的能力。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength. Also, certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 士氣是擊退敵人的有效武器。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies.

tc_text: 藉由打擊敵人的士氣，你會讓他們失去戰力，很容易就能取得他們的性命。這樣一來，一支小而精的部隊也可以以小擊大。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 記住，戰術和戰略是戰鬥中的重要關鍵。要善加利用這個道理以在戰場中取得勝利!
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 記住，小隊所受的傷會影響全體，當一支小隊損害到一定程度時，一個部隊就會因此陣亡。
en_text: Remember, a squad takes damage as a whole. When enough damage has been inflicted on the squad, a unit will die.

tc_text: 如果你在戰鬥中失去任何部隊，你可以利用增援功能，將小隊戰力再度發揮到極致。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 留心戰鬥中小隊的力量變化。經常運用增援功能，盡量讓小隊充份發揮戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 記住，當一支具有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你同時也會失去那項武器。這時你就必須替小隊升級，以再度獲得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 畫面左下角的菱形畫面就是你的小地圖。
en_text: The diamond-shaped display in the lower left-hand corner of your screen is your Mini-map.

tc_text: 小地圖提供克敵制勝的重要資訊。
en_text: The Mini-map provides important information that will help you win battles.

tc_text: 你可以利用小地圖觀看部隊和建築物的位置，快速掃瞄整個戰場，下達命令等等。
en_text: You can use the Mini-map to see where your units and structures are located, to quickly scan the battlefield, to issue quick orders, and so on.

tc_text: 在小地圖任意一處按一下，鏡頭就會移動到該處。當你需要快速調查整個戰場，決定戰術運用時，此時這個功能就能發揮其效果。
en_text: Clicking anywhere in the Mini-map will move your camera to that location. This is useful when you need to survey the battlefield quickly, to make tactical decisions.

tc_text: 隨時留意你的小地圖，它可以讓你知道部隊的現狀，和那些在檢視畫面中看不到的問題。
en_text: Keep an eye on your Mini-map. It will help you see what is happening to units that you cannot currently see in your view screen.

tc_text: 小地圖顯示出戰場上所有戰略位置的所在處，以及其他具有戰略重要性的東西。
en_text: The Mini-map displays the locations of all Strategic Points on the battlefield, as well as other items of strategic importance.

tc_text: 戰爭迷霧會在你不在場的地方出現，進而影響你的視覺。當你移動部隊到某個區域時，戰爭迷霧就會散開。
en_text: Fog of War prevents you from seeing things where you do not have a presence. As you move units into an area, the Fog of War will be lifted.

tc_text: 就算你在某個區域建有建築物，戰爭迷霧仍然會出現。
en_text: When you have structures built in an area, the Fog of War in that area will remain revealed.

tc_text: 礦渣區是地表下的能量集中點。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 在礦渣區上建立一個熱流電漿發電機以獲取大量的電能。
en_text: Build a Thermo-Plasma Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 快速瀏覽一下你的小地圖，圖上的小圓點就是礦渣區的所在處。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 叛教徒可以在礦渣區上建立熱流電漿發電機。
en_text: Heretics can build Thermo-Plasma Generators on Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 注意看當一個部隊產生時，小隊增援後所產生的變化，小隊自動重新整隊來接納他們的加入。這是因為小隊的行動都是一致的。
en_text: Notice how each time a squad is Reinforced and a unit arrives, the squad rearranges itself to accomodate the new arrival. This is because squads work together as a unit.

tc_text: 小隊接到類似移動和攻擊的指令，其行動都是協調一致的。這就是小隊的力量，讓你可以在戰場中更輕易的控制數量龐大的部隊。
en_text: A squad responds to commands, such as move and attack, in harmony. This is the strength of the squad, and it allows you to control a large number of units on the battlefield more easily.

tc_text: 記住，守住戰略位置能增加你的軍備資源。沒有足夠的軍備資源，就無法建立所需的軍力，在戰場中克敵制勝。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requsition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 當你決定在某處建立建築物時，請注意看，你的建築物附近就會出現白色環狀物。這就是所謂的控制區域。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能建造在控制區域以內的範圍，其他的建築物，像是監聽哨，可以建造在其他地點。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Listening Posts, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你要擺放一個新的建築物時，你在移動它的時候，它的顏色就會從紅色轉成綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its colour changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 綠色代表該建築物可以擺放在該處，如此建造工作也將開始。
en_text: A Green colour indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 隱藏能力列
你可以在能力列中上邊緣的位置按一下頭骨圖示。現在就試試看把能力列隱藏起來。
en_text: You can hide the taskbar by clicking on the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar. Try hiding the taskbar now.

tc_text: 按一下能力列中上邊緣的頭骨圖示，以隱藏能力列。
en_text: Hide the taskbar by clicking the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar.

tc_text: 當能力列呈隱藏狀態時，你會發現小地圖還在。
en_text: When the taskbar is hidden, you will notice the Mini-Map stays revealed.

tc_text: 不管下達命令還是將小隊升級，你可以叫出能力列或利用快速鍵。
en_text: To issue commands and upgrade your squads you can either unhide the taskbar or use the 'hotkeys'.

tc_text: 要恢復完整的能力列，只要再按一下頭骨圖示就可以了。
en_text: To return to the full taskbar, simply click the Skull icon again.

tc_text: 下達集合點指令
要下達一個集合點指令，先選取任何一個能生產小隊或載具的建築物，然後在附近的地面上按一下右鍵。
en_text: To issue a Rally Point command, select any building that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 你剛剛已經下達了一個集合點指令了。藉由選取一個可以建立小隊或載具的建築物，並在附近的地面上按右鍵，就能辦到這一點。
en_text: You've just issued a Rally Point command. You did this by selecting a structure capable of building squads or vehicles and right-clicking the ground nearby.

tc_text: 我們來下達一個集合點指令吧。
en_text: Let's issue a Rally Point command.

tc_text: 選取任何可以生產小隊或載具的建築物，並在附近的地面上按一下右鍵。
en_text: Select any structure that is capable of producing squads or vehicles and right-click the ground nearby.

tc_text: 當你下達一個集合點指令時，你會發現，世界地圖上會出現一支旗子。不管何時只要你選取了該棟建築物，這支旗子就會出現。
en_text: When you issue a Rally Point command, you will notice a flag appears in the world. This flag will be visible whenever you have the structure selected.

tc_text: 只要在該棟建築所建立的小隊或載具，當他們建立好時，就會自動在該集合點集合。
en_text: Any squads or vehicles that are built from that structure will automatically gather at the Rally Point when they are built.

tc_text: 現在我們要叫出目標選單。
en_text: Now we will bring up the Objective Menu.

tc_text: 目標選單上面會列出所有遊戲指派給你的主要和次要目標。滑鼠指在目標上就會有詳細的描述。
en_text: The Objective Menu provides you a list of all the Primary and Secondary Objectives assigned to you by the game. Mouse over the Objectives to get the description of each.

tc_text: 很好!只要你想要參考目標選單時，就在上層功能表列的目標按鈕上按一下。
en_text: Excellent! Anytime you want to refer to the Objectives Menu, click on the OBJ button on the upper menu bar.

tc_text: 關閉任務視窗
當你熟悉任務視窗時，選取「關閉」鈕回到教學關卡。
en_text: When you are familiar with the Objective Screen, click on the CLOSE button to return to the Tutorial.

tc_text: 建造混沌犀牛運輸坦克
選取你的機器坑並混沌犀牛運輸坦克。
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Chaos Rhino Transport.

tc_text: 選取你的機器坑並建造一部混沌犀牛運輸坦克。
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Chaos Rhino Transport.

tc_text: 混沌犀牛運輸坦克是混沌軍團的基本步兵載具。它的移動速度非常快，且具有相當強韌的鋼板，可以載著你的步兵在戰場上來去自如。
en_text: The Chaos Rhino Transport is the Chaos's basic infantry transport. Exceptionally fast and well armoured, it is an excellent way to quickly move your infantry around the battlefield.

tc_text: 很好!你現在已經有了一部混沌犀牛運輸坦克。你可以選取一支小隊，按下右鍵，試著將步兵載入混沌犀牛運輸坦克裡。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Rhino. You can try loading infantry into the Chaos Rhino Transport by selecting the squad and right-clicking on it.

tc_text: 要讓小隊離開載具，在混沌犀牛運輸坦克的能力列上按一下卸載圖示就可以了。
en_text: To unload the squad, click on the Unload icon on the Chaos Rhino Transport's taskbar.

tc_text: 建造惡魔引擎
選取你的機器坑並建造一部惡魔引擎。
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Defiler.

tc_text: 選取你的機器坑並建造一部惡魔引擎。
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Defiler.

tc_text: 惡魔引擎的砲火猛烈但準確性不佳，它可以將步兵炸飛，還能將建築物炸成灰燼。
en_text: Defiler artillery vehicles have a devestating but inaccurate area attack that can send infantry flying and pound buildings into dust.

tc_text: 很好!你的惡魔引擎可以像一般部隊一樣攻擊，或者你可以按一下惡魔引擎能力列上的地面攻擊圖示，並在戰場上按左鍵，以在特定的地點上發射出火砲。
en_text: Excellent! Your Defiler can attack like a normal unit, or you can click the Ground Attack icon on the Defiler's taskbar and left-click the battlefield to fire the artillery at a specific location.

tc_text: 建立惡魔引擎
選取你的機器坑，建立一個惡魔引擎
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Defiler.

tc_text: 選取你的機器坑，建立一個惡魔引擎
en_text: Select your Machine Pit and build a Defiler.

tc_text: 惡魔引擎是一種危險的機器人。他們在近身攻擊中所向無敵，並可以透過升級以增加他們的長程攻擊。
en_text: Defilers are dangerous mechanical walkers. They are feared in close combat and can be upgraded to have powerful ranged attacks.

tc_text: 很好!你的惡魔引擎是一具能打擊步兵士氣的致命殺人機器，並能摧毀載具，協助你打擊敵人。
en_text: Excellent! Your Defiler is a lethal killing machine that can break infantry Morale, crush vehicles and help you defeat your enemy.

tc_text: 混沌軍團有許多載具選項。升級你的褻瀆堡壘、佔領遺址、儲存軍備和電力資源，以建立所有的載具。
en_text: The Chaos have many vehicle options. Upgrade your Desecrated Stronghold, capture Relics and stockpile Requisition and Power Resources to build them all.

tc_text: 別忘了留意你的載具上限，超過了這個上限，你就無法建造更多的載具。
en_text: Don't forget to keep an eye on your Vehicle Cap. You cannot field more vehicles than you can support with your Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 混沌軍團可滲透任何所接觸到的東西。
en_text: The evil essence of Chaos seeps into everything they touch.

tc_text: 混沌軍團的建築物由腐敗的沼氣所圍繞著，稱為混沌印記，它會減緩敵軍部隊的士氣恢復速度，卻對友軍部隊具有治療的效果。
en_text: Chaos structures are surrounded by a corrupting miasma known as the Chaos Taint, which reduces the morale recovery of enemy units and heals friendly units.

tc_text: 建立獻祭魔陣
選取一個叛教徒並建立一個獻祭魔陣
en_text: Select a Heretic and build a Sacrificial Circle.

tc_text: 想要初次體驗混沌惡魔的滋味，就要先讓你的叛教徒建立一個獻祭魔陣。
en_text: To get your first taste of Chaos daemons, get your Heretic to build a Sacrificial Circle.

tc_text: 獻祭魔陣就像一個次要的軍營一樣，但它是給惡魔住，而不是給凡人住的地方。
en_text: A Sacrificial Circle is like a second barracks, but for daemonic forces instead of mortal men.

tc_text: 獻祭魔陣是對闇黑邪神絕對效忠的指標。透過它，你可以召喚懼妖，獲得附魔混沌星際戰士的支援，並開放生產你的第二支指揮部隊。
en_text: The Sacrificial Circle is a mark of true devotion to the Dark Gods. Through it you can summon Horrors, enlist squads of Possessed Marines and unlock your second commander unit.

tc_text: 召喚懼妖小隊
混沌軍團派小隊上戰場的方式和別人不同。要召喚一支懼妖部隊，首先你必須選取獻祭魔陣，然後方法就像建立其他步兵小隊一樣。完成後，就會出現召喚惡魔的圖示。要召喚懼妖部隊，按一下圖示，然後再按一下戰場上任何看得到的位置。
en_text: Chaos has special ways of getting squads out into the field. To Summon a Horror Squad, you must first select the Sacrificial Circle and build it like any other infantry squad. Once it is complete, the Summon Daemon icon will be available. To Summon the Horror Squad, click the icon and then click any visible location on the battlefield.

tc_text: 該是召喚一些惡魔的時候了。選取獻祭魔陣，然後由建立一支懼妖部隊開始。
en_text: It is time to Summon some daemons. Select the Sacrificial Circle and begin by building a Horror Squad.

tc_text: 當懼妖部隊完成建立之後，它會繼續留在建築物內作為備用，一直等到有人召喚他們或獻祭魔陣被毀為止。
en_text: When the Horror Squad is done building it will remain in reserve within the building until it is Summoned or the Sacrificial Circle is destroyed.

tc_text: 當你準備召喚懼妖部隊時，按一下獻祭魔陣能力列上召喚惡魔的圖示，然後在戰場上任何可見的區域再按一下。
en_text: When you are ready to Summon the Horror Squad, click on the Summon Daemons icon on the Sacrificial Circle taskbar and then click on any visible area of the battlefield.

tc_text: 做得好!懼妖已經產生了。懼妖會以固定大小出現，而且無法增援。他們真正的天賦在於出其不意。
en_text: Well Done! The Horrors have arrived. Horror Squads come in fixed sizes and cannot be reinforced. Their real gift is surprise.

tc_text: 建立惡魔坑
當堡壘升級為褻瀆要塞時，我們就可以建立一個惡魔坑。選取你的叛教徒並建立一個惡魔坑。
en_text: With the Stronghold upgraded to a Desecrated Fortress, we can now build a Daemon Pit. Select your Heretic and build a Daemon Pit.

tc_text: 當堡壘升級為褻瀆要塞時，我們就可以建立一個惡魔坑，它是最大的惡魔力量來源。
en_text: With the Stronghold upgraded to a Desecrated Fortress, we can now build a Daemon Pit, the source of the ultimate daemon power.

tc_text: 惡魔坑讓你可以建立毀滅者，以及召喚超級惡魔血神恐虐。
en_text: The Daemon Pit grants access to Obliterators and the ability to summon the Greater Daemon of Khorne.

tc_text: 惡魔坑，最邪惡的源頭，終於完成了!
en_text: At last! The Daemon Pit, source of ultimate evil.

tc_text: 混沌軍團和星際戰士的相似點在於軍隊的核心都是強悍且多功能的戰士，同樣有射擊和攻擊的專長，但他們的相似點就僅止於此。
en_text: The Chaos race is similar to the Space Marines in that the core of the army is a tough and versatile warrior equally capable of shooting and assault, but the similarities end there.

tc_text: 混沌軍團在攻擊方面的選項較星際戰士來得多，但是能使用的載具相對來得較少。
en_text: Chaos has a lot more assault-oriented options than the Space Marines, but has access to a much smaller selection of vehicles.

tc_text: 混沌軍團同時擁有最多將部隊從建築物直接送到戰場的方法；召喚懼妖，瞬間移動混沌毀滅者，當然少不了嗜血狂魔的附魔能力。
en_text: Chaos also has the most methods of getting units straight from a building into combat; with summoned Horrors, deepstriking Obliterators and, of course, the possession of the Bloodthirster.

tc_text: 召喚嗜血狂魔
要召喚黑暗力量中最厲害的嗜血狂魔，你首先必須選取惡魔坑，研發嗜血狂魔。完成之後，召喚嗜血狂魔的圖示就會出現在混沌領主、巫師和任何的混沌軍官身上。要召喚嗜血狂魔，按一下圖示，展開恐怖的一刻。
en_text: To summon the Bloodthirster, ultimate champion of the Dark Powers, you must first select the Daemon Pit and research the Bloodthirster. Once it is complete, the Summon Bloodthirster icon will appear on your Chaos Lord, Sorceror and any Aspiring Champions. To Summon the Bloodthirster, click the icon and watch the terror unfold.

tc_text: 召喚黑暗力量的佼佼者「嗜血狂魔」的時刻到了。選取惡魔坑，並由研發嗜血狂魔這個步驟開始。
en_text: It is time to summon then ultimate champion of the Dark Powers, the Bloodthirster. Select the Daemon Pit and begin by researching the Bloodthirster.

tc_text: 當研發完成之後，召喚嗜血狂魔的圖示就會出現在混沌領主、巫師和任何一位混沌軍官的能力列上。
en_text: When the research is done, the Summon Bloodthirster icon will appear on the taskbar of your Chaos Lord, Sorceror and any Aspiring Champions.

tc_text: 當你準備召喚嗜血狂魔時，在召喚嗜血狂魔的圖示上按一下，靜待觀賞附魔好戲。
en_text: When you are ready to Summon the Bloodthirster, click on the Summon Bloodthirster icon and watch the possession take place.

tc_text: 準備嚇得發抖吧!嗜血狂魔已經產生了!嗜血狂魔是因戰爭而生的，一定要讓他加入紛亂的戰局，否則他的健康值會逐漸衰退。
