en_text: Quake in fear! The Bloodthirster has arrived! The Bloodthirster lives on battle. Keep him in the thick of combat or his health will ebb away.

tc_text: 歡迎執行「破曉之戰」。這個程式會為你的電腦選擇最佳效能的設定。第一次執行此程式時請選擇[最佳化設定]。如果發生問題，請選擇 [安全模式設定] 。
en_text: Welcome to Dawn of War. This utility will select the optimal performance settings for your computer. Select "Optimal Configuration" the first time you run the utility. If you encounter problems, select "Safe Mode Configuration".

tc_text: 如果你安裝了多張顯示卡，請在下拉式選單裡選擇你在「破曉之戰」裡要使用的裝置，或選擇 [預設]。
en_text: If you have multiple video cards installed, select the device that you want Dawn of War to use from the drop-down menu, otherwise leave "Default" selected.

tc_text: 這是「破曉之戰」的建議解析度和更新率。點選 [測試] 按鈕以確認這些設定相容於你的系統。如果想改變預設設定，請從下拉選單中選擇您想要的解析度與更新率。
en_text: These are the recommended resolution and refresh rate settings for Dawn of War. Click 'Test' to verify these settings are compatible with your system. To change the default settings, select a screen resolution and refresh rate from the drop-down menus.

tc_text: 下列是依照你的選擇，在「破曉之戰」所做的設定。按一下 [完成] 按鈕儲存設定，或按 [返回] 按鈕更改設定。若需要關於效能設定的額外資訊，請查閱readme.txt。
en_text: Below are the options that will be set for Dawn of War based on your selections. Click the "Finish" button to save these settings, or the "Back" button to change them. For additional information on performance settings, view the readme.txt.

羅恩五號星的歐克蠻人為數眾多，但是他們缺乏戰勝混沌星際戰士的團結力量。這些墮落戰士以血腥的雙手掌握了羅恩五號星，而四散的歐克蠻人家族正在逐一瓦解。
en_text: While the Orks of Lorn V number many, they lack the unity to defeat the occupying force of Chaos Space Marines. These fell warriors squeeze Lorn V in their bloody grip, and the scattered Orks are losing ground, one clan at a time.

tc_text: 但是現在，一個名叫葛加茲的歐克蠻人戰爭頭目在各地打敗混沌軍團，使更多的歐克蠻人團結在他的旗下。葛加茲現準備接管行星上最大的歐克蠻人部族，以強大的怒吼團結所有的歐克蠻人，並且消滅阻礙他前進的所有事物。
en_text: But now, an Ork Warboss named Gorgutz is beating Chaos at every turn uniting more Orks under his banner. Gorgutz is now ready to take on and take over the biggest Ork Clans on the planet, drawing all the Orks together in a mighty WAAAGH!, and crush all in his path.

tc_text: 現在葛加茲集結了最龐大的歐克蠻人部族，打算以強大的怒吼，號召羅恩五號星上所有的歐克蠻人團結在他的旗幟下！為了聚集更多的戰士，葛加茲的技師準備了ㄧ支火箭梭，讓他得以輕易旅行到遠處。當然，前提是火箭梭能夠停留在空中…
en_text: Gorgutz now leads the largest of the Ork Clans and dreams of embroiling all of Lorn V's Orks in a mighty WAAAGH! under his banner. With the hope of gathering even more boyz, Gorgutz’s Meks have cobbled together a Rokkit Shuttle allowing him to travel to the far reaches with ease. That is, of course, so long as the Rokkit remains in the air…

tc_text: 同時，羅恩五號星的混沌星際戰士領導人-混沌領主克魯爾正在尋找機會，希望能夠迎戰這個新興的戰爭頭目葛加茲。他的機會即將到來。
en_text: Meanwhile, Chaos Lord Crull, leader of the Chaos Space Marines of Lorn V revels in the possibility of bloodshed and salivates for an opportunity to face this new Warboss Gorgutz. He is about to get his chance.

tc_text: 由於帝國防衛軍意外到來，加上發現一部泰坦，混沌領主克魯爾開始力圖佔有這台強力的戰爭機器。儘管他非常不相信巫師和他們的邪惡魔法，他卻打算利用他們收集足夠的祭品，將泰坦腐敗，以遂他的計謀。
en_text: With the surprising arrival of the Imperial Guard, and the discovery of a fallen Titan, Chaos Lord Crull has begun his obsession to possess this powerful war-machine. Despite his innate distrust of Sorcerers and their vile magics, he will use them to gather enough sacrificial blood to corrupt the Titan for his own designs.

tc_text: 同時，戰爭頭目葛加茲的怒吼逐漸壯大，如同增加他凝聚歐克蠻人部族的慾望一樣。戰爭頭目葛加茲，想要打敗新的對手，以證明他的能力。至於他的第一份獎品，他以帝國將軍史泰恩為目標。
en_text: Meanwhile, Warboss Gorgutz’s WAAAGH! grows in scale with every battle, as does the Ork’s lust for heads to add to his collection. He earns the moniker, Warboss Gorgutz ‘Ead ‘Unter, and for his first prize, he is eyeing the Imperial General, Sturnn.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍正在搶修泰坦，以強大的心靈防護罩圍繞在周圍，防止他方勢力搶奪。混沌領主克魯爾越來越不耐煩，極渴望擁有泰坦。他將部隊全力投入於搶奪這部戰爭機器，同時葛加茲為尋找戰鬥，渴望更多的血和戰爭來證明他的能力，也投入混戰之中。
en_text: The Imperial Guard, desperate to repair the Titan, surrounds it with a powerful psychic shield to forestall its capture. Lord Crull grows more impatient and desperate to possess the Titan. He commits his forces to capturing the war-machine while Gorgutz enters the fray in search of battle, blood and more heads to add to his collection.

tc_text: 但是由於神靈族的意外介入，情勢很快變得明朗化：泰坦是惟一的優勝者的獎勵，而失敗者只能早早入土。
en_text: With the unexpected involvement of the Eldar, however, it swiftly becomes obvious that the Titan is a prize promised for only one winner, while the losers can expect early graves.

tc_text: 混沌領主克魯爾突破帝國的防護罩，準備奪取泰坦；他似乎已勝利在望。令人遺憾的是，他的巫師為了召喚嗜血狂魔以打敗神靈族的戰神分身，已失去太多戰力。
en_text: His victory seemingly assured, Lord Crull breaches the Imperial Psychic Shield and prepares to take the Titan itself. Unfortunately, his Sorcerers lost much sacrificial blood when they raised the dreaded Bloodthirster to defeat the Eldar’s god-incarnate… the Avatar.

tc_text: 現在，混沌領主的軍隊必須為了執行最後的儀式，好令泰坦歸其所有，而取得更多的血。然而當混沌領主克魯爾夢想自己橫掃全銀河之時，一個新的事件即將展開，而這個事件會威脅到混沌領主克魯爾的一切成就。
en_text: Now, the Chaos Lord's forces must procure more blood for the final ritual that will bring the Titan under their dominion. And while Lord Crull dreams of his tyrannical march across the galaxy, a new event is about to unfold, one that threatens to unravel everything Crull has achieved.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人繼續壯碩的怒吼聲。戰爭頭目 葛加茲收集的頭顱數量隨著每次戰役而越發龐大，同時隨著每次的勝利，值得他收集的頭顱數量也越來越少。
en_text: The Ork avalanche continues with a magnificent roar. Warboss Gorgutz’s mound of heads grows larger with each battle, and with each victory the number of worthy skulls worth obtaining grows smaller.

tc_text: 戰爭頭目的最後目標放在混沌領主身上。為了獲得最後的勝利並收復羅恩五號星，葛加茲將誘騙克魯爾進入一場不可能獲勝的戰鬥…至少戰爭頭目是這麼認為的。
en_text: The last head for the Warboss to claim rests on Chaos Lord Crull’s neck. To rule the day and collect the pearl Lorn V, Gorgutz will lure Crull into a battle that he cannot win… at least if the Warboss has anything to say about the matter.

tc_text: 在勇敢的帝國將軍史泰恩的指揮下，帝國防衛軍進入冰雪世界羅恩五號星的軌道。他們的目標很簡單：取回一部名為泰坦的強力戰爭機器，那是混沌星際戰士從當地的帝國防衛軍駐軍手中征服該星球時所留下來的器械。如果史泰恩將軍想要成功登陸羅恩五號星，他的部隊必須先奪取目前在混沌軍團手中的一座防禦要塞。
en_text: Under the valiant General Sturnn, the Imperial Guard have entered orbit around the ice-world Lorn V. Their goal is simple; they must retrieve a powerful war-machine called a Titan that was left behind when Chaos Marines conquered the planet from the local Imperial garrison. If General Sturnn’s planetfall beachhead is to succeed, his forces must seize control of a defense fortress currently in the hands of Chaos.

tc_text: 幸好，帝國防衛軍擁有鋼鐵般的意志，必然能夠堅持到這場殘酷的戰役結束。
en_text: Fortunately, the Imperial Guard possesses the iron will to see this undoubtedly brutal battle through to its bloody end.

tc_text: 史泰恩將軍麾下的部隊已經奪取那座防禦要塞，並且開始建造一面巨大的心靈防護罩以保護泰坦。不幸的是，混亂星際戰士擊落運送泰坦駕駛員的運輸機，以及由超能戰士與星際戰士牧師組成的護衛隊。
en_text: The Imperials under General Sturnn have taken the defense fortress and begun construction of an immense Psychic Shield to protect the Titan. Unfortunately, Chaos Space Marines shot down the Thunderhawk transporting the Titan’s crew as well as their bodyguard detail consisting of Space Marine Chaplain Varnus and his hardened Ultramarines.

tc_text: 史泰恩將軍必須派兵營救在敵後的泰坦駕駛員與超能戰士護衛隊，但是在上一次戰役中救回他手下的那支神秘而邪惡的部隊令他感到困惑。
en_text: General Sturnn must launch a rescue attempt behind enemy lines of the crew and Ultramarines, but his thoughts are troubled by the mysterious, sinister force that saved his men in their last battle.

tc_text: 神靈族，也就是羅恩五號星戰鬥的秘密參戰者，也是默默幫助帝國防衛軍的勢力，正慢慢接近他們神祕的目標。神靈族靜靜地在帝國、歐克蠻人和混沌軍團的軍隊之間移動，他們的目標遠比泰坦還重要。
en_text: The Eldar, secret participants in the struggle on Lorn V and silent saviors of the Imperial Guard, are close to their mysterious objective. Quietly maneuvering between the armies of the Imperials, Orks and Chaos, the Eldar pursue a vital objective seemingly far more important than the Titan.

tc_text: 現在，阻擋在他們前面的是前所未見的大規模歐克蠻人。神靈族必須匿蹤穿過歐克蠻人的主力部隊，並且保持不被發現。如果他們失敗，他們將會被迫與數量佔有極大優勢的敵人一戰。
en_text: Now, all that stands between them and success is the largest Ork WAAAGH! they have ever seen. The Eldar must sneak through the main force of Orks, and remain undetected. Should they fail, they will fall under the sheer crushing number of their adversaries.

tc_text: 帝國和神靈族組成一個艱苦的聯盟，然而因為相互不信任，這個聯盟搖搖欲墜。他們各有各的目標，也知道他們的目標會犧牲其聯盟關係。然而這就是戰爭。帝國必須護送泰坦的機員安全回到防護罩裡，神靈族也希望將魍道聯集的靈魂之石帶回防護罩裡。
en_text: The Imperials and Eldar have struck an uneasy alliance, but it teeters under the weight of their mutual distrust. Both have their objectives, and both know their objective will cost them their alliance. Such is war, however. The Imperials must escort the Titan crew convoy safely through the Psychic Shield while the Eldar hope to accomplish the same with the Soul Stone of their Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 遺憾的是，只有一支軍隊能贏得勝利，而雙方都認為自己佔有優勢。
en_text: Unfortunately, only one army can win the day, and both believe they hold the greater stakes in the matter.

tc_text: 泰坦駕駛員已經就位，正在預備讓這部巨型戰爭機器上線運轉。史泰恩將軍將帝國防衛軍帶領得很好，但是現在他面對最大的挑戰，必須爭取時間預備泰坦。神靈族警告他要小心一個稱為死靈族的巨大威脅，那是一個冷血、無情的種族，他們會摧毀所有擋住他們去路的生命。但是因為泰坦之故，使得帝國的意志堅定不搖，史泰恩將軍計劃以全部的武力，昂首面對新的威脅。
en_text: The Titan crew is in place and bringing the great war-machine online. General Sturnn has led the Imperial Guard well, but he now faces his greatest challenge and races against time to ready the Titan. The Eldar warned him of a great threat called the Necrons, a cold, heartless species bent on destroying all life in their path. But with the Titan theirs and the will of the Imperials unbroken, General Sturnn plans to face the new menace with head held high and his full arsenal blazing.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍只要能活下來，就會獲得勝利。
en_text: The Imperial Guard will win the day so long as he breathes.

tc_text: 命運沒有許諾勝利，但是先知泰迪爾已經利用帝國、歐克蠻人和混沌軍團的結合力量來對抗她最大的挑戰和最大的隱憂。死靈族即將到來，如果先知泰迪爾未能在羅恩五號星阻止他們的前進，那麼死靈族將消滅幾十億個生命。當先知泰迪爾的部隊默默地為戰鬥作準備時，她自己卻煩燥不安；今天的勝利將不易取得。
en_text: Fate promises no victory but Farseer Taldeer has weathered the combined storm of the Imperials, Orks and Chaos to face her greatest challenge and her greatest fear. The Necrons are coming, and if Taldeer does not stop their current advance here, on Lorn V, the Necrons will consume billions of lives. While the Farseer’s vaunted warriors quietly prepare for the battle, she herself is restless; victory will not be easy this day.

tc_text: 這場戰鬥需要極大的犧牲，而且先知泰迪爾不確定今天的結局... 勝利還是失敗。
en_text: The battle will require great sacrifice, and Farseer Taldeer is unsure of the day’s full implication... win or lose.

tc_text: 絕對零度 (2)
這兩個寒冷的岬角因為有著極為重要的戰略價值及寒酷強風而有名。不幸被派到這裡的防衛軍給它取了不少外號，其中"絕對零度"是最常聽到的名字。
en_text: These two bitter-cold promontories are renowned for their strategic importance, and their harsh, freezing winds. Troops unfortunate enough to be assigned here have given several nicknames to the post, "Absolute Zero" being the least profane.

tc_text: 克魏斯的勝利 (2)
「重擊」戴理克的指揮官，也就是混沌領主賈那索．克魏斯，就是在這個聖地山谷擊敗戰爭頭目卡多司，儘管當時他的兵員數目遠居於劣勢。當「重擊」在「重擊之毀」預到危機時，便試圖嘗試模仿這場不易得的勝利，終究導致自己的死亡。當克魏斯聽到這個消息時，他的反應是：「聰明是沒有辦法教的。」
en_text: This is the sacred valley where Lord Jonathor Quest, "Biffy" Drecker's commanding officer, defeated the dreaded Warboss Kodos, despite being hopelessly outnumbered. Biffy was trying to imitate this unlikely victory when he met his untimely end at "Biffy's Peril." "You can't teach ingenuity," was Quest's response upon hearing the news.

tc_text: 放棄所有的希望 (2)
凱爾摩這個沼澤世界的植物實在太茂密，而且泥沼地區也非常詭譎，因此降落點非常難找。這表示當交戰雙方在軌道上互相開火的同時，經常會讓部隊降落在敵方軍隊的頭上。
en_text: The vegetation on the swamp world of Galmor is so thick, and the mud so treacherous, that drop zones are difficult, if not impossible to find. This often means that opposing armies are dropping troops right on top of each other while trading salvoes in orbit.

tc_text: 愛克斯離恩神龕 (2)
這個神龕奉獻給愛克斯黎恩——次元蜘蛛小隊長。他的戰術拯救了工藝世界「無敵」，使它不致於被暗黑神靈族破壞。先知安娜亞建造了這個神龕來紀念死去的戰士。有些人相信這個神龕有著治癒忠誠者的能力。當然，像這種異端的謠言，是不可信的。
en_text: This shrine is dedicated to the Warp Spider Exarch known as “Excellion.” Excellion’s brilliant tactics managed to save the Craftworld “Invincible” from certain destruction by the Dark Eldar. The shrine was erected by the Farseer Anaya in memory of the fallen warrior’s deeds. Some believe that the shrine itself has the ability to cure the faithful. Such heresies, of course, are not to be believed.

tc_text: 伊甸園 (2)
這個世界奇特的生態系統使它得以在發生多次的戰爭之後迅速復原。伊甸園的小河流及清新的草地掩飾了常在這世界發生的死亡及屠殺。
en_text: The strange properties of this world's ecosystem allow it to quickly recover from the many battles that have been fought here. Eden's gently flowing creeks and pristine meadows belie the death and carnage that often occur on this hotly disputed world.

tc_text: 流冰 (4)
哪一個種族會瘋狂到在一條開始碎裂的冰河上戰鬥?顯然不少，看看這道月形冰河經歷過無數次的戰爭就知道。
en_text: What race would be mad enough to fight on the cracking flows of a disintegrating glacier? Several races, apparently, seeing as how this crumbling glacier moon has been the site of countless epic battles.

tc_text: 葛海爾的坑洞 (4)
這個坑洞以前是諾瓦之環（一個由混沌領主組成的陰謀組織，他們在被擊敗、退回亞空間之前，控制著暴風區的大部份地區）的集會地點。這個世界那些頭腦簡單的居民常常宣稱他們的前任主人總有一天會回來。「讓他們來。」超能戰士們。「我們會再一次殲滅他們。」
en_text: This crater was once the meeting place of Circle Noir, a mysterious cabal of Chaos Lords who ravaged large parts of the Segmentum Tempestus before being driven back into the warp. The simple-minded inhabitants of this world often claim that their former masters will one day return. "Let them come," say the Ultramarines, "We will crush them yet again."

tc_text: 深入缺口 (4)
因為計畫不夠週詳，以致於帝國防衛軍多次必須奪回這個險要的山間隘口。每次的死傷都很慘重，帝國政戰軍官必須大叫「攻進缺口！你們這些畜牲，再進攻一次！」他叫得太多次了，沒人可以數得過來。
en_text: Due to poor planning, the Imperial Guard has been forced to retake this treacherous mountain pass on several occasions. The casualties have always been high, and the Imperial Commissars have had to scream "Into the breach! Into the breach once more, you dogs!" more times than a person could readily count.

tc_text: 恐懼之巔 (4)
這座「山」的精確角度迫使所有人承認一個結論：這不是自然可以形成的。被迫在這個巨型構造物上戰鬥的軍隊常會迷信的恐懼，擔心會褻瀆這座怪東西的「創造者」。
en_text: The precise angles of this "mountain" force all to conclude that it was constructed by something other than nature. Troops forced to fight on this monstrosity of a structure are always filled with superstitious dread, and panic at the thought of offending "the makers" of this aberration.

tc_text: 泰霸羅 (4)
泰霸羅是一個異教部落的傳奇酋長，他最後的據點就在這座山上。最後泰霸羅被一個名叫戴斯丁．伯恩的年輕上尉以穩定而有系統的戰術擊敗。審判官允許這座山沿用那名異教徒的名字，做為懷疑帝皇力量之人的教訓。
en_text: Tiboraxx was the legendary tribal chieftain of a heretic race that made his last stand on this mountainside. Tiboraxx was eventually defeated by the steady and methodical tactics of a young lieutenant by the name of Dustyn Bronn. Inquisitors have allowed the mountain to keep the heretic's name as a lesson to all who would doubt the power of The Emperor.

tc_text: 葛剛之眼 (5)
葛剛是個噬血而充滿野心的混沌領主，據說是在這個峽谷戰死。據說恐虐送給他的義眼埋在山谷裡的某個地方，使得葛剛的不潔污染了所有的東西。
en_text: Gorgon was a bloodthirsty and ambitious Chaos Lord who was said to have met his end in this valley. Legends say that his eye implant, a gift from Khorne himself, lies buried somewhere in the valley, leaving the vestiges of Gorgon's unholy taint over all.

tc_text: 泰梅奇的監獄 (5)
這塊高原據說是由狂人泰梅奇興建的一處巨大監獄的廢墟。泰梅奇是一個審判官，將全行星上所有輕視他的人都監禁起來。雖然他活著時擁有極大的權力，但是死後就被宣告為叛教徒。諷刺的是，這個判決是他的繼承者宣佈的，而這個繼承者被稱為「狠心的多米尼克」。
en_text: This plateau is said to be the ruins of a massive prison complex built by Totmacher the Mad. Totmacher was an Inquisitor who imprisoned the populations of entire planets for perceived slights. Though he held great power while he was alive, Totmacher was posthumously declared a heretic. Ironically, this declaration was pronounced by his successor, who came to be known as Dominic the Merciless.

tc_text: 阿法勒斯 (6)
這個有火山活動的衛星是以星際戰士士官卡迪爾斯．阿法勒斯之名為名。卡迪爾斯多次利用這顆衛星的隱密位置攻擊優勢敵軍的背後而逆轉戰爭情勢，而且都能在敵人反擊之前撤離。
en_text: This volcanic moon was named for Space Marine Sergeant Caudius Alvarus. Caudius turned the tide of several wars by attacking the rear of the victorious army from the obscurity of this moon, always managing to retreat before reprisal could occur.

tc_text: 憤怒之島 (6)
這個在伯恩海洋世界的孤島是最早已知有血鴉戰士參與的戰爭地點。因為這個原因，血鴉戰士認為這個孤島是他們神聖之地，並且渴望能有機會在這裡再次證明他們的英勇。
en_text: This lone island on the ocean world of Brun is the site of the earliest known battle involving the Blood Ravens. For this reason, the Blood Ravens consider the island to be sacred ground, and long for the opportunity to prove their valor once more on its soil.

tc_text: 牧師權杖 (6)
這個戰場是星際戰士牧師瑪利特斯最後駐守的地點。他以他的武器、技能，以及對至高帝皇的忠誠，獨自守住防線，讓機械主教復甦雷鳥型戰機的機械靈魂，並將人員送到安全處。
en_text: This battlefield is the site of the heroic last stand of Space Marine Chaplain Maritus. With his weapon, his skill, and his faith in the Almighty Emperor, he alone was able to hold the front line allowing for the Techpriests to revive the Machine Spirits of the waiting Thunderhawks and lift the men to safety.

tc_text: 泰葛倫 (6)
因為其戰略位置及豐富礦產之故，沙漠世界泰葛倫一直是暴風區的死亡十字路。
en_text: The desert world of Thargorum has always been a crossroads of death in Segmentum Tempestus, due to its strategic location and mineral wealth.

tc_text: 禁忌的叢林 (8)
審判官宣佈不准進入薩開諾這個叢林世界，但是從來不曾解釋真正的原因。不過這裡仍然發生零星的戰役，而審判官也迅速處決那些離營太遠，或是表現出「異教好奇心」的士兵。
en_text: Inquisitors have declared the jungle world of Saganor to be off limits, but the exact reason for this declaration has never been fully explained. The occasional battle still has to be fought here, though, and Inquisitors are quick to execute those who stray too far from camp, or exhibit a "heretical curiosity."

tc_text: 夏爾之綠洲 (8)
在遙遠的過去，夏爾之綠洲也許曾經是疲倦的沙漠旅人眼中一個令人欣喜的景觀。但是現在這裡卻是不斷發生流血事件的地方，因為帝國及神靈族都認為這是他們的神聖領地。
en_text: The Oasis of Sharr may once have been a welcome sight to weary desert travelers in the distant past. Now, however, it is a sight of constant bloodshed, since it is now considered a sacred site to both the Imperium and the Eldar.

tc_text: 洪流 (8)
曾有許多軍隊入侵這個無名、酷熱的叢林世界，但是都沒有停留太久。雖然在這裡有軍隊征服了另一支軍隊，但是沒有任何軍隊能夠征服這個嚴酷世界的惡劣天氣。
en_text: Many armies have invaded this nameless, sweltering jungle world, but none have remained for long. Though one army has conquered another here, no army has conquered the elements of this unforgiving world.

tc_text: 寒極冰帽 (8)
曼堂鈉的寒極冰帽是個奧提瑪殿堂通訊網路的一個重要據點，從一開始就一直是侵略及掠奪的目標。這個世界的戰鬥太過猛烈，以致於沒有文明人口存留。
en_text: The polar caps of Mendona are a vital part of the communications network of the Ultima Segmentum, and have been a constant target of raids and invasions from the beginning. So intense is the fighting on this world, that no civilian population remains.

tc_text: 泰勤的愚行 (2)
一個叫做泰勤．巴格斯的性急星際戰士少尉在這裡被一個小有名氣的混沌領主擊敗，導致帝國在此地區的發展延誤了好幾年。即使巴格斯被打敗，他的態度仍然傲慢，有人甚至懷疑他被插在矛尖上的頭骨還會吐出褻瀆的話。
en_text: A brash Space Marine Lieutenant by the name of Tazin Briggs suffered a crushing defeat on this plateau at the hands of Doran, a Chaos Lord of some notoriety. Imperial operations in the sector were set back several years as a result. So insolent was Briggs in defeat, that some suspect that even his skull continues to spout profanities from the top of the spike it mounts.

tc_text: 派恩的報應 (6)
這個世界極少發生戰爭，但每場戰役都關係到聖殿的控制權。其中一場戰役是帝國牧師海爾登為被殲滅的第648卡迪恩軍團復仇，因而打敗道星人軍閥雷尼克斯，並將他逐出此星系。
en_text: The few battles fought on this world have always brought visible swings in the battle for control of the Segmentum Tempestus. One such battle was when the Imperial Captain Harleton "Harazzer" Payne avenged the annihilation of the 648th Cadian Regiment by defeating the Tau warlord Rennikus, and drove him from the sector.

tc_text: 羅恩五號星 (2)
羅恩五號星這個焦黑的世界，早在帝國歷史記載前就戰火連連。儘管這個世界不能住人，也沒有開礦的價值，它的戰略位置卻使得它一直是一顆各方勢力爭奪不已的行星。
en_text: The charred world of Lonn V was reduced to ash long before the records of the Imperium begin. The strategic location of the world continues to make it a hotly disputed planet, despite the fact that it cannot support life and has no mineral value.

tc_text: 羅恩五號星 (2)
羅恩五號星這個焦黑的世界，早在帝國歷史記載前就戰火連連。儘管這個世界不能住人，也沒有開礦的價值，它的戰略位置卻使得它一直是一顆各方勢力爭奪不已的行星。
en_text: The charred world of Lonn V was reduced to ash long before the records of the Imperium begin. The strategic location of the world continues to make it a hotly disputed planet, despite the fact that it cannot support life and has no mineral value.

菲爾 (2)
在莫理亞海岸中的這座小島在暗黑聖戰期間發生了幾件血腥的衝突。混沌的信徒們聲稱這些噬血凶殺都是他們黑暗諸神的成就。
en_text: This tiny island in the Morriah Sea saw several bloody conflicts during the Dark Crusade. Chaos Cultists claimed the blood of all those slain here for their dark gods.

tc_text: 翡翠河(2)
這個世界的原住民相信這條河是通往來生的大門。在命運的奇妙轉折中，竟然證實這種看法：火蜥蜴將他們種族殘留的餘民困在這條河的河岸上，並且徹底地消滅他們。
en_text: The original inhabitants of this world believed this river to be the gateway to the afterlife. In an odd twist of fate, this turned out to be true when the Salamanders trapped the last remnants of their race against the banks of this river, and purged them from existence.

tc_text: 帝王谷(2)
雖然這顆星球沒有受到一陣強烈非凡的曲速風暴的直接衝擊，但是有超過一個世紀的時間，無法前往其它世界。漸漸地，神殿湮沒在週遭的叢林中，只有一小群血鴉軍團的士兵保持神殿的火焰不致熄滅。現在，手持過時的裝備和一群需要保護的人民，這一小群人所剩下的人面對風暴的再度來襲，以及另外一次信心的考驗。他們的神聖誓言是：「帝皇之力的火焰絕對不能熄滅。」創作者：Psy
en_text: While the planet was spared direct impact by an unusually strong warp storm, travel to and offworld was impossible for over a century. Over time, the temple has succumbed to the surrounding jungle, but a small contingent of Blood Ravens has kept the temple fires lit. Now, with aging equipment and a civilian population to protect, the remnants of that contingent face the passing of the storm and the coming of another test of faith. Their sacred vow: the fires of Emperor's Might will never be stifled. Created by: Psy

tc_text: 法塔．摩加納(2)
摩加納是一個混沌女巫，她引誘了這顆一度繁榮而忠誠的帝國殖民地的星球的總督。但是摩加納的勝利為時甚短，血鴉軍團很快就肅清了這顆星球的所有生物。摩加納本人是個兇殘的敵手，殺死了血鴉遠征軍的隊長和大部份的參謀。最後她被一個叫做戴維恩．蘇勒的年輕軍官所殺。
en_text: Morga was a Chaos witch that managed to seduce the planetary governor of this once-prosperous and loyal Imperial colony. Morga's victory was short-lived, however, and the Blood Ravens soon purged the planet of all life. Morga herself proved to be a deadly foe, and managed to slay the Blood Raven expedition leader and most of his staff. Ultimately she was killed by a young initiate by the name of Davian Thule.

tc_text: 霜吻河(2)
根據當地的傳說，如果一個人獨自沿著河岸走，就可以聽到它微聲說出死在這條冰冷河水中的無數死者的名字。創作者：MC Warhammer
en_text: According to local legend, if one walks the banks of the river alone, he can hear it whisper the names of the countless dead who have spilled their blood in its icy waters. Created by: MC Warhammer

tc_text: 寧靜末日(2)
布里安納的森林世界是帝國貴族階級獨有的狩獵保護區，在帝國一萬年的歷史中，從來不曾遭受破壞。但是這一切都即將改變…
en_text: The forest world of Breanna, an exclusive hunting reserve for the Imperial aristocracy, has never been ravaged in 10 millennia of Imperial history. But all of that is about to change…

tc_text: 漢尼斯之愚(2)
就是在這個破碎的星球上，斯提反．漢尼斯上校率領的第428卡司金軍團在對抗鈦星人的一場戰役中被徹底殲滅。儘管漢尼斯已經受到警告，指出他的防禦軍的裝備不足以對抗鈦星人的武器，他仍然發動攻擊，堅稱他的部下絕對可以迎接這個挑戰。「他們表現得很好！」是失去聯絡之前的最後一筆通話記錄。
en_text: It was here on this shattered planet that the 428th Thracian regiment, under the command of Colonel Stefan Haines, was utterly annihilated in a campaign against the Tau. Despite the fact that Haines had been amply warned that his guardsmen were ill-equipped to deal with Tau weaponry, he pressed forward with the attack, insisting that his men were more than ready for the challenge. "They're doing fine!" was his last recorded utterance before communications were lost.

tc_text: 泰坦殞落(2)
這個戰場是特倫的墓園。特倫是一部英勇的帝國泰坦，在亞巴頓對抗凱迪恩之門的聖戰中殞落。不幸的是，特倫高貴的機器之靈永遠無法得到安息，因為各方軍隊在此地衝突，為要取回已殞落的神級機器。
en_text: This battlefield serves as the graveyard of Telum, a valiant Imperial Titan that fell in combat during Abaddon's never-ending crusade against the Cadian Gate. Sadly, Telum's noble machine-spirit shall never know peace for even now armies clash to recover the fallen god-machine.

tc_text: 血腥地獄 (2)
阿克斯‧文格爾的遺言—"渾沌軍團控制了這座山谷，並且將他們敵人的鮮血注滿其中，真是有趣。" " —史學家記載
en_text: "It is said, that Chaos conquered this valley and filled it with the blood of their foes. Interesting." - The final words of Arcus Wengart. Created by: Listoric

tc_text: 昔蘭尼神殿（6）
昔蘭尼神殿座落在一片滿目瘡痍的土地上，這是一個遭到帝國審判庭滅絕令淨空的世界。昔蘭尼是加百列‧安傑羅的家鄉，如今卻淪為城市僅存遺跡，田野滿布塵埃的荒蕪世界。從曾經強大的昔蘭尼神殿的遺跡中崛起，奮戰奪取這個世界的霸權。佔領遺跡中心三處關鍵地點，或長驅直入敵人的基地掃蕩殲滅。
en_text: The Temple of Cyrene sits on the blasted landscape of a world scoured clean by the Exterminatus of the Imperial Inquisition. Homeworld of Gabriel Angelos, Cyrene is now a ghost-world of ruined cities and ashen fields. Fight for supremacy amidst the remains of Cyrene’s once-mighty temples. Claim the three critical locations at the heart of the ruins or drive into enemy bases and deliver annihilation.

破壞外城門
我們必須攻進去!攻擊並破壞在我們面前的門，並將部隊向前推進!
en_text: We must get inside! Attack and destroy the gates in our path and move the troops forward!

tc_text: 破壞內城門
已經突破第一批城門!但是我們不能一直停留在這裡。繼續攻擊，並突破第二批城門。
en_text: The first set of gates is breached! We cannot stay here forever though. Keep pushing the attack forward and break through the second series of gates.

tc_text: 破壞內部聖域
勝利就在我們眼前!破壞最後一批城門，讓部隊進入內部聖所。
en_text: Victory is at hand! Break the last set of gates and get the troops inside the Inner Sanctum.

tc_text: 破壞血城門
邪惡的惡魔大軍佔據了城門。但是我們一定要衝破血門並且進入要塞的中心。
en_text: Foul Daemonic forces have infested that gate. Regardless, we must break through the Blood Gate and into the center of the Fortress.

tc_text: 破壞熱流電漿發電機
一定要破壞這些熱電漿發電機，才能使這些保護巫師的砲塔失去動力。
en_text: In order to disable the Turrets protecting the Sorcerer we must destroy these Thermo Plasma Generators.

tc_text: 殺死巫師
巫師是血城門的力量泉源。殺死巫師並停止血城門周遭的防禦魔法。
en_text: The Sorcerer is the source of the Blood Gate's strength. Kill the Sorcerer and stop the protective spell around the Blood Gate.

tc_text: 破壞大砲
這些大砲會令士兵陷入混亂；我們必須破壞這些砲台。
en_text: Those guns will wreak havoc on the men; we must destroy the artillery that's shelling the area.

tc_text: 將援軍向前移動
選擇一個步兵總部建築，再按 "設定援軍"按鈕。這樣可以確使支援部隊從這個前進陣地抵達戰場。
en_text: Select an Infantry Command structure and click on the “Set Reinforcement” button. This will ensure the reinforcements arrive from this forward position.

tc_text: 保衛地區安全
我們必須保護附近區域，才能設立一個基地。佔據那兩個指定的戰略據點，以達成控制此區域的目的。
en_text: We must secure the local area in order to establish a base. Capture the two indicated Strategic Points in order to take control of the area.

tc_text: 建造野戰司令部
野戰司令部是我們的軍事總部，讓我們能夠建造所有的部隊及建築物。建造一個野戰司令部。
en_text: The Field Command is our headquarters and allows construction of all units and buildings. Build a Field Command.

tc_text: 建造步兵總部
步兵總部可讓我們徵用更多部隊，也可以用來當做碉堡。建造一個步兵總部。
en_text: Infantry Command allows us to requisition more troops and acts as a bunker for the men. Build an Infantry Command.

tc_text: 建造戰略指揮部
戰略指揮部可以讓我們以研究和武器升級加強基本部隊的能力。建造一個戰略指揮部。
en_text: The Tactica Control allows us to enhance basic troops with research and weapon upgrades. Build a Tactica Control.

tc_text: 建造一座砲塔
砲塔提供有效的定點防禦，而且不會限制部隊的數量。建造一個砲塔。
en_text: Turrets provide effective stationary defenses without limiting the number of troops. Build a Turret.

tc_text: 奪下要塞
這個舊的帝國防衛要塞是進行登陸及駐紮部隊的理想地點。若要佔領它，我們必須攻進內部聖所，並且殲滅所有的敵軍。
en_text: This old Imperial Defense Fortress is an ideal location for us to stage our landing and deploy the troops. To claim it we must reach the Inner Sanctum and destroy all opposition.

tc_text: 建立據點
我們要在這裡設置一個據點，才能攻取要塞。我們必須控制這個地區，並建造重要的建築，以鞏固我們的陣地。
en_text: We must establish a foothold on this position if we are to take the Fortress. Firm up our position by taking control of the area and setting up key buildings.

tc_text: 產生援軍
選擇魍道關口，並且按下「徵用小隊」按鈕，以徵用新部隊來支援我們的軍隊。
en_text: Requisition new units to supplement our Force by selecting a Webway Gate and clicking on the "Requisition Strike Force" button.

tc_text: 經由魍道關口移動
如果要攻擊發電機，我們必須將我們的戰士移進最近的魍道關口，才能重新佈署他們的位置。
en_text: In order to assault the Plasma Generators we must move our warriors into the nearby Webway Gate to relocate them.

tc_text: 攻佔哨兵機器人總部
雖然那個哨兵機器人工研總部很舊了，但還是可以使用。奪取那個戰略據點，我們就可以使用哨兵機器人。
en_text: That Sentinel Mechanized Command is old but still functional. Capture the Strategic Point and we will be able to get Sentinels.

tc_text: 獲得地獄犬級裝甲車
如果我們奪取那個工研總部，就可以引進地獄犬裝甲車。佔領那個戰略據點。
en_text: If we can capture that Mechanized Command we will be able to bring down Hellhounds. Capture the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 阻止猛禽戰士突擊
那些猛禽戰士妨礙了我們的前線進度。摧毀位於堡壘中心的兩座混沌神殿，以阻止猛禽戰士的攻擊。
en_text: Those Raptor raids are hampering our forward progress. Destroy the two Chaos Temples in the center bastion to stop the Raptor raids.

tc_text: 突擊
血城門
帝國軍無法突破最後一道城牆。我們必須想個法子削弱血城門的力量，讓帝國軍破壞血城門並前進。
en_text: The Imperials cannot breach the final gate. We must find a way to make the Blood Gate vulnerable to their weaponry and enable them to move forward.

tc_text: 啊…另一個世界,另一個塑造榮耀帝皇的勝利!
en_text: Ah... another world, another victory in the making for our glorious Emperor!

tc_text: 我在這裡看不見勝利。我只看見一個事實，就是戰爭。若不是為了我們的獎賞，這個世界根本不值得我們注意。
en_text: I see no victory here. I see but one truth, and that truth is war. This world would not even warrant our attention were it not for our prize.

tc_text: 太好了，泰坦支配者。想想看…一個在火星的火山鑄造廠中建造的雄偉戰爭機器。
en_text: Yes, the Titan Dominatus. Imagine... a great war machine forged in the volcanic foundries of Mars.

tc_text: 泰坦在防衛這個世界時被摧毀，而帝皇要求帝國護衛軍卡迪安第412步兵團將它回收。泰坦就在羅恩五號星的首都泰羅恩裡。
en_text: The Titan fell in the defense of this world, and the Emperor has entrusted the Cadian 412th Regiment of the Imperial Guard to retrieve it. The Titan lies in the ruins of Lorn V's principal city, Talorn.

tc_text: 但是，事情一個一個來。如果想要擊敗堅守在這個世界的混沌軍團，我們必須先佔據泰羅恩防衛要塞。通知所有弟兄。
en_text: But, one thing at a time. We must take the Talorn Defense Fortress if we hope to defeat the forces of Chaos firmly entrenched upon this world. Spread word to the men.

tc_text: 告訴他們，我們今天若不是贏得勝利，就是戰死沙場。沒有撤退的餘地!
en_text: Tell them we win this day or we die trying. There is no retreat!

tc_text: 我們贏了，但是損失慘重。數百人死亡…數千人受傷。如果你要看的話，我這裡有統計的人數。
en_text: We have won, but the cost was high. Hundreds dead... thousands wounded. I have the numbers here if you wish.

tc_text: 既然受傷者仍能戰鬥，我們就晚一點再哀悼死亡的士兵。但是我們已經建立據點，而剩下的士兵足夠守住泰坦。
en_text: We will mourn the dead later while the wounded can still fight. Regardless, we have our foothold and the soldiers left are more than enough to secure the Titan.

tc_text: 還有…我在納悶:為何惡魔城門會倒塌?到底是誰的命運?
en_text: Still... I wonder. Why did the Daemon Gate collapse? Whose fortune was that?

tc_text: 混沌軍團的命運，史泰恩將軍。這就是跟惡魔交往的愚昧。我可以確定帝皇正微笑地看著我們，將軍。
en_text: The fortune of Chaos, General Sturnn. Such is the folly of consorting with evil. The Emperor was smiling down upon us today, General, I'm certain of it.

tc_text: 只有蠢蛋才會確定，政戰官。我們還沒有完全勝利，還有更多的敵軍會來…但是到底是什麼在等著我們，我不能確定。
en_text: Only fools are certain, Commissar. And the day is not yet won. There is more to come... but what awaits us, I am not sure.

tc_text: …我重複一遍…我是超能戰士法諾斯弟兄…可恨的異教徒把我們擊落。泰坦駕駛員在我們這裡…
en_text: ... I repeat... this is Brother Varnus of the Ultramarines... fell heretics have shot us down. The Titan crew is with us...

tc_text: …我們會堅守到底，但是我們的運輸機墜毀在敵軍陣地內部…必須不計代價救出泰坦駕駛員…
en_text: ... will hold out for as long as we can but our transport has crashed deep inside enemy territory. ... must save the Titan crew at all costs...

tc_text: 集中你的注意力在城門上面，但別讓敵人從側翼包圍你!若要攻佔要塞，我們一定要破壞那些城門!
en_text: Concentrate your attention on those gates, but don't let the enemy outflank you! To breach the fortress, we must destroy those gates!

tc_text: 我們無法再承受這種攻擊了。
en_text: We cannot survive this barrage much longer.

tc_text: 惡魔城門受到邪惡的歐克蠻人保護。如果我們不能快點打敗他們，那就全完了!
en_text: The Daemon Gate is protected by the foul workings of the Warp. If we cannot overcome it quickly, then all is lost!

tc_text: 帝國軍在一開始就動搖了…比我想像中的還快。果然不出所料。可惜，我們必須插手。
en_text: The Imperials falter in their opening steps... far sooner than I would have liked. How typical of them. Sadly, we must intervene on their behalf.

tc_text: 我們需要援軍，但是我們必須佔據以下的戰略據點，以設立安全的降落區域。
en_text: We need reinforcements, but we must capture the following Strategic Points to establish a safe landing-zone.

tc_text: 如果失去這些據點，我們就無法獲得援軍，我們也必敗無疑！
en_text: If those points are lost, then we will be cut off from our reinforcements and we will most certainly perish!

tc_text: 哨兵機器人機棚?在這裡?當然了!這裡以前是帝國軍駐防地。戰報指示有些哨兵機器人還是可以用的。
en_text: A Sentinel Hangar? Here? Of course! This was once an Imperial Garrison. Reports indicate that some of the Sentinels are still functional.

tc_text: 如果我們想要使用那些哨兵機器人，就必須保護那個機棚。
en_text: We must save that hangar if we are to secure and use the Sentinels in our favor.

tc_text: 我們找到了可以容納重型裝甲的降落區域。
en_text: We've located a drop-zone large enough to accommodate the delivery of Heavy Armor.

tc_text: 準備清除帝皇之敵的目標據點，並且保護它，等待前來之運輸機。
en_text: Prepare to scour the target site of the Emperor's enemies and secure it for inbound transports.

tc_text: 愛莎之淚呀!有四個能源點傳送能量給惡魔門。如果要幫助這些帝國軍，我們必須摧毀那四個能源點。
en_text: Isha's Tears! Four generators channel power to the so-called Daemon Gate. If we are to help these Imperials, we must destroy the four generators first.

tc_text: 幸運地，我們可以用魍道關口來到達無法穿越的地形及躲過帝國軍的視線，他們永遠不會知道到底是誰在幫助他們。
en_text: Fortunately, we can use our Webway Gates to reach impassable areas and to bypass the Imperial presence. They'll never know it was we who helped them.

tc_text: 四個能源點全部被摧毀了…確實是令人高興的消息。但是動作要快，如果帝國軍發現我們介入，他們既無法明白，也不會感激我們。
en_text: The four generators are destroyed... that is indeed joyous news. Be quick, however. The Imperials would neither understand nor appreciate our intervention were they to discover our presence.

tc_text: 我們必須找到策劃這項攻擊行動的巫師，但是告訴戰士們，我，而且只有我，會去對付他。
en_text: We must reach the Sorcerer orchestrating this attack, but, tell the warriors that I and I alone will dispense with him.

tc_text: 機器主教發現了泰坦的心脈跳動。它的機械靈魂非常強壯。如果我們到達它所在之處的話，機器主教認為他們可以修好它。
en_text: The tech-priests have detected the heartbeat of the Titan. Its machine spirit is strong. The tech-priests believe they can repair it, if we can reach it.

tc_text: 我們會的，但是不能被人搶先一步。要不然我們將會被毀滅。
en_text: We shall, but not one step before the other. To do otherwise will ensure our doom.

tc_text: 我們的軍隊已經登陸，而且沒有遇到什麼抵抗。
en_text: Our forces have made planetfall and are encountering little resistance.

tc_text: 在過去四萬年間，我們知道一件事：我們惟一擅長的就是戰爭及破壞。但是我不知道那些可悲的魯因那斯特使們是怎麼從帝國軍手中奪走羅恩五號星的…。
en_text: For all we have learned in the last 40 millennia, it is that we are singularly skilled in matters of war and mayhem. But how these pathetic emissaries of the Ruinous Mark managed to wrest Lorn V from the Imperial Guard... I'll never know.

tc_text: 那些猛禽戰士從那座中央堡壘突擊我們。如果我們不攻佔它，他們會繼續騷擾我們。
en_text: Those raptors are striking at us from that central bastion. If we do not secure it they will continue to harass us.

tc_text: 我們必須建造步兵總部來鞏固我們的陣地!援軍必須到達前線附近!在前線建造步兵總部!
en_text: We must construct Infantry Command buildings to secure our position! The reinforcements must be near the front lines! Build them at the forward positions!

tc_text: 中央的基地在保護那些猛禽戰士。摧毀基地，就摧毀了猛禽戰士的干擾!
en_text: That central base is housing those Raptors. Destroy it and we destroy the Raptor threat!

tc_text: 突擊隊伍的成員已在戰場陣亡。我們必須繼續向前推進。從魍道關口多召喚一些兵員前來。
en_text: Members of the assault force have fallen in battle. We must press forward. Summon more from our Webway Gates.

tc_text: 不能讓任何東西衝破前線。建造砲塔來鞏固我們的防禦，並派出更多火力增援前線！
en_text: Nothing must break through the forward line. Build turrets to bolster our defenses and reinforce the forward line with more firepower!

tc_text: 好呀!戰略指揮部可以正常運作了!現在我們可以為帝國防衛隊配備更好的武器了!
en_text: Yes! Tactica Control is operational! We can now arm the Guardsmen with better weapons!

en_text: The firing capacity of those Turrets will be invaluable. Capture the nearby Strategic Point to gain control of the Turrets within its proximity.

tc_text: 佔領步兵總部
我們可以利用步兵總部，將我們的部隊向前推進。佔領鄰近的戰略據點來控制其區域內的步兵總部。
en_text: We can use this Infantry Command to move our troops forward. Capture the nearby Strategic Point to gain control of the Infantry Command Structures within its proximity.

tc_text: 支援超能戰士
超能戰士及泰坦駕駛員被敵軍包圍，並受到強烈的攻擊。他們無法永遠支持下去。向前推進並幫助受困的星際戰士。
en_text: The Ultramarines and the Titan Crew are under hellish assault from the forces surrounding them. They cannot hold forever. Push forward and assist the Space Marines in their plight.

tc_text: 抵達野戰司令部
這裡有一個被遺棄的野戰司令部，我們可以利用它來幫助我們的行進。我們必須殲滅所有附近的敵人來佔領它。
en_text: There is an abandoned Field Command which we can use to aid our progression. To take control of it we must destroy any enemies around it.

tc_text: 引誘第一支歐克蠻人軍隊
我們的軍隊並沒有強到可以擊敗擋住我們去路的歐克蠻人。我們必須利用匿蹤和狡詐來取勝。破壞歐克蠻人的發電機，爆炸會將歐克蠻人軍隊吸引過去，使我軍道路暢通。
en_text: Our force is not strong enough to defeat the Orks in our path. We must use stealth and cunning. Destroy the Ork Power Generator and the subsequent explosion will lure the Ork army to it, freeing our path.

tc_text: 引誘第二支歐克蠻人軍隊
我們的計畫成功；利用這種簡單的策略，歐克蠻人很快上鉤了。重複地利用此戰略，破壞下一個歐克蠻人的發電機並把他們引誘開。
en_text: Our plan was a success; the Orks are easily lured by simple tactics. Repeat the process, destroy the next Ork Power Generator and lure their force out of our way.

tc_text: 引誘第三支歐克蠻人軍隊
我們前方還有一支歐克蠻人的軍隊。他們簡單的大腦不值得我們浪費時間，破壞最後一個發電機，打開前往歐克蠻人大砲所在之處的道路。
en_text: One Ork force remains in our path. Their simple brains are not worthy of our efforts. Destroy the final Ork Power Generator and clear the path to the Ork Artillery.

tc_text: 修理哨兵機器人
如果我們修理那些哨兵機器人，我們就可以控制及利用它們。
en_text: If we repair those Sentinels we will be able to control them and use them to our advantage.

tc_text: 修理噴火獸級裝甲車
如果我們修理那些噴火獸級裝甲車，我們就可以控制及利用它們。
en_text: If we repair those Chimeras we will be able to control them and use them to our advantage.

tc_text: 帝國機械廠
這附近有一些被遺棄的帝國機械廠。把它們找出來。
en_text: There is some abandoned Imperial Machinery scattered throughout this region. Seek it out.

tc_text: 消滅歐克蠻人大砲
那些歐克蠻人的大砲會對在峽谷中移動的帝國軍造成威脅。我們必須摧毀歐克蠻人的大砲，再次幫助身處困境的人類。
en_text: That Ork Artillery is making short work of the Imperial Guard as they attempt to move through the valley. We must destroy the Ork Artillery, and once more help the humans in their plight.

tc_text: 破壞混沌軍團基地
混沌軍團基地一直對超能戰士發動攻擊。摧毀那個基地!
en_text: That Chaos Base is sending constant assaults on the Ultramarines. Destroy that base!

tc_text: 移動部隊前進
我們已經佔領一個新的步兵總部. 使用它來移動我們的部隊前進
en_text: We have captured a new Infantry Command. Use it to move our troops forward!

tc_text: 我們曾經經歷比這還要困難的戰爭！堅守戰線，該死的。你的死亡不會令帝皇感到困窘!
en_text: We have weathered fiercer storms than this! Hold the line, damn you. You will not embarrass the Emperor today by dying!

tc_text: 注意你的側翼並保護泰坦的操作員!那裡!有更多來找死的敵軍來了!
en_text: Watch your flanks and protect the Titan's crew! There! More come to die!

tc_text: 混沌軍團…歐克蠻人…我們的工作已完成。
en_text: Chaos... Orks... our work is clear.

tc_text: 真的!雷鷹型戰機在附近墜落，現在我們需要跟法那斯牧師及他的星際戰士會合。更重要的是…我們必須拯救泰坦的操作員。對這個任務而言…任何考量都不重要，包括我們的生命!
en_text: Indeed! The Thunderhawk crashed nearby and it is to us to reach Chaplain Varnus and his Space Marines. More importantly... we must save the Titan's crew. To this task, all considerations... even our lives, are secondary!

tc_text: 我會照著這樣做！
en_text: I would have it no other way!

tc_text: 來吧，你們這些外星渾球和墮落的背叛者!來面對宇宙唯一的真實力量，在黃金王座的視線下凋零吧!
en_text: Come all you Xeno-Scum and Fallen Heretics! Come face the one true might of the Universe and wither under the Golden Throne's gaze!

tc_text: 史泰恩將軍，我及超能戰士們再一次感謝你。
en_text: Again, General Sturnn, you have my thanks and the thanks of the Ultramarines.

tc_text: 我是帝皇的謙遜僕人，但是…今天的救援行動並不完全是我們的功勞。有人在暗中幫助我們。這已經是第二次了，一些無法突破的障礙奇蹟般地消失了。
en_text: I am the Emperor's humble servant, but... we were not entirely responsible for today's rescue. Someone else is helping us. This is twice that some impassable obstruction miraculously evaporated.

tc_text: 你應該相信帝皇。他今天與我們同在。
en_text: You should trust in the Emperor. He was with us today.

tc_text: 我絕不懷疑。但是，有人在暗中幫助我們，而且我希望他們可以停止。我並不喜歡暗地中進行的相助。在帝皇的光芒下，這些幫助都將凋零。
en_text: Of that I have no doubt. Still, something else is helping us and I wish they'd stop. I don't like favors curried in secret. They wilt under the Emperor's light.

tc_text: 你的話很虔誠，令人敬重。
en_text: Your words are pious... I respect that.

tc_text: 謝謝你。我隨時預備面對戰爭，而且我很少預測失誤或被偷襲。我會讓我的弟兄們知道帝國竭誠地感謝他們。
en_text: Thank you. I expect war in all things and I'm rarely disappointed or caught unaware. I'll let my men know that the Imperium's finest extends them their gratitude.

tc_text: 是的。泰坦駕駛員已經安全了,也準備出發。
en_text: Indeed. The Titan's crew is secure and ready for transport.

tc_text: 那麼我們離開這裡，回到前哨基地去。我們必須護送操作員回到泰坦，要不然這一切都沒有意義。
en_text: Let us leave this place, then, and make our return to the outpost. We must get the crew back to the Titan, or all this will have been for naught.

tc_text: 我們必須撤離並且找別的出路。我們無法過橋!
en_text: We must retreat and find another way around. The bridge is lost to us!

tc_text: 被這種事情阻礙…可惡!如果我們的石化蜥蜴級自走砲準備好了，就可以讓他們受到慘痛的教訓!
en_text: To be thrown back by this... filth! Had we our Basilisks ready, we would have taught them a lesson!

tc_text: 尊貴的先知!帝國軍在橋樑前陷入困境，受到慘重的砲擊。你的命令是?
en_text: Exalted Farseer! The Imperials are mired before the bridge and falter under heavy bombardment. Your orders?

tc_text: 帝國軍的無能在測試我的耐心!好吧…我們自己去解決歐克蠻人，但這是因為時間短促。死亡已經逼近我們…
en_text: The Imperials test my patience with their incompetence! Very well... we will deal with the Orks ourselves, but only because the time grows short. Death is almost upon us....

tc_text: 哨兵機器人!命運今天在對我們微笑！把它們修好，利用它們。
en_text: Sentinels! Fate smiles upon us today lads. Let's get them repaired and use them to our advantage.

tc_text: 這些噴火獸級裝甲車都已經殘破不堪，但是把它們修理好就可以使用。
en_text: Those Chimeras have seen better days, but with some field repairs they should serve our needs.

tc_text: 把哨兵機器人移到未被佔據的戰略據點上，中斷砲塔的能源!快!
en_text: Get the Sentinels to uncapture those Strategic Points and take power away from those turrets! NOW!

tc_text: 我們現在可以用噴火獸級裝甲車來運輸士兵，讓他們毫髮無傷地通過敵軍的砲塔。
en_text: We can now use those Chimeras to transport our troops unharmed past the fire of those enemy turrets.

tc_text: 這些地圖資料是帝國第一次駐軍在這裡的時候留下的。上面說這裡有地下隧道，連結各碉堡。我們可以利用這些地道!
en_text: These maps date back to the first Imperial garrison stationed here. They speak of underground tunnels that run through the area and connect the bunkers. We can use these tunnels to our advantage!

tc_text: 那些防禦護網佔有相當大的優勢。如果我們可以佔領它的話，可以更有效地殲滅帝皇的敵人。
en_text: Those defense nests are of a considerable advantage. If we can seize command of them, we can gain the upper hand and vanquish the Emperor's foes far more effectively!

tc_text: 總算…石化蜥蜴級自走砲到達，強化我們的陣地!現在讓歐克蠻人看看真正的射擊火力!
en_text: Finally... the Basilisks have arrived to reinforce our position! Now we show those Orks the true meaning of firepower!

tc_text: 史泰恩將軍…機器主教說他們的設備上出現奇怪的主體，但是我們無法鎖定。
en_text: General Sturnn... the Tech-Priests have augured a xeno-presence on their equipment, but we cannot lock it down.

tc_text: 是歐克蠻人嗎?
不是…但是除此之外，我們無法解釋讀數的意義。那是別的東西。
en_text: No... but beyond that we cannot explain the readings. Something else is out there.

tc_text: 我們沒有時間使用優雅的複雜戰略。向前衝鋒，殲滅敵人。泰坦駕駛員不能死亡或被俘。
en_text: We cannot afford the niceties of complex tactics. Charge forward and decimate the enemy. The Titan's crew cannot fall or be captured.

tc_text: 我服侍眾星之妙樂，我追隨你那響亮清徹之音…但是…我有疑問。我們為什麼幫助帝國軍呢?
en_text: I serve the music of the spheres and I follow your clarion voice in all things... but... I have doubts. Why do we help the Imperials?

tc_text: 因為，我們需要他們的野心。我們需要他們的幫助。如果我們帶領帝國軍直到最終之戰，就可以強迫他們幫助我們對抗那不死的敵人。
en_text: Because, we need their war-lust. We need their help. If we guide the Imperials to the final battle, we force them to help us fight the immortal enemy.

tc_text: 我們可以生產噴火獸級裝甲車了
我們可以生產哨兵機器人了
我們可以建造工研總部了
en_text: We can now build the Mechanized Command

tc_text: 快點!歐克蠻人對爆炸做出反應了，現在是我們避開他們的機會。
en_text: With haste! The Orks are reacting to the explosion. Now is our chance to avoid them.

tc_text: 我們不能跟歐克蠻人硬碰硬作戰。如果我們摧毀歐克蠻人的發電機，爆炸會引起他們的注意，我們就可以無聲無息的通過。
en_text: We cannot face this Ork force head to head. Perhaps if we destroy those large Ork Power Generators, the explosion will draw their attention and allow us to pass unnoticed.

tc_text: 否則，這會令我們一切的努力化為烏有，也完全摧毀我們要在羅恩五號星上想要達成的目標！若是沒有操作員…我們就會死!
en_text: Otherwise it'll undo everything we've accomplished or hope to accomplish on Lorn V! Without the crew... we will die!

tc_text: 即使是他們，也不至於眼瞎到不理會它的威脅。但是，如果他們真的那麼無知…這個世界就完了。我們都完了。
en_text: Even they aren't blind enough to ignore its threat. But, if they are that ignorant... woe betide this world. Woe betide us all.

en_text: Between a Stone and an Axe

如果我們試圖經過這個歐克蠻人老大，他帶有獨特設計的科技，可以偵測到我們。消滅他。
en_text: This Ork Boss has technology of a unique design that will detect us if we attempt to relocate past him. Destroy him.

tc_text: 建造一個新的魍道關口
我們被發現了!趕快傳送一個吟骨者到指定的地點建造一個魍道關口，這樣我們可以更換基地的位置。
en_text: We have been discovered! Quickly teleport a Bonesinger to the specified location to build a Webway Gate that will allow us to relocate our base.

tc_text: 使用傳送能力
我們的基地必須立刻移動!使用轉移功能在我們的建築上，並且轉換到完工的魍道關口，以逃離歐克蠻人。
en_text: Our base must be moved now! Use the Relocate ability on our buildings and Relocate to the completed Webway Gate to escape the Orks.

tc_text: 建造另一個魍道關口
我們必須繼續遷移，因為新的據點最後還是會被發現。時間緊迫!傳送一個吟骨者到新的據點並且建造另一個魍道關口。
en_text: Our exodus must continue for our new location will be eventually compromised. Teleport a Bonesinger to the new location and build another Webway Gate. Time is of essence!

tc_text: 再次使用傳送能力
快點，再一次轉移我們的建築物，好讓靈魂之石便可以存活。我們可不想在旅遊了那麼遠之後，死在這些野蠻人手下!
en_text: Quickly, Relocate our buildings yet again so that the Soul Stone may survive. We did not travel so far only to fall at the hands of these brutes!

tc_text: 保護神靈族基地
儘管這種安排很令人厭惡，神靈族對我們可能還是有利用價值。因此他們的存活是優先考量。我們不能讓歐克蠻人奪走我們的勝利!
en_text: As distasteful as this arrangement is, the Eldar may yet prove useful to us. Ensuring their survival is therefore a priority. We will not let the Orks seize victory from us!

tc_text: 堅守戰線!
神靈族已經成功地傳送到我們的基地。援軍已在路上。支撐到援軍到達，就可以殲滅歐克蠻人。
en_text: The Eldar have successfully relocated inside our base. Reinforcements are on their way. Hold the line until the reinforcements arrive and the Orks are defeated.

tc_text: 破壞歐克蠻人基地
歐克蠻人佔據了一部分的城市，阻止神靈族到達他們的目的地。摧毀他們的基地。
en_text: The Orks have a foothold in this part of the city, barring the Eldar from their destination. Destroy their base.

tc_text: 消滅所有歐克蠻人軍隊
圍攻這個區域殘餘的歐克蠻人裝甲部隊。
en_text: Mop up the remaining Ork armoured forces in the local area.

tc_text: 前進前線
我們必須把魍道聯集及靈魂之石移到泰坦的地方，但是我們必須小心不要被數量上佔優勢的敵軍發現。
en_text: We must move the Webway Assembly and the Soul Stone to the Titan, but we must be wary of becoming spotted by a force that would easily overwhelm us.

tc_text: 順勢同盟
神靈族幫了我們，所以我們要還他們一個人情…至少在他們背叛我們之前。
en_text: The Eldar have helped us, so we will return the favor... at least until they betray us.

tc_text: 泰迪爾先知?怎麼了?你好像不舒服。
en_text: Farseer Taldeer? What is wrong? You appear ill.

tc_text: 只是一時衰弱。不死的敵人向我們接近，我擔心他們的現形會削弱我的力量。
en_text: It is naught but passing weakness. The immortal enemy draws near and I'm afraid their presence taxes my strength.

tc_text: 那麼他們會發現我們埋伏在這裡，準備殺死他們。魍道聯集及靈魂之石都安全了。
en_text: Then they will find us lying in wait, ready with their deaths. The Webway Assembly is safe, as is the Stone itself.

tc_text: 很好，如果沒有了靈魂之石，我們就無法擊敗那將要來的敵人。但是，還有工作要做。如果我們再次遷移，就會引起歐克蠻人的注意。
en_text: Good, for without the Stone, we cannot strike down what approaches. Still... there is work to be done. We cannot relocate again without attracting the attention of the area's Orks, however.

tc_text: 他們的領導人擁有有趣的科技。在他們毀滅我們之前，派遊俠去解決這個歐克蠻人的領導人。
en_text: Their leader possesses interesting technology. Deploy our Rangers to eliminate this Ork leader before they attack and destroy us all.

tc_text: 很多人犧牲生命，我們才得以逃脫，但是我們也因為這些犧牲而削弱不少戰力。現在帝國軍知道我們的存在。我們只有一件事可以做…
en_text: The skein of plots unravels. Many have sacrificed themselves so that we might escape, but we are weakened for that loss. Now the Imperials know we are here. There is only one thing we can do....

tc_text: 你好，史泰恩將軍。我是先知泰迪恩。我需要你的協助。
en_text: Greetings General Sturnn, I am Farseer Taldeer. I require your assistance.

tc_text: 神靈族!我就知道，除了混沌星際戰士及歐克蠻人之外，還有其他人。嗯…如果你知道我的名字，那你應該知道我要問什麼！
en_text: Eldar! I knew there was more to this than the Orks and Chaos Space Marines. Well then... if you know me by name, then you know my question!

tc_text: 是的。你為什麼要幫助我們?因為就這件事來說…我們不是你們的敵人。是我們在地獄門及歐克蠻人大砲下救了你們。而且如果我們被消滅了，那麼你永遠不知道你們真正面對的威脅。
en_text: Indeed. Why should you help us? Because in this matter... we are not your enemy. It was we who saved you against the Daemon Gate and the Ork Artillery. And if we perish, then you will never know the real threat facing all of you.

tc_text: 你是說那些奇怪的讀數？好吧。我們當面談談。在這同時…
en_text: The strange readings? Very well. We will meet in person. Meanwhile....

tc_text: 我也不相信神靈族。但是這樣我們就知道他們在哪裡。派出我們的軍隊包圍神靈族，並且保護他們，直到我們可以重新安置他們為止。
en_text: I don't trust the Eldar either, but this way, we know where they are. Move our men into position around the Eldar and protect them until we can relocate them.

tc_text: 謝謝你的協助。
你們神靈族總是試圖操縱我們為你們而戰。亥卡地第七行星，泰塔羅斯…還有這裡!這次到底是什麼目的?
en_text: You Eldar are always trying to manipulate us into fighting your battles. Hekate 7, Tartarus... here! What is it this time?

tc_text: 很好，但是記住，一旦我告訴你事實之後…我就無法收回這些話。
en_text: Very well, but remember that once I tell you the truth... I cannot untell it.

tc_text: 我信奉帝皇。他是惟一的真實。你講的任何事情在帝皇面前都不堪一擊。
en_text: I believe in the Emperor. His is the only truth. Anything you have to say falters in comparison to that.

tc_text: 很好…死亡的蝗蟲準備現身於這個世界，而且它們會出現在你們的泰坦倒下的地方，阻止你們回收它。
en_text: Very well... death's locusts are coming to this world, and they will appear where your primitive Titan has fallen, to stop you from claiming it.

tc_text: 他們叫做死靈族，而且它們會把這個星系的所有生命燒為灰燼。
en_text: They are called the Necrons, and they will lay waste to all life in this sector.

tc_text: 死靈族?我曾經聽說過。
en_text: Necrons? I've heard the word before.

tc_text: 上次它們覺醒時，是在萬古年前，它們摧毀了銀河系的生物，並且使我們差一點滅絕。但是這次我們擁有一項武器。
en_text: The last time they were awake, eons ago, they thinned the galaxy of its species and threatened us to the verge of extinction. We possess a weapon this time, however.

tc_text: 我們的靈魂之石可以摧毀它們。但是…我們晚點再講。歐克蠻人及墮落人類來了。
en_text: Our Soul Stone can destroy them. But... we will speak more on this later. The Orks and Fallen Humans approach.

tc_text: 我們走吧。
en_text: Let us be on our way.

tc_text: Opening NIS here.
快點!我們必須轉移我們的基地。指示吟骨者傳送至前方，並在我們的下一個目的地建造一個魍道關口。
en_text: Hurry! We must relocate our base. Instruct the Bonesinger to teleport forward and build a Webway Gate at our next destination.

tc_text: 地下水道不能抵擋連續的猛烈攻擊!所有的部隊…準備轉移!
en_text: The pipe cannot withstand this continued onslaught! All forces... prepare to relocate quickly!

tc_text: 我們必須打倒歐克蠻人頭目，而且要快! 他的盟友越來越逼進了。在他的部下發現我們之前，迅雷不及掩耳地殺死他吧。
en_text: We must fell the Ork Boss, and quickly! His allies grow nearer by the minute. Strike like the storm and kill the Ork before his minions detect us.

tc_text: 先知希望能殺死歐克蠻人的領導人…所以務必要完成任務。利用遊俠來完成任務…命令他們去殺死歐克蠻人領導人!
en_text: The Farseer wishes to slay the Ork leader... so shall it be done. Deploy the Rangers to the task... tell them to kill the Ork leader!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人發現了我們的位置，並且用人海戰術壓制我們!他們的數量比我們想像的還多!更嚴重的是，他們利用廢棄的下水道系統移動。
en_text: The Orks have discovered our location and are swarming us! There are far more in the area than we expected! What is worse, they are using the abandoned sewer systems to move around.

tc_text: 今天是悲慘的一天。歐克蠻人很快就會突破下水道到達我方。我們必須利用魍道關口離開，但是我們沒有時間。我們必須倚賴自己的技術來幫助我們度過難關。
en_text: This is a grim day. The Orks will soon break through the sewer pipes to reach us. We must use our gates to escape, but we haven't enough time. We will trust to our skill to see us through.

tc_text: 但願我們有夠高明的技術。
神靈族暫時在我們的保護之下，但是我們必須從歐克蠻人的手中拯救他們!盡全力保護他們，直到把他們的基地轉移到我們的領地中!
en_text: The Eldar are under our aegis for now, but we must save them from the Ork threat! Protect them at all costs until we can relocate their base inside our fortifications!

tc_text: 現在神靈族獲得我們的保護，歐克蠻人更加倍的攻擊我們。他們的攻擊很強勢，但是我們必須堅守直到援軍到來…或是戰死沙場。
en_text: Now that the Eldar are safe behind our walls, the Orks have redoubled their attacks against us. The assault is overwhelming, but we must hold out until reinforcements arrive... or die in the attempt.

tc_text: 援軍到了，並且打破歐克蠻人的先發優勢!
en_text: The reinforcements have arrived, and that has broken the Ork initiative!

tc_text: 狡滑的野獸，歐克蠻人發現了我們。沒關係。我們需要更多的時間，但是我們被發現是必然的。
en_text: Cunning beasts that they are, the Orks have detected us. No matter. We could have used more time, but our discovery was inevitable.

tc_text: 我們對付死靈族的唯一武器就是我們珍貴的靈魂之石。如果它失陷了或是被摧毀了…那麼所有的希望就都沒了，這個星系會變成另一個被遠古敵人攻佔的宇宙墳場。
en_text: Our only weapon against the Necrons is our precious Soul Stone. Were it to fall in battle, or be destroyed... then all hope is lost and this system becomes yet another grave marker in the Ancient Enemy's march across the Universe.

tc_text: 指揮官!為什麼我們要忍受這些…神靈族?我們為什麼要保護這些混蛋異星人而不把他們殺光--
en_text: Commissar! Why must we suffer these... Eldar? That we must protect xeno-scum instead of killing them all --

tc_text: 閉上你的嘴巴!照你的將軍的命令做，還是你想要引起我的注意？很好，我想你很聰明地選擇了安靜。
en_text: You are better served keeping your mouth shut! You do as ordered by your General, or are you found wanting my attention? ... Good. I'll take your silence as wisdom.

tc_text: 神靈族!你的基地就要被歐克蠻人佔據了。快下令撤退，撤走你的基地!
en_text: Eldar! Your base is being overwhelmed by the Orks. Sound the retreat and evacuate your base!

tc_text: 如果我撤退的話，就真的一切都完了。我無論如何都不能逃走!
en_text: I evacuate and everything is truly lost. I cannot flee, regardless the cost!

tc_text: 你這麼做讓我別無選擇，只能保持我的承諾。我們會留下來保護你…希望這樣做是值得的!
en_text: Then you leave me no choice but to honor my word. We will remain to protect you as I promised... though I hope the prize is worth the cost!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人的領導人正在檢閱他下賤的暴民軍隊，看起來似乎相當脆弱。也許我們用集中的閃電攻擊對付歐克蠻人的領袖，要比對他們的基地本身發動全面攻擊來得好。
en_text: The Ork leader is inspecting his rabble of a force and appears vulnerable. We might be better suited striking at the Ork head with a single lightning bolt than battering the base itself with a storm.

en_text: Escort the Titan Crew Convoy through the battlefield and see they reach the safety of the psychic shield entrance.

tc_text: 清除路線
我們將到達混沌軍隊的側翼。清除道路，讓護衛部隊到達帝國軍陣線。
en_text: We're approaching the forces of disorder from their flank. Clear the way for the convoy so that it may proceed towards the Imperial lines.

tc_text: 防衛戰線缺口
混沌軍團正試圖突破牆上的一道大裂縫。如果我們幫助防衛軍守住防線，或許可以讓護衛部隊穿越缺口，並且更快進入城牆內。
en_text: The forces of disorder are attempting to storm through a large gap in the wall. If we assist the Guardsmen in holding the line, we may be able to get the convoy through the gap and within the walls more quickly.

tc_text: 取得基地指揮權
防衛部隊的士氣已經潰散。接管基地指揮權並且開始重整防禦。
en_text: The defending regiment have let their discipline lapse. Take command of this base and start rallying the defenses.

tc_text: 佔領控制建築
佔領控制建築，以便進入防護罩
en_text: Gain access to the psychic shield gate by capturing the control building.

tc_text: 進行最後的防禦
護衛部隊即將到達目的地。不能讓它發生任何差錯。
en_text: The Convoy is in its final approach. Don't let anything happen to it.

tc_text: 保護護衛部隊到達城門
護衛部隊必須穿越危險的戰場，並且到達另一邊的防護罩大門。
en_text: The Convoy must traverse the dangerous battlefield and reach the psychic gate on the other side.

tc_text: 交換陣營
使用英雄圖示旁邊的玩家切換按鈕，以切換為帝國防衛軍或神靈族。
en_text: Use the Player Switch button next to your hero icon to alternate between the Imperial Guard and the Eldar armies.

tc_text: 使用呼叫護衛能力
利用將軍的能力來召喚護衛部隊到達他的位置，並帶領運輸部隊安全抵達防護罩大門。否則護衛部隊會自己尋找路線。
en_text: Use the General's ability to summon the convoy to his location to guide the transport safely to the Psychic Gate. Otherwise the convoy will find its own route.

tc_text: 打開城門
數道受保護的城門擋住我們前往防護罩的路線。如果我們可以打開城門，那護衛部隊會更方便移動。
en_text: Several security gates block our path to the psychic shield. The convoy will have an easier go of it if we gain access to these gates.

tc_text: 打開外城門
佔領任一邊的城門據點來打開城門。
en_text: Capture the point on either side of the gate structure to lower the gates.

tc_text: 打開中城門
佔領任一邊的城門據點來打開城門。
en_text: Capture the point on either side of the gate structure to lower the gates.

tc_text: 打開內城門
佔領任一邊的城門據點來打開城門。
en_text: Capture the point on either side of the gate structure to lower the gates.

tc_text: 拯救靈魂之石
將置有靈魂之石的魍道聯集移進防護罩入口的安全範圍內。
en_text: Relocate the Webway Assembly, which houses the sacred Soul Stone, within the safety of the psychic shield entrance.

tc_text: 佔領控制建築
轉移至防護罩內
現在可以安全地將魍道聯集移進城門區了。不惜任何代價來防禦最後的轉移程序！!
en_text: It is now safe to move the Webway Assembly into the gate area. Defend the final relocation at all costs!

tc_text: 重新安置於高地
這個高地是一個很好的戰略據點，可以讓我們將魍道聯集推進防護罩裡。清除該區域的敵軍，並將我們的建築物傳送到這裡。
en_text: This plateau would make an excellent staging point to advance our Webway Assembly towards the psychic gate. Clear out the area and transfer our buildings there.

tc_text: 破壞發電機
主要防護罩及其他的防禦設施使我們無法將魍道聯集移到這裡。我們必須先關閉它們的電源，才能繼續前進。摧毀為其防禦設施及防護罩提供電力的發電機。
en_text: The primitive psychic shield and the other defenses preventing us relocating the Webway Assembly past the shield must be disabled before we can proceed. Destroy the generators powering their defenses and amplifying their pathetic psychic powers.

tc_text: 重設戰略據點
我們應該繼續前進並接近防護罩。這個地點讓我們同時接近發電機及防護罩的入口。
en_text: We should continue to move closer to the psychic shield. This position puts us within close proximity to both the generators and the shield entrance.

tc_text: 搜索防護罩入口
人類的防護罩真是原始，以致於我們完全不了解。必須派一支神靈族的部隊到入口處，這樣我們才能用我們的心靈來探測它的極限。
en_text: The humans' pathetic psychic shield is so primitive it is a mystery to us. An Eldar unit must make it to the entrance so that we can probe its limitations with our minds.

tc_text: 完成探測尚需時間: %1TIME%
破壞發電機: %1NUM%/4
我從來沒有遇見過這麼頑固的種族。歐克蠻人是他們天性的犧牲者，但是這些人類卻是有意識的盲目及固執。他們到底是怎麼活下來的…
en_text: Never have I encountered such an obstinate species. The Orks are victims of their nature, but these humans are willfully persistent and blind. How they survived...

tc_text: …恐怕不能分享這個宇宙，只是一個笑話。但是我們可以確定當泰坦可以使用時，人類就會背叛我們。這就是為什麼我們必須先帶著靈魂之石到達泰坦之處的原因。
en_text: ...is a joke the universe shares with no one, I'm afraid. But we can trust the humans to turn against us when the Titan is operational. That is why we must reach the Titan first with the Soul Stone.

tc_text: 只有如此我們才能擊敗死靈族。
en_text: Only then can we hope to defeat the Necrons.

tc_text: 死靈族?而你相信神靈族?
en_text: Necrons? And you believe the Eldar?

tc_text: 他們的斷言對我沒有意義。我答應幫助他們，是為了監視他們，並且讓他們幫助我們消滅敵人。我一直相信他們一有機會就背叛我們。
en_text: Their assertions mean nothing to me. I agreed to help them to keep them within reach and to aid us in destroying the enemy. I fully expect them to betray us at first opportunity.

tc_text: 我們必須在神靈族到達泰坦之前，先讓操作員就位。帝國和神靈族之中只有一方能夠獲得勝利。這裡會選擇勝利者。
en_text: We must reach that Titan and get the crew in place before the Eldar do. Only one of us, Imperial or Eldar, will win the day. And the victor will be chosen here.

tc_text: 歐斯衛突擊部隊…所以神靈族開始對付我們了。我們必須先到達泰坦，也就是說不能讓神靈族殲滅泰坦駕駛員。我們必須不惜代價地保護他們。
en_text: An Ulthwe Strike Force... so the Eldar are making their move against us. We must reach the Titan first, and that means I cannot allow the Eldar to destroy the Titan crew. I must protect them at all costs.

tc_text: 所以帝國軍派出了超能戰士來對付我們。正如我所預料的一樣。讓這些狗去狂吠，跟著我們的腳蹤走…我不能讓他們摧毀魍道聯集。
en_text: So the Imperials are unleashing the Ultramarines against us. I expected as much. Let these hounds bay and snap at our heels... I will not let them destroy the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 把死靈族交給人類對付的風險太大了。我們必須先抵達泰坦。
en_text: There is too much at stake to leave the Necrons to the humans. We must reach the Titan first.

tc_text: 這是帝國守衛隊卡迪安第412師史泰恩將軍。只有笨蛋才會相信「敵人的朋友就是朋友」這種謬論。但是神靈族證明他們能夠幫助我的手下到達陣地…而且是用他們自己的生命為代價。
en_text: This is General Sturnn of the Cadian 412th Regiment, Imperial Guard. Only fools believe that the enemy of my enemy is my friend. Still, the Eldar proved useful enough to bring my men into position... admittedly at cost to their own lives.

tc_text: 在我講話的同時，他們正在外面被擊殺，我不能冒險去幫助他們。我不會用我的手下的生命來換取他們的生命。
en_text: They lay outside, being cut to the last as I speak. I cannot risk helping them. I will not trade the lives of my men for theirs.

tc_text: 今天你會失敗的，將軍!沒有我們的靈魂之石，戰役就會失敗。死靈族會掃蕩你們，並且從你的屍體裡吸取你的靈魂!如果沒有我們，你面臨的只有死亡。
en_text: You will fail this day, General! Without our Soul Stone, the battle will be lost. The Necrons will sweep over you and drink your life out from the hollow vessel of your corpse! Without us you face your doom.

tc_text: 神靈族，卡迪安第412師以前就面對過死亡。我們今天也會!並且死得光榮!
en_text: Eldar, the Cadian 412th have faced doom before. We bested it then, and we will best it today! Die well!

tc_text: 我聽到了天堂之樂，但這音樂並不協調。很奇怪，但我在這不和諧中感到安適。
en_text: I hear the song of the celestial heavens, and the music is cacophonous. It is strange, but I find comfort in its dissonance.

tc_text: 就是在這樣的時候，各種族發現自己的偉大之處…或是恢復他們卑微的出身。
en_text: It is in such moments when species find their greatness... or settle back into the muck that spawned them.

tc_text: 無論是輸是贏…與死靈族的戰鬥可以拖延他們的進攻，並讓其他種族有足夠的時間準備。
en_text: Win or lose... fighting the Necrons delays their advance long enough to allow others to prepare.

tc_text: 無論輸是贏…這場戰爭我已經贏了…我的勝利。現在由命運來決定我是否能夠慶祝這個事實。
en_text: Win or lose... this battle is already my victory... my triumph. It is now fate which decides whether I am there to celebrate that fact or not.

tc_text: 糾正宇宙的不和諧是我族的存在意義，即使這代表我族會自我毀滅。
en_text: Righting the discord of the universal opus is what's given my people purpose when, by all right, we as a race should have collapsed in upon ourselves.

tc_text: 對我自己而言，我的存在就是為了糾正這個不協調的瘋狂走音。
en_text: For myself, I have purpose if only to correct one particular stray note in a symphony run amuck.

tc_text: 雖然看起來可能並不起眼，但是每一場和死靈族的戰爭都是無價的勝利。
en_text: And though it may not seem like much, each singular battle with the Necrons is already an invaluable victory.

tc_text: 命運在考驗我，但我會戰勝它。這些門已經毀壞。我們可以修理它們或是把它們炸開。
en_text: The fates test me, but I will prevail. The doors are damaged. Either we repair them or blast them open.

tc_text: 我們發現了廢棄的步兵總部。我們可以利用它來戰鬥。
en_text: We've discovered abandoned Infantry Command structures that we can put to good use! These will help us in our fight.

tc_text: 橋樑被破壞了!我們必須修理它或是讓泰坦駕駛員繞遠路…我們的時間不多!
en_text: The bridges are damaged! We must either repair them or travel the long way around with the Titan's crew in tow... and time is not in our favor!

tc_text: 太幸運了!我們可以利用這些廢棄的防衛軍建築來對付敵人。
en_text: Good fortune! These abandoned Guard buildings will suit us well in our fight against the enemy.

tc_text: 我們無法穿透護盾進行傳送，飛行或是空間跳躍。我們必須從它惟一的大門經過。這表示必須在大門輸入機械靈魂的代號。
en_text: We cannot teleport, fly or warp through the shield. We'll have to gain entry through its only gate. That means inputting the Machine Spirit's code at the gate itself.

tc_text: 我們已經到達入口，但是如果我們要到達泰坦必須先解開入口的鎖。
en_text: We've reached the entrance, but we must first unlock it if we hope to reach the Titan!

tc_text: 大門已解鎖!快點進去!
en_text: The gate is unlocked! Inside, quickly!

tc_text: 我們不能再浪費時間。從帝皇…我們的方向很清楚。控制這棟建築，我們就能控制入口!
en_text: There is little time to waste. By the Emperor... our course is clear. Control the building and we control the entrance!

tc_text: 我很羞愧…我竟然不信任那些犧牲他們生命來幫助我們的精神能力者。他們是帝皇的真正殉道者及帝國的英雄。
en_text: I am shamed... I distrusted the very Psykers who now sacrifice their lives for us. They are true martyrs of the Emperor and heroes of the Imperium.

tc_text: 魍道聯集受到破壞!立刻保護它，否則一切都完了!
en_text: The Webway Assembly is damaged! Protect it immediately or all is lost!

tc_text: 魍道聯集已經受到嚴重的破壞!它不能再受到攻擊了!不惜任何代價保護它!
en_text: The Webway Assembly has been critically damaged. It cannot sustain more punishment! Protect it at all costs!

tc_text: 不…不能如此。魍道聯集被摧毀了。我們還沒有面對死靈族就失敗了…
en_text: No... this cannot be. The Webway Assembly has been destroyed. We have lost before we could even face the Necrons...

tc_text: 護衛部隊遭到攻擊!重新佈署部隊來保護泰坦駕駛員!
en_text: The convoy is under attack! Redeploy the men to protect the Titan's crew!

tc_text: 護衛部隊遭到很嚴重的傷害!支援在哪裡,可惡!
en_text: The convoy is badly damaged! Where is that support, damn it!

tc_text: 超能戰士已在戰鬥中全部英勇陣亡。所有部隊…用你的生命來保護泰坦駕駛員!如果需要的話，用你的身體來擋!
en_text: The Ultramarines have fallen in valiant combat. All units... protect the Titan's crew with your lives! Shield it with your bodies if you must!

tc_text: 泰坦駕駛員已死…我們有負於帝皇。戰役已輸。所有人…戰鬥到最後一刻。我很榮幸帶領你們作戰。
en_text: The Titan's crew is dead... we failed the Emperor. The battle is lost. Every man... fight unto your last breath. It was an honor leading you.

tc_text: 想想看,結果竟是如此。沒有任何裝甲，槍砲可以阻止死靈族大軍。不…這個可以拯救億萬眾生的力量來自於這個不起眼的古物。
en_text: To think that it comes to this. That no ship, no gun alone could ever turn back the Necron tide. No... it rests within the power of this humble artifact to save millions.

tc_text: 靈魂之石不能被摧毀，因為不只是羅恩五號星的命運…數個星系的生命都有賴於它。
en_text: The Soul Stone must not be destroyed, for more than the fate of Lorn V... life across several star systems hangs in the balance.

tc_text: 魍道聯集必須移進那個原始的防護罩裡。
en_text: The Webway Assembly must be relocated to within that primitive Psychic Defensive Shield.

tc_text: 這個陣地是我們第一次移防的理想位置。它很封閉，不怕地面攻擊。
en_text: This position is the most ideal location for our first relocation. It is secluded and secure from ground assault.

tc_text: 首先我們必須消滅那些防衛的人類，然後再轉移魍道聯集。
en_text: First we must eliminate the pathetic humans defending it, then we will move the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 我們必須前往防護罩大門!
en_text: We must make our way to the Psychic Gate!

tc_text: 我們必須控制防護罩大門的防衛系統，才能進去。
en_text: In order to enter the Psychic Gate we must first take control of its defenses.

tc_text: 佔領控制建築，他們的原始科技就會落入我們的控制。
en_text: Capture the control building, and their primitive technology will be under our control.

tc_text: 大門是我們的…快點…將魍道聯集移到防護罩大門裡。
en_text: The gate is ours... with haste, relocate the Webway Assembly inside the Psychic Gate.

tc_text: 人類的護衛部隊接近防護罩大門。
en_text: The human convoy approaches the Psychic Gate.

tc_text: 人類已經可以進入防護罩大門，我們必須快點，不然就失敗了!
en_text: The humans have gained access to the Psychic Gate, we must hurry lest we fail!

tc_text: 人類的護衛部隊已經被殲滅了…我們可以利用這個優勢…
en_text: The human convoy has been destroyed... we can use that to our advantage...

tc_text: 護衛部隊又前進了，快點，不要無所事事!
en_text: The convoy is once more in motion, swiftly now, do not rest idly!

tc_text: 護衛部隊繼續逼近防護罩大門，我們不能讓他們控制它…
en_text: The convoy is continuing to close on the Psychic Gate, we cannot allow them to control it...

tc_text: 護衛部隊的狀況看起來很差，今天優勢在我們這邊。
en_text: The convoy appears in critical condition, favor falls upon us this day.

tc_text: 愚笨的人類!我們的力量超乎你們的想像，你們絕對無法獲得勝利!
en_text: Foolish humans! Our power is beyond your imagining, victory will never be yours!

tc_text: 這座防護罩及大門是混沌軍團及泰坦支配者之間僅有的建築。
en_text: This Psychic Shield and its Gate are all that stand between the forces of Chaos and the Titan: Dominatus.

tc_text: 有許多人為了保護它而死，會有更多人在今天因此而亡…這是帝皇的旨意。
en_text: Many of my men have fallen in its defense, and many more will on this day... such is the will of the Emperor.

tc_text: 我們的任務，唯一的任務，就是確保泰坦駕駛員毫髮無傷地到達泰坦。我們必須讓他們的掠奪者坦克安全到達防護罩大門。
en_text: Our duty, our only duty, is to ensure the Titan Crew reaches the Titan unharmed. We must get their Land Raider Transport safely through the Psychic Gates.

tc_text: 弟兄們!現在是你們的關鍵時刻，你們生存的意義!帝皇需要你，我需要你。不惜代價保護這輛運輸車!
en_text: Men! Now is the hour of your calling, this is the reason you are alive! The Emperor needs you, I need you. Defend this Transport at all costs!

tc_text: 立刻命令一個機械主教來修理這輛運輸車!
en_text: Order one of our Tech-Priests to repair that Transport now!

tc_text: 如果我們失去那輛運輸車，沒有一個人可以存活。
en_text: If we lose that Transport, none of us will survive this day.

tc_text: 如果我們為運輸車開出一條道路，就可以從側翼攻擊擋住去路的混沌軍團。
en_text: If we clear a path for the Transport we could flank these Chaos forces in our way.

tc_text: 為運輸車開出一條通路!
en_text: Clear that path and get the Transport on its way!

tc_text: 混沌軍團已經衝破那道防線了!
en_text: The Chaos have broken through that defensive line!

tc_text: 如果我們攻破他們的陣地，強迫他們撤退，就可以讓運輸機毫髮無傷地通過。
en_text: If we bolster their position and force them back we can get the Transport through unscathed.

tc_text: 這棟建築已經被廢棄…
我現在掌握指揮權…有問題?問這把槍吧…
en_text: I'm taking command here... questions? Ask the gun...

tc_text: 這些大門由這些戰略據點控制；佔領它們，我們就可以降下城門。
en_text: These gates are controlled by these Strategic Points, capture them, and we can lower the gates.

tc_text: 這些大門由這些控制建築控制。叫機器主教來完成建造工作，就可以令城門恢復動力，得以降下城門。
en_text: The gates are controlled by these Control Buildings. Get the Tech-Priests to complete construction, and we will return power to the gates allowing us to lower them.

tc_text: 城門已經降下!快點，讓運輸車通過。
en_text: The gate is down! Quick, get the Transport through.

cut
cut
你,過來!我給你個命令。
en_text: You there! Get over here, I've got orders for you.

tc_text: 駕駛員!你從現在開始聽從我的命令!
en_text: Driver! You're under my command now!

tc_text: 我指揮這個建築…
en_text: I'm taking command of this Structure...

tc_text: 沒錯，神靈族已經壓制我們太久了…該教他們什麼叫做帝國軍淨化。
en_text: That's it, the Eldar have been a knife in my gut for too long... time to teach them the meaning of Imperial Cleansing.

tc_text: 什麼?!神靈族太靠近防護罩大門。加強防禦，弟兄們!我們不能讓他們進去!
en_text: What?! The Eldar are too close to the Psychic Gate. Bolster the defense, men! We cannot let them through!

tc_text: 護衛部隊不能進入防護罩大門，除非我們控制那棟控制建築。
en_text: The Convoy can't get access to the Psychic Gate unless we command the Control Building.

tc_text: 佔領那棟控制建築!
防護罩大門在我的控制之下!現在…運輸車…把它移進大門內!
en_text: The Psychic Gate is under my control! Now... the Transport... get it inside that GATE!

tc_text: 好，這裡由我指揮，現在讓大門打開!
en_text: Alright, I'm giving the orders around here, now get those gates OPEN!

tc_text: 哈，神靈族被殲滅了…
en_text: HA! The Eldar have been wiped out...

tc_text: 很好，給我一點時間來打開這個門。
en_text: Alright, give me a moment and I'll get these doors open.

tc_text: 快點!在他們攻破前進去!
en_text: Hurry! Get inside before they break through!

tc_text: 我很抱歉，我的命令很清楚…不可以讓這些門打開。
en_text: I'm sorry, my orders are pretty clear... no way are these doors getting opened.

tc_text: 指揮部說那樣做違反同盟的條件。離開，否則我會射擊你們!
en_text: Command says that's against the terms of the alliance. Leave or I'll be forced to fire on you!

tc_text: 同盟破裂!開火!
警告!未經授權不可進入!終結程序開始…
en_text: Warning! Unauthorized access not permitted! Termination initiated...

tc_text: 警告!緊急應變反應已被關閉…
en_text: Warning! Emergency counter measures have been disabled...

tc_text: 護衛部隊無法回頭。
en_text: The convoy is unable to turn around.

tc_text: 很好，我們就採用這條上好的途徑。
en_text: Very well, we will make use of this superior path.

tc_text: 弟兄們!我們必須為帝皇的榮耀，名譽而戰!無論是一起或單獨，我們不會退縮!
en_text: Brothers! We must fight for His Glory, for His Name! Together or alone, we will never falter!

tc_text: 我們的勝利之道將是一條佈滿血與屍體的道路!
en_text: Our road to victory will be a path of blood and corpses!

tc_text: 我們感謝你的幫助。
en_text: We are grateful for your assistance.

tc_text: 運輸車的機械靈魂需要關照。它需要機器主教援助才能前進。
en_text: The Transport's Machine Spirits are in need of attention. It cannot proceed until it receives the ministrations of the Tech-Priests.

tc_text: 運輸車遭到嚴重的攻擊。殲滅這些混沌混蛋。
en_text: The Transport is under heavy assault. Cleanse this Chaos Scum.

tc_text: 運輸車遭到嚴重的傷害，我們必須堅守這個陣地，以便評估現況。
en_text: The Transport has sustained severe damage, we must hold this position while we assess the situation.

tc_text: 我們的弟兄們已在對帝皇效忠的責任中陣亡，希望你們也和他們一樣!
en_text: Our Brothers have fallen in the duty of the Emperor, pray your fate is the same!

tc_text: 我不能再讓護衛部隊停留不動。我們必須向前進。
en_text: I cannot permit the convoy to stand still any longer. We must press on.

tc_text: 我們目前的路徑已經不安全…我們必須回到之前的路徑。
en_text: Our present course is no longer clear... We shall return to the prescribed route.

我們需要機器主教在泰坦的關鍵位置上建造6個電漿發電機。完工之後，我們就可以使用泰坦支配者的重型武器，敵人將會嘗到帝皇的神威再現!
en_text: We need our Techpriest Enginseers to construct six Thermo Plasma Generators at key locations on the Titan. Once these are complete we will have access to the Titan Dominatus’ heavy weapons and our enemies will thereafter taste our Emperor’s wrath incarnate!

tc_text: 擊敗死靈族
我們的傳統武器似乎對死靈族浮石巨塔不是很有效。只要開啟泰坦支配者的重武器，我們就可以有效地擊敗這些邪惡的產物…
en_text: Our conventional weapons do not seem to be very effective against the Necron Monoliths. Once activated, the Titan Dominatus’ heavy weapons may prove to be the most effective means at our disposal to dispatch these vile creatures….

tc_text: 修理戰神研發總部
派遣一個遠征部隊去防護與修理被隔離在敵後的設施，好讓前來此處的毀滅之劍重裝戰車能夠順利抵達。擁有毀滅之劍重裝戰車一定可以讓我們展現帝皇審判的正義憤怒。
en_text: Send an expeditionary force to reinforce and repair the facility that’s cut off behind enemy lines, so that the Baneblade that is enroute to us properly arrives. Having a Baneblade will definitely make it easier for us to mete out the Emperor’s justice with righteous fury.

tc_text: 防禦基地
這個野戰司令部必須不惜任何代價加以保護!沒有了它，我們就無法協調對泰坦的防禦。當我們死去時，但願帝皇保護我們的靈魂。
en_text: The Field Command must be protected at all costs! Without it, we will not be able to coordinate our defense of the Titan. May the Emperor protect our souls should it fall.

tc_text: 保護發電機
如果不花時間保護好我們的電漿發電機，它們就會曝露出來，而且不堪一擊。建造防衛系統並命令部隊前去保護電漿發電機，確使它不被摧毀。
en_text: Our Thermo Plasma Generators will be exposed and extremely vulnerable to our enemies if we do not take the time to ensure their safety. Construct defenses and order troops to the sites to ensure the Thermo Plasma Generators are not destroyed.

tc_text: 泰坦!
泰坦支配者將屬於我們!泰坦駕駛員已經到達定點，現在只需要保護他們並傳送電力給系統。
en_text: The Titan Dominatus will be ours! The Titan Crew is in place. All that remains is to bring power to the systems and protect it at all costs.

tc_text: 雖然地球黃金王座在一顆距離我們極為遙遠的星球軌道上，今天帝皇之手仍然鼓勵著我們。
en_text: Although the Golden Throne of Terra orbits a distant star, far from here, the Emperor's hand is on your shoulders today.

tc_text: 你們英勇的戰鬥及忠誠表現已經無愧於帝國防衛軍之名。
en_text: You have fought and displayed bravery and loyalty far and above your calling as Guardsmen.

tc_text: 你們對付過野蠻的歐克蠻人:"吼~~~~~!"而且還與恐怖的亞空間混沌星際戰士戰鬥。很榮幸能夠領導你們戰鬥。
en_text: You have faced the full brunt of an Ork WAAAGH! as well as stared down the horrors of the Warp in the fallen Space Marines. And in that, I am honored to have led you.

tc_text: 但是我們仍有未完的任務。仍有工作要做。泰坦是我們的，但是它的機械靈魂受傷了。
en_text: Our task remains, however. There is still work to be done. The Titan is ours, but its Machine Spirit is injured.

tc_text: 泰坦駕駛員已經就位，我們必須保護泰坦，讓他們有時間啟動它的武器。我們需要能源來啟動武器系統。
en_text: The Titan Crew is in place, leaving us to defend the Titan while the crew brings its armaments online. For that, we need energy to power the weapon systems.

tc_text: 現在，去吧，戰爭還沒結束。
en_text: Now, go... the fight is far from over.

tc_text: 將軍!泰坦的雷達可以運作了，但是他們報告說有不協調的訊號及不尋常的異星能量。
en_text: General! The Titan's sensors are functioning, but they're reporting anomalous signals and unusual xeno-energy readings.

tc_text: 長官!!!是…死靈族!!
什麼?!所以神靈族說的是真的…
en_text: What?! So the Eldar was telling the truth...

tc_text: 召集軍隊，如果我們要阻擋這些冷血的死靈族的話，我們需要所有的兵力。
en_text: Rally the troops. If we're to hold off these vile, heartless Necrons, we will need every man.

tc_text: 將軍!泰坦的武器連上線了!
en_text: General! The Titan's weapons are online!

tc_text: 總算!現在我們可以給死靈族看看地球的力量!泰坦武器操作員…對那些死靈族的浮石巨塔開火!所有的防衛軍…擊退死靈族!讓它們嘗嘗地獄的滋味!
en_text: Finally! Now we show these Necrons the might of Terra! Titan gunnery crew... fire on those Monoliths and bring them down! All Guardsmen units... drive the Necrons back! Give them hell!

tc_text: 帝皇與我們同在…
泰坦的撤離小組已經與援軍一起降落。如果我是個好懷疑的人，我會說他們真會選擇時機。
en_text: The Titan's excavation crew is landing along with reinforcements. If I were a suspicious man, I'd call their timing too good.

tc_text: 我告訴過他們，等到我們戰勝死靈族再說。如果泰坦的武器不能運作，沒有必要讓更多人陷入屠殺之中。
en_text: I told them to hold off until we bested the Necrons. There was no reason to lead more into the slaughter without the Titan's weapons operational.

tc_text: 是的。今天是光榮的一天，將軍。你的手下是我所見過最優秀的帝國防衛軍。
en_text: Indeed. It's a day to be proud, General. Your men performed better than any Guardsmen unit I've encountered.

tc_text: 謝謝你，但是我們的任務還沒結束。羅恩五號星還是有很多歐克蠻人反抗我們，而且我們必須保護修理員，直到泰坦修復完畢。
en_text: Thank you, but our work is not yet done. There are still pockets of Ork resistance across Lorn V, and we must protect the repair crews while they nurse the Titan back to health.

tc_text: 盡管如此…與你同戰令我感到十分光榮。除了我的星際戰士之外…我找不到更優秀的部隊。
en_text: Still... it was an honor to fight alongside you. Barring my Space Marines... I could not have asked for better.

tc_text: 我們各有不同的任務。帝皇要我們做的就是站在前線並且戰死。
en_text: To each of us falls a task. And all the Emperor requires of us Guardsmen is that we stand the line and we die fighting.

tc_text: 那是我們最擅長的事。
en_text: It is what we do best.

tc_text: 我們將戰到最後一兵一卒。
如果要為泰坦提供能源，我們必須建造熱融電漿發電機。
en_text: We must build Thermo Plasma Generators if we hope to power the Titan.

tc_text: 很好!已經有一個熱融電漿發電機上線，供給泰坦能量。
en_text: A Thermo Plasma Generator is on-line and powering the Titan. Good work!

tc_text: 能量下降了!有一個熱融電漿發電機遭到摧毀!
en_text: Power is dropping! One of the Thermo Plasma Generators has been destroyed!

tc_text: 那座戰神研發總部受到嚴重攻擊。用你的生命保護它!如果我們可以修復它，就可以徵召毀滅之劍重裝戰車，所有的敵軍都會在它的神威之前顫抖!
en_text: That Mars Pattern Command facility is under heavy assault. Defend it, protect it with your lives! If we can repair it we can requisition a Baneblade, and all will tremble at its wrath!!

tc_text: 帝皇只要求你一件事…守住戰線!
en_text: Your Emperor asks but one task of you... hold the line!

tc_text: 奮勇作戰，今天的榮耀就屬於你!
en_text: Stand and fight, and the day is yours!

tc_text: 你們是帝國防衛軍…不能被擊敗…毫無畏懼…毫無遲疑!!
en_text: You are the Imperial Guard... no defeat... no fear... no hesitation!

tc_text: 給這些異星人看看地球的真正力量!
en_text: Show these xenos the true might of Terra!

tc_text: 我們是帝國防衛軍，而且我們是正規軍！
en_text: We are Guardsmen and we are Legion!

tc_text: 持續火力，並且突破他們的防線!
en_text: Maintain fire and cut a swathe through their ranks!

tc_text: 給他們看看我們對廢物有什麼看法！
en_text: Show them what we think of scum!

tc_text: 為了帝國!為了帝皇!
en_text: For the Imperium! For the Emperor!

tc_text: 只有死亡，義務才結束!
en_text: Only in death does duty end!

tc_text: 戰鬥，帝皇就會與你一同戰鬥!
en_text: Fight and the Emperor fights with you!

tc_text: 混沌軍團與歐克蠻人隨時都會到這裡，我們的防線無法抵擋。在靠近發電機的地方建立一個強大一點的防禦陣地…它們不能被摧毀。
en_text: The Chaos legion and the Orks will be here any minute, and our defenses won't hold. Establish a stronger perimeter near those Generator sites... they have to survive.

tc_text: 做得好!摧毀一座死靈族浮石巨塔了!
en_text: Well done! So falls a monolith!

tc_text: 摧毀另一座浮石巨塔了!
繼續加油，士兵們，又有一座死靈族浮石巨塔摧毀了!
en_text: Keep the pace, men, another Monolith brought to ruin!

tc_text: 這場爆炸真龐大!
感謝帝皇，你終於來了。被夾在歐克蠻人及混沌之間，我們可能早已全滅…但是我們會奮戰至死!
en_text: Thank the Emperor for your arrival. Between the Orks and the Fallen Space Marines, we would have died... but we would have died standing!

tc_text: 機器主教做得好!!戰神研發總部已經完全修復完畢。毀滅之劍重裝戰車已經上路。
en_text: The Techpriests have done well! Mars Pattern Command facility is fully repaired. The Baneblade is on its way.

死靈族來了。他們是所有生命的大敵。現在只有我們可以把他們趕回去。
en_text: The Necrons are coming. They are the arch-enemy of all life. It is up to us to send them back from where they came.

tc_text: 使用靈魂之石
選擇魍道聯集，使用靈魂之石瞄準並且破壞死靈族浮石巨塔。
en_text: Select the Webway Assembly and use the Soul Stone to target and destroy the Monolith.

tc_text: 埋葬泰坦
我們必須派遣吟骨者前往還能使用的泰坦武器系統。我們在那裡可以讓原始的機械靈魂受到我們的控制。
en_text: We must send our Bonesingers out to the Titan’s available weapon systems. There we will sway the primitive machine spirit to do our bidding.

tc_text: 剩餘部份: %1NUM%
尋找史泰恩將軍
派遣先知去尋找使泰恩將軍，並且說服他相信死靈族所代表的危險。
en_text: Send the Farseer out to find General Sturnn and convince him of the danger presented by the Necrons.

tc_text: 魍道聯集必須存活。
為了神靈族的榮耀及名譽，我們必須保護放在魍道聯集裡的靈魂之石。如果我們失去了它，所有的希望都沒了。
en_text: It is for the honor and glory of all Eldar that we must protect our Soul Stone housed in the Webway Assembly. If we lose this, all hope is lost.

tc_text: 指揮帝國防衛軍
利用人類盲目服從命令的特性。使用先知的新能力命令帝國防衛軍攻擊你選擇的位置
en_text: Use the weak humans penchant for following orders blindly to your advantage. Use the Farseers new ability to command the Guard to attack locations of your choosing.

tc_text: 指揮帝國防衛軍
這個能力可以命令帝國防衛軍前往集合點，並且攻擊在路途中遭遇的任何東西。
en_text: This ability drops a flare that the Imperial Guard will rally to and attack anything in their path.

tc_text: 在地圖上點選一個位置，以建立集合點
en_text: Click a location on the map to create a rally point

tc_text: 召喚戰神分身
我們必須召喚戰神分身。我們需要它強大的影響力來爭取勝利。
en_text: We must call forth the Avatar of Khaine. We shall need its powerful influence to win this day.

tc_text: 泰坦部位 1破壞: %1TIME%
泰坦部位 2破壞: %1TIME%
泰坦部位 3破壞: %1TIME%
