我光明的同胞們…一項艱巨的任務臨到我們身上。死靈族，我們祖先的大敵，我們友族的毀滅者，又回到這個世界。
en_text: My brothers and sisters of light and song... a terrible task falls to us. The Necrons, our ancestor-foes and destroyer of our sister species, have returned.

tc_text: 我們不能再度容忍這些敵人。消滅它們是一個重要的任務，我們絕不允許這個無比的邪惡意志存在。死靈族一定要為他們的行動付出代價。
en_text: We cannot abide this travesty again. To obliterate the soul itself is an act of utter, unprecedented malice that we cannot allow. The Necrons must pay for their actions.

tc_text: 今天…他們回答我們了。
先知泰爾達…看見死靈族浮石巨塔了。
好吧。每個戰役都是戰爭。我們不能只獲得一部份的勝利，因死靈族會一再地回來。
en_text: So it is. Every battle must be a war unto itself. There can be no partial triumphs, for the Necrons will return again and again.

tc_text: 準備好。今天我們要戰鬥。
即使到了這個世紀，仍有一些創造世界因為死靈族而倒在無聲的廢墟裡，無數的兄弟姊妹像微弱的蠟燭般殘存。
en_text: Even into this millennium, some Craftworlds lie in silent ruin because of them, millions of brothers and sisters guttered out like weak candles.

tc_text: 死靈族來了。準備好你的武裝，死靈族來了!
en_text: The Necrons have arrived. Steel yourselves, the Necrons are here!

tc_text: 更多的戰鬥!更多的殘殺!這不是最好的吼~~~~~嗎?
en_text: More fightin'! More killin'! Ain't dis the best WAAAGH! evvur!

tc_text: 祭祀血神之血!祭祀骸骨王座之骨!在戰場上殺光敵人!
en_text: Blood for the Blood God! Skulls for the skull throne! Gorge yourselves on battle!

tc_text: 眾神們…引導我的靈魂到無限母體裡。這是先知泰爾達，我最後一次祈禱。請給我力量!
en_text: By the Gods... guard my soul in the Infinity Matrix. This is Farseer Taldeer, praying for what I fear is the last time. Give me strength!

tc_text: 先知…我們真的贏了嗎?
我向你保證，這只是短暫的勝利。泰坦已經發揮它的作用，但是過度使用會令它疲乏。如果它爆炸的話，我們將會受到波及!
en_text: A momentary victory, I assure you. The Titan has served its purpose, but the strain ruptures it. If it explodes, it will claim us in her fury!

tc_text: 我們的人民等候你的命令，先知…您要我們做什麼?
en_text: Our people await your instruction, Farseer... what would you have us do?

tc_text: 死靈族來到這裡，希望可以吸取靈魂，但是他們卻被擊敗了。我們可以離開了。走吧…經由傳送點!傳令下去，我們要離開了，我們在這世界的任務完成了。
en_text: The Necrons came, expecting to find souls for the claiming, and instead, found defeat. We can leave now. Go... through the Portals! Sound the evacuation! We are finished with this world.

tc_text: 我們今天贏了，但是並不代表完全的勝利。死靈族會繼續他們的侵略，直到宇宙的邊際…但他們會發現我們在等待他們。他們會知道我們並不害怕…
en_text: We have won the day, but the day is not won on battles alone. The Necrons will continue their march, and at every turn of every crooked corner of this universe... they will find us lying in wait. And they will find us unafraid....

tc_text: 小心，死靈族已經接近…
en_text: Beware, for the Necrons' arrival is imminent...

tc_text: 隨人類去吧…不用擔心他們。
en_text: Leave the humans be... they are not our concern.

tc_text: 讓他們當誘餌，會比把他們當成目標好得多。
en_text: They may serve better as needed distraction than as targets.

tc_text: 我的戰士們，要有強壯之心!死靈族已到來!
en_text: Be strong of heart my warriors! The Necrons have arrived!

tc_text: 儘管他們的外表如此，但是死靈族並不慢…他們很有條理的!
en_text: Despite appearances, the Necrons aren't slow... they're methodical!

tc_text: 就是這個時刻，該使用靈魂之石了!
en_text: The moment is at hand... it is time to use the power of the Soul Stone!

tc_text: 選擇魍道聯集，並且使用靈魂之石來摧毀死靈族浮石巨塔!
en_text: Select the Webway Assembly and use the Soul Stone to obliterate the Monolith!

tc_text: 今天我們贏了!消滅最後一批死靈族戰士…我們終於可以回家了!
en_text: The day is won! Eliminate the last of the Necron Warriors... we can finally return home to our families!

tc_text: 不!出現更多死靈族浮石巨塔!戰爭才剛開始!
en_text: NO! More Monoliths have arrived! The battle has only begun!

tc_text: 靈魂之石的力量耗盡了…它無法再進行攻擊。我們要毀滅了…
en_text: The Soul Stone is depleted... it isn't ready for another attack! Our doom is upon us!

tc_text: 我們只有一個機會取得勝利。那個原始泰坦的力量還是很強大。
en_text: We have but one chance left to win this day. The primitive Titan is still powerful.

tc_text: 吟骨者可以吸取藏在它的武器裡的力量給我們使用。
en_text: The Bonesingers can ensnare the power contained within its archaic weapons and use it to our advantage.

tc_text: 吟骨者!你們必須抵達泰坦的一處武器位置，開始吸取它的力量。
en_text: Bonesingers! You must each reach one of the Titan's weapons to begin draining it of its power.

tc_text: 已經開始進行了，但是要成功的話，我們必須一次專注於一處泰坦部位。
en_text: The process has begun, but to succeed, we must devote our energies to one Titan piece at a time.

tc_text: 那個泰坦部位是我們的了!
使用泰坦的武器摧毀我們的敵人，擊退死靈族！
en_text: Direct the Titan's weapon against our foe and drive the Necrons back!

tc_text: 泰坦的武器正在幫助靈魂之石恢復它的力量!
en_text: The Titan weapon is helping the Soul Stone regenerate its power!

tc_text: 佔領的泰坦武器越多，靈魂之石就可以更快再度射擊!
en_text: The more of the Titan weapons we capture, the sooner the Soul Stone can fire again!

tc_text: 看來命運要我們做更大的事。現在我們也得和混沌軍團作戰。
en_text: It seems fate would ask greater things of us still. We must now fight the arriving armies of disorder as well.

tc_text: 無論如何，我們都不能失去靈魂之石!
en_text: We cannot lose the Soul Stone under any circumstance!

tc_text: 如果失去了魍道聯集，那我們就輸了!
en_text: If the Webway Assembly is lost, then so are we!

tc_text: 失去了靈魂之石，我們的希望也跟著消失了。現在只能繼續作戰，直到死亡。
en_text: The Soul Stone is lost, and with it our hopes. There is naught to do but kill until death receives us in kind.

tc_text: 死靈族浮石巨塔撤軍了!這比戰敗更慘，因為它們很快就會再來攻擊我們。
en_text: The Monolith phased! This is worse than defeat, for it will return soon to plague us again.

tc_text: 我們不能讓死靈族浮石巨塔逃走。在它撤軍時摧毀它!
en_text: We cannot allow the Monolith to escape. Destroy it before it phases away!

tc_text: 在致命一擊到達前，以所有的武器目瞄準它，以免它逃走!
en_text: Target everything we have against it lest it phases away before the killing blow arrives!

tc_text: 已經破壞了一個死靈族浮石巨塔…其他的浮石巨塔也會很快摧毀!
en_text: A Monolith has fallen... soon to be followed by others!

tc_text: 先知!魍道聯集已經耗盡能源。沒有能源，我們無法摧毀更多的死靈族浮石巨塔。
en_text: Farseer! The Webway Assembly is depleted of energy. Without its power, we cannot destroy any more Monoliths.

tc_text: 那我們要再次受惠於帝國防衛軍!吸光泰坦的能源，直到它剩下空殼為止!
en_text: Then we are indebted to the Imperials once again! Entomb the Titan's pieces and drain it until it is naught but a dried husk!

tc_text: 計畫進行得很順利!我們吸取了一處泰坦部位的能源。
en_text: The plan is working! We've entombed one of the Titan's pieces and are draining it of its energy.

tc_text: 有一塊泰坦部位受到攻擊!不惜代價地保護它!
en_text: One of the Titan pieces is under attack! Protect it at all costs!

tc_text: 死靈族…吸取靈魂的邪神崇拜者。我很悲傷，他們在我活著的時候再度復活。但是能有機會阻止我祖先的敵人，深感不配。
en_text: The Necrons... caretakers of corrupt Gods who feed upon souls. I am saddened that they chose my lifetime to reawaken, but I am humbled by the opportunity to stop the enemy of my ancestors.

tc_text: 我只祈禱我有力量追蹤祖先的腳步，把死靈族趕回他們的黑暗之中。
en_text: I only pray that I am worthy of following their steps, and driving the Necrons back into their fetid darkness.

tc_text: 放心…你在這裡殺死的每一個敵人都可以拯救所有人！
en_text: Take heart... every foe you kill here saves us all!

tc_text: 堅強一點…它們只能殺死你，但是不能摧毀你的意志!
en_text: Be strong... they can take your life but they must never break your spirit!

tc_text: 你會為你的行為付出代價，異星人!雖然你們搶到泰坦，但是你們不會有命使用它!
en_text: You will pay for your actions, alien! You may have seized the Titan, but you will not live long enough to use it!

tc_text: 人類…死靈族才是你們真正的敵人，不是我們。別再拒絕我們對你的幫助!
en_text: Human... the Necrons are your true enemies, not us. Stop resisting our efforts to help you!

tc_text: 死靈族…歐克蠻人…神靈族…等史泰恩將軍來到時，你們都會死!
en_text: Necrons... Orks... Eldar... you'll all die the same when General Sturnn arrives!

tc_text: 命令第三方陣部隊撤退…讓敵軍追擊他們。然後把第八及第十方陣部隊推向前…就像我們在巴耳坦的方式一樣。
en_text: Order the third phalanx to pull back... let the enemy pursue them. Then, close in with the eighth and tenth phalanxes... like we did on Baaltain.

tc_text: 將軍!神靈族!
住手，人類。我來跟你交談，不是戰鬥。
en_text: Stay your hand, human. I've come to speak with you, not fight.

tc_text: 你很有膽識，神靈族，想想看，我們已經相信過你們一次。
en_text: You have guts, Eldar, considering we already trusted you once.

tc_text: 恐怕你們必須再相信我們一次。死靈族會把我們都消滅。它們不在乎仇恨及爭吵，那正是它們的武器。
en_text: And you must do so again, I'm afraid. The Necrons will destroy us all. They care not of grudges or bickering. In fact, it serves them.

tc_text: 你的重點是?
今天我們不是你的敵人，所以別把我們當做敵人。我們並不想要你們的泰坦。只要消滅了死靈族，它就是你們的。
en_text: We are not your enemies today, so stop treating us as such. We do not want your Titan. It is yours once we dispose of the Necrons.

tc_text: 如果我們一起合作，它會更快屬於你們。
en_text: If we work together, it'll be yours sooner than later.

tc_text: 我不相信你，神靈族。
要贏得這場戰爭，並不需要你的信任…需要的是你的幫助。
en_text: Your trust is not required to win this war... only your help.

tc_text: 好吧，神靈族。所有的部隊…集中火力攻擊死靈族!我們要贏得這場戰爭!
en_text: Very well, Eldar. All units... concentrate your firepower on the Necrons! We have a war to win!

tc_text: 我們必須召喚戰神分身。我們需要它強大的影響力來贏得勝利。
en_text: We must call forth the Avatar of Khaine. We shall need its powerful influence to win this day.

打敗戰爭頭目!
歐克頭目是個難以逃避的威脅!他會領導歐克蠻人，形成一支綠皮海嘯大軍踏平一切。必須獵殺這個頭目並阻止他的大軍。
en_text: The Warboss is an elusive threat! He will inspire the Orks to rise in a great tide of green that will stomp anything in its path. This Warboss must be made an example of. We must hunt him down and halt this WAAAGH! before it begins.

tc_text: 消滅歐克蠻人基地
歐克蠻人以為他們可以把我們趕出我們的領地？燒毀他們小得可憐的建築!燒光它們，直到只剩下灰燼為止!
en_text: The Orks think they can push us out of our own territory? Burn their wretched hovels to the ground! Burn it all until nothing but ash remains!

tc_text: 摧毀能源來源
找到頭目護盾的能源來源。找到之後，派你的屬下破壞發電機。只有這樣才能殺掉歐克蠻人頭目!
en_text: Locate the power source the Warboss is using to sustain his force field. Once found, send your minions to destroy the generator. Only then will we be able to crush the Warboss!

tc_text: 保護神殿
歐克蠻人正在破壞恐虐神殿。這個神殿代表我們對血神的尊敬!用你的性命來保護它!
en_text: The Orks are trying to tear down the Temples of Khorne. These temples are symbols of our devotion to the great Chaos God of Blood! Defend them with your lives!

tc_text: 保護神殿: %1NUM%
摧毀人類!
克魯爾領主以為他可以殺死比我們更多的人類!像瘋子一樣地衝進他們的槍陣，他們將會被我們消滅。我們用我們的風格來作戰，保證比混沌小子更好!
en_text: Lord Crull thinks he can kill more humies than us Orks! Charging forward into their guns like lunatics, they gonna get dem'selves perished. Us Orks are gonna fight on our own and do it better than any Chaos boy!

tc_text: 重整軍隊
如果要殺光所有的人類，我需要更多的部隊。我最好在深入之前，在附近多找一些部隊。
en_text: I need more boyz if I'm gonna kill all dese humies. I better hunt around for some boyz before I get in too deep.

tc_text: 破壞兵營
這些人類的建築物竟敢一直吐出虛弱的人類。殺光人類是很好玩，但是我們有更重要的事要做。燒光它們!
en_text: Those humie buildings dere keep spitting out more puny humies. Killing humies is fun but we got other things ta worry about. Burn'em!

tc_text: 摧毀人類基地
這些人類不懂得什麼時候該放棄!他們要為自己建造更大的基地。看來我們最好幫他們把這些東西摧毀成碎片!
en_text: Dese humies don't know when to quit! They've gone an built dem'selves a big ol base. Looks like we better help'em take it apart!

tc_text: 召喚恐虐狂戰士
恐虐最強壯的戰士正在等候您的指揮。命令一個混沌領主到一個神殿中，並利用他的能力來召喚狂戰士。
en_text: Khorne's greatest warriors are waiting to be called forth. Take the Chaos Lord to one of the Temples and use his special ability to call forth the Berzerkers.

tc_text: 尋找歐克蠻人堡壘
殲滅敵人的第一步是找到他們。我們必須找到這些歐克蠻人隱藏的基地。
en_text: The first step to defeating your enemy is to find them. We must seek out where these wretched Orks are hiding their base.

tc_text: 殺死戰爭頭目
沒有他珍貴的能量護盾，戰爭頭目就不會是混沌的大敵!殺死他!
en_text: Without his precious force field the Warboss is no match for the hordes of Chaos! Crush him now!

tc_text: 破壞戰爭頭目的基地
戰爭頭目徵召了歐克蠻人準備開始大肆出擊。如果我們不設法阻止他們，他們很快就會壓倒我們。
en_text: The Warboss has rallied the Orks to start a Waaagh! If we do not take steps to stop them, they will soon overwhelm us.

tc_text: 困住戰爭頭目
戰爭頭目逃跑了。圍捕他以贏得勝利。
en_text: The Warboss is on the run. Corner him to win.

tc_text: 我們必須獵殺戰爭頭目!
en_text: We must hunt down the Warboss!

tc_text: 成功了，我們包圍了戰爭頭目!
en_text: Success, we have trapped the Warboss!

tc_text: 我們沒有困住戰爭頭目!
en_text: We have failed to trap the Warboss!

tc_text: 混沌領主必須存活
不能讓帝國防衛軍殺死混沌領主。他的命是屬於戰爭頭目的!
en_text: The Imperials must not be allowed to kill the Chaos Lord. His head belongs to the Warboss!

tc_text: 不能讓那些弱小的人類殺死領主!
en_text: Can't let the puny hummies kill the Lord!

tc_text: 好吧，如果他無法活下去，那他也不值得我去注意他!
en_text: Alright, if he can't make it now he's not worth my time!

tc_text: 呀～可惡，我要他的命!
en_text: Ah crap, I wanted his head!

tc_text: 狂戰士剩餘: %1NUM%
我才不管那些會飛的戰士全死光了…去給我找另一隊會飛的戰士讓我把他們殺光!
en_text: I don't care dat da flyer boy iz dead... find me anudder flyer boy so I can kill 'im instead!

tc_text: 如果我沒有小子部隊，我要怎麼打仗？
en_text: How am I supposed ta run a WAAAGH! out here wid no boyz?

tc_text: 就在人類基地的附近?真是太好了!
en_text: And right near a humie base? Dis just grand!

tc_text: 在防衛這個冰天雪地的羅恩五號星時，我的士兵已感到疲憊，但是我不能責怪他們。血應該溫熱而自由地流下，而不是冰冷又呆滯。
en_text: My men grow restless guarding this insufferable fleck of ice they call Lorn V, though I do not blame them. Blood was meant to flow hot and free... not to run cold and sluggish.

tc_text: 奉恐虐之名啊，我應該指揮長征的，但是這個世界…連最基本的樂趣都沒有。
en_text: By Khorne, I should be commanding crusades, but this world... see how it denies me even my most basic pleasures.

tc_text: 那麼也許我可以給你一點事情做。我們的獵人擊落了戰爭頭目葛加茲的座機。
en_text: Then perhaps I can provide you with some sport. Yes? Our Hunters clipped the wings of the shuttle carrying Warboss Gorgutz.

tc_text: 他最近聯合了其他歐克蠻人的部落。我相信他還活著。
en_text: He recently united the other Ork clans. I believe he survived the crash.

tc_text: 很好!總算有事做了。把葛加茲殺死會讓歐克蠻人陷入混亂之中。但是告訴所有人，只有我可以取他的命!
en_text: Yes! Finally some sport. Eliminating Gorgutz will send the Orks reeling. But tell everyone that I alone will claim his head!

tc_text: 等到夜晚來臨時，我們會用他的頭骨來敬酒!
en_text: By nightfall, we'll drink a toast from his skull!

tc_text: 什麼!那些大砲從哪來的!?
en_text: What! Where's that artillery coming from!

tc_text: 看來帝國防衛軍要來摧毀你的部落!
en_text: Looks like da Imperial Guardz come ta kick yer can!

tc_text: 混蛋!我們都會死在這個雪球裡!你會成為一個不錯的雪堆!除非我們在他們抵達之前衝破他們的陣線!
en_text: Fool! We'll both die on this misbegotten ball of ice! You'll make a lovely mound of snow! Unless we charge their lines before they tighten their noose!

tc_text: 那是你的計畫!衝破他們的陣線?告訴你，你走你的，我走我的，看看誰比較厲害!
en_text: Waddya mean, charge der line? Tell ya what. Youz go yer way, I go mine and we'll see who comez out da udder side!

tc_text: 什麼!葛加茲，你要去哪裡?葛加茲!詛咒他!我會獨自去衝破陣線，然後一看到他就殺了他。
en_text: What! Gorgutz, where in the Warp are you going? Gorgutz! Damn him! I'll charge the lines alone, then, and kill him when I next see his bloodshot eyes.

tc_text: 請住手…我會告訴你任何事情。我會告訴你任何事情!
en_text: Stop... please. I'll tell you whatever you want. I'll tell you everything!

tc_text: 為什麼你會在我的世界?告訴我我就大發慈悲。
en_text: Why are you here on my world? Answer me and I'll show you mercy.

tc_text: 我們被派來回收泰坦支配者。它在防衛這裡的時候遭到嚴重破壞。我們希望可以修理它。
en_text: We were assigned to retrieve a Titan: Dominatus. It was badly damaged in the defense of this world ages ago. We were hoping to repair it.

tc_text: 泰坦?那是什麼東西?
葛加茲，那是無法想像的力量。一個不凡的戰爭機器…一個可以破壞世界的武器…甚至整個星系。
en_text: Power unimaginable, Gorgutz. A war machine unlike any other... a weapon to devastate worlds... entire star systems, even.

tc_text: 如果我可以控制泰坦，那沒有任何東西可以阻止我。我會成為神。準備好你的軍隊，葛加茲，讓我們來解決這些帝國防衛軍。
en_text: If I can gain control of the Titan, none could stand in my way. I'd be a God. Organize your forces, Gorgutz, and let us be done with these Imperial Guardsmen.

tc_text: 然後我們再來解決我們之間的問題。
en_text: Afterwards, we'll settle matters between us.

tc_text: 聽起來不錯，克魯爾。我會聚集我的小子部隊，等我擊敗人類之後，我會把你揍到流血。
en_text: Soundz good, Crull. I'll gather da boyz, and once I crush da humies I'll help ya bleed somethin' good.

tc_text: 只要我沒有先用泰坦把你給踩死，葛加茲。
en_text: Not unless I crush you under the Titan's heel first, Gorgutz.

tc_text: 那些歐克蠻人從哪來的?提高警覺，你們這些狗!葛加茲正想逃走!如果他成功的話，我以混沌發誓，那個讓他逃走的人會知道什麼叫做痛苦!
en_text: Where are these Orks coming from? On alert, you dogs! Gorgutz is trying to escape! If he does, I swear by the Maelstrom that those who fail me will know naught but anguish!

tc_text: 找到幫助他的那些歐克蠻人部隊，並且在他們攻破封鎖區之前殲滅他們。
en_text: Find the source of the Orks helping him and crush them before they overwhelm the blockade.

tc_text: 什麼!還有更多的歐克蠻人?葛加茲在考驗我們的力量和我的耐心!保持警戒…歐克蠻人正在瞄準新的封鎖區。
en_text: What! Still more Orks? Gorgutz is testing our strength and my patience! Remain vigilant... the Orks are targeting a new blockade.

tc_text: 找到這些新的歐克蠻人部隊的來源，並且不計一切代價困住葛加茲。不能讓他逃走!
en_text: Find the source of these new Orks and keep Gorgutz trapped at all costs. He cannot escape!

tc_text: 這些歐克蠻人好像害蟲一般，但是我看透他們的遊戲了。他們躲在碎石裡，但是他們會發現那是一個很差的掩蔽!
en_text: These Orks are vermin, but I see their game. They hide in the rubble but they will find it a poor shelter!

tc_text: 粉碎這些粗石碉堡，殲滅這些躲在洞裡的老鼠!
en_text: Pulverize the rubble bunkers and crush these rats in their holes!

tc_text: 好了，小子們。是讓這些人類嘗嘗真正的"吼~~~~!!"的時間了!把這個世界永遠佔領的時間到了!!
en_text: Dat's it, boyz. Time ta show dese humies a real WAAAGH! Time ta take dis here world for us Orks once and for all!

tc_text: 首先，我們必須突破這些帝國防衛軍的防線，然後我們聚集更多的歐克蠻人來打更大的仗。
en_text: First, we gotta break tru dese Imperial linez, then we gather up more Ork boys for da big fight.

tc_text: 抓不到葛加茲…所有小子裡最大最壞的戰爭頭目!
en_text: Can't catch ol' Gorgutz... da biggest, baddest Warboss of all da boyz!

tc_text: 不!我不能輸給你們這種傢伙。我會在你逃離之前破壞這個世界!
en_text: No! I will not be outwitted by the likes of you. I will destroy this world before I let you escape!

tc_text: 太慢了，人類!我已經逃離了!
en_text: Too late, humie! I'z already gone!

tc_text: 還不夠好呀，人類!有這個閃亮的東西，你根本碰不到我!
en_text: Not good enuff, humie! You can't touch me behind dis here sparkle thingie!

tc_text: 護盾不能永遠保護你，懦夫!如果你的護盾消失了，我會用牙齒深深咬進你的喉嚨!
en_text: That shield won't protect you forever, coward! And when the shield drops, I will sink my teeth into your neck!

tc_text: 來呀。你的牙齒根本比不上我的。
en_text: Do yer worst. Youz ain't got da teef ta take da likez a' me!

tc_text: 閃亮的東西壞掉了!那些惡霸小子跟小鬼在幹什麼?我要用他們的工具把他們揍扁!
en_text: Da sparkle thingie broke! Wherez dat mekboy-fer-a-gretchin at? I'm gonna beat him ta a pulp wid his own tools!

tc_text: 歐!所有的小子呢?沒有小子就不能帶領"吼~~~~!"，沒有小子就沒有殘殺及狂嚎!我只能自己一個人"吼~~~~!"
en_text: Oi! Where all da boyz at! Youz can't run a WAAAGH! wid'out da boyz ta do da killin' and da screamin'! Do I have ta run da WAAAGH! by me lonesome?

tc_text: 你們這些懶惰的爛泥們，給我出來，我要把他們砍個稀爛。任何覺得可以和帝國一戰的小子，來！去殺了他們！
en_text: All ya lazy sackz of sludge... git yer oily hidez here ‘fore I skin ‘em nice n' good. Any boyz dat think dey can take da Imperialz, dis here's a WAAAGH! good n' proper! Come n' get ‘em!

tc_text: 很好,終於!激動人心的戰爭!
en_text: Yes, finally! War to stir the blood!

tc_text: 溫暖皮膚的血液!
讓他們來…屠殺他們，讓你們心滿意足。
en_text: Let them come... slaughter them to the last and eat your fill.

tc_text: 我們的靈魂早已被這個冰冷的地獄給凍結。
en_text: Our souls have cooled for too long in this frozen hell.

tc_text: 現在該點燃火燄了…我們今天要把歐克蠻人給吃掉!
en_text: It is time to stoke the flames... we eat Ork tonight!

tc_text: 主人，我們有三個軌道顯示器斷線了…是的。機器主教無法復活它們的機械靈魂。
en_text: Milord, three of our orbital monitors have gone off line... yes. The tech-priests cannot raise their machine spirits.

tc_text: 我晚點再處理!葛加茲快要落入我的掌握之中了，我不會失去這個濺血的機會。除非你想嚐嚐我的刀刃的滋味。
en_text: I will deal with it later! Gorgutz is almost in my grasp and I will not miss this opportunity to spill blood. Not unless you ache for my blade, instead!

tc_text: 血…我渴望嚐到血!
en_text: Blood... I ache for the taste of blood!

tc_text: 你感覺到了嗎?空氣中充滿了死亡的溫暖，所有我觸碰的東西都是一片寒冷。
en_text: Can you feel that? The air is warm with death, and all that touches me is the cold.

tc_text: 當我們可以痛快殺戮時，為什麼我們會在這裡?
en_text: Why are we out here when we could be in the thick of slaughter?!

tc_text: 我不知道那卑鄙的低賤生物葛加茲怎麼取得那護盾。那個護盾需要大量的能源。只要我找到那力量來源，我可以摧毀它並且把葛加茲撕成兩半。
en_text: How that misbegotten wretch Gorgutz acquired a shield of that strength is beyond me. Still, a shield like that requires substantial power. Once I find the power source, I can destroy it and render Gorgutz defenseless.

tc_text: 我找到了葛加茲護盾的能量來源。我必需在他可以反應之前摧毀它!
en_text: I've located the power source of Gorgutz's forcefield. I must destroy it quickly before he reacts!

tc_text: 能量來源已經摧毀了，葛加茲已經毫無防護。現在他是我的獵物了!
en_text: The power source is destroyed and Gorgutz is defenseless. Now he's mine to slaughter!

tc_text: 這就是"吼~~~~!"嗎?他以為可以用他那些可憐軟弱的歐克蠻人軍隊摧毀我的基地，真是羞辱我!我會把他和他的軍隊殲滅!
en_text: Is this what counts as a WAAAGH?!? I'm insulted that he thinks he can destroy my base with this pitiful rabble of Orks! I will crush him and his men for that affront!

tc_text: 你站在這裡幹什麼?歐克蠻人正在攻擊我們的戰略據點!
en_text: What are you standing here for?! The Orks are attacking our Strategic Points!

tc_text: 開啟血神的神殿!他們會呼喚瘋狂憤怒的狂戰士!
en_text: Open the Temples to the Blood God! They will call forth the righteous fury of the Berzerkers!

tc_text: 神殿也可以為我們灌注褻瀆神聖的空間能量!
en_text: The temples can also infuse us with the glorious energies of the Warp!

tc_text: 神殿正在遭受攻擊!
因為你，我們失去了一座神殿!
en_text: Because of you, we've lost a temple!

tc_text: 另一座神殿被摧毀了…恐虐血神會因為這樣而取你的雙眼!
en_text: Another temple destroyed... Khorne will take your eyes for that!

tc_text: 你這笨蛋!另一座神殿被摧毀了!恐虐血神一定會把我們兩個都撕碎!
en_text: You fool! Another temple destroyed! Khorne will rip us asunder for certain.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人正在攻擊我們的基地…擊退他們!
en_text: The Orks are attacking our base... repel them!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人正在破壞我們的基地…阻止他們!
en_text: The Orks are destroying our base... stop them!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人處於瘋狂狀態並且持續攻擊。阻止他們!恐虐血神請拯救我們'!
en_text: The Orks are frenzied and pressing the attack. Stop them! Save us Khorne!

tc_text: 綠皮族正在撤退!追擊他們…把他們殺光!
en_text: The green-skins are in retreat! After them... slaughter them to the last!

tc_text: 一個歐克蠻人的基地!燒光基地，殺光他們!
en_text: An Ork base! Burn it to the ground and kill them to the last!

tc_text: 我們摧毀了歐克蠻人的基地。現在就剩下那個懦夫葛加茲得死在我的刀口下!
en_text: We've destroyed the Ork base. Now that leaves the coward Gorgutz for my blade!

tc_text: 葛加茲在那邊!抓住他!
包圍葛加茲，但是把他留給我!我要獨自一人用他的頭骨喝他的血!
en_text: Surround Gorgutz but leave him to me! I alone will drink his blood from the goblet of his skull!

tc_text: 那個克魯爾差點逮到我!現在要給他們這些愚笨的人類一點教訓!但是首先，我需要更多的小子部隊。現在要使用特殊的戰嚎…嘿,小子們!你們在哪?
en_text: Dat Crull almost got me good! Time ta learn dez stupid humies a lesson in gettin' squished! But first, I needz me more boyz. Time ta put out da special call... HEY BOYZ! WHERE YA AT?

tc_text: 嘿…那棟建築看起來不錯。只要再塗上一些紅油漆及修理就像新的一般!嘿，小鬼們，過來這裡。看到那建築物沒有…把它們修好…要不然我會把你的頭踩到我覺得無聊為止!
en_text: Hey... dat dere buildin' workz pretty good. Just needz some red paint and some fixin' n' it'z like new! Hey GROTZ! C'mere. See dat buildin'... well ya getz ta fix it real good... or I'z stomp ya in da head till I git bored!

tc_text: 這真好!更多的小子們?這好像知道我的想法一樣!你們不是奇怪的小子們吧?
en_text: Dis is GREAT! More boyz? It'z like ya read my mind! Ya ain't no Weird Boy, iz ya?

tc_text: 把那些會飛的東西射到它們不會飛為止!
en_text: Shoot dem flyin' tingies till dey ain't flyin' no more!

tc_text: 嗯?我竟然把人類嚇到這種地步…他們飛走了!好吧…我開始無聊了。小鬼們!我又要踩你們的頭了!
en_text: Huh? I scared dem humies so bad... dey flew away! Okay... I'z bored now. GROTZ! Time ta stomp on yer head again!

tc_text: 我就知道人類很愚蠢!他們並不知道什麼時候該放棄。嘿!我有什麼好抱怨的?有更多的人類可以宰殺!
en_text: I knew dem humies waz stupid! Dey don't know when ta give up. HEY! What am I complainin' about? More humies ta kill!

tc_text: 用火燄槍把那軍營燒掉!歐…也可以把它給砍爛!
en_text: Burn down der barrack wid da burna's. Oh... and chop dem up real good!

tc_text: 最後一個人類基地!最後一個有腐爛的屍體!你以為我在開玩笑…我要把不是我的人全部殺光!快跑吧，你們這些小鬼愛好者!
en_text: Da last humie base! Last one dere's a rotten corpse! Ya think I'm kiddin'... I'm killin' da last one dere dat izn't me! RUN YA GRETCHIN-LOVERS!

tc_text: 歐~你!離那個力量能源遠遠的!
en_text: Oi you! Getz away from dat powa tingy!

tc_text: 去你的雙眼!現在我不能再召喚混沌軍團是什麼意思!
en_text: Damn your eyes! What do you mean I cannot call forth more Legions of Chaos for the moment!

tc_text: 我們必須讓總部升級並且加入混沌軍官來增加我們部隊上限。
en_text: We must upgrade our Headquarters and add Aspiring Champions to increase our Squad Cap.

tc_text: 笨蛋!你放任那個監聽哨沒有保護。快點…在它們淪陷前升級它們的裝甲及防禦!
en_text: Fool! You’ve left the Listening Posts unprotected. Quickly… upgrade them with better armor and defenses before they fall!

tc_text: 去你的運氣。那護盾的發電機在歐克蠻人領地的另一端!
en_text: Damn the luck. The force-field generator lies on the far side of Ork territory!

tc_text: 我們必須開一條血路，或是派猛禽戰士或懼妖穿越城牆並且攻擊歐克蠻人的弱點。
en_text: We must either slaughter our way through, or send Raptors and Horrors over the walls and attack the Orks at their weakest points.

tc_text: 我們有我們需要的所有狂戰士。
en_text: We have all the Berzerkers we need.

tc_text: 很好，很好!恐虐血神用他的忠實信仰者獎賞我們!恐虐狂戰士!
en_text: Yes, YES! Khorne rewards us with his most devout disciples! Khorne Berzerkers!

tc_text: 我們無法請求恐虐的恩澤!我們離神殿太遠了。
en_text: We cannot ask Khorne for favors! We have strayed too far from a Temple.

tc_text: 歐!小子部隊在哪?
用我的力量來召喚更多的小子怎樣?
en_text: Howz ‘bout I uze my special powa to call up more boyz!

tc_text: 那些歐克蠻人竟敢攻擊恐虐的聖殿?!
en_text: The Orks dare attack one of Khorne’s sacred temples!?!

tc_text: 在我們激怒血神之前快點阻止他們!
en_text: Stop them, quickly, before we anger the Blood God for this affront!

tc_text: 你這連一隻小鬼都殺不了的愚笨蠢蛋!帶我去神殿!我必須懇求恐虐血神獎賞我們更好的戰士!
en_text: You wretched idiots couldn’t kill a grot! Take me to the Temple! I must beseech Khorne for better soldiers!

tc_text: 去吧…現在就召喚狂戰士，把你的敵人像風ㄧ樣地消滅。
en_text: Do it… summon the Berzerkers now and scatter your enemies to the winds.

tc_text: 找任何東西來當作你的武器。我們必須有更多的戰士及防禦!
en_text: Arm yourselves with anything you can find. We must have more men and better defenses!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人會帶著更多回來！
en_text: The Ork will return in greater numbers!

tc_text: 凝聚部落
葛加茲部族

破壞碎顱者戰旗
要讓那些小子服從我們的話，就必須要爆破那大旗子!破壞他們基地的戰旗!
en_text: Ta get doze Boyz ta follow us we needz to blow up dere big banner! Destroy dat big banner in dere base!

tc_text: 破壞克維特老大戰旗
克維特老大部落喜愛載具，我們也一樣!破壞他們的戰旗，他們就會服從我們!
en_text: Doze Kwik Mekz like dere vehicles and so da we! Destroy da Kwik Mekz banner and deyz follow us!

tc_text: 破壞火箭遊俠戰旗
火箭小子有很多的火箭，這會很好用。破壞火箭遊俠戰旗之後我們就可以有個大爆炸!
en_text: Da Rokkit boyz have lots of Rokkits, dey’ll come in handy. Destroy da Rokkit Rangaz banner and we can bring da big boom!

tc_text: 破壞火燄小子戰旗
火燄小子有個可以燃燒所有東西的武器。摧毀他們的戰旗之後我們就可以把這個世界燒成灰燼!
en_text: Dem Burna Boyz got all the good burny stuff. Destroy the Burna Boyz banner and we can light dis world on fire!

tc_text: 得到史估革訓練師的服從
en_text: Gain the Services of the Squiggoth Trainer

tc_text: 釋放史估革訓練師，他就會加入我們的吼~~~~!"
en_text: Free da Squiggoth Trainer and he gonna join our Waaagh!

tc_text: 破壞史估革巨獸城門的發電機
en_text: Destroy the Squiggoth Base Gate's Power Generators

tc_text: 要想到達最後一個基地及史估革巨獸，我們必須開啟城門。摧毀6個大型發電機便可開啟城門。
en_text: Ta get da last base and da Squiggoths, we need to open da gate. Destroy six of da big powa generataz to bring down da gate.

tc_text: 抓住史估革巨獸
現在訓練師是我們的，用他來訓練史估革巨獸。把他移到史估革附近，他會知道該怎麼做!
en_text: Now dat da Trainer is ours, use 'im ta tame da Squiggoths. Move 'im close ta dem Squiggoths, an' 'ee will know wot ta do!

tc_text: 消滅混沌軍團
殺光人類!讓他們知道歐克蠻人是這個星球上最強的!吼~~~~~!
en_text: Crush da humies! Let dem know dat da Orkz are da strongest on dis 'ere planet! Waaagh!

tc_text: 撞開神靈族的大門。
使用史估革巨獸的狂暴能力來擊破神靈族的基地大門
en_text: Use the Squiggoths' Rampage ability to bash down the Eldar base gates.

tc_text: 佔領跺腳者部落基地
en_text: Take Over the Clan Footstompaz Base

tc_text: 奪取史估革巨獸來佔領基地。釋放被囚禁的史估革訓練師並且用他完成這些工作。
en_text: Take over the base by capturing the Squiggoths. Free the Squiggoth Trainer from captivity and use him to do this.

tc_text: 凝聚部落
在這個星球上有很多歐克蠻人部落。我們要讓他們看看我們才是這個星球上最強的歐克蠻人部落，之後他們就會加入我們的"吼~~~~!"
en_text: Dere are many Ork clanz on dis 'ere planet. We show dem dat we are da strongest and Orkiest clan on da planet, and dey will join our Waaagh!

tc_text: 馴服史估革巨獸
選擇這個，然後再選擇一個史估革巨獸加以馴服。
en_text: Select this and then select one of the squiggoths to tame them.

tc_text: 釋放史估革巨獸訓練師
那些史估革訓練師知道他們在做什麼。爆破城門，並且從囚牢中釋放他們出來!
en_text: Dat Squiggoth Trainer knows 'is stuff. Blow up the gate datz holding him captive!

tc_text: 佔領所有戰略據點
這會給我們所需要的資源部隊，並且讓大家知道葛加茲來了!
en_text: Dey will give us da requisition we need, and dey also let people know dat Gorgutz waz 'ere!

tc_text: 占領關鍵目標
這個重要的任務目標是讓那些小子知道誰才是老大的好機會。好好把握!
en_text: Dat Critical Location sure would be a good way to show da udder boyz whose da big boss. Capture it!

tc_text: 破壞混沌軍團的機械坑
雖然搶戰車很好玩，也不能讓他們擁有戰車。把混沌軍團的機械坑摧毀!
en_text: Can’t let dem have tanks even if dey are fun ta loot. Blow up da Machine Pit!

tc_text: 破壞混沌軍團神殿
我們必須要在它們派出更多的部隊前破壞它。摧毀混沌神殿之後他們就不能生產懦弱的人類了。
en_text: We gotta stop dem from bringin out troops. Blow up the Chaos Temples and dey won’t be able to make any more squishy humies!

tc_text: 破壞混沌軍團總部
我們必須把它們全部破壞!把混沌軍團總部破壞掉，它們就死定了!
en_text: We gotta blow dem up good! Destroy da Chaos Headquarters and dez as dead as dead!

tc_text: 我們跟混沌軍團打了好久。之前的帝國守衛軍很簡單，但是這些混沌…對我們來說太強了。如果我們不逃走，他們會擊敗我們!
en_text: We be fightin' dem Chaoz Boyz fer long time now. Da Imperial boyz before dem waz easy, but dese boyz... dey too tough fer us. Dey smash us good ‘less we run!

tc_text: 你聽起來很害怕。你這懦夫!他們只是人類!
en_text: You talkin' scared. You a coward! Dem only humies!

tc_text: 我比你聰明!我說我們逃走吧!
en_text: I'z got more brains den you! I sayz we run!

tc_text: 我說你給我閉嘴!我是老大!你有問題?很好!我們需要更多的小子來增強"吼~~~~~!"來打敗混沌軍團!
en_text: And I sayz you shut da hell up! I'm da Boss! Questionz? Good! We need more boyz for dese here WAAAGH! before we take da Chaos boyz down good!

tc_text: 你們這些小伙子在幹什麼?戰鬥!我沒有說他們死掉以前，他們都不算死掉！
en_text: What you gitz doin'? Fight! Dey ain't dead till I sayz dey dead!

tc_text: 那是什麼隆隆聲?
那個很有趣!衝啊，小子們!這場戰鬥已經是我的了…我可以感覺到!
en_text: Now dat waz funny! Charge, boyz! Dis fight iz already mine... I can taste it!

tc_text: 這個星球是我的了!所有的歐克蠻人回答我!誰是老大?
en_text: Dis planet iz mine now! All da Ork Boyz answer ta me! Who da Warboss?

tc_text: 葛加茲，葛加茲!你是最大，最壞的戰爭頭目。你比納茲戴克還大!你比高茲格爾還大!
en_text: You, Gorgutz! You da biggest, baddest Warboss ever. You bigger den Nazdreg! You be bigger den Ghazghkull!

tc_text: 沒有人比高茲格爾還大你這無知的小鬼!至少…還沒有!現在…我的飛行東西在哪裡?我拿到混沌軍隊克魯爾領主的頭骨來裝飾我的尖棍子!
en_text: Nobody bigger den Ghazghkull ya ignorant git! At least... not yet! Now... where'z my flyin' ting. I got me a Chaos boy skull by da name of Lord Crull ta claim for my pointy stik!

tc_text: 這裡是五大歐克蠻人部落的第一個部落。
en_text: Dis here is da first of da five big Ork Clanz.

tc_text: 要佔領他們，我們就必須破壞那些大戰旗!這樣給他們一個教訓。
en_text: Ta take ‘em, we needz ta destroy dere big WAAAGH! banner! That'll teach ‘em.

tc_text: 他們那邊好熱，那我們卻在這裡好冷!現在是時候把火燄小子解決掉了!
en_text: Dey got da heat and we here freezin'! Time ta take down dese Burna Boyz.

tc_text: 去找一個上面有火燄的戰旗，把它拆了，他們就會服從我。
en_text: Find dere big WAAAGH banner wid flamey tings on it and break it good so dey follow me.

tc_text: 這些小子好奇怪。他們竟然崇拜他們的卡車。
en_text: Dese here boyz r' strange ones. Dey worship dere Trukks n' da Mek Shop makin' 'em.

tc_text: 摧毀那個有著卡車標誌的戰旗，他們就會服從葛加茲!
en_text: Destroy dere big WAAAGH! banner wid Trukk partz on it n' maybe dey'll wize up enuff ta follow ol' Gorgutz!

tc_text: 這些小子崇拜在基地中心的那個大火箭。現在他們應該要崇拜我!
en_text: Dese boyz worship da giant rokkit dey built dere base ‘round. Now it'z time dey worship me!

tc_text: 我們摧毀有著火箭標誌的大戰旗，他們一定會服從我!他們沒有其他選擇!
en_text: We take down dat big WAAAGH! banner wid da rokkit on it and dey sure ta follow me! Dey don't get any udder choice!

tc_text: 歐!這扇門還真大!好，小子們。到目前為止我們擊敗了所有的部落，這個也不例外。我們必須衝進去，搶到史估革巨獸!
en_text: Oi! Dat'z one big gate! Okay, boyz. We got all da campz so far, and dis ain't no different. We march in and take da Squiggoths fer us boyz!

tc_text: 當然城門很堅固，但是如果我們破壞了電源及那個城門周遭的閃亮東西，那城門就掰掰了。
en_text: Sure dere gate iz tough, but we kill dere power and da sparkly ting ‘round da gate goez bye-bye.

tc_text: 我得到了史估革巨獸訓練師!但是如果我要得到史估革巨獸，那個訓練師必須得接近牠。
en_text: I gotz me a Squiggoth trainer! But before I can get me da Squiggoths, da trainer must getz near dem first.

tc_text: 小子們！轉移那頭瘋狂奔跑的史估革巨獸的注意力，讓訓練師可以接近牠們並注射藥汁!這樣牠們就被馴服了。
en_text: You boyz! Distract dose Squiggoths runnin' wild so da trainer can git in close and use dat kooky juice on deme! Den dey'll be tame.

tc_text: 有些小子告訴我這附近有一個帝國的前線基地。只要我讓這個雪地星球上所有的小子都叫我老大，我們就可以來解決這些懦弱的人類!
en_text: Da boyz tell me dere's a Imperial outpost nearby. Once I got all da boyz on dis here iceball callin' me Warboss, we'll deal wid dem pesky humies!

tc_text: 我是怎麼告訴你的，小子們。現在我們是一個快樂的大家族，就該要更多的戰爭!我知道有一個人類的前線基地可以用來開始我們的"吼~~~~!"
en_text: What did I tell ya, boyz. Now dat we all one big happy family, it'z time fer more fightin'! And I know just da humie outpost to start da WAAAGH!

tc_text: 歐…記得要帶史估革巨獸。我們還沒餵牠們耶!
en_text: Oh... and bring da Squiggoths. We ain't fed ‘em yet!

tc_text: 帝皇呀!這是什麼巨獸?牠們毫不費力地破壞我們防線。詛咒他們!堅守你的防線，弟兄們!不能害怕!你們不能從這個戰場撤退!
en_text: By the Emperor! What manner of beasts are those? They're cutting through our defenses with no effort. Damn them! Stand your ground, men! Show them no fear! You will not retreat from this battle!

tc_text: 讓我看看…火箭基地?我的!卡車基地?我的!火燄基地?我的!史估革基地?我的!聽到沒，小子們!
en_text: Let'z see... da rockit base? Mine! Da Trukk base? Mine! Da Burna base? Mine! Da Squiggoth base? Mine! Hear dat boyz?!

tc_text: 這個基地是我的了!
又一個基地成為我的!
我佔領了另一個基地!
不…我們還沒有足夠的小子部隊來佔領這個基地!讓我們先佔領其他基地，然後等我們夠強了再回來!
en_text: Nope... we don't got enuff boyz ta take dis base! Let'z take down da udder bases, den come back for dis one when we'z stronger!

tc_text: Placeholder line: Imperial Guard base destroyed
en_text: Placeholder line: Imperial Guard base destroyed

tc_text: 歐克蠻人喜愛三樣東西。戰鬥，戰鬥及軍旗!軍旗表示你很強壯並且準備要作戰!所以所有的小子追隨軍旗。摧毀那些戰旗，那些小子只好服從我!
en_text: Three tings Orkz luv. Fightin', fightin' and der bannerz! Da banner meanz yer strong and ready ta fight! So all dese boyz follow dere banner. Destroy dat and dey got no udder banner ta follow but mine!

tc_text: 這樣…我給我找到了一個"吼~~~~!"而且沒有殺死所有喜歡老大的小鬼就做到了!
en_text: Dat way... I get me a WAAAGH! and not have ta kill every gretchin lovin' nob around ta do it!

tc_text: 看來他們把所有的史估革巨獸訓練師都鎖起來了!如果我把他放出來，我相信他一定很感謝我。如果我救了他，然後再恐嚇說要殺了他，他一定會訓練幾隻史估革巨獸!
en_text: Lookz like dey got dere Squiggoth trainer all locked up! I bet he real grateful if I free him. Bet he train plenty of Squiggoths fer me if I save him... then threaten' ta kill him!

tc_text: 歐!停止攻擊那個指揮部!我需要讓這個"吼~~~~!"繼續!
en_text: OI! Stop attackin' dat big Headquarterz dere! I needz ta get dis WAAAGH! goin!

tc_text: 這個基地是我的，你聽到了嗎，你們這些喜歡老大的小鬼們!
en_text: Da base iz mine, ya hear me ya gretchin luvin' nobs!

tc_text: 可惡，這些發電機真硬!找一些火箭小子來把它們炸掉!
en_text: Dem Power Generators are tough! Get me some rokkit boyz to blow dem up fast!

tc_text: 為血神而戰!

俘虜防衛軍
當你的巫師位於正確的地點時，按鍵以俘虜防衛軍
en_text: Click when your sorcerer is in the right location to capture enemy Guardsmen.

tc_text: 殺死戰神分身
在接近戰神分身時按下按鍵以啟動同步擊殺
en_text: Click this button when close enough to the Avatar to trigger a sync kill.

tc_text: 你必須選擇一個帝國防衛軍小隊。
en_text: You must target a Guardsmen squad.

tc_text: 你的巫師必須接近目標部隊。
en_text: Your Sorcerer must be closer to the target squad.

tc_text: 你只能一次控制一個小隊。
en_text: You can only control one squad at a time.

tc_text: 你的血魔必須接近戰神分身。
en_text: Your Bloodthirster must be closer to the Avatar.

tc_text: 你必須選擇戰神分身為目標。
殺死史泰恩將軍
我們要頭顱!我們必須殺死那個人類史泰恩將軍然後把他的頭插在老大的棍子上!他在這附近，我們可以找到他。找到他並殺死他!
en_text: We needz HEADZ! We gotta kill dat humie General Sturnn and stick his head on my boss pole! He is here somewhere, we can hear him. Find him, kill him!

tc_text: 給恐虐進貢
把你的巫師帶到不同的敵人營地以俘虜意志懦弱的護衛兵的思想
en_text: Bring your sorcerer to the various enemy encampments in order to capture the minds of the weaker willed guardsmen.

tc_text: 佔領戰略據點
佔領環繞基地的4個戰略據點並在上面建造監聽哨。
en_text: Capture the four strategic points around your base and build listening posts on them.

tc_text: 保護血窟
這個血窟比我們性命還重要…尤其是你們的。我們必須建造一個基地來保護它!
en_text: This Blood Pit is more precious than our pathetic lives… especially yours. We must get a base established so as to protect it from the enemy!

tc_text: 建造砲塔
站立不動的防禦是很可憐沒錯，但是它可以讓敵人淌血!建造一些砲塔來保護血窟。
en_text: Stationary defenses are pathetic, but they spill BLOOD! Build some Turrets to better protect the Blood Pit.

tc_text: 建造機械坑
是的，現在這裡看起來比較像個基地!我們需要載具來取勝。建造一個機械坑！
en_text: Yes, now this is starting to look like a base! We will need vehicles if we want to win, however. Build a Machine Pit!

tc_text: 裝滿血坑
血坑必須裝滿血!血會流出!巫師可以用他們的能力來俘虜意志力薄弱的帝國防衛軍士兵。
en_text: The Blood Pit must be filled! Blood will flow! The Sorcerers can use their abilities to capture the minds and bodies of the weak willed Guardsmen.

tc_text: 察探帝國基地
派巫師去察探帝國基地，那裡一定有帝國士兵可以俘虜。
en_text: Send the Sorcerer to explore the nearby Imperial Base, there’s sure to be Guardsmen there he can capture.

tc_text: 俘虜防衛軍
使用巫師的"俘虜帝國士兵"能力來俘虜帝國士兵!
en_text: Use the Sorcerer’s “Capture Guardsmen” ability to capture a squad of Guardsmen!

tc_text: 將防衛軍獻祭
把帝國士兵帶回血窟，讓他們可以成為恐虐的祭品。
en_text: Bring the Guardsmen back to the Blood Pit where they will be sacrificed to Khorne.

tc_text: 消滅戰神分身
只有血魔才有能力摧毀那邪惡、軟弱的神靈族之神!
en_text: Only the Bloodthirster has the ability to destroy that foul, walking behemoth the Eldar call a God!

tc_text: 附魔你的巫師
把你的巫師帶到血窟，為他灌注恐虐的力量。
en_text: Bring your sorcerer to the Blood Pit to infuse him with the power of Khorne.

tc_text: 殺死戰神分身
把你的血魔帶到戰神分身旁，並且使用他的"擊殺"能力來摧毀他!
en_text: Bring your Bloodthirster to the Avatar and use his “Slay” ability to destroy him!

tc_text: 太多了…這裡實在太多了!從來沒有看過這麼多…快點撤退!快點--
en_text: Too many... there's too many! Never seen this many before... sound the retreat! Sound the --

tc_text: 就這樣了!隨心所欲地屠殺，用血塗滿冰道!這是真正的"吼~~~~!"!這樣應該可以…讓我當上戰爭頭目!
en_text: Dat'z it boyz! Kill yer fill and smear dis here ice patch wid dere blood! Dis is a WAAAGH! all good and proper! Da way it should be done... with me as Warboss!

tc_text: 那史泰恩怎麼辦，頭目…我可以殺了他嗎…讓你知道我是一個好的歐克蠻人?
en_text: What about Sturnn, Boss... can I kill him... showz you I'z a good Ork?

tc_text: 不!史泰恩是我的。我要他的頭!
en_text: No! Sturnn'z mine. I want his head!

tc_text: 他的頭有什麼特別?
en_text: What'z so special about his head?

tc_text: 因為頭有頭骨，笨蛋。而且如果我把他的腳插在我的尖刺上，我看起來會很笨!
en_text: Dat's were da skull is, stupid. And I'd look foolish wiz his foot on my pointy stik!

tc_text: 我真是笨，笨!我已經知道這個答案!
en_text: Stupid, stupid me! I knew da answer ta dat!

tc_text: 詛咒他們!我們浪費太多血在召喚血魔。現在我們需要更多的血來滿足恐虐!我告訴你，巫師。明天我會愉快地把神靈族的眼睛從他們的尖叫頭骨裡吸出來。
en_text: Damn them! We wasted too much blood summoning the Bloodthirster. Now we need more if we are to appease Khorne! I'll tell you this, Sorcerer. Tomorrow I shall enjoy sucking the Eldar's eyes from their screaming skulls.

tc_text: 阿，抱歉，我的主人。但是這還不是最糟的。
en_text: I am, uh, sorry, milord. But that is not the worst of it.

tc_text: 小心點，巫師。要不然我可能會殺了你，而不是殺神靈族。
en_text: Tread carefully, Sorcerer. Or I might savage you instead of the Eldar.

tc_text: 那麼，啊，我的主人，也許你可以用歐克蠻人的血來滿足你。葛加茲及他的暴民集結在泰坦附近。也許他想要攻擊它。
en_text: Then perhaps you should, ah, sate your thirst on Ork blood, milord? Gorgutz and his rabble are, uhm, gathered near the Titan. Perhaps he is ready to attack it.

tc_text: 葛加茲太大膽了!我已經對這個"盟軍"感到厭煩了。我要把這些卑劣的歐克蠻人的頭骨當作我的茶杯!
en_text: Gorgutz wouldn't dare! I grow tired of this so-called alliance. I've wanted for that miserable Ork's skull and I shall have it as my cup!

tc_text: 我們先要保住泰坦，再對付這些毒蛇。只有這樣我們才能裝滿血窟並讓它滿出來。
en_text: We will first move to secure the Titan and then deal with that venomous snake. Only then shall we fill the Blood Pit to its rim and set it overflowing.

tc_text: 這樣…泰坦終究是我的!
en_text: Then... the Titan will at last be mine!

tc_text: 史泰恩死了!他的頭現在我的尖刺上!這裡還有很多空間可以放你的頭，克魯爾!!
en_text: Sturnnz dead! Dis here is his head on my pointy stik! Dere's still enuff space fer yer head on dis pike, Crull!

tc_text: 小心對待我的戰利品，葛加茲。我會從你冰冷的屍體上拿到它。
en_text: Careful with my trophy, Gorgutz. I'll soon be claiming it from your frozen carcass.

tc_text: The Blood Pits are, ah, ready for the sacrifices, milord.
en_text: The Blood Pits are, ah, ready for the sacrifices, milord.

tc_text: 那就快點!我們收集的血越多，就可以越快滿足恐虐血神，泰坦就會越快成為我們的。但是在你離開之前，處決那些讓我覺得羞愧的戰士。
en_text: Then get to it! The faster we gather the blood to appease Khorne, the faster the Titan is ours. But before you leave, execute that pitiful excuse for a soldier for embarrassing me!

tc_text: 我必須準備血窟的祭品，那些意志薄弱的防衛軍應該可以滿足恐虐血神。
en_text: I must ready the sacrifices for the Blood Pits, and the weak-willed Guardsmen will serve well as offerings for Khorne.

tc_text: 但是，我必須先附身在他們身上。
en_text: For that, however, I must Possess them first.

tc_text: 不!神靈族已經召喚了戰神分身。除非我們行動快一點，要不然所有的計畫就會失敗!巫師，聽從我的命令。撤回血窟並且準備給戰神分身現形時一個驚喜!
en_text: No! The Eldar have summoned an Avatar. This will undo everything unless we act quickly! Sorcerer, heed me well. Retreat to the Blood Pits and prepare a surprise worthy of the Avatar's presence!

tc_text: 我已經到達血窟了，我的主人。您有什麼吩咐?
en_text: I have arrived at the Blood Pits, milord. What would you ask of me?

tc_text: 沒有比這更重要的…以我們現有的力量不能與戰神分身戰鬥，但是你會成為他的滅亡!
en_text: Nothing more than this... we cannot fight the Avatar with what we possess, but you shall be his downfall!

tc_text: 奉在所有黑暗之處流血的蟲眼之名，奉永不復原的傷口之命…我召喚你，嗜血狂魔，從最黑暗的深淵現身!現在戰神分身將面對他的敵人!
en_text: By the Worm Eye that bleeds in all the dark places, by the wound that never heals... I summon you, Blood Thirster, from the darkest depths of the Warp! Now the Avatar will face his better!

tc_text: The vessel of Khorne
神靈族竟然敢攻擊我的基地!我將會把他們軟弱的骨頭折成兩半，並用他們的血來潤溼我的雙手!
en_text: The Eldar dare attack my base! I will break their frail bones in half and rinse my hands in their blood!

tc_text: 不…完全不行。我不能控制這種部隊。
en_text: No... they won't do at all. I cannot control that type of squad.

tc_text: 我有我的極限…目標部隊對我的靈力來講太遠了。
en_text: I have my limits... the target squad is far beyond the reaches of my mind control.

tc_text: 我一次只能操控一個小隊。
en_text: I can only dominate one squad at a time.

tc_text: 我鄙視這種奸計，但是我們必須偵查戰場。讓叛教徒滲入敵陣會對我很有幫助。
en_text: I despise the need for such trickery, but we must scout the battlefield. Infiltrated Cultists will serve me well, here.

tc_text: 這些乏味的巫師死得太容易。沒關係。他們就像蒼蠅一樣…召喚另一個。我要更多的血!
en_text: These pathetic Sorcerers break too easily. No matter, they are like flies... summon another. I will have more blood! .

tc_text: 我們看看帝國猿人跟我的附魔混沌星際戰士作戰會有什麼結果!
en_text: Let's us see how well the Imperial Ogryns fare against my Possessed Marines!

tc_text: 我已操控了帝國防衛軍!他們的心智已在我的掌控下。
en_text: I've dominated the Guardsmen! Their minds are mine to play with.

tc_text: 很好，讓血奔流吧!我，也只有我自己，會成為恐虐的精選戰士…他最愛之隨從及第一戰士。而且今天泰坦將會是我的，你們將會崇拜我，就像你們崇拜你們的神一般!
en_text: Yes! Let the blood flow! I and I alone, will be Khorne's chosen... his favoured acolyte and prime among his champions. And on that day when the Titan is mine, you will all worship me as you do the Gods!

tc_text: 只要泰坦是我的，我會用我的手掌捏碎太陽。我會攻擊那個假的地球帝皇。我要用我的鐵指捏死他及他的黃金王座!更多!要更多的血來祭拜血神!
en_text: Once the Titan is mine, I will crush entire suns in the palm of my hand. I will stride down the halls of the Heathen Emperor and I will grind him and the Golden Throne of Terra between my iron fingers! More! More blood for the Blood God!

tc_text: 這真是瘋狂。克魯爾領主以為他可以扭轉歐克蠻人"吼~~~~!!"的浪潮，但是連葛加茲也無法真正控制這股憤怒之浪。戰爭頭目的智慧也只不過是沒有擋在這片浪潮的去路而已。可惜，我不覺得克魯爾有同樣的智慧。
en_text: This is madness. Lord Crull believes he can sway the course of this Ork WAAAGH!, but not even Gorgutz truly masters this tide of rage. The Warboss is merely smart enough not to stand in its way. Pity I cannot claim the same of Crull.

tc_text: 那些石化蜥蜴級自走炮並不是懼妖的對手。殲滅他們很容易。
en_text: Those Basilisks are nothing compared to our Horrors. They will fall easily.

tc_text: 現在來玩玩。用我們的猛禽戰士來攻擊這些可笑的石化蜥蜴級自走炮。
en_text: Now for some sport. Time to pit our Raptors against those pathetic Basilisks.

tc_text: 這些靈能者絕不是我恐虐狂戰士的對手
en_text: Those Psykers are no match against my Khorne Berzerkers.

tc_text: 看看這些靈能者在巫師的滅亡雷劈前毀滅。
en_text: Watch as these Psykers crumble before Sorcerer Doombolts.

tc_text: 嗜血狂魔還是太遠了!把他移到戰神分身旁!
en_text: The Bloodthirster isn't near enough yet! Bring him closer to the Avatar!

tc_text: 這是什麼!笨蛋!這不是戰神分身!只有戰神分身才配得嗜血狂魔去對付!
en_text: What is this! Fool! This is no Avatar! Only an Avatar is worthy of the Bloodthirster's... attention!

tc_text: 這些帝國防衛軍是我的!但是我必須先領導他們到血窟去。
en_text: The Guardsmen are mine! But I must lead them back to the Blood Pits first.

要進入那巨大閃亮的東西，我們必須要穿越大門，嗯，我們最好炸掉那個控制它的東西!

tc_text: 破壞神靈族基地
弱小的神靈族正在逃跑!抓住他們!
en_text: Puny Eldar are trying to run from us! Get em!

tc_text: 破壞防護罩
這些帝國守衛軍製造了一個圍繞泰坦的防護罩，以為可以阻止我們!我們必須破壞它!泰坦就在我們的手掌心了!
en_text: The pathetic Imperial Guard have created a Psychic Shield around their Titan, like that will stop us! We must break through it! The Titan is within our grasp!

tc_text: 抵達泰坦
我要先取得泰坦，這樣就可以在這個像雪球般的星球上拿到所有的好頭骨。
en_text: Weze gonna get to dat Titan first, dat way I can make sure ta get ALL da good skulls on dis ice ball of a planet.

tc_text: 殺死先知泰迪爾
那先知在戰鬥中表現還不錯，她的頭骨在我的頭目尖刺上會很好看!
en_text: Dat Farseer is pretty good in a fight, her skull on my boss pole will look even gooder!

tc_text: 葛加茲!這是什麼意思?
en_text: Gorgutz! What is the meaning of this?

tc_text: 我想是該收集一些神靈族頭骨的時刻了!我聽說先知有很好的頭骨…
en_text: It'z time I got me some Eldar skullz! I hear dere Farseer got a pretty skull.

tc_text: 別碰泰坦，歐克蠻人…如果敢搶我的獎勵，我就搶走你的四肢!
en_text: Just stay clear of the Titan Ork... try to rob me of my prize and I'll rob you of your limbs!

tc_text: 你太擔心那個泰坦了，克魯爾。它讓你瞎了眼。或許我應該幫你摧毀它…讓你專注在更重要的東西上…例如贏得這場勝利!
en_text: You'z too worried about dat Titan, Crull. Makez you blind. Maybe I should destroy it fer ya... keep yer mind on important tings... like winnin'!

tc_text: 泰坦是惟一值得擁有的獎勵!你再向它靠近一步，我的手指就會戳入你那油膩的眼睛裡。
en_text: The Titan is the only prize worth having! Take another step towards it and I will drive my thumbs into your greasy eye pits.

tc_text: 那帝國軍把你打得慘兮兮。你很懦弱!新的榔頭，就是我!我的"吼~~~~!"是無法阻擋的。你有什麼?什麼都沒有!
en_text: Da Imperial boyz smashed you good. You'z weak! Da new hammer, Crull, iz me! My WAAAGH! iz unstoppable. What you got? Nuttin!

tc_text: 我有足夠的人可以佔領控制城門。而誰控制大門，就控制這場戰役的命運!
en_text: I have enough men to seize the Control Gate. And who controls the gate, controls the fate of this battle!

tc_text: 我是有史以來最大，最壞的戰爭頭目!
en_text: I am da biggest, baddest Warboss dere is!

tc_text: 葛加茲!泰坦是我的，你聽見了嗎?我的!
en_text: Gorgutz! The Titan is mine, do you hear? Mine!

tc_text: 你跟小鬼一樣!泰坦是我的。我先到的!我控制著大門!
en_text: Youz a Gretchin git! Da Titan iz mine. I got here first! I control da gate!

tc_text: 別傻了!即使你有了泰坦，你也不知道怎麼操控它。
en_text: Don't be a fool! Even if you have the Titan, you don't know how to operate it.

tc_text: 泰坦對我來說沒有價值。所以我要把它打成廢鐵。
en_text: Da Titan iz worthless ta me. Dat's why I'm gonna pound it inta scrap.

tc_text: 不行!泰坦支配者是有史以來最偉大的戰爭機器。
en_text: You can't! The Titan Dominatus is one of the greatest war machines ever constructed.

tc_text: 你錯了!最偉大的戰爭機器是歐克蠻人的"吼~~~!"
en_text: Wrong ya git! Da greatest war machine is da Ork WAAAGH! We don't need no damn tinker'traption to be strong... we iz strong!

tc_text: 聽聽他們!叫得所有的星球都聽得到…
en_text: Listen to em'! Screamin' wid one voice across da whole planet...

tc_text: 你會後悔的，葛加茲!我對你發誓,我會拔你的皮抽你的骨頭然後吃了你的眼睛!所有的部隊…衝擊大門!
en_text: You'll regret this, Gorgutz! I swear to you, I'll rip the flesh from your bones and eat your eyes! All remaining units... charge the gate!

tc_text: 好!泰坦是我的了，歐克蠻人。去死吧！幾天前你就該死了！
en_text: Yes! The Titan is mine, Ork. Now rot! Rot as you should have done days ago!

tc_text: 如果不是我的話，你早就死了，克魯爾!!
en_text: If it wazn't fer me, you'd be dead, Crull!

tc_text: 你也是一樣，歐克蠻人。但是我讓你活下來，所以你才可以為我作戰…只是為了這個原因!你是隻好狗，現在去死吧!
en_text: So would you, Ork. But I spared your life so you could fight my battles... nothing more! You've been a good dog... now die.

tc_text: 也許我們歐克蠻人會做的事只有戰鬥及死，但是你知道嗎?我們很厲害而且我們會贏!
en_text: Maybe all we Ork boyz do is fight n' die, but ya know what? We'z good at it and we'z still gonna win!

tc_text: 但是為何我們會輸…?
什麼?你在跟我講話?
我以為你是最大，最壞的頭目。那為什麼我們輸了?
en_text: We thought you waz da biggest, baddest Boss. Why we lose, den?

tc_text: 現在我還是比你大隻!!還有誰想多話的?哈?
en_text: I still bigger den youz! Now! Who else been doin' da tinking? Huh?

tc_text: 你以為你可以殺掉我!我是最大的歐克蠻人，讓我看看你有什麼厲害之處!
en_text: You think you can take me! I'z da biggest Ork here. Show me what ya got!

tc_text: 現在走到這種情況了…和你這種卑鄙外星人一起面對我的最後一戰，而不是和勇敢的史泰恩那種人一起!
en_text: That it comes to this... facing my last battle with filthy aliens like yourself at my side rather than valiant men like Sturnn!

tc_text: 那麼人類，感激這個宇宙吧。它就有奇異的力量可以嘲笑我們的不幸。祝你好運。
en_text: Then appreciate the universe, human. It possesses the strange ability to laugh in the face of our misfortune. Good luck to you.

tc_text: 準備好自己的裝備，弟兄們!給這些異星人看看什麼是勇氣。
en_text: Prepare yourselves, men! Show these aliens the meaning of valor.

tc_text: 是的，姊妹們…要堅強。給這些人類看看什麼是尊嚴。
en_text: Indeed, sisters... stand strong. Show these humans the meaning of dignity.

tc_text: 帝國軍竟敢派泰坦駕駛員來偷取我的獎賞?不能讓他們抵達泰坦。我必須在他們盜取我的榮耀前，阻止並毀滅他們。
en_text: The Imperials dare send a Titan crew to steal my prize? They cannot reach the Titan first. I must stop and destroy them before they rob me of glory.

tc_text: 那先知有她的新玩意兒，她是我的。在我殺死她之後，我要把她的頭骨插在我的尖刺上…。
en_text: Dat Farseer iz wid her contraption, and she'z all mine fer da takin'. I'll plant her head on my Skull Stik... after I kill her good.

tc_text: 泰坦就像皇冠等著國王ㄧ樣地在等著我。只要我得到它，我就會將整個世界吞沒，並且用血噴灑整個星系，讓它們冷卻下來。
en_text: The Titan awaits me like a crown awaiting its King. And once it is in my grasp, I will drown entire worlds and quench the heat of the stars in spilt blood.

tc_text: 等到今天結束時，我的事蹟將會用數百萬人的血來書寫。那會是怎麼樣的內容呢?
en_text: By day's end, my deeds will be scripture inked in the blood of millions. How can this be anything other than fate?

tc_text: 出發，出發，出發！
en_text: ‘Ere we go, ‘ere we go, ‘ere we go!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人, 歐克蠻人, 歐克蠻人, 歐克蠻人!
另一個死了，另一個在這裡!
en_text: Annuder one dead, annuder one dere!

tc_text: Annuder one dead, annuder one dere!
en_text: Annuder one dead, annuder one dere!

使用你的靈能者，領導偽帝皇的信仰者到達獻祭窟，接受毀滅。但是要保護他們的軍營，若是沒有它，我們就沒有足夠的新鮮血液可用…
en_text: Using your Tainted Psyker, lead the believers of the False Emperor to their doom at our sacrificial pits. However, take care with their bases. Without their barracks we will not have a supply of fresh blood...

tc_text: 破壞死靈族浮石巨塔
死靈族威脅著我們剛佔領的泰坦!他們軍隊的弱點似乎是死靈族浮石巨塔。摧毀死靈族浮石巨塔!等泰坦的重型武器可以運作時，就可以使用它們。
en_text: The Necrons threaten our newly possessed Titan! The weak point of their force appears to be the Monoliths. Destroy these Monoliths! We may use the Titan heavy weapons when they become operational.

tc_text: 佔領泰坦部位
靈能者蒐集了足夠的血來取悅血神。使用佔領的能力，前去佔領泰坦的各部位。
en_text: The Tainted Psykers have collected enough blood to please the Blood God. Go forth and capture the Titan pieces through possession.

tc_text: 建造惡魔坑
如果我們要釋放出恐虐旗下最強大的惡魔－無法阻擋的混沌毀滅者，以及表現出對恐虐最大敬意的嗜血狂魔－就必須建造一個惡魔坑。
en_text: We must build a Daemon Pit if we are to unleash Khorne's greatest gifts; the unstoppable Obliterators and the ultimate tribute to Khorne, the Bloodthirster.

tc_text: 混沌總部必須生存
我們不能讓最為神聖的建築落入恐虐的敵人手中。不惜任何代價來保護它們!
en_text: We cannot let our most sacred of structures fall to the enemies of Khorne. Protect it at all costs!

tc_text: 為恐虐奪取泰坦
我們來奪取泰坦了!它將屬於我們，否則願恐虐吸食我們的靈魂!
en_text: We have come to claim the Titan! It will be ours or Khorne will feast upon our souls!

tc_text: 用血來祭祀血神!用血來祭祀血神!用血來祭祀血神!
en_text: Blood for the Blood God! Blood for the Blood God! Blood for the Blood God!

tc_text: 用血來祭祀血神!但是我們需要更多的祭品!飼養更多的帝國羊來屠宰。給恐虐更多的血，要不然我就把你殘破的身體擰乾。更多的祭品!更多的死亡!更多的光榮大屠殺!
en_text: Blood for the Blood God! But we need more sacrifices! Herd the Imperial lambs to the slaughter. Bring Khorne His fill or I'll wring what I need from your broken bodies. More sacrifices! More death! More glorious carnage!

tc_text: 什麼?這是什麼?
死靈族在這裡??好像整個宇宙聯合起來要來竊取我的獎賞!夠了!恐虐信徒注意聽我的命令!
en_text: Necrons! Here? It seems the universe itself conspires to rob me of my prize! Enough! Attention Followers of Khorne!

tc_text: 擊退入侵者…保護泰坦，直到巫師完成佔領。只有泰坦可以擊敗我們的敵人!到時候，即使眾神現身也不能阻止我們。
en_text: Repel the invaders... protect the Titan until the vermin-sorcerers complete its possession. Only with the Titan can we best our foes! Not even the Gods will stand in our way, then.

tc_text: 泰坦是我的了!讓命運屈服在我的野心下!這個宇宙將明白恐虐的旨意。顫抖吧…驚恐吧!這是你們最後的時刻，羅恩五號星。我的統治將會顛覆天堂，直到血流成河。
en_text: The Titan is mine! Let destiny submit itself to my ambition! The universe will know the will of Khorne. Tremble... quake! These are your final hours, Lorn V. My reign will turn the heavens, themselves, crimson.

tc_text: 看看你的新神。它真是嚇人!從這個世界開始，我會征服另一個世界，之後再一個!恐虐會為了這些屠殺而給我獎賞。
en_text: Behold your new God. Is he not terrible to behold! From this world, I will conquer the next, and the one after that! Khorne will surely reward me for the slaughter.

tc_text: 你要瞭解ㄧ點!接下來不是戰爭!而是奉祂的名進行永無止境的祭祀。用血祭祀血神…讓整個宇宙被血淹沒!
en_text: Know this! What will come to pass is no longer war! It is endless sacrifice in His name. Blood for the Blood God... let the universe drown in it!

tc_text: 靈能者在我的奴役下。我會用他們來引誘帝國防衛軍到血窟來做祭品。有他們的血，泰坦將會是我的!
en_text: The Psykers are under my thrall. I will use them to lure Imperial Guardsmen to the Blood Pits for sacrifice, and with their blood, the Titan will be mine!

tc_text: 但是靈能者必須要小心。敵人的指揮官一定會懷疑我的計畫，並且會保護他的部下。
en_text: But the Psykers must be wary. The enemy's Commissars surely suspect my plan and will have taken steps to save their men.

tc_text: 死靈族…他們的戰爭貪婪比這個世界還要更寒冷!他們嘗起來像灰燼!至少屍體還知道什麼時候該停止戰鬥。
en_text: Necrons... their battle lust colder than even this world! They taste like ash! At least corpses know when to stop fighting.

tc_text: 告訴所有恐虐信徒…跟死靈族作戰，直到泰坦的靈魂復甦!然後我們就可以用武器來摧毀死靈族浮石巨塔!
en_text: To all Followers of Khorne... fight the Necrons until the Titan's spirit awakens! Then we can use its armaments to destroy the Monoliths!

tc_text: 血窟裝滿了帝國精英的血水!這個時刻是我的!你，巫師…證明你們對恐虐還有些許的用途吧。
en_text: The Blood Pits overflow with the red ichor of the Imperium's finest! The moment is mine! You, Sorcerers... prove your lowly worth to Khorne.

tc_text: 利用你們的力量，一個部位一個部位地佔領泰坦。把我的獎賞帶來，要不然我要你們死!
en_text: Use your powers to possess the Titan piece by piece. Bring me my prize or I will bring you your deaths!

tc_text: 我快要登基了!我的榮耀之時!帝國守衛軍，歐克蠻人，死靈族…他們都以為可以阻礙我的最終勝利…可以阻止我的命運。
en_text: My ascension is at hand! My hour of glory! The Imperial Guard, the Orks, the Necrons... all thought they could stand between me and my ultimate triumph... that they could rob me of my destiny.

tc_text: 他們會因為自己的自大而付出代價，我會蒐集他們的頭骨來回報他們。
en_text: They will pay for their arrogance, a tribute I shall collect in skulls.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍還沒被擊敗!找出他們的武器倉庫。他們還有帝國武裝部隊。
en_text: The Imperials are not yet beaten! Find their weapons depot. It contains the remnants of the Imperial armor forces.

tc_text: 我的主人…重型武器接上線了!
en_text: Milord... the heavy weapons are online!

tc_text: 希望我們還沒有失去優勢。移動它們，讓它們面向死靈族浮石巨塔。讓我們獻身於恐虐的榮耀吧！
en_text: Pray we did not lose the advantage, worm. Bring them to bear on the Monoliths. Let us exact our retribution for the glory of Khorne!

tc_text: 好!我們已經取得一個泰坦的部位!都是因為我的功勞!
en_text: Yes! We have captured a Titan piece! All praise to ME!

tc_text: 我們得到泰坦的一個部位!我幾乎可以嘗到大屠殺的滋味了!
en_text: We've captured a piece of the Titan! I can almost taste the carnage!

tc_text: 好，很好!拿到泰坦的另一個部位，使我更加榮耀!
en_text: Yes, YES! More glory to me and another Titan piece in my grasp!

tc_text: 我得到泰坦的一個部位，很快就會再得到另一個!
en_text: A piece of the Titan is mine, soon followed by another!

tc_text: 血神的榮耀呀!泰坦的最後一個部位是我的了!
en_text: Glory to the Blood God! The final piece of the Titan is now MINE!

tc_text: 這些死靈族太容易了…看看這些死靈族浮石巨塔是怎麼墜毀的!
en_text: These Necrons are too easy... see how their Monoliths fall!

tc_text: 至少這些死靈族浮石巨塔爆炸得好!
en_text: At least the Monoliths explode well, I'll give them that!

tc_text: 又一個死靈族浮石巨塔被摧毀了!掉落在廢墟裡吧!
en_text: Another Monolith torn down! Salt the ruins for good measure!

tc_text: 看著這座死靈族浮石巨塔墜落，看看死靈族的恐懼眼神!
en_text: Watch this Monolith fall and see the fear in the Necrons' eyes!

tc_text: 撕碎死靈族浮石巨塔並繼續攻擊!
en_text: Tear the Monolith down and keep at their throats!

tc_text: 死靈族浮石巨塔墜落，他們的野心也跟著墜落!
en_text: With this Monolith, so falls the ambition of the Necrons!

tc_text: 重型武器上線了!利用它來把敵人打成廢墟!
en_text: Heavy weapons are online! Use them to bring ruin to the enemy!

那些人類防衛軍一直騷擾我們…摧毀前線基地!吼~~~~~!
en_text: Da humie guardz ova dere are annoyin’ gits dat keep attackin’ us… Destroy dere outposts and make ‘em Orky! Waaagh!!

tc_text: 破壞泰坦支配者的部位
en_text: Damage Guns of the Titan Dominatus

tc_text: 那些奇怪的人類實在有夠笨，他們根本不知道我們在這裡!他們實在太愛這個泰坦!哈哈哈!讓我們把"吼~~~~~!!"帶給泰坦!
en_text: Da weird humies are a dumb lot, they don’t even notice we Orks are 'ere! Dey loves da Titan so much! Har har har! Let’s bring our Waaagh! to da Titan!

tc_text: 找到克魯爾並且跟他一對一挑戰。
en_text: Reach Crull and Challenge Him to a Duel

tc_text: 克魯爾想要戰鬥?哈哈!讓我們把"吼~~~~!!"帶給他!
en_text: Crull wants a fight? Har har! Let’s bring da Waaagh! to HIM!

tc_text: 摧毀泰坦部位來使克魯爾憤怒
en_text: Destroy Titan Guns to Spite Crull

tc_text: 這些人類都喜歡這個泰坦。讓我們把它搶走並摧毀它!
en_text: Da humies all luv dis Titan. Let’s take it away from dem and destroy it!

tc_text: 結束跟克魯爾的決鬥
這些士兵很強，但沒有比歐克蠻人還強!現在，我們必須找到克魯爾並且把他殺死!吼~~~~!
en_text: Doze dead boyz were tuff, but not tough enuff for us Orks! Now, we must find Crull and finish ‘im good! Waaagh!

tc_text: 擊敗死靈族
這些士兵很強，但是歐克蠻人知道怎麼戰鬥!碾碎，擊潰並且毀滅這些死的士兵!
en_text: Deze dead boyz are sure tuff. But we Orks know a ‘ting or two about fightin’ as well! Crush, smash, and destroy da dead boyz!

tc_text: 戰利品
混沌軍團沒有地方可以逃跑了!是蒐集頭骨的時間了!克魯爾在我的尖刺上會很好看!
en_text: Da Chaos boyz 'ave nowhere ta run! Time ta collect some skullz! Crull's will look good when itz on a stik!

tc_text: 讓我看看…"吼~~~~!!"進度很好，但是少了一些東西…
en_text: Letz see.... Da WAAAGH! is goin' good, but dere'z someting missin'....

tc_text: 更多的頭骨?
沒錯!看…我有了所有的戰爭頭目的頭骨，史泰恩的頭骨，還有那個先知的頭骨。所以我還少了什麼?歐，對了，克魯爾的。我要他的頭骨放在我的尖刺上!你們知道我要怎麼讓他來找我?
en_text: Dat'z it! See... I got me da skullz of all da Warbosses I killed... Sturnnz skull and dat Farseerz skull. So who I missin'? Oh yeah! That git Crull. I need hiz head fer my pointy stik! And you know how I'm getting' him ta come after me?

tc_text: 叫他小鬼?
這算是一個計畫:白癡計劃!用你做名字!不…要讓克魯爾氣得發瘋，只要攻擊他的泰坦就可以!然後他就會來找我…為什麼你在偷笑?
en_text: We'll call dat Plan: Stupid! I named it after ya! No... da way ta get Crull crazy mad iz ta attack hiz Titan! Den he'll come fer me... Hey! Why'z you grinnin'?

tc_text: 因為你用我的名字來命名計畫!
en_text: Because you named a plan after me!

tc_text: 我知道這些人。死靈族!這是很好的屠殺!嘿!為什麼我沒有它們的頭骨?現在要改變了…現在要給死靈族"吼~~~~~!"然後我們再去把克魯爾的頭骨放在我的尖刺上!
en_text: I know dese guyz. Dese Necron boyz! Dem'z good killin! Hey! Why'z it I got none of dere skullz? Time ta change dat! Alright all ya gretchin-lovin' Orks... it'z time ta introduce da Necronz to da WAAAGH! Den we'll get Crull'z skull fer my stik!

tc_text: 把敗他們，打到死靈族撤退為止。
en_text: Beat ‘em down till da Necronz go runnin'.

tc_text: 我成功了!我打敗了其他的戰爭頭目，帝國軍人類，神靈族，混沌軍團，還有死靈族。這真是一個好"吼~~~~~!!"
en_text: I did it! I beat da udder Warbosses, da Imperial humies, da Eldar, dose Chaos boyz and even dem Necronz. Dat waz a good WAAAGH!

tc_text: 而你的尖刺上充滿了頭骨。真是好看的戰利品!但是我們現在要做什麼?已經沒有人可以打了!
en_text: And yer pointy stik got plenty of dem skullz. Dose are pretty trophies! But what you gonna do next, huh Warboss? Dere's nobody left to beat!

tc_text: 我是這個星球最大，最壞的戰爭頭目!不知道最近的星球在哪裡…
en_text: Dat's right. I da biggest, baddest Warboss on da planet! I wonder where da nearest udda planet is...

帝國軍人類已經潰散…但是他們還在反抗!他們配得一場公平的戰爭。快點殺光這些人類，好讓我們可以找到克魯爾。
en_text: Da Imperial humies are scattered, but dey still got some fight in dem! Dey deserve a battle all good n' proper. Time to kill dese humies quick so we'z can take our time with dat git Crull.

tc_text: 尋找並殺光剩下的帝國護衛軍。
en_text: Find and kill da remainin' Imperialz.

tc_text: 這就是我比克魯爾聰明的地方!要找到克魯爾，我們必須把他的士兵殺光。意思就是，一直攻擊泰坦，克魯爾不得不派他的近身護衛來保護泰坦。
en_text: Dis here iz why'z I'm smarter den Crull! Ta reach Crull, we'z gonna have ta rob him of his boyz. Dat meanz, attack da Titan so Crull got no choice but ta send his bodyguardz to protect ta Titan.

tc_text: 歐!殺死這些死靈族有什麼樂趣?他們已經死了!
en_text: Oi! Where da fun in killin' dese Necrons!? Dey already dead!

tc_text: 跟死靈族打鬥很有趣!我想知道他們為何攻擊?啊…神靈族應該知道，但是他們死了。所以只剩下克魯爾跟我而已!
en_text: Fightin' dem Necronz waz fun! I wonder why dey attacked? Eh... da Eldar probably knew and dey dead now. So it'z just Crull n' me now!

tc_text: 是拿取他的頭骨的時候了!
你這懦夫!來攻擊我吧!或是你害怕會反擊的對手?
en_text: You coward! Attack me instead! Or are you too afraid to attack someone who fights back?

tc_text: 離開泰坦!你這惡毒的害蟲!
en_text: Get away from the Titan! It's mine you puss-filled vermin!

tc_text: 你在哪，葛加茲?你太害怕，所以不敢自己來攻擊泰坦?
en_text: Where are you, Gorgutz? Too afraid to attack the Titan yourself?

tc_text: 敢碰那個泰坦，我發誓我會殺了你。我會殺了你!
en_text: Touch the Titan and I swear I'll kill you. I'll kill you!

tc_text: 我會把你的內臟掏出來…我要把你送到恐虐的神威下及沸騰的熱血下!
en_text: I'll gut you... I'll send down Khorne's wrath upon your heads and boil the blood from your veins!

tc_text: 他們還以為他們可以跟我們戰鬥?讓我想想如果一隻球菌怪在這裡我們會怎麼做!
en_text: Dey still tink dey can fight us? Let'z see how dey do now dat da Squiggoths are here!

tc_text: 你們小鬼總算到了。我們正在取得"吼~~~~!!"的勝利!你們這些新的小子，快去戰鬥!
en_text: About time you gretching gitz got here. We'z tryin' to win a WAAAGH! All you new boyz... get out dere and fight!

tc_text: 克魯爾!你那漂亮的頭骨是我的!
en_text: Crull! Yer pretty skull iz mine!

tc_text: 別以為你可以逃走!我有一根刻有你名字的尖刺!
en_text: Don't tink you'z runnin'! I gotz a nice pointy stik wid yer name on it!

tc_text: 過來!你讓我追你的時間拖得越長，我就讓你死得更痛苦！
en_text: Come ‘ere! The more'z ya make me run after ya, da longerz I take in killin' ya!

tc_text: 克魯爾!我的小子和我要拿你的頭來玩!我的意思是…反正你也用不著!
en_text: Crull! Da boyz ‘n me need yer head to play wid! I mean... you ain't usin' it!

tc_text: 那些迷失的小子們正是我們要找的!他們正躲在卑劣轟炸機附近!
en_text: Dere dose Ork Lost Boyz we been lookin' for! Dey been hidin' near dere skunked bomba!

tc_text: 然後，等克魯爾的護衛死得差不多了，只剩下他…我們就攻擊他，並拿走他的頭骨!
en_text: Den, when enuff of Crull'z boyz are gone, leavin' him weak... we attack Crull and take hiz skull!

tc_text: 好了各位，打仗的時候到了！
en_text: All right men, time to wage war!

tc_text: 我來效命！
準備好了。
讓我帶路﹗
帝皇的手帶領我們。
en_text: The hand of the Emperor guides all.

tc_text: 我會聽你的命令。
en_text: I will do as you ask.

tc_text: 我的榮幸。
勝利在那裡等候我們。
理解。
絕對服從。
恐懼不算什麼，我的信心很堅強。
en_text: Fear is nought, my faith is strong.

tc_text: 真正的僕人絕不懷疑。
en_text: A true servant never yields to doubt.

tc_text: 進爭論。 攻擊﹗
趕走他們，沒有四分之一﹗
在你的狂怒裡毫不節省﹗
面對皇帝的權力﹗
讓我們馬上就走。
en_text: Let us be on our way.

tc_text: 然後的全部適當速度﹗
我將從這裡走。
我們正著火﹗
趕走他們﹗
堅守你的立場﹗
讓他們攻擊﹗ 我將有他們的心﹗
en_text: Let them attack! I will have their hearts!

tc_text: 拉回，拉回﹗
撤退並且重新組合﹗
不﹗ 我將不接受這戰敗﹗
en_text: No! I will not accept this defeat!

tc_text: 我們再次準備好戰鬥﹗
en_text: We again stand ready to fight!

tc_text: 為了帝皇的光榮﹗
只有在死過程中職責才結束。
en_text: Only in death does duty end.

tc_text: 我用皇帝的拳頭罷工﹗
en_text: I strike with the Emperor's fist!

tc_text: 在他們站的地方殺死他們﹗
在我的邊旁邊，老兄﹗
對我﹗ 為帶有光榮﹗
en_text: To me! There is glory for the taking!

tc_text: 皇帝現下引導你。
火力控制，啟動掃射槍！

tc_text: 在已知之宇宙的邊緣有一個星球，稱為羅恩五號星。這個星球因為從帝國防衛軍手中失陷於混沌軍團，所以戰爭再次展開。泰坦，一部在火星的火山頂進行建造，可以扭轉戰場情勢的戰爭機器，失落在一個寒冷的城市中。史泰恩將軍率領著帝國防衛軍，必須取回這個曾經屬於他們的武器，而神祕的神靈族則正在等候難以言喻的恐怖到來...
en_text: On the edge of known space rests the ice planet, Lorn V. Lost to the Imperium and conquered by Chaos, Lorn V will once more be a planet of war. A Titan, forged in the volcanic furnaces of Mars and capable of redirecting the course of war, lies lost in a frozen city. The Imperial Guard, led by General Sturnn, must recapture what was once theirs, while the mysterious Eldar prepare for the arrival of an unspeakable horror...

tc_text: 羅恩五號星，好似被混沌軍團永遠佔據的冰雪世界。當歐克蠻人持續地攻擊混沌領主克魯爾及他的軍隊時，他們沒有發現埋在他們腳底下的祕寶。一具隱藏在冰雪廢墟城市中的帝國泰坦，將驅使瘋狂嗜血的混沌領主走上他最偉大的征服之旅，同時將有一個歐克蠻人的戰爭頭目加入戰爭，並帶領全星球的蠻人起來怒吼！
en_text: Lorn V, ice world on the edge of known space has been under Chaos control for what would seem an eternity. Whilst Orks wage incessant battles against the Chaos Lord Crull and his forces, all are unaware of the prize beneath their feet. Hidden in the heart of a ruined city, an Imperial Titan will drive the blood-crazed Chaos Lord toward his greatest conquest, while an Ork Warboss will join the battle and lead a planetwide WAAAGH!

tc_text: 選取野戰司令部
只要在野戰司令部上按一下滑鼠左鍵，即可將其選取起來。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵即可將其選取。
en_text: Left-click the Field Command to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: hint text
建立一支帝國防衛軍部隊
選擇你的總部並建立一支帝國防衛軍部隊。堡壘隨時可以徵召帝國防衛軍，他們是帝國防衛軍的主幹部隊。
en_text: Select your Field Command and build a Guardsmen Squad. Guardsmen are always available from the Stronghold. They are the backbone of any Imperial Guard army.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍提示文字
佔領戰略位置
若要佔領戰略位置，請出動帝國防衛軍部隊。佔領並鞏固戰略位置之後，我方將會獲得更多軍備。
en_text: Use a Guardsmen Squad to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 建立機器主教
請使用你的總部來建立機器主教。當你想要建造其他建築物時，便需要用到機器主教。你可以隨時透過總部建立機器主教。
en_text: Select your Field Command to build a Techpriest Enginseer. Enginseers are required to build additional structures. Enginseers are always available from the Field Command.

tc_text: 建立一座監聽哨
你必須使用機器主教來建立監聽哨。一旦將監聽哨建立於某個戰略位置上方，便能確保該戰略位置的安全性，使其免於遭到敵人攻佔，同時還能提升該戰略位置所生產的軍備數量。
en_text: You must use your Techpriest Enginseer to build a Listening Post. Listening Posts are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increasing the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: hint text
建立一座電漿發電機
請出動機器主教建立一座電漿發電機。電漿發電機提供特殊部隊、武器、載具、建築物和技能所需要的電力。電力是你在「戰鎚」遊戲中必須管理的第二種資源。
en_text: Use your Techpriest Enginseer to build a Plasma Generator. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: hint text
選擇機器主教並建造步兵總部。
en_text: Select your Techpriest Enginseer and build an Infantry Command.

tc_text: 你可以在步兵總部建造更多帝國防衛軍及更高級的帝國防衛軍步兵部隊。
en_text: The Infantry Command is the structure where you can build additional Guardsmen and more advanced Imperial Guard infantry units.

tc_text: hint text
增援你的帝國防衛軍
使用增援功能，為你的防衛軍小隊增加部隊。如果你在戰鬥中失去了一些人員，在戰場上的任何地方都可以進行增援。
en_text: Use the Reinforce function to add units to your Guardsmen Squad. You can Reinforce anywhere in the battlefield to replenish your squads if some of your units fall in battle.

tc_text: hint text
建立政戰軍官
選擇總部並建立政戰軍官，政戰軍官可以大幅提升帝國防衛軍的力量。
en_text: Select the Field Command and build a Commissar. The Commissar greatly enhances the power of your guardsmen.

tc_text: hint text
將政戰軍官加入部隊之中
en_text: Attach your Commissar to a squad

tc_text: 選取我方的政戰軍官，再按一下「加入」按鈕，然後選取你想要讓政戰軍官加入的小隊即可。
en_text: Select your Commissar, click the Attach button, and select the squad you want to attach him to.

tc_text: hint text
建立指揮部隊
選擇步兵總部並建立指揮部隊，指揮部隊足以與其他種族的英雄抗衡。
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and build a Command Squad. The Command Squad can counter the heroes of other races.

tc_text: hint text
建立戰略指揮部
選擇機器主教並建立戰略指揮部。戰略指揮部可以讓你用重型武器為部隊升級，並讓你進行研發。
en_text: Select your Techpriest Enginseer and build a Tactica Control. The Tactica Control will allow you to upgrade your squads with heavy weapons and will give you access to research.

tc_text: hint text
以重型武器為帝國防衛軍升級
en_text: Upgrade your Guardsmen with Heavy Weaponry

tc_text: 選擇帝國防衛軍並按下「升級: 榴彈發射器」按鈕。 這樣可以讓一名帝國防衛軍成員裝備榴彈發射器。
en_text: Select your Guardsmen and click the Upgrade: Grenade Launcher button. This will equip one of your squad members with a grenade launcher.

tc_text: hint text
為帝國防衛軍小隊增加一名士官
en_text: Add a Sergeant to your Guardsmen squad

tc_text: 選擇帝國防衛軍，並按下「升級: 增加 士官」按鈕。 士官可以提升帝國防衛軍的士氣與防禦。
en_text: Select your Guardsmen and click the Upgrade: Add Sergeant button. Sergeants increase the morale and durability of the Guardsmen in the squad.

tc_text: hint text
建造另一支帝國防衛軍，並將它強化到最大力量
en_text: Build another Guardsmen squad and bring it to full strength

tc_text: 選擇步兵總部，再訓練一支防衛軍小隊。將之增援至力量全滿，加入士官，並為部隊裝備重型武器。
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and train another squad of Guardsmen. Reinforce it to full strength, add a Sergeant and outfit the squad with heavy weapons.

tc_text: hint text
建立第二個政戰軍官
選擇總部並生產另一個政戰軍官。
en_text: Select your Field Command and train another Commissar.

tc_text: hint text
讓政戰軍官加入新的小隊
en_text: Attach the Commissar to the new squad

tc_text: 讓新的政戰軍官加入你剛才建立並增援的新小隊。
en_text: Attach your new Commissar to the new squad you recently built and reinforced.

tc_text: hint text
移動你的一個部隊到重遮蔽位置。
en_text: Move one of your squads into heavy cover

tc_text: 帶領你的一支步兵部隊，移動到地圖上標示的位置之一。
en_text: Take one of your infantry squads and move into one of the areas pinged on the map.

tc_text: hint text
占領三個戰略位置並且建造監聽哨。
en_text: Capture three Strategic Points and build listening posts on all three

tc_text: 占領三個戰略位置並且建造監聽哨。
en_text: Capture three Strategic Points and build listening posts on all three.

tc_text: hint text
占領關鍵位置。
選擇一支步兵部隊，並佔領一個關鍵位置(可從地圖上得知)
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and capture a Critical Location (look for the pings on the map).

tc_text: hint text
占領遺址
選擇一支步兵部隊並佔領一個遺址(可從地圖上得知)
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and capture a Relic (look for the pings on the map).

tc_text: hint text
將你的總部升級成作戰司令部。
en_text: Upgrade your Field Command to a Battle Command

tc_text: 選擇你的總部並按下「作戰司令部」升級鈕。
en_text: Select your Field Command and click the Battle Command upgrade.

tc_text: hint text
建立工研總部
選擇你的機器主教並建立一個工研總部
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build a Mechanized Command.

tc_text: hint text
建立一個哨兵機械人補給站
選擇你的工研總部並按下「哨兵機械人補給站」升級按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Sentinel Depot Addon icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立哨兵機械人
選擇你的工研總部並按下「哨兵機械人」按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Sentinel icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立一個石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站
選擇你的工研總部並按下「石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站」升級按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Basilisk Depot Addon icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立石化蜥蜴級自走砲
選擇你的工研總部並按下「石化蜥蜴級自走砲」按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Basilisk icon.

tc_text: hint text
升級你的總部成為軍團司令部
en_text: Upgrade your Field Command to a Regimental Command

tc_text: 選擇你的總部並按下「軍團司令部」升級按鈕
en_text: Select your Field Command and click the Regimental Command upgrade icon.

tc_text: hint text
升級你的步兵總部為猿人軍營
en_text: Upgrade your Infantry Command with the Ogryn Quarters addon

tc_text: 選擇你的步兵總部並按下「猿人軍營」升級鈕
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and click the Ogryn Quarters addon icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立猿人部隊
選擇你的步兵總部並按下「猿人」按鈕
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and click the Ogryn icon.

tc_text: hint text
升級你的工研總部能夠生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克
en_text: Upgrade your Mechanized Command with the Leman Russ Tank addon

tc_text: 選擇你的工研總部並按下「黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克」升級按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Leman Russ Tank addon icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立一台黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克
選擇你的工研總部並按下「黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克」按鈕
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and click the Leman Russ Tank icon.

tc_text: hint text
建立戰神研發總部
選擇你的機器主教並建造戰神研發總部
en_text: Select your Techpriest Enginseer and build the Mars Pattern Command.

tc_text: hint text
建立毀滅之劍重裝戰車
選擇戰神研發總部並按下「毀滅之劍重裝戰車」按鈕
en_text: Select your Mars Pattern Command and click the Baneblade icon.

tc_text: hint text
讓你的防衛軍駐防在總部裡面
en_text: Garrison your Guardsmen squad inside of your Field Command

tc_text: 選擇你的防衛軍部隊,並以滑鼠右鍵點選總部
en_text: Select your Guardsmen squad and right-click on the Field Command.

tc_text: hint text
從總部將防衛軍傳送到步兵總部
en_text: Transfer your Guardsmen from your Field Command to your Infantry Command

tc_text: 選擇你的步兵總部，並以滑鼠左鍵點選畫面中央下方的防衛軍肖像。
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and left click the Guardsmen portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: hint text
增援你的指揮部隊
按以下其中一個發光的按鈕，加入更多的隊長到你的指揮部隊中。
en_text: Click on one of the flashing icons below to add more leaders to your Command Squad.

tc_text: hint text
選擇鈦總司令部
只要在鈦總司令部上按一下滑鼠左鍵，即可將其選取起來。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵，是將其選取起來的一貫方法。
en_text: Left-click the Cadre Headquarters to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個潛行機兵小隊
選擇你的鈦總司令部，再於畫面下方中間的潛行機兵小隊肖像上按滑鼠左鍵。鈦總司令部隊時供應潛行機兵小隊，他們是你的主要偵察部隊。
en_text: Select your Cadre Headquarters, and left click the Stealth Team portrait in the bottom center of your screen. Stealth Teams are always available from the Cadre Headquarters, and are your main scouting unit.

tc_text: 提示文字
佔領戰略位置
使用一支潛行機兵小隊佔領一個戰略位置。佔領並鞏固戰略位置之後，我方將會獲得更多軍備。
en_text: Use a Stealth Team to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一部大地級建築艇
選擇你的鈦總司令部，建造一部大地級建築艇。 當你想要建立其他建築物時，便需要用到大地級建築艇。你可以隨時透過鈦總司令部建立大地級建築艇。
en_text: Select your Cadre Headquarters to build an Earth Caste Builder. Earth Caste Builders are required to build additional structures. Earth Caste Builders are always available from the Cadre Headquarters.

tc_text: 建立一座監聽哨
你必須使用自己的大地級建築艇來建立監聽哨。一旦將監聽哨建立於某個戰略位置上方，便能確保該戰略位置的安全性，使其免於遭到敵人攻佔，同時還能提升該戰略位置所生產的軍備數量。
en_text: You must use your Earth Caste Builder to build a Listening Post. Listening Posts are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken, and increasing the amount of Requisition generated by the Strategic Point they are on.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一台電漿發電機
請出動你的大地級建築艇建立一座電漿發電機。電漿發電機提供了特殊的部隊、武器、載具、建築物和技能所需要的電力。電力是你必須在「破曉之戰」遊戲中管理的第二種資源。
en_text: Use your Earth Caste Builder to build a Plasma Generator. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities. Power is the second resource you must manage in Dawn of War.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一座兵營
選擇你的大地級建築艇並且建造一座兵營。你可以在兵營建造烈焰戰士和更高及的鈦星人步兵部隊。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder and build a Barracks. The Barracks is the structure where you can build Fire Warriors and more advanced Tau infantry units.

tc_text: 提示文字
強化你的烈焰戰士小隊
選擇你的烈焰戰士小隊並點擊增援按鈕。一直增援到小隊的戰力全滿為止。
en_text: Select your Fire Warrior Team and click the Reinforce button. Reinforce until your squad is at full strength.

tc_text: 提示文字
選擇你的大地級建築艇並且建造一座克魯特兵營。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder and build a Kroot Barracks

tc_text: 克魯特兵營允許你訓練克魯特部隊。克魯特是近戰專家，當你的烈焰戰士用槍擊殺敵人時，克魯特部隊可以在近距離戰鬥中牽制敵人。
en_text: The Kroot Barracks allows you to train Kroot units. Kroot units are melee specialists who can tie up other units in melee while your Fire Warriors gun them down.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個克魯特掠食者小隊
選擇克魯特兵營，並且點擊畫面下方中央的克魯特掠食者肖像。
en_text: Select your Barracks and left click the Kroot Carnivore portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個烈焰戰士小隊
選擇你的兵營，並且點擊畫面下方中央的烈焰戰士肖像。
en_text: Select your Barracks, and left click the Fire Warrior portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一名鈦司令官
選擇兵營並且建造一名鈦司令官。鈦司令官是一個英雄部隊，可以承受更多傷害，並在戰場上造成巨大的損害。
en_text: Select the Barracks and build a Tau Commander. The Tau Commander is a hero unit that can take more punishment, and do heavy damage on the battlefield.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造啟蒙閘道
選擇你的大地級建築艇，並且建造啟蒙閘道。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder, and build a Path to Enlightenment.

tc_text: 提示文字
為你的烈焰戰士小隊添加一位沙隨領袖
en_text: Add a Shas'ui Leader to your Fire Warrior team

tc_text: 選擇你的烈焰戰士小隊，再點擊畫面下方中央閃動的肖像。
en_text: Select your Fire Warrior team, and left click the flashing portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
升級指揮官的武器
選擇你的鈦司令官，再點擊畫面下方中央閃動的肖像。
en_text: Select your Tau Commander, and left click the flashing button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個次元信號浮標
選擇你的大地級建築艇，並且建造一個次元信號浮標。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder, and build a Vehicle Beacon.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造天魟導彈戰艇
選擇次元信號浮標，再點擊位於畫面下方中央的天魟導彈戰艇肖像。
en_text: Select your Vehicle Beacon, and left click the Skyray portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心
選擇你的大地級建築艇，並且建造蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder, and build a Mont'ka Command Post.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一部殲擊機甲
選擇你的兵營，再於殲擊機甲圖示上按滑鼠左鍵。
en_text: Select your barrack, and left click the Crisis Suit icon.

tc_text: 提示文字
研發蒙特卡教義
選擇蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心，並且再點擊蒙特卡教義圖示。
en_text: Select your Mont'ka Command Post, and left click the Teachings of Mont'ka research button.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一架鎚頭鯊戰艇
選擇次元信號浮標，再點擊位於畫面下方中央的鎚頭鯊戰艇肖像。
en_text: Select your Vehicle Beacon, and left click the Hammerhead Gunship button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建立一個聯盟中樞站
選擇你的大地級建築艇，並且建立一個聯盟中樞站。
en_text: Select your Earth Caste Builder, and build a Coalition Center.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一名乙太導師
選擇你的聯盟中樞站，再點擊位於畫面下方中央的乙太導師肖像。
en_text: Select your Coalition Center, and left click the Ethereal button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
選擇休眠的浮石巨塔
在休眠的浮石巨塔上按滑鼠左鍵加以選擇。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵，是將其選取起來的一貫方法。
en_text: Left-click the Dormant Monolith to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一隻建築者聖甲蟲
選擇休眠的浮石巨塔，再於畫面下方中間的建築者聖甲蟲肖像上按滑鼠左鍵。你可以隨時透過浮石巨塔取得建築者聖甲蟲，它是你的建設部隊。
en_text: Select your Dormant Monolith, and left click the Builder Scarab portrait in the bottom center of your screen. Builder Scarabs are always available from the Monolith, and are your construction unit.

tc_text: 提示文字
佔領戰略位置
使用一隻建築者聖甲蟲佔領一個戰略位置。佔領並鞏固戰略位置之後，你就可以建造方尖石碑。
en_text: Use a Builder Scarab to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points allows you to build Obelisks.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一座方尖石碑
你必須使用你的建築者聖甲蟲建造一塊方尖石碑。 方尖石碑是鞏固戰略位置的模式之一，這樣就不會被敵人佔領。方尖石碑也減少召喚軍隊及完成研究所需的時間，並能提高你能夠建造部隊的數量上限。
en_text: You must use your Builder Scarab to build an Obelisk. Obelisks are a way of securing Strategic Points so they can not be taken. Obelisks also decrease the amount of time it takes to summon troops, complete researchs, and also increase the maximum number of units you can build.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造四台電漿發電機
使用建築者聖甲蟲建造四台電漿發電機。電漿發電機提供了特殊的部隊、武器、載具、建築物和技能所需要的電力。
en_text: Use your Builder Scarab to build four Plasma Generators. Plasma Generators provide the Power you need for your special units, weaponry, vehicles, structures, and abilities.

tc_text: 建造一個死靈戰士小隊
en_text: Build a squad of Necron Warriors

tc_text: 選擇休眠的浮石巨塔，並點選位於畫面下方中央的死靈戰士肖像。死靈戰士是你的基本的步兵單位。
en_text: Select the Dormant Monolith and click on the Necron Warrior portrait in the bottom center of your screen. Necron Warriors are your basic infantry unit.

tc_text: 提示文字
強化你的死靈戰士
選擇你的死靈戰士小隊，並且點擊增援按鈕。一直增援到小隊的戰力全滿為止。
en_text: Select your Necron Warrior squad and click the Reinforce button. Reinforce until your squad is a full strength.

tc_text: 提示文字
召喚死靈領主
選擇休眠的浮石巨塔並召喚死靈領主。死靈領主是一個英雄部隊，可以承受更多傷害，並在戰場上造成巨大的損害。
en_text: Select the Dormant Monolith and summon the Necron Lord. The Necron Lord is a hero unit that can take more punishment, and do heavy damage on the battlefield.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造召喚核心
選擇建築者聖甲蟲並建造召喚核心。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab and build a Summoning Core.

tc_text: 提示文字
將休眠的浮石巨塔升級為覺醒的浮石巨塔
en_text: Upgrade your Dormant Monolith to an Awakened Monolith

tc_text: 選擇休眠的浮石巨塔，並點選位於畫面下方中央的覺醒的浮石巨塔按鈕。
en_text: Select your Dormant Monolith, and left click the Awakened Monolith button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造剝皮者
選擇覺醒的浮石巨塔，並建造一個剝皮者小隊。剝皮者是肉搏戰的專家，也會嚴重降低附近小隊的士氣。
en_text: Select the Awakened Monolith and build a squad of Flayed Ones. Flayed Ones are melee specialists that also do heavy morale damage to squads nearby.

tc_text: 提示文字
佈署你的剝皮者
選擇覺醒的浮石巨塔，並點擊畫面下方中央的剝皮者肖像。在你希望他們出現的地圖位置上按滑鼠左鍵。
en_text: Select the Awakened Monolith and left click the Flayed One portrait in the bottom center of your screen. Left click the spot on the map where you want them to appear.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造禁斷文庫
選擇你的建築者聖甲蟲，並建造一座禁斷文庫。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab, and build a Forbidden Archive.

tc_text: 提示文字
為死靈領主研究避邪
en_text: Research Phylactery for your Necron Lord

tc_text: 選擇你的禁斷文庫，點擊畫面下方中央閃爍的按鈕。
en_text: Select your Forbidden Archive, and left click the flashing button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造大型召喚核心
選擇你的建築者聖甲蟲，並建造大型召喚核心。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab, and build a Greater Summoning Core.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造一個古墓蜘蛛
選擇休眠的浮石巨塔，點擊畫面下方中央的古墓蜘蛛肖像。
en_text: Select your Monolith, and left click the Tomb Spyder portrait in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
將覺醒的浮石巨塔升級為交戰的浮石巨塔
en_text: Upgrade your Awakened Monolith to an Engaged Monolith

tc_text: 選擇覺醒的浮石巨塔，點擊畫面下方中央的「交戰的浮石巨塔」按鈕。
en_text: Select your Awakened Monolith, and left click the Engaged Monolith button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
建造能量核心
選擇你的建築者聖甲蟲，並且建造一座能量核心。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab, and build an Energy Core.

tc_text: 提示文字
將交戰的浮石巨塔升級為完全恢復功能的浮石巨塔
en_text: Upgrade your Engaged Monolith to a fully-functional Monolith

tc_text: 選擇交戰的浮石巨塔，點選「復原浮石巨塔」按鈕。
en_text: Select your Engaged Monolith, and left click the Restore Monolith button.

tc_text: 提示文字
為死靈領主研究復活天體
en_text: Research Resurrection Orb for your Necron Lord

tc_text: 選擇禁斷文庫，再點選畫面下方中央的復活天體按鈕。
en_text: Select your Forbidden Archive, and left click the Resurrection Orb button in the bottom center of your screen.

tc_text: 提示文字
呼求致夜者元質
en_text: Call on the Essence of the Nightbringer

tc_text: 選擇你的死靈領主。在致夜者元質按鈕上按滑鼠左鍵。這樣可以讓死靈領主獲得星神的少部份能量，維持一小段時間。
en_text: Select your Necron Lord. Left click the Essence of the Nightbringer button. This will grant a small portion of the star god's power to the Necron Lord for a short period of time.

tc_text: 提示文字
研發「致夜者元質」
選擇你的能量核心。在「致夜者元質」按鈕上按滑鼠左鍵。這樣可以讓你的死靈領主呼求致夜者，獲得他的少部份能力。
en_text: Select your Energy Core. Left click the Essence of the Nightbringer button. This will grant your Necron Lord the ability to call on the Nightbringer for a small portion of his power.

tc_text: 提示文字
選擇你的野戰司令部
只要在野戰司令部上按一下滑鼠左鍵，即可將其選取起來。在部隊和建築物上按滑鼠左鍵即可將之選取。
en_text: Left-click the Field Command to select it. Left-clicking on units and structures always selects them.

tc_text: 提示文字
只要用滑鼠左鍵按一下部隊或建築物，即可將其選取起來。現在請前往你的基地，並選取野戰司令部。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Field Command.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經學會如何在本遊戲中選取部隊和建築物。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.
