tc_text: 選取堡壘之後，螢幕右下角便會出現「帝國防衛軍部隊」圖示。現在請按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Field Command and look for the Guardsmen Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 這時你會注意到小橫條正在逐漸填滿。你可以透過這個「進度橫條」看出某項工作還要多久才能完成。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一支帝國防衛軍部隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Guardsmen Squad.

tc_text: 戰略位置位於戰場上具有高度戰略價值的區域之中。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 在戰場上占領並控制戰略位置，即可提升軍備資源。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 只要用右鍵按一下某個戰略位置，即可命令帝國防衛軍部隊前去占領該戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Guardsmen Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 戰略位置位於戰場上具有高度戰略價值的區域之中。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 在戰場上占領並控制戰略位置，即可提升軍備資源。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 占領戰略位置需要花費一些時間。在進度橫條滿格以前，請勿移開正在占領戰略位置的部隊，否則你將無法控制該戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領這個戰略位置!你必須繼續占領其他戰略位置以取得更多軍備資源，用來建立更多部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is ours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 請選取我方野戰司令部，並建立一個機器主教。
en_text: Select your Field Command and build a Techpriest Enginseer.

tc_text: 當你想要建立其他建築物時，便需要用到機器主教。你可以隨時透過野戰司令部建立機器主教。
en_text: Techpriest Enginseers are required to build additional structures. Enginseers are always available from the Field Command.

tc_text: 機器主教已經抵達!機器主教是帝國防衛軍的建造部隊。每當你要建立新的建築物時，便需要用到機器主教。
en_text: The Techpriest Enginseer has arrived! Enginseers are the Imperial Guard's builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use an Enginseer.

tc_text: 選取機器主教，並在我方已占領的戰略位置上建立一座監聽哨。
en_text: Select the Enginseer and build a Listening Post on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 監聽哨除了能夠鞏固戰略位置的防守能力，還能提升戰略位置的軍備生產速率。
en_text: The Listening Post fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置已經受到嚴密防護，敵人難以攻佔。你應該繼續在我方已佔領的所有戰略位置上建立監聽哨。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Listening Posts on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 部份建築物、載具和研發計劃需要電力才能運作。建造一座電漿發電機，以便提供軍隊運作所需的電力。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Plasma Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 請選取你的機器主教，並建立一座電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 你的電漿發電機數目越多，電力資源的累積速度也會越快。
en_text: The more Plasma Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 電力來了!電漿發電機將會以固定的速率持續生產電力。請注意，每座堡壘所能建造的電漿發電機數目有一定的上限。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Field Command.

tc_text: 選擇你的機器主教並建造一座步兵總部。
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build an Infantry Command.

tc_text: 你可以在步兵總部建造更多帝國防衛軍及更高級的帝國防衛軍步兵部隊。
en_text: The Infantry Command is the structure where you can build additional Guardsmen and more advanced Imperial Guard infantry units.

tc_text: 很好!步兵總部完成了
en_text: Excellent, the Infantry Command is finished.

tc_text: 現在我們應該來強化我們的部隊到最強戰力。
en_text: Now we should focus on bringing our squads to full strength by reinforcing them.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的小隊戰力提升至最高。請選取一支帝國防衛軍部隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness. Select a Guardsmen Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 一旦有帝國防衛軍不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a brother Guardsmen falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 你可以多按幾次「增援隊伍」按鈕，將小隊的戰力提升至最高。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 恭喜!你已經強化了帝國防衛軍部隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Guardsmen Squad.

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 若你在戰鬥期間失去任何部隊，請透過「增援」功能，為你的部隊恢復完整的戰力。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 在戰鬥期間，請隨時留意小隊的體力指數，並請經常使用增援功能，讓你的部隊保持最高戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 請記住，持有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你的小隊將不再持有該項武器。這時你必須為該小隊進行升級，才能重新取得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 選取一支小隊之後，請注意該小隊的體力指數上方將會出現一道藍色的橫條。這道藍色橫條代表了該小隊的士氣指數。
en_text: Now select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just under the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 「士氣」代表我方部隊的戰力。你可以將士氣想成是專注力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的綜合指數。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 本遊戲中有許多武器會同時折損士氣和體力指數。當小隊的士氣有所折損時，藍色小橫條的指數便會下降，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 士氣指數過低時，小隊便會潰散。潰散的小隊不但會失去戰鬥意願，戰力也會大幅下降。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 不過，即使小隊已經潰散，你仍然能夠對其進行控制。你可以自行決定要讓潰散的部隊繼續戰鬥，或是撤退到後方重新累積戰力。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength.

tc_text: 若能妥善利用士氣指標，你將能更輕鬆地擊敗敵人。此外，某些特殊部隊具有提升小隊士氣的技能。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies. Also remember that certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 你可以藉由打擊敵人的士氣讓他們喪失戰力，以便更輕而易舉地殲滅敵人。如此一來，即使是小型部隊，只要裝備精良，也能擊敗人數眾多的敵方軍隊。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 記住，戰術和戰略是戰鬥中的重要關鍵。要善加利用這個道理以在戰場中取得勝利!
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 你要注意帝國防衛軍在戰鬥中死傷過多的話，他們會比其他種族更容易喪失鬥志並潰逃。
en_text: You will notice in combat that Guardsmen are much weaker than the warriors of other races, and quickly lose morale and flee.

tc_text: 因為帝國防衛軍是一般人類，在面對銀河中各種邪惡勢力時，他們需要更強的領導力來戰勝畏懼並奮勇作戰。
en_text: This is because Guardsmen are ordinary men being asked to fight the most evil and monstrous threats in the Galaxy. They require strong leadership to overcome their fear and fight effectively.

tc_text: 選擇野戰司令部建立政戰軍官。政戰軍官可以有效幫助帝國防衛軍更加強壯，也可以幫助士氣穩定。
en_text: Select the Field Command and build a Commissar. The Commissar will greatly enhance the strength and courage of your Guardsmen, and will help even the balance.

tc_text: 政戰軍官有權力處死懦弱的士兵，他用恐懼和紀律，以及他自己的勇氣來激勵部隊。
en_text: The Commissar has the power to execute soldiers for cowardice and disobedience. He inspires troops through fear and discipline, and by his own courage.

tc_text: 很好!政戰軍官已經抵達。但是政戰軍官要加入小隊才會顯現他的用途.
en_text: Excellent! The Commissar has arrived. But the Commissar will do you little good until he is attached to a squad.

tc_text: 選取我方的政戰軍官，再按一下「加入」按鈕，然後選取你想要讓政戰軍官加入的小隊即可。
en_text: Select your Commissar and click the Attach button. Now, select a Guardsmen Squad.

tc_text: 當政戰軍官加入小隊時，小隊會重整隊伍，空出位置給他們的隊長。
en_text: Notice how when the Commissar joins the squad, they rearrange themselves to make room for their esteemed leader.

tc_text: 有政戰軍官加入的小隊士氣不會降低。他們所受的傷害也會降低。政戰軍官是帝國防衛軍不可或缺的成功要素。
en_text: A squad with a Commissar attached will never have their morale break. They will also take less damage from enemy units. Commissars are vital to your success as Imperial Guard.

tc_text: 當你的科技有所進展時，你可以在小隊中加入帝國主教。帝國主教也可以提升步兵的能力。
en_text: You can also attach Priests to your squad when you advance in the Tech Tree. Priests also greatly increase the power of an infantry squad.

tc_text: 若要讓隊長脫離小隊，只要將該小隊選取起來，再按一下「脫離」圖示即可。「脫離」圖示的位置和「加入」圖示相同。但是請記住政戰軍官與帝國主教都要加入部隊中才能凸顯功能。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon. But remember that Commissars and Priests add little to your cause unless they are attached to a squad.

tc_text: 決定建築物的建造地點時，部份建築物周圍會出現白色的光環。這就是所謂的「控制區域」。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能在控制區域內部建立，而某些特定的建築物 (例如監聽哨) 則可以在控制區域以外的地點建立。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Listening Posts, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你想要為某座新建築物決定建造位置時，在四處移動該建築物的時候，建築物的顏色會從紅色變為綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its color changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 變成綠色時，代表你可以將建築物置於該處，並展開建造工作。
en_text: A Green color indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 大部分的種族會有一個英雄來帶領他們的軍隊，帝國防衛軍則是由一群接受帝國將軍指揮的勇士來進行帶領，這就是指揮部隊。
en_text: Most races have a single hero they can build that can lead their entire force. Imperial Guard are led by a group of several brave men commanded by the Imperial General. This group is known as the Command Squad.

tc_text: 選擇步兵總部並建立一個指揮部隊。
en_text: Select the Infantry Command and build a Command Squad now.

tc_text: 指揮部隊固定由帝國將軍帶領。將軍可以選擇其他的帝國防衛軍隊長來加入指揮部隊，例如政戰軍官、帝國主教與靈能者。
en_text: The Command Squad is always lead by your General. The General can choose to fill out his Command Squad with other Imperial Guard leaders such as the Commissar, Priest or the Psyker.

tc_text: 很好!你已經完成指揮部隊了。
en_text: Congratulations! You have finished building your Command Squad.

tc_text: 選擇機器主教並建造戰略指揮部。
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build a Tactica Control now.

tc_text: 你必須建造戰略指揮部來進行研發與武器升級。部隊可以裝備不同的武器，以便對付不同的敵人。
en_text: You must build a Tactica Control in order to access research and weapon upgrades. Squads can be equipped with a variety of weaponry, allowing you to prepare them against different enemy types.

tc_text: 很好!戰略指揮部可以運作了。
en_text: Excellent, the Tactica Control is now operational.

tc_text: 選擇一個帝國防衛軍，再按下「升級: 榴彈發射器」按鈕來昇級小隊成員。
en_text: Select your Guardsmen Squad and click the Upgrade: Grenade Launcher icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 請注意，其中一名小隊成員的手中會出現榴彈發射器。任何一種武器升級都可以透過相同的程序完成。
en_text: Notice a Grenade Launcher appears in one of your squad members' hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 你只能讓一定數量的成員配備這些強力武器，但是這些武器可以造成很強的殺傷力。
en_text: You can only upgrade a limited number of your total squad members with heavy weapons. But the power of these weapons makes the investment well worth it.

tc_text: 很好。你已經為帝國防衛軍完成武器升級。你可以為戰場上任何地點的小隊進行武器升級，為他們提供適合用來對付敵人的武器。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Guardsmen Squad. You can upgrade your squads anywhere on the battlefield to weapons that are well suited to counter your enemy.

tc_text: 選取一支帝國防衛軍部隊，再按一下「新增領導者：士官」圖示。
en_text: Select a Guardsmen Squad and click the Add Leader: Sergeant icon.

tc_text: 士官是英勇的領導者，能夠提升自己所屬小隊的戰力和士氣，也能增加帝國防衛軍的生命力。
en_text: Sergeants are brave soldiers that improve the combat ability and morale of the squad they are part of. They also increase the health of every Guardsman in the squad.

tc_text: 很好!你的士官已經抵達。請注意，士官屬於小隊的一部份，而且無法自小隊中脫離。
en_text: Excellent! Your Sergeant has arrived. Note that your Sergeants are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 選擇步兵總部並建立另一支帝國防衛軍部隊。
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and build another Guardsmen Squad.

tc_text: 你已經建立一個帝國防衛軍部隊，並增援其力量至最強。你也可以為他們加入士官，並配備重裝武器。
en_text: You have built a Guardsmen Squad and fully reinforced it. You have also added a Sergeant and outfitted it with heavy weapons.

tc_text: 但是這個部隊仍然不夠強，你需要用總部生產政戰軍官來加入小隊，它才算是完全做好作戰準備。
en_text: But the squad is still not at full strength. You need to build a Commissar from the HQ and attach it to the squad before it is fully ready for combat.

tc_text: 選擇野戰指揮部並生產第二個政戰軍官。
en_text: Select your Field Command and build a second Commissar.

tc_text: 你已經生產好第二個政戰軍官了，現在你必須讓他加入新建的防衛軍部隊。
en_text: You built a second Commissar. Now you must attach him to the new squad of Guardsmen.

tc_text: 選取我方新的政戰軍官，按一下「加入」按鈕，再選取新的小隊即可。
en_text: Select your new Commissar and click the Attach button. Now, select the new Guardsmen Squad.

tc_text: 很好，你已經建立好第二個防衛軍部隊，並強化到最強了。
en_text: Excellent! You have built a second squad of guardsmen and have brought it to full strength.

tc_text: 你的作戰基地所具有的後勤補給可以支援一定數目的部隊，而你在特定時間所能支援的部隊數目稱為「部隊上限」。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你目前的部隊上限會顯示在螢幕頂端的「資源區域」中。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 一旦達到部隊上限，你便無法繼續徵召其他部隊。因此在建立部隊的同時，請務必隨時注意自己的部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional squads, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 你可以建造額外的步兵總部來提升部隊上限。每個步兵總部都可以提高部隊上限，但是部隊上限不能超過二十。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building additional Infantry Commands. Each Infantry Command increases your maximum squad cap. But keep in mind that you cannot go beyond a squad cap of twenty.

tc_text: 為了達到有效的攻擊，你應該建立數個防衛軍部隊，並完全增援，並配置重裝武器、士官、政戰軍官或主教。
en_text: To mount an effective attack, you should try to have several Guardsmen Squads, fully reinforced to maximum strength and Upgraded with heavy weapons, a Sergeant, and a Commissar or Priest.

tc_text: 遭受敵方火力攻擊時，某些類型的地形可以為你的部隊提供保護。這就是所謂的「掩護」。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 請選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移往掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」能夠為你的部隊提供額外的防禦能力，使其變得更難對付，因而十分有用。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 要找到能提供掩護能力的地形並不困難 ——當你通過城巿內部的大型彈坑，或是叢林內部的濃密植被時，滑鼠游標發生變化之處即為掩護區域。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 將部隊移入掩護區域中時，你將會注意到部隊上方出現了小型的「掩護」圖示。這個圖示代表該部隊的防禦能力向上提升。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好!你的部隊已經進入掩護區域。你的部隊一旦進入掩護區域內部，敵人就難以射擊，因此遭受長程攻擊時受到的傷害也會隨之減低。請善加利用掩護區域，為我方取得戰略優勢，以有效制敵。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置，是確保我方軍備資源不虞匱乏的最佳方式。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 請派出帝國防衛軍部隊在我方基地周圍進行地圖探勘，並沿路占領途中發現的戰略位置。你必須占領三個戰略位置，才能達成這項目標。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your Guardsmen Squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must capture three Strategic Points.

tc_text: 為了確保軍備資源 (也就是你的主要資源) 不虞匱乏，你必須占領並固守更多戰略位置。請占領三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立監聽哨。
en_text: Make sure to use your Enginseer to build Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立了監聽哨。戰略位置的奪取和固守是擊敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Listening Posts on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置的方式和占領戰略位置完全相同。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領並固守一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家便能取得勝利!凡是我方固守的關鍵位置，也能為我方軍隊生產軍備資源。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 請派出部隊占領一個關鍵位置。「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一個關鍵位置。請注意，你無法在關鍵位置上建立監聽哨。你必須透過其他途徑來固守關鍵位置。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Listening Posts built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 固守遺址之後，就能開始為你的軍隊建造最佳的部隊和載具。若要確保自己能夠運用最先進的科技，請全力固守遺址!
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 請派出一支部隊占領一處遺址。「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一處遺址。你可以建立監聽哨，以鞏固我方已占領的遺址。你也可以占領敵方的遺址，使其喪失建立最佳部隊以及運用最先進科技的能力。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 選擇野戰司令部並按「作戰司令部」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Field Command and click the Battle Command Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 我們必須將野戰司令部升級為作戰司令部，才能開始為部隊徵召領導者，並完成其他更先進的研發選項和建築物。
en_text: We must upgrade the Field Command to a Battle Command to gain access to powerful research options and powerful structures such as the Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 工研總部可以讓你生產載具,載具是充滿威力的部隊,可以扭轉戰局。
en_text: The Mechanized Command allows you to requisition vehicles. Vehicles are powerful units that can turn the tide of large battles.

tc_text: 作戰司令部完成了,你可以建造工研總部。
en_text: The Battle Command is complete! You can now build a Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 選擇你的機器主教並建造工研總部。
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build a Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 就像步兵總部可以生產步兵部隊一樣，工研總部則是生產載具部隊。
en_text: Just like the Infantry Command is used to build infantry units, the Mechanized Command is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 載具十分強悍，面對尚未升級的敵方步兵時，幾乎是刀槍不入。載具會組成我方軍隊的一個基本環節，而且能用來攜帶強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 很好!你已經順利建立一座工研總部。現在你可以開始建立威力強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Mechanized Command. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 請注意，你的作戰基地只能支援一定數目的載具。這種限制稱為「載具上限」。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 就像部隊上限一樣，一旦達到載具上限，你就無法繼續建立更多的載具。若要提升載具上限，請蓋更多工研總部來增加載具上限。
en_text: Just like Squad Cap, once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can increase your vehicle cap by building additional Mechanized Commands.

tc_text: 選擇一個工研總部，並按「哨兵機器人補給站」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Mechanized Command and click the Sentinel Depot Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 升級哨兵機器人補給站可以讓你從工研總部生產哨兵機器人。
en_text: The Sentinel Depot Addon will allow you to build Sentinels from this Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 如果你要在別的工研總部生產哨兵機器人,你也必須幫那座工研總部升級哨兵機器人補給站。
en_text: If you want to build Sentinels from other Mechanized Commands, you will need to upgrade them with the Sentinel Depot Addon as well.

tc_text: 哨兵機器人補給站完成了,你現在可以生產哨兵機器人。
en_text: The Sentinel Depot is complete! You can now build a Sentinel.

tc_text: 選擇工研總部並生產哨兵機器人。
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and build a Sentinel.

tc_text: 哨兵機器人是快速步行裝甲載具，善於消滅其他載具,他們也可以解除敵人佔領的據點（不過他們不能進行佔領）。
en_text: Sentinels are quick raiding vehicles that excel at destroying other vehicles. They can also uncapture enemy points (though they cannot capture them).

tc_text: 很好!你現在有一部哨兵機器人。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Sentinel.

tc_text: 選擇一個工研總部並按「石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Mechanized Command and click the Basilisk Depot Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 升級石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站可以讓你從工研總部生產石化蜥蜴級自走砲。
en_text: The Basilisk Depot Addon will allow you to build Baslisks from this Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 如果你要在別的工研總部生產石化蜥蜴級自走砲，你也必須幫那座工研總部升級石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站。
en_text: If you want to build Basilisks from other Mechanized Commands, you will need to upgrade them with the Basilisk Depot Addon as well.

tc_text: 石化蜥蜴級自走砲補給站完成了,你現在可以生產石化蜥蜴級自走砲。
en_text: The Basilisk Depot is complete! You can now build a Basilisk.

tc_text: 選擇工研總部並生產石化蜥蜴級自走砲。
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and build a Basilisk.

tc_text: 石化蜥蜴級自走砲是重型砲兵載具，能夠消滅步兵與建築物。注意，他們不能受到太多傷害，所以將他們放在軍隊後方。
en_text: Basilisks are heavy artillery vehicles that excel at killing infantry and buildings. Keep in mind that they can't take a lot of punishment, so keep them behind your army.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有一部石化蜥蜴級自走砲了。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Basilisk.

tc_text: 選擇作戰司令部並按「軍團司令部」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Field Command and click the Regimental Command Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 我們必須將野戰司令部升級為作戰司令部，才能完成其他更先進的研發選項和建築物，例如猿人部隊或黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克。
en_text: We must upgrade the Field Command to a Regimental Command to gain access to powerful research options and powerful addons such as the Ogryn Quarters or the Leman Russ Depot.

tc_text: 黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克補給站可以讓你生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克，黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克對付所有載具都十分有利。
en_text: The Leman Russ Depot allows you to requisition Leman Russ Tanks. Leman Russ Tanks are powerful all-purpose vehicles.

tc_text: 軍團司令部完成了，你可以建造威力更強大的部隊。
en_text: The Regimental Command is complete! You can now build more powerful units.

tc_text: 選擇步兵總部並按「猿人兵營」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Infantry Command and click the Ogryn Depot Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 升級猿人兵營可以讓你在步兵總部生產猿人。
en_text: The Orgyn Quarters add-on will allow you to build Ogryns from this Infantry Command.

tc_text: 如果你要在別的步兵總部生產猿人，你也必須幫那座步兵總部升級猿人兵營。
en_text: If you want to build Ogryns from other Infantry Commands, you will need to upgrade them with the Ogryn Quarters add-on as well.

tc_text: 猿人兵營完成了,你現在可以生產猿人。
en_text: The Ogryn Quarters are complete! You can now build Ogryn squads.

tc_text: 選擇步兵總部並生產猿人。
en_text: Select your Infantry Command and build a squad of Ogryns.

tc_text: 猿人是重裝近戰步兵,可以造成巨大傷害，也可以承受大量的傷害。
en_text: Ogryns are heavy melee infantry that deal large amounts of damage and can take incredible amounts of punishment.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有了一支猿人部隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a squad of Ogryns.

tc_text: 選擇一個工研總部並按「黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克補給站」升級按鈕。
en_text: Select the Mechanized Command and click the Leman Russ Depot Upgrade icon.

tc_text: 升級黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克補給站可以讓你從工研總部生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克
en_text: The Leman Russ Depot add-on will allow you to build Leman Russ Tanks from this Mechanized Command.

tc_text: 如果你要在別的工研總部生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克,你也必須幫那座工研總部升級黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克補給站。
en_text: If you want to build Leman Russ Tanks from other Mechanized Commands, you will need to upgrade them with the Leman Russ Depot add-on as well.

tc_text: 黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克補給站完成了,你現在可以生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克。
en_text: The Leman Russ Depot is complete! You can now build a Leman Russ Tank.

tc_text: 選擇工研總部並生產黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克。
en_text: Select your Mechanized Command and build a Leman Russ Tank.

tc_text: 黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克是可以對付步兵與其他載具的全方位坦克。
en_text: Leman Russ Tanks are all purpose tanks that are good against infantry and other vehicles.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有一輛黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Leman Russ Tank.

tc_text: 選擇機器主教並建造戰神研發總部。
en_text: Select your Enginseer and build a Mars Pattern Command.

tc_text: 戰神研發總部是唯一可以建造毀滅之劍重裝戰車的特殊建築物
en_text: The Mars Pattern Command is a specialized building that only builds one type of unit: the Baneblade

tc_text: 毀滅之劍重裝戰車是傳說中近乎無敵的載具，他們火力全開時，幾乎可以消滅整個軍團。
en_text: Baneblades are legendary vehicles that are nearly invincible. They unleash unimaginable fire power and can destroy whole armies.

tc_text: 戰神研發總部如同工研總部一樣，可以增加載具上限。
en_text: Note that the Mars Pattern Command, like the Mechanized Command, increases your vehicle cap.

tc_text: 很好,你已完成戰神研發總部，現在你可以生產毀滅之劍重裝戰車，讓你的敵人陷入恐慌吧。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Mars Pattern Command. You can now build a Baneblade. Let your enemies tremble in fear.

tc_text: 選擇戰神研發總部並建造毀滅之劍重裝戰車。
en_text: Select your Mars Pattern Command and build a Baneblade.

tc_text: 毀滅之劍重裝戰車是可以摧毀射程內任何東西的恐怖坦克。
en_text: Baneblades are fearsome vehicles that can destroy anything that dares to venture into range.

tc_text: 很好！現在你有了毀滅之劍重裝戰車，你的敵人性命將盡，把它送到前線去消滅敵人吧！
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Baneblade. Your enemy's fate is sealed. Send it forward to annihilate him.

tc_text: 為了增加部隊數量，你需要建造更多步兵總部.
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as Imperial Guard, you need to build additional Infantry Commands.

tc_text: 你已經達到可以派出的小隊數量極限。確定你已將小隊戰力增援到最高點，達到充分利用的效果。如果你覺得投資不慎，可以在鍵盤上按一下刪除鍵，將不要的小隊解雇。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them.

tc_text: 請記住，提升軍備資源的方法就是固守戰略位置。一旦軍備資源匱乏，你就無法建立自己需要的部隊，而且會失去自己在戰場上的優勢。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requisition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 「礦渣區」是集中隱藏在行星地表下方的能源。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 只要迅速瀏覽一下迷你地圖，你就會發現一些表示礦渣區的小點。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 請在礦渣區上建造一座熱流電漿發電機，以取得大量的電力資源。
en_text: Build a Thermo-Plasma Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建造你的基地，你需要機器主教。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need an Enginseer.

tc_text: 選擇野戰司令部並生產機器主教。
en_text: Select your Field Command and build an Enginseer.

tc_text: 請出動步兵部隊占領戰略位置，並命令機器主教在戰略位置上建立監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points, and Enginseers to build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 請持續建造建築物，並持續進行研發計劃，以提升自己的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 請建立更多的部隊和載具。為了提升自己的部隊上限和載具上限，請務必透過研發計劃完成相關升級。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure you research upgrades that will increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 在這個戰場上取得勝利之後，請前往其他戰場，與敵人一決高下。除非你已徹底殲滅敵人，否則這場戰爭將永無終止之日。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 若你先前曾做了不明智的決定，請按鍵盤上的 Delete 鍵，以終結自己不需要的部隊。
en_text: If you have invested unwisely, you can press the 'Delete' button on your keyboard to terminate unwanted squads.

tc_text: 在你建立更多設施並完成更多研發計劃之後，便能進一步建立星際戰士的其他指揮部隊。
en_text: The Space Marines' other commander units will become available as you build more facilities and unlock more research.

tc_text: 將星際戰士小隊選取起來，再按一下「升級：火焰槍」圖示，即可為其中一名小隊成員進行升級。
en_text: Select your Space Marine Squad and click the Upgrade: Flamer icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 請注意，其中一名小隊成員的手中將會出現火焰槍。
en_text: Notice a Flamer appears in one of your squad member's hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 我們必須將褻瀆堡壘升級為褻瀆要塞以開放生產小隊領袖和其他強大的研發選項及建築物。
en_text: We must upgrade the Desecrated Stronghold to a Desecrated Fortress to gain access to more powerful units, research options and structures.

tc_text: 褻瀆要塞完成了!你的力量更加茁壯。
en_text: Excellent! The Desecrated Fortress is complete! Your power grows.

tc_text: 注意其中一名小隊成員的手中會出現重型爆彈槍。
en_text: Notice a Heavy Bolter appears in one of your squad member's hands.

tc_text: 很好。你已經為混沌星際戰士小隊裝備重型爆彈槍，用來對付步兵十分有效。
en_text: Excellent! You have outfitted your Chaos Marines with Heavy Bolters. They will now be much more effective against infantry.

tc_text: 你必須建造兵工廠以便升級重裝武器。
en_text: You must build an Armoury in order to access heavy weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 很好!暗黑死神是致命的殺手，擅長自遠距離外殺死敵人。
en_text: The Dark Reapers are deadly marksmen that excel at killing units from a distance.

tc_text: 很好!你現在有暗黑死神部隊，記住暗黑死神部隊適合在狂嚎女妖於近戰中牽制敵人時進行遠距離攻擊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Dark Reaper squad. Remember that Dark Reapers are ideal for making ranged attacks from a distance while Banshees tie up enemy squads in melee combat.

tc_text: 次元蜘蛛部隊的遠距離攻擊火力比暗黑死神更強大,他們有重裝甲可以承受更多攻擊，也可以升級來破壞載具或建築物。
en_text: Warp Spider Squads have a more powerful ranged attack than the Dark Reaper, and their heavy armor allows them to take more punishment. They can also be upgraded to handle vehicles and destroy buildings.

tc_text: 很好，你現在有一支次元蜘蛛部隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Warp Spider squad.

tc_text: 要獲得神靈族的最高級科技，我們首先必須研發靈魂神龕的戰亂動員。
en_text: To reach the final tier of Eldar technology, we must first research Mobilize for War located on the Webway Assembly.

tc_text: 很好!研發已完成。你現在可以建立神靈族最致命的部隊與科技。
en_text: Excellent! The Mobilize for War research is complete. You now have access to the Eldar's most deadly units and technologies.

tc_text: 現在來生產戰神分身吧，你可以在神態次元關口生產戰神分身。
en_text: The time has come to build an Avatar. You can build an Avatar at the Aspect Portal.

tc_text: 將槍手小隊選取起來，再按一下「升級：大把歐克槍」圖示，即可為其中一名小隊成員進行升級。
en_text: Select your Shoota Boy Squad and click the Upgrade: Big Shoota icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 請注意，其中一名小隊成員的手中將會出現大把歐克槍
en_text: Notice a Big Shoota appears in one of your squad member's hands.

tc_text: 很好。你已經為槍手小隊完成武器升級。你可以為戰場上任何地點的小隊進行武器升級
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Shoota Boy Squad. You can upgrade your squads with heavy weapons anywhere on the battlefield.

tc_text: 歐克小鬼頭可以免費增援自己，讓他們在戰場上活得更久。你應該隨時讓他們增援至最強戰力。
en_text: Gretchin squads, or Grotz, can reinforce themselves for free, allowing them to survive longer on the battlefield. You should always reinforce your Gretchin squads to full strength.

tc_text: 額外的歐克小鬼頭也可以縮短建造建築物的時間。完成建設的時間取決於你有多少歐克小鬼頭。
en_text: Additional Grotz also decrease the time it takes to build structures, The time it takes to complete a building depends on how large your Gretchin Squad is.

tc_text: 現在是學習防禦陣地與壕溝的好時機。帝國防衛軍可以進入一些建築物中進行防禦。
en_text: Now is a good time to learn about unit garrisons and underground tunnels. The Imperial Guard can garrison infantry inside of some of their buildings.

tc_text: 選擇帝國防衛軍部隊，並在野戰司令部上按滑鼠右鍵。
en_text: Select your Guardsmen Squad and right click on the Field Command.

tc_text: 很好，現在你的小隊可以躲避敵人的炮火，他們也可以在建築物裡對敵人開火。
en_text: Very good! Your units are now protected from enemy fire. They can also use the building's mounted weapons against their enemies while inside.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍可以在建築物之間挖掘壕溝，讓他們可以安全地移動到另一棟建築物。
en_text: The Imperial Guard dig tunnels between all of their buildings so they can move in safety. You can move your squads from building to building without ever leaving their protection.

tc_text: 點選步兵總部。留意它有三個空位。注意野戰司令部內部的小隊顯示在空位下方。點選小隊的圖示，便可將它從野戰司令部傳輸到步兵總部。
en_text: Click on the Infantry Command. Notice that it has three empty slots. Notice how your squad in the Field Command is shown below. Click on the squad icon to transfer the unit from your Field Command to the Infantry Command.

tc_text: 注意小隊圖示上方的時間棒，這代表在兩棟建築物之間移動所需的時間。
en_text: Notice the timer bar over the squad icon. This is the amount of time it will take to travel between the two buildings.

tc_text: 你的小隊已經位於步兵總部。再按一次小隊圖示，即可令防衛軍離開建築物。
en_text: Your squad is now in the Infantry Command. Click on the squad icon a second time to ungarrison your Guardsmen from the building.

tc_text: 好極了!現在你了解利用建築來保護你的部隊，以及在建築物之間移動的方法。
en_text: Congratulations! You now understand the basics of placing your units in the protection of your buildings, and moving them from building to building.

tc_text: 我們已經建造一支指揮部隊，應該加以增援強化。
en_text: Now that we have built a Command Squad we should reinforce it.

tc_text: 點選其中一個發光的按鈕，以增加一名額外的隊長到指揮部隊。
en_text: Add an additional leader to the Command Squad by clicking on one of the flashing icons now.

tc_text: 如果你要跟其他種族的英雄抗衡，你需要將指揮部隊增援到最強戰力。
en_text: You will need your Command Squad to be at full strength if you want to counter the strength of the other races' heroes.

tc_text: 很好!你已經增援了你的指揮部隊，你應該多按幾次直到戰力達到最強。記住，每一種隊長都可以為小隊帶來不同的效應。因此變化就是力量。
en_text: Congratulations! You have reinforced your Command Squad. You should continue to reinforce the Command Squad until it is at full strength. Remember that each leader type adds something to the squad. Diversity is strength in this case.

tc_text: 只要用滑鼠左鍵按一下部隊或建築物，即可將其選取起來。現在請前往你的基地，並選取鈦總司令部。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Cadre Headquarters.

tc_text: 選取鈦總司令部之後，螢幕右下角便會出現「潛行機兵小隊」圖示。現在請按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Cadre Headquarters and look for the Stealthsuit Team icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 很好!你已經建立了一支潛行機兵小隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Stealthsuit Team.

tc_text: 潛行機兵使用先進技術，使敵人看不見他們。在「破曉之戰」中，這種類型的部隊稱為「滲透」。
en_text: Stealthsuits use advanced technology to make them virtually invisible to enemy units. In Dawn of War, units of this type are said to be Infiltrated.

tc_text: 滲透部隊可以在不曝露自己的情況下進行標準部隊能做的一切事，包括攻擊敵方部隊。這個特性使得滲透部隊極為強大。
en_text: Infiltrated units can do everything standard units can without revealing their position, including firing on enemy units. This makes infiltrated units very powerful.

tc_text: 但是要小心。有一些敵方部隊是偵察者，任何接近他們的滲透部隊都會被發現。被發現的敵人就會被任何敵人攻擊。
en_text: Be careful, though. Some enemy units are detectors, and any infiltrated units who get close to them are revealed. Revealed units can be targeted by any enemies.

tc_text: 在戰略位置上按滑鼠右鍵，命令潛行機兵前去佔領。
en_text: Order the Stealthsuit to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 選擇你的鈦總司令部，並建造一艘大地級建築艇。
en_text: Select your Cadre Headquarters and build an Earth-Caste Builder.

tc_text: 當你想要建立其他建築物時，便需要用到大地級建築艇。你可以隨時透過鈦總司令部建立大地級建築艇。
en_text: Earth-Caste Builders are required to build additional structures. Builders are always available from the Cadre Headquarters.

tc_text: 大地級建築艇已經抵達!大地級建築艇是鈦星人的建造部隊。每當你要建立新的建築物時，便需要用到大地級建築艇。
en_text: The Earth-Caste Builder has arrived! Builder drones are the Tau Empire's builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use an Earth-Caste Builder drone.

tc_text: 選擇大地級建築艇，再點選螢幕右下方的建築圖示。這樣會列出建築者能夠建造的所有建築的圖示。點選監聽哨圖示，再將它放在佔領的戰略位置上。
en_text: Select the Earth-Caste Builder and click on the Build icon on the lower right area of the screen. This brings up the icons of all the structures the Builder can construct. Click on the Listening Post icon and then place it on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造一座電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 電力來了!電漿發電機將會以固定的速率持續生產電力。請注意，每座鈦總司令部所能建造的電漿發電機數目都具有一定的上限。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Cadre Headquarters.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造一座鈦兵營。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build a Tau Barracks.

tc_text: 你可以在兵營中，向鈦星帝國的烈焰階級徵召基本和高級的步兵部隊。
en_text: The Barracks is the structure where you can build basic and advanced infantry units from the Tau Empire's Fire caste.

tc_text: 很好，鈦兵營完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Tau Barracks is finished.

tc_text: 選擇鈦兵營，並建造一個烈焰戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Tau Barracks and build a Fire Warrior Team.

tc_text: 烈焰戰士是鈦星帝國的基本步兵部隊。他們擁有極佳的射程，並以脈衝步槍造成不錯的傷害，但是在近距離戰鬥中非常軟弱。 為了保護烈焰戰士的性命，你必須讓他們和敵方部隊保持一段距離。
en_text: Fire Warriors are the basic infantrymen of the Tau Empire. They have excellent range and damage with their pulse rifles, but are very weak in melee. To keep your Fire Warriors alive, you'll need to keep them at a distance from enemy units.

tc_text: 很好。 你已經建造了一個烈焰戰士小隊。
en_text: Excellent. You have built a Fire Warrior Team.

tc_text: 「增援」是將額外的部隊加入小隊中、使其戰鬥效能達到最大的動作。選擇一個烈焰戰士小隊。點擊「增援小隊」按鈕，為你的小隊添加一名新部隊。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness. Select a Fire Warrior Team. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 一旦有烈焰戰士不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a Fire Warrior falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 恭喜你﹗ 你已經強化你的烈焰戰士小隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Fire Warrior Team.

tc_text: 為了彌補烈焰戰士在近距離戰鬥方面的弱點，鈦星帝國使用其聯盟種族克魯特的戰士。
en_text: To make up for the weakness of Fire Warriors at close quarters, the Tau Empire uses warriors from their allied race, the Kroot.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造一座克魯特兵營。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build a Kroot Barracks.

tc_text: 所有的克魯特部隊皆由克魯特兵營進行建造。
en_text: All Kroot units are build from the Kroot Barracks.

tc_text: 很好。現在你有一座克魯特兵營，並且可以建造克魯特部隊。
en_text: Excellent. You now have a Kroot Barracks and can build Kroot units.

tc_text: 選擇克魯特兵營，並建造一個克魯特掠食者小隊。
en_text: Select your Tau Barracks and build a Kroot Carnivore squad.

tc_text: 克魯特掠食者是原始的戰士，他們已經與鈦星帝國結盟。他們擅長肉搏戰鬥，可以牽制敵人，以便烈焰戰士能將敵人射殺。
en_text: Kroot Carnivores are primal warriors who have allied themselves with the Tau Empire. They are experts at melee combat and can tie up enemies so that Fire Warriors can gun them down.

tc_text: 很好。你已經建造了一個克魯特掠食者小隊。
en_text: Excellent. You have built a Kroot carnivore squad.

tc_text: 你可以藉由建造研發建築（例如啟蒙閘道和蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心）來提升部隊上限。但是要記住，部隊上限的最大值是20。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building research structures like the Path to Enlightenment and the Mont'ka Command Post. But keep in mind that you cannot go beyond a Squad Cap of twenty.

tc_text: 大多數種族都可以建造一名英雄來率領整支軍隊。對鈦星帝國來說，這個英雄就是鈦司令官，他是烈焰階級的資深成員，駕駛一座最先進的XV22戰鬥機甲。
en_text: Most races have a single hero they can build that can lead their entire force. For the Tau Empire, this hero is the Tau Commander, a senior member of the Fire Caste who pilots a cutting-edge XV22 Battlesuit.

tc_text: 選擇鈦兵營並建造鈦司令官。
en_text: Select the Tau Barracks and build the Tau Commander now.

tc_text: 鈦司令官的戰鬥機甲可以使用多種武器系統進行升級，包括火焰噴射器、融合大砲和飛彈發射器。鈦司令官是鈦星帝國戰鬥哲學的縮影，移動迅速並具備大量遠距離火力。但是他在肉搏戰中非常容易受傷，而且沒有自己的肉搏武器。
en_text: The Tau Commander's Battlesuit can be upgraded with a variety of weapon systems, including a flamer, fusion cannon and missile launchers. The Tau Commander is the epitome of the Tau Empire's battle philosophy, moving quickly and packing a lot of ranged firepower. He is very vulnerable to melee attacks however, and has no melee of his own.

tc_text: 恭喜你﹗你已經建造完成鈦司令官。
en_text: Congratulations! You have finished building the Tau Commander.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造啟蒙閘道。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build the Path to Enlightenment now.

tc_text: 為了開始研究及取得武器升級，你必須建造啟蒙閘道。研究可以提高你的小隊的效率。
en_text: You must build the Path to Enlightenment in order to access research and weapon upgrades. Research increases your squads' effectiveness.

tc_text: 很好，啟蒙閘道開始運作了。
en_text: Excellent, the Path to Enlightenment is now operational.

tc_text: 選擇一個烈焰戰士小隊，並點選「增加領袖︰沙隨」圖示。
en_text: Select a Fire Warrior Team and click the Add Leader: Shas'ui icon.

tc_text: 沙隨是烈焰戰士老兵，能為你的小隊添加更多的能力。
en_text: Shas'ui are veteran Fire Warriors who add more power to your squad.

tc_text: 很好﹗沙隨已經到達。注意，沙隨是小隊的一分子，不能離開。
en_text: Excellent! Your Shas'ui has arrived. Note that your Shas'ui is part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 烈焰戰士小隊還能獲得第二個特別部隊，稱為兵蜂盾。兵蜂盾是能產生強大能量盾的小型機器人，保護小隊不受遠距離攻擊。
en_text: Fire Warrior Teams can also gain a second special unit called a Shield Drone. Shield Drones are small robots that can generate a powerful energy shield, protecting the squad from ranged fire.

tc_text: 選擇一個烈焰戰士小隊，並點擊「增加領袖︰兵蜂盾」圖示。
en_text: Select a Fire Warrior Team and click the Add Leader: Shield Drone icon.

tc_text: 就和沙隨一樣，兵蜂盾是小隊的一分子，不能離開。
en_text: Like Shas'ui, Shield Drones are part of your squad and can't leave it.

tc_text: 很好。你的兵蜂盾已經到達。
en_text: Excellent. Your Shield Drone has arrived.

tc_text: 選擇鈦司令官，並點選「升級：火焰噴射器」圖示，以此武器升級他的戰鬥機甲。
en_text: Select your Tau Commander and click the Upgrade: Flamer icon to upgrade his battlesuit with that weapon.

tc_text: 注意新武器出現在指揮官身上。可以執行這個程序來換用他能使用的任何一種武器升級。
en_text: Notice the new weapon appears on the Commander. This procedure can be performed with any of his available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 很好。你的鈦司令官已經完成升級。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Tau Commander.

tc_text: 烈焰戰士小隊固定使用相同的武器，因此不會有武器升級。但是你可以使用研究來提高他們的戰鬥效果。
en_text: Fire Warrior Teams always have the same weapons, so they do not have weapon upgrades. You can use research to increase their combat effectiveness, however.

tc_text: 選擇啟蒙閘道，並點選「高級脈衝步槍」研究圖示。就和升級一樣，研究需要花時間。但是研究會影響所有相關的小隊，而不是僅僅一個小隊。
en_text: Select the Path to Enlightenment and click on the icon for the Advanced Pulse Rifles research. Like upgrades, research takes time. Research affects all relevant squads, however, instead of just a single one.

tc_text: 很好。現在所有的烈焰戰士小隊都擁有高級脈衝步槍。現在他們可以造成更大的傷害，並有更大的射程。
en_text: Excellent. All your Fire Warrior Teams now have advanced pulse rifles. They now do more damage and have greater range.

tc_text: 克魯特掠食者小隊與烈焰戰士不同，他們不能用沙隨或者兵蜂盾之類的特別領袖來予以加強。
en_text: Unlike the Fire Warriors, Kroot Carnivore squads cannot be reinforced with special leader units like a Shas'ui or Shield Drone.

tc_text: 但是克魯特掠食者可以由一種稱為「克魯特塑形者」的特殊部隊帶領。塑形者可以提高克魯特小隊的速度和生命值，使他們成為更可怕的敵人。
en_text: Kroot Carnivores can, however, be led by a special unit called a Kroot Shaper. Shapers boost the speed and health of Kroot squads, making them even more fearsome to your enemies.

tc_text: 選擇克魯特兵營，並建造一名克魯特塑形者。
en_text: Select the Kroot Barracks and build a Kroot Shaper.

tc_text: 很好﹗塑形者已經到達。但是必須讓塑形者加入小隊，否則他對你沒有什麼好處。
en_text: Excellent! The Shaper has arrived. But the Shaper will do you little good until he is attached to a squad.

tc_text: 選擇塑形者，並點擊「加入」按鈕。現在，選擇一個克魯特掠食者小隊。
en_text: Select your Shaper and click the Attach button. Now, select a Kroot Carnivore Squad.

tc_text: 很好﹗塑形者已經加入克魯特掠食者小隊了。
en_text: Excellent! The Shaper has now joined the Kroot Carnovore squad.

tc_text: 有塑形者加入的克魯特小隊可以移動得更迅速，小隊的所有成員亦獲得額外的生命力。
en_text: A Kroot squad with a Shaper attached moves more quickly and all members of the squad gain additional health.

tc_text: 塑形者只能加入克魯特掠食者或克魯特獵犬小隊（這是你在科技樹中有所進展時所獲得的另一種小隊）。
en_text: Shaper can only attach to squads of Kroot Carnivores or Kroot Hounds, a squad available when you advance in the Tech Tree.

tc_text: 要讓領袖離開小隊，只需選擇小隊，再點選「脫離」圖示。它的位置和「加入」圖示相同。但是要記得，塑形者若不加入小隊，對你沒有多大好處。
en_text: To detach the leader from this squad, simply select the squad, then click the Detach icon. It is located in the same place as the Attach icon. But remember that Shapers add little to your cause unless they are attached to a squad.

tc_text: 現在應該試試你所學習到的內容。選擇一個烈焰戰士小隊和一個克魯特掠食者小隊，並將它們移動到指示的地點。記住，要讓克魯特掠食者走在前面，他們才能保護烈焰戰士，不被敵人的近戰部隊攻擊。
en_text: Time to put what you've learned to the test. Select a Fire Warrior Team and a Kroot Carnivore squad and move them to the indicated point. Remember to send your Kroot Carnivores ahead so they can screen the Fire Warriors from any enemy melee units.

tc_text: 發現敵人。在敵方小隊上按滑鼠右鍵以進行攻擊。
en_text: Enemy spotted. Attack the enemy by right-clicking on the enemy squad.

tc_text: 記得要讓克魯特進入近距離戰鬥，並讓烈焰戰士保持一段距離。這樣一來敵人就會被釘在原處。若有傷亡，就增援小隊。
en_text: Remember to bring your Kroot into melee and keep your Fire Warriors a short distance away. This way enemy units are pinned down. Reinforce your squads to make up for any casualties.

tc_text: 很好，你已經消滅了敵人的小隊。
en_text: Excellent you have destroyed the enemy squad.

tc_text: 用你的小隊去探勘基地週圍的地圖，並佔據你發現的所有戰略位置。要完成這個目標，你必須佔領三個戰略位置。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 務必使用大地級建築艇，在佔領的戰略位置上建造監聽哨。這樣可以強化它們，對付敵人。
en_text: Make sure to use your Earth-Caste Builder to build Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 遺址讓你獲得額外的軍備資源，但是並非建造鈦星部隊的必要條件。但是大多數其他種族需要遺址才能建造他們最強大的部隊，因此透過佔領遺址，你可以讓敵人無法使用他們最好部隊和技術。
en_text: Relics gain you additional Requisition, but aren't strictly necessary to build any Tau units. Most other races need Relics to build their most potent units, however, so by capturing Relics you deny your enemy access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 很好!你已經占領了一處遺址。你可以建立監聽哨，以鞏固我方已占領的遺址。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造一個次元信號浮標。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build a Vehicle Beacon.

tc_text: 正如鈦兵營和克魯特兵營用來建造步兵部隊一樣，次元信號浮標用來建造載具。
en_text: Just like the Tau Barracks and Kroot Barracks are used to build infantry units, the Vehicle Beacon is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 很好!你已經順利建立一座次元信號浮標。現在你可以開始透過這座次元信號浮標建立威力強大的載具。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Vehicle Beacon. You can build powerful vehicles from this building.

tc_text: 一旦達到載具上限，你就無法繼續建立更多的載具。你可以興建研究建築來提升載具上限，就和小隊上限一樣。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can increase your Vehicle Cap by building research buildings, just like Squad Cap.

tc_text: 選擇你的次元信號浮標，並建造一架天魟導彈戰艇。
en_text: Select your Vehicle Beacon and build a Skyray Missile Gunship.

tc_text: 天魟導彈戰艇是多用途的支援載具，可以發射飛彈。他們有很好的射程，並擅於使步兵混亂。
en_text: Skyrays are versatile support vehicles that fire missiles. They have excellent range and excel at disrupting infantry.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你有天魟導彈戰艇。你可以在啟蒙閘道裡研究飛彈彈幕能力，以便升級天魟導彈戰艇。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Skyray. You can upgrade the Skyray by researching the Missile Barrage ability at the Path to Enlightenment.

tc_text: 鈦星帝國的階級通常採取兩種主要策略之一。這兩種策略各有自己的研究築，分別稱為蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心和考恩戰術指揮所，並用來建造特殊部隊。
en_text: Tau Empire cadres generally follow one of two broad strategies. Each strategy has its own research building called a Command Post and allows construction of special units.

tc_text: 蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心專注於「致命擊殺」戰略，焦點在於行動火力。
en_text: The Mont'ka Command Post commits the cadre to the "Killing Blow" strategy that focuses on mobile firepower.

tc_text: 考恩戰術指揮所則採取「耐性獵人」的戰略，倚重步兵和克魯特的特殊部隊。
en_text: The Kauyon Command Post commits the cadre to the "Patient Hunter" strategy that relies of infantry and Kroot special units.

tc_text: 在同一場戰役中，你不能同時興建這兩種建築，因此在每一場戰役中，你必須選擇那一種戰略最適合眼前的狀況。
en_text: You cannot build both command posts during the same battle, so in each battle you will have to choose which strategy is best for the situation at hand.

tc_text: 就這個教學課程而言，我們將採取蒙特卡，或「致命擊殺」戰略。
en_text: For the purposes of this Tutorial, we will pursue the Mont'ka or "Killing Blow" strategy.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並建造蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心。
en_text: Select your Earth-Caste Builder and build the Mont'ka Command Post.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你致力於蒙特卡的科技樹。注意，作戰中心已經提升你的部隊上限和載具上限。
en_text: Excellent! You are now committed to the Mont'ka tech tree. Note that the Command Post has increased your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心使你的部隊有新部隊可用。選擇鈦兵營，並建造一個XV8個殲擊機甲小隊。
en_text: The Mont'ka Command Post has made new units available for your army. Select your Tau Barracks and build an XV8 Crisis Suit Team.

tc_text: 殲擊機甲是具備可升級武器的機械化機甲。就和鈦星人所有的戰鬥機甲一樣，它們佔用的是部隊上限而不是載具上限（更重型的載具才使用）。
en_text: Crisis Suits are mechanized battlesuits with upgradeable weapons. Like all Tau battlesuits, they use Squad Cap rather than Vehicle Cap (used by heavier vehicles).

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你有了一個XV8殲擊機甲小隊。你可以增援這個小隊，並為他們選擇武器升級。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a squad of XV8 Crisis Suits. You can reinforce this squad and choose weapon upgrades for them as well.

tc_text: 蒙特卡哲學最強力的部隊是重形載具，例如鎚頭鯊戰艇。但是要建造這部載具，你還需要其它的研究。
en_text: The most powerful units of the Mont'ka philosophy are heavy vehicles like the Hammerhead Gunship. To build this vehicle, however, you need to pursue additional research.

tc_text: 選擇蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心，並研究蒙特卡教義。
en_text: Select the Mont'ka Command Post and research the Teachings of Mont'ka.

tc_text: 很好。現在你可以建造鎚頭鯊戰艇。
en_text: Excellent. You can now build the Hammerhead Gunship.

tc_text: 選擇次元信號浮標，並建造一架鎚頭鯊戰艇。
en_text: Select your Vehicle Beacon and build a Hammerhead Gunship.

tc_text: 很好。現在你的戰場上有一架威力強大的鎚頭鯊戰艇。這輛重型坦克可以對敵人造成巨大的傷害。
en_text: Excellent. You now have a powerful Hammerhead Gunship on the field. This heavy tank can deal out huge amounts of punishment to the enemy.

tc_text: 選擇你的大地級建築艇，並且建立一個聯盟中樞站。
en_text: Select your Earth-caste Builder and build a Coalition Center.

tc_text: 很好。聯盟中樞站準備好了。
en_text: Excellent. Your Coalition Center is ready.

tc_text: 聯盟中樞站允許你建造最終極的鈦星人部隊，乙太導師。 這名英雄出身於領導鈦星帝國的階級，並且擁有幾項強大的能力。
en_text: The Coalition Center allows you to build the ultimate Tau unit, the Ethereal. This hero is from the caste that leads the Tau Empire and has several powerful abilities.

tc_text: 選擇聯盟中樞站，並建造一名乙太導師。
en_text: Select your Coalition Center and build an Ethereal.

tc_text: 很好。乙太導師的存在就能強化所有的鈦星人部隊，提高他們的士氣、健康和傷害力。
en_text: Excellent. The presence of the Ethereal strengthens all your Tau units, increasing their morale, health and the amount of damage they do.

tc_text: 乙太導師自己也有幾項特殊能力，例如從鈦星人空級的軌道大砲發動攻擊。
en_text: The Ethereal himself also has several special abilities, such as calling down a strike from the orbital artillery of the Tau Air Caste.

tc_text: 但是要小心。乙太導師的死對鈦星人而言是重大的打擊。如果乙太導師死於戰鬥中，所有鈦星人部隊的士氣和生命力都會暫時喪失。
en_text: Be careful, though. The death of an Ethereal can be a crushing blow to a Tau cadre. If your Ethereal dies in combat, all Tau units will suffer a temporary loss of morale and health.

tc_text: 為了提高你能生產的小隊數量，你必須興建研究設施，例如啟蒙閘道或蒙特卡殲滅作戰中心。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Tau Empire, you need to build research facilities like the Path to Enlightenment or the Mont'ka Command Post.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建立你的基地，你需要一個大地級建築艇。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need an Earth-Caste Builder.

tc_text: 選擇你的鈦總司令部，並建造一個大地級建築艇。
en_text: Select your Cadre Headquarters and build an Earth-Caste Builder.

tc_text: 使用步兵部隊佔領戰略位置，用大地級建築艇在其上建造監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points, and Earth-Caste Builders to build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 只要用滑鼠左鍵按一下部隊或建築物，即可將其選取起來。現在請前往你的基地，並選取浮石巨塔。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Monolith.

tc_text: 選取浮石巨塔之後，螢幕右下角便會出現「建造者聖甲蟲」圖示。現在請按一下這個按鈕。
en_text: Select your Monolith and look for the Builder Scarab icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你有一隻建築者聖甲蟲。 建築者聖甲蟲是是死靈族的建造部隊。每當你要建立新的建築物時，便需要用到建築者聖甲蟲。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Builder Scarab. Builder Scarabs are the Necron builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Builder Scarab drone.

tc_text: 使用死靈族時，你的主要目標是令浮石巨塔恢復運作，它是一座移動堡壘，在每次遊戲開始時，都處於休眠狀態，並且埋在沙地裡。
en_text: Your main objective when playing the Necrons is to revive the Monolith, a mobile fortress that begins each game dormant and buried in the sands.

tc_text: 當你建造第二座建築時，就能恢復浮石巨塔的功能，並使用越來越強大的部隊。
en_text: As you build secondary structures, you can revive your Monolith and gain access to more and more powerful units.

tc_text: 幾乎所有的死靈族部隊、建築和升級都需要電力才能作用。建造電漿發電機可以為你提供興起不死軍隊所需要的電力。
en_text: Almost all Necron units, structures and upgrades require Power to function. Building Plasma Generators will supply you with the Power you need to raise your deathless army.

tc_text: 選擇建築者聖甲蟲，並建造四台電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab and build four Plasma Generators.

tc_text: 電力來了!電漿發電機將會以固定的速率持續生產電力。請注意，每座浮石巨塔所能建造的電漿發電機數目都具有一定的上限。
en_text: You now have a steady flow of Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Monolith.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能在控制區域內部建立，而某些特定的建築物 (例如監聽哨) 則可以在控制區域以外的地點建立。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Obelisks, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 除了興建建築之外，建築者聖甲蟲也是惟一能夠佔領戰略位置的死靈族部隊。戰略位置位於戰場上具有極高戰略價值的地區。
en_text: In addition to building structures, Builder Scarabs are also the only Necron unit that can capture Strategic Points. Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 佔領戰略位置，敵人就無法使用。其他種族使用戰略位置來產生資源，因此佔領戰略位置可以妨礙他們的努力。
en_text: Capturing Strategic Points denies them from the enemy. Other races use Strategic Points to generate resources, so capturing points can hamper their efforts.

tc_text: 在戰略位置上按滑鼠右鍵，命令建築者聖甲蟲前去佔領該位置。
en_text: Order the Builder Scarab to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 很好!你已經佔領這個戰略位置!
選擇建築者聖甲蟲，並在佔領的戰略位置上建造一座方尖石碑。
en_text: Select the Builder Scarab and build an Obelisk on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 方尖石碑可強化你對戰略位置的掌控，可以加速你建造部隊及建築、以及研究升級。
en_text: The Obelisk fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, which accelerates the speed at which you build units and structures and research upgrades.

tc_text: 很好!這個戰略位置已經受到嚴密防護，敵人難以攻佔。注意螢幕左上方的死靈族時間修正器的度量增加了。你應該繼續在所有已佔領的戰略位置上建造方尖石碑。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. Note that the Necron Time Modifier indicator on the top left of your screen has increased. You should continue to build Obelisks on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 選擇你的浮石巨塔，並建造一個死靈戰士小隊。
en_text: Select your Monolith and build a Necron Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 死靈戰士是你的基本步兵部隊。 他們使用強力的高斯武器，生產費用也非常便宜，但是移動十分緩慢。
en_text: Necron Warriors are your basic infantry unit. They wield powerful gauss weapons and are very cheap to produce, but are quite slow-moving.

tc_text: 很好。你已經建造了一個死靈戰士小隊。
en_text: Excellent. You have built a squad of Necron Warriors.

tc_text: 「增援」是將額外的部隊加入小隊中、使其戰鬥效能達到最大的動作。選擇一個死靈戰士小隊。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness. Select a Necron Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 一旦有死靈戰士不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a Necron Warrior falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 恭喜你﹗ 你已經強化你的死靈戰士小隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Necron Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 你的浮石巨塔所具有的後勤補給可以支援一定數目的部隊，而你在特定時間所能支援的部隊數目稱為「部隊上限」。
en_text: Your Monolith has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你可以透過佔領戰略位置、並在其上興建方尖石碑的方式來提高部隊上限。你不能以這種方法使部隊上限超過20，但是確實有一些能力能讓你達成這個目的。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by capturing Strategic Points and building Obelisks on them. You cannot go beyond a Squad Cap of twenty in this way, but some abilities do allow you to do so.

tc_text: 就和大多數的種族一樣，死靈族也能建造一個英雄部隊來領導整支軍隊。 這位英雄就是死靈領主，卡坦手下古老而強大的僕人。
en_text: Like most races, Necrons can build a single hero unit to lead their entire force. This leader is the Necron Lord, an ancient and powerful servant of the C'tan.

tc_text: 現在選擇浮石巨塔，並建造死靈領主。
en_text: Select the Monolith and build the Necron Lord now.

tc_text: 死靈領主是你最強大的部隊之一，可以獲得多種升級和特殊能力。你會注意到死靈領主尚未活動的身體已經以碎片的樣式出現在浮石巨塔附近。
en_text: The Necron Lord is one of your most powerful units and can receive a variety of upgrades and special abilities. You'll notice that the Necron Lord's inactive body is already in pieces near your Monolith.

tc_text: 恭喜你﹗你已經建造了死靈領主。注意，死靈領主現有的身體是重新復活，而不是從浮石巨塔裡出現。如果後來死靈領主在戰鬥過程中死亡，你可以再次建造他，使他在死亡的地點上復活。
en_text: Congratulations! You have finished building the Necron Lord. Note that the Necron Lord's existing body has reanimated rather than emerging from the Monolith. If the Necron Lord is later killed in battle, you can reanimate his body where it fell by building the unit again.

tc_text: 如果你的時間修正器過低，要恢復浮石巨塔的能力和召喚部隊都要花很長的時間。要提高修正器的量度，就要佔領並鞏固更多的戰略位置。
en_text: Reviving your Monolith and summoning forces can be a long process if your Time Modifier is low. To raise your modifier, capture and secure more Strategic Points.

tc_text: 用你的小隊去探勘基地週圍的地圖，並使用建築者聖甲蟲來佔據你發現的所有戰略位置。要完成這個目標，你必須佔領三個戰略位置。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter using your Builder Scarabs. To complete this objective you must Capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 務必使用建築者聖甲蟲，在佔領的戰略位置上建造方尖石碑。這樣可以強化它們，對付敵人，並提高你的時間修正器。
en_text: Make sure to also use your Builder Scarabs to build Obelisks on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies and increases your Time Modifier.

tc_text: 你可能要用浮石巨塔建造更多的建築者聖甲蟲小隊，並且增援這些小隊，以協助佔領並鞏固這些位置。
en_text: You may wish to build more Builder Scarab squads from your Monolith and reinforce those squads to help capture and fortify these points.

tc_text: 很好﹗你已經佔領三個戰略位置，並在上面建造方尖石碑。佔領並固守戰略位置是戰勝敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Obelisks on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 選擇一個建築者聖甲蟲小隊，並建造一個召喚核心。
en_text: Select a Builder Scarab squad and build a Summoning Core now.

tc_text: 為了使用更強大的部隊，並且開始啟動浮石巨塔，你必須建造召喚核心。
en_text: You must build the Summoning Core in order to access more powerful units and to begin the revival of your Monolith.

tc_text: 很好，現在召喚核心開始運作了。我們準備開始喚醒浮石巨塔。
en_text: Excellent, the Summoning Core is now operational. We are ready to begin awakening the Monolith.

tc_text: 選擇浮石巨塔，並點選「喚醒浮石巨塔」圖示。
en_text: Select the Monolith and click on the Awaken Monolith icon.

tc_text: 當浮石巨塔覺醒時，它從沙裡浮現，有更多的古老系統開始運作。可以使用更強大的部隊。
en_text: As the Monolith Awakens, it emerges from the sands and more of its ancient systems become operational. More powerful units become available.

tc_text: 很好﹗你的浮石巨塔已經被喚醒了。要讓浮石巨塔完全恢復運作，需要更進一步的升級。
en_text: Excellent! Your Monolith is now Awakened. Further upgrades will be necessary to make the Monolith completely operational.

tc_text: 選擇覺醒的浮石巨塔，並建造一個剝皮者小隊。
en_text: Select the Awakened Monolith and build a Flayed Ones squad.

tc_text: 剝皮者是強大的近戰部隊，現在可以加入我們的死靈族軍隊。
en_text: Flayed Ones are powerful melee units that are now available to add to our Necron army.

tc_text: 很好。你的剝皮者小隊已經準備好了。
en_text: Excellent. Your squad of Flayed Ones is now ready.

tc_text: 你會注意到剝皮者還沒有出現在戰場上。事實上，這些部隊可能從你的部隊所能見到的任何地下墳墓中被召喚出來，甚至可以出現在敵人的中間。
en_text: You'll notice that the Flayed Ones haven't appeared on the battlefield yet. Indeed, these units can be called from their underground tombs anywhere your units can see, even in the midst of your enemies.

tc_text: 選擇覺醒的浮石巨塔。注意顯示在畫面底部中央的剝皮者圖示。這表示有一個小隊可以部署。
en_text: Select your Awakened Monolith. Notice the Flayed Ones icon in the display at the bottom center of your screen. This means a squad is ready to be deployed.

tc_text: 在小隊圖示上按滑鼠左鍵，再於你已經揭開的地圖的任意位置上按滑鼠左鍵。
en_text: Left-click on the squad icon and then left-click anywhere on the map you have revealed.

tc_text: 除了在面對面戰鬥中造成嚴重傷害之外，剝皮者也會散發一股可怕的氣息，對附近的敵方部隊造成士氣傷害。
en_text: In addition to doing serious damage in hand to hand combat, Flayed Ones project a terrifying aura, doing Morale damage to enemy units near them.

tc_text: 選擇一個建築者聖甲蟲小隊，建造禁斷文庫。
en_text: Select a squad of Builder Scarabs and build a Forbidden Archive.

tc_text: 禁斷文庫允許你為死靈領主裝備可怕的神器，使他更加強大。
en_text: The Forbidden Archive allows you to equip your Necron Lord with dread artifacts, making him even more powerful.

tc_text: 很好﹗禁斷文庫完成了。
en_text: Excellent! The Forbidden Archive is ready.

tc_text: 選擇禁斷文庫。你會在螢幕右邊看到幾個不同的圖示。 這些神器都是死靈領主可以進行升級的項目。
en_text: Select the Forbidden Archive. You'll notice several different icons on the right side of your screen. Each of these artifacts are possible upgrades to the Necron Lord.

tc_text: 有一些圖示呈灰色，表示該神器還不能使用。
en_text: Some icons are grayed out, meaning that artifact isn't available yet.

tc_text: 雖然有許多不同的神器可以使用，但是在一場戰役中最多只能獲得三個神器。因此你必須小心選擇升級項目。
en_text: Although there are many different artifacts available, you can never acquire more than three over the course of a single battle. So you need to choose your upgrades carefully.

tc_text: 就本課程而言，我們要選擇「避邪」。點選它的圖示。
en_text: For this tutorial we'll choose the Phylactery upgrade. Click on its icon now.

tc_text: 很好。現在死靈領主裝備了「避邪」。 一大群小聖甲蟲圍繞他，使他難以被擊中，並且混淆其敵手。
en_text: Excellent. The Necron Lord is now equipped with a Phylactery. A swarm of small scarabs surround him, making him harder to hit and confounding his opponents.

tc_text: 如果你選擇了死靈領主，就會發現避邪圖示已經出現在升級區中。
en_text: If you select the Necron Lord, you'll notice that the Phylactery icon has now appeared in the upgrades area.

tc_text: 現在應該試試你所學習到的內容。選擇一個死靈戰士小隊和一個剝皮者小隊，並將它們移動到指示的地點。
en_text: Time to put what you've learned to the test. Select a Necron Warrior squad and a Flayed One squad and move them to the indicated point.

tc_text: 注意剝皮者在接近時一直受到傷害，但是當他們接近時，敵人小隊的士氣迅速下降。同時死靈戰士從遠處進行攻擊。
en_text: Note that the Flayed Ones take damage as approach, but the enemy squad quickly looses morale when they get near. Your Necron Warriors, meanwhile can fire from a distance.

tc_text: 死靈族小隊在戰鬥過程中擁有一個非常強大的優勢。身為星辰諸神的不死結構，非常難以徹底破壞他們。
en_text: Necron squads benefit from a powerful advantage in combat. As deathless constructs of the Star Gods, they are very difficult to completely destroy.

tc_text: 每當一個死靈族步兵部隊被摧毀時，它都有機會在幾秒鐘以後重組復活。以這種方式重回戰場的部隊的生命力不如從前，但是功能完全不受影響。
en_text: Whenever a Necron infantry unit is destroyed, there's a chance it will reassemble itself and rise again a few seconds later. Units that reactivate like this return at diminished health, but are otherwise fully functional.

tc_text: 這個過程是自動的，因此你不必理會它。只是當你發現手下的部隊自行復原、重新投入戰鬥時，不要太吃驚。
en_text: This process is automatic, so you don't have to worry about it. Just don’t be surprised to see your troops pulling themselves back together to fight anew.

tc_text: 選擇建築者聖甲蟲，並建造大型召喚核心。
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab and build a Greater Summoning core.

tc_text: 正如召喚核心一樣，大型召喚核心幫助浮石巨塔恢復更多系統，並且允許你建造更強大的單位。
en_text: Just like the Summoning Core, the Greater Summoning Core helps more of the Monolith's systems activate and allows you to build more powerful units.

tc_text: 這些新單位大多數是龐大的滑行體，在死靈族軍隊中的功能就和其他種族軍隊中的坦克和其它載具一樣。
en_text: Many of these new units are large skimmers that serve the function in a Necron army that tanks and other vehicles do in other race's forces.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你有大型召喚核心了。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Greater Summoning Core.

tc_text: 選擇浮石巨塔，並建造一個古墓蜘蛛。
en_text: Select your Monolith and build a Tomb Spyder.

tc_text: 古墓蜘蛛是大型滑行體，能進行強力的近戰攻擊。他們也有能力大量生產額外的死靈族部隊。就和死靈領主一樣，古墓蜘蛛是從碎裂的形態中啟動，而不是出現在浮石巨塔裡。
en_text: Tomb Spyders are large skimmers with powerful melee attacks. They also have the ability to spawn additional Necron units. Like the Necron Lord, Tomb Spyders activate from their broken forms on the battlefield rather than emerging from the Monolith.

tc_text: 很好！現在你有一個古墓蜘蛛了。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Tomb Spyder.

tc_text: 注意，你的浮石巨塔所能支援的古墓蜘蛛這一類的重型部隊數量有限。這個限制被稱為載具上限。
en_text: Note that your Monolith can only support a finite number of heavy units like the Tomb Spyder. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 一旦達到載具上限，你就無法繼續建立更多的載具。你可以佔領戰略位置和建造額外的方尖石碑來提升載具上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more heavy units. You can increase your Vehicle Cap by capturing strategic points and building additional Obelisks.

tc_text: 古墓蜘蛛能夠收集死靈族步兵部隊的零件並加以重組。附近有一些死靈族的遺體。將古墓蜘蛛派過去—選擇該部隊，再於指定位置上按滑鼠右鍵。
en_text: Tomb Spyders are able to collect the shattered parts of Necron infantry units and reassemble them. There are some Necron remains nearby. Send your Tomb Spyder there by selecting the unit and right clicking on the indicated point.

tc_text: 現在選擇古墓蜘蛛，再點選收割圖示。古墓蜘蛛開始處理遺體，將它們從戰場上移除。注意畫面右下方呈灰色的小隊圖示橫欄如何開始漸漸填滿。
en_text: Now select the Tomb Spyder and click the Harvest icon. The Tomb Spyder begins processing the remains, removing them from the battlefield. Note how the bars on the grayed out squad icons on the bottom right of your display begin to fill.

tc_text: 當一個或多個圖示變成啟動狀態時，點擊圖示即可產生該類型的小隊。
en_text: When one or more of the icons become active, click them to spawn a squad of that type.

tc_text: 很好﹗古墓蜘蛛帶領另一個小隊進入戰鬥。
en_text: Excellent! The Tomb Spyder has brought another squad to the battle.

tc_text: 你可以繼續收割，或者再次點選收割圖示以停止此程序。利用古墓蜘蛛，你可以超過部隊上限。
en_text: You can continue to harvest or click on the Harvest icon again to stop the process. You can exceed your Squad Cap by several points using the Tomb Spyder.

tc_text: 浮石巨塔準備啟動更多系統。選擇浮石巨塔，並點擊「交戰的浮石巨塔」圖示。
en_text: The Monolith is ready to have more of its systems reactivated. Select the Monolith and click the Engaged Monolith icon.

tc_text: 交戰的浮石巨塔允許你生產最強大的死靈族部隊，並為死靈領主研究強大的升級。
en_text: An Engaged Monolith allows you to spawn the most powerful Necron units and research powerful upgrades for your Necron Lord.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你的浮石巨塔進入交戰，幾乎可以開始攻佔戰場了。
en_text: Excellent! Your Monolith is now engaged and almost ready to take to the field.

tc_text: 選擇建築者聖甲蟲，並建造一個能量核心
en_text: Select your Builder Scarab and build an Energy Core

tc_text: 這是令浮石巨塔完全恢復功能所需要的最後一項元件。它也允許你的死靈領主使用可怕的「致夜者元質」。
en_text: This is the last component needed to bring the mighty Monolith back to full functionality. It also allows your Necron Lord to assume the terrible Essence of the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 很好﹗現在你有了能量核心。
en_text: Excellent! You now have an Energy Core.

tc_text: 使浮石巨塔完全恢復功能的時刻來臨了，使它成為戰場上最強大的部隊。
en_text: The time has finally come to completely restore the Monolith, making it into the most powerful unit on the battlefield.

tc_text: 選擇浮石巨塔，再點選「復原浮石巨塔」圖示。
en_text: Select the Monolith a click on the Restored Monolith icon.

tc_text: 一旦恢復，浮石巨塔就成為一座活動堡壘，具有難以置信的火力。雖然移動緩慢，浮石巨塔能夠在地點之間傳送，輕易略過敵人的防禦。
en_text: Once restored, the Monolith will become a mobile fortress with incredible firepower. Although it moves slowly, the Monolith can also teleport from one point to another, passing over enemy defenses with ease.

tc_text: 很好。浮石巨塔已經復原，準備消滅敵人。
en_text: Excellent. The Monolith is restored and ready to lay waste to the enemy.

tc_text: 雖然可以移動，浮石巨塔仍然是你的總部，照常生產部隊。
en_text: Although mobile, the Monolith still functions as your headquarters, producing units as normal.

tc_text: 選擇禁斷文庫，並為死靈領主取得「復活天體」神器。
en_text: Select the Forbidden Archive and acquire the Resurrection Orb artifact for your Necron Lord.

tc_text: 很好。現在你的死靈領主使用復活天體，讓你能夠復活死去的死靈族部隊。
en_text: Excellent. Your Necron Lord now wields the Resurrection Orb, a powerful artifact that allows you to raise fallen Necrons.

tc_text: 選擇死靈領主，將他移到指定的位置。那裡有許多死靈族等待復活。
en_text: Select your Necron Lord and move him to the indicated point. There are a number of Necron remains there waiting to be revived.

tc_text: 選擇死靈領主，並點擊集體復活圖示。
en_text: Now select your Necron Lord and click on the Mass Resurrection icon.

tc_text: 很好。死靈領主使用他的復活天體，令死去的死靈族復活。
en_text: Excellent. The Necron Lord has used his Resurrection Orb to bring back the fallen Necrons.

tc_text: 這些復活的戰士生命力低落，但是功能完全恢復。你可以增援這些小隊，以恢復他們的力量，有時候可以使用建築者聖甲蟲來修理損壞的部隊。
en_text: These risen warriors have low health but are otherwise fully functional You can reinforce these squads to restore their strength and in some cases use Builder Scarabs to repair damaged units.

tc_text: 集體復活允許你超過部隊上限的限制。
en_text: Mass Resurrection allows you to surpass your Squad Cap by several points.

tc_text: 除了從禁斷文庫進行升級以外，死靈領主也可以使用他的星神—致夜者的元質。
en_text: Beyond the upgrades from the Forbidden Archive, the Necron Lord is also able to channel to essence of his mighty Star God, the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 選擇能量核心，研究「致夜者元質」。
en_text: Select the Energy Core and research the Essence of the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 致夜者是死靈原族（後來成為死靈族）最初的神祇。就是為了滿足他無限的慾望，死靈族才會殘殺生靈。
en_text: The Nightbringer is the original deity of the Necrontyr, the race who became the Necrons. It is to feed his endless appetite that the Necrons purge the living.

tc_text: 很好﹗死靈領主已經變化，接收致夜者元質。
en_text: Excellent! The Necron Lord has transformed, taking on the essence of the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 這種影響只會持續短暫時間，但是在有效時間內，你可以消滅你的對手。
en_text: This effect will only last a short time, but while it does, you may lay waste to your opponents.

tc_text: 很好！現在死靈領主準備接收致夜者元質。
en_text: Excellent! The Necron Lord is now ready to take on the Essence of the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 現在選擇你的死靈領主。注意，出現了一個新圖示，讓他召喚致夜者。點選這個圖示。
en_text: Now select your Necron Lord. Notice that a new icon has appeared allowing him to summon the Nightbringer. Click this icon now.

tc_text: 為了提高你能生產的小隊數量，你必須佔領更多戰略位置及興建更多方尖石碑。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field, you need to capture more strategic points and build additional Obelisks.

tc_text: 記住，電漿發電機產生電力資源。 使用建築者聖甲蟲建造更多發電機，以增加你的電源。
en_text: Remember, Plasma Generators produce the Power Resource. Use your Builder Scarabs to build more generators to increase your Power supply.

tc_text: 為了更進一步建立你的基地，你需要一個建築者聖甲蟲。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Builder Scarab.

tc_text: 選擇浮石巨塔，並建造一隻建築者聖甲蟲。
en_text: Select your Monolith and build a Builder Scarab.

tc_text: 使用復原的浮石巨塔消滅敵人。
en_text: Use your restored Monolith to exterminate the enemy.

tc_text: 建造步兵和重型小隊來支持你的堡壘，消滅大批敵人。
en_text: Build infantry and heavy squads to support your fortress, cutting down scores of enemies.

tc_text: 研究禁斷文庫的升級功能，讓死靈領主本身成為一支強大的武力。
en_text: Research upgrades at the Forbidden Archive to make your Necron Lord a mighty force in his own right.

tc_text: 在這個戰場上取得勝利之後，請前往其他戰場，與敵人一決高下。除非你已徹底殲滅敵人，否則這場戰爭將永無終止之日。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until the whole galaxy has been purged of life.

tc_text: 歡迎光臨「破曉之戰：暗黑聖戰」的單玩者戰役。這些教學視窗將帶領你完成前兩回合遊戲，介紹這個全新戰役模式的重要特色。/ 你的目標是征服克諾努斯星。這個世界的大陸被分為二十五個不同的行省。你的征服行動將逐省進行。 / 戰役地圖是你在指揮部隊的戰略行動時的主要界面。個別的戰役則在小規模的戰役地圖上進行。
en_text: Welcome to the single-player campaign of Dawn of War: Dark Crusade. These tutorial windows will guide you through the first two turns of play and introduce key features of this all-new campaign mode. / Your goal is to conquer the Planet Kronus. This world's inhabited continent is divided into twenty-five different provinces. Your conquest of the planet will happen one province at a time. / The campaign map is your major interface for directing your troops' strategic moves. Individual battles are fought on the smaller-scaled battle map.

tc_text: 這個行省是你的要塞，或家鄉。你從這裡發動對克諾努斯的征服行動。如果你的要塞被人征服，你就會被逐出克諾努斯，戰役亦告失敗。 / 由於這是第一回合，因此這是你惟一控制的行省。 / 敵方陣營各自擁有自己的要塞，由戰役地圖上的旗幟標示。要贏得戰役，奪取克諾努斯，你必須征服這六個防禦堅強的行省。
en_text: This province is your stronghold, or home province. It is from here that you are launching your conquest of Kronus. If your stronghold is ever conquered, you will be pushed from Kronus and lose the campaign. / Since this is the first turn, this is the only province you currently control. / The enemy factions each have their own strongholds, identified by banners on the campaign map. To win the campaign and make Kronus yours, you must conquer all six of these heavily defended provinces.

tc_text: 指揮官的圖片指出你的主力軍隊目前的位置。你只能攻擊主力軍隊所在行省的鄰接行省，因此軍隊在地圖上的位置決定了你的選擇。 / 敵方陣營各自擁有自己的軍隊，也只能攻擊鄰接的省份。但是你的敵人之一控制了帕翁尼斯省的一個太空港。他可以攻擊地圖上的任一地區。
en_text: The figure of your commander indicates the current position of your main army. You can only attack a province that borders the province where your army is, so its position on the map defines your options. / The enemy factions each have armies of their own and also can only attack adjacent provinces. One of your enemies, however, controls a space port in the Pavonis province. He can attack all over the map.

tc_text: 這些箭頭顯示你的軍隊在這個回合中可以移動或攻擊的地方。紅色箭頭表示攻入敵人的行省。綠色箭頭表示移進友方行省。 / 因為這是你的第一回合，而且你只控制自己的行省，因此你必須攻擊敵人的行省。 / 要移進或攻擊一個行省，請按滑鼠左鍵選擇該行省，然後點選右側面板中的攻擊或移動按鈕。我們應該從攻擊敵人行省開始。選擇你要攻擊的行省，再點選攻擊按鈕。 / 在行省上按滑鼠左鍵都會叫出這些箭頭（除非你在這個回合中不能再移動）。
en_text: These arrows show you where your army can move or attack this turn. Red arrows indicate attacks into enemy provinces. Green arrows indicate moves into friendly provinces. / Since this is your first turn, and you only control your stronghold, you must attack an enemy province. / To move to or attack a province, left-click to select that province and then click on the Attack or Move button in the right panel. We should begin by attacking an enemy province. Select the province you want to attack and click the Attack button. / Left-clicking on a province always brings up these arrows (unless you have no more moves left this turn).

tc_text: 這個畫面顯示你所帶領進行攻擊的部隊，如果你決定稍後再攻擊，也可以返回戰役地圖。 / 因為這是你的第一次攻擊，因此大部份選項都不能選擇。/ 等你準備要攻擊時，只管點選攻擊按鈕。這樣會讓你進入戰役地圖，在遊戲中面對敵人。
en_text: This screen shows you the forces you are leading into an attack and allows you to return to the campaign map if you decide you want to attack later. / Since this is your first attack, most options aren't yet available. / When you're ready to attack, just click on the Attack button. This will take you to the battle map, where you will face enemies in a game of Dawn of War.

tc_text: 當你征服越來越多省時，你的指揮官就會獲得特殊裝備。這個裝備稱為戰爭裝備。 / 你不會獲得特定的某一件戰爭裝備；在每次獎賞時，你必須從這個畫面的列表中選擇一項。（注意，你可能必須先拿到某些戰爭裝備，才能解開其它更具威力的版本。）
en_text: As you conquer more and more provinces, you'll be awarded pieces of special equipment for your commander. This equipment is called wargear. / You will never be awarded a specific piece of wargear. Instead, for each award, you get to choose one piece from the list on this screen. (Note that you may have to get some pieces of wargear to unlock other, more powerful versions.)

tc_text: 恭喜！你征服了第一個行省。這場勝利給你數項獎賞，包括一件戰爭裝備，以及該行省提供的加成。 / 地圖上的每個行省都有一項特殊加成。當你選擇該行省時，這項加成顯示在右側面板中。 / 有些行省讓你有能力訓練一個特殊部隊，作為指揮官的榮譽護衛。在訓練完畢後，這些部隊會隨著你的指揮官進入戰役的初始階段。你可以在指揮官畫面或攻擊畫面中訓練這些部隊（如果他們在戰役中被毀，也可以再度訓練）。 / 其它行省給你特殊能力，例如艾瑞惡地讓你每回合能夠攻擊兩次。
en_text: Congratulations! You have conquered your first province. This victory has given you several rewards, including a piece of wargear and the bonus from the province. / Every province on the map has a special bonus. This bonus is displayed in the right-hand panel when you select the province. / Some provinces give you the ability to train a special unit for your commander's honor guard. Once trained, these units accompany your commander into the initial stages of battle. You can train these units (or retrain them if they are destroyed in battle) from the Commander Screen or the Attack Screen. / Other provinces give you special abilities, like the Eres Badlands which gives you the ability to attack twice per turn.

tc_text: 這是你剛剛征服的行省。注意，它已經改變為你的顏色，現在你的軍隊在這裡。每當你征服一個行省時，你的軍隊就會移到該省。 / 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。 / 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: This is the province you've just conquered. Notice that it has changed to your color and that your army is now here. Whenever you conquer a province, your army moves to that province. / You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn, new provinces will be available for you to attack. / When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 敵人擊退你對該行省的攻擊。 / 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。 / 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: The enemy repelled your attack on the province. / You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn you will be able to attack again and avenge yourself. / When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 每一個敵方陣營會輪流行動。和你一樣，他們各自擁有自己的要塞和軍隊。他們會移動自己的軍隊，或是攻擊及增援其行省。 / 留意敵人的軍隊在什麼地方。軍隊會增援鄰近遭受攻擊的友軍，用額外的軍隊強化防禦。
en_text: Each of the enemy factions will now act in turn. Like you, they each have their own strongholds and armies. They will each move their armies or attack and reinforce their provinces in turn. / Pay attention to where your enemies' armies are. Armies will reinforce nearby friendly provinces under attack, bolstering the defense with additional troops.

tc_text: 你的行省遭受攻擊。 / 你可以選擇在戰役地圖上進行戰鬥，或是自動計算戰役結果。但是自動計算結果可能很危險，因為它是根據行省和攻擊武力的相對力量來計算。如果你自己進行戰鬥，永遠都有較佳的獲勝機會。也有一些戰爭裝備只能透過在戰役地圖上進行防禦戰才能獲得，因此你應該好好考慮是否要使用自動計算結果。 / 如果你選擇戰鬥，而且你的軍隊位於該行省或鄰近的行省中，你的指揮官和其榮譽護衛就會加入防禦。如果不是，你就必須運用駐紮在該行省中的軍隊進行戰鬥。
en_text: One of your provinces is under attack. / You can choose to fight on the battle map or to auto-resolve this battle. Auto-resolving can be dangerous, however, since it depends on the relative strength of your province and the attacker's forces. You always have a better chance of winning if you fight the battle yourself. There are also pieces of wargear that can only be earned by fighting defensive battles on the battle map, so you should think carefully before auto-resolving. / If you choose to fight and your army is on the province or one that neighbors it, your commander and his honor guard will join the defense. If not, you'll have to make do with whatever forces are garrisoned there.

tc_text: 現在又輪到你行動了。 / 你會注意到，你從所控制的行省處獲得行星軍備。每個行省在每回合都會生產行星軍備。 / 你使用行星軍備來強化行省，將部隊駐紮在該處，以及訓練榮譽護衛部隊。 / 要強化一個行省，只需在你擁有的行省上按滑鼠左鍵，再點選右側面板中的「增援」按鈕即可。
en_text: It is now your turn to act again. / You'll notice that you have gained Planetary Requisition from the provinces you control. tc_text: 這個畫面允許你將部隊駐紮在行省中。當你抵抗敵人侵略時，就可以運用這些部隊。 / 將部隊駐紮在行省中，需要花費行星軍備。可使用的部隊顯示在面板上。 / 以後你可以召回這些部隊（如果該行省不再有危險）。召回部隊可以讓你獲得駐紮他們時所使用之行星軍備的半數。 / 小心，當你接受這個畫面中的變動時，所有的購買行動都不能反悔。
en_text: This screen allows you to garrison troops in a province. These troops will be ready when you fight to defend this province from enemy attacks. / Stationing troops in a province costs you Planetary Requisition. The available units are on the panel. / Later, you can recall these troops (if the province is no longer at risk). tc_text: 恭喜。你剛剛征服了一個敵對種族的要塞。這場勝利結束了該種族征服此星球的野心。如果你能夠征服其餘的五個敵方要塞，就可贏得遊戲。 / 被打敗的種族可能還擁有幾個行省，但是沒有了要塞，他們就沒有軍隊，也沒有能力攻擊。 / 你可以掃平他們殘餘的行省，獲得相關的加成；你也可以改變目標。

tc_text: 你征服了艾瑞惡地，獲得狂怒特殊能力。 / 狂怒讓你在一回合中行動兩次，而不是一次。就和以前一樣，你可以使用每個回合來移動軍隊到你所控制的鄰接行省，或是攻擊鄰接的敵方行省。 / 這個能力立刻生效，因此你可以在這個回合中發動第二次攻擊，或是將你的軍隊從艾瑞惡地移走，再結束你的回合。

en_text: You have conquered the Ariel Highlands and gained the Bulwark special ability. / Bulwark makes it cheaper for you to reinforce your provinces. This cost savings is applied automatically.

tc_text: 你征服了海必里恩山峰，並且獲得前進基地特殊能力。 / 現在當你攻擊一個行省時，你可以在攻擊畫面中購買建築。每棟建築都要花費行星軍備，並在你到達戰役地圖時立即出現在地圖上。
en_text: You have conquered the Hyperion Peaks and gained the Forward Base special ability. / When you attack a province, you will now be able to purchase structures from the Attack Screen. Each structure costs Planetary Requisition and appears immediately when you arrive on the battle map.

tc_text: 你征服了帕翁尼斯，獲得空港特殊能力。 / 空港允許你更加自由地在戰役地圖上移動軍隊。你不再只能移入或攻擊鄰近的行省，而是可以移入或攻擊地圖上的大部份行省。 / 但是空港不允許你攻擊遠方的要塞。要攻擊敵人的要塞，你仍然必須從鄰接的行省發動攻擊。

en_text: You have conquered the Vandean Coast and gained the Industrial Production special ability. / When you fight on the battle map, you will start with additional Requisition, allowing you to produce units and structures more quickly.
