引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在迪摩斯半島一處令人厭惡的祭壇裡，失喪的靈魂將黑暗使徒艾理法斯召喚到克諾努斯。在那裡，真言持有者興建他們的黑色神殿，並對世界發動攻擊。可怕的能量以深不可測的裂縫劈開世界，將茂盛的叢林改變成散發出毀滅能量的惡夢大地。
en_text: In a foul shrine in the Deimos Peninsula, lost souls summoned the Black Apostle Eliphas to Kronus. There, the Word Bearers raised their black temples and launched their assault on the world. Eldritch energies split the earth with abyssal fissures, and remade the lush jungles into a nightmare landscape pulsing with ruinous energies.

tc_text: 艾理法斯是個高明的蠱惑者，他利用向混沌屈服之人的易怒天性。他不倚靠統一的防禦，而是允許手下的英雄和秘教領袖建立自己的衛星神殿，讓他們在其中追求自己的黑暗儀式。任何想要打敗真言持有者的攻擊者都必須擊敗大量的異教徒——包括一些軍團中最有經驗的混沌星際戰士。
en_text: A master demagogue, Eliphas made an advantage of the fractious nature of those bent to Chaos. Instead of relying on a unified defense, he allowed his champions and cult leaders to establish their own satellite temples where they could pursue their own dark rituals. Any attacker who hoped to defeat the Word Bearers would have to run a bloody gauntlet of heretics—including some of the Legion's most veteran Chaos Space Marines.

tc_text: 的確，只要在艾理法斯的城堡裡的那座巨大次元傳送門仍然開啟，殺死克諾努斯上的異教徒是沒有意義的。巫師安非恩 和錫蘇斯的黑暗魔法使這個巨大的裂縫保持在開啟狀態，為艾理法斯提供無限量的增援部隊。
en_text: Indeed, killing the heretics on Kronus was pointless so long as the great Warp portal in Eliphas's bastion remained open. The dark spells of the sorcerers Amphion and Zethus maintained this massive rend in the fabric of creation, granting Eliphas endless reinforcements.

tc_text: 只要迪摩斯的入口仍然開啟，克諾努斯就不可能獲得勝利。
en_text: So long as the Deimos portal remained open, there could be no victory on Kronus.

en_text: In a foul shrine in the Deimos Peninsula, lost souls summoned the Black Apostle Eliphas to Kronus. There, the Word Bearers raised their black temples and launched their assault on the world. Eldritch energies split the earth with abyssal fissures, and remade the lush jungles into a nightmare landscape pulsing with ruinous energies. A master demagogue, Eliphas made an advantage of the fractious nature of those bent to Chaos. Instead of relying on a unified defense, he allowed his champions and cult leaders to establish their own satellite temples where they could pursue their own dark rituals. Any attacker who hoped to defeat the Word Bearers would have to run a bloody gauntlet of heretics—including some of the Legion's most veteran Chaos Space Marines. Indeed, killing the heretics on Kronus was pointless so long as the great Warp portal in Eliphas's bastion remained open. The dark spells of the sorcerers Amphion and Zethus maintained this massive rend in the fabric of creation, granting Eliphas endless reinforcements. So long as the Deimos portal remained open, there could be no victory on Kronus.

tc_text: 我們的命運全都寫在次元之中，而你的命運就是死亡。
en_text: Our fates are all written in the Warp and yours is death.

tc_text: 混沌軍團是無窮無盡的，侵略者。 你在這裡無法獲勝。
en_text: The legions of Chaos are without end, intruder. You cannot prevail here.

tc_text: 緊抓住你的希望吧，我的朋友。這會使你的毀滅更加甜美。
en_text: Cling to your hope, my friend. It will make your destruction all the sweeter.

tc_text: 這裡只有我能聽到你的禱文，我的朋友。 並且恐怕我不會回應你。
en_text: Only I can hear your prayers here, my friend. And I'm afraid I will not answer them.

tc_text: 對，把我的戰士趕回去。我還有更多戰士。更多。
en_text: Yes, drive back my warriors. I have many more. Many more.

tc_text: 在戰鬥中，我們都尊崇恐虐。
en_text: In battle, we all honor Khorne.

tc_text: 和你的神和解吧，因為你今天就要死了。
en_text: Make peace with your gods for you die this day.

tc_text: 你無法中斷黑色的傳承。
en_text: You cannot stop the Black Inheritance.

tc_text: 次元諸神將吞吃你的夢，飲下你的靈魂。
en_text: The Warp Gods will eat your dreams and drink your soul.

tc_text: 來目睹繼承者艾理法斯的升華！
en_text: Come and witness the ascension of Eliphas the Inheritor!

tc_text: 做得好。你深入這塊祝福之土的程度比我想像的更好。
en_text: Well done. You've come further into this blessed land than I thought you would.

tc_text: 恐虐大君會在這塊土地上飲你的血。
en_text: Lord Khorne will drink your blood from the very soil.

tc_text: 你的士兵之死就是祭物。多派一些人來，餵養混沌的力量！
en_text: Your soldiers serve in their deaths. Send more of them to feed the power of Chaos!

tc_text: 混沌是無限的，我的朋友。破壞一座神殿，在同一個位置上會生出兩座來。
en_text: Chaos is infinite, my friend. Destroy one temple and two more sprout up in its place.

tc_text: 你對破壞有股渴望。加入我們，我們可以一起滿足它。
en_text: You have a hunger for destruction. Join us and we can sate it together.

tc_text: 你把我的羊群中的弱者除掉了，朋友。我會把你的服務獻給黑暗諸神。
en_text: You weed the weak from my flock, friend. I will reward your service to the Dark Gods.

tc_text: 啊，不能保護自己禮物的那些人不配擁有它們。讓我來看看你是否有價值。
en_text: Ah, those who cannot defend their gifts do not deserve them. Come let me show you if I am worthy.

tc_text: 你欺騙混沌之神。你將為此付上代價。
en_text: You cheat the Chaos gods of their due. You will pay for that.

tc_text: 你或許可以暫時令惡魔沈默，但是我很快就會把你的靈魂餵給他。
en_text: You may have silenced the daemon for now, but I will feed him your soul soon enough.

tc_text: 為了和你說話，我已經等很久了，塔迪兒。
en_text: I've waited a long time to speak with you, Taldeer.

tc_text: 你的微聲不能令我離開我所命定的方向，艾理法斯。
en_text: Your whispers will not drive me from my destined course, Eliphas.

tc_text: 噢，我當然希望不致如此。 是你的命定道路把你帶到我這裡。
en_text: Oh, I certainly hope not. It is your destiny that has brought you to me.

tc_text: 先知。 我們發現第二扇次元傳送門。一個強大的惡魔盤旋。
en_text: Farseer. We have discovered a secondary warp gate. A mighty daemon circle.

tc_text: 在他們召喚更多大敵的惡魔之前破壞它。
en_text: Destroy it before they summon more of the Great Enemy's fiends.

tc_text: LINE CUT PLEASE ADJUST SCRIPT.
是的，走進我的家，塔迪兒。
en_text: Yes, come into my home, Taldeer.

tc_text: 我來消滅你，怪物。
en_text: I come to destroy you, monster.

tc_text: 那麼我為什麼在你的古老的聲音裡聽到懼怕？
en_text: Then why do I hear fear in your ancient voice?

tc_text: 啊，歡迎光臨迪摩斯，亞歷山大總督。
en_text: Ah, welcome to Deimos, Governor Alexander.

tc_text: 甜美的帝皇﹗ 他惡劣的聲音在我的腦海裡迴響。 立刻幫我找個靈能者。
en_text: Sweet Emperor! His foul voice is in my very head. Get me a Psyker immediately.

tc_text: 你那些被閹割的靈能者在這裡不能保護你，總督。
en_text: Your emasculated telepaths cannot protect you here, Governor.

tc_text: 長官，偵察小隊報告說有一些異教徒集結在古老的廢墟。
en_text: Sir, recon squads report a concentration of heretics around some ancient ruins.

tc_text: 如果你有能耐的話，除掉他們。 但是次元傳送門是我們的主要目標﹗
en_text: Clear them out if you can. But that Warp Gate is our primary target!

tc_text: 是的長官。
就是它了！為了帝皇！
en_text: This is it men! For the Emperor!

tc_text: 偽皇帝不在這裡保護你的手下，總督。
en_text: The False Emperor is not here to protect your men, Governor.

tc_text: 只有混沌能從他們的犧牲中得利。
en_text: Only Chaos will gain from their sacrifice.

tc_text: 沒有靈魂的自動機器。 你不能戰勝混沌。
en_text: Soulless automatons. You cannot prevail against Chaos.

tc_text: <低聲地說>
你…你的靈魂已經沒有了…我會消滅你！
en_text: It… your soul is gone… I will destroy you!

tc_text: 看哪，混沌的能力。這個世界是我們的，現在直到永遠！
en_text: Behold the power of Chaos. This world is ours now and forever!

tc_text: 你前來迎向你的死亡，死靈族。我會把你送回墳墓。
en_text: You come to your death, Necron. I will send you back to your tomb.

tc_text: <低聲地說>
不…不可能這樣…
你的血將其他人一樣成為祭物，外星人。
en_text: Your blood will serve as any other, alien.

tc_text: 你在我的腦袋裡幹什麼？滾出去！
en_text: Whatcha doin' in me 'ead? Get outta dere!

tc_text: 很樂意，你的腦袋並不是我想喝的上好靈魂。
en_text: Gladly, yours is not the refined soul I wish to drink from.

tc_text: 老大！這裡有個遺址和一些亮亮的東西！但是這裡到處都有混沌小子。
en_text: Boss! Dere's a relic n' some shiny bits here! But da chaos boyz is everywhere here.

tc_text: 那就殺掉他們。那些亮的東西是歐克蠻人的了！
en_text: Dem wipe 'em out, ya git. Dem shiny bitz is for da Orks now!

tc_text: 我來了，混沌小子！
你的陰險令我吃驚，歐克蠻人。
滾出我的腦袋！
隊長，歡迎。 你終於看見事實了嗎？
en_text: Welcome, Captain. Have you seen the truth at last?

tc_text: 我不會聽你的謊話，異教徒﹗
en_text: I won't listen to your lies, heretic!

tc_text: 那麼我不會對你說謊，弟兄。你已經聽了夠多謊言了…
en_text: Then I won't lie to you, brother. You've been lied to enough….

tc_text: 古老的廢墟，隊長。到處都有叛徒。
en_text: Ancient ruins, Captain. There are traitors all over it.

tc_text: 清除他們。 我們必須奪回那些遺物。
en_text: Purge them. We must recover those relics.

tc_text: 弟兄們，來。 讓我們歡迎你回家。
en_text: Come, brothers. Let us welcome you home.

tc_text: 當你背叛皇帝時，你就不再是我們的弟兄們﹗
en_text: You stopped being our brothers when you betrayed the Emperor, filth!

tc_text: 當一個弟兄們行為愚蠢時，並不會影響弟兄們關係，隊長。你仍然能獲得原諒。
en_text: Brotherhood is not lessened when one brother is foolish, Captain. You can still be forgiven.

tc_text: 外星人，你前來面對你的毀滅。
en_text: Alien, you come here to your doom

tc_text: 我的通訊器有雜訊。換個頻道。
en_text: I've got a buzzing in my comms. Switching channels.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們發現敵人的某種神殿。
en_text: Commander, we've located some sort of enemy temple.

tc_text: 那是次要基地。如果我們掃平它，應該就能打通前往主要基地的道路。
en_text: It's a secondary base. If we wipe it out, our way to the main bastion should be clear.

tc_text: 烈焰戰士。 向前進。 我要消滅這些狂人。
en_text: Fire Warriors. Move forward. I want these Gue'la maniacs eliminated.

tc_text: 你來找死，鈦星人。
en_text: You come to your death, Tau.

tc_text: 別用通訊器聊天！
en_text: And shut down that comm chatter!

tc_text: 有一個人類巫師把你的幾個戰士困在一連串的古怪能量裡。
en_text: A human sorcerer has several of your warriors trapped within chains of eldritch energy.

tc_text: 殺掉那個巫師。我們必須釋放那些囚犯，以免他們死在大仇敵的手下。
en_text: Eliminate that sorcerer. We must free the prisoners before they are lost to the Great Enemy.

tc_text: 做得好。烏斯維的孩子，和我們一起加入戰爭的光榮。
en_text: Well done. Children of Ulthwé, join us in the glory of war.

tc_text: 現在他們的靈魂和斯拉尼希在一起，先知。
en_text: Their souls are with Slaanesh now, Farseer.

tc_text: 我們將為他們報仇，惡魔。
長官！我們的人被困在邪惡的魔法裡。
en_text: Sir! Our men are trapped in unholy magics.

tc_text: 這附近一定有巫師。佈署一個排，消滅那個異教徒，士官。
en_text: There must be a sorcerer nearby. Deploy a platoon and eliminate the heretic, sergeant.

tc_text: 很好。把這些人和其他排佈署在一起，準備下一次攻擊。
en_text: Excellent. Deploy those men with the other platoons and prepare for the next assault.

tc_text: 你的手下的慘叫聲餵養次元諸神，就像他們的血餵養這塊土地一樣。
en_text: Your men's screams feed the Warp Gods just as their blood feeds this land.

tc_text: 皇帝照顧他們的靈魂，怪物。而且他要求我們報仇﹗
en_text: The Emperor watches over their souls, monster. And he demands vengeance!

tc_text: 你的機械形式很有趣的，死靈族。 他們早晚也會為混沌效力。
en_text: Your mechanical forms are interesting, Necrons. Sooner or later, they too shall serve Chaos.

tc_text: 你或許釋放了一些同胞，死靈族，但是到最後你會失敗！
en_text: You may have freed some of your kin, Necron, but in the end you will fall!

tc_text: 就算是沒有死亡的人也會死，死靈族﹗
en_text: Even the deathless may die, Necron!

tc_text: 老大！那些混沌小子把我們的一些人困在奇怪的東西裡！
en_text: Boss! Dem Chaos boyz 'ave got some of our boyz stuck with some weird stuff!

tc_text: 打死那個巫師，釋放我們的人，去！
en_text: Bash dat sorcerer ta free the boyz, ya git!

tc_text: 哈！歡迎回到吼～軍團！小子們。現在去砍殺吧！
en_text: Hah! Welcome back to da Waaagh! me boyz. Now get a choppin'!

tc_text: 更多血來獻給血神，外星人。
en_text: More blood for the Blood God, alien.

tc_text: 隊長﹗那些異教徒用令人厭惡的魔術困住幾個戰鬥弟兄們。
en_text: Captain! The heretics have several battle brothers trapped by foul magics.

tc_text: 我們不能留下弟兄等死。消除那個異教的巫師！
en_text: We will not leave our brothers to die. Eliminate that heretical sorcerer!

tc_text: 歡迎回來，弟兄們。 加入肅清行動，在捉拿你的人身上為你自己報仇﹗
en_text: Welcome back, brothers. Join the purge and avenge yourself on your captors!

tc_text: 他們的死亡將以血來償還，叛徒！
en_text: Their deaths shall be avenged in blood, Traitor!

tc_text: 沙索，敵人把幾個戰士困在不明的能量裡。
en_text: Shas'o. The enemy holds several of the cadre's warriors trapped with unknown energies.

tc_text: 鈦星帝國不會將它的戰士留在這樣的命運裡。沙隨，消滅控制這些能量的人。
en_text: The Tau Empire does not abandon its warriors to such fates. Shas'ui, eliminate the gue'la controlling those energies.

tc_text: 做得好，沙隨。叫被釋放的戰士入列，準備參加攻擊。
en_text: Well done, shas'ui. See to it that the freed warriors join the ranks and prepare for an assault.

tc_text: 就算失去最好的戰士，也不能阻止我們。在鈦星，我們是強大的。
en_text: The loss of even the finest warriors shall not deter us. In Tau we are strong.

tc_text: 利用增奇的三十七把鑰匙，我們為弟兄打開道路。
en_text: With the thirty-seven keys of Tzeentch, we open the way for our brothers.

tc_text: 透過斯拉尼希的一千個低吟，我們呼喚他們。
en_text: With the thousand whispers of Slaanesh, we call to them.

tc_text: 藉由奈格的十二種瘟疫，我們打倒他們的敵人。
en_text: With the twelve plagues of Nurgle we fell their enemies.

tc_text: 並且利用恐虐的強大的斧，我們為他們劈開世界﹗
en_text: And with the mighty axe of Khorne, we cut open the world for them!

tc_text: 是的，前來領受混沌之語！
en_text: Yes, come forth to bear the Word of Chaos!

tc_text: 聽我的警告，不信的人，這是由極端王子的能力帶到你思想中的警告。
en_text: Hear my warnings, unbelievers, carried to your minds by the power of the Prince of Excess himself.

tc_text: 我們已經在這塊土地上建立祭壇，這樣才能把你獻給我們的神。
en_text: We have raised altars in this land so that we may sacrifice you to our gods.

tc_text: 數千年邪惡戰爭的老兵等著把你踩在他們腳下。
en_text: Veterans of ten millennia of unholy war wait to grind you beneath the treads of their mighty boots.

tc_text: 恐虐的神選者渴望將你加入他們的血腥競賽。
en_text: The chosen of Khorne hunger to add you to their bloody tally.

tc_text: 血腥之神親自選擇這塊土地，將把你們的頭骨拿去做他們的寶座。
en_text: The Blood God himself has marked this land and will claim your skulls for his throne.

tc_text: 反抗不可避免之事，是沒有希望的。
en_text: There is no hope in opposing the inevitable.

tc_text: 放下武器，不信的人，在完全混沌面前俯伏！
en_text: Put down your arms, unbelievers, and bow before the forces of Chaos Undivided.

tc_text: 他們拒絕混沌的真理，大人。這裡的信徒不夠強大…
en_text: They reject the Word of Chaos, my lord. The faithful here are not strong enough…

tc_text: 這是一個軟弱的牧人在責備他的羊群，使徒。失敗是你的責任，而且只有你要負責！
en_text: It is a poor shepherd who blames his flock, Apostle. This failure is yours and yours alone!

tc_text: 不！我不要再去酷刑會堂！
en_text: No! I will not go to the Basilica of Torments again!

tc_text: 不用害怕，使徒。酷刑會堂是為那些能夠救贖自己的人預備的。
en_text: Fear not, Apostle. The Basilica is reserved for those who may redeem themselves.

tc_text: 不…不…
你不會有這樣的機會。
en_text: You will have no such chance.

tc_text: 神靈族
追逐的盡頭
玩者的陣營
神靈族
提瑞亞
格擋與佯攻
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 當其他人倚靠直接的力量和勇氣之時，神靈族卻倚靠匿蹤和狡計。這些外星人是被貶低的古代民族，只有在別無選擇之時，才會涉入戰爭。
en_text: Eldar rely on stealth and trickery where others trust in direct force and valor. An ancient and debased people, the aliens only sully their hands in battle when they have no choice.

tc_text: 當神靈族的敵人終於發現他們在提瑞亞上的秘密行動基地時，先知塔迪兒採用狡詐的策略。在這方面，她依從她那古老而狡猾之種族的做法。她的部隊被集中在遠方的冰天雪地裡，一處出入口極為有限的龐大山丘上。為了切斷這些出入口，先見將貓爪引誘到提瑞亞上。對軍閥戈古茲的軍隊不滿的歐克蠻人順從塔迪兒的巫師所密傳的建議，在能夠保護神靈族不受攻擊的地方紮營。
en_text: When the Eldar's enemies at last tracked down their hidden base of operations in Tyrea, the Farseer Taldeer turned to a strategy of trickery. In this, she followed the ways of her ancient and deceitful race. Her forces were centered on a great reinforced hill in a remote, frozen area with very limited access. To cut off these access points, the Farseer lured cat's-paws to Tyrea. Orks dissatisfied with the Waaagh! of Warlord Gorgutz followed advice whispered by Taldeer's Warlocks and camped right where they could screen the Eldar from attackers.

tc_text: 神靈族仍然自己建立了一支龐大的軍隊。魍道關口允許他們從躲藏在克諾努斯星系的某個空間中的戰艦上，將部隊運送過來。但是這些門也是神靈族的大弱點——如果攻擊者能夠攻下這些門，塔迪兒就會被切斷後援，也毫無逃脫的希望。
en_text: The Eldar nevertheless built a substantial force of their own. Advanced Webway Gates allowed them to ferry troops from the wraithship hiding behind a holofield somewhere in the Kronus system. But these same gates were the Eldar's great weakness—if attackers could take and hold them, Taldeer would be cut off from reinforcements and any hope of escape.

tc_text: 不但勢單力孤，而且人數居於劣勢，神靈族被困在自己的陷阱裡。
en_text: Alone and outnumbered, the Eldar would be caught in their own trap.

Alone and outnumbered, the Eldar would be caught in their own trap.

tc_text: 消滅神靈族的前進基地
先知塔迪兒現身在一處前進陣地裡。在她退回主要營地之前，破壞該基地並消滅先見。
en_text: Farseer Taldeer has exposed herself in a forward position. Destroy the base and eliminate the Farseer before she can retreat to her main encampment.

tc_text: 先知塔迪兒現身在一處前進陣地裡。在她退回主要營地之前，破壞該基地並消滅先知。
en_text: Farseer Taldeer has exposed herself in a forward position. Destroy the base and eliminate the Farseer before she can retreat to her main encampment.

tc_text: 攻佔並堅守神靈族的魍道關口
en_text: Capture and Hold the Eldar Webway Gates

tc_text: 佔領並持有三個關鍵位置10 分鐘。這樣可以封閉魍道關口，將神靈族困在克諾努斯上，結束他們的侵略。
en_text: Capture and defend the 3 Critical Locations for 10 minutes. This will seal the Webway Gates and trap the Eldar on Kronus, ending their invasion.

tc_text: 佔領並持有三個關鍵位置10 分鐘。這樣可以封閉魍道關口，將神靈族困在克諾努斯上，結束他們的侵略。
en_text: Capture and defend the 3 Critical Locations for 10 minutes. This will seal the Webway Gates and trap the Eldar on Kronus, ending their invasion.

tc_text: 消滅歐克蠻族的營地
神靈族誘使野生歐克蠻人來反對你。消滅東北山區的所有歐克蠻人建築，徹底消滅他們。
en_text: The Eldar have lured Feral Orks to oppose you. Destroy all Ork structures in the northeast mountains to wipe them out.

tc_text: 神靈族誘使野生歐克蠻人來反對你。消滅東北山區的所有歐克蠻人建築，徹底消滅他們。
en_text: The Eldar have lured Feral Orks to oppose you. Destroy all Ork structures in the northeast mountains to wipe them out.

tc_text: 釋放未受訓練的史估革巨獸
派遣部隊到史估革巨獸的獸欄去釋放牠們。這樣所造成的混亂可以干擾敵人。
en_text: Send units to the Squiggoth pen to free them. The resulting mayhem will disrupt the enemy.

tc_text: 派遣部隊到史估革巨獸的獸欄去釋放牠們。這樣所造成的混亂可以干擾敵人。
en_text: Send units to the Squiggoth pen to free them. The resulting mayhem will disrupt the enemy.

tc_text: 殺死造成分裂的混亂巫師
神靈族派遣一批混沌小支派的信徒來對抗你。他們由一名巫師率領，如果殺死他，他們就會瓦解。
en_text: The Eldar have sent a splinter cult of Chaos worshippers against you. They are led by a Sorcerer and will crumble if he is slain.

tc_text: 神靈族派遣一批混沌小支派的信徒來對抗你。他們由一名巫師率領，如果殺死他，他們就會瓦解。
en_text: The Eldar have sent a splinter cult of Chaos worshippers against you. They are led by a Sorcerer and will crumble if he is slain.

tc_text: 混沌分支教派
野生歐克蠻人
LINE NO LONGER USED
LINE NO LONGER USED
LINE NO LONGER USED
哈！這裡只有一些微不足道的神靈族！我們離開戈古茲是對的，我們在這裡可以為自己建立一支吼～軍隊！
en_text: Hah! Dere’s more dan just puny Eldar ‘ere! We was right to split off from Gorgutz's lot, we gonna have us a proper Waaagh right 'ere!

tc_text: 我們應該用史估革巨獸對付他們！
en_text: We should use da Squiggoths on dem!

tc_text: 不﹗別理他們！史估革巨獸還沒訓練好，而且我也不想在腳上沾上他們的碎片！
en_text: No! Leave ‘em be! Da Squiggoths ain't trained yet, and I don't wanna get stuck scrapin' bits of ya offa dere feet!

tc_text: 該死的神靈族欺騙我…
史估革巨獸被放開了！快跑！
en_text: Da Squiggoths is loose! Run fer it!

tc_text: LINE NO LONGER USED
要塞仍然堅固，先知，但是通往你的生魂艦的魍道關口很脆弱。
en_text: The bastion remains strong, Farseer, but the webway gates to your wraithship are vulnerable.

tc_text: 那麼我們的方向很清楚。不計代價保護魍道關口。若是沒有它們，我們可能永遠無法逃離這個世界。我們必須擊退攻擊者。
en_text: Our course is clear, then. Protect the gates at all costs. Without them, we may never escape this world. We must drive the attackers back.

tc_text: LINE NO LONGER USED
LINE NO LONGER USED
神靈族為你帶來迅速的死亡。
en_text: The Eldar bring you swift death.

tc_text: 命運已經宣佈你必須死。
en_text: The fates have decreed that you must die.

tc_text: 對了工藝世界﹗
敵人已經攻陷一座魍道關口。擊退他們。
en_text: The enemy has taken a webway gate. Drive them back.

tc_text: 幽靈船絕對不會回應你的召喚，外來者。立刻撤退！
en_text: The wraithbone will never answer your call, outsider. Retreat now!

tc_text: 我們不能允許他們長久佔有關口。不要憐憫他們，弟兄姐妹！
en_text: We cannot allow them to hold the gates for long. Show them no mercy, brothers and sisters!

tc_text: 奪回關口，否則我們再也見不到工藝世界！
en_text: Retake the gates or we shall never see the Craftworld again!

tc_text: 隊長。我們發現神靈族的一處前進基地。先知自己也在那裡。
en_text: Captain. We have discovered an Eldar forward encampment. The Farseer herself is there.

tc_text: 在這麼明顯的地方？若是運氣夠好，我們或許可以一舉消滅那些外星人。
en_text: In such an exposed location? With any luck, we may be able to eliminate the alien in one stroke.

tc_text: 神靈族巫婆與混沌結盟。迅速攻擊﹗
en_text: The Eldar witch is in league with Chaos. Strike quickly!

tc_text: 你和那個傻瓜艾理法斯一樣狡猾，蘇勒隊長。我會先殺死你，然後殺死所有我找得到的任何神靈族。
en_text: You are as deluded as that fool Eliphas, Captain Thule. I will kill you first and then scourge any Eldar I can find.

tc_text: 隊長。 主要的營地在這裡北邊的小山頂上。
en_text: Captain. The main xeno encampment is at the top of the hill north of here.

tc_text: 很好。 我們將徹底消滅他們。
en_text: Excellent. We will wipe them out.

tc_text: 神靈族準備逃走，與他們怯懦的本性一樣。有三座大型的魍道關口位在他們的基地附近。但是如果我們能夠佔領它們，就可以把他們永遠困在這裡。
en_text: The Eldar have prepared an escape, as is their cowardly nature. Three great webway gates stand near their base. But if we can capture them, we can trap them here once and for all.

tc_text: 上好的消息，隊長。在肅清混沌軍團爭握的領土時，我們和第四連的一個裝甲班接觸了。
en_text: Excellent news, Captain. By clearing the Chaos-held territory, we have linked up with an armored column from Fourth Company.

tc_text: 有更多第四連的裝甲部隊被隔離在山地裡，就在歐克蠻人的營地後面。他們也加入戰鬥了。
en_text: More of Fourth Company's armor was isolated in the mountains, beyond the Orks encampment. They too have joined the fight.

tc_text: 有更多增援部隊到達，隊長。
主人。外星人駐紮在西面！
en_text: My lord. The aliens are camped to the west!

tc_text: 是的，而且他們的先見和他們在一起。 如果我們殺了她，其他人就會瓦解。
en_text: Yes, and their Farseer is with them. If we take her, the rest will fall.

tc_text: 真言持有者軍團的艾理法斯領主！等你死後，你的軍隊將為我效命。
en_text: Lord Eliphas of the Word Bearer Legion! Your forces will march for me once you lay slain.

tc_text: 你真的以為你那小小的邪教就能勝過我？等你在我的手中接受刑罰時，我所忍受的數千年折磨會看起來像抓癢一樣。
en_text: You truly think your tiny cult can overcome my Legion? The thousand years of torment I suffered will seem gentle when you receive your sentence at my hands.

tc_text: 我開始厭煩外星人的技倆。我們必須困住他們，消滅他們。
en_text: I grow sick of the alien's trickery. We must trap them and finish them.

tc_text: 預兆是清楚的，大人。 神靈族已經透過這座山頂的三扇大門，將他們的魍道關口延伸到這個世界。
en_text: The auguries are clear, my lord. The Eldar have extended their webway to this world through three great gates at the crest of this mountain.

tc_text: 若是將這些大門獻給混沌的力量，我們就可以把他們永遠困在這裡。
en_text: By dedicating the gates to the power of Chaos, we can trap the aliens here forever.

tc_text: 啊，叛徒軍隊的叛徒。聽我號令，你們或許可以在混沌之前拯救自己。
en_text: Ah, defectors from the renegade's forces. Serve me, and you may redeem yourselves before Chaos.

tc_text: 本來這些歐克蠻人將我們派進山裡的裝甲哨兵的道路切斷。現在他們或許可以加入我們一起進行眼前的戰鬥。
en_text: These Orks had cut off the armored scouts sent into the mountains. Now they may join us for the coming fight.

tc_text: 有更多軍團兵到達。他們會加入我們，一起攻佔神靈族的關口。
en_text: More of the Legion has arrived. They will join us in taking these gateways from the Eldar.

tc_text: 老大！那些小神靈族在這裡的西方建了一座基地。探子說裡面有一個人戴著大大的尖帽子，就是你說的那個樣子。
en_text: Boss! Dem puny Eldar makin' a base west o' 'ere. Da grots say one's wearin' dat big pointy hat you was talkin' about.

tc_text: 尖帽子？那是神靈族的老大！把小子們召集起來，我們要消滅他們！
en_text: Pointy hat? Dats da Eldar boss! Get the boys together, we gonna go doff 'er up!

tc_text: 今天情勢看好！我也要殺一些混沌小子！
en_text: Dis day is lookin’ up! I gets ta kill me some Chaos boyz too!

tc_text: 神靈族欺騙﹗算了，我先殺了你歐克蠻人，再找到那個巫婆﹗
en_text: Eldar trickery! So be it, I will kill you first Ork and then find that witch!

tc_text: LINE NO LONGER USED
你猜怎麼著，老大？探子說神靈族在山上有一些關口。如果我們攻佔他們的關口，他們就沒有路可以逃走。
en_text: Guess what, boss? Da Meks say dat dem Eldar 'ave got some of there gates on top a dat dere hill. If we take them gates, dey won’t have no way ta get away.

tc_text: 哈！他們畢竟還是有一點用處！
en_text: Hah! Dem sparky bits o’ theirs is working after all!

tc_text: 你，你們應該要從側面攻擊那些混沌小子。你遲到！去，算了，和我們走，我們還有更多人要殺。
en_text: You lot, you was supposed to flank dem Chaos boys. Yer late! Bah, never mind, fall in with us, we gots more thumpin' ta do.

tc_text: 不要射擊﹗我們明白，戈古茲終究還是最強壯的！我們跟隨你，我們會幫助你打敗神靈族﹗
en_text: Don't shoot! We gets it, Gorgutz is da strong one after all! We follow da strong, we'll 'elp ya take dem Eldar!

tc_text: 有更多小子剛到？我們走吧，我要你們全部投入對付神靈族！
en_text: More boyz just gettin' 'ere? Well get movin', I need all o' ya stuck in against dem Eldar!

tc_text: 你為我而來，死靈，我在等候。
en_text: You have come for me, Necron, and I await.

tc_text: 你終於接受不可避免的命運。
死會令你靜默，巫師。
死靈族﹗神靈族騙我們。破壞這些機械畸形，然後給我找出那個外星人巫婆﹗
en_text: Necrons! The Eldar has tricked us. Destroy these mechanical monstrosities and then find me that alien witch!

tc_text: 工藝世界烏斯維永遠不會停止反抗你們，死靈族。
en_text: Craftworld Ulthwé will never stop opposing you, Necron.

tc_text: 我們已對你們瞭如指掌，神靈族。 我們知道，如果沒有那個魍道關口，你就不能離開這個世界。我們要從你手中把它們奪過來，再肅清這個世界裡的你們。
en_text: The analysis of your technologies is complete, Eldar. We know you cannot escape this world without your webway gates. We will take them from you and then purge this world of your race.

tc_text: 由於打敗那個次元巫師，我們有許多同胞從地下的洞穴復活過來，神靈族。我們的肅清力量隨著每一個死亡而變得更強大。
en_text: With the Warp sorcerer defeated more of us have risen from the caverns below, Eldar. Our purge grows stronger with every death.

tc_text: 我們把你的歐克蠻族卒子包圍在山地裡，神靈族，而且我們的軍隊已經重組。該結束你的詭計了。
en_text: We encircled your Ork pawns in the mountains, Eldar, and now our forces have regrouped. It is time to end your tricks.

tc_text: 我們有更多四散的僕人再度加入戰鬥。聚集起來，我們終於能使神靈族永歸寂靜。
en_text: More of our dispersed servants have rejoined the battle. Gather together, that we may silence the Eldar at last.

tc_text: 有人在邊看見神靈族先知。她很脆弱。
en_text: The Eldar Farseer has been spotted to the west. She is vulnerable.

tc_text: 各位。巫婆塔迪兒已經進駐前進陣地。 迅速攻擊﹗
en_text: Men. The witch Taldeer has taken a forward position. Strike quickly!

tc_text: 你只是那個神靈族女巫的遊戲中的卒子。但是我們還是會消滅你。
en_text: You’re just a pawn in that Eldar witch’s game, heretic. But we will dispatch you anyway.

tc_text: 你會和你所效忠的偽皇帝一樣死去！
en_text: You will die just like the False Emperor you serve!

tc_text: 機械主教的分析已經完成，總督。那些外星人使用三個巨大的門前往這個世界。只要封閉這些大門，我們就可以把他們永遠困在這個世界。
en_text: The Techpriest's analysis is complete, Governor. The aliens are utilizing three great gates to travel to this world. By sealing those gates we can trap them here forever.

tc_text: 並且將他們消滅。很好。
en_text: And mop them up from there. Excellent.

tc_text: 幹得好，各位。現在西向的道路已經暢通，我們和一支裝甲連取得連繫，使我們的人數增加了。
en_text: Fine work, men. Now that the western road is clear, we've linked up with an armored company and bolstered our numbers.

tc_text: 第二裝甲連報到，我主。歐克蠻人把我們困在山裡，但是我們準備再次效忠。
en_text: Second armored company reporting for duty, my lord. The Orks had us pinned in the mountains, but we're ready to serve again.

tc_text: 邊境來了更多增援部隊？ 好，我們需要所有人來根除這些外星人。
en_text: More reinforcements in from the borders? Good, we need every last man to uproot these aliens.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們在西方的一處前進營地裡發現一個神靈族的隱士。
en_text: Commander, we have located an Eldar mystic at a forward camp to the west.

tc_text: 歐內爾提到過這些隱士的智慧。我們一定可以讓她看見加入更大良善的價值。
en_text: Aun’el has spoken of these mystics’ wisdom. Surely she can be made to recognize the value in joining the Greater Good.

tc_text: 神靈族的一次高明偽裝。我們需要清除這些人才能繼續前進。
en_text: A masterful feint by the Eldar. We need to clean out these humans before we can proceed.

tc_text: 外星人渣﹗那個傻瓜艾理法斯只會等待，我卻要把你從這顆行星上除去！
en_text: Alien scum! I will wipe this planet clean with you while that fool Eliphas only waits!

tc_text: 凱斯。大地級已經確定神靈族利用這些架構來運送他們的侵略部隊。
en_text: O’Kais. The Earth caste has determined that the El’dar are utilizing these structures to transport their invasion force.

tc_text: 在他們逃走之前，我們就可以抓住他們並困住他們。然後他們將不得不承認更大的善良。
en_text: We shall take them and trap their forces before they can escape. Then they will have no choice but to recognize the Greater Good.

tc_text: 由於西方的道路已經打通，西塔任務團和總部取得聯繫。
en_text: With the western road cleared, Mission Group Theta made contact with the cadre.

tc_text: 我們本來以為奧米加和迦瑪小隊已經完了，但是他們還活著，而且準備為更大的良善而奮戰﹗
en_text: We had thought Omega and Gamma Teams to be lost, but they live and are ready to fight for the Greater Good!

tc_text: 那些剛剛抵達戰場的人，去找你的指揮官報到！他需要你協助對付神靈族的隱士。
en_text: You who have just arrived on the field of battle, go to your Commander! He has need of your help in confronting the Eldar mystics.

tc_text: 都預備好了。
很好。拉卡尼斯神官，帶著你的次元蜘蛛就定位，然後回到角度祭壇。
en_text: Excellent. Exarch Rakanis, take your Warp Spiders to their positions and then return to the Aspect Shrine.

tc_text: 你在疑惑，丑角。
我信任妳的預言，烏斯維的塔迪兒。 但是被原始人包圍，令我感到不安。
en_text: I trust in your vision, Taldeer of Ulthwé. But to stand surrounded by primitives makes me uneasy.

tc_text: 我理解你的厭惡。但是神靈族倚賴速度和祕密行動。我們較適合待在工事陣地裡。
en_text: I understand your distaste. But Eldar rely on speed and stealth. We are not made for entrenched positions.

tc_text: 但是歐克蠻人卻是很好的工具。他們可以封鎖補給道路，削弱我們真正的敵人。
en_text: The Orks, however, make for excellent tools. They will keep the supply roads closed and our true enemies weak.

tc_text: 如果這些攻擊者戰勝歐克蠻人呢？
en_text: And if these attackers defeat the Orks?

tc_text: 我相信他們可以擊敗我們的打手，但是必須付出代價。而且在他們受創的時候，他們將面對衰弱的自己，他們將面對哭泣毀滅。
en_text: I do not doubt they will overcome our cat's-paws, but it will cost them. And in their weakened state, they will face the Wailing Doom itself.

tc_text: 先知議會已經任命年輕國王。管理次元蜘蛛的拉卡尼斯神官將犧牲自己來喚醒我們最強大的戰士…
en_text: The Seer Council has named the Young King. Exarch Rakanis of the Warp Spider shrine shall sacrifice himself to awaken our most powerful warrior—

tc_text: 凱因戰神分身。
返回主要基地。讓我們的敵人自相殘殺。
en_text: Return to the main base. Let our enemies fight amongst themselves.

tc_text: 現在魍道關口不對我們開啟。我們被困在這個世界上。
en_text: The Webway is closed to us now. We are trapped on this world.

tc_text: 凱因戰神分身已死亡。
en_text: The Avatar of Khaine has fallen.

tc_text: 所有人撤退吧。自己在這個蠻荒星球尋找避難處。
en_text: Go, all of you. Find what refuge you can in the wilderness of this world.

tc_text: 仍然有可能逃脫，先知—
我不配得這個稱號，丑角。我的預言致使我們失敗。
en_text: I do not deserve that title, Harlequin. My vision has failed us all.

tc_text: 我命該絕於此，我不會逃避。
en_text: My fate is here and I shall not flee from it.

en_text: Hold the three critical points for %1NUM% more minutes!

en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 到達克諾努斯之後，盧卡斯．亞歷山大就成為戰事總督，並且開始為帝皇佔領這顆星球。當他的敵人對他的首都發動攻擊時，他準備用巨大的傷害來擊退他們。
en_text: Upon arriving on Kronus, General Lukas Alexander became Governor-Militant and set about reclaiming the planet for the Imperium. When his enemies launched attacks on his capital, he prepared to repel them with extreme prejudice.

tc_text: 帝國守衛軍是星球防禦的專家，他們建築堅固的防禦工事，在勝利海灣強化防禦。任何攻擊者都將面對武裝優異、補給充足的士兵，還有強大的裝甲分隊和砲兵陣地做後盾。
en_text: Experts in planetary defense, the men of the Imperial Guard were heavily dug in and fortified in Victory Bay. Any attacker would face well-armed and well-supplied soldiers backed by powerful armored columns and artillery positions.

tc_text: 守衛軍惟一的真正弱點是它的士氣。雖然大多數士兵都忠誠服役，軍團第五連的士兵卻不夠堅強，並且由軍團政戰軍官安東．吉貝特指揮，位於維多利亞河北岸的一處前進基地裡。若是沒有吉貝特的督促，這個連和它的基地一定守不住。
en_text: The Guard’s only real weakness was its morale. Although most soldiers served honorably, the men of the regiment’s Fifth Company had proven less than stalwart and were placed under command of regimental Commissar Anton Gebbet in a forward base on the northern shore of the Victoria River. Without Gebbet's whip, the company and its base would surely fold.

tc_text: 其他連則在較敏感地區的前進基地裡，準備擊退敵人。但是堅定的攻擊者可能攻下這些陣地。
en_text: Other companies took position in forward bases in more sensitive areas, ready to drive the enemy off. Still, determined attackers could overrun those positions.

tc_text: 但是亞歷山大總督仍然信心十足。事實上，任何能夠穿過他的前進基地的敵人都會發現自己正面對著一具泰坦身上的巨大地獄風暴巨砲的砲管。
en_text: Governor Alexander remained confident, however. Indeed, any opponent who made it past his forward positions would find themselves staring down the barrel of the massive Hellstorm cannon of an Imperator Titan.

en_text: Upon arriving on Kronus, General Lukas Alexander became Governor-Militant and set about reclaiming the planet for the Imperium. When his enemies launched attacks on his capital, he prepared to repel them with extreme prejudice. Experts in planetary defense, the men of the Imperial Guard were heavily dug in and fortified in Victory Bay. Any attacker would face well-armed and well-supplied soldiers backed by powerful armored columns and artillery positions. The Guard’s only real weakness was its morale. Although most soldiers served honorably, the men of the regiment’s Fifth Company had proven less than stalwart and were placed under command of regimental Commissar Anton Gebbet in a forward base on the northern shore of the Victoria River. Without Gebbet's whip, the company and its base would surely fold. Other companies took position in forward bases in more sensitive areas, ready to drive the enemy off. Still, determined attackers could overrun those positions. Governor Alexander remained confident, however. Indeed, any opponent who made it past his forward positions would find themselves staring down the barrel of the massive Hellstorm cannon of an Imperator Titan.

tc_text: 引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在死靈族對楚爾阿畢斯高原底下的陵墓發動劫掠之前，他們在克諾努斯的存在狀況一直不為人所知。這個星球上的第一次死靈族大屠殺就發生在那裡，他們的敵人也預期能發現一些異星的堡壘。但是他們發現的是進入地底世界的入口。
en_text: The full extent of the Necron presence on Kronus did not become clear until those opposing them launched raids into the catacombs under the Thur'Abis Plateau. The first Necron massacres on the planet had occurred there and their enemies expected to find some sort of alien bastion. Instead they found an entryway into the underworld.

tc_text: 根據奉命進入洞穴通道的哨兵所傳回來的片斷情報來看，整片高原底下是一個陵墓網絡。有一些墓穴已經空了，其它的墓穴則成為死靈族部隊的陣地。但是最糟糕的是，在仍然埋著成千上萬死靈族的隧道中，他們正緩緩地醒過來，加入其領主的全球屠殺行動。
en_text: Garbled reports from doomed scouts sent into the cavernous passageways revealed a network of catacombs honeycombing the entire Plateau. Some of these now stood hollowed out, while others served as staging grounds for Necron forces. Worst of all, however, were the deeper tunnels where row upon row of Necrons still stood, slowly waking to join their lord's global genocide.

tc_text: 攻擊者決定一項危險的初步行動。將有一支攻擊部隊進入陵墓中，在主要洞穴的深處安裝一個巨大的爆炸裝置。那裡的爆炸可以令整個網絡塌陷，將殘餘的死靈族埋在其中，並炸毀已經復活的死靈族。
en_text: The attackers settled on a dangerous gambit. A strike force would enter the catacombs and plant a massive explosive device deep in the main cavern. An explosion there would collapse the entire network, crushing or sealing off the legions of still-dormant Necrons and shattering those already risen.

tc_text: 目前仍然不知道是否有人能夠順利地安裝這個裝置，更不用說是用極短的時間逃出來，繼續在克諾努斯上的戰鬥。
en_text: It remained to be seen if anyone could deliver this device, much less escape in time to continue the fight across Kronus.

en_text: Hear me, Word Bearers! This day we destroy the hateful forces of the Star Gods.

tc_text: 受次元保佑的安非恩和錫蘇斯準備了一個偉大的設備，受到曾奇的大能祝福。利用它，我們可以炸毀這些洞穴，擊碎死靈族﹗
en_text: Warp-blessed Amphion and Zethus have prepared a great device, blessed by Lord Tzeentch's might. With it we shall bring down these caverns and crush the Necrons!

tc_text: 我將親自把這個偉大的神器帶進這些洞穴的深處。保衛我進去和撤退。
en_text: I will deliver this great artifact into the bowels of these caverns myself. Guard my advance and my withdrawal.

tc_text: 我不會死，讓這些機器心滿意足。
en_text: I will not give these machines the satisfaction of my death.

tc_text: 那個黑色塑像散發出死靈族的邪惡能量。
en_text: That black idol seethes with the Necrons' foul energies.

tc_text: 破壞它，為了混沌的榮耀﹗
en_text: Destroy it, for the glory of Chaos!

tc_text: 另一個死靈族的塑像。摧毀它！
en_text: Another of the Necrons' idols. Destroy it!

tc_text: 浮石巨塔﹗現在好像在休眠狀態，但是肯定不會持續太久。
en_text: Monoliths! They seem dormant for now, but that surely won't last.

tc_text: 把他們全部消滅！
神器已經就定位。我要返回地面。
en_text: The artifact is in place. I return to the surface.

tc_text: 不計代價保護我的逃離路線﹗
en_text: Protect my escape route at all costs!

tc_text: 我已經離開墓窖。 準備目睹混沌的能力﹗
en_text: I have escaped the catacombs. Prepare to witness the power of Chaos!

tc_text: 我的使徒，星辰諸神的力量流貫這個地方。它累積在這些地方。
en_text: My Apostle, the power of the Star Gods runs through this place. It pools in these locations.

tc_text: 真言持有者，派人到那些地區。 我們不能不去察看死靈族s的機器。
en_text: Word Bearers, send men to those areas. We cannot let the Necrons' machines go unchecked.

tc_text: 死靈族已經拋棄這些通道。 如果有另一個入口，我們就能安全使用這些通道。
en_text: The Necrons have abandoned these passageways. If there is another entrance we can use these passages in safety.

tc_text: 很好。另一個進入通道的入口。我們可以自由地利用那裡移動軍隊。
en_text: Excellent. Another access point to the passageways. We can move troops freely through there.

tc_text: 扭曲武器準備好了嗎？
是的，先知。把這個武器帶進這些墓窖的深處，就可以一勞永逸消滅這些死靈族。
en_text: Yes, Farseer. Carry this weapon into the bowels of these catacombs and you may eliminate these Necrons once and for all.

tc_text: 我在現在和當時之間看到極大的衝突，丑角。但是我不會失敗。
en_text: I see great strife between now and then, Harlequin, but I shall not fail.

tc_text: 但是塔迪兒，太危險了。如果你死在敵人手下，我們就無法繼續。
en_text: But Taldeer, it is too dangerous. Were you to fall to the enemy, we could not continue.

tc_text: 那麼我就不會死在他們手中，丑角。我會活下來再戰。
en_text: Then I shall not fall, Harlequin. I will live to fight another day.

tc_text: 卡坦的可憎能量流經那個結構。在它的動力全滿之前，我們必須破壞它。
en_text: The loathsome energies of the C'tan flow through that structure. We must destroy it before it reaches full power.

tc_text: 另一個卡坦信標。迅速破壞它。
en_text: Another C'tan beacon. Destroy it quickly.

tc_text: 我們找到一群休眠的死靈族浮石巨塔。
en_text: We have found a group of dormant Necron Monoliths.

tc_text: 在它們起來攻擊我們之前，先破壞它們。
en_text: They must be destroyed before they rise to oppose us.

tc_text: 扭曲炸彈準備好了！在它爆破之前，護送先知塔迪兒到地面去。
en_text: The distortion bomb is prepared! See Farseer Taldeer to the surface before it detonates.

tc_text: 烏斯維的武士﹗我們成功了﹗克諾努斯的死靈族即將毀滅﹗
en_text: Warriors of Ulthwé! We have succeeded! The doom of the Necrons of Kronus is at hand!

tc_text: 塔迪兒。我在這些墓穴裡看見隱藏的可怕東西。
en_text: Taldeer. I have seen terrible things hidden in these catacombs.

tc_text: 我也有同樣的預知，丑角。我會派遊俠去偵察那些地區。
en_text: I have had the visions as well, Harlequin. I shall dispatch Rangers to scout those areas.

tc_text: 埋在這些隧道裡的死靈族已經都離開了。如果我們能夠找到另一個出入口，就可以像使用魍道關口一樣地利用它們來移動。
en_text: All the Necrons buried in these tunnels have already exited. If we can find another access, we may move through them as we do through the webway.

tc_text: 我們發現另一個進入廢棄隧道的出入口。
en_text: We have uncovered another access to the abandoned tunnel system.

tc_text: 機械主教報告說電漿炸彈已經準備好了，總督。他們也已經找出最適合安裝的地方。
en_text: The Techpriests report that the plasma bomb is prepared, Governor. They have identified the most auspicious place for it as well.

tc_text: 很好。準備你的部隊。我們要親自去安裝這個設備。
en_text: Excellent. Prepare your men. We are delivering this device personally.

tc_text: 戰死是最高的榮譽，總督。
en_text: To die in battle is the highest honor, Governor.

tc_text: 我並不打算死在這裡，士官。我們還有一整顆行星要解放。
en_text: I have no intention to die here, sergeant. We still have a planet to free.

tc_text: 我們發現某種信標，長官。
en_text: We've spotted some sort of beacon, sir.

tc_text: 那些外星人一定設置了另一個陷阱。 破壞那個東西。
en_text: The aliens are surely planning another trap. Destroy that thing.

tc_text: 另一個信標。拿一些重型武器來處理掉它。
en_text: Another beacon. Bring up some heavy weapons and take care of that thing.

tc_text: 帝皇啊，更多浮石巨塔 ...
en_text: By the Emperor, it's more of those Monoliths...

tc_text: 派一個破壞小隊去處理，士兵。我要它們在啟動之前就被破壞。
en_text: Get a demolitions team on those things, soldier. I want them smoking heaps before they can activate.

tc_text: 好了。炸彈已經安裝。弟兄們，加速回到地面！
en_text: That's it. The bomb is set. Back to the surface men, on the double!

tc_text: 帝國的士兵﹗ 我們已經贏了﹗
en_text: Soldiers of the Imperium! We have won the day!

tc_text: 總督，機械主教發現這些點傳出外星人的能量。
en_text: Governor, the Techpriests have picked up alien energies coming from these points.

tc_text: 派一些攻擊小隊去。我們不能冒險讓他們切斷安全通道。
en_text: Send out some strike teams. We can't risk them cutting off our escape.

tc_text: 看起來這些隧道是安全的。如果我們能夠找到另一個安全的進出口，我們就可以像使用己的基地隧道一樣地使用它們。
en_text: It looks like these tunnels are safe. We could use them just like our own base tunnels, if we can find another safe access point.

tc_text: 另一個進入隧道的入口。很好。
en_text: Another access to the cleared tunnels. Excellent.

tc_text: 我拿到你的炸彈了，老大。
給我！
好，小子，聽好。我要把這個炸彈放進死靈族的喉嚨裡。所以我們進去，迅速除掉他們。
en_text: Okay, ya gits, lissen up. I'm gonna stuff dis here bomb down these Necron boyz throats. So lets get down there and get out right quick.

tc_text: 老大。這裡有像雕像的東西。
en_text: Hey Boss. Dere's some kinda statue thing here.

tc_text: 我討厭所有又黑又綠的東西。破壞它，小子！
en_text: I hate all that black n' green stuff. Wreck it boyz!

tc_text: 又一個雕像。把它也砸了，小子們。
en_text: Another one of those statues. Wreck that one too, boyz.

tc_text: 老大！有一堆浮石巨塔。
en_text: Boss! It's a bunch a those monolith things!

tc_text: 那些死靈族住在那些東西裡，笨蛋。破壞它們﹗
en_text: Those Necrons live in those things ya git. Wreck 'em!

tc_text: 哈哈！看起來死靈族要倒楣了。
en_text: Hah hah! Looks like it's gonna be a bad day fer them Necron boyz.

tc_text: 我們離開這裡！
哈！你們不會以為能夠阻止戈古茲吧，金屬小子？
en_text: Hah! Ya didn't think you could stop Gorgutz did ya, ya metal gits?

tc_text: 老大，他們在底下有一些大發電機之類的東西。
en_text: Boss, they got some right big generators or something running down there.

tc_text: 在那裡？
這裡這裡還有'這裡'。可能是一些發亮的好東西。
en_text: Here an' here an' here. Could be some good shiny bitz there.

tc_text: 或是一些陷阱。叫到一些小子去檢查。
en_text: Or some traps. Get some boyz to check 'em out.

tc_text: 看過了。隧道裡沒有死靈族。如果我們能再找到另外一條進入的路，我們就可以用它們來移動一些小子。
en_text: Lookit. Them tunnels is empty of Necrons. If we find anudder way in, we can move some boyz through 'em.

tc_text: 哈！另外一個安全的入口。
隊長。機械戰士報告說電漿炸彈準備好了。
en_text: Captain. The Techmarines report that the plasma bomb is ready.

tc_text: 謝謝，弟兄。現在我們必須把它放進這些外星墓穴裡，讓天空塌陷在死靈族頭上。
en_text: Thank you, Brother. We must now deliver it into the belly of these alien catacombs and bring the sky crashing down upon these Necrons.

tc_text: 雖然可能要付上我們的生命，但是我們不能令參事會失望。。
en_text: Though it may cost our lives, we will not fail the chapter.

tc_text: 如果我們做沒有必要的犧牲，就是失敗，弟兄。為參事會效忠而犧牲生命是值得讚美的，但是如果會使我們無法繼續進行未來的戰鬥，就不值得讚美了。
en_text: We fail if we give our lives needlessly, brother. To die in the chapter's service is praiseworthy, but not if it leaves us without the means to fight the battles to come.

tc_text: 你的領導是我們最有價值的資源，隊長。 你一定要活下來，以繼續戰役。
en_text: Your leadership is our most valuable resource, Captain. You above all must survive to continue the campaign..

tc_text: 我會的，弟兄。
那些能量來自那個外星神器。那一定是某種武器。
en_text: The energies are coming from that alien artifact. It must be some form of weapon.

tc_text: 在它們以我們的人為目標之前，破壞它。
en_text: Destroy it before they can target our men.

tc_text: 又一個死靈族神器。破壞它﹗
死靈族浮石巨塔﹗弟兄們，在這些可憎惡的東西起來攻擊我們之前，先破壞它們。
en_text: Necron monoliths! Brothers, destroy these xeno abominations before they rise to attack us.

tc_text: 弟兄們﹗電漿炸彈放好了。我們前往地表﹗
en_text: Brothers! The plasma bomb is planted. We make for the surface!

tc_text: 血鴉軍團﹗我已經到達地面。所有還在戰鬥的弟兄全部撤退！
en_text: Blood Ravens! I have breached the surface. All remaining battle brothers withdraw!

tc_text: 隊長。 我們的感測器從這些地點讀到未知的能量讀數。
en_text: Captain. Our sensors are picking up unknown enregy readings from these points.

tc_text: 我們必須查明那裡有什麼東西。 我不要在離開時發生任何意外，士官。
en_text: We'll have to find out what's there. I don't want any surprises on the way out, sergeant.

tc_text: 這些特別的墓穴似乎沒有死靈族的防禦者。如果我們能夠找到第二個出入口，也許可以利用它們。
en_text: These particular catacombs seem devoid of Necron defenders. If we can find a second access point, perhaps we can use them to our advantage.

tc_text: 很好。 另一個墓窖入口。 我們可以經由這裡輕易移動軍隊。
en_text: Excellent. Another access to the emptied catacombs. We can move troops through here with ease.

tc_text: 幸運的動物。你終於找到死亡的平靜。
en_text: Lucky creatures. At long last you have found the tranquility of death.

tc_text: 我曾經和你一樣，戀眷生命，看不見真理。
en_text: I was like you, once, clinging to life and blind to the truth.

tc_text: 當我發現真理時，我也顫抖，因為害而臉色蒼白。
en_text: When I uncovered the truth, I too shuddered and paled with fear.

tc_text: 在這些墓窖的深處，我被重造。在這裡，當活人像雜草一樣蔓長時，我的弟兄們睡眠永世。
en_text: Deep in these catacombs, I was remade. Here, my brethren slumbered for eons while the living grew like weeds.

tc_text: 我主知道這一天會來。他對我們每一個人都有計劃。我們應該再一次肅清這個世界。
en_text: My Lord knew this day would come. He had plans for us all. We would purge this world once more.

tc_text: 因此來吧，活人的不幸受害者。 我們將在這些墓穴裡賜你平靜。
en_text: So come, poor victims of life. We will grant you tranquility in these crypts.

tc_text: 克諾努斯將再次成為墳墓世界。
en_text: Kronus will be a Tomb World once more.

tc_text: 你只是穿透了我們墓穴的最表層。
en_text: You have penetrated but the very surface of our catacombs.

tc_text: 每過一秒鐘，就有越多我們的人從地底深處站起來。
en_text: More and more of us rise from the depths with every passing moment.

tc_text: 帶他們回來，大人。活人正在逃跑…
en_text: Bring them back, my Lord. The living are escaping…

tc_text: 大人，活人已經…

引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 反對軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲的綠色浪潮所面對的挑戰和鈦星人在克諾努斯上多年來所面對的挑戰是一樣的：把歐克蠻人從沙漠和城市裡趕出去是一回事，但是把他們從叢林裡趕出來又是另外一回事。即使是傳奇的鈦指揮官遠見也沒有辦法把歐克蠻人從綠色海岸的沼澤區趕走。
en_text: Those opposing Warlord Gorgutz Headhunter’s green tide faced the same challenge the Tau had faced on Kronus for generations: pushing the Orks back from the deserts and cities was one thing, but dislodging them from the jungle was another altogether. Even the legendary Tau leader Commander Farsight had failed to purge the Ork-infested swamps of the Green Coast.

tc_text: 要打敗戈古茲並不需要澈底消滅。這個軍閥的龐大軍隊（或用外星人的說法，是「吼～」）是由大量的小部落和家族組成的。只要軍閥率領吼～獲得勝利，他們就會保持忠誠。但是如果敵人攻到他們的家，歐克蠻人就會發出不滿的聲音。小酋長會認為自己能成為比戈古茲更優秀的軍閥。
en_text: Still, a complete purge wasn’t necessary to break Gorgutz. The Warlord had cobbled together his great horde (or "Waaagh!" in the parlance of the alien) from a large number of fractious clans and tribes. So long as the Warlord led the Waaagh! to victory, their clans’ loyalty was assured. But with enemies assailing them in their very homes, discontent reared its head among the Orks. Secondary chieftains wondered if they might not make better warlords than Gorgutz.

tc_text: 就在「吼吼！」之間的嫌隙日增之際，歐克蠻人的敵人發動攻擊。他們深入綠色海岸，企圖了結戈古茲本人，並促使蠻人大軍內鬥及叛變。
en_text: With these fissures in the Waaagh! widening, the Ork’s enemies struck. They drove deep into the Green Coast, hoping to eliminate Gorgutz himself and plunge the horde into infighting and rebellion.

tc_text: 對軍閥戈古茲來說，唯一的解決辦法就是用歐克戰士的浪潮淹沒攻擊者。
en_text: For Warlord Gorgutz, the only solution was to crush the attackers under unrelenting waves of Ork warriors.

tc_text: 反對軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲的綠色浪潮所面對的挑戰和鈦星人在克諾努斯上多年來所面對的挑戰是一樣的：把歐克蠻人從沙漠和城市裡趕出去是一回事，但是把他們從叢林裡趕出來又是另外一回事。即使是傳奇的鈦指揮官遠見也沒有辦法把歐克蠻人從綠色海岸的沼澤區趕走。但是，要打敗戈古茲並不需要澈底消滅。這個軍閥的龐大軍隊（或用外星人的說法，是「吼～」）是由大量的小部落和家族組成的。只要軍閥率領吼～獲得勝利，他們就會保持忠誠。但是如果敵人攻到他們的家，歐克蠻人就會發出不滿的聲音。小酋長會認為自己未必不能成為比戈古茲更優秀的軍閥。就在吼～之間的嫌隙日增之際，歐克蠻人的敵人發動攻擊。他們深入綠色海岸，希望能夠消滅戈古茲本人，令蠻人大軍內鬥及叛變。對軍閥戈古茲來說，唯一的解決辦法就是用歐克戰士的浪潮淹沒攻擊者。
en_text: Those opposing Warlord Gorgutz Headhunter’s green tide faced the same challenge the Tau had faced on Kronus for generations: pushing the Orks back from the deserts and cities was one thing, but dislodging them from the jungle was another altogether. Even the legendary Tau leader Commander Farsight had failed to purge the Ork-infested swamps of the Green Coast. Still, a complete purge wasn’t necessary to break Gorgutz. The Warlord had cobbled together his great horde (or “Waaagh!” in the parlance of the alien) from a large number of fractious clans and tribes. For Warlord Gorgutz, the only solution was to crush the attackers under unrelenting waves of Ork warriors.

tc_text: 殺死軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲
結束歐克蠻人的吼～軍團！你必須殺死率領它的野獸。尋找並且殺死軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲。

你以為你可以到處晃而不被我的小子們發現？
en_text: Ya think ya can sneak about wiffout me boyz seein’ ya?

tc_text: 你以為你可以摸走我的頭嗎？
en_text: Ya think ya can come for me ‘ead?!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人從來不曾在戰鬥中被打敗。
en_text: Orks is never beaten in battle.

tc_text: 閉嘴，笨蛋！他們其餘的人正在逼進，我們必須準備好。
en_text: Shut it, ya grot! The rest of ’em are comin’ and we’s got to be ready.

tc_text: 告訴小子們，有一些東西要殺！
en_text: Tell the boyz there’s some killin’ to do!

tc_text: 我做大的旗子給他們，提醒他們最好讓他們的小子規矩一點。
en_text: I made them Big Bannaz to remind da clans dat they better keep dere boyz in line.

tc_text: 我不希望敵人在這裡的時候，還有人想要找我打架。
en_text: I don’t want no squig-heads lookin’ to fight me when the enemy’s right here.

tc_text: 戈古茲是老大，懂了沒，廢物？
en_text: Gorgutz is da Warboss, got it ya muck-suckers?

tc_text: 這是擴音器，讓他跟你們講話，所以打開你們的耳朵！
en_text: Dis here voicey-box lets ‘im talk to ya, so open yer ears!

tc_text: 聽好了，小子！
en_text: Lissen up ya grots n’ squigs!

tc_text: 他們來對付我們，好像我們是人類飯桶。但我們不是。我們是歐克蠻人，這將是一場超猛的戰爭！
en_text: D’eyz comin’ fer us like we some kind o’ humie gits. But we ain’t. We’z da Orks and dis here is gonna be one great fight!

tc_text: 所以拿好你們的斧頭和長矛，準備來一場大大的殺戮！
en_text: So gets yer choppas and yer shootas ready boyz, cuz dere’s some killin’ to do!

tc_text: 碎顱，準備好了嗎？？
吼哇！
跺足，你們的史估革巨獸準備好了嗎？
en_text: Footstompas, yer Squiggoths n’ such ready?

tc_text: 吼哇！
燃燒小子，你想要戰鬥？
吼哇！
火箭場，你要加入嗎？
en_text: Rokkitrangaz, you in it or what?

tc_text: 吼哇！
你們呢，奇克米克？你們想讓別的家族一手包辦這場大戰嗎？
en_text: An what about youz Kwikmeks? You gonna let dese other runts get all the good fightin’ done?

tc_text: 吼哇！
這就是了！我們要把他們全殺了。
en_text: Dat’s right! We gonna crush ’em all. Dis here is a right an proper

tc_text: 吼哇！
吼哇！
過來這裡，這樣我就能殺了你！
en_text: Come ‘ere so’s I can kill ya!

tc_text: 你是在為你的生命戰鬥。也是最後一場戰鬥。哈！
en_text: Yer in fer the fight of yer life. ‘N the last one too. Har!

tc_text: 砍倒他們，小子們！但是把頭帶來給我！
en_text: Chop ‘em up, boyz! But bring me the ‘eads!

tc_text: 吼哇！
就是這樣，小子們！刺死他們！
en_text: Dat’s it, boyz! Give ‘em the pointy ends!

tc_text: 你的頭骨會放在我的尖棍的上面。那可是個榮譽。
en_text: Yer skull’s goin’ right on top o’ me pointy stick. Dat’s an honor, dat is.

tc_text: 對付他們，小子們！他們被打碎時很令人爽快！
en_text: Get at ‘em, boyz! They break real good!

tc_text: 這才叫打仗！上！
en_text: Now dis iz a fight! Get ‘em!

tc_text: 用你的火箭，笨蛋！
我的棍子又多了一顆頭！
碎顱﹗他們來打你了！
他們來了，跺腳！保護訓練者的安全。我不要史估革巨獸踩死我們的小子！
en_text: ‘Ere dey come Footstompas! Keep da trainer safe. I don’t want no Squiggoths stompin’ our boyz!

tc_text: 燃燒小子！他們在那裡。燒死他們！
en_text: Ya Burnaboy gits! They’z right there. Get a’ burnin’!

tc_text: 你們在幹什麼，火箭場？他們來打你了！攻擊！
en_text: Whatcha doin’, Rokkitrangaz? They’s comin’ for ya! Attack!

tc_text: 他們來了！奇克米克，炸了他們！
戈古茲讓他們拿走戈克的胃！他不是老大！打他！
en_text: Gorgutz let ‘em take da Maw of Gork! He ain’t no Boss! Get ‘im!

tc_text: 你想打架？過來這裡，這樣我就能殺了你！
en_text: Ya wanna fight?! Come ‘ere so’s I can kill ya!

tc_text: 史估革巨獸跑出來了！讓路，小子們！
en_text: Da Squiggoths’s loose! Clear out boyz!

tc_text: 噢不！
大旗完了！大旗完了！
en_text: Da Big Banner iz gone! Da Big Banner iz gone!

tc_text: 現在我是老大，所以閉嘴！
en_text: I'm da boss now, so shut it!

tc_text: 碎顱！現在我們要靠自己了！
en_text: Headcrashaz! We'z on our own now!

tc_text: 喂！戈古茲的大旗剛剛被踩倒了！
en_text: Oy! Gorgutz’ Big Banner jus’ got ‘itself stomped!

tc_text: 哈！我們要踩倒戈古茲的所有小子！
en_text: Hah! We’ll stomp all a’ Gorgutz’s boyz!

tc_text: 哈哈﹗戈古茲的大旗幟被炸掉﹗
en_text: Ha ha! Gorgtuz' Big Banner got blown up!

tc_text: 戈古茲是一個沒用的東西！我應該當老大！
en_text: Gorgutz' iz a grot-herder, that one! I should be Boss!

tc_text: 免談﹗現在我是老大！
en_text: No way! I’s da Boss now!

tc_text: 告訴過你們，那個老大沒有多厲害！他連自己的旗幟都保護不了！
en_text: Told ya da Boss won’t so tough! 'E can't even protect 'iz own banner!

tc_text: 我敢說戈古茲也沒多厲害！
en_text: Betcha Gorgutz ain’t so tough neither!

tc_text: 對！我們去查清楚！
大旗子燒得好看，不是嗎？
en_text: Big Bannerz burn good, don’t they?

tc_text: 那是老大的大旗，笨蛋！
en_text: That wuz da Boss'z Big Banner, ya git!

tc_text: 哈！大老大的旗子燒得真好看！
en_text: Hah! Big Boss Bannerz burn real good!

tc_text: 派歐克老大去，笨蛋。那些傢伙比我們想像的難搞！
en_text: Send in da Nobz, ya gits. Dese grots is tougher dan we thought!

tc_text: 就是這樣！派我們最強大的小子去！我要把他們的頭插在我的尖桿上！
en_text: Dat’s it! Send in da biggest boyz we got! I want deir ‘eads on me pointy stick!

tc_text: 你有帶來手下最大的混沌小子嗎？我不想浪費時間在你的小鬼身上。
en_text: You bring yer biggest Chaoz Boyz ‘r what? I don’t want to waste no time on yer little runts.

tc_text: 你的時間是我最不想浪費的東西，外星人。
en_text: Your time is the last thing I wish to waste, alien.

tc_text: 那就別再發牢騷，開始戰鬥。
en_text: Then quit yer yappin’ and get to fightin’.

tc_text: 享受你的最後一戰吧，歐克蠻人。
en_text: Enjoy your last moments of bravado, Ork.

tc_text: 費好大的勁才找到我，是嗎？
en_text: Took ya long enough to get to me, didn’t it?

tc_text: 混沌以它自己的步調前進，不是你的。
en_text: Chaos moves at its own pace, alien, not yours.

tc_text: 死呢？你會死得比較快嗎？我還得計劃今天的行程…
en_text: How bout dying? Do you do that any faster? I gots to plan da rest of me day…

tc_text: 啊，等你死了以後，我會想念這個笑話。
en_text: Ah, I will miss this banter once you are dead, Ork.

tc_text: 你們神靈族開始成為真正的頭痛問題了，你們知道嗎？
en_text: You Eldar are startin’ to be a real pain, ya know that?

tc_text: 我們在這裡的任務太重要，不能讓你這種人破壞。
en_text: Our task here is too important to let one such as you derail it.

tc_text: 嗯？你說了什麼嗎，神靈族？我聽不到你的聲音，你呼氣的聲音太大了。
en_text: Hunh? Did you say somethin’, Eldar? I couldn’t hear for all that hot air youz blowin’.

tc_text: 你實在幼稚極了，歐克蠻人。
她還說個不停！
en_text: And she still won’t shut it!

tc_text: 別再多說，神靈族。我們來看看能不能把你們的頭骨插在我的尖桿上。
en_text: Nuff o’ yer sneakin’ about, Eldar. Let’s see if I can get me some o’ yer pointy skulls for me stick.

tc_text: 你的惡毒侵略到此結束，歐克蠻人。
en_text: Your ill-begotten invasion ends now, Ork.

tc_text: 什麼？你們神靈族對於自己說大話的本事相當自豪。
en_text: I’ll be what’in, now? You Eldars is mighty proud of yer big words, you know.

tc_text: 知識帶來力量，野蠻人。
en_text: Knowledge brings power with it, barbarian.

tc_text: 什麼？更多的人類嗎？他們的頭骨數量已經夠了！
en_text: What? More humies? Got me enough of them skullz already!

tc_text: 克諾努斯解放者將把你從這個世界中清除，外星人渣﹗
en_text: The Kronus Liberators will push you from this world, alien scum!

tc_text: 你帶著一些猿人來嗎，人類？至少他們不像你們其他人一碰就倒！
en_text: You got some Ogryn with you, humie? At least they don’t break as easy as the rest of you lot!

tc_text: 克諾努斯解放者﹗攻擊﹗
外星人的基地。攻佔它，解放者﹗
en_text: The alien’s base. We have him, Liberators!

tc_text: 那就來吧，人類。讓我們看看你的本事。
en_text: Come on, then, humie. Let’s see whatcha got.

tc_text: 我的本事就是讓你死，外星人。
en_text: What I have is your death, alien.

tc_text: 你不是第一個以為可以打倒我的人，人類。讓我們看看你能否活著實踐你的大話。
en_text: Yer not the first to think dey got me, humie. Let’s see if ya can live up to yer yammerin’.

tc_text: 死亡已經來臨。我們為你而來。
en_text: Death has arrived. We come for you.

tc_text: 死亡？你看起來比較像是一個需要胖一點的人類，金屬小子。
en_text: Death? You look more like a humie who needs some feedin’, metal-boy.

tc_text: 我們曾經消滅這個星球上所有的生命，我們會再做一次。
en_text: We exterminated all life on this planet once before and we will do so again.

tc_text: 那是在我的吼～成立以前！現在，我們才是殺光所有人的力量。
en_text: Dat was before my Waaagh! got ‘ere. Now, we’s the ones doin’ the sterminatin’.

tc_text: 金屬小子！插在我的旗桿上會很不錯。殺了他們，小子！
en_text: Metal boyz! That’ll go all nice on me pointy stick. Kill ‘em, lads!

tc_text: 我們是你的盡頭，外星人。
如果你說的是我的尖桿的盡頭，我正打算把你們拿來做。哈！
en_text: If ya mean the end of me pointy stick, I’m right there wiff ya. Hah!

tc_text: 你的虛張聲勢救不了你。
en_text: Your bravado will not save you.

tc_text: 你繼續廢話啊，人類。我很快就會逮到你。
en_text: You jus’ keep on talkin’, humie. I’ll get to ya soon enuff.

tc_text: 喂，人類。你現在站的是歐克蠻人的土地。希望你不會對自己的腦袋太過留戀。
en_text: Oy, humies! Yer in Ork lands now. Hope you ain’t too ‘tached to yer ‘eads.

tc_text: 隨便你要怎麼吼叫，外星人。血鴉軍團是來消滅你的。
en_text: Yell and gnash all you want, alien. The Blood Ravens are here to finish you off.

tc_text: 有一點勇氣的人類！你的腦袋是我的！
en_text: A humie with some spirit! Yer ‘ead’s gonna be mine!

tc_text: 你會先嚐到我的子彈，臭東西！
en_text: You’ll meet my bolter first, filth!

tc_text: 哈！我喜歡你的思考方式，人類。這會很有趣！
en_text: Hah! I like tha’ way you think, humie. Dis is gonna be fun!

tc_text: 星際戰士！敵人的營地在那裡。攻擊！
en_text: Marines! There’s the enemy’s camp. Attack!

tc_text: 更多待宰的人類。上吧小子們！
en_text: More humies to kill. Get to it boyz!

tc_text: 你該去面見你那低級創造者了，歐克蠻人。
en_text: It’s time for you to meet your misbegotten maker, Ork.

tc_text: 我創造了自己，人類。而我準備要毀滅你！
en_text: I made meself, humie. An’ I’m gonna un-make you!

tc_text: 歐克蠻人！你一點機會也沒有。向更大的良善屈服吧。
en_text: Ork! You don’t have a chance. Surrender for the Greater Good.

tc_text: 你不太認識歐克蠻人，對吧，灰皮人？
en_text: You don’t know much about Orks, do ya, grayskin?

tc_text: 我已經給過你機會。交談的時間結束了。
en_text: I’ve given you your chance. The time for talk is over.

tc_text: 現在，你才是用我的方式在看待事情。閉嘴，開始戰鬥吧！
en_text: Now, yer seein’ things my way, grayskin. Shut yer yap and get to fightin’!

tc_text: 來啊，灰皮人！我需要你的頭骨來裝飾我的尖桿！
en_text: C’mon, grayskin! I need yer skull for me pointy stick!

tc_text: 你看不出來你必敗無疑嗎，歐克蠻人？你不可能有得勝的希望。
en_text: Don’t you see that your defeat is inevitable, Ork? You cannot hope to win.

tc_text: 閉上你的臭嘴，到這裡來讓我砍死你如何？我可以希望這樣嗎？
en_text: How ‘bout you shutting yer yap and getting over here so’s I can chop ya? Can I hope fer that?

tc_text: 野蠻人。
戈古茲沒有這麼強悍！打他！
愛搞鬼的傢伙都不能離開我的吼～！殺了他們，小子們！
en_text: Ain’t no grot lovers gonna leave me Waaagh! Chop ‘em up boyz!

tc_text: 老大！燃燒小子叛變了！
老大！跺腳叛變了！
老大！碎顱叛變了！
老大！奇克米克叛變了！
老大！火箭場叛變了！
我看到了，臭農夫！閉上你的嘴，回去戰鬥！
en_text: I can see dat, ya squig-farmer! Shut yer yap and get back to killin’!

tc_text: 但是要殺誰，老大？
你還沒有打敗我…
只是小小的驚喜..
en_text: Got me one more serprize for ya…

tc_text: 呃，老大？我們被攻擊了。
en_text: Uh, boss? We'ze getting' shot up.

tc_text: 你真有後見之明。用查蛋！
en_text: Ain’t you da master of da obvious. Use da splosives!

tc_text: 用什麼？
炸彈，笨蛋！炸彈！
en_text: Da bomb, ya git! Da bomb!

tc_text: 隨時得把你的隧道挖好。
en_text: Always have yer tunnels dug ‘n ready.

tc_text: 你真的很聰明，老大。
閉嘴，笨蛋。我得重建整個吼～軍團。現在，我們先離開這裡。
en_text: Shut it, ya git. I got me a whole Waaagh to rebuild. Now get me da Gork offa dis here planet.

tc_text: 破壞血鴉軍團的修道院要塞
en_text: Destroy the Blood Ravens’ Fortress Monastery

tc_text: 要打敗星際戰士，你必須摧毀他們的修道院要塞。摧毀星際戰士修道院要塞總部。
en_text: To defeat the Space Marines, you must raze their Castellum Incorruptus to the ground. Destroy the Space Marine Fortress Monastery HQ.

tc_text: 要打敗星際戰士，你必須摧毀他們的修道院要塞。摧毀星際戰士修道院要塞總部。
en_text: To defeat the Space Marines, you must raze their Castellum Incorruptus to the ground. Destroy the Space Marine Fortress Monastery HQ.

tc_text: 切斷星際戰士增援部隊
摧毀前進基地的軍營，以防血鴉軍隊從軌道上帶來更多援軍。
en_text: Destroy the Chapel Barracks at the forward base to prevent the Blood Ravens from bringing in reinforcements from orbit.

tc_text: 摧毀前進基地的軍營，以防血鴉軍隊從軌道上帶來更多援軍。
en_text: Destroy the Chapel Barracks at the forward base to prevent the Blood Ravens from bringing in reinforcements from orbit.

tc_text: 攻佔衛星收發站
血鴉軍團的戰鬥駁船能瞄準你的軍隊，要歸因於一座軌道收發站。攻佔那座軌道收發站，阻止砲擊。
en_text: The Blood Ravens’ Battle Barge is targeting your forces thanks to an orbital relay station. Capture the Orbital Relay to prevent further bombardments.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團的戰鬥駁船能瞄準你的軍隊，要歸因於一座軌道收發站。攻佔那座軌道收發站，阻止砲擊。
en_text: The Blood Ravens’ Battle Barge is targeting your forces thanks to an orbital relay station. Capture the Orbital Relay to prevent further bombardments.

tc_text: 攻佔神殿廢墟
血鴉軍團正在保護一座對他們而言十分神聖的廢棄神殿；只要他們還擁有該地，就不會撤退。攻擊廢墟中的遺址，降低星際戰士的士氣。
en_text: The Blood Ravens are defending a ruined temple holy to them and will never retreat so long as they hold it. Capture the Relic in the ruins to make the Space Marines susceptible to morale.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團正在保護一座對他們而言十分神聖的廢棄神殿；只要他們還擁有該地，就不會撤退。攻擊廢墟中的遺址，降低星際戰士的士氣。
en_text: The Blood Ravens are defending a ruined temple holy to them and will never retreat so long as they hold it. Capture the Relic in the ruins to make the Space Marines susceptible to morale.

tc_text: 軌道直接砲擊
現在你可以血鴉軍團自己的軌道砲對付他們，只需從攻佔的軌道收發器發送座標即可。選擇軌道收發器，使用它的軌道轟炸能力。
en_text: You may now use the Blood Ravens' own orbital artillery against them by sending coordinates from the captured Orbital Relay. Select the Orbital Relay and use its Orbital Bombardment ability.

tc_text: 現在你可以血鴉軍團自己的軌道砲對付他們，只需從攻佔的軌道收發器發送座標即可。選擇軌道收發器，使用它的軌道轟炸能力。
en_text: You may now use the Blood Ravens' own orbital artillery against them by sending coordinates from the captured Orbital Relay. Select the Orbital Relay and use its Orbital Bombardment ability.

tc_text: 星際戰士
星際戰士要塞說明
預備好自己。你們的覺醒就在眼前！
en_text: Prepare yourself. Your reckoning is at hand!

tc_text: 我們是死亡天使，會將死亡帶來給你。
en_text: We are the Angels of Death and shall deliver it unto you.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團不會敗在你這種人的手下。
en_text: The Blood Ravens will not fall to one such as you.

tc_text: 弟兄們，讓他們嚐嚐帝皇的憤怒﹗
en_text: Bring them the Emperor's wrath, brothers!

tc_text: 為了參事會！消滅他們！
休想通過！
戰術和攻擊小隊，恢復攻擊！
en_text: Tactical and assault squads, resume the attack.

tc_text: 為了帝皇﹗
準確攻擊！
弟兄們，敵人在禮拜堂附近﹗拉近距離，攻擊﹗
en_text: Enemies are near the chapel, brothers! Close ranks and attack!

tc_text: LINE CUT PLEASE REVISE SCRIPT
敵人試圖切斷我們的增援部隊﹗ 趕走他們﹗
en_text: The enemy is trying to cut off our reinforcements! Drive them back!

tc_text: 我們的增援部隊被切斷﹗不能撤退﹗不能投降﹗
en_text: Our reinforcements are cut off! No retreat! No surrender!

tc_text: 守住要塞！
加強東側！
佈署在西側！
弟兄們，守住戰線﹗
守住軌道收發站！我們必須和「憤怒禱文」保持聯繫。
en_text: Hold the relay station! We must keep in touch with the Litany of Fury.

tc_text: 弟兄們﹗敵人正在把座標輸送到戰鬥駁船。準備迎接來襲的軌道轟炸。
en_text: Brothers! The enemy is feeding coordinates to the Battle Barge. Prepare for incoming orbital fire.

tc_text: 感受一下帝皇的裝甲拳擊的威力！
en_text: Feel the power of the Emperor’s Mailed Fist!

tc_text: 第一連和我們一起作戰！立刻攻擊敵人！
en_text: The First Company is with us! Strike at the enemy now!

tc_text: 消除他們的大本營﹗
敵人在西門﹗ 弟兄們，守住﹗
en_text: The enemy is at the western gate! Hold fast, brothers!

tc_text: 不惜任何代價守住東門﹗
en_text: Hold the east gate at all costs!

tc_text: 我們戰役至最後一兵一卒！
en_text: We will fight you to the last man!

tc_text: 你的人像雨一樣地倒下。 你不可能贏。
en_text: Your men fall like rain. You cannot win.

tc_text: 已進行1NUM%︰分鐘遊戲
軌道轟炸
點選，即可將座標到星際戰士的戰鬥駁船，讓它攻擊自己的部隊。在遊戲世界任一可見的區域上按滑鼠左鍵，即可指定目標。
en_text: Click to send coordinates to the Space Marines' Battle Barge and cause its guns to fire on their own troops. Left-click on any visible location in the game world to target.

tc_text: 你只能瞄準你的軍隊能看見的位置﹗
en_text: You can only target locations your troops can see!

tc_text: 現在你控制了血鴉軍團的軌道收發器。現在你可以將座標輸入星際戰士的戰鬥駁船，呼叫軌道攻擊！
en_text: You are now in control of the Blood Ravens' Orbital Relay. You can now feed false coordinates to the Space Marines Battle Barge and call in orbital strikes!

tc_text: 我們不怕你，異教徒。
我希望你不怕，隊長。不懼怕的敵人更加令人滿意。
en_text: I should hope not, Captain. Fearless foes are much more satisfying.

tc_text: 我們惟一能令你滿意的地方就是死得快一點。
en_text: The only satisfaction we’ll give you is a quick death.

tc_text: 現在你讓我覺得厭煩了，隊長。我已經聽了太多空泛的自誇了。
en_text: And now you tire me, Captain. I’ve heard far too much empty boasting already.

tc_text: 如果你覺得我們是在自誇的話，那就來吧。
en_text: Come on, then, if you think our boasts are empty.

tc_text: 有耐心一點，隊長。我會選個好時間，把你們全都殺了。
en_text: Patience, Captain. I will kill you all in good time.

tc_text: 你撐不了多久的，惡魔的孩子！
en_text: You won’t hold that for long, daemon-spawn!

tc_text: 惡魔的孩子？完全不明白自己的起源的人不應該這麼隨便就侮辱別人的父母，弟兄們。
en_text: Daemon-spawn? One so hopelessly ignorant of his origins should not be so quick to insult another’s parentage, brother.

tc_text: 我們不是弟兄們，異教徒。
當然不是。是我的錯。
弟兄們，我們戰鬥到底﹗這座要塞不會淪陷﹗
en_text: We fight to the last man, my brothers! This fortress shall not fall!

tc_text: 多麼令人鼓舞的勇氣！也許我們會把你的屍體放在一張黃金椅上，還用你造一尊偶像。
en_text: Such inspiring courage! Perhaps we’ll mount your corpse on a golden chair and make an idol out of you as well.

tc_text: 你說出一個又一個的異端，叛徒。帝皇怎麼會信任你這樣的垃圾？
en_text: You pile heresy upon heresy, traitor. How could the Emperor have ever trusted trash like you?

tc_text: 你應該懷疑的是我們怎麼會信任像他那樣的人，弟兄們。
en_text: Wonder instead how we ever could have trusted one such as him, brother.

tc_text: 回到陰影去，神靈族。你無法在這裡獲勝。
en_text: Go back to the shadows, Eldar. You can’t win here.

tc_text: 我已經看見我們的勝利了，人類。你只是在拖延必然的結果。
en_text: I have already seen our victory, human. You simply delay the inevitable.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團從未向命運或者命運屈服，現在也不會。帝皇呼召我們，我們就遵命。
en_text: The Blood Ravens have never bowed before destiny or fate, and we won’t start now. The Emperor calls and we serve.

tc_text: 在愚昧的行為裡表現美德是年輕人的特權。
en_text: Seeing virtue in idiocy is the prerogative of the young.

tc_text: 外星人巫婆﹗你的存在就玷污了我們的禮拜堂。
en_text: Alien witch! You despoil our chapel with your presence.

tc_text: 你的帝皇只是一個幻象，人類。我無法褻瀆不是神祇的東西。
en_text: Your Emperor is an illusion, human. I cannot blaspheme against something that isn’t divine.

tc_text: 你膽敢…！
當然，除非你在這座毀壞的神殿裡，向另外一個完全不一樣的東西祈禱。
en_text: Unless, of course, you pray to something else altogether from this ruined temple.

tc_text: 我們會用棺材把你送回工藝世界﹗
en_text: We will send you back to your Craftworld in a tomb!

tc_text: 我知道自己死亡的時刻是你生命長度的十倍，隊長。休想用這種話來恐嚇我。
en_text: I’ve known my death for ten of your lifetimes, captain. Don’t think to scare me with it.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團不會被你這樣的人打敗。
en_text: The Blood Ravens will not be driven back by one such as you.

tc_text: 敗在比你們優秀的人手中，至少值得安慰。這沒有什麼恥辱可言。
en_text: Take solace at least in facing defeat at the hands of your betters. There is no ignominy in that.

tc_text: 我們還沒有見過比我們優秀的人，外星人，當然這個被遺棄的世界也絕對不會有比我們優秀的人。我們在這裡只看到欺騙人的暴君，異教徒，還有外星人渣。
en_text: We have yet to meet our betters, alien, certainly not on this forsaken world. All we have seen here are deluded tyrants, heretics and alien scum.

tc_text: 那麼，你一定是看到鏡中的倒影。
en_text: You should have looked beyond your mirror, then.

tc_text: 我們受到誤導來消滅你，這個行動必須結束，蘇勒隊長。區域指揮部下令，要這個軍團返回克諾努斯。撤回你的星際戰士，以免事態無法收拾。
en_text: This misguided purge of yours must end, Captain Thule. Segmentum Command has ordered this regiment to return Kronus to the Imperium. Withdraw your Space Marines before it is too late.

tc_text: 我也有我的命令，將軍。血鴉軍團必須為了參事會和帝皇來肅清這個世界。 我們不能撤退。
en_text: I have my orders as well, General. The Blood Ravens must purge this world for the sake of the chapter and the Imperium. We cannot withdraw.

tc_text: 你對參事會的忠誠為你增光，隊長，但是這並不能阻止我履行我的命令。
en_text: Your loyalty to your chapter does you credit, Captain, but it will not stop me from carrying out my orders.

tc_text: 你是在冒險，將軍。
en_text: You tread in places for which you are unprepared, General.

tc_text: 我在帝皇吾神的聖堂中十分自在，隊長。但是也許你並不是如此？
en_text: I am quite comfortable in a chapel of the God Emperor, Captain. But perhaps you are not?

tc_text: 我在一切事上都為帝皇服務。
en_text: I serve the Emperor in all things.

tc_text: 那就為了他的緣故撤兵。已經流了太多帝國子民的血。
en_text: Then withdraw, for His sake. There has been too much Imperial blood spilled already.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團不會撤退，將軍。
en_text: The Blood Ravens will not retreat, General.

tc_text: 那麼就這樣吧。
立刻投降，隊長。你的星際戰士已經被打敗了。你只是在拖延必然的命運。
en_text: Surrender now, Captain. Your Space Marines are beaten. You only delay the inevitable.

tc_text: 我的天性不容許我不理會上級的命令，將軍。
en_text: It is not in my nature to disregard the orders of my superiors, General.

tc_text: 那就拜托一下，當我命令你撤退時，聽我的命令。
en_text: Then for pity's sake, obey me when I order you to stand down.

tc_text: 你無權管束血鴉軍團，將軍。我們只對我們的參事會和帝皇負責。
en_text: You have no authority over the Blood Ravens, General. We answer to our chapter and to our Emperor alone.

tc_text: 你們的綠色浪潮在這裡停止了，歐克蠻人！你們在這裡只能找到死亡。
en_text: Your green tide stops here, Ork! You’ll find only death here.

tc_text: 我喜歡那種說話態度，人類。我的棍子還有地方可以放你的腦袋。
en_text: I likes that kind ‘a talk, humie. I still gotz room on me stick fer yer ‘ead.

tc_text: 我的靴子底下還有空間可以踩你咧，外星人。
en_text: And I have room for you under my boot, alien.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團，攻擊﹗
殺死外星人！
哈！這會很有趣。
en_text: Hah! Dis iz gonna be fun.

tc_text: 你玷污了一切你接觸到的東西，歐克蠻人！
en_text: You defile all that you touch, Ork!

tc_text: 如果你這麼喜歡這個東西，你應該好好保管它，而不是把它放在這裡。現在它是歐克蠻人的了！
en_text: If’n you liked dis thing so much, humie, you shoulda kept it safe instead of leaving it out ‘ere. Now it belongs to da Orks!

tc_text: 我來取你的頭了，人類！
那就來吧！你會知道我們為你們的種族預備了什麼好東西。
en_text: Come on, then! You’ll see what the best of the chapter has to offer your kind.

tc_text: 你真的很喜歡抱怨對不對，人類？
en_text: You sure do like to yammer, don’t ya humie?

tc_text: 我們會奮戰到底﹗
en_text: We’ll fight to the last man!

tc_text: 噢，閉上你的嘴巴去死吧！
en_text: O, shut yer maw an’ die, already!

tc_text: 人類，投降吧。就算不是為你自己，也要為了更大的良善。
en_text: Surrender, human. If not for you, then for the Greater Good.

tc_text: 更大的良善從我的槍口奔向你，外星人。
en_text: The greater good is coming to you from my bolter, alien.

tc_text: 你的手下的犧牲對你就這麼沒有意義嗎？你有這麼瘋狂嗎？
en_text: Do the deaths of your soldiers mean so little to you? Are you that mad?

tc_text: 你的手下的犧牲對你就這麼有意義嗎？你有這麼懦弱嗎？
en_text: Do the deaths of yours mean so much to you, alien? Are you that weak?

tc_text: 你不能這麼輕易地就瓦解我們的信仰，外星人。
en_text: You will not squelch our faith so easily, alien.

tc_text: 如果你能夠看見理智，鈦星帝國就會尊重你的信仰，人類。
en_text: The Tau Empire will respect your faith, human, if you would only see reason.

tc_text: 我們信仰的是人類的帝皇，外星人。對你讓步是異端。
en_text: Our faith is in the Emperor of Man, alien. To bow to you is heresy.

tc_text: 那麼你就是走上毀滅的道路。
en_text: Then you follow the path to destruction.

tc_text: 寧可毀滅，也不要為奴。
奴隸就是這樣告訴自由之人的。
en_text: So says the slave to the free man.

tc_text: 你早該投降的。現在太遲了。
en_text: You should have surrendered, gue'la. Now it is too late.

tc_text: 那就來吧！你的死亡在等候你！
en_text: Come on, then! Your death awaits!

tc_text: 死亡已經臨到你了，星際戰士。
en_text: Death has come for you, Space Marines.

tc_text: 我們的帝皇最優秀的士兵。我們不會倒在你手下，外星人！
en_text: We are the Emperor’s finest. We won’t fall to you, alien!

tc_text: 你的末日是不可避免的。投降，結束活著的痛苦吧。
en_text: Your end is inevitable. Submit and spare yourselves the pain of living.

tc_text: 我們會把你們趕出去，死靈族！
en_text: We will drive you from there, Necrons!

tc_text: 你只會跟隨你的帝皇走入死亡。
en_text: You will only follow your Emperor into death.

tc_text: 皇帝保護我們。 我們不會失敗。
en_text: The Emperor protects us. We will not fall.

tc_text: 你會的。
這場戰鬥還沒結束！
但是你的生命結束了。
敵人就在我們的門前，自以為可以把我們趕出這個世界。他們已經在洋洋得意的妄想品嚐他的勝利。
en_text: The enemy is at our doorstep and thinks he can push us off this world. He is already gloating. He can taste his victory.

tc_text: 但是他看不見的是，我們會讓這次的品嚐成為他的最後一餐。
en_text: But what he fails to see is that we will make this his last meal.

tc_text: 主智庫館長已經下令要肅清這個世界，以保護我們的秘密。難道我們要在未完成任務的情況下撤退嗎？
en_text: The Chief Librarian has ordered the purge of this world to protect our chapter's secrets. Are we to retreat with our duty unfulfilled?

tc_text: 我們要讓黑色的標記污染血鴉的旗幟嗎？
en_text: Are we to let a black mark stain the banner of the Blood Ravens?

tc_text: 我說，我們不會這麼做！我說我們的敵人會因為他們決定在戰鬥中與我們面對面而後悔不已！
en_text: I say that we will not! I say our enemies will regret the day they ever decided to face us in battle!

tc_text: 我們的戰鬥駁船就在頭上繞行，將把帝皇的神聖之怒傾倒在敵人頭上。
en_text: Our Battle Barge orbits overhead and will rain the Emperor’s holy fury on our opponents.

tc_text: 會有更多弟兄前來參加戰鬥，但是我們的敵人數量遠多於我們。你們每一個人都要以一當千！
en_text: More of our brothers will come to join the fight, but as ever our enemy outnumbers us. Each of you must be an army in your own right!

tc_text: 第一連的老戰士，全軍團最優秀的戰士，和我們站在一起。 讓他們的英勇引導你們直擊敵人的心臟﹗
en_text: Veterans of the First Company, the finest of the entire chapter, stand with us. Let their valor guide your fire into the enemy's heart!

tc_text: 記得我們是血鴉軍團，弟兄們。 我們都曾誓言保護隱藏的知識。若要把這個世界交給敵人，除非我們全部陣亡！
en_text: Remember that we are Blood Ravens, brothers. We have all sworn to protect fonts of hidden knowledge. Each one of us must fall before handing this world to the enemy.

tc_text: 帝皇與我們同在。未知神官與我們同在。
en_text: The Emperor is with us. The Unknown Primarch is with us.

tc_text: 他們為了讓我們流血而來，但是流血的人將是他們！
en_text: They have come for our blood but they will drown in their own!

tc_text: 北汪迪恩
增援部隊已經到達。 戰鬥，血鴉軍團﹗
en_text: Reinforcements have arrived. To battle, Blood Ravens!

tc_text: 不…我們不能失敗…
基因種子必須被保護。護送蘇勒隊長到雷鷹號。
en_text: The gene-seed must be preserved. Get Captain Thule to the Thunderhawk.

tc_text: 理解。
加入他們，藥劑師弟兄，我們會掩護你逃離。
en_text: Join them, Brother Apothecary, we will cover your escape.

tc_text: 你呢？
我們不能允許敵人佔領我們的遺物。這個地區必須用軌道射擊加以肅清。
en_text: We cannot allow the enemy to claim our relics. This area must be cleansed with orbital fire.

tc_text: 軍團將尊榮你，弟兄。

tc_text: 在終於面臨全面的攻擊時，血鴉軍團的星際戰士都駐在北汪迪恩良好的防禦工事中。血鴉軍團完全不願意投降或是再繼續撤退，因此準備了一項強大的防禦，迎接即將到來的攻擊。助防要塞的部隊當中，有來自著名的第一連的星際戰士。這些人是參加過多次遠征的老兵，每個人都能夠面對整個小隊的敵方攻擊者。地面上的血鴉軍團會獲得戰鬥駁船「憤怒禱文」號的新部隊增援。駁船正在星球的軌道上。只有兩個因素使得待在要塞中的血鴉軍團易受攻擊。最重要的是，這個要塞無法直接接收來自軌道的援軍。因此蘇勒隊長必須建立一個前進基地，才能迎接登陸艙和登陸艇。雖然防禦甚佳，仍能攻下這個前進基地。第二，星際戰士已經在血鴉軍團聲稱對該軍團而言至關重要的遺址附近建立其基地。因為不願意藉由防禦工事而褻瀆那個空間，蘇勒將門戶洞開，面向要佔領該區域的敵人，因此對通常牢不可破的星際戰士士氣造成嚴重的打擊。北汪迪恩的戰役將是整場戰爭中最血腥的一役。
en_text: The Space Marines of the Blood Ravens chapter were well entrenched in their Castellum in North Vandea when they finally faced all-out attack. Utterly unwilling to surrender or retreat any further, the Blood Ravens prepared a mighty defense against the coming assault. Among those defending the keep were Space Marines drawn from the chapter’s hallowed First Company. These were the hardened veterans of many crusades, each man ready and able to face down whole squads of enemy attackers. The Blood Ravens on the ground would be further bolstered by fresh troops arriving from the Battle Barge Litany of Fury in orbit around the planet. Only two factors made the Blood Ravens at all assailable in their stronghold. Most critically, the fortress was unable to receive reinforcements directly from orbit. Captain Thule thus had to establish a forward base to receive drop pods and landing craft. Although well-defended, this base could be taken. Secondly, the Space Marines had established their base near ancient ruins which the Ravens claimed held relics of great importance to the chapter. Unwilling to desecrate the space by fortifying it, Thule opened the door to an enemy claiming the area and thus dealing a powerful blow to the normally unbreakable Space Marine morale. The battle of North Vandea would be one of the bloodiest of the entire war.

tc_text: 當戰爭的情勢不利於鈦星人時，他們在亞沙里斯（外星人將它更名為塔辛恩）的要塞受到攻擊。但是這些外星人有良好的防禦工事，並且準備抗戰到底。
en_text: When the tide of war turned against the Tau, they faced attack in their stronghold in the city of Asharis (renamed Tash’n by the aliens). The aliens were well entrenched, however, and ready to mount a vigorous defense.

tc_text: 鈦星人軍隊領袖沙索．凱斯在市中心一座龐大的城堡裡設置他的總部，迫使攻擊者必須穿越狹窄的城市街道，暴露於狙擊手的攻擊和伏擊之中。在城市不同地區的外圍基地支援他的策略，而克魯特戰士和強力的裝甲部隊更進一步擾亂攻擊者。
en_text: Shas’o Kais, the Tau military leader, made his headquarters in a mighty citadel in the city’s center, forcing attackers to wend their way through the tight city streets, exposed to sniper fire and ambushes. Outlying bases in different quarters of the city supported his strategy, with Kroot warriors and powerful armored units harassing attackers even further.

tc_text: 鈦星人戰略上唯一的弱點是團結廣場，城裡的主要公眾空間。攻擊者可以利用那裡的一座精密通訊塔來暴露城市各地的匿蹤部隊。
en_text: The Tau's only strategic vulnerability was Unity Plaza, the city’s main public space. A sophisticated communications tower there could potentially be used by an attacker to expose the stealth units positioned across the city.

tc_text: 但是凱斯知道，他的攻擊者的最終目標是暗殺，而非征服。神秘的乙太導師成員之一歐內爾．席歐雷斯率領塔辛恩城堡中的鈦星部隊。如果他死掉，鈦星人的部隊就會瓦解。
en_text: O'Kais knew, however, that his attackers’ ultimate objective would be assassination, not conquest. Aun’el Shi’ores, a member of the mysterious Ethereal caste, led the Tau forces from the citadel in Tash’n. Were he to die, Tau forces would crumble.

en_text: When the tide of war turned against the Tau, they faced attack in their stronghold in the city of Asharis (renamed Tash’n by the aliens). The aliens were well entrenched, however, and ready to mount a vigorous defense. Shas’o Kais, the Tau military leader, made his headquarters in a mighty citadel in the city’s center, forcing attackers to wend their way through the tight city streets, exposed to sniper fire and ambushes. Outlying bases in different quarters of the city supported his strategy, with Kroot warriors and powerful armored units harassing attackers even further.
