tc_text: 傑納斯薩瓦納
中央沙漠的南方邊緣轉變成熱帶的森林與叢林，穿過傑納斯薩瓦納。這裡四處散佈著廢墟和零星的礦區，這個無法可管的狂野邊境吸引了許多不法份子以及失去希望的流浪者。
en_text: The southern edge of the central desert bleeds into the forests and jungles of the tropical belt across the Janus Savannah. Scattered ruins and lonely mining settlements dot the region, a wild, lawless frontier that attracts the disenfranchised and hopeless.

tc_text: 沙漠/薩瓦納
露出的岩石以及灌木林地覆蓋著這塊稀樹平原，曝晒在夏日的陽光下。偶爾在冬季的降雨過後會長出一些生命短暫的野草，但是很快就乾枯，並且成為引燃灌木林火災的真兇。
en_text: Rocky outcroppings and brushland cover the savannah, which bakes under the summer sun. Occasional winter rains create short-lived blooms of wild grasses, that quickly dry up and become fodder for the next brush fire.

tc_text: 摘錄自「我是一個速度的奴隸」，發佈於塔辛恩市全國新聞電視網
en_text: From “I Was a Slave to Speed” published on Tash’n News Net

tc_text: 你感覺的到他們比任何事情都還來得早。在深處的隆隆聲響劃過這塊乾旱之地，連帶使得沙鼠驚慌地跑開，並且也在你腦海中的某個地方產生共鳴。危險來臨了。在稍待片刻之後，聲音開始了—將就使用的空氣噴射裝置和負擔過重的穩定器所發出的扭曲嗚鳴聲，就像是一些肉食性鳥禽的慟哭聲一樣。
en_text: You feel them coming before anything. A deep rumble travels through the arid ground, sending sand rats scurrying, and resonating somewhere in your brain. Danger is coming. A few moments later, the sounds start – the distorted whine of makeshift aero-jets and over-taxed stabilizers like a keening of some predatory bird.

tc_text: 在此時，任何有意識的薩瓦納居民都會奔跑尋找掩蔽物，拿出武器，或是兩者同時進行。
en_text: By this time, any savannah dweller with sense is running for cover, loading a weapon, or both.

tc_text: 最後，這陣灰塵煙霧雲緩緩的飄到丘陵之上，在地平線上出現黑色的斑點。一個海市蜃樓，你想，一些地表受熱曝晒升溫後所出現的幻影。但就在片刻之後，這些遠方的小黑點就會變成無數的刀劍凜冽無情地向你襲來；而這些聲音的速度之快足以讓你驚訝不已。
en_text: Finally, the dust clouds rise above the hills and black specks appear on the horizon. A mirage, you think, some trick of the heat rising off the baked earth. But in mere moments, what had been smudges in the distance are tons of steel hurtling toward you just shy of the speed of sound.

tc_text: 如果你的運氣非常好，那你只是不幸地發現自己身處於千里競賽的路途當中而已。即將把你撞倒的歐克蠻人、強盜和扭曲的不法之徒絕對不會減低速度，如果你能夠及時讓開，他們離去的速度就和到來之時一樣快速。
en_text: If you’re supremely lucky, you’ve just had the misfortune to find yourself in the path of a thousand-kilometer race. The Orks, ruffians, and twisted outlaws about to run you down won’t slow down at any cost, and if you can just get out of their way, they’ll be gone just as quickly as they came.

tc_text: 但是也許這並不只是兩個瘋子之間的競賽而已。也許這是一次掠奪，在這種情況下你最好把武器給準備好。
en_text: But maybe this isn’t a race between two madmen. Maybe this is a raid, in which case you had better have that weapon ready.

tc_text: 就像電視節目中的暗黑神靈族海盜的故事一樣，侵略者為了尋找奴隸、財富以及惡劣的趣味而襲擊採礦基地和農莊。一隊侵略者在加速器之間拖著網子，捕捉他們的受害者。其他的侵略者則投擲臨時的炸彈，把所有他們不拿走的東西燒光。還有歐克蠻人，他們乘著漆著紅色的車輛，揮舞的凶狠的大刀，砍斷人類以及鈦星人的頭顱。
en_text: Like the Dark Eldar pirates from vid-stories, raiders descend on mining outposts and farmsteads in search of slaves, wealth and nasty fun. One gang uses nets pulled between speeders to scoop up their victims. Another drops makeshift firebombs in their wake, burning all they don’t take for themselves. And then there are the Orks, who ride in on their red-painted vehicles wielding fierce blades they use to decapitate the humans and Tau they run down.

tc_text: 當地人盡他們的最大努力來保護自己。他們退入裝備有武器射擊孔的地下碉堡，試圖擊退來犯的侵略者。他們建造圍牆並且放置金屬刺條。但是傑納斯薩瓦納的礦工並不是烈焰戰士軍隊，每次的攻擊行動都會造成更多人死亡。
en_text: Locals defend themselves as best they can. They retreat to bunkers outfitted with weapon-slits and try to drive off their tormentors. They build walls and lay razor wire. But the miners of the Janus Savannah are not teams of fire warriors and every attack claims a few more lives.

tc_text: 汪迪瑪山脈
汪迪瑪山脈最明顯的特徵就是廣闊的乾燥高原，這裡區隔開中央沙漠與溫帶孔雀平原。它的高原地區在利西斯星系聖戰期間經常發生帝皇軍與鈦星人彼此之間零星的游擊戰鬥。
en_text: Broad and arid plateaus mark the Van de Mar range, which separates the central desert from the temperate Pavonian plains. Its highlands were the site of running battles between Imperial and Tau forces during the Lithesh Sector Crusade.

tc_text: 山脈
門迪瑪的山峰頂端一年到頭被白雪所覆蓋，而較低的海拔則與中央沙漠地帶一樣屬於乾燥氣候。除此之外在高地高原上面也分佈著石頭與些許的灌木叢林。
en_text: The highest peaks of the Van de Mars are snow-covered all year round, while the arid climate of the central desert continues at lower altitudes. The highland plateaus are semi-arid patches of rock and scrubland.

tc_text: +++ 戰地報告，利西斯星系聖戰 +++
訊息發佈者：指揮官達賴‧特洛伊，超新星戰士第四連
en_text: Message Author: Captain Darius Troy, Novamarines 4th Company

tc_text: 主題：戰地報告，利西斯星系聖戰
en_text: Subject: Field Report, Lithesh Sector Crusade

tc_text: 來源：克諾努斯星，丁伯拉次星系, 利西斯星系，亞提瑪區域指揮部
en_text: Provenance: Planet Kronus, Timbra Sub-Sector, Lithesh Sector, Ultima Segmentum

tc_text: 經由：費里恩天文終端台
+++ 正文開始 +++
致公爵指揮官 —
攻擊在利西斯星系侵蝕帝皇權威的鈦星人的戰爭繼續進行中。做為聖戰軍隊的一份子，第四連的士兵與帝國防衛軍第一六七布林洛克龍騎兵的兩個連一起來到克諾努斯的礦產世界。
en_text: Battle continues against the Xenos known as Tau who have undermined Imperial authority in the Lithesh Sector. As part of the crusade force, elements of the 4th Company have come to the mining world of Kronus along with two companies of the 167th Brimlock Dragoons of the Imperial Guard.

tc_text: 這顆行星很顯然落入鈦星人的掌控中，而當地的人類似乎若非屈服，就是發誓效忠外星勢力而背叛帝皇。正如先前的報告指出，鈦帝國的軍事力量仰賴特殊技術，使他們在戰場上擁有強大的攻擊能力，尤其是在遠距離下。
en_text: The planet is very clearly in the hands of the Tau and much of the local human population seems to be either subjugated or to have betrayed the Emperor by swearing allegiance to alien powers. As previous reports have indicated, the Tau military forces rely on deviant technologies that can grant them impressive striking power in the field, especially at range.

tc_text: 鈦星人使用的步行裝甲類似（至少在體積方面是如此）類似我們的神聖無畏機兵，尤其具有效用。這些「殲擊機甲」配備多種重型武器（同樣地，都以遠距攻擊為目的）以及強力的噴射裝，讓它們可以在區域間跳躍。在我們沿著汪迪瑪山推進時，敵人的跳躍能力一直是與我們一同作戰的防衛軍的咒詛對象。我們不只一次經過漫長的戰鬥才到達鈦星人的重型武器駐紮的高地，確看著我們原本希望已經摧毀的機甲卻跳到另外一個更難到達的山峰上。
en_text: Tau use of armored walkers akin (in size at least) to our holy Dreadnaughts has been especially effective. These “crisis suits” are equipped with a variety of heavy weaponry (again all focused on ranged combat) and powerful thrust packs that allow them to jump from area to area. This latter ability has been the subject of many curses from the Guardsmen fighting alongside us as we push along the plateaus of the Van de Mar Mountains. More than once we have fought long battles to reach the perch from which Tau heavy weapons fire rained down upon us, only to watch the very battle suits we had hoped to destroy leap to another, yet more inaccessible peak.

tc_text: 為了因應這種情勢，我們撤回基本步兵團，並且結合反重力浮艇以及裝備跳躍背包的星際戰士來打擊敵人的戰鬥優勢。此時我必須強調的本連第一突擊小隊的馬拉斯．波蒙中士的重要貢獻。波蒙中士一向是一位勇猛的鬥士，但是他帶領三個星際戰士突擊小隊攻佔敵人的陣地，超越了自己的表現。波蒙配備熱熔炸彈，配合我軍的煙霧彈掩護，終於令兩團壓制我們行動的機甲失去行動能力。若是沒有這些機甲提供的掩護，敵人的混合步兵必然倒斃在我們新一波的攻擊之中。
en_text: In response, we have pulled our basic infantry back and used a combination of land speeders and Marines equipped with jump packs to take away the enemy’s advantage. At this point, I must underline the critical contributions made by Sergeant Mallas Bomont of the company’s 1st Assault Squad. Sergeant Bomont has ever been a stalwart fighter, but he surpassed himself by leading three squads of Assault Marines against enemy positions. Armed with meltabombs and screened by a feint from the rest of our force, Bomont was able to cripple the two groups of battle suits that had pinned us down. Without the cover provided by these suits, the mixed enemy infantry fell before our renewed assault.

tc_text: 即使他們的天性愚拙，我擔心這些鈦星人不久之後就會適應我們的新戰術。我預計還要經過數週的艱苦奮戰，才能穿過這片山脈。
en_text: Despite their degenerate nature, I fear these Tau will soon adapt to our new tactics. I expect many more weeks of hard fighting before we are through these mountains.

tc_text: 我建議授予波蒙中士新星勳章的榮耀，以獎勵他在戰場上的行為以及戰術的貢獻。
en_text: I recommend that Sergeant Bomont be awarded the Novastar for his actions in the field and his tactical contributions.

tc_text: 以帝皇之名。
指揮官達賴‧特洛伊，超新星戰士第四連
瑞恩洪水大陸
這是以垃圾為主要材料填入瑞亞河流域而造成的土地，洪水大陸是一連串密集的小島，覆有濃密的葉子。洪水大陸的生態系統有很大的變化，包括大量的克魯特居民。
en_text: Made of the tons of silt the River Rhea dumps into sea, the Floodlands are a tightly-packed series of small islands covered with dense foliage. The Floodlands support a diverse ecosystem, including a large Kroot population.

tc_text: 叢林
瑞恩洪水大陸主要是原始的熱帶氣候，具有高溫、豐沛雨量和遍佈植物等特色。這個地區的條狀諸島只具有平坦的地形。
en_text: An archetypal tropical climate pervades the Rhean Floodlands, featuring high temperatures, plentiful rains and pervasive vegetation. The silt islands of the region feature only mild topography.

艾希莉亞森林
艾希莉亞森林裡面有幾所突出的大學和研究機構。在這些機構的田園圍牆後面，則進行對外星生活的密集研究（有些人會認為這是異端）。
en_text: The Aceria Forests are home to several prominent universities and research facilities. Behind the idyllic walls of these institutions, intense – and some would say heretical – study of alien life takes place.

tc_text: 森林
溫和的天氣和豐沛的雨量造就了這些茂密的森林。直到迪摩斯腐化之前，只有小河川和幾座小山隔開這片樹海。現在南方古怪森林變成了這些無形且令人毛骨悚然的東西出沒的地方。
en_text: Temperate weather and plentiful rainfall feed the massive forest. Until the corruption of Deimos, the sea of trees was broken only by small rivers and a few small chains of mountains. Now horrors from the Immaterium haunt the south's twisted woods.

經由：哈卓恩天文終端台
作者：探勘長蓋亞斯
這是一個通滿驚奇與恐怖的行星，古明。
en_text: This is a planet of wonders and horrors both, Cumin.

tc_text: 我與我的僕人已經到達克諾努斯星主大陸的東南部份，繼續尋找帕拉帝厄斯的工作；他是最聰明的機械主教，被派到克諾努斯去研究地獄風暴巨大炮（目前在勝利海灣）。我們追尋最薄弱的線索，終於發現一個在赫魯斯異端事件之後、與帕拉帝厄斯同時代的純淨神器，時間大約有一萬年以前。
en_text: My Servitors and I have arrived in the southeastern sections of Planet Kronus’s principal continent, continuing our search for the works of Magos Paladius, the most brilliant of the Tech Priests sent to Kronus to study the Hellstorm Cannon currently in Victory Bay. Following the thinnest of leads, we have at last uncovered a pure artifact of Paladius's time here immediately following the Horus Heresy, some ten millennia ago.

tc_text: 在大陸南方邊緣的森林樹群之間，座落著具有上千年歷史且許久未被啟用的宙斯級發電器以及控制站。我花費數週的時間去尋找正確的儀式，希望能喚醒其中的機器本靈，好讓我們能夠進入。兩天前，門終於打開了，從那時候開始，我就把時間用來研究蘊藏其中的寶藏。
en_text: Amidst the trees of the forests on the southern edge of the arid heart of the continent, a Zeus-class relay and control station has seemingly stood undisturbed for thousands of years. It has taken me several weeks to find the proper rituals to awaken the machine spirits in the station so they would grant us access. The doors finally slid open two days ago and I have spent the time since pouring over the treasure trove that lurked within.

tc_text: 看起來這個中繼站曾經控制一個軌道砲擊站網路，可以對行星表面進行大規模的破壞轟擊。但是只有幾顆衛星還存留著。我猜想幾千年來已經有許多衛星毀壞，或是完全休眠了，但是我在這裡的古老邏輯引擎中發現一些不完整的自我毀滅指令。
en_text: It seems that the relay station once controlled a network of orbital artillery stations able to rain destruction across the planet’s surface. Only a few of the satellites have survived, however. I imagine many were damaged or became hopelessly dormant over the millennia, but I have found traces of incomplete self-destruct orders in the ancient logic engine here.

tc_text: 然而更麻煩的是控制站中所留下來的實際戰鬥的痕跡。極致戰士控制了這個中繼站之後，必然在他們與真言持有者的戰鬥中獲得極大的優勢，我也確信那些異教徒會想盡辦法從他們手中奪走這個中繼站。
en_text: More troubling still are the traces of actual combat within the station. The Ultramarines’ control of this station must have made a huge difference in their battle with the Word Bearers and I’m sure the heretics would have gone to great lengths to take the station from them.

tc_text: 我並沒有找到中繼站的防禦系統遭到破壞的證據，只有裡面的戰鬥痕跡。那麼我就無法理解，異教徒是怎麼進來的。也無法理解拉帝厄斯發生了什麼事。
en_text: I haven’t found any evidence of a breach of the station’s defenses, only traces of battle within. I cannot understand, then, how the heretics gained access. Or what happened to Magos Paladius.

tc_text: 我會儘快再度回報。
楚爾阿畢斯高原
楚爾阿畢斯高原介紹
沙漠
在巨大沙漠的中心，是死靈族覺醒的古代廢墟。事實上，在楚爾阿畢斯的乾旱高原沙礫與石頭的下面就是克諾努斯陵墓，也就是死靈族的要塞。
en_text: In the heart of the great central desert lie the ancient ruins from which the Necrons have awoken. Indeed, below the sand and rock of the arid plateau of Thur'Abis lie the Catacombs of Kronus, their stronghold.

tc_text: 楚爾阿畢斯高原是一大片有著岩石和沙子的寬闊乾旱區域，零星散佈著綠洲，以及死靈族所賴以藏身、自大洪水時代以前留下來的廢墟。他們的墓穴是個由地下洞穴、古老的墓穴和外星墳墓構成的地下迷宮。
en_text: The Thur’Abis Plateau is an arid expanse of rock and sand, dotted with a few oases and the antediluvian ruins that hid the Necrons. Their catacombs are an underground warren of caves, ancient crypts and alien sepulchers.

tc_text: ++ 分類：為了更大的良善而受壓制 ++
en_text: ++ Classification: Suppressed for the Greater Good ++

tc_text: 存在主義是也許生命最沈重的體現。我們必須問為什麼，尋找一些解釋。雖然如此，無論我有多麼完美，我仍是個活人，因此必須因此我頭腦中的種種問題而受苦。因此我發出最後這道的訊息，試圖回答一些你將會遇到的問題。
en_text: Existentialism is possibly the most onerous imposition of life. The need to ask why, to find some explanation. Nevertheless, despite the perfections granted me, I remain a living man and so must suffer under the cacophony of questions in my brain. And so I send out this final message to attempt to answer some of the questions you will have.

tc_text: 我為什麼帶領著我的同伴來到這塊乾旱高原上邁向毀滅？我為什麼甘願屈服於這股由復活的不朽生物所帶來的力量？像我這樣一個受尊敬的自然科學家和傑出公民，如何能夠背棄賜我這麼多恩典的文明？
en_text: Why did I lead my fellows to their doom here on this arid plateau? Why have I submitted myself to the power of the immortal creatures who have risen from its sands? How could I, a respected scientist and prominent citizen, turn my back on the civilization that has given me so much?

tc_text: 答案很簡單。我以純潔之名來做這一切的事情。
en_text: The answer is simple. I have done everything in the name of purity.

tc_text: 大約在十五年前，在我的記憶和情感以這種更完美的形式重組之前，我花費一生的時間去研究文明的所有形式。我的辛勤工作可以總結如下：所有的生命都生存在不和諧之中。戰爭和衝突影響所有已知的社會，所有的物種都用自己的存在來與其他物種爭奪有限的資源。從嬰兒為了尋找母親乳頭的哭聲，到骯髒的垂死老人身上所發出的惡臭，生命就是一連串的爭吵與醜陋。
en_text: Before my memories and emotions were reassembled in this more perfect form some fifteen cycles ago, I had spent a human lifetime studying civilization in all its forms. The sum of my work can be put thus: all life exists in discord. War and strife affect all known societies and all species spend their existences competing with others for limited resources. From the cries of an infant for the maternal teat to the wretched stench of the aged dying in their own filth, life is a series of squabbles and ugly messes.

tc_text: 你有另一個選擇。有一種狀態，可以解決所有的衝突，一切歸於寒冷和寂靜。沒有需求，沒有戰爭，沒有爭吵。
en_text: There is an alternative. There exists a state in which all conflict is resolved and all is cold and silent. There are no wants, no wars, no squabbles.

tc_text: 如果你願意，你可以稱呼這種狀態為死亡，但是那是錯誤的稱呼。死亡僅僅只是生命的結束，而且那只是結束的方法之一。這個終結是純潔的，是一切都將靜止且永恆不變的時候。
en_text: You may call this state death if you wish, but that is a misnomer. Death is but the ending of life, and that is only a means to an end. That end is purity, the time when all is still and unchanging.

tc_text: 我們的宇宙始於純潔，也將返回純潔的狀態。加快這個返回的過程，是我所喚醒的這些生物的偉大工作，他們也讓我成為他們的一分子。
en_text: Our universe began in purity and it will return to that blessed state. Hastening that return is the great work of the perfected beings I have awoken and who have made me their own.

tc_text: 你努力地破壞我們偉大的工作。你在全銀河中散佈你那邪惡、不潔的自我，譏笑我們所帶來的美麗寂靜。這些都是徒然的。
en_text: You have tried to undo our great work. You have spread your vile, unclean selves across the galaxy, making a mockery of the beautiful silence we had wrought. It was all in vain.

tc_text: 歡喜吧，因為我們已經回來，你的日子就要結束了。
en_text: Rejoice, for we have returned and your days are at an end.

tc_text: 提瑞亞
提瑞亞大部分無人居住的北方森林與凍原現在躲藏著從工藝世界烏斯維到克諾努斯星的神靈族。在他們到來之前，只有一些野人與野生歐克蠻人居住於此。
en_text: The largely uninhabited boreal forests and tundra of Tyrea now shelter the Eldar come to Kronus from Craftworld Ulthwé. Before their arrival, only a few wild men and feral Orks called Tyrea home.

tc_text: 次極地森林
從北海海岸一直到阿裡爾的丘陵，提瑞亞是一塊荒蕪的土地。到處都是冰原，只有凍原和亞寒帶森林處未被冰原覆蓋，冷風似乎一年到頭吹個不停。
en_text: From the shores of the Northern Sea to the foothills of the Ariels, Tyrea is a harsh land. Ice fields give way only grudgingly to tundra and boreal forests and a cold wind seems to blow year round.

tc_text: 蒙凱的第四次沉思
烏瑟維夢想者塔迪兒著
en_text: By Taldeer the Dreamer of Ulthwé

tc_text: 把未來想像成一棵枝葉繁茂的樹，是很吸引人的想法。從每個決定點又會分出數種可能性，每種可能性都包含本身的決定點，餘此類推。不遵循先知之道的人可以想像得出來，我們的生命都被用來跟隨這些分離的道路行事。
en_text: It is tempting to think of the future as a branching tree. From every decision point several possibilities branch out, each containing their own further decision points, and so on. Those who do not walk the Path of the Seer might well imagine that we spend our lives following these separate strands.

tc_text: 事實上，未來遠比這個簡單的模式更加複雜—而且容我如此說，也遠比它更不優雅。我們這些先知經過一個充滿可能性與結果的扭曲迷宮，一條窄小的走道往往又通回另外一條小徑。當我們探索這個迷宮時，我們發現自己一再的踏足相同的地面，雖然可能是從不同的路線到達相同的地方。
en_text: In truth, the future is far more complex – and I fear to say, far less elegant – than that simple model. We Seers walk through a twisting labyrinth of possibilities and consequences, one whose tight passageways often fold back upon one another. As we explore this maze, we find ourselves treading the same ground over and over again, although perhaps arriving at it from different routes.

tc_text: 我最常踏足的通道之一是由「蒙凱」的頑強和殘暴所構成的。不管我在哪裡轉彎，我都會在腳下發現那些熟悉的石頭。這個年輕的種族或許是單純與天真，但他們擁有一種令人忿怒的能力，可以透過頑固的天性去影響事物的進行。
en_text: Among the passageways I have tread most is that made of the stubbornness and barbarity of the Mon-Keigh. No matter where I turn, I find its familiar stones under my feet. This young species may be simplistic and naïve, but they have an infuriating ability to impact the flow of events through their sheer mulish nature.

tc_text: 自從死靈族到達洛恩五星的這段時間以來，再三的教導我這個知識。這些古代的生命破壞者顯然會對所有的生命造成嚴重的威脅，從最卑微的蒙凱 到我們最古老的種族。任何有一點點理智的生物都能看出這個事實，也能理解其它所有的爭執都應該先置於一旁。
en_text: The time since the arrival of the Necrons on Lorn V has taught me this lesson again and again. These ancient destroyers of life are clearly a grave threat to all life, from the lowliest Mon-Keigh to the most ancient of our race. Any creature with a modicum of reason can see this and understand that other squabbles should be put aside.

tc_text: 蒙凱卻不然。在我們的警告中，他們看到的是欺騙。在我們的指導中，他們看到的是圈套。即使面臨最深刻的事實，他們選擇用獵殺我們的方式來證明他們的野蠻性格。就像所有的低級野獸一樣，不能與他們理論，所以只能統治他們。
en_text: Not the Mon-Keigh. In our warnings, they see deceit. In our guidance, they see entrapment. Even faced with the deepest truths, they choose to prove their barbarity by hunting us. Like all lesser beasts, they cannot be reasoned with, only yoked.

tc_text: 那麼，讓想要獵殺我們的那些人來吧。讓他們帶著頑固的作風到另外一個世界去，讓古代民族復活。他們的死亡會比他們的生命有更大的貢獻。
en_text: Let those who hunt us come, then. Let them bring their mulish ways to this next world where the ancients arise. Their deaths will serve where their lives have not.

tc_text: 汪迪恩海岸
汪迪亞是一個含有豐富礦產的地區，包含數個建立於帝國時代的大型工業中心，而且目前仍然在營運。現在這裡的城市人口稀少，而且嚴重污染，但是仍然是鈦帝國的重要工業資產。
en_text: A mineral rich region, Vandea includes several large industrial centers built in the Imperial era and still in operation. The cities are now underpopulated and polluted, but remain critical industrial assets for the Tau.

tc_text: 城市／冬季
汪迪亞眾城市中的生產與冶煉工廠令景觀受到破壞，空氣受到污染，使得這些城市具有價值，卻令人不愉快。灰色的天空一年到頭都飄著充滿煤灰的髒雪或是酸雨。
en_text: The manufacturing and smelting plants of the Vandean cities have scarred the landscape and stained the air, making the cities valuable but hardly pleasant. Soot-laden snow or acidic rain fall from gray skies year round.

tc_text: ++ 生產報告 ++
費歐維．克諾努斯．梅斯拉 –
我很遺憾地通知你，汪迪亞小型工廠廿七號與廿九號無法完成這個週期的限額。生產量預計達到期望值的72% 與 21%。解釋如下。
en_text: I regret to inform you that Vandea Minor Build Plants 27 and 29 will not meet their quotas this cycle. Production is expected to be at 72% and 21% of projections, respectively. Explanations follow.

tc_text: 因為城市受到惡劣天氣的影響，以致廿七號生產工廠遭受意想不到的產量銳減與停工。這個區域發生了氣象的瓶頸，以致於環境介質難以發散，導致這個區域極容易產生酸雨。本週期的酸雨是二十個週期以來最惡劣的一次，也引發工人許多健康的問題。獎勵計劃或是分發刺激飲料都無法提升生產效率。
en_text: Build Plant 27 suffered unexpected work stoppages and slowdowns due largely to the inclement weather that affected sector 27 of the city. A meteorological bottleneck of sorts occurs over the area, making it difficult for environmental agents to disperse and making the sector highly prone to acidic rains. This cycle's rains were the worst in twenty cycles, causing many health problems among the workers. Incentive programs and distribution of stims failed to make up for the decrease in productivity.

tc_text: 廿九號生產工廠則是因為四個次循環前，它的中央四號電廠發生巨大的爆炸而受到影響，到現在還無法恢復正常。爆炸發生後不久就開始進行修復作業，但是進度十分緩慢。我甚至不能保證工廠能在下個循環中恢復正常生產。
en_text: Build Plant 29 suffered a catastrophic detonation of its central power plant 4 sub-cycles ago, and has yet to come back online. Repairs have been ongoing since shortly after the detonation, but progress is very slow. I cannot even promise that the plant will be online again next cycle.

tc_text: 看起來在廿 29 號所發生的爆炸事件很明顯是所謂的「汪迪亞工會」的激進份子故意進行的破壞行為，正如先前的報告中所詳述的相關資料指出，他們宣稱城市裡的工人受到不必要的虐待。關於需要更大型社區的清楚說明並不能說服這個激進支派。
en_text: It seems evident that the detonation at Plant 29 was an intentional act of sabotage carried out by the most militant wing of the so-called Vandean Workers Pact, which as previous reports have detailed, claims that the workers in the cities are suffering needlessly. Clear explanation of the needs of the greater community has failed to convince this militant wing.

tc_text: 我重複我的要求，請差派烈焰戰士小隊前去追蹤及消滅這些破壞者。本地城市民兵數量太少，而且很可能受到滲透，不適任這項任務。
en_text: I repeat my request for dedicated Fire Warrior teams to pursue and eliminate these saboteurs. The local city militia is too limited and too prone to infiltration by pact elements to be up to the task.

tc_text: 致上我的敬意，
古拉．費歐維．克諾努斯．丹門
西方瘠地
瘠地是無數個牧場以及數個中型城市的家園，幾個世紀以來一直受到野生歐克蠻人的攻擊。當地居民長久以來不斷地對抗這些如潮水般湧入的外星人。
en_text: The Barrens are home to countless ranches and several mid-sized cities that have suffered for centuries under the attacks of feral Orks. The locals have fought long battles against tide after tide of aliens.

tc_text: 沙漠／大草原
這個半乾燥的瘠地一向是克諾努斯農場工人的家鄉，在乾燥的灌木叢林間牧放龐大的牲畜群。小城市中則設有屠宰場與運輸中心。
en_text: The semi-arid Barrens are the traditional home to Kronus’s ranchers, moving huge herds across the dry brushlands. Small cities shelter slaughterhouses and transport hubs.

tc_text: ++ 部分恢復的聲音記錄 ++
++ 安格隆農場，西方瘠地 ++
++ 敘述者：莫坎．安格隆 ++
...就是不斷地來。到目前為止，圍牆還能撐得住，但是那些畜生就像沙漠蝗蟲一樣不斷湧來，只不過還帶著斧頭與槍枝。歐克蠻人。所有的牧場都荒廢了，我們的存糧也無法永遠支持下去。這會兒他們又來了。
en_text: ...just won’t stop coming. The walls are holding so far, but the buggers just keep coming like sand locusts, but with axes and guns. Orks. All the pasturelands are gone and our food stores won’t hold out forever. Here they come again.

tc_text: 今天我們失去了基利安。他據守南方高塔已經好幾天了，使用他的步槍取走任何攀爬圍牆的歐克蠻人之生命。我以為他沒問題，但是他昨天告訴我說他知道確切的殺敵數量。他已經射擊了數百發的子彈，但是至今只打下兩個綠皮蠻人。而且這兩個人的體積還比他們的平均體積小。
en_text: We lost Killian today. He’d been on the south tower for days, using his rifle to pick off the Orks as they scrambled up the wall. I thought he was doing okay, but he told me yesterday he was keeping count. He'd squeezed off hundreds of rounds, but only two of the greenskins ever went down. And they were smaller than most by a fair margin.

tc_text: 當他看見那些綠色的大傢伙爬上高塔的腳時，他開始尖叫。他們把一輛冒著煙的拖引機開進鐵刺網裡，再利用它爬上來。我們也朝著他們開火，但是他們的數量太多，而且他們實在太壯了。基利安用斧頭和爬到高塔頂端的蠻人廝殺，但是卻沒有任何效果。
en_text: He started screaming when he saw the big green buggers climbing up the legs of the tower itself. They rammed a smoke-belching tractor into the razor wire and got up above it and the spikes. We fired on them too, but there were too many of them and they were too tough. Killian came at them with an ax when they reached the top of the tower, but it didn’t do any good.

tc_text: 他們把他的頭顱插在高塔頂端的一根長矛上。
en_text: They put his head on a pike on the tower.

tc_text: 我沒有多少時間了。西面的圍牆剛剛坍塌了。他們一定是挖掘圍牆牆角並且使用炸藥來破壞。我原先以為歐克蠻人只是粗心的野獸，但沒想他們也會使用工兵。
en_text: I don’t have much time. The west wall just gave way. They must have dug under it and used explosives. I thought Orks were mindless brutes, but they used sappers.

tc_text: 我們大多數人在爆炸中被炸死，但是還有幾個人撤回主要住宅裡。門不會支撐太久 —
en_text: Most of the others were killed in the blast, but a few of us made it back to the main house. The doors won’t last long-

歐里斯塔辛恩
鈦帝國在克諾努斯上的首都，塔辛恩是個現代化且繁榮的大城市，有數個外圍的社區，以及數個大型的軍事基地。它建築在帝國時代的亞沙里斯的位置上，仍然可以見到許多帝國時代遺留下來的建築。
en_text: The Tau capital of Kronus, Tash’n is a modern and thriving metropolis with a full province of outlying communities along with several large military bases. Built on the site of the Imperial-era city of Asharis, it still bears many signs of Imperial architecture.

tc_text: 城市
北方有阿裡爾高地的保護，加上西方的海洋提供溫暖，塔辛恩地區擁有長時間的夏天與溫和的冬季。在塔辛恩的密集市區外面，則沿著可以航行的河流建立了較小型的城市。
en_text: Protected by the Ariel Highlands to the north and warmed by the western sea, Greater Tash'n enjoys long summers and mild winters. Outside the dense sprawl of Tash'n itself, smaller cities nest along several navigable rivers.

悠可斯 –
我不敢相信你會決定要留下來。不管有多危險，這可是一生一次的機會。
en_text: I can’t believe you decided to stay behind. Danger be damned, this was the chance of a lifetime.

tc_text: 好吧，我承認我自己也有一點懷疑。向西方旅行前往首都是件難事，而且我們在經過帕翁尼斯的時候，甚至看到軌道戰鬥的火光照亮夜空。（你在 汪迪亞看到過這種景象嗎？）但是當我到達塔辛恩的市中心時，我的懷疑就一掃而空。
en_text: Okay, I’ll admit I had some doubts myself. The journey west to the capital was hard and we even saw the flashes of orbital battle lighting up the night sky over Pavonis when we passed through there. (Did you see any of that in Vandea?) But as soon as I got into the center of town here in Tash'n, all my doubts vanished.

tc_text: 全市區都有大電視螢幕，廣播關於第一星域氏族的艦隊前來的最新消息。當看起來人類似乎封鎖住我們的船艦時，我發誓當時全市沒有一個人說得出話來。當我們衝破封鎖線時，歡呼聲震耳欲聾。
en_text: There were large vid screens all over town broadcasting updates about the approach of the fleet from the first sphere Septs. When it looked like the humans had our ships blockaded, I swear no one in the whole city could speak. When we broke through, the cheers were deafening.

tc_text: 又過了一天，我們看到船艦降落在太空港口上。就像其他人一樣，我把這個景象當成聚集和等待的暗示。我們擠進統一廣場，成千上萬的人一起等待。在那裡，四個階級的人都是平等的，悠可斯。
en_text: It was another day before we saw the ships landing at the space port. Like everyone else, I just took that as my cue to gather and wait. We pressed into Unity Square, thousands upon thousands of us and waited. All four castes were there as equals, Ukos.

tc_text: 終於，港口的一支護航隊進入廣場。（鎚頭鯊戰艇和魔鬼魚運兵艇，殲擊機甲在側邊保護，全都漆成鈦星的橙色！令人難以置信的場面！）領導車輛停在我後面的舞台，所以只有在他從統一日雕像下面的台階上走下來的時候，我才看到他。我記得他的榮譽刀上閃爍的光芒，我感覺自己好像可以飛起來。
en_text: Finally, a convoy from the port made its way into the square. (Hammerheads and Devilfish flanked by Crisis Suits, all painted in the orange of T’au itself! It was incredible!) The lead vehicle stopped behind the stage from where I was, so I only saw him when he stepped up from the steps that run under the Unity Day statue. I remember the light glinted off his honor blade and I felt like I could fly right then and there.

tc_text: 歐內爾．席歐雷斯站在我的面前。近兩百年來，克諾努斯的第一位乙太導師！
en_text: Aun’el Shi’ores was standing before me. The first Ethereal on Kronus for almost two hundred cycles!

tc_text: 廣場上沒有任何揚聲器或設備來傳達他的聲音，但是無所謂。他一開口講話，所有人就安靜下來並且專心聆聽。
en_text: There weren’t any speakers or other devices in the square to carry his voice, but it didn’t matter. He just spoke and everyone was quiet and listened.

tc_text: 「他們前來奪取我們的世界，」他說，「破壞我們的工作，並且奴役我們眾人。不能允許這種事情發生。為了更大的良善，我們不會容許這件事。」
en_text: “They have come to take our worlds,” he said, “to undo our works and to enslave us all. This cannot come to pass. For the Greater Good, we will not allow it.”

tc_text: 然後我們開始歡呼。我不能相信你竟然錯過這精采的一幕。
en_text: Then we started cheering. I can’t believe you missed it.

tc_text: – 高揚
歐里斯坦平原
這個開發良好的地區擁有一個精密的高速軌道網絡，以及數個從帝國時代即相當重要的城市。人類與鈦星人在這裡一起生活，雖然並不一定很容易。
en_text: This well-developed region features a sophisticated network of high-speed rail links and several cities of the Imperial era that remain important to this day. Human and Tau populations live side-by-side in the province, although not always easily.

tc_text: 農田
遼闊且綿延起伏的平原擁有炎熱的夏天，以及通常溫和的冬天，形成舒適的生活環境。但是每隔幾年就會有一陣強勁的寒冬風暴從北方的汪迪亞襲來。
en_text: The broad rolling plains feature hot summers and generally mild winters, making for pleasant living conditions. Every few years a powerful winter storm will drive in from Vandea to the north, however.

tc_text: —煽動叛亂（共計 4 次）
留意以瓦里安斯政戰軍官之名在歐里斯坦的工業城市中運作的煽動者，他煽動人類進行公開暴動，對大地級和清水級人民行使暴力，以及叛亂。這個身份不明的人士自稱為人類帝國軍事組織中的政治軍官，憑藉其帝國的權柄推動暴力行動。
en_text: Be on the lookout for agitator operating in Orestan industrial cities under the name of Commissar Valiance and inciting the human population to acts of public unrest, violence toward earth and water-caste citizens, and outright sedition. This unidentified man styles himself after the political officers employed in the military complex of the human Imperium and calls upon the authority of their Emperor to spark violence.

tc_text: 到目前為止，瓦里安斯引發六起民眾叛亂的獨立事件，最嚴重的一場暴動是在歐里斯塔第二機器工廠。在這次的騷動中，瓦里安斯把一名大地階級的工人拖到一個臨時搭建的舞台上，並且冷酷地殺了他。這種行為鼓動成群的人類走向街頭，並且攻擊其他大地級公民的居住單位。在當地政府恢復秩序之前，總計發生一百五十三起攻擊事件。
en_text: Valiance has so far caused six separate incidents of public unrest, most seriously a riot in the Oresta Secundus Machine Works. During this riot, Valiance dragged an earth-caste worker onto a makeshift stage and murdered him in cold blood. This prompted the crowd of humans to rampage through the streets and toward habitation units of other earth-caste citizens, resulting in 153 cases of assault before local authorities restored order.

tc_text: 瓦里安斯絕對是個危險人物，而且帶有武器。
en_text: Valiance is undoubtedly armed and dangerous.

tc_text: 潘尼亞低地
潘尼亞低地的城市和農場位於人類居住中心和鈦星人聚落的邊界，兩個種族之間發生過許多流血事件。帝國的效忠者對這裡的鈦星人政府發動漫長的游擊戰，因此而造成的傷痕仍然令人記憶猶新。
en_text: Bordering on the centers of human and Tau settlement on Kronus, the cities and agrifarms of the Panrea Lowlands have seen much bloodshed between the two races. Imperial loyalists waged a long guerrilla campaign against Tau authorities here, and the scars remain quite fresh.

tc_text: 農田
座落於溫和帶的北方邊緣，潘尼亞低地是小型農場、大片北方森林以及無數湖泊的家鄉。雖然冬季較長，但仍可以居住，溫暖的夏天則可以溶解漫長冬季所帶來的積雪。
en_text: Located on the northern fringes of the temperate belt, Panrea is home to small-scale farming, large boreal forests and countless lakes. Winters are long but livable, with warm summers making up for the long snow-covered months.

tc_text: 注意灰皮人的謊言！帝皇正在注視你！
en_text: Beware Grayskin Lies! The Emperor Is Watching!

tc_text: 克諾努斯的男人與女人：
決不能忘記我們是神聖之地的兒女，並且受到帝皇的保護。灰皮外星人用謊言與異端邪說引誘我們，但是我們必須抵抗他們。他們把我們視為寵物和奴隸，然而他們才是外星的髒東西。他們讚揚科技的好處；但那只會導致異端和瘋狂。
en_text: Never forget that we are sons and daughters of Holy Terra and protected by the Emperor. The Grayskin Xenos tempt us with lies and heresy, but we must resist them. They see us as pets and slaves, when they are the alien filth. They laud the benefits of technology when it can only lead to heresy and madness.

tc_text: 你的孩子會在羞恥中記住你的名字，只記得你是親吻灰皮人裙邊的叛徒嗎？還是他們會因為你堅定站立，抵抗世界的鎮壓，以及持守你的信仰而倍感驕傲？
en_text: Will your children remember you with shame, as a traitor who kissed the hem of a grayskin’s skirt? Or will they take pride that you stood firm and resisted the subjugation of your world and the perversion of your faith?

tc_text: 我們是命運的代理人。我們的世界被外星人宰制。你要做別人的財產，還是做個人類？
en_text: We are the agents of destiny. Our world is under an alien yoke. Will you be chattel or will you be men?

tc_text: 起來抗爭！
每日一思：臣服於外星人之的人類根本不能算是人。
en_text: Thought for the Day: A man subjected to an alien is no man at all.

tc_text: 帕翁尼斯心臟地帶
在帝國的時代，心臟地帶是克諾努斯 的糧倉，擁有開發良好的農地，以小片森林隔開。帝國在這個地區建造的城市仍然帶著第三十九千禧年時爆發的鐵肺傳染病所留下的傷痕。
en_text: The breadbasket of Kronus in the Imperial era, the heartland features well developed farmlands separated by small forests. The Imperial-built cities of the region still bear the scars of the ironlung pandemic which struck in the 39th Millennium.

tc_text: 農田
克諾努斯的溫和帶使心臟地帶擁有漫長而涼爽的夏天，以及非常長的生長季節。有時會有強大的風暴侵襲這個地區，但是通常都是溫和的氣候。
en_text: Kronus's temperate band grants the Heartland long but cool summers and a very long growing season. Powerful windstorms can buffet the region, but mild weather is the norm.

tc_text: ++ 第三級緊急報告 ++
++ 歐楚斯緊急護理中心 ++
++醫學生斯坎杜．費力克斯．宋尼亞報告 ++
關於會導致所謂的鐵肺瘟疫的不明病源體散播的可怕消息。北部地區和更西部的城市裡的醫學中心必需準備進行全面隔離。而且，他們必須保護自己，以對抗那些似乎決心要讓這種疾病大肆流行的煽動行為和異教邪說。
en_text: Dire news regarding the spread of the unknown pathogen causing the so-called ironlung plague. Medicus Centers in the northern sectors and in cities further west must prepare for full quarantine. What’s more, they must bulwark themselves against the action of seditious and heretical elements that seem determined to see the disease spread far and wide.

tc_text: 大約十九天前，自從城市裡第一個確認病例出現後，我們在緊急護理中心即擔任中央協調單位。我們的設施擁有澈底隔離的裝備，而前幾波的病人也被帶到這裡來接受隔離。後來的病例則在次要的小型中心進行隔離，因為病患的數量已經超過我們的容納能力。
en_text: We here at the Critical Care Center have been serving as the central coordinating authority since the first cases were confirmed in the city, some 19 days ago. Our facilities are equipped for absolute containment and the first several waves of patients were brought here for isolation. Subsequent cases have been isolated in secondary care centers and converted habblocks as the sheer number of patients has surpassed our capacities.

tc_text: 雖然如此，在三天前，我們相當自信可以在疾病攻擊人口較密集的北部區域之前加以阻止。我們沒有將希望看到我們失敗的異教徒因素列入考量。
en_text: Nevertheless, as of three days ago, we felt fairly confident that the spread of the disease could be stopped before it hit the more densely populated northern sectors. We had not counted on heretics who wished to see us fail.

tc_text: 昨天晚上，有幾位感染的病患攻擊護理人員，宣稱他們是在殺害而非治療，以致隔離區爆發暴動。過後不久，一個聲音（我相信是一個在中心外的異教鼓吹者）從用於一般性宣佈的廣播系統中傳出來。這個挑撥者說了一些異教徒的愚蠢主張，宣稱鐵肺瘟疫是來自上天的祝福，而非疾病，染上疾病的人應該被尊為所謂的「不潔之偉神」的神選者，等等之類的言語。這種說法在病患中引發嚴重的騷動，他們很快就打倒我那些被包圍的人員。超過三百個感染（並且帶有傳染力）的病患逃出中心，跑到城市街道上，朝著北方的人口中心前進。
en_text: Last night, a commotion erupted in the isolation wing as several infected patients turned on the staff, claiming the nurses were killing rather then treating them. Soon thereafter a voice (that of an outside heretical agitator, I believe) came over the vox caster system used for general announcements. This agent provocateur spewed heretical foolishness about ironlung plague being a blessing from on high rather than an affliction, that those who contract the disease should be honored as the chosen of the so-called Great Unclean One, and so forth. This led to an outright riot among the patients, one that quickly overwhelmed my beleaguered staff. Over three hundred infected (and infectious) patients escaped the facility and fled into the city streets, heading north toward the population centers.

tc_text: 現在所有將瘟疫限制在城市南區的希望都已破滅。
en_text: Any hope of containing the outbreak to the southern sectors of the city has now vanished.

tc_text: 目前在歐楚斯市的死亡人數是11,672人，受到感染的人數超過22,000人。我預期由於這些異教的行動，在接下來的幾天裡，這個數字會成長四倍。
en_text: Current death toll in Otrus City is 11,672 with over 22,000 more infected. I expect these numbers to quadruple in the next few days as a direct result of these heretical actions.

tc_text: 我祈求帝皇的憐憫。
en_text: I pray to the Emperor for mercy.

tc_text: 帕翁尼斯
克諾努斯星的第二大城市，帕翁尼斯 仍然像是帝國的城市，儘管這個行星屬於鈦帝國所有。它的主要建築是一千年興建於此的一座古代空港。
en_text: The second-largest city of Kronus, Pavonis still resembles an Imperial city, despite the planet’s Tau ties. It is dominated by the ancient spaceport built there millennia ago.

tc_text: 城市
從人類定居初期以來，帕翁尼斯這個城市就極少改變；它那寬闊的街道仍舊令放棄克諾努斯的帝國十分榮耀。冬天不像北地那樣嚴酷，但是陰暗的天空和寒冷的雨是地方的特色。
en_text: The city of Pavonis has changed very little since the early days of human settlement; its broad avenues still glorify the Imperium that abandoned Kronus. The winters are not as harsh as in the northlands, but overcast skies and cold rain are endemic.

tc_text: ++ 帝國工研所 ++
收信人：探勘長古明
已傳送：帕翁尼斯，克諾努斯星，利西斯星系，亞提瑪區域指揮部
en_text: Transmitted: Pavonis, Planet Kronus, Lithesh Sector, Ultima Segmentum

tc_text: 已接收：火星
十八號確認
經由：哈卓恩天文終端台
作者：探勘長蓋亞斯
機器本靈祝福了我們！
en_text: The Machine God has blessed us!

tc_text: 我和奉命追殺神靈族的帝國防衛軍特遣隊所派出的先遣隊到達利西斯星系的克諾努斯星。他們要找的目標—一個烏斯維工藝世界的所謂先見—據說和一個最近才遭遇到的異星威脅（這個種族被歸類為死靈族）密切合作。據報死靈族出現在克諾努斯星上，因此帝國防衛軍派出間諜進行調查，並尋找他們的追殺目標出現於此地的證據。
en_text: I arrived on Planet Kronus in the Lithesh Sector alongside the advance force sent by the Imperial Guard’s taskforce charged with hunting a particular miscreant of the Eldar race. This target – a so-called Farseer of the Ulthwé Craftworld – is said to be operating in conjunction with the newly encountered Xenos threat tentatively categorized as the Necron. These latter have been reported on Kronus and so the Imperial Guard sent agents to investigate and seek out evidence of their target’s presence here as well.

tc_text: 但是我的目的並不是前來協助進行沒有果效的異星人獵殺行動。我來這裡是要尋找帕拉帝厄斯的工作，在火星的巨大檔案庫中說他是我們組織中最有見識的機械主教。在赫魯斯異端事件之後的日子，大製造者派遣帕拉帝厄斯前往這個在當時還沒有人居住的世界，監督地獄暴風巨砲的研究；這門巨砲是在帝國泰坦「帝權鷲座」落入異教徒手中之後，再度被奪回。直到今天，那門巨砲仍然留在鐵工海灣的城市裡，但是我的研究指出帕拉帝厄斯對這個世界進行很多探索。我前來克諾努斯，是希望帕拉帝厄斯在將這個世界當成他的家之時，能為我們留下一些未被發現的財富。
en_text: My purpose here is not, however, to aid in some fruitless Xeno hunt. Rather I am here to find the works of one Magos Paladius, a Tech Priest mentioned in the great archives of Mars as among the most enlightened our order has ever seen. In the days after the Horus Heresy, the Fabricator General dispatched Paladius to this then-unihabited world to oversee study of the great Hellstorm Cannon recovered from the Imperator Titan Aquila Ignis after it fell to heretics. That cannon remains in the city of Ironworks Bay to this day, but my studies indicate that Paladius did much exploring of this world. My hope in coming to Kronus was that Magos Paladius may have left us some undiscovered treasures when he set about making this world his home.

tc_text: 克諾努斯超過我的一切期望，而且在帕翁尼斯裡我就發現一個真實的奇跡。古明，我已經發現一個可以運作的艾歐利斯級軌道控制站。我不必提醒你這是一種以為早就失傳的標準樣本建築。我們只知道它被模糊地描述為「凱柏追蹤工作站的更有效率形態）。對於含蓄地描述黑暗時代前的祖先的我們而言，這是多麼不凡的禮物！這個工作站能夠追蹤所有的軌道活動，並繪製航線，連最完全的包圍隊形都能避開。
en_text: Kronus has exceeded all my hopes, and in the city of Pavonis I have discovered a true wonder. Cumin, I have uncovered a functioning Aeolis-class Orbital Control Post. I need not remind you that this is a Standard Template Construct long thought lost. We have only the vaguest description of it as the “more-efficient cousin of the Kyber Tracking Station.” What a gift for understatement our Dark Age predecessors had! This station can track all orbital activity and plot courses to evade even the most complete siege formations.

tc_text: 我的僕役已經開始對這個工作站進行完整的視像研究，我會把它們準備好，一等到可以實用就傳送到火星。同時我自己則研究這裡的邏輯引擎，希望知道帕拉帝厄斯是否還在其他地方如此完美地召喚機械之神。
en_text: My servitors have begun a complete visual study of the post, which I will prepare for transmission to Mars as soon as practical. In the mean time I find myself working with logic engine here hoping to find clues of where else Paladius might have invoked the Machine God with such perfection.

tc_text: 瑞恩叢林
稠密的熱帶雨林遍佈瑞亞河的整個盆地。這條河流沿岸沒有多少城市，但是有很多貿易站—多半有強化防禦工事，以對抗住在叢林深處的野生歐克蠻人和克魯特。
en_text: Dense tropical rainforest extends throughout the drainage basin of the mighty Rhea River. The river features few outright cities, but many trading posts – often fortified against the feral Orks and Kroot who inhabit the deep jungles.

tc_text: 叢林
極其稠密的叢林包圍蜿蜒前進的瑞亞河兩岸，但是過去發展農業的嘗試在樹林裡留下一些空地。樹蔭可以帶來涼爽的天氣，但是氣候通常炎熱而潮溼，秋冬則常有暴風雨。
en_text: Extremely dense jungle lines the snaking River Rhean, although past attempts to develop agriculture have left some clearings in the foliage. The shade of the canopy can lead to cool patches, but the climate is generally hot and wet, with frequent storms in the autumn and winter.

tc_text: ++ 加密傳輸，寄給血鴉軍團智庫館長艾薩多．亞奇歐斯 ++
en_text: ++ Coded transmission sent to Librarian Isador Akios of the Blood Ravens ++

tc_text: ++ 日期是第二次克諾努斯戰爭的五年前，亞奇歐斯在塔塔魯斯落入混沌的三年前 ++
en_text: ++ Dated five years before the Second Kronus War and three years before Akios fell to Chaos on Tartarus++

tc_text: 智庫館長大人—
我的偵察艦隊已經對位於利西斯星系的達摩克里斯灣附近的克諾努斯行星完成初步調查。按照你的指示，我和我的弟兄盡力偽裝，不讓當地居民和控制這個世界的外星人發現我們的存在。我們搭乘貿易船「艾斯崔拉之光」到達此星系；這艘船是由海盜貿易商西門．瓦尼爾斯駕駛，他曾經多次與血鴉軍團合作。
en_text: My scout team has completed an initial survey of Planet Kronus in the Lithesh Sector near the anomaly known as the Damocles Gulf. As per your instructions, my brothers and I endeavored to mask our presence from the local inhabitants and to the alien powers who control this world. We arrived in system aboard the trading vessel Estrella’s Light, operated by Rogue Trader Simon Varnius, who has been of use to the Blood Ravens on several occasions.

tc_text: 當瓦尼爾斯以太空梭前往這個世界由外星人控制的首都時，我和我的弟兄們使用修改過的亞伏斯級登陸艇，在南方的稠密叢林中著陸。按照你指示，我們尋找血鴉軍團過去在這個世界上行動的證據。
en_text: While Trader Varnius traveled by shuttle to the world’s alien-controlled capital, my brothers and I used our modified Arvus-class lander to make landfall in the dense jungles of the south. As per you instructions, we pursued evidence of previous action by our brother Blood Ravens on this world.

tc_text: 雖然你提供給我們的那些資料認為我們的弟兄是在北方和他們所追逐的異教徒發生戰鬥，但是當我們的登陸艇的掃瞄器收到一個使用參事會的神聖密碼的信號信標時，我們決定降落在瑞恩叢林盆地。
en_text: Although the documents you provided to us suggest that the battle between our brothers and the heretics they pursued occurred in the north, we chose to land in the Rhean Jungle basin when our lander’s scanners picked up a signal beacon using the sacred codes of the chapter.

tc_text: 我們的搜索引導我們進入最濃密的叢林，到處都是野生歐克蠻人和其他動物。我們選擇不與外星人交戰，以免犧牲我們最大的優勢—匿蹤。我們追蹤這個信號信標，一直到達一個龐大的垃圾堆—歐克蠻人長期肆虐的典型現象。在那堆垃圾裡，我們發現一個傷痕累累（但是仍然完好）的納瑟西恩箱，上面有我們參事會的法印，以及一段簡短的錄音訊息，我將它附在這裡：
en_text: Our search led us into the densest jungle, infested with feral Orks and other creatures. We chose not to engage the aliens, lest we sacrifice the stealth that was our greatest advantage. We tracked the signal beacon to an overgrown junk pile – one of the common artifacts of longtime Orkish infestation. In that pile we found a battered (but still intact) narthecium case bearing the sigil of our chapter and a brief recorded message I reproduce here:

tc_text: ++ 在這裡發現泰利亞斯．努爾弟兄和以西結．雷慕斯學員的神聖原生淋腺，他們在對抗那些毀滅性力量時陣亡於戰場上。我們繼續向異教徒的權力中心挺進，但是我把這些寶貴的器官留在這裡。我擔心我們是走向屠殺，至少要讓我們的一些基因種子能夠在風暴之中倖存。奉帝皇之名，我請求你們將這個箱子送回翁尼斯亞肯能。奉他的聖名，我是血鴉軍團第四連的藥劑師法蘭西斯。 ++
en_text: ++Find here the holy progenoid glands of Brother Terrias Null and Initiate Ezekiel Remus, fallen in battle against the ruinous powers. We continue our march toward the center of power of the heretics, but I leave here these precious organs. I fear we march to the slaughter and would have at least some of our gene-seed survive the coming storm. In the Emperor’s name, I beseech you to return this case to the Omnis Arcanum. In His Holy Name, I am Apothecary Francis of the 4th Company, Blood Ravens Chapter.++

tc_text: 我們無從得知歐克蠻人在哪裡或是何時找到這些神聖的物品，雖然我們可以因為他們隨意丟棄這個物品而感激他們的野蠻性格。我認為取回這個失落的基因種子要比進一步探勘更加重要，因此命令我們的小隊返回瓦尼爾斯的船艦。但是我確實對於姓名的巧合感到驚奇。你先前提供給我們的記錄似乎是由一個雷慕斯弟兄記載的，但是這份記錄指出有一個死亡的學員也叫這個名字。真的是在同一個小隊裡有兩個同名同姓的人嗎？若非如此，那麼在雷慕斯死後，誰冒用他的名字？
en_text: We have no way of knowing where or when the Orks found this holy item, although we can thank their barbarity for disposing of it so casually. I judged the recovery of this lost gene-seed to take priority over further exploration and ordered our return to Trader Varnius’s vessel. I do find myself wondering at the coincidence of names, however. The records you provided us seem to be penned by one Brother Remus, while this record points to the death of an Initiate of the same name. Could there truly have been two men in the same team with the same name? And if not, then who assumed Remus’ name after his death?

tc_text: ———馬拉奇．雅普雷斯弟兄，血鴉第十偵察連
en_text: —Brother Malachi Ypres, Blood Ravens 10th Scout Company

tc_text: 阿卡馬爾沙漠
阿卡馬爾沙漠當然不像北方的塔辛恩地區的人口那麼多，但是它無疑仍是鈦帝國工業的重鎮。地方首都真度斯是活躍的工業中心，還有數個更小的城鎮分佈在乾旱內陸。
en_text: Certainly not as populated as Greater Tash'n to the north, the Agamar Desert nonetheless bears many marks of Tau industry. The regional capital of Jandus is a bustling industrial center, while several smaller burgs dot the arid inland.

tc_text: 沙漠
行星的中心沙漠往西方擴展，包含沙漠構成的海洋以及多岩、風片山地的「海岸」。巨大的沙塵暴週期性地覆蓋這個地區。
en_text: The western extension of the planet’s central desert includes both oceans of sand and “coasts” of rocky, wind-hewn mountains. Massive sandstorms periodically blanket the region.

tc_text: 主旨：測量克諾努斯星（亞提瑪區域指揮部，利西斯星系） —報告 #217：阿卡馬爾沙漠
en_text: Subject: Survey of Planet Kronus (Ultima Segmentum, Lithesh Sector) – Report #217: Agamar Desert

tc_text: 作者：書記賈哈尼斯．克連
概述︰
佔據整個克諾努斯星內陸的巨大中央沙漠延伸至西海南方邊緣的海岸，這一大片的水域是從亞沙里斯（佔領這個行星的外星人稱之為塔辛恩）延伸過來的。雖然不像最深處的遠東一樣荒涼， 阿卡馬爾的氣候幾乎不適合人類居住，因此已經成為外星人的家園。
en_text: The great central desert that dominates the inland of Kronus reaches out to the coast along the southern edge of the Western Sea, a large body of water extending from the city of Asharris (now called Tash'n by the Xenos occupying the planet). Although not as inhospitable as the depths further east, the Agamar is hardly the ideal climate for human inhabitation and so has become a home for aliens.

tc_text: 城市中心：
整個沿海平原有二十三個居住地帶，人口都在兩百人以上， 其中只有一個夠資格稱為一座城市，即地區首都真度斯。真度斯位於多山高地，遠離水域，一開始是一個小小的開礦殖民地，是在克諾努斯星不再受帝國垂青的時代以前建立的。最近鈦星人的領袖顯然下令進行大規模的擴建。現在城裡約有五萬個居民（我們估計只有兩千個人類），以及幾間大型的工業工廠。
en_text: The entire coastal plain is home to twenty-three habitation clusters with populations above 200, only one of which can rightly be termed a city, namely the regional capital of Jandus. Located in the mountainous highlands away from the water-line, Jandus began as a small mining colony established in the era before Kronus fell from Imperial grace. In more recent times, the Tau overlords have apparently directed a major expansion. The city now houses some 50,000 inhabitants (of which we estimate only 2,000 human souls) and several large industrial plants.

tc_text: 歷史焦點︰
阿卡馬爾沙漠是數個鈦星人與歐克蠻人決定性戰役的發生地點。歐克蠻人酋長瑪爾布魯得（據說是軍閥亞山達的私人使臣）領軍對這個地區進行持續的攻擊，掠奪許多較小型的工業哨站。他的軍隊（在鈦星人的記錄中，估計超過一萬人）後來攻擊真度斯。城市的守軍—由鈦生人、克魯特和人類組成，人數遠遜於對方—擁有優越武器和強化工事的優勢，但是損失慘重，許多新發現的鈦星人記錄透露出城市滅亡的感覺。
en_text: The Agamar Desert was the site of several decisive battles between the Tau and Ork invaders. The Ork chieftain Mahrblud, rumored to be a personal envoy of the Warchief of Alsanta, led a sustained assault on the region, razing many of the smaller industrial outposts. His warband, estimated at over 10,000 strong in Tau records, then set upon the city of Jandus. The city’s defenders – a much smaller force of Tau, Kroot and humans – had the advantages of superior arms and entrenched positions, but suffered severe losses and many recovered Tau reports indicate a feeling that the city was doomed.

tc_text: 守軍將所有的力量集中在消滅瑪爾布魯得本人，以扭轉災難。裝甲部隊砍殺重重的歐克蠻人士兵，讓幾群克魯特戰士得以直接攻擊酋長和其隨從。根據幾份報告指出，當克魯特將瑪爾布魯得的頭插在旗桿上高高舉起時，歐克蠻人軍隊迅速開始內戰。
en_text: The defenders averted disaster by directing all their energies at eliminating Mahrblud himself. Armored units cut through the screens of Ork foot soldiers, allowing several packs of Kroot warriors to engage the Warboss and his entourage directly. According to several reports, when the Kroot raised Mahrblud’s severed head on a large pike, the Ork army rapidly fell to infighting.

tc_text: 瑪爾布魯得的頭顱仍然展示在真度斯的公眾廣場上。
en_text: Mahrblud’s skull remains on display in Jandus’s public square.

tc_text: 氣候學︰
沿海平原可謂是主辛大陸中心的大沙漠的延伸。降雨量極少，地方植物大部分是仙人掌和乾燥的灌木叢牧草。主要氣候特徵只有沙塵暴。在分隔海岸與乾燥內地的高地上，面對西方的斜坡具有幾種微型氣候，包括從海岸沿著斜坡上升的溼氣所造成的降雨，帶來多種溫合的天氣。
en_text: The coastal plain is more properly an extension of the great desert that dominates the center of the continent. Rainfall is minimal and local vegetation is principally hardy cacti and dry scrub grasses. Major climate events are limited to sandstorms. The west-facing slopes of the highlands that separate parts of the coast from the arid inland are home to some micro-climates including bands of temperate weather fed by rainfall caused by moist air driven up the slopes from the coast proper.

tc_text: 異星的影響：
非常高。這個地區的人口稀少，但主要是鈦星人以及他們的幾種僕役種族，包括胡蜂。有一些證據顯示野生歐克蠻人生活在靠近真度斯的山麓丘陵，城市裡則有小規模的人類人口。
en_text: Very high. Population in the region is sparse, but dominated by Tau xenotypes along with several of their servitor races, including the Vespid. There is some evidence of feral Ork population in the foothills near Jandus and the city is home to small pockets of human population.

tc_text: 阿裡爾高地
沿著克諾努斯主大陸的西海岸的大片山地，阿裡爾高地擁有克諾努斯的最高主峰。在目前的戰爭爆發前，有數個鈦星人城市以及軍事基地分佈在高原中間。
en_text: The major chain of mountains along the western coast of Kronus's major continent, the Highlands feature the highest peaks on Kronus. Several Tau cities and military bases perched among the highlands before the outbreak of the current war.

tc_text: 山脈
阿裡爾山脈中有數個溫和的山谷，由僅能經由狹窄隘口通過的高峰隔開。在北方，大風雪可能切斷這些居住地的對外交通達數月甚至一年的時間。
en_text: The Ariel Mountains shelter several large temperate valleys separated by high peaks passable only through tight passes. In the north, blizzards can cut off these pockets of habitation for months or even years at a time.

tc_text: ++ 次軌道追蹤報告 ++
間接觀察顯示，在我們位於阿裡爾高地的陣地北方的提瑞亞丘陵上，出現大批屬於不明外星結構的載具及部隊。標準直接追蹤法顯示山丘間只有幾個地區有少量的能量波動。但是分派至本站的導航者小隊已經執行數次偵察任務，並發現外星人部隊在多處隱密地點間移動的證據。
en_text: Indirect observation reveals the arrival in the Tyrean hills north of our position in the Ariel Highlands of a significant number of vehicles and troops of unknown alien construction. Standard direct tracking methods reveal only minor energy surges in several areas of the hills. Nevertheless, the team of Pathfinders assigned to this station have undertaken several reconnaissance sorties and found evidence of alien troops moving between several concealed points.

tc_text: 聯合指揮部根據在第三星域擴張期間的遭遇戰進行分析，從這些分析中可以判斷得知，這些現象很可能是短距離次元跳躍設備的行動所致，它們採用全息技術，與所謂的神靈族的技術一致。
en_text: Relying on analyses received from coalition command based on encounters in the third sphere expansions, it is probable that these signs point to the action of short-range warp-jump devices of some sort and of holographic technologies consistent with the unaligned agents known as El’dar.

tc_text: 這些隱藏的通道可以允許大量軍隊進行佈署，被發現的機會極低。因此可能神靈族已經在提瑞亞佈署了相當大量的兵力。
en_text: These hidden gateways would allow large numbers of troops to deploy with very little chance of being detected. It is likely then that these El’dar have landed a substantial number of forces in Tyrea.

tc_text: 要注意的是，類似本站這種位於阿裡爾高地間的觀測站，是目前惟一位於這些入侵者和首都之間的防禦力量。我們有良好的裝備，可以擊退任何試圖以空中攻擊載具穿越山峰的意圖，甚至可以應付大部份的地面載具，但是這些傳送關口卻極難反制。我謙卑地請求迅速支援，讓我們得以固守所有的隘口，將所有的威脅限制在提瑞亞中。
en_text: Note that stations such as ours in the Ariel Highlands are currently all that stands between any such invader and the capital city. We are well equipped to repel any attempt to pass over the peaks with aerial assault vehicles or even most ground assaults, but the use of these gateways is much harder to counter. Deferring of course to the wisdom of Aun’el, I humbly request rapid reinforcement, so that we may secure all the passes and contain whatever threat lies in Tyrea.

tc_text: 迪門斯北方地帶
一個延伸至克諾努斯北極地區的陸塊，北方地帶大部份地區被極地的冰和永久凍土覆蓋。只有不法之徒和叛徒會自願在這塊嚴厲的土地上安家。
en_text: A landmass reaching far into Kronus' arctic region, the Northlands are largely covered by polar ice and permafrost. Only outcasts and renegades have ever voluntarily made their homes in this harsh land.

tc_text: 極地凍原
迪門斯擁有散佈的亞寒帶森林，起伏的丘陵中分佈著古代礦坑、凍原和大片冰原。一年到頭都會降雪，整個冬天都有惡劣的大風雪肆虐。
en_text: Demes features scattered boreal forests, rolling hills dotted with ancient mines, tundra and large ice fields. Snowfall occurs year round, with harsh blizzards striking throughout the winter.

收信人：探勘長古明

tc_text: 已接收：火星
經由：哈卓恩天文終端台
作者：探勘長蓋亞斯
古明—
在天譴特遣隊的協助下，我繼續在克諾努斯星的探測，但是目的在於尋找一般認為早已失落在這世界的翁尼西亞的神聖遺物。當然，其中最偉大的要算是帝國泰坦「帝權鷲座」的地獄風暴巨砲，那是在赫魯斯異教事件期間，羅福斯．帝權和他的莫德拉提叛變之後所取回的武器。
en_text: I continue my exploration of Planet Kronus under the auspices of Task Force Retribution (established by the Departmento Munitorium) but in search of more of the holy relics of the Omnissiah thought lost on this world. The greatest of these, of course, is the great Hellstorm cannon of the Imperator Titan Aquila Ignis, recovered after the loathsome treason of Princeps Rufus Aquila and his Moderati during the Horus Heresy.

tc_text: 我在勝利海灣發現的帕拉帝厄斯日誌中，提到他非常擔心羅福斯的叛變可能已經永久地腐敗那尊巨砲。雖然帕拉帝厄斯很留意他在日誌中的記載，但是他暗指那些異教徒將自己獻給混沌的瘟疫力量，而且擔心巨砲可能仍然和那股邪惡力量有所聯結。
en_text: The journals of Magos Paladius, which I recovered in Victory Bay, speak of grave concerns that Princeps Rufus’s treason may have permanently corrupted the cannon. Although Paladius was careful with what he put down in his journal, he implies that the heretic crew gave themselves to the Chaos powers of pestilence, and feared the cannon might well be tied to that foul power still.

tc_text: 在穿越迪門斯北方地帶的結凍荒地時，我發現證據，令帕拉帝厄斯的擔夏更增可信度和急切性。事實上，我一直在這顆行星的文化裡尋找那門巨砲的記錄，也發現幾處提到「巨砲秘教」在那些決定生活在行星邊境的居民當中生根。據報這類的秘教當中，有一個仍然在迪門斯北方地帶活動，時間不過在幾十年前。
en_text: In traveling across the frozen wastes of the Demes Northlands, I have uncovered evidence that adds credence and immediacy to Paladius’s worries. Indeed, I had been tracking references to the cannon in the culture of this planet and found references to several “cults of the gun” having taken root among those who chose to live their lives on the planetary frontier. One such cult had been reported still active mere decades ago in the frozen Demes Northlands.

tc_text: 經過一些搜尋之後，我們在東方的冰原上的一處小營地找到這個密教的遺跡。他們的禮拜堂是一座破爛不堪的建築，上面的符號雖然粗糙，但是明顯是地獄風暴巨砲。一個有六面大圓盤環繞的頭骨標示出主要大門，就像以孩童的手法表現巨砲的砲管和前方。在裡面，我們發現類似醫療所的東西。裡面有十個可憐人住在那裡，每個人都患有不同階段的枯萎病。小小的奉獻祭壇排列在牆邊，一個比一個不幸。雖然那裡有密教的符號，但是也有腐肉的祭物，以及類似梅斯沖邊境發生瘟疫時所使用的法印。
en_text: After some searching, we found the remains of this cult in a small encampment on the eastern ice fields. Their chapel was a ramshackle building marked with symbols that, although crude, clearly echoed the Hellstorm cannon. A skull surrounded by six large discs marked the main door, like a child’s representation of the gun’s barrels and fronting. Inside, we uncovered something more akin to a hospice. Ten wretches lived there, each in a stage of a withering pestilence. Small devotional shrines lined the walls, each more troubling than the last. While the cult’s crude symbols were present there, so were offerings of rotting meat and sigils reminiscent of those borne by the plague legions faced on the edge of the Maelstrom.

tc_text: 我們清除掉這些不幸的人和他們那棟令人厭惡的禮拜堂。但我擔心亞歷山大將軍想要重新啟動地獄風暴巨砲，可能會釋放出某種巨大的邪惡瘟疫。
en_text: We purged these unfortunates and their foul chapel. But I am concerned that General Alexander’s wish to reactivate the Hellstorm cannon could release a foul pestilence of some greater sort.

tc_text: 我希望你能提供一些指導。
en_text: I hope you can provide some guidance.

tc_text: 艾瑞惡地
中央沙漠地帶最嚴酷的地區，艾瑞惡地的岩石乾燥地面奪走許多不謹慎的旅行者的生命。不神聖的遺物和腐敗的廢墟散佈在惡土上，可能是赫魯斯異教的戰鬥遺跡。
en_text: The harshest area of the central desert band, the Badlands’ rocky dry terrain has claimed many unwary travelers. Unholy relics and foul ruins dot the Badlands, supposedly remnants of the battles of the Horus Heresy.

tc_text: 沙漠
位於中央沙漠東方邊緣上的自然蕭條，艾瑞惡土沒有水源。只有偶爾出現的小塵暴會中斷不斷照射這片惡土的陽光。
en_text: A natural depression on the eastern edge of the central desert, the Badlands have no known source of water. Only the occasional dust devil interrupts the pounding of the sun on this barren deathtrap.

tc_text: 摘錄自「失落者的沙漠：惡土三年誌」，作者：雷吉亞斯．韓（帕翁尼斯出版社，限量出版）
en_text: From “Desert of the Lost: Three Cycles in the Badlands” by Regias Han (Pavonis Press, Limited Release)

tc_text: 除了乾渴和飢餓之外，瘋狂總是在惡土上伴隨著我。艾瑞沙漠和我曾經去過的其他沙漠都不一樣—它有一種力量，緩慢地磨損我的心靈，就像風侵蝕石頭一樣。海市蜃樓與風中的聲音是常見的同伴，讓我看見自己最黑暗的角落。我一再地看見我傷害過和欺騙過的人，我拋棄的女兒，我背叛的妻子。
en_text: Along with thirst and hunger, madness was always with me in the Badlands. Eres is not like any other desert I had ever been in – there was something about it that slowly wore away at my mind just like the wind did the rock. Mirages and voices in the wind were constant companions, showing me the darkest corners of myself. I saw again and again the people I had hurt and lied to, the daughter I had abandoned, the wife I had betrayed.

tc_text: 但是還有其它的幻象，一些非常恐怖而陌生的東西，驅使我越來越深入沙漠，只為了逃避它們。其中最惡劣的東西被我稱呼為「玫瑰少女」。
en_text: But there were other mirages, images of things so terrible and alien that they drove me further and further into the desert, if only to escape them. The worst of these was a thing I came to call the Rose Lady.

tc_text: 當然，我從來不曾清楚地看見她，但她是我所遭遇過的事情中最美麗又最可怕的事物。在夜晚的最深處，她會從陰影裡走出，她的眼睛就像豐富的石英，她的肌膚是蒼白的粉紅色，彷彿從來不曾接觸過陽光。月光描繪出她的胸脯和大腿的曲線，一波又一波的興奮之情會湧進我昏昏欲睡的意志中。
en_text: I never saw her clearly, of course, but she was both the most beautiful and the most horrific thing I had ever encountered. In the depths of the night, she would step from the shadows, her eyes like rich quartz and her flesh a pale pink never touched by the sun. The moonlight would hint at the curve of her breasts and the line of her thighs, and waves of arousal would rush through my sleep-addled mind.

tc_text: 還有她的聲音。我會聽到她在風中唱歌，或是對我附耳說話，並且心醉神迷。直到今天，當我試圖回想她的音調時，就會落入遺憾和思念的循環中。那就像聽到一種顏色，一種美得不可能存在但是根本上就不對勁的事物。
en_text: And her voice. I would hear her sing in the wind or whisper in my ear and would swoon. To this day, when I try to remember her tones, I get caught in loops of regret and yearning. It was like hearing a color, something impossibly beautiful but inherently wrong.

tc_text: 玫瑰少女的每次來訪都令我癡迷，但她們也是非常恐怖。到最後，當她在我的夢中走向我時，她會微笑，露出像針一樣的可怕牙齒，或是光線會照射出她的頭髮裡那些扭動的蛇。
en_text: All the Rose Lady’s visits were rapturous, but they were also horrifying. Eventually, as she sidled up to me in my dreams, she would smile and reveal her terrifying needle-like teeth, or the light would catch the writhing serpents in her hair.

tc_text: 我每天早上都尖叫著醒來，但是每天晚上又熱切盼望她回來。
en_text: I woke screaming every morning, but yearned for her return every night.

tc_text: 海必里恩山峰
帝國時代的開礦聖地，海必里恩山區帶著大量開掘和採礦的巨大傷痕。即使千年之後，地表上的切痕仍然清晰可見。
en_text: The site of intense Imperial-era mining, the Hyperion mountain range bears the huge scars of massive excavation and strip-mining endeavors. Even millennia later, the gashes in the landscape are clear.

tc_text: 山脈
海必里恩山峰從中央沙漠的乾旱土地裡突起，形成與南部的綠色海岸的深遠叢林間的屏障。舊礦坑和採石場散佈在貧瘠的北部斜坡，還有幾條河從南部的山丘流入叢林。
en_text: The Hyperion Peaks jut up from the arid expanse of the central desert, forming a barrier with the deep jungles of the Green Coast to the south. Old mines and quarries dot the barren northern slopes, while several rivers flow from the southern foothills into the jungle.

十八號確認
經由：哈卓恩天文終端台
作者：探勘長蓋亞斯
克諾努斯星的探索繼續提供豐富的發現。我和我的僕人繼續探索這個星球上最古老的開發地區，以尋找標準技術建築（或稱為STC衍生裝置）。
en_text: Exploration of Planet Kronus continues to provide a rich bounty of discoveries. My servitors and I have continued to explore the areas of oldest development on the planet in our search for Standand Technology Constructs or STC-derivatives.

tc_text: 在過去三個月裡，我們在這顆星球的沙漠帶南緣的山峰裡移動。這些山峰含有豐富的礦物，而且還有帝國剝削這顆行星的密集開礦活動的痕跡（大約在300.M37左右）。有幾個巨大的製造廠仍在使用中，取出礦石後，並在半精煉的狀態下將它們送到位於北方的城市。
en_text: Over the last three standard months we have moved among the peaks on the southern edge of the planet’s desert belt. These peaks are rich sources of minerals and bear the marks of intense mining activity in the early years of Imperial exploitation of the planet (circa 300.M37). Several large Manifactoria remain in use, extracting ores and sending them on in semi-refined states to the cities to the north.

tc_text: 但是對於有眼可看的人來說，顯然這些設施當中有一些的日期要比建立殖民地的年代早了數千年。事實上，記錄在礦坑邏輯引擎中的資源萃取速度超過我過去所見過的記錄。這些礦坑顯然比其他礦坑更接近標準樣板。
en_text: For those with the eyes to look, however, it is clear that some of these facilities predate the colonial founding by many millennia. Indeed, the resource extraction rates recorded in the logic engines of the mines exceed any I have seen before. These mines are clearly closer to the Standard Template than any other mines in the Segmentum.

tc_text: 我開始更深入研究最古老設施的邏輯引擎中的記錄。利用我在分析帕翁尼斯空港時所獲得的資料，我再次發現帕拉帝厄斯的證據，他在赫魯斯異教事件後不久來到克諾努斯星。帕拉帝厄斯似乎下令興建這些巨大的礦坑，以協助興建幾個次級研究機構。
en_text: I have begun deeper exploration of the records within the logic engine of the oldest facility. Using the information gleaned from my analysis of the Pavonis Space Port, I have found the evidence once again of Magos Paladius, who arrived on Kronus shortly after the Horus Heresy. Paladius seemingly ordered the construction of these great mines to aid in the construction of several secondary research facilities.

tc_text: 這些設施的確切本質，以及帕拉帝厄斯和他對於我們的黑暗時代祖先所留下來的標準樣板的驚人知識究竟發生了什麼事，仍然不清楚。
en_text: The exact nature of those facilities and what became of Paladius and his wondrous knowledge of the Standard Templates left by our Dark Age predecessors remains unclear.

tc_text: 如果機器本靈確實祝福與我，我希望能夠在下一次的報告中提出這些問題的答案。
en_text: Assuming the blessings of the Machine God are with me, I hope to have answers for these questions by the time of my next report.

tc_text: 穆拉德沼澤地
穆拉德是莫理亞海口的一座大島，是一個充滿野生動物的稠密悶熱地區，並且散佈著古老的廢墟。有一些人類聚落位於北方的海岸上。
en_text: A large island at the mouth of the Morriah Sea, Murad is a dense and muggy region full of wildlife and dotted with ancient ruins. A few human settlements stand on the northern coast.

tc_text: 沼澤地
莫理亞和東海的水流形成北岸的田園氣候，但是一旦離開海灘，內部的沼澤便成主角。在夏天和秋天發生熱帶風暴是司空見慣的事。
en_text: The currents of the Morriah and Eastern Seas make for idyllic weather on the northern coast, but as soon as one leaves the beach, the muggy swamps of the interior take over. Tropical storms are commonplace in the summer and autumn.

tc_text: ++ 聲音傳輸片段 ++
++ 來源 —穆拉德十三號氣象站 ++
++ 聲音鑑定不明確 ++
不確定有誰會收到這些報告，但是我想我們發現了那些一直攻擊我們的瘋子的目的。在這個世界全都瘋了之前，這個地方曾經是一個氣象站。這裡有一個關於迪摩斯海岸的影像記錄，記載它如何從一個熱帶海灘天堂變成一個…一個，我不知道該怎麼說…某種地獄吧，我想。
en_text: Not sure if anyone is receiving these reports, but we think we’ve discovered what the madmen who have been assaulting us are after. This place used to be a weather station before this whole world went mad. There’s actually a vid-record here of the Deimos shoreline on the horizon and how it went from some tropical beach resort to a… to a, I don’t know what it's become… Some sort of hell, I guess.

tc_text: 無論如何，我們一直使用這個地方作為作戰基地。牆很堅固，我們可以相當容易地控制出入。但自上周起，我們開始遭到夜襲，這些攻擊者只令我想到瘋子。我認為他們曾經是人類，但是他們顯然失去所有感官，而且似乎毫無理由地攻擊我們。他們從迪摩斯使用小船穿越海峽到達這裡，高喊著我不想重複的瘋狂誓言。我們一夜又一夜地擊退他們，但是這不能一直持續下去，我要求一些人到叢林更深處看看能否找到另一個基地，或是我們能夠撤退的地方。
en_text: Anyway, we’ve been using this place as a base of operations. The walls are solid and we can pretty easily control access. But last week we started coming under nightly assault from what I can only think of as frothing madmen. I think they were human once, but they’ve obviously lost all sense and seemed to be launching themselves at us for no reason. They’d come in small boats across the straights from Deimos, shouting mad oaths I’d rather not repeat. We held them off night after night, but it couldn’t last forever, and I asked some of the guys to look deeper in the jungle and see if they could find another station or somewhere we could fall back to.

tc_text: 他們找到的地方一定就是那些畸形傢伙要找的東西。我剛剛親自視察結束回來，我並不確定我願意描述它...我想是某種雕像…它完全被藤蔓蓋住，直到我們清理掉一半...我不確定它應該是什麼東西， 看起來就像是火燄或是什麼東西，有人被困在裡面...
en_text: What they found has got to be what the freaks are after. I just came back from seeing it myself and I’m not sure I want to describe it… a sort of statue I guess… it was covered in creeper vines until we cleared off about half of it… I’m not sure what it’s supposed to be, it’s like flames or something with people caught in them…

tc_text: 岩石上還刻著一行又一行的文字，但是我看不懂。我確定其中有一些聽起來像是那些瘋子的吶喊。
en_text: There are lines and lines of text carved into the rock too, but I couldn’t read it. I’m sure some of it would sound a lot like the madmen’s screams.

tc_text: 但是那些在火焰裡的臉…他們看起來很熟悉…好像我知道他們會在那裡…
en_text: The faces in the flames, though… they looked familiar… like I knew they’d be there…

tc_text: ++ 傳輸結束 ++
莫理亞海岸
根據在莫理亞海岸定居的人類及鈦星人的說法，有一些古代文明的遺址深藏在內地叢林未經探索的中心地帶。死靈族的興起為這些傳說賦與全新而可怕的真實性。
en_text: According to the humans and Tau who make their homes on the Morriah Coast, the ruins of some ancient civilization lurk deep in the unexplored heart of the inland jungles. The rise of the Necrons has given these legends a new and terrible verisimilitude.

tc_text: 森林
莫理亞海岸的南部海岸擁有廣闊的沙灘，以及令人愉快的炎熱氣候。但是內地的叢林則擁有豐富的雨量以及較涼爽的溫度。
en_text: The coast of Morriah Bay to the south is home to broad sand beaches and a pleasant, hot climate. The inland forests, however, feature heavier precipitation and cooler temperatures.

tc_text: ++ 現況報告 ++
++ 獵人幹部藍星 ++
++ 提報的指揮官︰沙塞．維爾拉．江凱 ++
索瓦—
我們的作戰目的是將住在叢林的歐克蠻人趕出莫理亞海北面的半島，雖然進度緩慢，但是穩定地進行。
en_text: Our operation to drive the jungle-dwelling Ork population out of the peninsula north of the Morriah Sea continues to make slow, but steady progress.

tc_text: 和我們在兩年前抵達這個世界的時候，在塔辛恩的首都城市面對的歐克蠻人比較起來，這個地區的歐克蠻人比較沒有組織。由於沒有一位統領他們的酋長做為領導中心，他們似乎回復到原始的作戰方法，比較著重於掠奪眼前的對象，而不是盡力奪取及佔領更多領土。因此我們可以預測他們攻擊的可能目標，並從側翼加以攻擊，得以在戰術上勝過歐克蠻人。也因為這個因素讓我們能夠以少勝多，以一對抗二十或三十個敵人。
en_text: The Orks of this region are far less organized than those we faced in the capital city of Tash’n upon our arrival on this world two cycles ago. Without the central authority of one of their chieftains, they seem to revert to savage tribal warfare tactics, more focused on raiding whoever is at hand than on making any concerted efforts to take and hold territory. Our cadre has thus been able to outmaneuver the Orks by anticipating likely targets for their aggression and striking at their flanks. This allows us to compensate for the massive numerical advantage enjoyed by the enemy, who outnumber us some twenty or thirty to one.

tc_text: 我們幹部裡的胡蜂輔助部隊在這次的戰鬥過程中特別有效果。他們能以高速度穿越過濃密的樹林，向敵人襲擊，然後消失於密林中。根據導航者從遮蔽處進行的觀察，這些攻擊總是令這些歐克蠻人火冒三丈，他們會爬到樹上，或是朝著森林發射粗糙的彈藥，結果只是在另一道陣線上遭受攻擊。胡蜂戰士造成的混亂為烈焰戰士小隊或是殲擊機甲創造了絕佳的砲轟機會，甚至可以由克魯特掠食者小隊進行近身攻擊。
en_text: The Vespid auxiliaries in our Cadre have proven especially effective in this battle. They are able to fly at high speeds through the dense foliage, striking at the enemy and then vanishing again into the canopy. According to Pathfinders observing from cover, these raids regularly drive the Orks into apoplectic fits as they scramble up trees or launch volleys of crude projectiles into the foliage, only to be attacked from another front. The disarray the Vespid cause creates perfect opportunities for barrages from fire warrior teams or crisis suits, or even for close assault by Kroot carnivore teams.

tc_text: 我相信我們可以繼續以最小的損失進行這種掠奪作戰，慢慢地將歐克蠻人向南方和西方趕逐。但是要真正地消滅這些蠻人需要比我手中可資運用的更大的火力。
en_text: I am confident we can continue this harrying tactic with minimal loss and slowly drive the Orks south and westward. Actually eliminating these barbarians, however, will require more firepower than my cadre has at its disposal.

綠色海岸
綠色海岸很久以前就是歐克蠻人與其他危險野獸的居住地。現在它是軍閥戈古茲的吼～軍團的執政中心，它正威脅著要擴散到全克諾努斯和更遙遠的範圍。
en_text: The Green Coast has long been the abode of feral Orks and other dangerous beasts. Now it is the heart of Warlord Gorgutz' great Waaagh!, which threatens to spread across all of Kronus and beyond.

tc_text: 沼澤地
因為有數百條河川流入溫暖的南海，海岸線本身比較像是海市蜃樓，而不像實景。堅實土地外有龐大壯闊的漂浮植綿延數哩，而惡臭的鹽水沼澤也同樣延伸至整個內陸中。
en_text: Riddled with hundreds of rivers flowing into the warm Southern Sea, the coastline itself is more mirage than reality. Huge expanses of floating vegetation stretch out for miles beyond solid ground, while fetid saltwater swamps stretch inland just as far.

tc_text: ++ 偵察報告++
++ 匿蹤小隊獨身獵人 ++
請注意，近距離軌道的柯西指揮站所提供的報告已經過確認。最近撞擊瑞恩海的熱帶海岸的物體確定是歐克蠻人侵略者所使用的粗糙運輸艦。密切觀察之後，獲得幾項顯著的資料︰
en_text: Be advised that reports from Kor’shi command in close orbit are confirmed. The object that recently impacted the tropical coast of the Rhean Sea was indeed a crude form of transport employed by Ork invaders. Close observation has revealed several salient details:

tc_text: 這個物體似乎是一個挖空的自然小行星，或至少是以大量的鐵礦石建造出來的。雖然因為進入大氣層和撞擊而有許多疤痕，這個物體仍舊像一座巨大的石山，豎立在綠色海岸的沼澤中。這顯然是歐克蠻人所謂的「洛克」。
en_text: The object seems to have been a hollowed out natural asteroid or at the very least is built from a great deal of ferrous ores. Although scarred by entry into the atmosphere and by impact, the object remains a great stone mountain jutting from the marshes of the Green Coast. This is clearly what the Orks refer to as a “rok.”

tc_text: 當地的野生歐克蠻人一開始以警覺和敵意的態度對待撞擊事件，而且事實上巨大的撞擊直接摧毀了幾處聚落。近距離偵察發現在撞擊之後不久即發生大規模的戰鬥，可能是在洛克釋出其乘員之時，倖存的野生歐克蠻人對他們發動攻擊。
en_text: The local feral Ork population greeted the impact initially with alarm and aggression, and indeed the tremendous impact destroyed several settlements outright. Close reconnaissance reveals that a large battle occurred shortly after impact, presumably when the rok disgorged its passengers and they were set upon by the surviving feral Orks.

tc_text: 野生歐克人和新來的歐克人之間的衝突已經大致平息。洛克裡顯然住著一個強大的酋長（名字叫做軍閥戈古茲），他已經統治了這個地區裡的所有歐克蠻人。
en_text: Aggression between the feral and newcomer Orks has largely abated. The rok apparently housed a powerful chieftain (going by the name Warlord Gorgutz) who has imposed his authority over all Orks in the region.

tc_text: 這個戈古茲非常具侵略性，而且似乎意在征服。現在綠色海岸的歐克蠻人能量都專注於預備一場大規模的征戰。歐克蠻人當中最不原始的成員正忙著組合大量的載具，並生產大量的武器。
en_text: This Gorgutz is highly aggressive and seems intent on conquest. Orkish energies in the Green Coast are now focused on readying for a great conquest. The least primitive of the Orks are busy assembling great numbers of vehicles and producing huge stocks of weapons.

tc_text: 獨身獵人小隊會繼續觀察，並盡我們所能地發動破壞攻擊，但是要阻止這些野蠻人，需要極大規模的軍力。需要數個軍隊，包括許多能在近戰中面對歐克蠻人的克魯特小隊。
en_text: Team Lonehunter will continue to observe and do our best to strike crippling blows where we can, but stopping these barbarians requires a much larger force. Several cadres are called for, including many Kroot teams who can face the Orks in close combat.

tc_text: 迪摩斯半島
過去曾經是一處田園退修地，但是混沌的力量將迪摩斯扭曲並污染，現在它就像次元最黑暗的地區。他們打算把這種感染推及全克諾努斯。
en_text: Once an idyllic retreat, the powers of Chaos have twisted and tainted Deimos until it now resembles the darkest reaches of the Warp. They plan to spread this contagion across Kronus.

tc_text: 惡魔世界
次元的力量將迪摩斯轉變為克諾努斯地表上的明顯傷口。血泡從地裡冒出，破敗的能源在空氣中傳送，天空滿是黑色的瘟疫蒼蠅。
en_text: The powers of the Warp have transformed Deimos into an open sore on the surface of Kronus. Blood bubbles from the earth, ruinous energies pulse through the air, and the sky is shrouded in black clouds of plague flies.

tc_text: 摘錄「黑色傳承，第九卷」：
en_text: From the Ninth Book of Black Inheritance:

tc_text: 在任命之時，繼承者艾理法斯，黑暗使徒和完全混沌的真言持有者，返回克諾努斯。他對這個世界的旨意是消滅那些被欺騙的偽帝皇跟隨者，但是黑暗使徒早已自遠處觀察這個世界，直到這個光榮的夜晚。
en_text: In the appointed time, Eliphas the Inheritor, Dark Apostle and Bearer of the Word of Chaos Undivided, returned to the soil of the planet Kronus. His will had ever been with this world where he had shed the blood of the deluded followers of the False Emperor, but the Dark Apostle had watched over the world from afar until this glorious night.

tc_text: 一小群陰謀分子抵達迪摩斯半島南方遠端的黑色傳承第三神殿。他們搭乘一輛小的飛梭，從北方的嚴酷沙漠裡逃離沒有靈魂的死靈族之手。這些人的經驗破碎了理智的束縛，他們將信仰視為希望的指標。他們將他們的禱告轉向八角星，祈求為他們和他們的世界帶來救贖。
en_text: A small cabal of men arrived at the Third Temple of Black Succession in the far south of the Deimos Peninsula. They came aboard a small air vessel, having escaped from the rise of the soulless Necrons in the harsh desert to the north. Driven out of the shackles of reason by their experiences, these men clung to their faith as a beacon of hope. As is right and true, they turned their prayers to the eight-pointed star to bring them and their world salvation.

tc_text: 在那些人當中，有一個人名叫維吉利歐斯，特別虔誠。神殿的長老弗來維恩張開雙臂歡迎他。維吉利歐斯經常閱讀最神聖的文字「洛嘉書信」，因此知道必須發生的事情。在到達神殿後的第八個晚上，他叫醒他的同伴，要求他們與他一起前往神殿中心的大房間。維吉利歐斯一直誠實地帶領他們，因此這些可憐人跟隨他前往。
en_text: One among the men was named Virgilius and was especially faithful. He was greeted with open arms by the temple’s presbyter, Flavian. Virgilius read frequently from that most holy of texts, The Book of the Epistles of Lorgar, and so knew what must occur. On the eighth night of their visit to the temple, he woke his fellows and asked them to accompany him to the great chamber at the temple’s heart. Virgilius had led them true thus far and so these wretches followed him anew.

tc_text: 在那個房間裡，他們發現他們的救贖正在等候他們。根據我們最神聖的信仰所制定的，有八根鐵矛豎立在石地上。長老和他的執事也在房間裡等候，當眾人當中最不誠實的人因恐懼而崩潰並試圖逃走時，他們抓住他，把他刺死在第四個方位上的長矛上。在慘叫聲中，他發出第十五個咒詛，而維吉利歐斯和弗來維恩認為這是最吉利的預言。很快地，維吉利歐斯的另外六個同伴也被刺死在長矛上，他們的血流進神殿地板上的槽溝裡。
en_text: In the chamber, they found their salvation awaiting them. In the configuration of our most holy faith, eight iron pikes stood planted in the stonework. The presbyter and his deacons also awaited in the chamber and when the least true of the men succumbed to fear and attempted to flee, they did take him and place him on the pike at the fourth minor octant. In his screaming he issued the fifteenth curse, which Virgilius and Flavian took to be a most auspicious omen. Soon the other six of Virgilius’ companions had been positioned and their blood ran down the grooves in the temple floor.

tc_text: 弗來維恩轉向維吉利歐斯，準備考驗這個人的信仰是否會在最後一刻發生動搖。但是他不需要擔心，因為維吉利歐斯知道完全混沌的真理，也知道他必須做的事。他滿懷信心地走向第一方位上的主矛，並且踩著蹲伏在那裡的執事的肩膀，爬到矛的上面，讓矛深深刺入他的身體。當他的體重使他的身體落入長矛裡時，維吉利歐斯張開雙臂，要拿取最後一項物品；弗來維恩迅速將黑色刀交給他。
en_text: Flavian turned to Virgilius, ready to submit this man if his faith were to falter at the last instant. But he need not have worried, for Virgilius knew the truth of Chaos Undivided and what was required of him. He walked with confident strides to the pike at the first major octant, and stepping upon the shoulder of the prostrate deacon there, climbed upon it and allowed it to bite deep into his flesh. As his weight slid him down the pike, Virgilius extended his hand for the final element and Flavian was quick to provide him with the black blade.

tc_text: 維吉利歐斯以迅速的動作割開他的腹部，讓內臟落下。當生命離開他時，他看見次元之門在眾端點之間打開，並且看著繼承者艾理法斯走出來。
en_text: With a swift motion, Virgilius opened his abdomen to allow his entrails to fall. As the life left him, he saw the warp open between the points of the star and watched Eliphas the Inheritor step forth at last.

tc_text: 第九傳承於焉開始。
en_text: Thus did the Ninth Inheritance begin.

tc_text: 勝利海灣
曾經是克諾努斯的首都，在帝國守衛軍前來之前，鐵工海灣呈被遺棄狀態達數世紀之久。他們將它更名為勝利海灣，以紀念他們前來征服這顆星球。
en_text: Once the capital city of Kronus, Ironworks Bay stood abandoned and derelict for centuries before the Imperial Guard arrived. They have renamed the city Victory Bay in honor of their coming reconquest of the planet.

tc_text: 都市
勝利海灣本身的城市位於溫和帶的北端，冬季偏長，全年的其餘時間多半下雨。但是這個省的內地向南延伸，農田在此利用較溫和的夏季進行耕種。
en_text: The city of Victory Bay itself lies at the northern end of the temperate belt and is prone to long winters and rain much of the rest of the year. The provincial hinterland, however, stretches to the south where agrifarms take advantage of the milder summers.

tc_text: ++投擲在克諾努斯東北方主要城市裡的的傳單++
en_text: ++Propaganda Leaflet Dropped In Major Cities of Northeast Kronus++

tc_text: 今天是勝利的日子﹗
帝國的公民歡欣鼓舞！脫離外星人統治的日子即將到來﹗統治我們的帝皇已經派遣他勇敢的軍隊前來面對奴役克諾努斯的暴君和瘋狂的異教徒，並將我們的世界歸回到他的統治之下。
en_text: Citizens of the Imperium rejoice! Liberation from the yoke of alien domination is at hand! The Emperor who rules us all has sent his brave troops to face the tyrannical despots and mad heretics who have enslaved Kronus and return our world to His Grace.

tc_text: 來自鈦星帝國、從帝皇手中竊取克諾努斯的外星侵略者已經放棄鐵工海灣的城市，也就是你們富裕的首都。他們害怕神皇的威嚴，俯視城市的地獄風暴巨砲正是這種威嚴的代表。它來自帝皇自己的泰坦戰爭機器，現在再次落入帝皇之手。
en_text: The alien invaders from the Tau Empire who stole Kronus from the Imperium have abandoned and neglected the city of Ironworks Bay, your proper capital. They fear the might of the God-Emperor, represented so clearly by the great Hellstorm Cannon that watches over the city. Taken from one of the Emperor’s own great Titan war machines, it is now in Imperial hands once again.

tc_text: 為了紀念自由的第一擊，奉帝國守衛軍克諾努斯第一軍團的勇士的領袖、軍事總督亞歷山大之命，鐵工海灣更名為勝利海灣。
en_text: To mark this first blow for liberation, Ironworks Bay has become Victory Bay by order of Governor-Militant Alexander, leader of the brave soldiers of the Imperial Guard’s 1st Kronus regiment.

tc_text: 很快地，隨著解放兵團打擊外星人、異教徒，以及在這個美好世界上肆虐的叛徒，這個勝利會遍及全克諾努斯。
en_text: Soon this victory will spread across Kronus as the Liberators strike against the aliens, heretics and traitors who beset this fine world.

tc_text: 現在就為了那一天做準備！外星人統治的鎖鍊已經變弱，你們可以掙脫它！
en_text: Prepare for that day now! The chains of alien domination are weak and you can break them!

tc_text: 牢記戰事總督在到達克諾努斯時所說的話：
en_text: Take heart in the words of the Governor-Militant, spoken when he arrived on Kronus:

tc_text: 「看看你的週圍，看看這個曾經是大城之城的荒涼建築和廢棄道路。看見忽略的記號，以及這個世界偏離我們所愛之帝皇所設定之道路有多麼遙遠。我們在這裡，要撥正這個世界，我們的第一個步驟就要在這裡進行。敵人的失敗就從此時此地開始，因此我將這個重生的城市命名為勝利海灣。奉帝皇之名。」
en_text: “Look around you, at the skeletal buildings and the abandoned roads of this once-great city. See in the signs of neglect and just how far this world has strayed from the path set for it by our beloved Emperor. We are here to set this world aright and our first step shall occur right here. The defeat of our enemies begins here on this very day, and so I name this reborn city as Victory Bay. In the Emperor’s Name.”

tc_text: 崇敬皇帝。尊敬他的軍隊。贏得他的恩典。
en_text: Revere the Emperor. Honor His Troops. Earn His Grace.

tc_text: 今天就是勝利日
北汪迪恩
因其嚴酷的冬天和強悍的殖民者而聞名，北汪迪恩現在是修道院要塞的家鄉，也就是血鴉軍團的星際戰士開始對這個星球進行掃盪的起點。
en_text: Known for its harsh winters and hardy settlers, North Vandea is now home to the Castellum Incorruptus, a massive fortress from which the Space Marines of the Blood Ravens chapter launch their purge of the planet.

tc_text: 山地
冬天的冰雪吹向內地時，在北汪迪恩的海岸覆上冰冷的鹽。血鴉軍團在這個地區施行焦土政策，只留下光禿的岩石和冰。
en_text: The coast of North Vandea is battered by cold salt spray while winter snows lash inland. The Blood Ravens have practiced a scorched earth policy in the region, leaving little but barren rock and ice before them.

由於猖獗的異教和普遍的異星影響，血鴉軍團宣佈克諾努斯行星為禁入區。為了保護這個陷入黑暗的行星上可能剩餘的未腐敗神聖遺址，以及避免影響克諾努斯的惡勢力擴散，血鴉軍團的參事長和主智庫館長下令進行大規模的肅清活動。戴維恩．蘇勒隊長，第一、第二及第四連的指揮官，將率領這支十字軍。協助他的人有牧師麥可魯斯 和智庫館長安提亞斯。
en_text: Due to rampant heresy and overwhelming xeno influence, the Blood Ravens have declared the planet of Kronus to be mundis prohibitis. In order to protect what uncorrupted holy relics may remain on this benighted world, and to prevent any spread of the cancer gripping Kronus, the Chapter Master and Chief Librarian of the Blood Ravens has ordered that a great purge take place. Brother-Captain Davian Thule, commanding elements of the First, Second and Fourth Companies, shall lead this crusade. Standing at his side shall be Chaplain Mikelus and Librarian Anteas.

tc_text: 因此，在盧卡斯．亞歷山大將軍麾下的帝國防衛軍部隊，以及正前往該星球表面的部隊，都要立刻停止行動，並撤出該星球。此項命令乃根據帝皇於統治初期賜給星際戰士的權柄所發佈。
en_text: Therefore, the Imperial Guard forces serving under General Lukas Alexander and currently dispatched to the planet's surface, are hereby ordered to cease and desist at once, and to evacuate the system forthwith. This order comes under the authority granted to the Space Marines by the Emperor Himself at the dawn of His rule.

tc_text: 對抗血鴉軍團的人只能接受迅速而無情的死亡。
en_text: Those who stand against the Blood Ravens can expect only swift and merciless death.

tc_text: 榮耀歸於帝皇。

en_text: Armor: Marked with sigils of decay, this armor's entropic powers turn an enemy's mighty blows into mere pinpricks.

tc_text: 防止近戰攻擊； 大幅提高生命力。
en_text: Protects against melee attacks; greatly increases health.

tc_text: 損壞敵人士氣；提高混沌領主的生命力。
en_text: Damages enemy morale; increases Chaos Lord's health.

en_text: Shuriken Pistol: Firing mono-molecular plasti-crystal shards at fantastic velocities, this shuriken pistol brings death to the Craftworld's enemies.

tc_text: 取代基本型手槍。

tc_text: 需要手裡劍發射槍。
魔女之刃
魔女之刃︰ 一種強大的力量之矛，魔女之刃使得先知在戰鬥中成為致命的武力。
en_text: Witchblade: A mighty force spear, the Witchblade makes the Farseer a deadly force in melee combat.

tc_text: 取代標準動力之劍。
吟唱之矛
吟唱之矛︰這柄強大的武器具備兩柄用靈能力量充能的刀刃，能夠輕易切穿盔甲和身體。

tc_text: 需要魔女之刃
伊沙手套
伊沙手套︰以神靈族的收穫女神為名，這些手套傳送靈能能量，讓先知更快康復。
en_text: Gauntlets: Named for the Eldar harvest goddess, these gauntlets allow the Farseer to recover more quickly.

tc_text: 提高能力的充能速度及生命力
en_text: Increases ability recharge rate and health

tc_text: 見證符文

en_text: Runes of Witnessing: These runes guide the Farseer's vision, exposing hidden enemies and new sources of psychic power.

tc_text: 顯示滲入的敵人； 增加能力給比率再充電。
en_text: Reveals infiltrated enemies; increases ability recharge rate.

tc_text: 鬼魂頭盔
鬼魂頭盔︰這個頭盔的水晶靈能迴路讓先知的靈魂在次元中得到保護，使她能夠安全地接觸到更深的力量貯備。
en_text: Ghosthelm: Psychic circuitry masks the Farseer's spirit in the Warp allowing her to tap deeper reserves of power.

tc_text: 提高能力的充能速度及生命力
en_text: Increases ability recharge rate and health

tc_text: 怒骨盔甲

en_text: Armor: Large plates of wraithbone encase the Farseer, offering her increased protection without reducing her mobility.

tc_text: 大幅提高生命力。

保護符文︰這些古代符文創造出一個精神干擾的力場，使敵人攻擊失準。
en_text: Runes of Warding: These runes create a field of psychic interference, causing enemy attacks to go astray.

tc_text: 防止遠距攻擊；提高生命力。
en_text: Protects against ranged attacks; increases health.

tc_text: 古文氣息

en_text: Rune Aura: Powerful runes charged with psychic energy fill the air, healing the Farseer and her allies.

tc_text: 明顯提高先知和附近盟友的生命恢復速度。
en_text: Markedly increases regeneration of Farseer and nearby allies.

tc_text: 風暴箭
風暴箭︰每次攻擊都射出多隻穿甲箭矢，令對手遭受死亡攻擊。
en_text: Storm Bolter: Fires multiple armor-piercing bolter shots per attack, sending a hail of death at the opponent.

tc_text: 取代標準武器。
電漿手槍
電漿手槍︰發射超高溫電漿矢，燒穿盔甲和肉體。
en_text: Plasma Pistol: Fires a bolt of super-heated plasma, burning through armor and flesh alike.

tc_text: 需要風暴箭

en_text: Master-Crafted Power Claws: Forged by a great artisan, these claws surpass those issued more regularly in every way.

tc_text: 取代標準動力爪。
動力拳
動力拳︰流貫其中的能力加強其使用者的力量，使他能夠擊敗帝國的敵人。
en_text: Power Fists: Channeled energy magnifies the power fist wielder's strength, allowing him to crush the Imperium's foes.

tc_text: 需要精製動力爪
勝利飾帶
