en_text: Victory Sash: A mark of distinction awarded to senior officers, this red sash is a sign the regiment is led by a true hero of the Imperium.

tc_text: 提高所有帝國警衛軍小隊的士氣及整體的軍備速率。
en_text: Increases Morale of all Guardsmen squads and overall Requisition rate.

tc_text: 龜甲護脛
龜甲護脛︰這些強化的裝甲護脛提供很好的保護，而不犧牲機動性。
en_text: Carapace Greaves: These reinforced armored greaves grant excellent protection without sacrificing mobility.

tc_text: 提高移動速度和生命力。
瞄準光學鏡
瞄準光學鏡︰ 生物電子裝置讓帝國將軍得以看穿多道頻譜，提供準確的戰術資料。
en_text: Targeting Optics: Bionic augmentation allows the Imperial General to see across several spectrums and provides ready tactical data.

tc_text: 顯示滲透部隊，並提高遠距攻擊的傷害力
en_text: Reveals infiltrated units and increases damage of ranged attacks

tc_text: 龜甲肩甲
龜甲肩甲︰即使在戰鬥最激烈的時候，強化肩甲仍能保護穿戴者的安全。
en_text: Carapace Pauldrons: Reinforced armaplas shoulder guards keep the wearer safe even in the heat of battle.

tc_text: 防止遠距攻擊；提高生命力。
en_text: Protects against ranged attacks; increases health.

tc_text: 龜甲胸甲
龜甲胸甲︰多層胸甲保護所有的重要器官不致受傷。
en_text: Carapace Chest Plate: Layers of armaplas and ceramite protect all vital organs against incoming fire.

tc_text: 防止遠距攻擊；提高生命力。
en_text: Protects against ranged attacks; increases health.

衣服︰帝國總督的鑲金披風強調他的權力和地位，使他獲得額外的資源和軍隊。
en_text: Raiment: The gilded cape of an Imperial Governor emphasizes his authority and status, making additional resources and troops available.

tc_text: 提高軍隊和載具上限；允許卡舍津護衛加入指揮小隊。
en_text: Adds Squad and Vehicle Cap; allows Kasrkin Bodyguard in Command Squad.

tc_text: 自製槍
自製槍︰機械小子們發明這種有兩個槍管的好槍，可以打倒人類和其他種族。 Mek Boyz有激動槍殺人類 和其餘他們的有兩個桶的這好的shoota。
en_text: Kustom Shoota: Da Mek Boyz have worked up this nice shoota with two barrels to gun down the humies and the rest of them.

tc_text: 替換標準槍。
巨型爆裂
巨型爆裂︰惡霸技師常用這種槍，但這不表示老大不能用它來燒死敵人。
en_text: Mega Blasta: Da Big Mek uses dis gun lots, but that don't mean da Boss can't use it to fry up his enemies too.

tc_text: 需要自製槍
大爪
大爪︰如果以前你認為你的爪很好砍人，你應該試試這個自製的東西！
en_text: Bigga Claw: If you thought yer claw was chopping 'em up before, just you try this kustom job!

tc_text: 替換標準爪。
巨爪
巨爪︰哈！有什麼能比用大爪撕裂他們更好？就是噴火的爪！
en_text: Mega Claw: Hah! What's better than a big claw to chop 'em up? A big claw with fire runnin' through it!

tc_text: 需要大爪
紅鐵岩
紅鐵岩︰用時髦的新鐵岩，讓你看起來閃亮無比，還可以擊倒敵人。
en_text: Red Iron Gob: Get a fancy new Iron Gob to make ya look flash and let ya chomp down on the humies.

tc_text: 增加近戰傷害和生命力。
速行腿

en_text: Fasta Legz: Red ones go fasta! These new legz will let ya catch up with any gits getting away.

tc_text: 提高速度和生命力。
大角
大角︰戴上更龐大的野獸的角，用它們來撕裂敵人！
en_text: Big Horns: Wear da horns of an even bigga beast and use 'em to tear the humies apart!

tc_text: 增加近戰傷害和生命力。
巨型重盔甲
巨型重盔甲︰惡霸技師幫你造出最好的盔甲，因為你是最好的歐克蠻人！
en_text: Mega 'Eavy Armor: Da Big Meks have made ya that best armor, cause yer the best Ork!

tc_text: 大幅提高生命力。
頭骨

en_text: Skullz: Show off yer 'ead 'unting with the skullz of yer enemies on a couple nice pointy sticks!

tc_text: 帕翁尼斯的戰鬥
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在暗黑聖戰的大部份戰鬥中，大型艦隊盤旋於克諾努斯戰場的高空，運用其火力壓制長途飛行。無論是帝國防衛軍還是異教徒，都必須浴血逐步推進。在有大型艦隊於整個星系彼此開火的情況下，這似乎對在地面上的指揮來說是一個不可改變的事實。
en_text: For much of the Dark Crusade, great fleets plied the orbital lanes above the battlefields of Kronus, using their firepower to ground long range flights. Guardsman and heretic alike had to fight meter by bloody meter. With great battlefleets exchanging fire across the system, it seemed an immutable fact of life for commanders on the ground.

tc_text: 帕翁尼斯的戰鬥完全改變這個局面。這個空港具備一個古代帝國工研所的追蹤系統，結合了鈦星人空氣級的異星技術。這個系統有足夠的敏銳度，可以繪製航線以避開軌道火力，因此可以深入敵境進行攻擊。
en_text: All this changed with the Battle of Pavonis. This space port featured an ancient Adeptus Mechanicus tracking system merged with the alien technologies of the Tau Air Caste. This system was sensitive enough to plot courses that avoided orbital fire, making strikes deep into enemy territory possible.

tc_text: 一名機械主教發現這個科技奇蹟，留下他的僕役來詳細研究它。無論是那一個種族能夠找到這些生化僕人，就能獲得系統的控制權，並發動對克諾努斯的攻擊。
en_text: A Tech-Priest had discovered this technological marvel and left his servitors to examine it in detail. Whichever force was able to recover these bionic servants would gain control of the station and be able to launch strikes attacks Kronus.

tc_text: 在暗黑聖戰的大部份戰鬥中，大型艦隊盤旋於克諾努斯戰場的高空，運用其火力壓制長途飛行。無論是帝國防衛軍還是異教徒，都必須浴血逐步推進。在有大型艦隊於整個星系彼此開火的情況下，這似乎對在地面上的指揮來說是一個不可改變的事實。帕翁尼斯的戰鬥完全改變這個局面。這個空港具備一個古代帝國工研所的追蹤系統，結合了鈦星人空氣級的異星技術。這個系統有足夠的敏銳度，可以繪製航線以避開軌道火力，因此可以深入敵境進行攻擊。一名機械主教發現這個科技奇蹟，留下他的僕役來詳細研究它。無論是那一個種族能夠找到這些生化僕人，就能獲得系統的控制權，並發動對克諾努斯的攻擊。
en_text: For much of the Dark Crusade, great fleets plied the orbital lanes above the battlefields of Kronus, using their firepower to ground long range flights. Guardsman and heretic alike had to fight meter by bloody meter. With great battlefleets exchanging fire across the skies, trench warfare seemed an immutable fact of life for commanders on the ground. All this changed with the Battle of Pavonis. This space port featured an ancient Adeptus Mechanicus tracking system merged with the alien technologies of the Tau Air Caste. This system was sensitive enough to plot courses that avoided orbital fire, making strikes deep into enemy territory possible. A Techpriest had discovered this technological marvel and left his servitors to examine it in detail. Whichever force was able to recover these bionic servants would gain control of the station and be able to launch strikes across Kronus.

tc_text: 敵人已經取得一個僕役。我們不能讓更多僕役落入他們手中。
en_text: The enemy has captured one of the Servitors. We must not let more fall into their hands.

tc_text: 解放者﹗敵人幾乎已經取得軌道追蹤系統的存取碼了！我們必須找到那些僕役﹗
en_text: Liberators! The enemy has almost retrieved the access codes for the orbital tracking system! We must find those Servitors!

tc_text: 勝利是我們的，弟兄們﹗
那是人類的僕役之一！把他們帶到營地去！
en_text: Dats one of dem humie Servitors! Get 'im back to da camp!

tc_text: 我們把一個僕役送到營地，惡霸技師正在看管他們。但是我們需要更多僕役。
en_text: We gots a Servitor 'ere at da camp an' da Mek Boyz iz lookin' at 'im. But we needs some more.

tc_text: 喂！你們在幹什麼？敵人抓到一個僕役了！
en_text: Oy! Wot ya doin' ya grots?! Da enemy's got one of me Servitors!

tc_text: 這個不是吼～作戰的方式！敵人幾乎找到所有的僕役了。把他們搶回來！
en_text: Dis ain't no way ta fight a Waaagh! da enemy's got almost all dem Servitors. Get 'em back!

tc_text: 哈！我們得到需要的東西了。我們的飛行炸彈可以高飛了！
en_text: Hah! We gots all we need, boyz. Our fightabombaz iz gonna be flying high now!

tc_text: 那個人類是肉體和金屬的粗糙組合，但是它含有珍貴的訊息。帶它到浮石巨塔。
en_text: That human is a crude melding of flesh and metal, but it contains valuable information. Bring it to the Monolith.

tc_text: 聖甲蟲正在分析那個人類混種，但是我們需要更多這種人類。
en_text: The scarabs are analyzing the human hybrid, but we require more of them.

tc_text: 活人已經取得一個僕役。 不要讓他們享受他們的小小勝利。
en_text: The living have recovered a Servitor. Do not let them savor their petty victory.

tc_text: 我們的敵人已經取得大多數僕役。我們的動作必須更迅速。
en_text: Our enemies have recovered most of the Servitors. We must gather more quickly.

tc_text: 我們取得需要的全部僕役了。我們的肅清作戰可以不受影響地繼續進行。
en_text: We have all we need. Our purge continues unabated.

tc_text: 機械主教的僕役之一。 把它帶到我們的要塞。
en_text: One of the Techpriests Servitors. Bring it to our stronghold.

tc_text: 做得好，弟兄們。 我們已經安全地取得一個僕役。但是，我們需要更多僕役，才能讓這個空港恢復運作。
en_text: Well done, brothers. We have safely recovered a Servitor. We will need more to bring the space port back online.

tc_text: 弟兄們，注意。敵人也在收集僕役。
en_text: Take heed, brothers. The enemy is gathering Servitors as well.

tc_text: 敵人就要勝利了，弟兄們。我們必須成功﹗這是帝皇的旨意﹗
en_text: The enemy is on the verge of victory, brothers. We must succeed here! The Emperor wills it!

tc_text: 帝皇與我們同在，弟兄們﹗勝利是我們的﹗
en_text: The Emperor is with us, brothers! Victory is ours!

tc_text: 這是帝國的僕役之一。送它回總部。
en_text: There is one of the Imperium Servitors. Return it to the headquarters.

tc_text: 已經有一個僕役回到我們的總部，沙斯拉。我們必須找回更多個。
en_text: A Servitor has made it to our headquarters, Shas'la. We must recover more.

tc_text: 敵人也在找這些僕役。我們必須迅速行動。
en_text: The enemy gathers these Servitors as well. We must act quickly.

tc_text: 敵人已經找回很多僕役。趁還來得及的時候，進攻！
en_text: The enemy has recovered many Servitors. Strike before it is too late!

tc_text: 就像鈦星一樣，我們成功了。空港是我們的。
en_text: Like Tau, we have prospered. The space port is ours.

tc_text: 混沌星際戰士
你是「繼承者」艾理法斯，真言持有者軍團的黑暗使徒。你效忠次元的力量，前來依照你主人的扭曲形象重新塑造克諾努斯。
en_text: You are Eliphas the Inheritor, Black Apostle of the Word Bearer legion. You serve the eldritch powers of the Warp and have come to remake Kronus in the twisted image of your masters.

tc_text: 驅策你的混沌星際戰士和惡魔僕人向敵人攻擊，使他們看到自己所做所為都是徒勞的。混沌是不能抗拒的。
en_text: Drive your Chaos Space Marines and daemonic servants toward the enemy to make them see the futility of their ways. Chaos cannot be denied.

tc_text: 神靈族
你是烏斯維的先知塔迪兒。 你已經預見異種死靈族的歸回。現在他們已經在克諾努斯上醒來，必須加以阻止。
en_text: You are Farseer Taldeer of Ulthwé. You have foreseen the return of the genocidal Necrons. Now, they have awoken on Kronus and must be stopped.

tc_text: 你的戰士是令銀河中最偉大、也最可怕的種族的最新一代。使用他們匿蹤和速度的天賦，你的敵人將在你面前倒下。
en_text: Your warriors are among the last generations of the greatest and most terrible race to grace the galaxy. Use their gifts of stealth and speed, and your enemies will fall before you.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍
你是盧卡斯．亞歷山大，最新獲派任為行星戰事總督和克諾努斯第一軍團—「解放者」的指揮官。你的帝國防衛軍和強大的裝甲部隊是從人類帝國中召募而來，已經準備發動攻擊。
en_text: You are Lukas Alexander, newly declared planetary Governor-Militant and commander of the 1st Kronus Regiment—the Liberators. Recruited from across the Imperium of Man, your massed Guardsmen and mighty armored columns are ready to strike.

tc_text: 克諾努斯受外星人統治太久了。你將為不朽的神帝將它奪回。
en_text: Kronus has languished under alien dominion for too long. You will reclaim it for the Immortal God Emperor.

tc_text: 死靈族
你是活人稱為克諾努斯的墳墓世界的死靈領主。很久以前，你在全銀河系執行光榮的滅絕。現在，活人感染了這個世界，你會把它清除淨盡。
en_text: You are the Necron Lord of the tomb-world the living call Kronus. Eons ago you cut a swath of glorious extermination through the galaxy. Now, the living infect this world anew, and you will wipe it clean.

tc_text: 喚起你的浮石巨塔，讓你的不死士兵向前邁進。你的受害者的墳墓正等著被填滿。
en_text: Raise your monoliths and march your deathless soldiers forward. The graves of your victims wait to be filled.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人
你是軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲，這顆行星是你的吼～軍團的另一個獎勵﹗人類和死靈族和混沌小子正在這個世界大戰，但是沒有人比歐克蠻人更堅強或更殘忍，也沒有歐克蠻人比你更堅強或更殘忍。
en_text: You are Warlord Gorgutz 'Ead 'Unter and this planet is another prize for your Waaagh! Humies and Necrons and Chaos boyz are fighting over this world, but no one is tougher or meaner than an Ork, and no Ork is tougher or meaner than you.

tc_text: 召喚你的小子們，把其他人全部踩在你的靴子下。
en_text: Call up your hundreds of boyz and crush all the others under your boots.

tc_text: 星際戰士
你是戴維恩．蘇勒隊長，指揮奉派到克諾努斯的三個血鴉連隊。這個到處都有外星人的星球上有許多黑暗的祕密和神聖的遺址，你必須保護它們。
en_text: You are Brother-Captain Davian Thule, commanding the three Blood Raven companies sent to Kronus. Dark secrets and holy relics lurk on this alien-infested planet and you must protect them.

tc_text: 克諾努斯上滿是敵人，星際戰士將把他們清除掉。沒有人能在戰鬥過程中對抗你的弟兄們，或是擊破他們那不可征服的意志。
en_text: Kronus seethes with enemies and the Space Marines will purge it clean. None can match your brothers in battle or break their indomitable will.

tc_text: 鈦星帝國
你是沙索．凱斯，鈦星軍隊在克諾努斯上的指揮官。當其它人為了貪婪、驕傲或者征服而戰鬥時，你為了更大的良善而戰鬥。
en_text: You are Shas'o Kais, military commander of Tau forces on Kronus. While others fight for greed, pride or conquest, you fight for the Greater Good.

tc_text: 從高科技戰鬥機甲到可怕的輔助兵器，你的軍隊準備為鈦星帝國奪回克諾努斯。乙太導師席歐雷斯已經宣佈你必須擊退那些入侵者。你不會失敗。
en_text: From high-tech battlesuits to fearsome auxiliaries, your forces stand ready to reclaim Kronus for the Tau Empire. Ethereal Shi'ores has declared that you must push back the invaders. You will not fail.

暗黑聖戰戰役
歡迎光臨「破曉之戰：暗黑聖戰」的單玩者戰役。這些教學視窗將帶領你完成前兩回合遊戲，介紹這個全新戰役模式的重要特色。
en_text: Welcome to the single-player campaign of Dawn of War: Dark Crusade. These tutorial windows will guide you through the first two turns of play and introduce key features of this all-new campaign mode.

tc_text: 你的目標是征服克諾努斯星。這個世界的大陸被分為二十五個不同的行省。你的征服行動將逐省進行。
en_text: Your goal is to conquer the Planet Kronus. This world's inhabited continent is divided into twenty-five different provinces. Your conquest of the planet will happen one province at a time.

tc_text: 戰役地圖是你在指揮部隊的戰略行動時的主要界面。個別的戰役則在小規模的戰役地圖上進行。
en_text: The campaign map is your major interface for directing your troops' strategic moves. Individual battles are fought on the smaller-scaled battle map.

tc_text: 繼續
你的要塞
這個行省是你的要塞，或家鄉。你從這裡發動對克諾努斯的征服行動。如果你的要塞被人征服，你就會被逐出克諾努斯，戰役亦告失敗。
en_text: This province is your stronghold, or home province. It is from here that you are launching your conquest of Kronus. If your stronghold is ever conquered, you will be pushed from Kronus and lose the campaign.

tc_text: 由於這是第一回合，因此這是你惟一控制的行省。
en_text: Since this is the first turn, this is the only province you currently control.

tc_text: 繼續
敵方陣營各自擁有自己的要塞，由戰役地圖上的旗幟標示。要贏得戰役，奪取克諾努斯，你必須征服這六個防禦堅強的行省。
en_text: The enemy factions each have their own strongholds, identified by banners on the campaign map. To win the campaign and make Kronus yours, you must conquer all six of these heavily defended provinces.

tc_text: 軍隊
指揮官的圖片指出你的主力軍隊目前的位置。你只能攻擊主力軍隊所在行省的鄰接行省，因此軍隊在地圖上的位置決定了你的選擇。
en_text: The figure of your commander indicates the current position of your main army. You can only attack a province that borders the province where your army is, so its position on the map defines your options.

tc_text: 敵方陣營各自擁有自己的軍隊，也只能攻擊鄰接的省份。但是你的敵人之一控制了帕翁尼斯省的一個太空港。他可以攻擊地圖上的任一地區。
en_text: The enemy factions each have armies of their own and also can only attack adjacent provinces. One of your enemies, however, controls a space port in the Pavonis province. He can attack all over the map.

tc_text: 繼續
移動和攻擊
這些箭頭顯示你的軍隊在這個回合中可以移動或攻擊的地方。紅色箭頭表示攻入敵人的行省。綠色箭頭表示移進友方行省。
en_text: These arrows show you where your army can move or attack this turn. Red arrows indicate attacks into enemy provinces. Green arrows indicate moves into friendly provinces.

tc_text: 因為這是你的第一回合，而且你只控制自己的行省，因此你必須攻擊敵人的行省。
en_text: Since this is your first turn, and you only control your stronghold, you must attack an enemy province.

tc_text: 要移進或攻擊一個行省，請按滑鼠左鍵選擇該行省，然後點選右側面板中的攻擊或移動按鈕。我們應該從攻擊敵人行省開始。選擇你要攻擊的行省，再點選攻擊按鈕。
en_text: To move to or attack a province, left-click to select that province and then click on the Attack or Move button in the right panel. We should begin by attacking an enemy province. Select the province you want to attack and click the Attack button.

tc_text: 在行省上按滑鼠左鍵都會叫出這些箭頭（除非你在這個回合中不能再移動）。
en_text: Left-clicking on a province always brings up these arrows (unless you have no more moves left this turn).

en_text: This screen shows you the forces you are leading into an attack and allows you to return to the campaign map if you decide you want to attack later.

tc_text: 因為這是你的第一次攻擊，因此大部份選項都不能選擇。
en_text: Since this is your first attack, most options aren't yet available.

tc_text: 等你準備要攻擊時，只管點選攻擊按鈕。這樣會讓你進入戰役地圖，在遊戲中面對敵人。
en_text: When you're ready to attack, just click on the Attack button. This will take you to the battle map, where you will face enemies in a game of Dawn of War.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
戰爭裝備畫面
當你征服越來越多省時，你的指揮官就會獲得特殊裝備。這個裝備稱為戰爭裝備。
en_text: As you conquer more and more provinces, you'll be awarded pieces of special equipment for your commander. This equipment is called wargear.

tc_text: 你不會獲得特定的某一件戰爭裝備；在每次獎賞時，你必須從這個畫面的列表中選擇一項。（注意，你可能必須先拿到某些戰爭裝備，才能解開其它更具威力的版本。）
en_text: You will never be awarded a specific piece of wargear. Instead, for each award, you get to choose one piece from the list on this screen. (Note that you may have to get some pieces of wargear to unlock other, more powerful versions.)

tc_text: 確定
繼續
勝利和報酬
恭喜！你征服了第一個行省。這場勝利給你數項獎賞，包括一件戰爭裝備，以及該行省提供的加成。
en_text: Congratulations! You have conquered your first province. This victory has given you several rewards, including a piece of wargear and the bonus from the province.

tc_text: 地圖上的每個行省都有一項特殊加成。當你選擇該行省時，這項加成顯示在右側面板中。
en_text: Every province on the map has a special bonus. This bonus is displayed in the right-hand panel when you select the province.

tc_text: 有些行省讓你有能力訓練一個特殊部隊，作為指揮官的榮譽護衛。在訓練完畢後，這些部隊會隨著你的指揮官進入戰役的初始階段。你可以在指揮官畫面或攻擊畫面中訓練這些部隊（如果他們在戰役中被毀，也可以再度訓練）。
en_text: Some provinces give you the ability to train a special unit for your commander's honor guard. Once trained, these units accompany your commander into the initial stages of battle. You can train these units (or retrain them if they are destroyed in battle) from the Commander Screen or the Attack Screen.

tc_text: 其它行省給你特殊能力，例如艾瑞惡地讓你每回合能夠攻擊兩次。
en_text: Other provinces give you special abilities, like the Eres Badlands which gives you the ability to attack twice per turn.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
征服行省
這是你剛剛征服的行省。注意，它已經改變為你的顏色，現在你的軍隊在這裡。每當你征服一個行省時，你的軍隊就會移到該省。
en_text: This is the province you've just conquered. Notice that it has changed to your color and that your army is now here. Whenever you conquer a province, your army moves to that province.

tc_text: 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。
en_text: You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn, new provinces will be available for you to attack.

tc_text: 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
失敗
敵人擊退你對該行省的攻擊。
en_text: The enemy repelled your attack on the province.

tc_text: 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。
en_text: You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn you will be able to attack again and avenge yourself.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
敵人的回合
每一個敵方陣營會輪流行動。和你一樣，他們各自擁有自己的要塞和軍隊。他們會移動自己的軍隊，或是攻擊及增援其行省。
en_text: Each of the enemy factions will now act in turn. Like you, they each have their own strongholds and armies. They will each move their armies or attack and reinforce their provinces in turn.

tc_text: 留意敵人的軍隊在什麼地方。軍隊會增援鄰近遭受攻擊的友軍，用額外的軍隊強化防禦。
en_text: Pay attention to where your enemies' armies are. Armies will reinforce nearby friendly provinces under attack, bolstering the defense with additional troops.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
保護你的行省
你的行省遭受攻擊。
en_text: One of your provinces is under attack.

tc_text: 你可以選擇在戰役地圖上進行戰鬥，或是自動計算戰役結果。但是自動計算結果可能很危險，因為它是根據行省和攻擊武力的相對力量來計算。如果你自己進行戰鬥，永遠都有較佳的獲勝機會。也有一些戰爭裝備只能透過在戰役地圖上進行防禦戰才能獲得，因此你應該好好考慮是否要使用自動計算結果。
en_text: You can choose to fight on the battle map or to auto-resolve this battle. Auto-resolving can be dangerous, however, since it depends on the relative strength of your province and the attacker's forces. You always have a better chance of winning if you fight the battle yourself. There are also pieces of wargear that can only be earned by fighting defensive battles on the battle map, so you should think carefully before auto-resolving.

tc_text: 如果你選擇戰鬥，而且你的軍隊位於該行省或鄰近的行省中，你的指揮官和其榮譽護衛就會加入防禦。如果不是，你就必須運用駐紮在該行省中的軍隊進行戰鬥。
en_text: If you choose to fight and your army is on the province or one that neighbors it, your commander and his honor guard will join the defense. If not, you'll have to make do with whatever forces are garrisoned there.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
行星軍備
現在又輪到你行動了。
en_text: It is now your turn to act again.

tc_text: 你會注意到，你從所控制的行省處獲得行星軍備。每個行省在每回合都會生產行星軍備。
en_text: You'll notice that you have gained Planetary Requisition from the provinces you control. Each province produces Planetary Requisition every turn.

tc_text: 你使用行星軍備來強化行省，將部隊駐紮在該處，以及訓練榮譽護衛部隊。
en_text: You use Planetary Requisition to reinforce your provinces by stationing troops there and to train honor guard units.

tc_text: 要強化一個行省，只需在你擁有的行省上按滑鼠左鍵，再點選右側面板中的「增援」按鈕即可。
en_text: To reinforce a province, simply left-click on a province you own and then click on the Reinforce button in the right-hand panel.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
強化行省
這個畫面允許你將部隊駐紮在行省中。當你抵抗敵人侵略時，就可以運用這些部隊。
en_text: This screen allows you to garrison troops in a province. These troops will be ready when you fight to defend this province from enemy attacks.

tc_text: 將部隊駐紮在行省中，需要花費行星軍備。可使用的部隊顯示在面板上。
en_text: Stationing troops in a province costs you Planetary Requisition. The available units are on the panel.

tc_text: 以後你可以召回這些部隊（如果該行省不再有危險）。召回部隊可以讓你獲得駐紮他們時所使用之行星軍備的半數。
en_text: Later, you can recall these troops (if the province is no longer at risk). Recalling a unit will give you back half the Planetary Requisition you spent to station it in the first place.

tc_text: 小心，當你接受這個畫面中的變動時，所有的購買行動都不能反悔。
en_text: Be careful. All your purchases will be final once you accept the changes on this screen.

tc_text: 繼續
指揮官畫面
這個畫面讓你一眼即可明白征服克諾努斯星的進度。其中包括征戰的總數、你的指揮官的統計數據、你的榮譽護衛等等。
en_text: This screen provides you with a snapshot of your progress in conquering the Planet Kronus. It includes a running tally of your conquests, your commander's statistics, your honor guard and more.

tc_text: 如果你還沒有訓練榮譽護衛（或是在戰役中失去），可以在這個畫面中進行訓練。點選其圖示即可。
en_text: If you haven't yet trained an honor guard unit (or you've lost one in battle), you can train it on this screen by simply clicking on its icon.

tc_text: 你也可以在這裡進入戰爭裝備畫面。
en_text: You can also access the Wargear Screen from here.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
戰勝一個敵人
恭喜。你剛剛征服了一個敵對種族的要塞。這場勝利結束了該種族征服此星球的野心。如果你能夠征服其餘的五個敵方要塞，就可贏得遊戲。
en_text: Congratulations. You have just conquered an enemy race's stronghold. This victory ends that race's attempt to take the planet. If you can conquer the five remaining enemy strongholds, you will win the game.

tc_text: 被打敗的種族可能還擁有幾個行省，但是沒有了要塞，他們就沒有軍隊，也沒有能力攻擊。
en_text: There may still be some provinces held by the defeated race, but without a stronghold they no longer have an army or the ability to attack.

tc_text: 你可以掃平他們殘餘的行省，獲得相關的加成；你也可以改變目標。
en_text: You can mop up their remaining provinces to gain the associated bonuses, or you can move on to other targets.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
狂怒
你征服了艾瑞惡地，獲得狂怒特殊能力。
en_text: You have conquered the Eres Badlands and gained the Fury special ability.

tc_text: 狂怒讓你在一回合中行動兩次，而不是一次。就和以前一樣，你可以使用每個回合來移動軍隊到你所控制的鄰接行省，或是攻擊鄰接的敵方行省。
en_text: Fury gives you two full moves per turn, instead of just one. Just like before, you can use each one to move your army to a neighboring province you control or to attack a neighboring enemy province.

tc_text: 這個能力立刻生效，因此你可以在這個回合中發動第二次攻擊，或是將你的軍隊從艾瑞惡地移走，再結束你的回合。
en_text: This ability is available right away so you can attack a second time this turn or move your army from the Eres Badlands before ending your turn.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
壁壘
你已經征服阿裡爾高地並且獲得壁壘特別的能力。
en_text: You have conquered the Ariel Highlands and gained the Bulwark special ability.

tc_text: 壁壘讓你以較低廉的代價增援行省。費用節省會自動發生作用。
en_text: Bulwark makes it cheaper for you to reinforce your provinces. This cost savings is applied automatically.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
前進基地
你征服了海必里恩山峰，並且獲得前進基地特殊能力。
en_text: You have conquered the Hyperion Peaks and gained the Forward Base special ability.

tc_text: 現在當你攻擊一個行省時，你可以在攻擊畫面中購買建築。每棟建築都要花費行星軍備，並在你到達戰役地圖時立即出現在地圖上。
en_text: When you attack a province, you will now be able to purchase structures from the Attack Screen. Each structure costs Planetary Requisition and appears immediately when you arrive on the battle map.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
空港
你征服了帕翁尼斯，獲得空港特殊能力。
en_text: You have conquered Pavonis and gained the Space Port special ability.

tc_text: 空港允許你更加自由地在戰役地圖上移動軍隊。你不再只能移入或攻擊鄰近的行省，而是可以移入或攻擊地圖上的大部份行省。
en_text: The Space Port allows you to move your army around the campaign map much more freely. Instead of moving to or attacking only adjacent provinces, you can move to or attack almost any province on the map.

tc_text: 但是空港不允許你攻擊遠方的要塞。要攻擊敵人的要塞，你仍然必須從鄰接的行省發動攻擊。
en_text: The Space Port does not allow you to attack a distant stronghold, however. To attack an enemy stronghold, you still have to do so from a neighboring province.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
工業生產
你征服了汪迪恩海岸，並獲得工業生產特殊能力。
en_text: You have conquered the Vandean Coast and gained the Industrial Production special ability.

tc_text: 當你在戰役地圖上戰鬥時，一開始就會獲得額外的軍備資源，讓你更快速生產部隊及建築。
en_text: When you fight on the battle map, you will start with additional Requisition, allowing you to produce units and structures more quickly.

tc_text: 當你在戰役地圖上戰鬥時，一開始就會獲得額外的電力資源，讓你更快速生產部隊及建築。
en_text: When you fight on the battle map, you will start with additional Power, allowing you to produce units and structures more quickly.

tc_text: 確定
繼續
增加人力
你征服了艾希莉亞森林，並獲得增加人力特殊能力。
en_text: You have conquered the Aceria Forests and gained the Increased Manpower special ability.

tc_text: 當你在戰役地圖上戰鬥時，一開始就會獲得較大的部隊上限及載具上限，讓你生產更大規模的軍隊。
en_text: When you fight on the battle map, you will start with an increased Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap, allowing you to field a larger force.

引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 雖然一度是繁榮的工業中心，但是在暗黑聖戰開始以時，汪迪恩海岸已經廢棄不用。城市裡的一些工廠仍然在運作，但是其它巨大的地下精煉廠在海岸的沙地下閒置；許早以前就被該星球的鈦星人視為不必要而加以廢棄。
en_text: Once a thriving industrial center, by the beginning of the Dark Crusade, the Vandean Coast had fallen into disuse. Some factories in the cities were still operational, but other great underground refineries languished under the sands of the coast, long-since abandoned as unnecessary by the planet's Tau masters.

tc_text: 隨著聖戰的進行，這些古老的工廠突然變得非常有價值。交戰的陣營可以透過攻佔汪迪恩海岸重新啟動精煉廠休眠中的機器靈魂，以保證其軍隊補給不斷。汪迪恩發生數週的激烈戰鬥，而工人則將大量的電力輸入巨大的電容器中，以啟動長久未曾使用的工廠。
en_text: As the Crusade dragged on, however, these ancient factories suddenly became very valuable. The warring factions could ensure their armies' supplies by taking the Vandean Coast and waking the refineries' dormant machine spirits. Weeks of fighting raged in Vandea, while workers channeled massive amounts of power into great capacitors to power-up the long-disused factories.

tc_text: 控制這個海岸的人將在接下來的聖戰中享有更多的優勢。有了這樣強大的生產設備，戰場指揮官可以征用比敵人更多的武器。
en_text: Whoever gained control of the coast would enjoy a powerful advantage for the rest of the crusade. With such potent manufacturing facilities, field commanders could requisition more weapons than their foes.

tc_text: 雖然一度是繁榮的工業中心，但是在暗黑聖戰開始以時，汪迪恩海岸已經廢棄不用。城市裡的一些工廠仍然在運作，但是其它巨大的地下精煉廠在海岸的沙地下閒置；許早以前就被該星球的鈦星人視為不必要而加以廢棄。但是隨著聖戰的進行，這些古老的工廠突然變得非常有價值。交戰的陣營可以透過攻佔汪迪恩海岸並重新啟動精煉廠休眠中的機器靈魂，以保證其的軍隊的補給不斷。汪迪恩發生數週的激烈戰鬥，而工人則將大量的電力輸入巨大的電容器中，以啟動長久未曾使用的工廠。控制這個海岸的人將在接下來的聖戰中享有強有力的優勢。有了這樣強大的生產設備，戰場指揮官可以征用比其敵人更多的武器。
en_text: Once a thriving industrial center, by the beginning of the Dark Crusade, the Vandean Coast had fallen into disuse. Some factories in the cities were still operational, but other great underground refineries languished under the sands of the coast, long-since abandoned as unnecessary by the planet's Tau masters. As the Crusade dragged on, however, these ancient factories suddenly became very valuable. The warring factions could ensure their armies' supplies by taking the Vandean Coast and waking the refineries' dormant machine spirits. Weeks of fighting raged in Vandea, while workers channeled massive amounts of power into great capacitors to power-up the long-disused factories. Whoever gained control of the coast would enjoy a powerful advantage for the rest of the crusade. With such potent manufacturing facilities, field commanders could requisition more weapons than their foes.
