艾理法斯的返回
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 混沌的能力在克諾努斯南部海岸曾是樂土的迪摩斯半島上蓬勃發展，把它轉變成一塊破碎的地獄之境。在異教的邪教頭目召喚之下，黑色使徒「繼承者」艾理法斯從次元中出現，率領真言持有者混沌軍團前來。
en_text: The powers of Chaos manifested in the once-pleasant Deimos Peninsula on the southern coast of Kronus, transforming it into a blasted hellscape. Summoned by heretical cultists, the Black Apostle Eliphas the Inheritor emerged from the Warp leading a whole company of the Word Bearer Chaos Legion.

tc_text: 這些異教的星際戰士曾經來過克諾努斯，在赫魯斯異教的黑暗時代與他們忠實的弟兄們對抗。當時艾理法斯只不過是個年輕的英雄，但是再度現身時已經是一個可怕的混沌領主，準備為全銀河帶來毀滅。暗黑聖戰將是他的實力證明之戰。透過擊敗這顆行星上的許多競爭勢力，他意圖贏取他所敬拜的黑暗諸神的垂顧。
en_text: These heretical Space Marines had been to Kronus before, fighting against their loyal brothers during the dark days of the Horus Heresy. Eliphas had been but a young Champion then, but returned a terrible Chaos Lord, ready to bring ruin to the Galaxy at large. The Dark Crusade would be his proving ground. By defeating the many powers vying for the planet, he sought to gain favor with the dark gods he worshipped.

tc_text: 除非能夠將他們阻擋在那裡，否則真言持有者將攻擊到帝國深處。
en_text: Unless they could be stopped then and there, the Word Bearers would strike deeper into the Imperium.

tc_text: 為了極端王子
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 工藝世界烏斯維的神靈族來到克諾努斯追求其異星理想，但是最後沒有任何成就，只為混沌領主「繼承者」艾理法斯灌注了更多力量。儘管女巫塔迪兒利用歐克蠻人，甚至運用一支敵對的混沌秘教，她仍然無法抵抗艾理法斯的軍隊；艾理法斯切斷她與其船艦的聯繫，使她的人民面對最可怕的命運。
en_text: The Eldar of Craftworld Ulthwé came to Kronus pursuing their alien agendas, but in the end did nothing but feed the power of the Chaos Lord Eliphas the Inheritor. Despite her use of Orkish servants and even a rival Chaos cult, the witch Taldeer was unable to hold back Eliphas’s forces, who cut her off from her vessel and subjected her people to the most terrible of fates.

tc_text: 為了慶祝他對神靈族的勝利，艾理法斯叫他的手下打開外星人所有的導航石。根據這個黑暗之日以後所流傳的黑色文字記載，這些神靈寶石中藏有神靈族的靈魂，使他們不至被餵食給混沌的力量。將導航石破壞之後，真言持有者將數千個神靈族的靈魂餵給斯拉尼希（也就是極端和頹廢的混亂之神）， 並且為他們的暗黑聖戰取得了這名黑暗神祇的支持。
en_text: To celebrate his victory over the Eldar, Eliphas had his men crack open all the aliens’ waystones. According to the black texts circulated after this dark day, these eldritch gems held the souls of the Eldar, keeping them from feeding the powers of Chaos. By breaking the waystones, the Word Bearers fed thousands of Eldar souls to Slaanesh, the Chaos God of Excess and Decadence, and obtained that dark deity’s favor for their Dark Crusade.

tc_text: 為了腐敗領主
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 戰事總督亞歷山大的部隊在勝利海灣被混沌的軍隊屠殺時，就證明他為首都取的名字實在言之過早。「繼承者」艾理法斯帶領邪惡軍隊穿過被粉碎的城市，他的秘教徒大聲叫喊可怕的話語，並收集死者和傷者。
en_text: Governor-Militant Alexander’s naming of his capital proved highly premature, as Victory Bay saw his troops broken and slaughtered by the powers of Chaos. Eliphas the Inheritor led an unholy procession through the streets of the shattered city, his cultists shouting out terrible supplications and gathering up the dead and wounded.

tc_text: 這些不幸的事件是在形成帝國防中心的地獄風暴巨砲完成之前發生的。後來艾理法斯的巫師安非恩和錫蘇斯利用這些腐爛的屍體作為其祭物，舉行一種可怕的儀式。運用他們的黑暗咒文，在赫魯斯異教重生之際，將瘟疫的惡魔融入巨砲之中。真言持有者慶祝這一天，認為就是在這一天，他們的新聖戰獲得了瘟疫和腐敗的混沌之神奈格的支持。
en_text: These unfortunates were brought before the great Hellstorm cannon that had formed the center of the Imperial defense. Eliphas’s sorcerers, Amphion and Zethus, then performed a terrifying ritual using these rotting corpses as their sacrifice. With their dark words, the daemon of plague and rot bound into the cannon during the Horus Heresy awoke anew. The Word Bearers celebrated this day as that when their new crusade obtained the support of Nurgle, the Chaos God of Pestilence and Decay.

tc_text: 為了道路變換者
en_text: For the Changer of the Ways

tc_text: 引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 帝皇的忠實子民以理解的態度看著真言持有者攻向克諾努斯的死靈族核心。隨著兩股無法平息的邪惡勢力彼此敵對，很自然地眾人以為正義的勢力必然得勝。不幸的是，繼承者艾理法斯將以勝利之姿現身於楚爾阿畢斯高原，而且比以前更具危險性。
en_text: Faithful subjects of the Emperor understandably took heart to see the Word Bearers strike at the heart of the Necron infestation of Kronus. With two implacable evils turning on one another, the thinking went, the forces of right couldn't help but win. Unfortunately, Eliphas the Inheritor would emerge from his victory in the Thur’Abis Plateau more dangerous than ever.

tc_text: 帝國的指揮官猜測不到死靈族擁有奇怪的技術和神器，是混沌的力量所憎惡的，就像活人憎惡死靈族一樣。在粉碎死靈族的玄武岩浮石巨塔和不神聖的檔案之後，艾理法斯正在攻擊唯一一個能夠斥退毀滅力量的勢力（除了神皇本人之外）。在這麼做的時候，他不但除掉對他勢力的一大威脅，也獲得曾奇（次元的混沌諸神之一）的喜愛。從那天起，他的暗黑聖戰帶著巫術之神的聖命，使它更加無法阻止。
en_text: Imperial commanders could not guess that the Necrons held strange technologies and artifacts that were as hateful to the powers of Chaos as they were to life itself. By shattering the basalt monoliths and unholy archives of the Necrons, Eliphas was striking at one of the only forces (other than the God Emperor Himself) able to push back the ruinous powers. In so doing, he not only removed a threat to his power, but gained the favor of Tzeentch, one of the Chaos Gods of the Warp. His Dark Crusade would carry the sanction of the God of Sorcery from that day onward, making it all the more unstoppable.

tc_text: 為了血神
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 集結的歐克蠻人家族傾其全部軍力對抗真言持有者的浪潮，但是在異教徒和外星人的戰役當中，褻瀆者獲得勝利。事實上，就如同他們慣用的技倆，混沌軍隊在歐克蠻人當中種下不滿和衝突。當軍閥戈古茲面對由次元供應能量的異教徒時，他那支一度統一的吼～軍隊已經落入交戰的分裂狀態。
en_text: The massed Ork clans threw their full might against the tide of the Word Bearers, but in the battle between heretic and alien, the blasphemers triumphed. Indeed, as is their way, the forces of Chaos sowed dissent and conflict among the Orks. The once-unified band of Warlord Gorgutz fell into fractious infighting just when he faced the Warp-powered heretics.

tc_text: 接著發生的屠殺規模極大，但是艾理法斯的真正目標比較簡單。黑色使徒從戈古茲那裡取得克魯爾的頭顱，就是洛恩五星的屠殺者。這個可恨的異教徒率領所謂的死虐血軍團抵抗帝國防衛軍的第四一二卡迪安軍團。艾理法斯聲稱他砍斷死虐的「頭骨寶座」，以這種方法獲得混亂諸神中最可怕者的支持。
en_text: The slaughter that ensued was of epic proportions, but Eliphas the Inheritor’s true objective was simpler. The Black Apostle recovered from Gorgutz the skull of Crull, the Butcher of Lorn V. This debased heretic had led the so-called Blood Legion of Khorne and faced the Imperial Guard’s 412th Cadian regiment. Eliphas claimed his severed head for Khorne’s “skull throne,” obtaining in this way the favor of the most terrible of the Chaos Gods.

tc_text: 為了戰爭大師
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 真言持有者擊敗血鴉軍團星際戰士，是對帝皇效忠者的可怕打擊。血鴉軍團戰至最後一卒，並且用軌道火力轟擊地面，而不願看到他們的遺物落入異教徒的手中，但是他們的犧牲似乎是徒然的。
en_text: The Word Bearers’ victory over the Blood Ravens Space Marines was a terrible blow to the Emperor’s faithful. The Ravens fought nearly to the last and blasted the landscape with orbital fire rather than see their relics fall into heretical hands, but their sacrifices ultimately seemed in vain.

tc_text: 的確，繼承者艾理法斯把北汪迪恩視為他最關鍵的勝利之役。發狂的報信者在克諾努斯的各城市宣告說，在打敗血鴉軍團之後，真言持有者為他們的暗黑聖戰取得戰爭大師亞巴頓的個人祝福。從來沒有知道，為什麼血鴉軍團的死—他們的歷史甚至可以回溯到赫魯斯異教的時代—會特別令亞巴頓感到喜悅。雖然如此，從那時候開始，真言持有者的軍隊帶著全新而可怕的確切性進行戰鬥。
en_text: Indeed, Eliphas the Inheritor saw North Vandea as the site of his most critical victory. Mad preachers took to the streets of Kronus’s cities claiming that, by breaking the Blood Ravens, the Word Bearers had obtained the personal sanction of Warmaster Abbadon for their Dark Crusade. It was never clear why the deaths of Blood Ravens – a chapter whose history does not go back to the Horus Heresy – would be especially pleasing to Abbadon. Nevertheless, the forces of the Word Bearers fought with a new and terrible certainty from that point on.

tc_text: 為了神官洛嘉
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 繼承者艾理法斯擊敗鈦星帝國的外星部隊，形成對審判團的運作實務的一種扭曲嘲諷。真言持有者慶祝歐內爾．席歐雷斯的死亡，並指出乙太導師的不幸下場正可證明鈦星人信奉的是假偶像。與這次事件有關的異教宣傳則認為真言持有者把用來指責他們的控告套用在這個世界。他們稱鈦星人為異教徒，是沒有信仰的怪物，在階級制度的乙太導師階級下敬拜虛空的偶像。
en_text: Eliphas the Inheritor’s defeat of the alien forces of the Tau Empire led to a twisted parody of Inquisitorial practices. The Word Bearers celebrated the death of Aun'el Shi'ores and pointed to the Ethereal's demise as evidence of the falsehood of Tau idols. The heretical propaganda surrounding this event saw the Word Bearers spitting back at the world the same accusations used to damn them. They called the Tau heretics and infidels, faithless creatures who worshipped empty ideals under the boots of the hierophantic Ethereal caste.

tc_text: 這些行為全部都是為了取悅洛嘉，據說他是從西卡魯斯惡魔世界管理這個軍團的真言持有者神官。洛嘉是其軍團所傳講之扭曲信任的創始人，據說他最恨惡不虔誠的人。若是如此，不難想像他會看著奉他的名在克諾努斯城市中的大屠殺而發出微笑。
en_text: These acts were all directed at pleasing Lorgar, the Word Bearer Primarch who is said to rule the Legion from the Daemon World of Sicarus. The founder of the twisted faith preached by his Legion, Lorgar is said to hate the irreligious above all others. If so, it is not hard to imagine him smiling over the slaughter carried out in his name in the Tau cities of Kronus.

tc_text: 聖戰繼續進行
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在第二次克諾努斯戰爭結束時，真言持有者令人厭惡的旗幟飛揚在整個行星之上。天空因為釋出的邪惡能量而撕裂，次元風暴在天空肆虐，惡魔遍佈在大地上。過去曾是繁榮的殖民地，變成一塊邪惡的惡麼世界，像在虛空中焚燒的腐敗之地。黑色教堂出現在所有的城市之中，整個人口若非改信完整混沌的褻瀆信仰，就是成為其血腥祭物的飼料。
en_text: By the end of the Second Kronus War, the foul banner of the Word Bearers flew across the entire planet. The very earth cracked with the foul energies unleashed there, Warp storms wracked the sky, and daemons spread across the land. Where once a prosperous colony had stood, a foul Daemon World burned like a canker in the void. Black Cathedrals rose in all its cities and the entire population either converted to the blasphemous faith of Chaos Undivided or became fodder for its blood sacrifices.

tc_text: 但是，失去一個世界和數千萬個靈魂，若和艾理法斯接下來的行為相比，就顯得遜色了。在他於克諾努斯獲得最後勝利後不久，他的巫師召喚惡魔軍團和其他令人厭惡的野獸，混沌艦隊亦從次元傳送門中出現。克諾努斯變成征服的出發站，而這場征戰將切穿奧提瑪殿堂的大部份地區，直接攻向神聖之地本土。
en_text: The loss of a single world and a few hundred million souls would soon pale in comparison to Eliphas’s next acts, however. Soon after his final victory on Kronus, his sorcerers called forth legions of daemons and other foul beasts, while Chaos fleets appeared from the Warp. Kronus became the launching point for a campaign of conquest that would cut through much of Ultima Segmentum as it drove toward Holy Terra itself.

tc_text: 克諾努斯的戰爭是帝國最黑暗時代的開端。
en_text: The War for Kronus was but the dawn of the Imperium’s darkest day.

tc_text: 烏斯維的女巫
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在工藝世界烏斯維的最深處，神靈族 先知塔迪兒預見死靈族的返回和他們在銀河系的種族大屠殺作戰。她已經在洛恩五星上驅使帝國防衛軍去對抗這個古代仇敵，但是威脅仍然十分真實。
en_text: In the depths of Craftworld Ulthwé, the Eldar Farseer Taldeer foresaw the return of the Necrons and their campaign of galactic genocide. She had driven the Imperial Guard on Lorn V against this ancient foe, but the threat remained real.

tc_text: 當死靈族出現在克諾努斯上時，塔迪兒面臨一個新問題。這個位於銀河邊緣的行星位於神靈族魍道關口的範圍之外。塔迪兒的部隊沒有透過這種古老的系統從工藝世界出發前往，而是搭乘她的生魂艦—利利亞斯之視。這艘外星人船艦藏在星系邊緣，由一支先遣隊伍搭著小飛行梭前往提瑞亞的冰凍荒原。他們在那裡建造了與利利亞斯之視連結的特殊關口。
en_text: When the Necrons arose on Kronus, Taldeer faced a new problem. This planet on the galaxy’s edge was beyond the reach of the Eldar webway. Instead of traveling from the Craftworld via this ancient system, Taldeer’s forces arrived aboard her wraithship, the Vision of Lileath. This alien vessel hid at the edge of the system while an advance party took a small shuttle to the frozen wastes of Tyrea. There, they erected special gateways linked to the holds of the Vision of Lileath.

tc_text: 神靈族發現這顆行星的狀態很糟。死靈族正在進攻，而且不能倚靠克諾努斯上的其他勢力去阻止他們。塔迪兒放棄她習慣的運作方式，命令其部隊在克諾努斯上展開全面征戰。
en_text: The Eldar found the planet in a sorry state. The Necrons were on the march and the assortment of other powers on Kronus could not be trusted to stop them. Abandoning her habitual manipulations, Taldeer ordered her forces to begin an all out conquest of Kronus.

tc_text: 如果其他的勢力都不去阻止死靈族，神靈族就自己動手。
en_text: If none of the Mon-Keigh would stop the Necrons, the Eldar would do it themselves.

tc_text: 在潔淨的火中
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 雖然死靈族是先知塔迪兒真正的獵物，但是神靈族對於混沌的毀滅力量幾乎一樣大。傳說中認為混沌神祇斯拉尼希乃出生於原始的神靈族文明墮落之中，而塔迪兒的隨從急欲擊退崇拜這樣一種生物的人類異教徒。
en_text: Although the Necrons were Farseer Taldeer’s true prey, the Eldar hatred for the ruinous powers of Chaos was almost as great. Legends hold that the Chaos god Slaanesh was born from the fall of the original Eldar civilization, and Taldeer’s followers were anxious to beat back the human heretics who worshipped such a creature.

tc_text: 塔迪兒手下最資深的方位戰士率領對迪摩斯半島的攻擊，高歌神靈族戰神凱拉．曼沙．凱恩的名字，一面砍殺那些狂人、叛變的星際戰士，以及起來抵抗他們的惡魔毒物。當混沌之門關閉、真言持有者瓦解時，塔迪兒命令方位戰士撤退。後後她的巫師主持巨大的潔淨儀式。從軌道上，達一公里長的古文字符以明亮的火焰顯現，讓所有人都看見神靈族的勝利。
en_text: Taldeer’s most senior Aspect Warriors led the drive into the Deimos Peninsula, singing the name of the Eldar war god Kaela Mensha Khaine as they cut through the madmen, traitor Space Marines and daemonic filth arrayed against them. With the Chaos Gates closed and the Word Bearers broken, Taldeer ordered her Aspect Warriors to withdraw. Her Warlocks then performed a great cleansing rite. From orbit, kilometer-long runes appeared in bright fire, announcing the Eldar victory for all to see.

tc_text: 總督的末日
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 塔迪兒在洛恩五號星上操弄帝國防衛軍，已經使她被視為帝國的敵人。從那時候開始，盧卡斯．亞歷山大將軍即領導他的軍隊去攻擊她。當先知終於把她的軍隊傳送到勝利海灣時，雙方知道這場漫長的追逐終於要結束了。亞歷山大的手下英勇地作戰直到最後，但是神靈族結合匿蹤、速度和外星人的殘酷，擊敗了他們。獵殺先知塔迪兒的行動以外星人揮刀作為結束。
en_text: Taldeer’s manipulation of the Imperial Guard on Lorn V had resulted in her branding as an enemy of the Imperium. General Lukas Alexander had led his troops against her ever since. When the Farseer at last sent her troops into Victory Bay, both sides knew that this long chase was finally over. Alexander’s men fought with bravery until the end, but the Eldar’s combination of stealth, speed and alien ruthlessness overwhelmed them. The hunt for Farseer Taldeer ended with the swing of an alien blade.

tc_text: 勝利海灣的機械主教破壞了該地的地獄風暴巨砲，以免它落入神靈族的手中，但是先知仍然命令其吟骨者和守護者以扭曲彈藥裝填那座巨大的砲。當這些以次元提供能量的武器爆炸時，它們將大砲炸成無數的碎片。即使只有一點點的希望，能夠用這座強大的武器為帝皇服務，神靈族也要永遠粉碎它。
en_text: The Techpriests in Victory Bay sabotaged the great Hellstorm cannon there, lest it fall into Eldar hands, but the Farseer still ordered her Bonesingers and Guardians to load the mighty gun with distort charges. When these Warp-powered weapons detonated, they shattered the cannon into countless pieces. If there was any hope at all of ever restoring this mighty weapon to the Emperor’s service, the Eldar dashed it forever.

tc_text: 死者的殘餘
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 先知塔迪兒親自率領她的軍隊進入死靈族的墓穴，並安置巨大的電漿炸彈炸毀墓穴，以岩石埋葬她的敵人和許多自己的戰士。也許是為了彌補這件事，她也率領找回死者遺體的工作。
en_text: Farseer Taldeer personally led her forces into the catacombs of the Necrons and delivered the massive plasma bomb that collapsed the catacombs, bringing tons of rock down on her foes and many of her own warriors. Perhaps to atone for this, she also led the efforts to recover the remains of the fallen.

tc_text: 在這段暗淡的期間，塔迪兒發現失落者的墳墓，那是死靈族在很久以前建造的一個陵墓，用以祭拜其獵物的遺體。在裡面有幾個古代神靈族的遺體，是在第一次戰爭中對抗死靈族的戰士。塔迪兒將以盛大的儀式將這些遺體迎回烏斯維。
en_text: During this somber triage, Taldeer uncovered the Tomb of the Lost, a crypt built eons ago by the Necrons to enshrine the remains of their victims. Within were the remains of several ancient Eldar, warriors in the first war against the Necrons. Taldeer would return these to Ulthwé with great ceremony.

tc_text: 或許就是因為有這樣古老的遺址存在，促使先知完成克諾努斯的征服。即使打敗了死靈族，她仍然將軍隊引進未征服之地。她說，每一吋土地都要翻過來，以免死靈族重新在這個世界上興起。
en_text: Perhaps it was the presence of such antediluvian relics that drove the Farseer to complete her conquest of Kronus. Even with the Necrons defeated, she drove her forces forward into the territories as yet unconquered. No rock could be left unturned, she said, lest the Necrons rise anew on this world.

tc_text: 叢林遊戲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 塔迪兒的軍隊像剃刀鋒利的刀鋒一樣攻入偉大的歐克蠻人部落中，擊破吼～大軍，並使剩餘的歐克蠻人陷入毀滅性的內戰當中。為了表示他們對這些野蠻戰士的輕視之意，神靈族的主要軍隊在打敗軍閥戈古茲之後，立刻撤出綠色海岸。
en_text: Taldeer’s forces struck like a razor-sharp blade into the heart of the great Orkish horde, decapitating the Waaagh! and plunging the remaining Orks into destructive infighting. Showing their contempt for the brutish warriors, the main Eldar force withdrew from the Green Coast immediately after it had disposed of Warlord Gorgutz.

tc_text: 只有一小群遊俠和一個巫師留在叢林中，使用他們的偽裝斗篷和其他設備保持不被交戰的家族發現。每當有一位首領似乎獲得足夠的地位，可以將歐克蠻人結合成一支軍隊時，遊俠就暗殺他，使野蠻的外星人陷入另一循環的混戰。同時，巫師艾尼米亞（塔迪兒的先知議會成員之一）則不斷地為不同的歐克人首領提供惡意的幫助，讓他們彼此攻擊要害，使整個種族保持在軟弱的狀態。
en_text: Only a small cadre of Rangers and a single Warlock remained in the jungle, using their cameleoline cloaks and other devices to remain hidden from the warring clans. Any time a chieftain seemed to be gaining enough stature to assemble the Orks into a viable force, the Rangers assassinated him, plunging the wild aliens into another cycle of infighting. Meanwhile, the Warlock Enimiah (a member of Taldeer’s Seer Council) repeatedly offered poisonous aid to various Ork chiefs, sending them at each others’ throats and keeping the race as a whole weak.

tc_text: 血鴉的殞落
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 神靈族對北汪迪恩攻擊，打破了血鴉軍團在克諾努斯上的勢力。塔迪兒的軍隊不但殺死了參事會中許多最優秀的戰士，也取得了許多血鴉軍團急欲隱藏的遺物。雖然牧師麥可魯斯犧牲自己，至少破壞了一些參事會的黑暗秘密，其它的仍然落入神靈族的手中。
en_text: The Eldar assault on North Vandea broke the back of the Blood Ravens presence on Kronus. Not only did Taldeer’s forces kill many of the finest warriors in the chapter, but they claimed many of the relics the Blood Ravens were so anxious to hide. Although Chaplain Mikelus sacrificed himself to destroy at least some of the chapter’s dark secrets, others fell into Eldar hands.

tc_text: 塔迪兒以巫師之道對付星際戰士屍首的方式，更令倖存的血鴉軍團戰士心悸。好像要把他們當做某種瘟疫的源頭，那個外星人巫師把北汪迪恩所有的血鴉軍團屍體都燒成灰燼。這樣一來，任何重返克諾努斯並取回死去戰士基因的預定作戰都變得毫無意義。
en_text: Taldeer’s warlocks treatment of the corpses of fallen Space Marines was even more galling to the surviving Blood Ravens. As if expecting them to be the source of some pestilence, the alien sorcerers incinerated every last Blood Raven body left in North Vandea. This made any planned operations to return to Kronus and recover the gene-seed from the fallen battle-brothers pointless.

tc_text: 參事會發誓要為失去的可貴基因庫而復仇。
en_text: The chapter vowed revenge for the loss of its valuable gene stock.

tc_text: 在亞沙里斯的瘋狂行為
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 神靈族對亞沙里斯的攻擊是以速度對付速度，以匿蹤對匿蹤。最後，是塔迪兒的古老巫術和她的先知議會戰勝了鈦星防禦者的外星技術。鈦星人的乙太導師之死瓦解了他們的士氣，塔迪兒直接允許沙索．凱斯從克諾努斯撤退。
en_text: The Eldar assault on Asharis pitted speed against speed and stealth against stealth. Ultimately, it was the ancient sorceries of Taldeer and her Seer Council that prevailed over the alien technologies of the Tau defenders. The death of the Tau’s Ethereal ruler broke their morale and Taldeer simply allowed Shas’o Kais to withdraw from Kronus.

tc_text: 在鈦星人撤退之後，神靈族對其敵人表現出完全的輕視，而且直接放任亞沙里斯，由它的命運去決定。在戰鬥開始時，人類掙脫數世紀的外星人統治，獲得自由的人類擁上街頭，對留下來的鈦星人平民進行一些伸張正義的行為。復仇之心導致瘋狂，很快地亞沙里斯就陷入鋒火。先知塔迪兒對於那裡失去的生命的關切程度，就和他對踩在腳下的人類的態度一致。
en_text: The Eldar showed utter contempt for their enemies and simply left Asharis to its fate once the Tau had withdrawn. In the wake of the battle, humans freed from centuries of alien bondage took to the streets and exacted some measure of justice upon the Tau civilians left behind. Revenge led to madness and soon Asharis was ablaze, Farseer Taldeer having as much concern for the lives lost there as a man might for the ants under his feet.

tc_text: 提瑞亞的鬼魂
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 外星人的想法是奇怪和神祕的，先知塔迪兒在她的克諾努斯征服之戰中再一次證明這一點。神靈族已經擊潰所有抵抗他們的人，無論是人類、外星人還是異教徒都一樣。克諾努斯屬於他們所有。但是他們沒有鞏固自己在這個世界的勢力，或是進行最後的決戰，而是直接消失，就像傳說中的鬼魂一樣。
en_text: The alien mind is strange and mysterious, and Farseer Taldeer proved this once again upon her conquest of Kronus. The Eldar had broken all who stood before them, driving back men, alien and heretics alike. Kronus was theirs. However, instead of securing their hold on the world or enacting some final gambit, they simply vanished, like the ghosts of legend.

tc_text: 神靈族返回他們的母艦「利利亞斯之視」（所有從克諾努斯星系中試圖找出其出口的嚐試都告失敗）。塔迪兒留下一個無政府狀態的星球，到處散佈著她的敵人的屍體，註定在未來幾個世界中將成為一個沒有法律的偏遠地帶。也許這本來就是她的用意；也許克諾努斯本身，以及可能在那裡興起的那些軍閥，就是塔迪兒早就預見並且終於戰勝的威脅。
en_text: The Eldar returned to their ship, the Vision of Lileath, which evaded all attempts to track its exit from the Kronus system. Taldeer left behind her a planet in anarchy, littered with the corpses of her enemies and destined to become a lawless backwater for centuries to come. Perhaps that had been her intention all along; perhaps Kronus itself, and the warlords who might have arisen there, were the threat Taldeer had long foreseen and finally defeated.

tc_text: 事實真相就和先知最後的命運一樣，仍然是個謎。
en_text: The truth, like the Farseer’s ultimate fate, remains a mystery.

tc_text: 一個新目標
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 為了追趕神靈族先知塔迪兒，帝國防禦軍抵達克諾努斯。但是盧卡斯．亞歷山大將軍在這裡不只是發現他的獵物而已。他找到他的命運。
en_text: The Imperial Guard arrived on Kronus in pursuit of the Eldar Farseer Taldeer. General Lukas Alexander found more than his prey there, however. He found his destiny.

tc_text: 亞歷山大將軍宣部將鐵工海灣的廢棄城市做為作戰基地，並在那裡發現一座戰爭泰坦的地獄風暴巨砲。數千年前，機械主教將這件可怕的遺物帶到克諾努斯，那是在赫魯斯異教期間，從一台異教的戰爭機器上切下來的。
en_text: General Alexander claimed the abandoned city of Ironworks Bay as a base of operations and found there the massive Hellstorm cannon of an Imperator war titan. Techpriests had brought this fearsome relic to Kronus millennia ago, soon after it was cut from a heretical war machine during the Horus Heresy.

tc_text: 當將軍回報他的發現時，帝國防衛軍最高指揮部給他新的命令。他必須佔領泰坦的巨砲，以及其它機械主教的遺物，然後要讓克諾努斯歸回人類帝國的統治。區域指揮部命令亞歷山大總督逐出蔓延在這個世界上的外星人和異教徒，任命他為戰事總督，並從他的地面部隊中建立了克諾努斯第一軍團。新任總督迅速將這個城市命名為勝利海灣，將它設立為新行星的首都，他的部下則以「解放者」稱呼自己的軍團。
en_text: When the General reported his discovery, the Imperial Guard's high command issued him new orders. He would secure the titan's gun along with any other relics of the Techpriests, and would then return Kronus to the Imperium of Man. Ordering him to drive out the aliens and heretics besetting this world, Segmentum Command named Alexander Governor-Militant and created the 1st Kronus Regiment from his ground forces. The new Governor quickly renamed the city itself Victory Bay, making it his new planetary capital, while his men adopted the sobriquet of "Liberators" for their regiment.

tc_text: 當血鴉軍團星際戰士開始對克諾努斯進行肅清時，戰事總督拒絕撤退。無論星際戰士要求什麼，他的命令是清楚的。帝國防衛軍將對抗血鴉軍團和其他所有的侵略者。
en_text: When the Blood Ravens Space Marines began their purge of Kronus, the Governor-Militant refused to retreat. His orders were clear, regardless of the demands of the Space Marines. The Guard would fight the Blood Ravens along with all the other invaders.

tc_text: 惡魔殺手
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在對真言持有者的次元門進行最後攻擊時，解放者第三連構成了戰事總督亞歷山大軍隊的主體。這個選擇很聰明，因為第三連是從卡迪安第十五軍團成立的，是他們在家鄉裡對抗混沌勢力的多場重要戰役的老戰士。
en_text: The Liberators’ 3rd Company provided the bulk of Governor-Militant Alexander’s troops during the final assault on the Word Bearers’ warp gate. This choice was astute, as 3rd Company had been drawn from the Cadian 15th regiment and were veterans of several hard battles against Chaos forces on their home world.

tc_text: 第三連的士兵表現極為稱職，儘管他們必須必須穿過受到次元影響的地形，並面對無數的扭曲恐怖。在血腥的戰鬥之後，該連被稱為「惡魔殺手」，但是有許多人在那塊腐敗的土地上犧牲性命，還有更多人受傷及殘廢。在支援部隊的靈能者中，傷亡更加慘重。戰場上有許多未清除的次元能量，令許多人發瘋或對自己的能力失去控制。軍團政戰軍官必須處決被敵人所利用的靈能者。
en_text: The men of Third Company did their duty admirably, despite having to fight across warp-blasted terrain and face countless twisted horrors. In the wake of the bloody battle, the company came to be known as the “Daemon Killers,” but scores of men left their lives on that corrupted soil, and many more were maimed and wounded. The toll of the battle was higher still among the sanctioned psykers supporting the troops. The presence of so much unbridled warp energy drove many to madness or to loose control over their strange abilities. The regimental commissariat oversaw the execution of those lost to the enemy.

tc_text: 女巫的末日
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 當解放者終於在提瑞亞的冰凍大地上發現先見塔迪兒的蹤跡時，任何詭技或欺騙都不能勝過帝皇的正義。在封密女巫的魍道關口、並摧毀她的部隊的情況下，戰事總督亞歷山大很快就抓住這個異星先知。被下藥並囚禁的她終將被轉交給審判團。
en_text: No amount of trickery or deceit could forestall the Emperor’s justice when the Liberators finally tracked Farseer Taldeer to the frozen terrain of Tyrea. With the witch’s web gates sealed and her forces crushed, Governor-Militant Alexander soon held the xeno Farseer in his hands. Drugged and imprisoned, she would ultimately be handed over to the Inquisition.

tc_text: 塔迪兒被捕表示亞歷山大總督的最初任務已接近尾聲。但是，在一次對提瑞亞軍隊發表的演說中（而且這次演說還廣播到全行星），亞歷山大提醒他們不要忘記使克諾努斯歸回帝國統治的任務。帝國主教馬特爾（總督自己的告解者）奉帝國神皇之名祝福總督這項命令，而且軍團的政戰軍官宣稱獲得全面勝利是所有忠實的帝國防衛軍的職責。
en_text: Taldeer’s capture meant Governor Alexander's original mission was at an end. However, in a rousing speech before the troops in Tyrea – and broadcast across the planet – Alexander reminded his soldiers of their duty to return Kronus to Imperial control. Father Martel, the Governor’s own confessor, blessed this mandate in the name of the Immortal God Emperor, and the regimental Commissars called it the duty of all loyal Guardsmen to push on to total victory.

tc_text: 進入死亡之谷
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 穿越死靈族墓窖的地下迷宮，使解放者付出很大的代價。無法平息的敵人殺死許多生命，特別是徹底毀滅第四連的第二排和第五排。但是當造成墓穴倒塌的大爆炸塵埃底定時，生還者發出巨大的歡呼。
en_text: The terrifying battle through the underground labyrinth of the Necron catacombs cost the Liberators dearly. The implacable foe claimed scores upon scores of lives, notably wiping out 4th Company’s 2nd and 5th platoons. But when the smoke cleared from the great detonation which collapsed the catacombs, a great cheer arose from the survivors.

tc_text: 在幾個地方，死靈族墳墓世界的古老建築突顯在沙漠之中。最後帝國主教馬特爾（總督的告解者，也是克諾努斯實質上的大執事）指稱這些建築是異教的瘟疫，繼續腐化所有花時間接近它們的人。戰事總督亞歷山大聽從他的話，並命令手下用更多炸彈，將所有的遺址都炸得粉碎，或把它們埋在大批的沙土之下。
en_text: In several places, the ancient structures of the Necron tomb world emerged from the desert. Father Martel, confessor to the Governor and the de facto arch-deacon of Kronus, ultimately condemned these as heretical blights which continued to corrupt all those who spent time near them. Governor-Militant Alexander took his words to heart and had his men use further bombs to reduce all ruins to rubble or bury them under tons of sand.

tc_text: 獵頭
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 儘管投注大批外星人軍團來對抗解放者，軍閥戈古茲仍然無法抵抗帝國防衛軍的力量。歐克蠻人軍閥的逃走，後來成為綠色海岸勝利中的一個缺憾，但是在後來隨即發生的後續戰鬥中，大部份人認為他死在摧毀其基地的大爆炸中。
en_text: Despite the legions of aliens he threw against the Liberators, Warlord Gorgutz could not stand against the might of the Imperial Guard. The Ork chieftain’s escape would later put a blemish on the victory in the Green Coast, but in the immediate aftermath, most assumed he had died in the cataclysmic explosion that destroyed his encampment.

tc_text: 戰事總督亞歷山大將消滅四分五裂的歐克蠻人的工作交給格雷戈爾．瓦許的第二連。瓦許將他的部隊分成獵殺小隊，能擊殺最多敵人的小隊可以獲得獎勵和榮耀。他麾下的猿人認真參加這個競賽，為他們自己收集了極多的歐克蠻人頭顱。最後連政戰軍官禁止這個做法，因為與帝國的信條相違。在將他的決定告知猿人戰士之後，他在醫療神殿裡住了好幾週。
en_text: Governor-Militant Alexander entrusted the job of cleaning up the now divided Orks to Captain Gregor Vash’s 2nd Company. Vash broke his forces up into individual hunter squads, offering rewards and glory to those units that confirmed the most kills. The Ogryns under his command took this contest to heart and collected massive piles of Orkish skulls for themselves. The company commissar eventually forbade this practice as incompatible with the Imperial creed. He spent some weeks in the medicae temple after informing the Ogryn warriors of his decision.

tc_text: 以血解決紛爭
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 戰事總督亞歷山大和血鴉軍團蘇勒隊長之間的衝突只能在血中結束。雙方都有明確的命令，而且雙方都認為他們的行動有帝皇的祝福。一直到解放者攻進北汪迪恩，並且剷平星際戰士的修道院要塞時，血鴉軍團才停止他們的肅清作戰並撤離。
en_text: The clash between Governor-Militant Alexander and the Blood Raven Captain Thule could only end in blood. Both had explicit orders, and both were convinced they acted with the Emperor's blessing. Only when the Liberators had driven into North Vandea and leveled the Space Marines’ Castellum Incorruptus did the Blood Ravens cease their purge of the planet and withdraw.

tc_text: 雖然來自血鴉軍團戰鬥駁船的軌道砲剷平了基地的大部份剩餘部份，但是亞歷山大總督命令手下仔細搜索星際戰士可能留下的任何記錄。他們的搜尋並不徒勞，亞歷山大發現關於參事會過去曾經來過這顆行星的記錄，以及參事會歷史中的種種矛盾行徑。看起來這些發現直接導致審判團於不久之後對參事會展開調查。
en_text: Although orbital salvos from the Blood Ravens’ battle barge leveled much of the remains of the base, Governor Alexander directed his men to conduct a careful search for any records the Space Marines might have left behind. Their search was not in vain, and Alexander uncovered records linking the chapter to past visits to the planet, as well as disturbing contradictions in the chapter’s history. It seems likely that these discoveries led directly to the Inquisition’s probe of the chapter soon thereafter.

tc_text: 亞沙里斯的解放
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 帝國在亞沙里斯擊退鈦星人軍隊，絕對是最艱難的戰鬥之一，也是最為人慶祝的勝利。隨著乙太導師席歐雷斯的死亡，以及其部隊撤退，戰事總督亞歷山大看見自己完成了讓克諾努斯永遠脫離鈦星帝國統治的夢想。
en_text: Certainly one of the most hard-fought, the Imperial victory over the Tau forces in Asharis was definitely the most celebrated of the liberation campaign. In the death of the Ethereal Shi’ores and the retreat of his forces, Governor-Militant Alexander saw the completion of his dream of once and for all stripping Kronus from the Tau Empire.

tc_text: 在亞沙里斯街道上舉行的閱兵典禮突顯了這場勝利，同時配星人佔領的標誌被破壞的場面也一再重演。軍團政戰軍官也在亞沙里斯和其他已經解放的城市裡建立辦公室，讓人民能夠提供關於協助外星佔領者之人的情報。對於被控為賣國賊的人的審訊極為迅速和致命，帝皇的公義不會對人類的賣國賊有任何憐憫。
en_text: A military parade through the streets of Asharis marked the victory, along with repeated scenes of sanctioned destruction of the signs of alien occupation. The regimental commissariat also established offices in Asharis and other liberated cities where citizens could provide information on those who had aided the alien occupiers. The trials of accused collaborators were rapid and deadly, the Emperor’s justice having no mercy for traitors to the human race.

tc_text: 一股不可忽視的力量
en_text: A Power to Be Reckoned With

tc_text: 引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 隨著最後一座外星人的要塞倒塌，戰事總督亞歷山大成為克諾努斯惟一的統治者，也是部下心目中的英雄。即使面臨血鴉軍團的反對，總督仍然履行其命令，並且獲得他的報酬。事實上，區域指揮部命令解放者在克諾努斯停留一段維和時期，然後就前往下一個衝突區域。亞歷山大總督則留下來，以神皇之名進行統治。
en_text: With the last alien bastion broken, Governor-Militant Alexander stood as the uncontested ruler of Kronus and a hero to his men. Even faced with the opposition of the Blood Ravens, the Governor carried out his orders and received his rewards. Indeed, Segmentum Command ordered the Liberators to remain on Kronus during a pacification period and then to ship out to the next conflict zone. Governor Alexander would remain behind to rule in the God Emperor’s name.

tc_text: 許多機械主教前往克諾努斯，監督大規模的公共工程建設，並帶來所需要的巨大資源。作為報答，他們獲准研究勝利海灣的地獄風暴巨砲，希望讓它能夠繼續為帝皇的部隊效力。
en_text: Large numbers of Techpriests arrived on Kronus to oversee a massive campaign of public works, bringing with them the huge resources needed. In return, they gained permission to resume study of the Hellstorm cannon in Victory Bay, hoping to return it to the Emperor’s service.

tc_text: 至於解放者，亞歷山大總督提升瓦許隊長為上校，並且將指揮權交給他。軍團仍然效忠於他，一顆行星由他統治，還有火星的機械主教也欠他人情，盧卡斯．亞歷山大開始成為銀河的這個星系中一個不可忽視的新興力量。
en_text: As for the Liberators, Governor Alexander promoted Captain Vash to colonel and placed him in command. With the regiment still loyal to him, a planet at his command, and the Techpriests of Mars in his debt, Lukas Alexander had begun his rise as a power to be reckoned with in this sector of the galaxy.

tc_text: 致夜者的飢餓
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 死靈族深埋在克諾努斯的沙漠裡已經很久，他們在一場只有像神靈族這麼古老的種族才記得的大戰結束後撤退到此處。早在人類直立行走之前，死靈族和他們的黑暗諸神已經撤回到他們的墳墓世界。
en_text: The Necrons had lain buried in the sands of Kronus for eons, having retreated there at the end of a great war only hinted at in the histories of ancient races like the Eldar. Long before Man even stood upright, the Necrons and their dark gods had retreated to their tomb worlds.

tc_text: 但是他們的睡眠並非永恆。他們的異星神祇終於再次喚醒他們，驅使他們消滅在沈睡期間遍佈於銀河中的生靈。在克諾努斯上，當一個考古隊伍挖開楚爾阿畢斯高原上的一個神祕墓穴時，就喚醒了他們。大多數隊員死亡，但是考古隊的隊長托馬斯．馬卡比不知為何成為神秘的死靈族流放者之一。他似乎仍然保留了一點人性，當靜默的軍隊前進時，他偶爾會為其發言。
en_text: But their slumber was not eternal. Eventually their genocidal deities awoke them again, driving them to purge the life that had spread across the galaxy during their sleep. On Kronus, this awakening came when an archeological team opened a mysterious crypt on the arid Thur’Abis Plateau. Most of the team died, but expedition leader Tomas Macabee somehow became one of the mysterious Necron Pariahs. Seemingly retaining a hint of his personality, he occasionally spoke for the silent army as it advanced.

tc_text: 克諾努斯的死靈領主是這個星球上最古老、最強大的不死生物，他立刻發動滅絕的戰役。他的可憎神祇，致夜者，渴望殺死克諾努斯上的所有生靈。
en_text: The Necron Lord of Kronus, the most ancient and powerful of the deathless creatures on the planet, promptly launched a campaign of extermination. His loathsome god, the Nightbringer, hungered for the deaths of all those on Kronus.

tc_text: 次元諸神的毀滅
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在最古老的神靈族神話裡，有關於死靈族的嗜血神祇和次元力量衝突的故事。因此，死靈族對混沌要塞的攻擊可謂是史前戰爭的再現，實體化死靈族的無情浪潮與渾沌無法抑止的瘋狂發生強烈的衝突。
en_text: In the most ancient of Eldar myth cycles, there are tales of the Necrons’ bloodthirsty deities clashing with the powers of the Warp. Thus, the Necron assault on the Chaos stronghold was something of a reenactment of that prehistoric war, the merciless wave of the material Necrons clashing with the unbridled madness of the Immaterium.

tc_text: 儘管有黑色的巫術和邪惡惡魔的憤怒，就算是叛徒星際戰士也不能阻止死靈族的無盡浪潮。 致夜者的僕人在勝利之後繼續留在迪摩斯一段時間，似乎專注於清潔該地被次元能量腐化的的土壞。死靈族的高斯武器將僅餘的混沌神殿和遺址化為灰燼，更不用提所有的屍體以及在最初的攻擊中生還的不幸者了。等到死靈族前往其下一個目標時，這個半島已經成為一個灰與塵的燒焦半島。
en_text: Despite black sorceries and the rage of foul daemons, even the Traitor Space Marines could not stop the unending tide of Necrons. The Nightbringer’s servants remained in Deimos for some time after their victory, seemingly focused on purging the very soil there, which had been tainted by the power of the Warp. Necron gauss weaponry atomized every last Chaos temple and artifact left, not to mention all the corpses and the unfortunates who survived the initial attack. By the time the Necrons moved to their next target, the peninsula had become a scorched desert of ash and dust.

tc_text: 一堆冥骨
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 神靈族特別前來克諾努斯迎戰死靈族，當不死的軍隊前進到提瑞亞時，他們曾有機會。但是儘管他們的先知擁有大受讚譽的預知能力，神靈族並不能扭轉死靈族的浪潮，並且倒在死靈族的武器之下。工藝世界烏斯維的夢想被其古代敵人的鐵蹄踩碎。
en_text: The Eldar had come to Kronus specifically to face the Necrons and when the deathless army marched into Tyrea, they got their chance. For all the lauded foresight of their Farseer, however, the Eldar were unable to stem the Necron tide and fell under the power of their weapons. The dreams of Craftworld Ulthwé came crashing down under the metallic heel of their ancient enemies.

tc_text: 死靈族花費極大的能量來摧毀神靈族留下的各種冥骨建築。據說這種神靈族的材料直接出自於次元，對不死戰士的冒犯似乎更甚於生靈。當高斯閃光和外星刀劍將神靈族的尖塔砍得粉碎時，神靈族的建築全部倒塌。直到先知塔迪兒的建築全部被毀掉之後，死靈族的浪潮才繼續向前推進。
en_text: The Necrons directed much of their energy to destroying the various wraithbone structures left by the Eldar. This eldritch material is said to emanate directly from the Warp, which seems to have offended the deathless warriors even more than the existence of life. The thin spires built by the Eldar collapsed as gauss flares and alien blades cut them into their atomic components. Only when the works of Farseer Taldeer were blasted to nothing did the Necron tide move on.

tc_text: 人類的殞落
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 帝國軍隊曾經和死靈族交過手，特別是在洛恩五號星和弗督斯原星上，而且每次都令人類的英雄付出極大的代價。在克諾努斯上，事態只變得更加艱難，而且當死靈族軍隊衝進勝利海灣時，即使是再度啟動地獄風暴巨砲的巨大力量也無法阻止他們。
en_text: Imperial forces had faced Necrons before, notably on Lorn V and Verdus Prime, and it had cost the champions of Man dearly each time. On Kronus, things only got harder, and when the Necron forces swept into Victory Bay, even the raw power of the revived Hellstorm cannon could not stop them.

tc_text: 當死靈族在勝利海灣殺死最後的機械主教和帝國防衛軍時，死靈族對於人類的成就表現出冷淡的輕視。由於沒有任何活人生還以懼怕他們，也沒有人可以被他們殺戮，他們便直接前往下一個征服對象。他們完全忽視偉大泰坦巨砲的遺跡，即使它的強大威力與堪與他們的神祇要求的種族大屠殺相比。
en_text: The Necrons showed cold contempt for the works of Man as they murdered the last Techpriests and Guardsmen in Victory Bay. With none left to fear them and none left to die, they simply moved on to the next conquest. The remains of the great Titan gun they ignored altogether, even its mighty power paling in comparison to the galactic genocide their gods demanded.

tc_text: 被燒焦的地球
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 當死靈族進入綠色海岸時，兩道永不停息的潮流彼此衝撞。帝國的公民看見粗野的歐克蠻人面對這群古代死亡使者的無情推進而感到高興，實在是情有可原。但是無論是誰獲勝，人類的目標都受到影響。而當死靈族的大鐮刀斬殺歐克蠻人之時，他們只是朝著滅絕銀河系的目標更進一步而已。
en_text: Two unrelenting tides crashed into one another as the Necrons moved into the Green Coast. Imperial citizens can be forgiven for rejoicing to see the barbaric Orkish horde face the merciless advance of the ancient death-bringers. No matter who won, however, the cause of Man suffered. And when the Necron scythe decapitated the Ork horde, it was only one step on their march of galactic extermination.

tc_text: 由於歐克蠻人的生育率極高，因此很難將他們完全除盡。 的確，早在軍閥戈古茲到達以前，克諾努斯的叢林一直是野生歐克蠻人的領土。但是死靈族也在這裡發揮他們堅決的殺戮決心，有系統地逐步肅清叢林。最後有數百萬的歐克蠻人死亡，每個死亡都是令致夜者歡喜的祭物。
en_text: Orkish hordes are notoriously difficult to eradicate since the beasts reproduce at a phenomenal rate. Indeed, Kronus’s jungles had been the domain of feral Orks long before Warlord Gorgutz arrived. The Necrons, however, applied their murderous resoluteness here as well and systematically purged the jungle one step at a time. Millions of Orks ultimately perished, each death a pleasing sacrifice for the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團的毀滅
en_text: The Doom of the Blood Ravens

tc_text: 引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 就連血鴉軍團的精英也無法阻擋死靈族的殺戮推進。死靈族以完全的寂靜和手中高斯槍的衝擊來回應星際戰士的戰鬥吶喊。這些外星人對於可能埋藏在北汪迪恩的任何祕密都完全不感興趣，完全不理會那裡的血鴉教堂廢墟。他們可怕的戰士撕下星球上每一個星際戰士的血肉，但是留下他們的神聖盔甲和其他遺址，任其在嚴酷的天氣中腐蝕。
en_text: Even the elite of the Blood Ravens could not hold back the murderous advance of the Necrons. The Necrons answered the Space Marines' shouted benedictions with stoic silence and murderous blasts from their gauss flayers. The aliens were uninterested in any arcane secrets that might have been hidden in North Vandea, utterly ignoring the scorched ruins of the Blood Ravens chapel there. Their gruesome warriors flensed the flesh from every Space Marine left on the planet, but left their holy battle armors and other relics to corrode in the harsh weather.

tc_text: 悲慘的是，和血肉一起化為塵粒的是那些星際戰士的基因，對參事會造成近乎致命的一擊。透過攻取北汪迪恩，死靈族在克諾努斯上擊敗了血鴉軍團。但是他們消滅了所有陣亡弟兄的基因傳承，形同澈底消滅了整個參事會。
en_text: Tragically, among the flesh reduced to particulate ash was the gene-seed of those Space Marines, dealing a near fatal blow to the chapter. By taking North Vandea, the Necrons defeated the Blood Ravens on Kronus. But by purging the genetic heritage of all those fallen battle brothers, they may well have destroyed the whole chapter.

tc_text: 消滅年輕帝國
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在年輕的鈦星帝國和死靈族的古代邪惡之間所發生的衝突中，古時的決心勝過年輕的繁盛。儘管指揮官凱斯的戰術技能高超，仍然無法阻止死靈族的洪水，他們殺死亞沙里斯的所有生靈，正像他們對付之前的其他土地一樣。
en_text: In the clash between the young Tau Empire and the ancient evil of the Necrons, antediluvian determination won out over youthful exuberance. For all the tactical skill of Commander O’Kais, the Necron wave was unstoppable and they purged Asharis just as they had all other regions before it.

tc_text: 鈦星人軍隊的撤退，使得亞沙里斯剩餘的人民在面對死靈族的屠殺時毫無保護。但是在他們冷血的殺戮結束後，死靈族就放棄城市及週遭的社區，留待時間去侵蝕。自動影像系統仍然廣播廢棄街道的影像，鈦星人、克魯特以及人類被燒焦的頭骨靜靜地躺在滿是灰燼的街道上。
en_text: The retreat of the Tau forces left the remaining civilian population of Asharis unprotected from the Necron purge. Once their cold-blooded slaughter completed, however, the Necrons simply abandoned the city and its surrounding communities to the ages. Automated vid-systems still broadcast images from the desolate streets, the bleached bones of Tau, Kroot and humans lying still in the ash-strewn streets.

tc_text: 在虛空深處的某處，致夜者一定對著他的血腥作品露出微笑。
en_text: Somewhere in the depths of the void, the Nightbringer surely smiles at his gruesome handiwork.

tc_text: 墳墓世界興起
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 到了暗黑聖戰結束時，克諾努斯再一次成為一個墳墓世界。正如死靈族軍隊向前推進、砍殺所有敵人一樣，其他的惡魔裝備也在星球的生態系統中發揮作用。成群的聖甲蟲清除掉南方茂盛的叢林和北方的肥沃平原，而可憎的能量脈動連微小的細菌都殺得乾乾淨淨。海洋死亡，空氣變得稀薄，而且有毒。不久之後，貧脊的沙和灰塵掠過克諾努斯的地面，只有獻給致夜者的紀念碑豎立其中。
en_text: By the end of the Dark Crusade, Kronus was a tomb world once more. Just as the marching Necron armies cut down all their opponents, so do did other fiendish devices work on the planet's very ecosystem. Scarab swarms scoured the lush jungles of the south and the fertile plains of the north, while pulses of loathsome energy killed even microscopic bacteria. The seas died and the air itself became rarified and poisoned. Soon sterile sand and dust swept across the Kronusian landscape, broken only by black monuments to the Nightbringer.

tc_text: 克諾努斯成為死靈族在銀河系東方邊緣的生靈滅絕中心。從克諾努斯的浮石巨塔中出現的戰士將死亡帶進鈦星人帝國、奧特瑪的領土，以及其他更多的星系。帝國的攻擊艦隊、鈦星人的戰鬥隊，以及神靈族的攻擊隊都試圖奪回克諾努斯，但是都敗在從軌道上保護墳墓世界的巨大墓穴船艦之下。每一次的英勇嚐試只為致夜者的殺戮人數憑添記錄。
en_text: Kronus became the black heart of the Necron purge in the eastern edge of the galaxy. Warriors emerging from the monoliths of Kronus would bring death to worlds across the Tau Empire, the domains of Ultramar and many more sectors. Imperial strike fleets, Tau battle formations and Eldar raiding teams would all try to retake Kronus, only to fall before the huge crypt vessels protecting the tomb world from orbit. Each heroic effort only added more deaths to the Nightbringer’s tally.

tc_text: 綠潮高漲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在被逐離洛恩五號星之後，歐克人的軍閥「獵頭者」戈古茲在暗黑聖戰期間以更大的威脅之姿再度現身。他將歐克蠻人的海盜和強盜以及其他從洛恩星系被逐出的部族結合，形成新的軍團，並且開始在鈦星帝國的外圍進行掠奪，一路獲得資源。當克諾努斯發出絕望的呼求，尋求協助對抗死靈族時，戈古茲派他的軍隊前去攻擊一個脆弱的目標。
en_text: Driven from Lorn V, the Ork Warboss Gorgutz Headhunter managed to return as a greater threat still during the Dark Crusade. He formed a new warband from Ork freebooters and pirates and others pushed out of the Lorn system, and set about raiding worlds on the outskirts of the Tau Empire, gaining resources along the way. When Kronus sent out desperate calls for help against the Necrons, Gorgutz sent his forces to strike at a vulnerable target.

tc_text: 戈古茲的戰爭艦隊離開次元傳送門時，發現帝國和鈦星人艦隊早就部署在克諾努斯上空。歐克蠻人損失了幾艘船，但是來襲的艦隊無法擊退戈古茲投入大氣層中的大量歐克蠻人。這些巨大的登陸艦由轉化的小行星製成，衝進綠色海岸，並卸下其中的歐克侵略者。在那裡，戈古茲迫使野生歐克蠻人屈服，並開始他的征服。
en_text: Gorgutz's war fleet dropped out of the Warp, only to find Imperial and Tau fleets squaring off above Kronus. The Orks lost several ships, but the clashing fleets were unable to repel the large number of roks Gorgutz threw into the atmosphere. These massive landing ships, made from converted asteroids, smashed into the Green Coast and unloaded their bands of Ork invaders. There, Gorgutz brought the local feral Orks to heel and set about his conquest.

tc_text: 吼～軍團已經扺達克諾努斯。
en_text: The Waaagh! had come to Kronus.

tc_text: 惡魔殺手戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在洛恩五號星上，軍閥戈古茲已經與混沌領主克魯爾發生過衝突，而當他把軍隊派遣到迪摩斯半島時，這個經驗對他很有幫助。雖然有許多歐克蠻人死在真言持有者令人厭惡的惡魔和黑色巫術之下，戈古茲還有大量的後備部隊，而且終於壓倒那些異教徒。
en_text: On Lorn V, Warlord Gorgutz had clashed with the Chaos Lord Crull, and that experience served him well when he sent his horde into the Deimos Peninsula. Although huge numbers of Orks fell to the foul daemons and black sorceries of the Word Bearers, Gorgutz had plenty to spare and eventually overwhelmed the heretics.

tc_text: 戈古茲把黑色使徒艾理法斯和他的巫師的頭顱插在矛上，而且隨身攜帶，做為吼～軍團的標誌。其它的歐克蠻人首領像往常一樣地模仿他們的軍閥，立刻開始砍頭的狂歡，在艾理法斯撤退之時，將留下來等死的無數秘教徒和星際戰士的頭顱推得老高。
en_text: Gorgutz mounted the skulls of Black Apostle Eliphas and his sorcerers on pikes and had them carried as grisly standards for his Waaagh. The other Orkish chieftains, as ever imitating their warlord, promptly went on an orgy of decapitation, mounting the heads of the countless cultists and Chaos Space Marines left dead when Eliphas withdrew.

tc_text: 在這次勝利之後，戈古茲獲得「惡魔殺手」的稱號。
en_text: In the wake of this victory, Gorgutz assumed the name of Daemonkilla.

tc_text: 鬼魂殺手戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 先知面臨歐克蠻人大軍時，先知塔迪兒或許過於太詭計多端，以致反而對自己不利。戈古茲非常樂於砍殺被她用來做為傀儡的叛變歐克人酋長以及自我催眠的異教徒。戈古茲砸破通往神靈族生魂艦的通道，用一個簡單的套索抓住先知，並且用它扼死她。
en_text: Faced with the Ork horde, Farseer Taldeer was perhaps too wily for her own good. Gorgutz was more than happy to cut through the rebellious Orkish chieftain and self-obsessed heretic she used as dupes. Smashing the gates to the Eldar wraithship, Gorgutz caught the Farseer in a simple noose and strangled her with it.

tc_text: 在洛恩五星上，戈古茲曾經試圖取下塔迪兒的頭，但是失敗了；這次他成功了。當神靈族的脆弱屍體遍佈於提瑞亞的凍土上時，軍閥和他的將士對著夜空嗥叫。因為無法使用神靈族的科技，戈古茲的野獸索性破壞所有找得到的冥骨。
en_text: On Lorn V, Gorgutz had tried and failed to claim Taldeer’s head, but this time he succeeded. As the fragile bodies of the Eldar lay broken across the frozen soil of Tyrea, the warlord and his horde howled at the night sky. Unable to make any real use of Eldar technology, Gorgutz’s beasts simply destroyed every piece of wraithbone they could find.

tc_text: 在這場壯闊的包圍戰之後，戈古茲獲得「鬼魂殺手」的稱號。
en_text: In the wake of this grand sacking, Gorgutz assumed the name Ghostkilla.

tc_text: 滅槍者戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 戈古茲曾經在洛恩五號星上吃過帝國防衛軍的苦頭，因此他把對勝利海灣的攻擊視為報復的機會。令人遺憾的是，戰事總督亞歷山大和他的克諾努斯第一軍團「解放者」無法拒絕戈古茲的要求。歐克蠻人的浪潮掠過荒涼的城市，毫不猶豫地殺死人類。
en_text: Gorgutz had suffered at the hands of the Imperial Guard on Lorn V and saw his assault on Victory Bay as a chance for revenge. Unfortunately, Governor-Militant Alexander and his 1st Kronus Liberators were unable to deny Gorgutz his want. The Ork tide swept through the desolate city, spilling the blood of men with virtual impunity.

tc_text: 等到塵埃落定時，戈古茲和他的歐克技師面對著巨大地獄風暴巨砲的遺跡—它在勝利海灣的機械主教最後採取的行動中受到巨大的破壞。歐克蠻人的惡霸技師對於它們所代表的異教毫不在意，從它的巨大電路中取下所有元件，利用它們來強化其原始的槍械和載具。
en_text: When the smoke cleared, Gorgutz and his Ork meks faced the remains of the great Hellstorm cannon, severely damaged by the desperate last acts of the Techpriests of Victory Bay. Unconcerned with the heresy they enacted, the Ork Mek Boyz scavenged every last component from the great circuits, using and abusing them to add power to their primitive guns and vehicles.

tc_text: 在這次戰鬥之後，戈古茲獲得「滅槍者」的稱號。
en_text: In the wake of this battle, Gorgutz assumed the name Gunsmasha.

tc_text: 死亡殺手戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 由於習於最惡劣的環境，戈古茲的歐克蠻人直接衝進死靈族的可怕墓穴。雖然那些不死戰士殺死極多的歐克蠻人，但這一次，當越來越多的綠色野獸湧進洞穴中時，他們才是被掃盪的一方。當戈古茲引爆造成死靈族洞穴倒塌的巨形炸藥時，也有許多手下一起被壓死。
en_text: Accustomed to the vilest of environments, Gorgutz’ Orks ran headlong into the gruesome catacombs of the Necrons. Although the deathless warriors reaped a massive bounty in Orkish lives, for once it was they who were swept under a ceaseless tide as more and more of the green beasts poured into the caverns. When Gorgutz detonated the massive explosive that brought down the caverns atop the Necrons, he left scores of his boyz to be crushed.

tc_text: 雖然如此，生還者仍然為他們的老大歡呼，即使他們嘲笑他犧牲同伴的無情。獵頭者戈古茲離開楚爾阿畢斯高原時沒有帶著任何新鮮的人頭，只有「死亡殺手」的稱號。
en_text: Nevertheless the survivors cheered their boss, even laughing at the ruthlessness with which he had sacrificed their fellows. Gorgutz Headhunter left the Thur’Abis Plateau without any fresh skulls, but with the new appellation of Deathkilla.

tc_text: 濺血者戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 血鴉軍團參事會在歷史上曾經多次與歐克蠻人對抗，最著名的就是擊潰塔魯斯的巨大歐克軍團。或許因為這個原因，軍閥戈古茲所率領的歐克蠻人特別高興地迎接對北汪迪恩的攻擊行動。在這裡，他們有機會證明自己比其種族最大的敵人還要強壯。
en_text: The Blood Ravens chapter had faced more than a few Ork assaults over its history, notably smashing the great horde on Tartarus. Perhaps because of this, the Orks under Warlord Gorgutz approached the assault on North Vandea with especial glee. Here was their chance to prove themselves stronger than their race’s greatest enemies.

tc_text: 北汪迪恩的勝利令戈古茲損失極大量的小子，但是軍閥很樂於付出這種代價。戈古茲本人將兩個戴著頭盔的星際戰士頭顱插在他可怕的老大杖上，他的隨從也跟著他這麼做。在戰鬥中生還的歐克老大和其他體型較大的歐克蠻人把血鴉軍團的頭盔裝在他們的武器上，或把它們掛在懸帶上作為戰利品。在未來的歲月裡，血鴉軍團的破碎紅色頭盔一直是戈古茲的歐克蠻人心目中最珍視的獎品。
en_text: Victory in North Vandea cost Gorgutz a huge number of his boyz, but the warlord was happy to pay the price. Gorgutz himself mounted two helmeted Space Marine skulls on his gruesome bosspole and his followers emulated him. Many Nobz and other larger Orks who survived the battle mounted Blood Raven helmets on their weapons or wore them on slings as war trophies. In the years to come, the battered red helms of the Blood Ravens would remain the most prized trophy among Gorgutz’ Orks.

tc_text: 至於他自己，軍閥自命為「濺血者」戈古茲，以慶祝他的勝利。
en_text: For himself, the warlord celebrated his victory by taking on the name Gorgutz Bloodspilla.

tc_text: 怒吼者戈古茲
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在抵達克諾努斯之前，軍閥戈古茲已經掠奪過達摩克里斯灣附近的數處鈦星人殖民地。當他派遣一波又一波的小子去攻擊亞沙里斯的鈦星人守軍時，這些經驗給他很大的幫助。歐克蠻族和克魯特之間的血腥混戰顯明這兩個種族的野蠻性格，而戈古茲也樂於送他的歐克蠻人前去死在烈焰戰士的手下，直到他擊潰他們的防線。
en_text: Before his arrival on Kronus, Warlord Gorgutz had raided several other Tau colonies near the Damocles Gulf. This experience served him well as he sent waves of his boyz against the Tau defenders of Asharis. Bloody melees between Orks and Kroot showed the barbarity of both races and Gorgutz was happy to send waves of his Orks to die under Fire Warrior fusillades until he could overwhelm their lines.

tc_text: 但是到最後，亞沙里斯的陷落卻成為戈古茲的挫敗。因為鈦星人軍隊撤退時帶走了乙太導師的屍體，因此歐克蠻人軍閥無法取得他最喜歡的可怕獎品。沒有取得歐內爾的頭顱，使他感受到空前的挫折，而且據說戈古茲親自取出實際下手殺死歐內爾的歐克蠻人的內臟，責備他們沒有看好乙太導師的屍體。
en_text: In the end, however, the fall of Asharis was a frustration for Gorgutz. With the Tau forces retreating and taking the corpse of their Ethereal with them, the Ork Warlord was denied the gruesome trophies he loved so much. His frustration had not having Aun’el’s skull was epic in scope, and Gorgutz is said to have personally eviscerated the Orks who actually killed Aun’el, blaming them for not securing the Ethereal’s corpse.

tc_text: 這種在大勝利之後發出的怒吼聲為戈古茲贏得「怒吼者」的稱號。
en_text: This outburst of pique after a great victory won Gorgutz the name of Ragescreamer.

tc_text: 克諾努斯的軍閥
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 打敗最後的敵人之後，戈古茲的部落獲得克諾努斯的統治地位。軍閥本人沈浸在歐克蠻人的殘忍榮耀裡，被人尊稱為獵頭者、怒吼者、濺血者、死亡殺手、惡魔殺手、滅槍者，以及鬼魂殺手。
en_text: With the last enemy beaten, Gorgutz’s horde reigned supreme on Kronus. The warlord himself had draped himself in the cruel glory of the Orks, being hailed as the Headhunter, the Ragescreamer, the Bloodspilla, the Deathkilla, the Daemonkilla, the Gunsmasha and the Ghostkilla.

tc_text: 歐克蠻人大軍繼續劫掠這顆行星，建造下一支侵略艦隊。戈古茲親自率領那支艦隊，但是克諾努斯一直是一個有歐克蠻人大批出沒世界，軍閥定期回來該處，為下一次的征服徵集軍隊。
en_text: The Orkish horde proceeded to pillage the planet to build their next invasion fleet. Gorgutz himself set off at the head of that fleet, but Kronus remained an Ork-infested world and the Warlord regularly returned there to gather forces for his next conquest.

tc_text: 有這樣一個肥沃的作戰根據地，軍閥將在未來的歲月裡，在帝國的東翼和鈦帝國的領土中開出一條血路。
en_text: With such a fertile base of operations, the Warlord would cut a swath through the Imperium’s eastern fringe and the Tau Empire for years to come.

tc_text: 知識就是力量
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 血鴉軍團參事會的星際戰士抵達克諾努斯，像帝皇的裝甲之拳一樣。奉參事長和主智庫館長之命，年輕的戴維恩．蘇勒隊長命令血鴉軍團對這個世界進行全面的肅清。
en_text: The Space Marines of the Blood Ravens chapter arrived on Kronus like the mailed fist of the Emperor. Acting under orders from his Chapter Master and Chief Librarian, young Brother-Captain Davian Thule ordered the Blood Ravens to carry out a thorough purge of this world.

tc_text: 本章掌握告訴Thule章的古老遺物隱藏在克諾努斯，來自血鴉軍團的神祕的早年的人工製品上。 這些神聖的項目不能被允許分成外國人手。
en_text: The Chapter Master had told Thule that ancient relics of the chapter were hidden on Kronus, artifacts from the mysterious early years of the Blood Raven. These sacred items could not be allowed to fall into alien hands.

tc_text: 蘇勒隊長命令駐紮在勝利海灣方面的帝國防衛軍撤退，但是亞歷山大總督斷然拒絕撤離其部屬。蘇勒認為總督是一個好人，但是除了派他的星際戰士與總督的軍隊和克諾努斯的其它勢力交戰之外，別無選擇。
en_text: Captain Thule ordered the withdrawal of the Imperial Guard forces stationed in Victory Bay, but Governor Alexander flatly refused to pull his men back. Thule judged the Governor a good man, but had little choice but to send his Space Marines to battle the Governor's troops along with all the other powers on Kronus.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團不願意和帝國的士兵作戰，這種想法並非未受重視。開始有傳說克諾努斯上的那些遺物並不神聖，反而是受咒詛的。只有戰爭的勝利者能夠判斷事情的真相。
en_text: The Blood Ravens willingness to fight soldiers of the Imperium did not go unnoticed. Whispers began that the relics on Kronus were more damning than holy. Only the war’s victors would be left to decide the truth of the matter.

tc_text: 對抗黑色使徒
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 血鴉軍團突擊位於迪摩斯半島的黑色神殿，重演赫魯斯異教的悲劇性戰鬥。星際戰士再次與星際戰士交戰，一方堅信帝皇的光明，另一方落入最黑暗的異端。血鴉軍團以熱心面對這次戰鬥，急欲擊倒那些背叛其信念的人。
en_text: The Blood Ravens assault on the black temples of the Deimos Peninsula replayed the tragic battles of the Horus Heresy. Once again, Space Marine fought Space Marine, one side holding true to the Emperor’s light, the other fallen into blackest heresy. The Blood Ravens faced this battle with zeal, anxious to bring down those who had betrayed all they stood for.

tc_text: 最後，血鴉軍團打敗惡魔和叛徒，關閉傳送異端軍隊及黑色使徒的次元傳送門。至於遍佈地面上的褻瀆神殿和令人厭惡的祭壇，參事會的智庫館長將它們編成目錄，並且記錄所有的內容。然後他們負責將這些黑暗神器運回智庫，以便安全地加以摧毀。
en_text: In the end, the Blood Ravens weathered the assault of daemons and traitors alike, closing the Warp gate that was feeding the heretical army and bringing down the fiendish Black Apostle who led it. As for the desecrated temples and foul shrines that dotted the landscape, the Librarians of the chapter catalogued and recorded all their contents. They then undertook the safe transport of these black artifacts to their Librarium, where they could be safely destroyed.

tc_text: 烏斯維的遺址
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在抵達克諾努斯之前不久，血鴉軍團曾在塔塔魯斯和拉希樂園遭受神靈族 欺騙。在提瑞亞，他們以外星人的血為他們死去的弟兄報仇。透過封閉神靈族先知塔迪兒的魍道關口入口，他們斷絕了她逃離的任何可能性。隨之而來的是仔細獵殺提瑞亞裡的所有外星人，終於導致塔迪兒的死亡。
en_text: The Blood Ravens had suffered Eldar trickery on Tartarus and Rahe’s Paradise not long before their arrival on Kronus. In Tyrea, they avenged their fallen battle brothers with alien blood. By sealing the Eldar Farseer Taldeer’s webway portals, they blocked any possibility of her escape. What followed was a careful hunt for every last alien in Tyrea, culminating in the death of Taldeer herself.

tc_text: 至於參事會的智庫館長，他們將戰後的許多時間用來研究神靈族召喚的可怕惡魔的遺體。這個所謂的「凱因戰神分身」—一個瀆神的異星神祇的野蠻化身—在戰鬥最熾熱之時化為碎片。書記安提亞斯是克諾努斯上的資深智庫館長，負責確保所有碎片都被收集，編入目錄並且後送到智庫。多年之後，這個作法為血鴉軍團惹來不少麻煩。
en_text: The chapter’s Librarians, for their part, spent much of the aftermath of the battle studying the remains of the fearsome daemon summoned up by the Eldar. This so-called Avatar of Khaine – the savage incarnation of a blasphemous alien god – crumbled into inert matter at the battle’s apex. Epistolary Anteas, senior Librarian on Kronus, made sure that each piece was collected, catalogued and shipped back to the chapter Librarium. In later years, this would cause the Blood Ravens no small amount of trouble.

tc_text: 忠實的報酬
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 當血鴉軍團在勝利海灣將戰事總督的宮殿夷為平地時，他們也結束了帝國內部的一場悲哀衝突。蘇勒隊長和亞歷山大總督都聽從其上級的命令行動，當這些命令使他們發生衝突時，雙方都不能後退。蘇勒隊長和牧師麥可魯斯甚至於因為被殺死的總督忠於其命令而大加稱揚。由於他的死，他們安排將生還的防衛軍運輸離開這個世界。大多數人被送到區域指揮部，見證他們的所做所為令他們的軍團感到自豪。
en_text: When the Blood Ravens leveled the Governor-Militant's palace in Victory Bay, they brought an end to a sad conflict within the Imperium. Both Captain Thule and Governor Alexander were acting under orders of their superiors and neither could back down when those orders brought them into conflict. Captain Thule and Chaplain Mikelus went so far as to praise the slain Governor for his stalwart dedication to his orders. With his death, they arranged for the transport of the surviving Guardsmen off world. Most were sent toward Segmentum Command with testimonials that they had done their regiment proud.

tc_text: 血鴉軍團對於第五連的叛變防衛軍則較不寬容。雖然這些人在政戰軍官吉貝特死亡時，曾經大喊自己對帝皇的死亡天使效忠，但是星際戰士並未向他們表示憐憫。事實上，這些士兵拿起武器來對抗自己的軍團，而血鴉軍團判決他們是叛徒，應被處決。
en_text: The Blood Ravens were less forgiving to the rebellious Guardsmen of the 5th Company. Although these men had shouted their loyalty to the Emperor’s Angels of Death upon the death of Commissar Gebbet, the Space Marines showed them no favor. Indeed, these Guardsmen had taken up arms against their regiment and the Blood Ravens judged them traitors to be executed.

tc_text: 但是星際戰士最大的怒火則落在破壞地獄風暴巨砲、沒有讓它落入參事會手中的機械主教身上。倖存而獲審問的惟一一名工程師宣稱他做了他該做的事，以防巨砲落入不配擁有之人的手中。
en_text: The Space Marines greatest ire, however, was reserved for the Techpriests who sabotaged the great Hellstorm cannon rather than have it fall into the chapter's hands. The one Enginseer who survived to be interrogated claimed he had done what he must to keep the cannon from unworthy hands.

tc_text: 軍閥的殞落
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 就像在塔塔魯斯一樣，血鴉軍團精確地攻擊克諾努斯的歐克蠻人核心。奉派深入綠色海岸最深處的星際戰士以彈幕和真正帝國士兵的信心迎向綠色的浪潮。沼澤都被歐克蠻人的血染紅，一個又一個營地毀在血鴉軍團的肅清戰鬥中。
en_text: As they had on Tartarus, the Blood Ravens cut with surgical precision into the heart of the Ork horde on Kronus. The hardened Space Marines sent into the depths of the Green Coast answered the green tide with waves of bolter fire and the faith of true soldiers of the Imperium. The swamps ran red with the blood of Orks, as camp after camp fell to the Blood Ravens’ purge.

tc_text: 軍閥戈古茲竟能逃離克諾努斯，令蘇勒隊長感到極為沈重。他推測（後來證時是正確的）總有一天，歐克蠻人會再度回來造成帝國的困擾。為了確保沒有其他的歐克蠻人倖存，蘇勒下令進行大規模的焦土作戰，燒掉成千上萬畝的叢林，澈底地消滅歐克蠻人。
en_text: That Warlord Gorgutz managed to escape Kronus weighed heavily on Captain Thule. He surmised (correctly as it turned out) that the Ork would someday return to plague the Imperium again. In an effort to make sure no other Orks survived, Thule ordered a massive scorched earth campaign, burning hundreds of thousands of square kilometers of jungle to purge the Ork once and for all.

tc_text: 勝過死亡
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 對楚爾阿畢斯高原下方的死靈族墓穴進行的最後攻擊，在血鴉軍團中成為傳奇。深入陰森的底層社會，戰鬥弟兄們一定感覺與帝皇之光完全隔絕。雖然如此，他們以帝國最優秀的勇氣和武力進行戰鬥，用神聖的火焰燃燒所有生命的敵人。
en_text: The final assault against the Necrons in the catacombs under the Thur’Abis Plateau became the thing of legend among the Blood Ravens. Descending into that sepulchral underworld, the battle brothers must have felt cut off from the Emperor’s light altogether. Nevertheless, they fought with all the courage and steel of the Imperium’s finest, bringing holy fire to the enemies of all life.

tc_text: 從燒焦的地底世界生還的弟兄在他們的盔甲上繪上一個小小的長形頭骨，象徵死去的死靈族敵人。參事會的第二連（他們是進入楚爾阿畢斯高原的主要部隊）則在其紋章中加入死靈族的頭骨，並遵循「勝過死亡」這句格言。
en_text: Those brothers who emerged from that charnel underworld marked their armors with a small elongated skull, emblematic of their fallen Necron foes. The chapter’s second company, which contributed most of the forces sent into Thur’Abis, would add the Necron skull to its heraldry and adopt the motto “Victory Over Death.”

tc_text: 亞沙里斯的潔淨
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在較早的達摩克里斯灣聖戰期間，鈦星帝國擊退降落在克諾努斯的超新星戰士。在對亞沙里斯的攻擊中，血鴉軍團不只是為超新星戰士復仇而已。
en_text: During the earlier Damocles Gulf Crusade, the Tau Empire had repelled the Novamarines who landed on Kronus. In their assault on Asharis, the Blood Ravens more than avenged the Novamarines’ defeat.

tc_text: 就像第三連在塔塔魯斯的馬格納波南戰役中一樣，血鴉軍團第四連在亞沙里斯的街道上戰鬥，一次一街區地打開一條出路，用鋼鐵般的決心將鈦星人的烈焰戰士和克魯特掠食者擊退。 不過鈦司令官凱斯順利地騙走血鴉軍團的一項獎勵，就是乙太導師席歐雷斯的屍體；若是落入血鴉軍團的手中，必然會被送到智庫去進行研究。結果當鈦星人撤回被殺的乙太導師的屍體時，藥劑師哥迪恩花了許多天，收集留下來的外星人血樣。
en_text: Much as the third company had during the Battle of Magna Bonum on Tartarus, the Blood Ravens fourth company fought its way through the streets of Asharis one block at a time, pushing back at the Tau Fire Warriors and Kroot carnivores with steely determination. The Tau Commander Kais did manage, however, to cheat the Blood Ravens of one prize, namely the body of the Ethereal Shi’ores, which would undoubtedly have ended up under study in the chapter Librarium and Apothecarion. As it was, Apothecary Gordion spent many days collecting the alien blood samples left behind when the Tau withdrew with the corpse of their slain Ethereal.

tc_text: 黑暗浪潮
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在多漫長而血腥的戰鬥之後，血鴉軍團終於完成克諾努斯行星的肅清任務。戰鬥駁船「憤怒禱文」一直停留在近距離軌道中，嚴格禁止任何人前往該世界，而第五連則在北汪迪恩維護修道院要塞。
en_text: After many long and bloody battles, the Blood Ravens finally completed their purge of the Planet Kronus. The Battle Barge Litany of Fury remained in close orbit, imposing a strict prohibition on any visits to the world, while the fifth company maintained the Castellum Incorruptus in North Vandea.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍的區域指揮部針對血鴉軍團的行動提出抗議，向審問團舉發他們。血鴉軍團成功為其行動辯護，使他們的審問者確信亞歷山大將軍本應接受血鴉軍團的命令並且撤軍。
en_text: The Imperial Guard’s Segmentum Command lodged protest for the Blood Ravens actions, reporting them to the Inquisition. The Blood Ravens successfully defended their actions, convincing their interrogators that General Alexander should have bowed to the Blood Ravens orders and withdrawn.

tc_text: 儘管如此，審問團繼續監視參事會，因為關於遺物被暗藏起來的謠言從來不曾完全平息過。同樣地，防衛軍建築中有許多人永遠忘不了灑在克諾努斯上的血跡。
en_text: Nevertheless, the Inquisition kept a watchful eye on the chapter, for the rumors of hoarded relics never fully abated. Likewise, many in the Guard's command structure never forgot the blood shed on Kronus.

tc_text: 而且事實上，該參事會最黑暗的歷史就在戰爭結束後不久開始。
en_text: And indeed, the darkest time in the chapter’s history began soon after the war’s end.

tc_text: 為了更大的良善
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 死靈族的興起，以及其他勢力來到克諾努斯行星，對於鈦星帝國來說都是不容忽視的強大威脅。根據他們以所謂的「更大的良善」為中心而建立的誡律，鈦星人不能容許眼看著一個繁榮的殖民地被奪走。
en_text: The rise of the Necrons and the arrival of other powers on Kronus was a threat the Tau Empire could not ignore. With their doctrine built firmly around the so-called Greater Good, the Tau could not tolerate seeing a thriving colony taken away from them.

tc_text: 乙太導師是帝國的領袖階層，他們回應克諾努斯的求救信號，派遣最優秀、最聰明的部隊前來奪回這個世界。歐內爾．席歐雷斯是新一代乙太導師階級中最獲讚美的人；他要負責恢復這個遙遠世界的秩序。和他一起來是軍事將領沙索．凱斯。凱斯是普瓦泰德指揮官的教導學員之一，他帶來為數眾多的烈焰級戰士，以及鈦星的聯盟種族：克魯特和胡蜂的輔助兵力。
en_text: The Ethereals, leaders of the empire, responded to the distress signals from Kronus by sending some of their best and brightest to retake the world. Aun’el Shi’ores was among the most lauded of a new generation of the Ethereal caste; he would be responsible for restoring proper order to this wayward world. With him came the military leader Shas'o Kais. A student of the teachings of Commander Puretide, O’Kais brought a massive force of Fire Caste warriors as well as auxiliaries from the Tau’s allied races, the Kroot and Vespid.

tc_text: 鈦星人的地面部隊在塔辛恩（或者應該使用它正確的帝國名字：亞沙里斯）降落，並從那裡開始進行奪回行星的聖戰。
en_text: Tau ground forces landed in the city of Tash’n (or Asharis to use its true Imperial name) and from there began the crusade to retake the planet as a whole.

tc_text: 混沌的污點
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 來到克諾努斯的鈦星人還不曾和混沌軍團發生過任何大型戰鬥，不知道等候他們的是何種瘋狂。雖然如此，凱斯的軍隊堅定地防守，拒絕對惡魔和異教徒讓步。軍隊向前推進，終於干擾了令混沌星際戰士到達克諾努斯的黑色魔法。多少算是奇蹟的是，在攻擊過程中，沒有任何一個鈦星人士兵落入次元的異教信仰中。
en_text: The Tau forces who came to Kronus had not fought any major battles against the agents of Chaos and could not know the madness that awaited them. Nevertheless, O’Kais’s forces held strong, refusing to give into the daemons and heretics. The force pushed forward and finally disrupted the black enchantment that had brought the Chaos Space Marines to Kronus. Somewhat miraculously, not a single of the Tau soldiers fell into Warp heresy during the assault.

tc_text: 但是在這次戰鬥結束後，烈焰級的士兵開始難以明白他們所看到的情形。歐內爾．席歐雷斯迅速採取行動，以保護他的軍隊不受異教的影響。他下令剷平半島上所有的建築物及儀式神器，並將地區封鎖，派兵駐守。吃過死亡的星際戰士和異教徒的克魯特掠食者則被殘酷追捕，以免污染進入他們的基因內。
en_text: In the wake of this battle, however, the soldiers of the Fire Caste struggled to understand just what they had witnessed. Aun’el Shi’ores acted quickly to preserve his forces against the power of heresy. He ordered that all structures and ritual artifacts on the peninsula be leveled and the area sealed off under guard. Kroot carnivores who had partaken of the flesh of dead Chaos Space Marines and cultists were ruthlessly hunted down lest the taint make its way into their gene-matrix.

tc_text: 工藝世界的祕密
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 暗黑聖戰代表鈦星帝國和神靈族之間的第一次大規模衝突。這兩個外星人勢力都偏好速度和匿蹤，二者都利用多種非人類的技術。最後，年輕壓制年長者，凱斯的軍隊在提瑞亞打敗神靈族。
en_text: The Dark Crusade represented one of the first major clashes between the Tau Empire and Eldar forces. Both alien powers favored speed and stealth, and both employed a variety of inhuman technologies. Ultimately, the young surpassed the old and O’Kais’s forces overran the Eldar in Tyrea.

tc_text: 鈦星人部隊非常熱心學習神靈族的技術祕密。必須等到克諾努斯上的敵意消珥，雙方才能協商釋放神靈族囚犯的事直。同時，洪水級的外交官則和所有的神靈族囚犯進行廣泛的詢問。在這同時，大地級科學家則解剖分析神靈族的技術。雖然鈦星人迅速分析了神靈族的雷射和手裡劍武器，但是比較特殊的武器（例如以次元為動力的扭曲加農砲）以及許多神靈族建築所採用的冥骨材料的本質，都比較難以解讀。
en_text: The Tau forces were very keen to learn the secrets of Eldar technologies. Negotiations for the release of Eldar prisoners could begin only after hostilities ended on Kronus. In the meantime, Water caste diplomats conducted extensive interviews with all Eldar prisoners. Earth caste scientists, meanwhile, dissected and analyzed the technologies of the Eldar. Although the Tau quickly analyzed Eldar laser and shuriken weapons, more esoteric weapons like the Warp-powered distort cannon and the nature of the wraithbone material used in so much Eldar construction proved much harder to crack.

tc_text: 對抗帝國
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 雖然在克諾努斯上的其他勢力以徹底滅絕的手段威脅鈦星人，但是以勝利海灣為中心的帝國防衛軍所威脅的是鈦星人統治這個世界的合法性。由於外星人對自己的目的有無法動搖的信心，因此在許多方面而言，這是更大的威脅，凱斯便率領軍隊進入勝利海灣，以聖戰士之姿對抗異教。這場戰役最後打破戰事總督亞歷山大的軍隊所設立的防線。
en_text: Although other powers on Kronus threatened the Tau forces there with outright extermination, the Imperial Guard forces centered in Victory Bay threatened the legitimacy of the Tau claim to the world. Given the aliens’ unshakable faith in their own cause, this was in many ways the greater threat and O’Kais led his forces into Victory Bay as crusaders against heresy more than anything. This drive ultimately overcame the defenses set up by Governor-Militant Alexander's forces.

tc_text: 在戰鬥結束後，鈦星人聚攏倖存的防衛軍，並建立一個再教育營地，試圖使他們背叛神皇，接受鈦星人的理想。很多人抵抗，最值得注意的是有一支卡舍津小隊逃進鄉間，並發動一場小型的游擊戰役，但是其他人都屈服了，將他們所知的一切都告訴鈦星人。在將來的歲月裡，當鈦星人攻擊多個星球的弱點時，帝國的軍隊將有理由去除掉這一次的背叛行為。
en_text: In the aftermath of the battle, the Tau rounded up the surviving Guardsmen and established a reeducation camp in an attempt to make them betray the God Emperor and embrace the Tau cause. Many resisted, most notably a Kasrkin squad which managed to escape into the countryside and launch a small guerilla campaign, but others succumbed and surrendered all they knew to the Tau. In the years to come, the forces of the Imperium would have reason to rue this last betrayal as Tau forces struck at weak points on several planets.

tc_text: 古代技術
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 凱斯攻進死靈族墓穴，主要是倚靠其部隊的匿蹤和速度，得以將一顆融合炸彈放進不死敵人的勢力核心。他的作戰成功了，雖然他拋下許多士兵。
en_text: O’Kais’s drive into the Necron catacombs relied heavily on the stealth and speed of his forces to deliver a fusion bomb to the heart of the deathless enemy’s power. His gambit succeeded, although he left many soldiers behind him.

tc_text: 在戰鬥結束後，歐內爾．席歐雷斯下令在楚爾阿畢斯高原興建巨大的研究設施。在烈焰戰士的保護下，大地級科學家開始研究死靈族使用的技術，進度緩慢。少數沒有消失的死靈族武器和被擊碎的戰士則受到非常密切的調查。鈦星人帝國是否能夠利用這種古老和令人生厭的技術，無法確知， 但是他們的武器繼續發展，非常令在戰鬥過程中面對他們的帝國軍隊感到氣憤。
en_text: In the wake of the battle, Aun’el Shi’ores directed the creation of a vast research complex on the Thur’Abis Plateau. Under the protection of Fire Warriors, the scientists of the Earth caste began the slow process of studying the technology used by the Necrons. The few pieces of Necron weaponry and smashed warriors that did not fade out of existence were subjected to very close scrutiny indeed. Whether or not the Tau Empire was ever able to make use of this ancient and loathsome technology is unknown, but their weaponry continues to advance, much to the chagrin of the Imperial forces facing them in combat.

tc_text: 叢林戰爭
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 在暗黑聖戰之前，傳奇的鈦司令官遠見已經在克諾努斯領導軍隊數十載，並且擊散了軍閥骨卡拉卡的歐克蠻人部族。凱斯研究遠見的戰術，並且應用在對綠色海岸的攻擊中。透過消滅軍閥戈古茲，他使歐克蠻人陷入內戰的循環中，有效地令他們不介入克諾努斯的戰鬥。
en_text: The legendary Tau Commander Farsight had led troops on Kronus some decades before the Dark Crusade and had smashed the Ork horde of the Warboss Bonekraka. O’Kais studied Farsight’s tactics and used them in his assault on the Green Coast. By eliminating Warlord Gorgutz, he plunged the Ork horde into a cycle of infighting that effectively took them out of the battle for Kronus.

tc_text: 但是，歐內爾．席歐雷斯對於克諾努斯的叢林裡仍有大批野生歐克蠻人出沒感到不快。即使仍然繼續與其他對手進行戰鬥，乙太導師仍命令許多烈焰戰士和克魯特掠食者去獵殺剩下的歐克蠻人，一次奪回一平方公里的叢林。在追捕歐克蠻人方面，克魯特的表現最好，他們接管這些地區的大部分生態系統以獵殺歐克蠻人。很快地，克諾努斯的叢林就像克魯特的家鄉世界。
en_text: Still, Aun’el Shi’ores was hardly pleased that Kronus’s jungle remained infested with feral Orks. Even with other opponents still to fight, the Ethereal directed significant numbers of Fire Warriors and Kroot carnivores to hunt the remaining Orks, taking back one square kilometer of jungle at a time. The Kroot proved the most successful here, taking over much of the ecosystems of these areas in order to hunt down the Orks. Soon, the jungles of Kronus resembled the Kroot home world of Pech more than anything.

tc_text: 敵人的遺物
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 鈦星人和星際戰士曾經在達摩克里斯灣聖戰期間於克諾努斯上發生過衝突，但都是小型的打帶跑作戰。鈦星人對北汪迪恩的攻擊行動則完全是另外一回事；凱斯率領其部隊，攻擊防禦工事良好、防禦精良的血鴉軍團。帝皇的戰士，星際戰士殺死許多鈦星人和克魯特，但是無法阻擋凱斯的人潮。當血鴉軍團離開克諾努斯時，許多最優秀的士兵陣亡於北汪迪恩。
en_text: Tau forces and Space Marines had clashed on Kronus during the Damocles Gulf crusade, but these had been small hit and run engagements. The Tau assault on North Vandea was something else altogether, with O’Kais leading his troops in an assault on the entrenched and well-defended Blood Ravens. Warriors of the Emperor, the Space Marines left many Tau and Kroot dead, but were unable to hold back O’Kais’s tide. When the Blood Ravens left Kronus, many of their finest soldiers lay dead in North Vandea.

tc_text: 歐內爾．席歐雷斯在血鴉軍團身上看到他認為最惡劣的人類帝國。乙太導師認為他們的信仰根本就是瘋狂，他們對克諾努斯的肅清作戰則是全球性的謀殺行為。因此他決定保留北汪迪恩的星際戰士要塞遺跡，讓銀河各種族看見反對更大的良善會有何種下場。
en_text: In the Blood Ravens, Aun’el Shi’ores saw what he considered the worst of the Imperium of Man. The Ethereal called their faith madness and their purge of Kronus murder on a global scale. He chose thus to preserve the remains of the Space Marine fortress in North Vandea as an example of the opposition the Greater Good faced in the wider galaxy.

tc_text: 第三星域成長
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「暗黑聖戰：第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “Dark Crusade: A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 攻破最後一座敵人要塞之後，鈦星人對克諾努斯的統治權再次穩固。從鈦星人家鄉派遣前來的特遣隊留在星球上負責保護，過後不久有更多的開拓者和殖民者從帝國各地前來。留在克諾努斯的人類發現生活異常艱難—有許多人歡迎帝國回來統治，現在發現自己必須接受再教育或其它懲罰。
en_text: With the last enemy stronghold broken, the Tau hold on Kronus became secure once again. The task force sent from the Tau home world remained on the planet to secure it, and soon thereafter further waves of settlers and colonists arrived from across the empire. The humans left on Kronus found life increasingly difficult for them – many had embraced the Imperial return and now found themselves subject to reeducation or other penalties.

tc_text: 鈦星人和克魯特的密集殖民動作導致人口組合迅速變動，黑暗聖戰之後十年內，人類人口減少到未達總人口的5%。雖然沒有公開宣佈這種現象，但事實上人類在克諾努斯的生育率也突然下降。一部份原因是鈦星人成立的單性別再教育營地，但是也有可能是外星人進行某種絕育計劃—都為了所謂的更大的良善。
en_text: Intensive colonization by Tau and Kroot led to a rapid demographic swing, with the human population dwindling to less than 5% a decade after the Dark Crusade. Although no public announcements were ever made to this effect, it seems clear that human births on Kronus also dropped precipitously. In part this is due to the single-gender reeducation camps imposed by the Tau, but it is also possible that the alien powers undertook some form of sterilization project – all for the so-called Greater Good.

tc_text: .無論事實真相為何，克羅諾斯被公認為是所謂的「第三星域」的大本營，該星球上雖有人類居住，但只是少數民族。
en_text: Whatever the truth, when Kronus was admitted as a full sept of the so-called Third Sphere, its human population was but a footnote.

tc_text: 混沌第一次驅使星際戰士彼此對抗，是在赫魯斯異端事件時期。克諾努斯目睹這場可怕戰鬥的一部份，而那些古代的異教徒也留下他們可怕的戰爭兵器。
en_text: It was during the Horus Heresy that the influence of Chaos first drove Space Marine against Space Marine. Kronus witnessed some of this terrible fighting and the heretics of those ancient times left behind them terrible artifacts.

tc_text: 在荒涼的艾瑞惡地上就有這樣一個紀念物，那是血神恐虐的一尊古老雕像。當戰爭再次橫掃克諾努斯之時，雕像內的一個惡魔醒了過來。它吞吃在戰鬥中身亡之人的靈魂，並且允諾要賞賜給那些滿足他的血腥渴求的人。
en_text: In the desolate Eres Badlands stood one such talisman, an ancient icon of the Blood God Khorne. With war sweeping Kronus once more, a daemon within the icon awoke. It fed on the souls of those slain in combat and promised gifts to whoever would slake its thirst for blood.

tc_text: 即使是帝國的戰士，當他們在艾瑞惡地戰鬥，以阻止其他人取得這項獎賞之時，自己也成了這個惡魔的食物。忠誠者試圖不去理會惡魔放在他們腦海中的微小聲音，但是每個死亡之人仍然成為它的黑暗糧食。
en_text: Even the warriors of the Imperium ended up feeding the fiend as they fought across the Badlands to prevent others from claiming this prize. The faithful tried to ignore the whispers the daemon slipped into their minds, but every death still fed its dark appetite.

tc_text: 到最後，只要控制了艾瑞惡地，就能獲得那個惡魔的一部份怒氣，使他們在攻擊敵人之後能夠再度發動攻擊。
en_text: In the end, whoever controlled the Eres Badlands would gain a measure of the daemon’s fury, allowing them to launch attack after attack against their enemies.

en_text: Beset on all sides by the tides of war, this once-quiet colony became a savage battlefield.

tc_text: 七個種族在這個世界上發生大規模的衝突，每個種族都拒絕撤退，每個種族都相信自己的所做所為是正確的。
en_text: Seven armies clashed on this one world, each refusing to back down, each convinced it was in the right.

tc_text: 從克諾努斯中央沙漠的沙地下面出現的是死靈族，他們是定意消滅所有生靈的古代機械。
en_text: From beneath the sands of Kronus’s central desert came the Necrons, ancient machines bent on eradicating all life.

tc_text: 但是另外一個邪惡勢力也早已經將其目光轉移到這個行星。從次元的最深處，混沌的惡魔部隊前來實現其主張。
en_text: But another evil already had its eyes on the planet. From the depths of the Warp, the daemonic forces of Chaos arrived to enforce their claim.

tc_text: 為了抵抗這些可怕的勢力，這個星球的鈦星帝國統治者派遣其精英戰士和精密的戰鬥裝甲投入戰場。
en_text: To oppose these fearsome powers, the planet’s rulers in the Tau Empire sent their elite soldiers and sophisticated battlesuits into the fray.

tc_text: 強大的人類帝國則派出帝國防衛軍，為了神皇的榮耀前來佔領克諾努斯。
en_text: From the mighty Imperium of Man came the Imperial Guard, there to secure Kronus for the glory of the God Emperor.

tc_text: 就像綠色狂潮一樣，歐克蠻人也來到克諾努斯，毫不理會其他人的宣告，只管灑下破壞的種子。
en_text: Like a green tide, the Ork horde descended on Kronus, caring little for others’ claims and sowing destruction in its wake.

tc_text: 死靈族的古代世仇神靈族也從他們的魍道關口中現身，在克諾努斯上追求自己的目標。
en_text: The Eldar, ancient enemies of the Necrons, emerged from their Webway to pursue their own agenda on Kronus.

tc_text: 最後出現的是星際戰士，帝國士兵當中最優秀、最堅強的戰士。看到這個滿是外星人和異教徒的世界，他們開始一場大規模的潔淨作戰。
en_text: And last came the Space Marines, finest and most uncompromising of the Imperium’s soldiers. Seeing a world beset by aliens and heretics, they undertook a great purge.

tc_text: 黑暗聖戰已經開始了。只有在一個種族獲得全面的勝利，並且消滅其他種族之時，這場戰爭才能結束。
en_text: A Dark Crusade had begun. It could only end with the total victory of one of these factions, and the total defeat of all others.
