tc_text: 裝甲攻擊
引用自書記馬可斯．歐瑞斯提斯所著之「第二次克諾努斯戰爭記事」：
en_text: From “A Relation of the Second Kronus War” by Scriba Marcus Orestes:

tc_text: 雖然本地的工人從來不曾了解這件事，但是克諾努斯的海必里恩山峰的礦場裡藏有功能強大的礦石精煉機器，是火星的機械主教留下來的。在暗黑聖戰期間，這些古老的礦石處理及機械製造廠和戰場製造廠發揮了實質的作用。
en_text: Although the local workers never realized it, the mines of Kronus's Hyperion Peaks featured powerful ore refining machines left there by the Tech-Priests of Mars. These ancient ore-processing and field-manufacturing plants took on a more martial aspect during the Dark Crusade.

tc_text: 事實上，這些設備可以相當容易地用來生產軍事建築，或是在戰場上進行建造時所需要的加工材料。因此控制這座設施的人就有能力在克諾努斯各地推進時，迅速建立前進基地。
en_text: Indeed, these same devices could, with relative ease, be made to produce military structures or the processed materials needed to assemble them in the field. Those in control of this facility thus gained the ability to rapidly build forward bases as they pushed across Kronus.

tc_text: 然而海必里恩山峰是一個艱難的戰場，與標準的補給線隔離甚遠。試圖佔領礦場的人被迫派遣一支裝甲部隊深入，奉命破壞敵人所有的建築。在沒有援軍的情況下，坦克的指揮官必須憑藉自己的力量。
en_text: The Peaks were a difficult battlefield, however, isolated from standard supply lines. Those trying to take the mines were forced to send in a single armored column ordered to wipe out all enemy structures. Without reinforcements, the tank commanders were on their own.

tc_text: 雖然本地的工人從來不曾了解這件事，但是克諾努斯的海必里恩山峰的礦場裡藏有功能強大的礦石精煉機器，是火星的機械主教留下來的。在暗黑聖戰期間，這些古老的礦石處理及機械製造廠和戰場製造廠發揮了實質的作用。事實上，這些設備可以相當容易地用來生產軍事建築，或是在戰場上進行建造時所需要的加工材料。因此控制這座設施的人就有能力在克諾努斯各地推進時，迅速建立前進基地。然而海必里恩山峰是一個艱難的戰場，與標準的補給線隔離甚遠。試圖佔領礦場的人被迫派遣一支裝甲部隊深入，奉命破壞敵人所有的建築。在沒有援軍的情況下，坦克的指揮官必須憑藉自己的力量。
en_text: Although the local workers never realized it, the mines of Kronus's Hyperion Peaks featured powerful ore refining machines left there by the Tech-Priests of Mars. These ancient ore-processing and field-manufacturing plants took on a more martial aspect during the Dark Crusade. Indeed, these same devices could, with relative ease, be made to produce military structures or the processed materials needed to assemble them in the field. Those in control of this facility thus gained the ability to rapidly build forward bases as they pushed across Kronus. The Peaks were a difficult battlefield, however, isolated from standard supply lines. Those trying to take the mines were forced to send in a single armored column ordered to wipe out all enemy structures. Without reinforcements, the tank commanders were on their own.

在薩瑪北方荒地的一座大都市，現在已經變成了戰鬥修女、神聖玫瑰團的分部。看來修女們選擇它來作為一個象徵：一個矗立在荒原地的帝國聖典。
en_text: Adrift in the barren northern lands of Sama stands a single metropolis, which has now become a Preceptory of the Sisters of Battle, Order of the Sacred Rose. Most likely the Sisters chose this city for its symbolism: a proud testament to the Imperium rising out of a dusty wasteland.

tc_text: 在戰鬥修女到達之前，薩瑪行政區是軍團的帝國防衛軍駐紮最少的地方。野蠻的獵捕遊戲，活絡的東—西貿易，以及僕役的輸出支撐了這個地方的人口，他們帶著近乎是崇敬的的恐懼迎接了戰鬥修女的到來。
en_text: Prior to the arrival of the Sisters of Battle, the Sama District was one of the regions least dependant on the Imperial Guard presence. Wild game hunting, active East-West trade, and domestic manufacture had supported an independent population that welcomed the Sisters of Battle with nearly as much reverence as fear.

tc_text: 皇帝的忠實僕人和薩瑪的市民啊，這個鄉下地方已經宣告納入戰鬥修女—真實的艾克黎西亞奇之手的管轄之中。從現在開始，為了我們神聖的任務和償還皇帝的愛，你們必須奉獻出所有的資產、食物、和財富。
en_text: Faithful servants of the Emperor and citizens of Sama, this provincial realm is hereby claimed and annexed unto the right and pious cause of the Sisters of Battle, acting as a hand of the One True Ecclesiarchy. Be assured that all property, sustenance, and chattel you are compelled to donate to our holy cause will be repaid by the Emperor’s love, now and hereafter.

tc_text: 注意，對神聖皇帝保持著忠貞和正直的人是不需要害怕的。只有腐敗、異類和異教徒將會被聖火給洗淨。任何想要自白並求取神聖救贖的人，應該在1000時向莫夏廣場的新分團總部報告。想要加入弗拉特里斯自衛隊的虔誠者應該在0950時報到。
en_text: Be advised that no one who is righteous and holds his allegiance to the God-Emperor need be alarmed. Only the corrupt, the mutant, and the heretic shall perish in flames. Any wishing to confess themselves up front, and pass swiftly into blessed redemption should report to the new Preceptory headquarters, in Moksha Square, at 1000 hours, sharp. Devout individuals wishing to join the Frateris Militia should report at 0950 hours.

tc_text: 這個在考拉瓦一號東部邊緣的龐大城市，在最近變成了戰鬥修女的併吞物。儘管還沒有發生大規模的衝突，而它北方的區域已經靜悄悄的被戰鬥修女所管轄了。
en_text: This eastern edge of Kaurava I’s leviathan city has recently begun to experience annexation by the Sisters of Battle. Although no outright conflict has yet taken place, its northern sectors have been quietly claimed by the Sisterhood.

tc_text: 在戰鬥修女和帝國防衛軍之間的衝突最後還是發生在這個城市的區域，讓這個城市大部分區域的百姓大量的逃離，前往鄰近的區域來尋求避難。
en_text: Conflict between the Sisters of Battle and the Imperial Guard has occurred of late in this area of the city. As a result, the populace of the cities and suburbs of the province have largely fled, seeking refuge in neighboring provinces.

我要求制訂的戒律的關鍵，在於行政部門跟軍事部門彼此之間的表達方式。我將會不斷的提醒這一點的重要性。這些一定都會發生，儘管我們必須劃分彼此的功能性，但絕對不能去劃分我們的目標。
en_text: Key among the precepts I require enacted is that administratum and military forums find mutual expression. I will repeat this as many times as necessary to get the point across. This must happen, we cannot have divisions in purpose, although we must be divided in function.

tc_text: 在這結束之後，第19、37跟第4區域間的管道將會擴張，讓杜薩拉和凡阿薩之間的聯絡將會更更順暢。我已經命令加強在維拉塔河的防禦工作了。
en_text: To this end the aqueducts in sectors 19, 37, and 4 will be expanded to accommodate better converse between Dussala and Vyasa. I have already ordered the embankments on the Virata River fortified.

tc_text: 此外，就像在阿堤拉一樣，城市外圍的區域也將會列入管轄，所有的基礎建設都用來建構一個新的太空站。在所有的努力之下，我們將會讓我們的世界籠罩在皇帝的光輝之下。
en_text: Furthermore, the outer urban areas will be properly districted, just as on Attila, and the foundation-work laid for an additional space-port, with full shipping and military capacities. By these and other such efforts, we will make our world redound to the glory of the God-Emperor.

tc_text: 杜薩拉是在考拉瓦一號南方所形成的大城市，它同時也是這個星系中帝國防衛軍的指揮中心，第252守護者軍團的家鄉。
en_text: Dussala forms the southern stretch of the great leviathan city of Kaurava I. It is also the central headquarters of the Imperial Guard presence of the system, proud home of the 252nd Conservator Regiment.

tc_text: 軍人和市民們混雜的遍佈在杜薩拉中，和平的相處在一起。而幾乎所有杜薩拉的家庭，都至少一個孩子被徵召加入252軍團。
en_text: Throughout Dussala, military and civilian life have blended remarkably well. There are few Dussalan families without at least one son enlisted in the 252nd.

注意，杜薩拉的人們：
經由軍事總督史塔伯斯的輔助執行官所下的命令，我們歡愉的宣布...明日的1100時，在第252守護者軍團跟重軍備正式部署之前，將會舉行正式的遊行。所有人都必須出席參加，日蝕日報期待全部人的到場。將有一萬名的個帝國防衛軍士兵參加遊行，還有剛剛抵達、才從前線回來的卡舍津軍團。
en_text: As per the orders of Governer-General Stubbs’ sub-auxilliary executive commissioner of planetary affairs, we are pleased to announce… that tomorrow at 1100 hours there will be a formal parade of 252nd Conservator troops and heavy armor, before they are deployed to the field of battle. Attendance is mandatory. Daily Eclipse editorial looks forward to seeing you all there. Among the parade retinue will be 10,000 Guardsmen, two refitted Baneblades, and a newly arrived company of Kasrkin Guard, direct from the frontlines on Cadia.

tc_text: 你們將出現為我們的部隊祈求平安。十二支列隊進行的部隊將會演奏帝國的聖樂，女武神級運輸機也將表演空中列隊行進。我們被要求要提醒你們要臣服所有的帝國部隊，他們將被授權用武力來回應任何的挑釁。
en_text: You will come and wish our troops well. Twelve processional troops will play anthems of the Imperium, and Valkyries will perform flying maneuvers overhead. We have been asked to remind you to heed all Adeptus Arbites direction immediately, as they are authorized to respond with force of arms.

tc_text: 在考拉瓦一號的中心是卡拉瓦城，這是一個大城市，事實上，是在杜薩拉跟凡斯塔斯坦之間最大的城市。考拉瓦城是帝國文化在這個星系中最最繁盛的地方，是它的首府、所有最偉大的學府、以及艾克黎西亞奇神廟的家鄉。
en_text: At the heart of Kaurava I is Kaurav City. This region is one vast city, which is, in fact, part of an even more gigantic city extending through Dussala and Vyasastan. But it is Kaurav City that is the pinnacle of Imperial culture in the system, its capital, and home to the great universities, libraries, and Ecclesiarchal temples.

tc_text: 這個城市本身是成長和衰敗的混合物。新蓋好的建築豎立在毀壞跟腐朽的遺跡旁，而在富裕的中央商業建設的兩旁是充滿了貧民的陋巷。
en_text: The city itself is a patchwork of new growth and decaying neglect. Fresh structures are raised amongst collapsed, burnt out, and decaying buildings. Slums flank mansions and opulent centers of commerce.

tc_text: ++ 考拉瓦城記錄 ++
++ MCXVII，次標題IX ++
++ 年度淨化行動，由異教徒審判庭審判官塞若拉尼榮譽出席 ++
en_text: ++ Annual Purge, honorably attended by Inquisitor Lord Seroglazni of the Ordo Hereticus ++

tc_text: 每年都跟帝國防衛軍的地獄犬跟仲裁庭合作行動，淨化所有在城市中道德腐敗、沈淪、不合時宜和貧窮增長的地方。
en_text: Purge of all city sectors where the morally depraved, corrupt, unseemly, and poor have increased in number. Performed annually in coordination with Imperial Guard Hellhounds and the Adeptus Arbites.

tc_text: 在這次的淨化行動中，查到了1700個潛在的異教徒跟異型—全部都被淨化燃燒在審判團的火刑之下。在超過今日不遠的一百年後，我們的塞羅格拉尼大君將會重新確認正確的淨化被依循執行。
en_text: In this purge, 1,700 potential heretics and mutants were identified – all were cleansed and burnt upon the Inquisitorial stakes. At a date not later than 100 years from the current time, our Lord Seroglazni will reattend to ensure correct cleansing is being adhered to.

tc_text: 年度的淨化活動是保持卡拉瓦I有效統治的重要方式。
en_text: Annual purge remains a vital organ in the functioning corpus of Kaurava I’s effective governance.

tc_text: 在夏昆海岸旁的鄉鎮以對健康有良好優勢的環境而聞名，對於那些想要在水岸旁建構第二個家的人富有吸引力。
en_text: The small province formed by the habitable shore of Shakun Sea is famous for its health benefits, and for the wealthy and powerful who tend to have second homes along the water.

tc_text: 這個區域擁有幾個城市，周圍散佈著許多貧窮的小漁村。一個著名的外星異型的博物館因為史塔伯斯總督的到來而關閉，因為他認為這是一個褻瀆和異教式的表現。
en_text: The region boasts several proper cities, along with numerous poor fishing villages. A famed museum of xenos and mutant curiosities was closed with the arrival of Governor Stubbs, who deemed it blasphemous and heretical.

tc_text: ++ 私人信件 ++
++ 低階層加密—已解碼 ++
麥倫，
我現在沒辦法告訴你更多事，事情已經變得一團亂了。而且，我並不相信這封信可以被你讀到。重要的是，期待我能熬過這一星期。麥倫，在凡斯塔斯坦已經沒有甚麼好事了。我不過是一個小小的聖職人員，而不是身經百戰的衛隊戰士，我不是負責戰鬥的。
en_text: I can’t tell you much at the present, things have been in such disarray. Also, I can’t trust that this letter won’t be read. The important thing is, expect me in a week. By Holy Terra, Miron, no good will come to anyone left in Vyasastan. I’m just a petty cleric, not some battle hardened Guardsman. I’m not made for this.

tc_text: 這裡的狀況越來越糟了。沒甚麼人採取正式行動，但是頭上都是閃電戰機和砲擊飛過，每天都有建築物被燒毀，到處都是異教徒審判庭的事端。我現在在252軍團的後方，跟著賈叔叔、一個少校還有所有的人。在結束的那一天，我的忠貞仍屬於無畏的神聖皇帝和艾克黎西亞奇。
en_text: Things here are bad. Officially nobody has made a move, but there’s shelling and Lightning fighter runs overhead, and every day some building gets stormed, by which I mean flamed with multi-meltas. Ordo Hereticus business. Now I’m behind the 252nd all the way, what with Uncle Jurr a Major and all that, but at the end of the day my allegiance is to the Immortal God-Emperor and the Ecclesiarchy.

tc_text: 你看看我陷入了甚麼樣的困境？甚麼，我緊緊的被這些行星軍備和商業委任給纏住了？我不能留下來—沒有人可以留下來—不然他們會互相的猜疑。這就是我所能說的了，重要的是，讓我度過這個星期。我會到那裡去。
en_text: You see what a scrape I’m in? What, with my ties to the planetary requisitions and commerce commissions? I can’t stay – no one can stay – or they’ll come under suspicion from one side or another. That is all I can say here. The important thing is, expect me within the week. I’ll be there.

tc_text: 賽倫
在考拉瓦一號上唯一的遠古通道，加拉甘達的一個部分，是考拉瓦城令人印象深刻的延伸。在這裡，透過通道進行了活躍的星際貿易，讓許多商人成了大富豪。
en_text: Home to the only Ancient Gate on Kaurava I, a part of Jalaganda is effectively an extension of Kaurav City. Here, bustling interplanetary commerce passes constantly through the gate, making many merchants fabulously rich.

tc_text: 那裡是另一個加拉甘達。潮濕的低地流遍了帶有淤泥的河流、水道和蓋在泥漿上的村莊，而勇敢、沈默的"低地人"居住在這個地方。據說這些人都是優秀、可靠的護衛戰士。
en_text: There is another Jalaganda, however. The humid land of silty rivers, canals, and mud-hut villages is peopled by the solitary “Lowlanders,” brave, taciturn people. It is said they make excellent, dependable Guardsmen.

tc_text: ++ 第252守護者軍團 ++
++ 再度徵召報告記錄 ++
++ 語音記錄摘錄 ++
好吧，我回來後，馬上知道這是不對的。這是我的第17次旅程，他們說我該停下了。重武器，位於II和IV。
en_text: Well I got back and right off I knew it wasn’t right no more. It was my 17th tour, and they said I could have off. Heavy weapons, been to II and IV.

tc_text: 瞧，我沒多想。我在那喝了點酒，聊了些關於山脈中都是歐克蠻族的事情。我們低地人大部分都沒看過山脈，更不用說是歐克蠻人了。好吧，在我最後一次旅程中，我們穿越了污穢的渾沌勢力。兄弟，你不會相信我看到的，更糟的是，在我們到了那裡，我看到了塞柏，他居然跟他們在一起。塞伯是跟我一起長大的，十足的一個低地人，大家都是這樣說的，他居然投靠到另一邊去！
en_text: See I wasn’t thinking. A few drinks and there I was gabbing about mountains full of Orks, where we Lowlanders, most’ve us ain’t never seen mountains, let alone Orks. Then, see, well, on my last tour, we came across the foul abominations of Chaos. Man, you wouldn’t believe what I saw, but the worst of it was, just before we cut out of there, I swear, I swear or give me a muddy grave, I saw Sureb, and he was with them. Sureb, what as grew up down the way from me, Lowlander right enough, eight brothers all told. Gone over to the other side!

tc_text: 好吧，我真該知道自己不要多嘴，像這樣歪七扭八的坐著，滿口胡言的說著你鄰居的壞話。不，我不可以留下來。那麼，政軍官，我可是道地的低地人，我想要回去。我現在是個防衛軍，那是我得去面對的。
en_text: Well, I shoulda known never to open my big mouth about that. Didn’t sit right. Strange tales, speakin’ ill of your neighbors. No, I can’t stay. I’m a Lowlander no more. So, see, Commissar, I’d like to go back. All I am now is a Guardsman. I got to face that.

tc_text: 考拉瓦二號的北方大陸都是荒地和險峻的土地，以它奇特驚人的美麗而著名。除了獨居者和游牧民族外，沒人可以在這個區域中生活，所以讓它得到了孤寂之地的名稱。這些游牧人在孤寂之地的極北端從事獵補和一些危險的活動，來維持自己的生活。
en_text: The northern continent of Kaurava II is a harsh, forbidding land, noted for its striking and singular beauty. The region was given its solitary name because no one but hermits and nomads could survive there long. These nomads sustain themselves by hunting the prized and dangerous game found in the northernmost reaches of Solitude.

tc_text: 當血鴉軍團到達時，他們佔據了區域中央一個適合居住的海灣。對星際戰士來說，孤寂之地的貧瘠跟戰爭的嚴苛相比，其實一點也不算甚麼。
en_text: When the Blood Ravens arrived, they claimed a relatively habitable basin near the center of the region. As Space Marines they found Solitude’s harshness nothing to the accustomed rigors of war.

tc_text: ++ 偵察報告++
++ 偵察隊長肯西，仲裁庭，血鴉軍團分部 ++
en_text: ++ Scout Captain Kensey, Adeptus Astartes, Blood Ravens Chapter ++

tc_text: 偵察隊回報關於該地區西北方象限，包含數千公里的範圍，報告如下。
en_text: Reconnaissance team responsible for the survey of northwestern quadrant of the territory, an area of several thousand square kilometers. Report is as follows.

tc_text: 從總部西到北範圍75公里的半徑範圍：沒有任何平坦的地形，也沒有足以步行或讓車輛通行的交通路線。想要從北方進行攻擊，會是一件相當困難的事情。
en_text: 75km radius due W to due N around proposed headquarters: There is no flat terrain and no good foot or vehicular paths. Assault from this northerly direction would be extremely difficult.

tc_text: 西北西方120公里：流動的水源，將會是雷鷹號護衛隊所需。
en_text: 120km WNW: Viable water source. Thunderhawk convoys will be necessary.

tc_text: 正北方512公里：平緩的峽谷，可能會是敵人攻擊的潛在地，據傳那邊曾有以前的殖民地。周圍有數個峭壁圍繞封閉著峽谷，讓它不容易被人進入
en_text: 512km due N: Gentle valley, potential landing area for enemy assault. Scant evidence of prior settlement there. Detonated several cliff-sides, closing the valley and rendering it inhospitable.

tc_text: 北北西方970公里：這是個很有趣的遭遇。數個身形粗壯的巨大長角野獸，爬行在陡峭的路堤上。偵察隊原本正準備開火時，突然出現了穿著灰白色迷彩服裝的人類游牧民族，用極快的速度和效率屠殺著這些野獸。命令記錄：徵召這些游牧民族，如果這些新人不適合我們的部隊，就將他們轉往帝國防衛軍去。
en_text: 970km NNW: Interesting encounter. Several great horned beasts, massive forearms, climbing among steep embankments. Scouting team readied to fire, but human nomads garbed in gray and white camouflage came from nowhere, killing the beasts with great speed and efficiency. Note to command: investigate recruiting these nomads. If unsuitable as Neophytes for our Chapter, refer for Imperial Guard recruitment.

tc_text: 這些肥沃的田園之地上居住了數個世代的人類移民，從事著種植和漁牧來維持生計。這裡的暖季時間很長，冬季的氣候則是相當溫和。
en_text: These idyllic and fertile lands have drawn generation after generation of human settlers. Farms burgeon and coastal fisheries yield plentiful catch, providing much of the system with food. The warm seasons are long, and the winter is temperate.

tc_text: 在這裡所有的一切都是那麼的平靜，也沒有遭受到鄰近洛克可羅的歐克蠻族的騷擾襲擊。這些山脈的基地中都曾經有帝國防衛軍的駐紮，但有許多基地現在都已經被摧毀或是荒廢了。
en_text: All would indeed be tranquil in the province, were it not for occasional Ork sorties out of the adjoining Rokclaw range. The base of these mountains had been dotted with Imperial Guard outposts, many of which have recently been abandoned or destroyed.

tc_text: ++ 在皇帝昇華先知酒吧所聽見的事，考拉瓦城 ++
en_text: ++ Overheard at the Emperor’s Ascension hab bar, Kaurav City ++

tc_text: 再請我喝一杯酒，我就把整個故事都告訴你。啊！你真是個好人，知道好酒的價值在哪裡。我曾經在西賽洛里亞務農，沒錯，一塊美麗的土地，一塊富饒的土地。好吧，當我在那邊的時候，我們遭遇到了一些歐克蠻人。哈哈！沒錯，當我還小的時候，我就曾經見過歐克蠻人，而且還不只一次。你看起來很訝異，但這就是在那邊的生活。
en_text: Buy me another drink and I’ll tell you the whole story. Ah! A good man, knows the value of a drink. Well I was farming, Western Cerulea. That’s right, land of beauty. Land of bounty. Well, where I was, we get some Orks now and then. Haha! Why yes, I’ve seen an Ork. More than one, since I was a pup. You act surprised, but this is life on Two.

tc_text: 但我要告訴你，我從未見過像這樣這麼多數量的歐克蠻人。我們在農田建立了一座組合塔，而當時農人都躲進裡面。接著那些粗暴的—我是說值得信賴的（哈哈！）252軍團出現了，然後他們抵擋了一陣子，接著，出現了兩倍數量的綠色野人，當他們成群的出現時我知道事情糟了。天啊，我可以老實的跟你說，那天我還以為我們都要掛了呢。
en_text: But I’ll tell you, I never seen Orks in numbers like this. So the farm got a single permacrete tower, and all us farmers are up in it. The rusty – I mean trusty (har har!) 252nd show up, and they hold ‘em off for awhile. Only then, twice the number of Greens was there. I knew it was getting bad when they swarmed a Leman Russ and wrenched the hatch off. Honest to goodness, and I swear to you as I sit here now, I thought we were all goners that day.

tc_text: 當我聽到這個隆隆聲時，我往回看，往著北邊的方向－就在長滿了新播農作的地方－居然有一整排、或是更多的暗紅色的坦克。血鴉軍團！我告訴你的都是實話。他們第一個轟掉的東西是黎曼魯斯戰鬥坦克，接著我所知道的事，是一大群的星際戰士從犀牛裝甲運輸車衝了出來，將那些歐克蠻族全都給夷平了。
en_text: Just then I hear this rumbling, and I look back, and coming right in from north – right over all our new-sowed crops! – is a row of maybe a dozen or so dull red tanks. Blood Ravens! I am telling you the Emperor’s truth. First thing they blast is that Leman Russ. Next thing I know, Space Marines are pouring out of their Rhinos and giving those Orks such a meal of bolter rounds as to lay ‘em flat.

tc_text: 那之後...好吧，在那之後我瞭解到生命的價值，而且我想，考拉瓦一號會有更多的帝國防衛軍，而歐克蠻族將不再存在。保護者們，那個就是我的地方。
en_text: After that… well, after that I realized the value a’ life, and I thought, Kaurava I, more Guardsmen and no Orks. Conservators, that’s the place for me.

tc_text: 平緩生長的森林幾乎覆蓋了整個崔伊地區，如同鄰近的賽洛里亞一般的平靜和動人。崔伊森林中生產了豐富的果實和木料，不過跟其它在北部地方的人類居民相比，這裡則承受了更多來自歐克的攻擊。
en_text: Gently rolling woodlands cover almost the entirety of Trivie. As peaceful and lovely as neighboring Cerulea, the many Trivian forests bear fruit and lumber. The human inhabitants have suffered more greatly from Ork attacks than the rest of the northern hemisphere.

tc_text: 偉執政官類城市在崔伊北部曾經一度繁榮，但當帝國防衛軍在星系的掌握力逐漸削弱之際，歐克蠻族侵犯了他們的山脈，讓大部分的人口逃走或是被迫散佈到其它的地方去。
en_text: Great human cities had once thrived in the north of Trivie, but as the Imperial Guard’s grasp on the system weakened, Orks overran their mountains and the human population mostly fled or scattered.

tc_text: > 建議：瓦解歐克蠻族的威脅
彷彿是從主大陸分裂出去一樣，這邊遍佈了上百個島嶼，有些小到只能容納一個村莊。水資源極深也極清澈，擁有大量的漁產。純樸的小村莊世世代代的在這些島嶼上發展，依附著這個水域生存。
en_text: Hundreds of islands, some small enough for a single village, lie as if they had tumbled off the mainland. The crystalline waters are rarely deep, and fish school in great numbers. Until the current war, generations of humble villages dotted the islands.

tc_text: 這整個區域的唯一平坦的部分只有降落平台，用來跟兩個月球之一的伊里迪恩保持交通的聯繫。
en_text: The only part of the entire region that is not rustic is the lander pad that allows traffic with Irridene, one of the planet’s two moons.

tc_text: ++ 百姓的證詞 ++
++ 由考拉瓦防禦站K2.1739所取得 ++
en_text: ++ Recovered from Kauravan Defense Post K2.1739 ++

tc_text: 所以，我看到的...好吧，在日出前我們出航，我在甲板上拿著漁網，將它們準備好。
en_text: So what I see’d was… well, see, we get out in the boats a ways before sunlight. Bearfish feed then. So we’re on the water like, and I’m there above board with the nets in my hands, gettin’ them ready.

tc_text: 我往上看，很清澈的夜空。伊里迪恩高高掛在天上，歐里敦在低一點的地方，像一幅畫一樣。我就是在那時看到的，在空中有一個條紋，不像是飛船，突然的出現了，就在很遠的距離。它的速度很慢—也不大—看起來就像是往月球前進，接著就接近月球了。
en_text: I jus’ looked up. Fine clear night. Irridene’s high up, a-glitterin’, and Orridune’s down low. Paint a picture, ya could. That’s when I see’d it. A streak, not like a ship comin’ outta warp travel, no. Just outta th’ distance. An’ it slowed – an’ got bigger – and like as if just met up with the moon. Went right into it.

tc_text: 那時我把漁網灑了出去，像隻賽若賓鯊魚般的站在那邊。我斜眼看著，它並沒有擊中歐里敦，它就是停在那而以。再注意看那不只一個，看起來就好像有十幾個小斑點一樣，就停在那邊，在月球上面。
en_text: By now I done dropped the net, standin’ there like a Sirrabin Shark. I squinted and it hadn’t hit Orridune, it just stopped right at it like. An’ a squinted a hair more and saw it wasn’t one thing, it was dozens a’ little specks, just resting there, above the moon.

tc_text: 好吧，長官，我害怕下一個就會是艾克黎西亞奇，我心裡想，好好看著，然後把你看到的說出來。接著第二晚，月球出來了，那些斑點還在那裡。不過我發誓你現在還會看到它們在歐里敦上面蠕動，我發誓。所以我過來了，把事情告訴你。
en_text: Well, sirs, I fear th’ ‘cclesiarchy right proper as the next man. Watch it, I thought, then say what ye’ve seen. So the next night, moon came up, and the specks were still there. But now I’d a swored you could see some-aught crawling upon Orridune. I’d a swore. So I came right next day, and here I be.

tc_text: 在考拉瓦二號上，幾乎都可以看見矗立在遠方壯闊的洛克可羅山脈。儘管那些山峰很雄偉，但卻會令人感到畏懼，因為在帝國的運輸機到達這地方之前，歐克蠻族就已經潛伏在那個地方了。
en_text: There are few places in Kaurava II where you cannot see the vast, imposing peaks of the Rokclaw Mountains looming in the distance. Those peaks, though majestic, have always inspired as much dread as awe. Orks have lurked there since the first Imperial Valkyries arrived.

tc_text: 現在戰爭頭目戈古茲組了一支龐大的吼～軍團，山徑中到處都是歐克蠻人和升起了他們旗幟的崗哨。歐克工廠發出的濃煙在清澈的藍天中翻滾，而在下方的山谷則充斥了史估革巨獸的吼聲。
en_text: Now Warboss Gorgutz has raised a huge Waaagh! and the mountain paths teem with Orks and bristle with banners and turrets. Smoke from Ork foundries billows into the clear blue skies, and the bellows of training Squiggoths echo in the valleys.

tc_text: ++ 帝國防衛軍，第252守護者軍團官方戰地報告 ++
en_text: ++ Imperial Guard, 252nd Conservator Regiment Official Field Archives ++

tc_text: ++ 獲取的通話記錄，重新繕寫 ++
"嘿，希倫，你想歐克蠻人真的在那些山丘上嗎？"
en_text: “Hey Siram, you think there’s really Orks up in these hills?”

tc_text: "如果我看到了一個歐克蠻族，我該怎麼辦？我可是知道怎麼樣去用雷射槍來射擊的。"
en_text: “I see an Ork, what’s it to me? I know how to use my lasgun.”

tc_text: "唉，據說他們都用斧頭和棍棒的。"
en_text: “Ay, they say they got stone axes and clubs”.

tc_text: "在我開槍之前，我不會給他們任機會的。"
en_text: “I’d shoot ‘em down before they got a chance.”

tc_text: "是啦，不過那都是那些女人在說的。"
"說到女人，你有看到那些在賽洛里亞的娘們是怎麼看我的嗎？就在那邊的村子裡？"
en_text: “Speakin’ of wives, did you see how that Cerulean lass gave me the eye, in the village back there?”

tc_text: "看著你！哈哈哈！當然啊。"
en_text: “Gave you the eye! Ha ha ha! Sure she did”.

tc_text: "就算她們沒有瞧著你，也不代表你—那是甚麼？"
en_text: “Just ‘cause she wasn’t giving it to you, don’t mean you – what was that? Listen!”

tc_text: "希倫？你在—喔，我的皇帝啊…我看到他們了。"
en_text: “Siram? What are you – oh Emperor… I see them.”

tc_text: "甚麼—他們是甚麼？"
"歐克蠻人，那一定是歐克蠻人。"
"他們的數量真多！他們用的可不是石頭跟棍棒！"
en_text: “So many of them! And they ain’t stone clubs!”

tc_text: "我們—我們得離開這裡，我的的裝備只夠用來作監看任務而以！"
en_text: “We – we got to get out of here. We’re not equipped for more than surveillance!”

tc_text: "我知道，我知道！快點，往那邊！
en_text: “I know, I know! Quick, that way!”

tc_text: "小聲一點，你不會想要讓他們發現我們吧？"
en_text: “Keep low. You don’t suppose they saw us, do you?”

tc_text: "好了，我想我們安全了…應該安全了吧…"
en_text: “Okay, we’re safe… I think we’re safe…”

tc_text: "人類！啊哈哈哈！抓住他們，我的孩子！"
<尖叫聲，伴隨著敲擊和激烈的聲響>
en_text: <screams, followed by hacking and smashing sounds>

tc_text: 蒙斯是考拉瓦二號的已開發區域，長久以來它一直都是城市和農地的混合地。因為它一直受到洛克可羅歐克蠻族的侵襲，所以讓蒙斯成為考拉瓦二號上防禦作的最好的區域。
en_text: Although it is the developed region of Kaurava II, Monse has long been a patchwork of city and farmland. The province is so exposed to the Ork-infested Rokclaws that over time it has grown to be one of the best fortified and developed parts of Kaurava II.

tc_text: 在歐克蠻族的吼～軍團跟帝國防衛軍的夾擊下，蒙斯無法抵禦攻擊，讓一部分的區域變成了廢墟。
en_text: With the Ork Waaagh! underway and the outer Imperial Guard establishment crumbing, Monse has not been able to hold off attacks, and stretches of the once pristine territory now lie in ruins.

tc_text: 帝國的市民們注意—
阿藍斯伯格城市在這段艱苦的時間盡了所有的可能來幫助你們，請注意現在我們必須歡迎來自於我們在附近奪取區域的大批農民，遷入到我們的城市中。這些難民並沒有—我們重申，並沒有—威脅到我們食物儲量。這份公告將會由帝國防衛軍來執行。
en_text: The city of Arransburg is doing all it can to protect you in these troubled times. Please be advised that we must welcome the number of farmers from neighboring agricultural districts which we have taken in. These refugees do not – we repeat DO NOT – threaten our food reserves. Anyone found proclaiming otherwise will be executed by Imperial Guard firing squad.

tc_text: 為了好好的保護我們城市中的所有居民，將執行嚴格的宵禁。只有一小部分配發了官方通行證的人，才可以在宵禁的時間外出。
en_text: To better protect all residents of our city, a strict curfew of sundown will be enforced. Official passes will be issued to the small number of individuals who need to be out after curfew starts.

tc_text: 在最後，一個散佈在歐里敦月球上關於異星人的惡意謠言，終於引起了我們的注意。透過我們當地帝國防衛軍政戰官的證實，並沒有任何的異型登陸、或可能登陸在月球之上。所有任何關於談論"死亡之光"的謠言，不管是異型或是其他的東西，全都是不真實的。散佈謠言的人江會被送到政戰處去進行心靈改造。
en_text: Finally, it has come to our attention that a malicious rumor has sprung up concerning xenos on the moon Orridune. We have confirmation from our local Imperial Guard Commissar that no alien has landed, or COULD land on the moon. All rumors concerning a “death-ray” stationed on that moon, alien or otherwise, are also false. Rumor mongers will be handed to the commissariat for mind scrubbing.

tc_text: 芬德‧賽蒙斯
考拉瓦二號，阿藍斯伯格市長
在洛克可羅西方險峻又美麗的山丘地，隸屬於歐克蠻族的時間跟帝國防衛軍是一樣長的。結果，在那片土地上只有發展出了小型的村莊和畜牧業。在過去幾百年的鬥爭之中，這裡只有歐克蠻族跟人類之間的衝突血濺，以及令人擔憂的迫近而以。
en_text: The rough-hewn and picturesque hill country west of the Rokclaws has belonged to the Orks as often as they have belonged to the Imperium. As a result, the land has never supported greater settlement than small villages and cattle pasturing. Many past centuries of strife have seen Orks and humans existing in bloody and uneasy proximity.

tc_text: 在這片長久存在的低之下，這個區域的許多地方顯露出了許多匆促而粗糙的採礦痕跡。其它的區域則承受了工業跟戰爭所帶來的化學傷害，因而變成了一大片的不毛之地。
en_text: Beneath the almost constant low-lying fog, many miles of this province show the signs of hasty and careless strip-mining. Other areas suffer the chemical wounds of industry and warfare, resulting in miles of barren slopes.

tc_text: ++ 源自古老洛克可羅的牧羊人之歌 ++
en_text: ++ From an ancient Rokclaw shepherd’s song ++

tc_text: 走出薄霧—我的羊群從沼澤來
en_text: Out of the mists – my flock comes from the fen

tc_text: 爬上山丘—越過山丘—又進入了薄霧之中
en_text: Up hill – over hill – into mist again

tc_text: 歌聲環繞著山谷，歌聲穿入在心中
en_text: A song to haunt the valleys, a song to pierce the heart

tc_text: 一個黑眼的女孩等待著我，而我們兩地分離
en_text: A dark eyed girl who waits for me, while we must be apart

tc_text: 穿越山丘和峽谷—我拖著疲憊的步伐
en_text: Across the hills and gullies – I thread my weary feet

tc_text: 從東方，我朝著遇見迷人女孩的地方前進
en_text: Ever east, ever towards my siren girl to meet

tc_text: 在一個孤寂的山頂，她的村莊就在那個地方
en_text: From a lonely hilltop, where her village stood

tc_text: 而我只見到了碎片—只見到了餘燼—被屠殺的野獸和歐克蠻族倒在血泊之中
en_text: I saw only splinters – only cinders – slaughtered beasts and Orks all doused in blood

tc_text: 歌聲環繞著山谷，歌聲穿入在心中
en_text: A song to haunt the valleys, a song to pierce the heart

tc_text: 個黑眼的女孩等待著我，而現在我們卻兩地分離
en_text: A dark eyed girl who waited, now we’ll ever be apart.

tc_text: ++ 分類：上尉等級或是更高 ++
這裡披蓋著一片翠綠和半遮掩銀色薄霧，不難想像它為什麼會被人取了這樣的名稱。在千年以來有一群人居住在這個地方，從不離開、也不接納外地的陌生人。
en_text: Emerald green and half-shrouded in silver mists, it is not hard to see why those who first discovered the islands chose the name they did. The choice proved to be fitting. For nearly a millennium a quiet people have dwelled there, not leaving and not welcoming strangers.

tc_text: 儘管他們從未宣稱自己屬於帝國或是其他的異教徒，遺忘島嶼的人們獨自的生活在自己的第方。當然，像這樣的孤離是絕對於法在這場戰爭中存活下去的。
en_text: Although they had never declared a separation from the Imperium or any other heresy, the people of the Forgotten Isles lived apart. Of course, such isolation could never survive the current war.

tc_text: ++ 莫里特‧凱隆，考拉瓦歷史學家 ++
++ 天堂中的第15個循環：考拉瓦之旅的歷史紀錄 ++
en_text: ++ Fifteen Cycles in Paradise: A Historical Travelog of Kaurava II, pp. 1341 – 42 ++

tc_text: 我在遺忘群島的三個循環中，我學到了許多；首先，我學到這群神秘的霧對我來說永遠都是一個謎，但我將會盡我所能，來描述這個地方。
en_text: During my three cycles upon the Forgotten Isles, I learned much; foremost, I learned that there was much these secretive folk would never reveal to me. But I will give, as much as is in my power, a broad sketch of its provenance.

tc_text: 發現遺忘群島並將其命名的人是杜‧吐戈，考拉瓦15的第一批移民，一個我們幾乎不認識的人。在最大島嶼的提爾克城市廣場中，豎立有他的雕像，而在一個循環之前任何人都可以證實這個真相。
en_text: The discoverer and also namer of the Forgotten Isles was Tur Turgold, the fifteenth of Kaurava’s First Settlers, and the one about whom we know the very least. A statue of him stands in the town square on the largest island, Tilk, although it was more than a cycle before anyone would confirm the fact.

tc_text: 有人說杜是一個啞巴，或者是說，在這個群島上所代表的意思是，他"不愛說話"。從這裡可以清楚的見到遺忘群島的人的隔離於世，這些語言、還有一些神秘的事物，都是他們從杜他自己所傳承下來的。
en_text: Some say that Tur was in fact a mute, others that, in the strange mode of expression these islanders have, he “loved words not.” It is clear enough that the Forgotten Islanders view their isolation, terse speech, and general secrecy as something they inherit from Tur himself.

tc_text: 我必須花點時間來驅散一些關於這個群島中的謠言。不管是甚麼導致了他們的天性，但我可以證實的是，他們絕不是異教徒。就像所有的人一樣，他們都敬畏並熱愛皇帝。他們不是吃人的巫師，或是異種。他們不過是單純的人民而以，儘管歷史對他們的偏移有著相當的興趣…
en_text: I must take a moment to dispel some of the rumors concerning these isles. Whatever the cause of their nature, they are not, I assure the good reader, heretics. They fear and love the Emperor, as all men must. They are not cannibals or wizards, nor mutants. They are simply quiet folks, although the historical causes of this shift are of considerable interest…

tc_text: 直到次元風暴出現，第二個貧瘠的月球歐里敦就多多少少被忽略了。如果帝國防衛軍沒有被擊潰，如果歐克蠻族是大自然的占星家，他們就會注意到有一個奇蹟出現了。
en_text: Up until the appearance of the Warp Storm, the barren second moon then known as Orridune had been more or less ignored. If the Imperial Guard presence on the planet below had not been crumbling, or if the Orks were star-gazers by nature, they would have noticed a miraculous occurrence.

tc_text: 他們會看到一支鈦星人的艦隊向月球湧來，部署了上千的兵蜂。帶著驚人的速度和效率，大地級建築艇在當地建立了水源補給和寬闊的平原。艦隊接著著陸了，開始了楠‧亞諾以的軍事設施的建設。
en_text: They would have seen a Tau fleet descend on the moon, deploying thousands of drones. With surprising speed and effort, the Earth Caste created localized atmosphere, water supplies and a great plateau. The fleet then landed, and the construction of the Nan Yanoi military complex was begun.

tc_text: ++ 楠‧亞諾以 ++
橙區進度超前，1－9到12－9的分區已經可以完全運作。
en_text: Orange sector ahead of schedule. Subsectors 1-9 to 12-9 are functionally complete.

tc_text: 藍區被一些沈澱物的問題拖住了。我們幾個最好的大地級建築艇已經被派往處理該問題。我們估計這只會帶來一點點的延遲。有一份來自7－2－藍的奇異報告：不知道為什麼有一個建築者兵蜂失序了，被發現在一個通風柵口，正在用鉚釘製造楠‧亞諾以的概要圖。
en_text: Blue sector has had some issues with the slag deposit hook-up. Several of our best Earth Caste have been sent to look into the problem. We anticipate only minor delays. A strange report from 7-2-Blue: Somehow a builder drone had been misprogrammed, and was found constructing the entire schematic for Nan Yanoi in rivets on a ventilation casing plate.

tc_text: 紅區則需要關切，來解決它嚴重進度落後的問題，這是因為有部分的結構跟月球的表面地形無法搭配。同時還有一點點...發生在吵鬧的克魯特軍團跟寂靜的胡蜂戰士間的衝突。
en_text: Red sector is a cause for concern. Moderate to great delays may be possible here. This is due in part to structural inadequacies in the moon’s surface beneath our terraforming efforts. There was also a minor… incident between a particularly noisy Kroot regiment and dormant Vespids.

tc_text: 有32個建築兵蜂損壞並需要修理，其中有19個是因為在倒管工作時遭受到突波的損害，其它的則需要日常的維修工作。
en_text: Thirty-two construction drones are damaged and require repairs. Nineteen of these are due to a power surge in a conduit they were working on, the others require normal regular maintenance.

tc_text: 如果不是因為遠古通道，這顆冰冷的月球就會像它的姊妹一般的被人忽視。遠古通道在和平的時期，提供了星際間的貿易路線和帝國防衛軍一個相當有用的工具。為了提昇它的使用效率，在平坦的區域建造了兩個降落平台，讓月球間的交通得以順暢的通行。連結這些平台跟通道的是一個小型的工業城，其中有許多廠房、運輸站和一個宇宙商港。
en_text: If it weren’t for the Ancient Gate, this icy moon would have gone on as ignored as its sister. The Ancient Gate, in times of peace, had provided a vital route for interplanetary trade and a valuable tool to the Imperial Guard. To facilitate its usefulness, lander pads had been built in two planetside territories, allowing regular traffic to and from the moon. Linking these pads to the Gate is a small industrial city, complete with factory beds, depots, and a commercial space port.

tc_text: ++ 告示牌，自由商業區 ++
親愛的顧客、供應商和債務人，
很遺憾的特羅傑和合夥人關閉了他們的自由貿易大廳。在經過三千年提供最好品質的紡織品給帝國部隊之後，我們發現必須盡快並且不經警告的關閉我們的大門。
en_text: It is with regret that Troagers & Associates have closed their Irridene trade hall. After three millennia of providing the finest quality bulk textiles for the Imperium's fighting men, we have found it necessary to close our doors with great speed and no warning.

tc_text: 任何尚未完成的交易、債務、訂單或是其它的借款，很不幸的都失效了。為了獲得賠償，請填寫IXF553－2b表格，協助機構將會在27.9年內檢視你的申訴。不論如何，任何人提供關於前古文記錄員或是他的手下的消息，特羅傑和合夥人的中央辦公室將會提供優渥的報酬。請向加拉甘達的辦公分部索取更多的訊息。
en_text: Any pending sales, refunds, invoices, or other debts are, unfortunately, null and void. For compensation please fill in form IXF553-2b, and a servo-assistant will review your complaint within approximately 27.9 years. However, any information about the former Scribe Ancient or his person, dead or alive, will be richly rewarded by our Troagers & Assoc. central offices. Please report to the Jalaganda branch office for more details.

tc_text: 強勁的風在行星北端的高地和其它的石地間咆哮的吹動著。這個區域非常的荒涼。除了日光和酷熱之外，沒有任何得以維持生命所需的物資。
en_text: Strong winds howl between the mesas and other barren rock formations that cover the northern reaches of the planet. The territory is truly barren, offering nothing required to sustain life other than sunlight and heat.

tc_text: 在過去，只有少數的帝國採礦前哨站在這片土地上作業。當神靈族到達時，他們很快就被消滅了，取而代之的是閃爍著微光、交錯連接的軍事網路—一支在陰影中行動的軍隊。
en_text: In earlier times, only a few Imperial mining outposts graced the rocky landscape. When the Eldar arrived, these quickly vanished, replaced by a shimmering, delicate network of infiltrated military installations – an army moving among the shadows.

tc_text: 關於責任和榮耀的演說
en_text: ++ Speech on the Meaning of Duty and Glory ++

tc_text: 工藝世界的先知卡里絲，抵達了埃塞二號—坦尼爾
en_text: ++ Farseer Caerys of Ulthwé, on arriving in Essir Il-Tanil ++

tc_text: 我們曾經在這個地方作戰，我們戰鬥並且獲得了勝利。我們必須作戰，我們勝利，而所獲得的榮耀將會與工藝世界共同長存。現在我們又要作戰了，我們必須維持一個已經完成的責任嗎？如果我們戰敗了，會讓以往光榮的戰績晦暗嗎？
en_text: We have made battle in this place before. We have fought and won. Fought because we knew that we must. We won, and brought upon ourselves glory that will not fade as long as Ulthwé thrives. Now we are called to battle again. Must we perform a duty which we have already accomplished? If we fight and fail, are our former victories tarnished?

tc_text: 我們就像洞穴中的回聲，或是水面上的波紋：接受任何需要我們的徵召。在時間的流動之中我們瞥見了廣闊的川流，交錯又交錯的通道。我們是先見之主，擁有洞察和遠見的神靈族，我們的責任遠大於那些無知者、好戰之徒和盲目的人。
en_text: We are like echoes in a cave, or waves upon the water: performing our part every time we are called. We who have glimpsed into the flow of time see that it is exactly such vast confluence, paths crossed and re-crossed. All are swept along. And we Eldar, masters of hindsight, insight, and foresight are bound that much more tightly to our duty than the ignorant, the belligerent, the blind.

tc_text: 只有當一個人真正的瞭解了命運的意義之後，在無數分歧的道路之中，才能真正的看見他獨特的命運，並且在責任的路途之末獲得榮耀於一身。當我們生為神靈族，就註定不會失敗。
en_text: When one truly understands fate as it is, myriad branching paths, then one can truly see that duty is cleaving to a particular fate, and glory is the accomplishment of duty’s ends. When we are true to the nature of the Eldar, we cannot fail.

tc_text: 一旦當破碎的大地成為強大帝國人民的殖民地時，大城市的周圍就會被用來支援工業的採礦活動跟生產設施所包圍。
en_text: Once the broken lands were home to the largest and most developed Imperial population on the planet. Large cities were flanked by stately suburbs, industry supported by vast mining and production facilities.

tc_text: 不幸的，商業帝國將採礦活動帶到考拉瓦三號的月球上，引起了一場巨大的爆炸。有一半以上的月球都變成了寒冰和塵土，現在成為環帶圍繞著星球。殘餘破碎的表面都是殘破的土地，導致了無數的死亡和毀滅。
en_text: Unfortunately, a commercial enterprise to bring mining to the Kaurava III’s moon resulted in a massive explosion. Half the moon was turned to dust and ice, now rings encircling the planet. The rest scourged the face of the broken lands, resulting in untold death and destruction.

tc_text: ++ 遊戲獵人簡‧索倫的個人日記 ++
en_text: ++ Personal Journal of Game Hunter Jan Solenz ++

tc_text: 我把足以度過30個循環的補給、彈藥和電池裝在我的浮艇上，如果我可以抓到三隻角獸或是一兩隻阿肯獸，就可以讓我在賽洛里亞的海灘上度過一年半的好時光了...
en_text: Provisions, ammo, and power cells for thirty cycles loaded into my speeder. If I can bag at least three Horned Nigos and an Arkenbeast or two, I can spend half a year wasted on a Cerulean beach…

tc_text: 我在這個早上盯上了一個小的角獸群，追了牠們一整天。我在日落時埋伏撂倒了一隻，還必須先離開以躲避剩下的角獸。在擺脫牠們之後我必須回去，以防那隻角獸的屍體被別的東西給破壞了。
en_text: Spotted small family of Nigos this morning. Trailed them whole day. Ambushed them at sunset and got one. Had to hightail it to escape the others, but managed to lose them and get back before anything got at the corpse.

tc_text: 看到了綠色的閃光，像閃電一樣，就在西南方的水平線上。
en_text: Saw green flashes, like lightning, on horizon to the SW.

tc_text: 花了兩個循環來追蹤一隻阿肯獸。不能靠得更近了，我必須等待射擊的機會。
en_text: Trailing an Arkenbeast for two cycles. Can’t get too close. Just need to wait until I can get a clear shot.

tc_text: 我想我在這快發瘋了，看到了更多的綠光。我駕著我的浮艇朝著它們駛去，如果沒有錯，我想我看到了一個黑色的金字塔，有巨大的綠色光芒包圍著它。在它的頂上閃爍著綠色的閃電，我得離開這裡了。
en_text: Think I’m losing my mind out here. Saw more green flashes. Headed towards them on my speeder, and if I didn’t know better, I’d think I saw a sort of black pyramid way out, and a great green aura all around it. Top of it flashed green. Got the hell out of there.

tc_text: 幾乎就射中阿肯獸了。我準備好來福槍，準備按下扳機，突然間某個東西出現在我的眼前。瘦小的傢伙，像人類一樣的奔跑著，發出白色的微光。接著他們來到一個空間，在那裡有個拱門，一陣閃光後，他們就不見了。就這樣，沒錯，你在這種地方停留太久一定會瘋了，我要背著這條野獸立刻回家。
en_text: Almost got a shot on the Arkenbeast. Had my rifle set, ready to pull the trigger. Suddenly saw something out of the corner of my eye. Thin things, like humans, running. Gleamed white. Then they walked up to an empty space, and a sort of arch was there, and a flash, and they were gone. That’s it. They’re right, you do go mad if you stay out here too long. I’m bagging this one ‘Beast and going home.

tc_text: 惡臭的湖泊延伸在晦暗無光的泥濘草原上，河流從高處往低處緩慢的流動，匯集了每一個循環打擊在這些土地上的冰冷又刺骨的雨水。
en_text: Fetid lakes punctuate squalid stretches of dull, clayish prairie. Sluggish rivers trickle water from higher elevations to lower, and once per cycle cold and bitter rains pummel the greater part of these lands for weeks together.

tc_text: 基爾‧哈拉德只有幾個小村莊，儘管它們變得更大了，但卻更靠近了尼雷恩的邊界。
en_text: No more than a few squalid villages dot Kier Harrad, although they grow larger and less desperate near the border of Nirraein.

tc_text: ++ 個人通訊 ++
親愛的安妮基，
你不會相信在這邊下的雨，我是有多麼的厭惡這些雨啊。這邊的雨不像杜薩拉，它又黑又冰又刺人入骨。這些雨水都不會流入土壤，沒有東西可以在這裡生長。不管怎樣，沒甚麼東西可以生長。
en_text: You wouldn’t believe the rain here. I’m hating every moment of it. It’s not like the rain we get in Dussala. It’s cold and dark and stings, and the rain doesn’t go into the soil. Things don’t grow here. Not many things, anyway.

tc_text: 該死，當我加入252軍團時，我想我會駐紮在二號，用重武器從碉堡來攻擊歐克蠻人。我是說，我得為帝國作戰。我想要跟敵人戰鬥，而不是坐著沒事幹！我們在基爾‧哈拉德紮營，我們只是等待著。我們站衛兵、巡邏，就是一直等著。
en_text: Hell, when I joined up with the 252nd, I thought I’d be stationed on Two, shooting Orks with heavy weapons from some bunker. I mean, I thought I’d get to fight for the Imperium. I want to fight the enemy, not sit around! We’re camped here in Kier Harrad, and we just wait. We stand guard, we go in patrols, but we just wait.

tc_text: 當然，那邊有一些謠言。或許你已經在杜薩拉聽過了，有些東西從南方的沙地中跑了出來，並且毀滅了所有的村莊。如果那是真的，我可是沒見過。北方也出現了奇怪的東西，但我還是坐在這個潮濕的碉堡中，度過冰冷的雨天，我想我在為皇帝戰死之前會先死於無聊。等著我，安娜基，不管是在這個或是下一個世界，請等著我。
en_text: Sure, there are rumors. Maybe you’ve heard them all the way back in Dussala. Something came out of the sands in the south, in Imossa. Some people say it’s some type of Arkenbeast swarm or sandworms, and they crush entire villages flat. Well if any of that’s true, I haven’t seen it. Strange stuff going on up North, too. Some mining operations up in the Wastes just gone. Lost radio contact, and gone. Most likely I’ll just sit here in this humid bunker with the cold and the sound of rain, and die of boredom before I get to die for the Emperor. Wait for me, Anneke. In this world or the next, wait for me.

tc_text: 布萊頓
普林斯皮亞的荒地不是那麼的貧瘠、乾燥或是完全的毫無生計。但不管是居在在這的人類或是四處漫遊的危險野獸，都必須擁有在這片粗糙、艱困的土地上或氣候中，自給自足的謀生能力。
en_text: The rough country of Principia is not so barren, dry, or formidable as to bar life entirely. Anything that dwells there, whether human or one of the species of large and dangerous beast that roam the planet, must accommodate itself to a remarkably harsh and unforgiving landscape and climate.

tc_text: 在惡地上散佈著數個先前帝國城市的遺跡。幾個世紀以來，只有遊戲獵人跟少數防禦精良的帝國衛哨在這個地方生活著。
en_text: The scattered remnants at several early Imperial attempts at cities can be seen upon the Badlands’ heights. For centuries, no more than game hunters and a few well-defended Imperial Guard posts have subsisted here.

tc_text: 我，工藝世界遊俠隊長伊內塞，遞送我關於歐瑞羅斯這區域的報告，或是年輕種族稱其為普林斯皮亞的地方。我所說的就是我跟我的遊俠們所見到的。
en_text: I, Ranger Captain Inessar of Ulthwé, deliver my report concerning the territory known as Orreloth, or Principia to the younger races. All that I speak is as I and my Rangers have seen.

tc_text: 三個偉大的歐瑞爾尖塔都倒塌毀壞了，沒有任何標示殘存。曾豎立著兩座尖塔的地方散佈著帝國的遺跡，第三座現在則變得光禿而淒涼。有許多我們先祖置放的隱藏的魍道關口需要修理維護。奇異的野獸在這片土地上漫遊，沒有任何神靈族可以手無寸鐵的在這裡獨自行動。
en_text: Gone are the three great Orrel spires, toppled and broken and ground to dust. No sign of them remains. Ruins of the Imperium lie where two of the spires stood. The third is bare. Gone are fully half of the hidden Webway gates which our ancestors placed, and many of those remaining need repair. Strange beasts now roam the land, and no Eldar should roam this country unarmed or alone.

tc_text: 帝國在這裡並不強大，人類獵人三兩或是獨自的行動，他們並不構成威脅。有五個軍事哨站監視著通道和寬闊的地方。這些都是我們可以除去或呼是的，如果我們不去理他們，他們將看不見我們。先知將會導引我們進入這裡解決所有的東西。
en_text: The Imperium is not strong here. Human hunters go alone, or in threes. They pose no threat. Five military outposts watch the byways and broad places. These we can remove or ignore. They will not see us, if we do not choose it. The Farseer will guide us in this and all matters.

tc_text: 總結來看，歐瑞羅斯就跟我們離開的時候一樣—複雜又困難，難攻進去，也很難防守住。
en_text: In all other ways, Orreloth is as we left it – gnarled and difficult. Hard to fight in and hard to hold.

tc_text: 在普林斯皮亞遙遠的西方邊境有一塊突出的地方，崎嶇不平又危險，讓旅行者無法涉足。這塊被稱為"岩石地"的地方就在絕望海角。
en_text: At the far western edge of Principia lie stretches of land so jagged, uneven, and dangerous that it is almost impossible to traverse them on foot. Beyond these so-called “rocklands” lies the Cape of Despair.

tc_text: 巫師柏里爾的發言。
"在眼中，我們站在龐大深淵的邊緣，是險峻美麗土地中的小小生命。在心中，在這個時代之前，我們則是站在屬於神靈族的偉大行動跟龐大損失的所在。
en_text: “To the eye, we stand upon the edge of a great abyss, in a land of austere beauty but little life. To the heart, which remembers, we stand in the very place where great acts and great losses were known to the Eldar, in an age before this one.

tc_text: "你知道嗎？我保證你的心會知道，聽聽我的話然後自己評斷。當我們在很久之前與死靈族戰鬥，詐騙者被召喚出來對抗我們。它讓我們相信在峭壁之旁就是無盡的平原，而我們的敵人則是脆弱不堪的。有一個神靈族逃脫了這個瘋狂並看見了我們的命運，他是一個強大的神態戰士。在那時他製造了一個偉大的凱因戰神，帶領我們遠離死亡和困境，然後在戰爭中得到的偉大的勝利。儘管詐騙者在之後扭轉了他的思緒，但死靈族的損失還是無法改變。這是一個轉捩點，戰爭的勝利因此快速的轉變到我們的方向。"
en_text: “Do you know it? Your heart does, I assure you. Hear my words and judge for yourself. When we battled the Necrons so very long ago, the Essence of the Deceiver was summoned against us. It made us believe this cliff to be an endless plane, and our foes to be weak and defenseless. There was one Eldar alone who broke free of the madness and saw our certain doom. He was a mighty Aspect Warrior, and in that time he was made a great Avatar of Khaine. He led us from death and certain doom, and on to a great victory in that war. For this the Deceiver later slew him, but the Necrons' loss could not be altered. It was a turning point, and the war swiftly turned in our favor.”

tc_text: 巫師沈默了一陣子。"這是我們一定要記得的事。明晰和遠見一直都在幫助我們遠離毀滅的邊緣。"
en_text: The Warlock was silent a moment. “It is for this that we must remember. Clarity and foresight ever keep us from the brink of destruction.”

tc_text: 生命在考拉瓦三號上並不如同規則般的興旺－但比起尼雷恩或是其它任何地方則是好多了。伊謬、王座、卡魯斯克和提莫林這四個城市環繞著遠古通道，跟星系中的其它星球進行貿易來維持他們的生計。
en_text: Life does not, as a rule, thrive on Kaurava III – but it fares better in Nirraein than anywhere else. The four cities of Immur, Throne, Karrusk, and Timmolin subsist off of the Ancient Gate that they encircle, carrying trade to and from the other planets in the system.

tc_text: 尼雷恩的財富足以讓他們進行整地、灌溉的工作，並且防衛外地野獸的襲擊。另外，這個區域同時也是卡拉瓦著名的鬥建競技場和競速賽車之鄉。
en_text: The wealth in Nirraein has allowed for a modest amount of terraforming, hydroponics, and security from outland beasts. The region has also been home to the famed Kauravan gladiatorial arenas and speed-racing courses.

tc_text: ++ 尼雷恩帝國防衛軍守護者軍團辦公室 ++
en_text: ++ Nirraein Imperial Guard Conservator Regiment’s Office ++

tc_text: 所有的警衛、哨兵和其他值勤的士兵將保持遠古通道額外15公里範圍的警戒。我們收到數個來自於通道的攻擊報告，這些攻擊都是未知的狀況，準備好面對任何事物，衛隊的同仁們。
en_text: All guards, sentries, and other soldiers on active duty will maintain extra vigilance within 15km of the Ancient Gate. We have received several strange reports of attacks coming from the very gate itself. As the nature of these attacks is unknown, be ready for anything, fellow Guardsmen.

tc_text: 在這個早上，我們擴大了遠古通道周圍的戰鬥警戒。從昨天的備忘錄開始，數起目擊報告確認了這些攻擊的本質。這些刺客的尖角飛船飛翔在黑暗之中，高火力的槍陣地正被設置在通道的周圍，來進行周邊的防禦。
en_text: As of this morning, we are officially escalating to battle-readiness within the vicinity of the Ancient Gate. Since yesterday’s memorandum, multiple eye-witness reports have confirmed the nature of these attacks. The assailants fly in dark, angular ships. High output gun-posts are being erected around the ancient gate in order to preserve our perimeter.

tc_text: 整個夜晚，守衛遠古通道的11個槍陣地中有六個被摧毀了，沒有發出任何的求救訊號。不管我們在這裡要面對的是甚麼，它都是非常的迅速而且極端的危險。我們已經向杜薩拉請求援助，讓我們祈求皇帝的援軍可以及時趕到。
en_text: Overnight, six of the eleven gun-posts guarding the ancient gate were destroyed, without even a call for help. Whatever we are dealing with here is extremely dangerous and very likely extremely fast. A request for help has been sent to Dussala. Let us pray to the Emperor that help arrives in time.

tc_text: 卡拉瓦III單一大陸的北方區域，逐漸變成了寬闊的紅色沙漠。而沙漠在最後變成了具有毒害、不適合居住的深淵，蔓延了整個星球2/3的區域。
en_text: The high northern regions of Kaurava III’s single continent lower gradually into vast tracts of red desert. The desert itself eventually descends into the poisonous and uninhabitable abyss that shrouds over two thirds of the planet.

tc_text: 帝國勢力長久以來控制著星系，卻從不知可能有麻煩埋藏在這些沙地之下。直到當第一個被喚醒的死靈族爬出了沙地，橫跨了整個伊摩沙之後，他們才學到了一件事情：那就是死亡。
en_text: The Imperial forces that have long controlled the system never suspected that something terrible might lie beneath those sands. Not even when the first awakened Necrons crawled from the sands did they learn the truth. By the time they did, crossing into Imossa meant only one thing: death.

tc_text: ++ 調查小組398官方語音記錄 ++
皮爾努斯：好吧，維斯特，當你進行時把它讀出來，我會盯著顯示的。
en_text: PIRENUS: Alright, Verst, you read it out as you go, and I’ll keep my eye on the readings.

tc_text: 維斯特：準備好了嗎？
皮爾努斯：我們已經在盤旋了。
皮爾努斯：好，很好，我正在擷取最後一次掃瞄中的信號，繼續。
en_text: PIRENUS: Good, good. I’m getting a signal on the last sweep. Keep going.

tc_text: 皮爾努斯：等等！等等！停一下，那是甚麼？
en_text: PIRENUS: Wait! Wait! Hold up. What was THAT?

tc_text: 維斯特：它顯示了108。
皮爾努斯：嗯，還有指示器…不可能。那裡全都是沙，我們知道的。在岩床上應該除了沙外，甚麼都沒有才對。
en_text: PIRENUS: Yeah, and the indicators… that just can’t be. It’s all sand. We KNOW it’s all sand. Sand all the way down to bedrock, and nothing else.

tc_text: 維斯特：現在是96。
皮爾努斯：甚麼？它在移動？這是同一個讀數嗎？你確定嗎，維斯特，那到底是甚麼東西在移動？不，你知道嗎？我可不想知道。讓我們繼續進行下一個區域，我們會補足數字的。
en_text: PIRENUS: What? It’s MOVING? That’s the same reading? Are you sure. Verst, what the hell does it mean if it’s moving? No, you know what? On second thought, I don’t want to know. Let’s clear on to the next sector. We’ll make up the numbers.

tc_text: 維斯特：皮爾，語音記錄還是開的。
en_text: VERST: Pi, the vox recorder’s still going.

tc_text: 皮爾努斯：皇帝足下！當我們回去時別忘了把記錄給抹掉，我們會假造那些數字的。我的天啊，那些沙—它們會移動！以特拉之名，我們走吧！
en_text: PIRENUS: Emperor’s feet! Well don’t forget to destroy that bit when we get back, and we’ll fake the numbers. My god, the sands – they’re moving! For Terra’s sake, GO!

tc_text: 當龐大的山脈橫跨了整個考拉瓦四號的上方區域時，從上到下，在這些山脈之中只有在東北方的區域才是真正的山岳國家。
en_text: While the great mountain range crosses the entire upper continent of Kaurava IV, top to bottom, it is the northeast province that is true mountain country, taking the name of those predominant mountains.

tc_text: 在渾沌勢力抵達這個星球之前，莫侯地帶曾是翠綠旺盛的宏偉之地，現在卻變得陰暗而邪惡。污穢之物潛伏在這地方的裂縫跟洞穴之中，等待阿爾發軍團或是暗黑神靈族經過遠古通道時來與其作戰。
en_text: Before the arrival of Chaos on the planet, the Morholts were verdant and grandiose, looking down on the fertile lands on either side. Now they have blackened and grown sinister. Foul things lurk in the crevices and caves of this country, while the Alpha Legion or the Dark Eldar fight for and travel through the high-placed Ancient Gate there.

tc_text: ++ 巫師督門‧西里歐斯的奧秘文字 ++
en_text: ++ Arcanum texts of Sorcerer Diuman Cilious ++

tc_text: ++ 由莫侯的高層發言 ++
en_text: ++ Uttered From Atop the Morholt Heights ++

tc_text: 這個大頭笨蛋皇帝無法瞭解他們不但無法擊敗我們，而且還無法在渾沌的勝利號角之下逃脫或反抗。
en_text: What the thick-headed fools with their broken corpse of an Emperor fail to understand is that not only can they never defeat us, but they can not hide or flee or shield themselves from the triumph of Chaos.

tc_text: 他們是有限之物，而我們是無限和無法分化的。他們不能犯錯，不然就會墜入異端之中，加入我們的目標。任何一個帝國笨蛋膽敢睜開他的眼睛，就是準備接受我們的徵召。他們的努力緊緊可以抵擋一下我們的狂怒和力量，他們繼而將會耗盡無遺。
en_text: They are finite and we are unbound, undivided. They must not err, or they fall to heresy. All who fall join our cause. Every Imperial fool who dares to open his eyes is a willing recruit. They strive merely to hold back our fury and might, and it consumes them.

tc_text: 因此你可以見到混沌是不可避免的。我們不只是潛伏在他們的控制和大門之下；我們還潛伏在他們靈魂的黑暗深處、在他們知覺的尖端、在他們折磨的夢中。我們就是他們，但卻沒被加諸無知的束縛。我們就是他們，但是我們更強壯...更先進。我們就是他們，但是多更多！
en_text: Thus you can see Chaos is inevitable. We lurk not only beyond their grasp and at their gates; we lurk within the darkness of their souls, on the tip of their tongues, in their tortured dreams. We are them, but freed from the shackles of ignorance. We are them, grown strong… evolved . We are them, but so much more!

tc_text: 這個粗獷的半島曾經是城市和農田的美麗組合，現在卻陷入了渾沌的黑暗之手中。大地滿是爛瘡，樹上長滿了茂密又看來邪惡的藤蔓。黑色的物體在空中飛撲，成群的遮蔽了陽光，並且製造出了巨大又吵鬧的噪音。
en_text: Once a beautiful patchwork of city and rolling farmland, this rough-hewn peninsula is now mired in the darkness of Chaos. The ground festers and crawls and trees are overgrown with sinister-looking vines and strange fungal growths. Black things swoop through the air, often in great numbers, blotting out sunlight and making a great, distant noise.

tc_text: 次元風暴穩定的在行星的上方迴旋，原生的能量像漏斗般的向下注入，並接觸到半島的一個點上，而那個點看來似乎非常的接近阿爾發軍團的總部。
en_text: The Warp Storm steadily whirls above the planet. Raw energy seems to funnel down and touch the peninsula at a single point. That point seems remarkably close to the Alpha Legion’s headquarters.

tc_text: ++ 戰爭八大守則 ++
++ 阿爾發軍團摘要 ++
1.紀律引領勝利
2.戰爭中的勝利帶來永生
en_text: 2. It is Victory in War that brings Immortality

tc_text: 3.永生是渾沌的恩賜
en_text: 3. Immortality is the Gift of Chaos

tc_text: 4.做為代價，渾沌需要鮮血
5.因此，鮮血必須濺灑
en_text: 5. Thus, Blood must ever be spilt

tc_text: 6.所以，永恆的生命需要永恆的戰爭
en_text: 6. Therefore, Eternal Life demands Eternal War

tc_text: 7.永恆的戰爭需要永恆的紀律
8.渾沌將永遠擁有鮮血：不是你的，就是他們的。
en_text: 8. Chaos will always have Blood: Yours or Theirs

tc_text: 在莫侯山脈下方的延伸區域都是險峻的山峰，瀑布從數千公尺高的地方落到下方的翠綠水池之中。很多像這樣的地方都不是適合人類居住或是通行的環境。在北方和南方之間只有一條通路，那就是有名的戈門通道。
en_text: The lower stretches of the Morholt Mountains are full of vertiginous peaks, with waterfalls cascading thousands of meters to emerald pools below. Much of this province is so pitched and uneven that it is not habitable or passable by humans. Only one pathway offers land-passage between the northeast and the southwest, and that is known as Gurmun’s Pass.

tc_text: 這條通道位於寬闊舒適的山谷之中，在裡面有幾個寂靜的小村莊。而其它地方的道路，就窄小到只能供一輛坦克車來通行。
en_text: This pass is at places a wide and pleasant valley, dotted with quiet villages. In other places, it narrows to little more than one tank’s breadth.

tc_text: ++ 摘錄：阿爾發軍團偵察報告 ++
當我們進入山脈後已經是第四個循環了。大多數的通道都很崎嶇，當黃昏時我們必須到達一個地方是那麼的狹窄和陡峭，除了夜空外我們甚麼都看不到，星辰在美麗而殘酷的次元風暴前蜷縮著。終於在破曉之前，我們到達了高地，通道也接著變寬了。我們看到在我們下方的是一個平緩的山谷，在溪流旁緊鄰著沈睡的村莊。我們突然的發動襲擊，在屠殺沈睡的無辜者之後，我們以恐虐之名升起了獻祭之火，然後將這個地方夷為平地。
en_text: It was the fourth cycle since we had set out into the mountains. Much of the passage was jagged, and by nightfall we had reached a place so narrow and steep that we could see little other than the night sky, the stars cowering before the beautifully savage and luminous Warp Storm. Finally, in the minutes before dawn, we reached a high place and the path widened. We saw below us a gentle valley, a sleepy village nestled against a stream there. We descended, and after spilling the blood of the sleeping innocents, we set a sacrificial fire in Khorne’s name and razed the settlement to the ground!

tc_text: 在第15個循環是節約之日，隨著我們襲擊了一座帝國防衛軍的哨站並且徹底的將其破壞，我們以渾沌之神為名奉獻出了許多的祭品，並且取走了對我們有用的食物和軍火物資。
en_text: The fifth cycle was provident, as we were able to surprise an Imperial Guard outpost and destroy it utterly. We offered many up as sacrifices in the name of the Chaos gods, and took what food and munitions were of use to us.

tc_text: 在這個行星赤道上超過半數的土地都集中在這個區域。因為這個第四行星離考拉瓦的太陽最遠，熱度也不會太高，所以讓崔斯蘭平原成為目前最佳的農田之地。
en_text: The majority of the land on the planet’s equator lies in this province. The general lack of warmth on this fourth and farthest planet from Kaurava’s sun makes the Tristram Plains the best farmland by far.

tc_text: 當行星北方的區域迅速的被渾沌給侵襲時，生產出了奇特的牛種，不過在最南端則還保留了它們的純樸之美。直到暗黑神靈族來到之前，許多農人就像生活在太平盛世一般。當然，他們現在都像奴隸般的被關在拉肯尼月球之上。
en_text: While the northern reaches of the Plains were quickly overrun by Chaos, producing mutated beasts of simple cattle, the southernmost reaches retain their rustic beauty, and until the Dark Eldar arrived, many farmers lived on as if there were no war raging around them. Of course, they are now all slaves caged upon the moon of Lacunae.

tc_text: ++ 戰鬥修女 ++
++ 神聖玫瑰團 ++
++ 異教徒審判庭邊年史 ++
以下是來自一個從考拉瓦四號的崔斯蘭逃出來的農夫，所做的直接記述。在目擊了這些事件後，他直接從遠古通道逃到了加拉甘達。這個農夫，已經徹底的懺悔，並且被寬容的處死了。
en_text: The following is a direct account reported by a farmer who fled from Tristram on Kaurava IV. He fled to Jalaganda via the Ancient Gate directly after witnessing these events. The farmer, one Stifan Nirebolus, has since been fully confessed and received a merciful death.

tc_text: 我發誓這些都是真的，修女，如同我畏懼著皇帝一般。當渾沌星際戰士攻擊我們的農田時，我躲在灌木的後方。我在那裡藏了一輛安靜的機車，我知道我得逃走，但我無法停止我自己—我看見他們在燃燒著僕人的四肢，我看見他們把我兄弟尖叫的家人從房子裡拖出來。我一定得離開，那裡真的是太恐怖了。接著，突然間，一陣尖嘯的聲音還有像是黑色蝗蟲的東西遮蔽了天空，他們是暗黑神靈族！我以前只有聽過他們，但我看到的東西絕對沒有錯。在我認出他們之前，他們對著阿爾發軍團開火...我看見一個混沌星際戰士撕裂了一個人的臂膀，我同時也看見一個穿著纏腰布的可怕女人一次對抗三個星際戰士，一下子就砍掉了三個人的頭。一道光束意外的燃燒了我身旁的灌木，接著我就逃開來了。
en_text: "I swear this is true, Sister, as I fear the Emperor. When the Chaos Space Marines attacked our farmstead I hid in the heath behind. I had hidden a small and very quiet auto bike there. I knew I should flee, but I couldn’t stop myself – I saw them burning the servants’ quarters and the silo. I saw them drag my brother’s family out of their house kicking and screaming. I should have gone, it was so terrible. Then, suddenly, there was a screaming sound and what looked like black locusts clouding the sky. The Dark Eldar! I have only heard of them, but there was no mistaking what I saw. Before I knew it, they were firing on the Alpha Legion… I saw one of the Chaos Space Marines tear the arm off of one. I also beheld a terrible woman in a loincloth fight three Marines at once, cutting off each of their heads in turn. A stray beam burnt the tree beside me to a crisp, and I fled."

tc_text: 被從在莫侯地帶上方的許多陸地孤立出來的馬可尼亞，總是跟有技術根基的顧客、和在南方陰鬱跑道另一邊的帕門尼，有著更多的共通之處。
en_text: Isolated from much of the upper continent by the Morholt Range, Marconia has always had more in common with the technology-based customs and ways of the Parmenians, south across the Lowering Straight.

tc_text: 在次元風暴之前，這地區的首都，包含了許多古老的城市，都是教育、藝術和工業的中心。
en_text: Prior to the Warp Storm, the regional capital, comprised of dozens of aggregated cities, were centers of learning, art, and industry.

tc_text: 執政官！我，凱爾‧烏瑞克，享樂者，回報勝利和增加數量的消息。我們用112人軍力的部隊痛擊了馬可尼亞，在我們的力量和速度之下，城市接著城市淪陷了。令人訝異的，人類跪了下來並請求饒恕，但我們甚麼都不給他們。費里恩淪陷了，接著是賽柏加，接著是比爾候。我們殺死許多人，但在每次的殺戮中，都會留下十個活口，那就是我們帶來比傳聞還要更多的禮物，要奉獻給強大的黑心卡柏。我們服侍你，執政官，服侍於你的力量之下。我，凱爾‧烏瑞克，享樂者，以上，你可以用我的行為來評斷我的言語。
en_text: Archon! I, Kel Urect, Sybarite, return with news of victory and increase. With a force of one hundred and twelve we stormed Marconia. Before our might and speed, city after city fell. Surprised, humans fell to their knees and begged for mercy, and we showed them none. Fillion fell, and Sabreguard, and Bierhold was leveled to the ground. We slayed many, but for every kill, ten were taken alive, so that the gifts we bring, proffered to the might of the Black Heart Kabal, are more than numerous. We serve you, Archon, for you are mighty. I, Kel Urect, Sybarite, have spoken, and you may judge my words by my deeds.

tc_text: 在不久之前，第一批帝國的移民，帝國機械信徒的狂熱者來到了考拉瓦四號的南方大陸定居。從那時開始，帕門尼就變成了機械主教的主要來源，和全力供應第251、252、253帝國防衛軍軍團坦克跟武器的生產工場。
en_text: Not long ago, the first Imperial colonists, devotees of the Imperial Machine Cult found their way to this southern continent of Kaurava IV and settled there. Since that time, Parmenie has been the primary source of Techpriests and boasts factories of an order fit to fully supply the 251st, 252nd and 253rd Imperial Guard Regiments with tanks and weaponry.

tc_text: 當暗黑神靈族抵達，他們發現這個機械之神膜拜者的大陸比上方的大陸更難征服。不管怎樣，當他們處理掉這些帝國的人後，便開始往南方發展，在最後終於達到了渾沌星際戰士所不能達到的成績。
en_text: When the Dark Eldar arrived, they found this continent of Machine-God worshipers far more difficult to raid than the upper continent. However, when they had exhausted those Imperial populations, they looked southward, eventually taking all that the Chaos Space Marines did not reach first.

tc_text: ++ 帝國工研所，考拉瓦的保存資料 ++
++ 帕門尼的馬哥斯的發言 ++
en_text: ++ Words of the Magos of Parmenie ++

tc_text: 機械之靈的忠誠僕人，我不需要告訴你黑暗的時光正籠罩著我們。我們被困在帕門尼，而且沒有人可以活的多久了。我希望可以活著見到我們所學得珍貴的知識被傳送到火星去，我希望，跟著我所有的道友，可以逃離這個星系。但是如果我們不能，那就讓我們記得跟邪惡的力量及渾沌作戰而死，是多麼榮耀的一件事情。
en_text: Loyal servants of the Machine Spirit, I need not tell you that dark times are upon us. We are trapped here in Parmenie, and none of us may have long to live. As I hope to live to see our acquired precious machine knowledge transferred to Mars, I hope, with all my brethren, to escape this system. But if we should not, let us remember that it is a great honor to die fighting the powers of evil and Chaos.

tc_text: 從現在開始，所有一般的義務都無限期停止。我們所有的努力都要投注在防禦我們可怕的敵人之上。這些包含了砲塔和升級顝顱探測器，還有石化蜥蜴級自走砲陣列。等待接收上級的命令，讓我們大家為了機械之靈而努力吧。
en_text: From this time forward, all normal duties are indefinitely suspended. The entirety of our efforts will be devoted to erecting formidable defenses against our foes. These will include turrets and upgraded skull probes of all varieties, as well as automated sensor-basilisk arrays. Await instructions from your superior. Let us all ever labor for the glory of the Machine Spirit!

tc_text: 不像北方是機械膜拜信徒的殖民地，位於帕門尼南方區域的粗糙、冰冷的內地，幾乎都是大片的荒蕪，不過也不是完全的無人居住。
en_text: Rough, chilly hinterlands form the southern region of Parmenie. Where the northern province is settled thoroughly by the believers in the Machine Cult, this scrubland is largely desolate, but not entirely empty.

tc_text: 在地表上的區域是帝國佔領區的分離物：軍事訓練地、工業廢料場、地窖或是其它類似的東西。
en_text: Dotting the landscape are the outliers of Imperial occupation: military training grounds, industrial waste sites, silos, quarries, and the like.

tc_text: ++ 語音日誌，被發現在燒盡的農場中 ++
en_text: ++ Vox journal, found in a burned out homestead ++

tc_text: 別為我做的事情責怪我，我看著我的妻子和女兒死在我的眼前。不是死亡就是投向渾沌，而我之道應該選擇渾沌。在這之後我學到的就是，渾沌就是生命，生命就是改變、破壞和新的型式，從未顯示出的新的變化。我們緊緊抓著皇帝，一個垂死的肖像，因為他就是我們全部所知曉的。我們畏懼生命，我們畏懼自己潛在的力量。帝國正在死亡，緩慢，但仍是死亡。我做了我該做的事情，就這樣。我打開了雙眼看到了我們全都像個笨蛋，向一個坐在王座中半死的失敗者躬身。哈哈！褻瀆仍然讓我發抖。這是一個全新的生命，我現在被奉獻給混沌了，現在我真實的活著！
en_text: Don’t blame me for what I’ve done. I watched my wife and daughters die before me. It was death or embracing Chaos, and I knew that through Chaos, I might live. Live! It is life that matters and what I have learned is that Chaos IS life, for life is change and destruction and new forms, new mutations ever manifesting. We clung to the Emperor, a dying effigy, because He was all we knew. We feared life. We feared our own potential strength. The Imperium is dying. A slow death, but it’s dying. I did what I had to, that’s all. I opened my eyes and saw what fools we all were, bowing to a half-dead failure slumped on a throne. Haha! The blasphemy still sends shivers down my spine. It is the freshness of life. I am given to Chaos now. Now I truly live!

tc_text: 長久以來，在考拉瓦四號上方的孤月，已經成為這個星球的象徵了－這是一個美麗的又艱困的世界，而它也是星際旅遊間的一個重要連結之處。但當暗黑神靈族到達時，這個地方被冠上了另一個新而恐怖的意義。
en_text: The lone moon above Kaurava IV has long been a symbol to the planet’s inhabitants – of the rough-hewn beauty of their world, and its important connection to interplanetary travel. When the Dark Eldar arrived, the symbol took on a new and more horrible meaning.

tc_text: 遠古通道現在只為它的新主人服務了，看來似乎只要透過它，就可以到達星系中的任何地方。當帝國在月球上的居民迅速被剷除時，暗黑神靈族快速的控制了從月球到主行星的傳輸路線。
en_text: The Ancient Gate now served only its new masters, who seemed able to descend almost anywhere in the system through it. With the Imperial population on the moon quickly wiped out, the Dark Eldar quickly went on to control the one transit route from the moon to the main planet.

tc_text: ++ 拉肯尼刑罰花園 ++
++ 發現刻寫在牢籠地板上的文字 ++
en_text: ++ Found scratched into the floor of a cage ++

tc_text: 當我開始計算日子之後，我被這些未開化的低等種族俘虜已經超過20個循環了。我在牢籠後面隱藏了一片金屬片，讓我可以在地板上刻字。我不確定會有人可以讀到這些；至少不是在我還活著的時候。這些都是我為自己寫的，用來支持我的勇氣和精神。
en_text: As far as I am able to reckon, more than twenty cycles have passed since I was taken captive by this barbarous and debased people. I have hidden a shard of metal at the back of my cage, and it is with this that I scratch these words into its floor. I am certain no one shall ever read this; not while I live. I write for myself, to sustain my courage and sanity.

tc_text: 那些管轄這個地方的人手上有一個很大的鐵爪，而他邪惡的笑聲會出沒在你的夢境中。當他們攻破了我們的本部時，裡面有超過40個人：28個烈焰戰士和至少12個克魯特戰士。每天他都會挑一個人抓出去折磨拷打，很多人都死在他用在我們身上的一個恐怖機器。我曾經見過那個機器，它會吸食你身上所有的生命。我看著見過大家日益空虛、陰鬱、閃光消逝的眼神，而我們現在只剩下四個人了。喔！那種疼痛—是極度的痛苦。我沒辦法說出他做出的恐怖行動，不，我不想待在這裡，這裡永遠不會有人可以讀到我寫的這些字。
en_text: The one who presides over this place has a great metal claw over one hand. His vile laughter haunts your dreams. When they captured our cadre, there were over forty of us: twenty-eight Fire Warriors and twelve Kroot. Day after day, he has taken one or another of us out for torture. Occasionally he will push one of us too far, but more often we die when he places our heads in a terrible machine. I have seen it. It is as if it sucked more than just the life out of you. I have seen their eyes grow vacant, murky, and something gleaming pass out. We have dwindled to only four. Oh! The pain – the agony. What horrible acts he has committed, I cannot repeat. No, not even here, which no one will ever read.

tc_text: 你的弟兄，
你是渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫，為了征服的行動和復仇之名，你引領著阿爾發軍團脫離了次元風暴的致命波動。
en_text: You are the Chaos Lord Firaeveus Carron. You have led the dreaded Alpha Legion out of the deadly fluctuations of the Warp Storm in the name of conquest and revenge.

tc_text: 擊敗令人憎惡的帝國軍隊，並且以渾沌的恐懼之名，征服考拉瓦星系。
en_text: Strike down the hated armies of the Imperium and claim the Kaurava System in the dread name of Chaos.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：忽視補給線
你是塔里爾執政官，黑心卡柏。你從黑暗卡莫拉穿越了魍道，來到考拉瓦的戰場進行血腥的屠殺。
en_text: You are the Archon Tahril, of the Black Heart Kabal. You have traversed the Webway paths from dark Commoragh to make a blood-sport of the Kaurava battlefield.

tc_text: 因為你著迷於敵人靈魂上的歡宴，和沈醉於戰勝之中，讓暗黑神靈族不再擁有速度和殘酷的優勢。
en_text: Revel in conquest and feast upon the souls of your enemies. The Dark Eldar have no equal for speed or cruelty.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：免費的遠古通道之行
en_text: BONUS POWER: Free Ancient Gate travel

tc_text: 你是先知卡里絲，帶領著工藝世界烏斯維的大軍。在預知中你見到了考拉瓦陷入了巨大的危險。不管是暗黑神靈族這個愚蠢而年輕的種族，或是渾沌勢力的軍隊，你都無法相信他們可以和死靈族來進行對抗。
en_text: You are Farseer Caerys, leading the armies of Craftworld Ulthwe. In visions you have seen the great danger that looms over Kaurava. The foolish younger races cannot be trusted to deal with the Necrons, Dark Eldar, or the armies of Chaos.

tc_text: 善用你的速度和潛行的優勢，來騙過阻擋你的敵人。
en_text: Make use of your superior speed and stealth to outwit all who obstruct you.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：增加移動速度
你是文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍，第252守護者軍團的新指揮官。你必須比前任領導者更強壯、更有紀律，並且重申帝國防衛軍在卡拉瓦星系的權力。
en_text: You are General Vance Stubbs, newly appointed to the 252nd Kauravan Conservator Regiment. You must be stronger and more disciplined than your predecessor, and re-assert the Imperial Guard’s right to rule the Kaurava System.

tc_text: 擊敗任何在你面前的異型和異教徒，但也要小心那些看輕帝國防衛軍價值的帝國人士。
en_text: Strike the alien and the heretic before you, but keep an eye open for elements of the Imperium who do not respect the worth of the Imperial Guard.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：降低生產花費
你是死靈族大君，從考拉瓦三號的千年沈睡之中醒來，你無堅不摧的死亡軍隊又再度的復生了。
en_text: You are the Necron Lord who has wakened from millennia of slumber in the sands of Kaurava III. Your inexorable army of death marches once more against the living.

tc_text: 將致命的浮石巨塔重新啟動，並且集結你的軍團。這個世界曾經屬於你，現在又再將度回到你的掌握中。
en_text: Restore your dreaded Monoliths and raise your legion armies. This world was yours once, and shall be again.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：回復失落的力量
你是獨一無二的戰爭頭目戈古茲，帶領著永不疲憊的吼～軍團，在考拉瓦進行著大規模的作戰。戰鬥的規模越是龐大，偉大的歐克蠻族勝利的機會就越大。
en_text: You are the one and only Warboss Gorgutz. You have brought your tireless Waaagh! to the big fight going on in Ko-ruvva. The bigger the fight, the greater the Ork who wins it.

tc_text: 帶領你在考拉瓦的孩子們去痛擊所有的敵人。
en_text: Lead the Ko-ruvvan Boyz and stomp all your enemies good.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：人口快速的成長
你是大修女賽林娜‧阿格娜，帶領著戰鬥修女在光榮的戰役中對抗所有神聖皇帝的敵人。你的責任是清除這個世界上的異種、外星生物和異教徒。
en_text: You are the Canoness Selena Agna, leading the Sisters of Battle in glorious battle against all foes of the holy God-Emperor. It is your duty to cleanse these worlds of the mutant, the alien, and the heretic alike.

tc_text: 巨大的腐敗力量已經籠罩了考拉瓦星系，每一個的人都可能是異教和腐化之徒。所有的事物都需要被淨化之火焚燒，然後讓他們回歸於大地之中。
en_text: A great corruption has fallen upon the Kaurava System, and every one there is suspected of heresy or taint. Everything must be burnt to the ground.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：前進基地
你是弟兄們的領隊—英德里克‧波里爾，帶領五支血鴉連隊進入了戰場，與污穢的渾沌軍隊和外星垃圾對抗。這個星系存在了太多的異端、腐敗和帝國的敵人。
en_text: You are Brother-Captain Indrick Boreale, leading five Blood Raven companies into battle against the foul armies of Chaos and the xenos filth. This system abounds in heresy, corruption, and enemies of the Imperium.

tc_text: 帶領著無與倫比的星際戰士來為皇帝的榮耀而戰，你的勝利是必然的。
en_text: Lead your peerless Space Marines to utter conquest for the glory of the Emperor. Your victory is inevitable.

tc_text: 獎勵力量：深入打擊小隊
你是天賦異稟的指揮官—歐耶斯卡將軍。你來自於鈦星帝國，胸懷著三個偉大的目標：控制次元風暴，建立一個強大的軍事前哨站，然後將整個考拉瓦星系變成為殖民地。
en_text: You are the gifted general Commander Or’es’Ka. You come from the Tau Empire with a three-fold goal: contain the Warp Storm, build a mighty military outpost, and prepare all Kaurava for colonization.

tc_text: 善用你的種族的先進科技，以及他們的同盟，在這場至高無上的競賽中對抗無知又虛偽的敵人。因為只有你的勝利，才可以顯示更大良善的卓越智慧。
en_text: Ply your technologically advanced race, and their allies, against the ignorant and deceitful enemies all vying for supremacy. Only your victory will show the superior wisdom of the luminous Greater Good.

en_text: - Deep strike squads return to your stronghold if you are victorious. Otherwise, they are lost.

tc_text: －健康的環境和生活條件可以供給士兵額外的徵召力、回復能力、以及其它的東西。
en_text: - Wholesome environment and living conditions promote extra soldiers via recruiting, recovery, and other means.

tc_text: －駐防人數會隨著每一回合增加數量。
en_text: - Garrison populations automatically increase every number of turns.
