Perhaps this memory deepened the bitter despair of the Dark Eldar, as they fought and died. Perhaps there was a gloating air of vengeance to the Necrons as they crushed them.

tc_text: 事實上有一座古老的神靈族堡壘曾經駐紮在考拉瓦三號，這讓第252守護者軍團徹底的受到震驚，也是史塔伯斯將軍不願意聽到的事情。在派出了軍官負責打探考拉瓦三號軍情給打擊小隊之後，史塔伯斯將軍便開始進行除去行星上所有非帝國勢力的存在。
en_text: The fact that an ancient Eldar stronghold had resided on Kaurava III took the 252nd Conservator Regiment entirely by surprise, something that General Vance Stubbs was not pleased to hear of. After sending the officers responsible for intelligence on Kaurava III to the firing squads, General Stubbs undertook to remove all non-Imperial presences from the planet.

tc_text: 雖然神靈族的戰略和科技均大幅遠勝，但無畏的將軍匯集的火力和重甲發揮了極大優勢，終於找出地圖上的所有神靈族軍力，將他們逼至敗境並逐出地圖範圍。
en_text: Although the strategies and technology of the Eldar far outmatched his abilities, the fearless General marshaled firepower and heavy armor to great advantage, finally revealing, cornering, and removing the Eldar forces from the face of the the map.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍在戰鬥後所發現的東西，是神靈族武力比他們更早存在的證據，事實上，遠比任何帝國軍都還要久遠。史塔伯斯將軍對這個發現只有一點點的訝異，接著便下令清除了所有的神靈族建築和人造物。
en_text: What the Imperial Guard found, after the battle, was evidence of an Eldar military presence older than theirs, and, in fact, older than the very Imperium. General Stubbs paused only a moment to wonder at this, before ordering nearly all of the Eldar structures and artifacts summarily destroyed.

tc_text: 在史塔伯斯的想法中，考拉瓦三號是個荒涼的星球，可以用來開礦，只要一點的武力駐紮，然後就沒甚麼特別的了。而上廢棄場應該可以成為帝國防衛軍較低等的前哨站。
en_text: In Stubbs’ mind, Kaurava III was a waste planet, good for mining, a few necessary military installations, and no more. The Upper Wastes would make a finer low-grade outpost for the Imperial Guard.

tc_text: 最近經過神靈族在洛恩五號 及克諾努斯上的衝突的全面簡報後，部隊指揮官英德里克‧波里爾小心翼翼的看著先知卡里絲的部隊。或許他想在其它的狀況中與嚴峻的神靈族領袖達成一個謹慎的聯盟，但當機會來臨時，他也不會猶豫攻擊她在上廢棄場中的堡壘，來達成血鴉在考拉瓦星系的任務。
en_text: Having been fully briefed on the recent Eldar interference on Lorn V and in the Conflict Over Kronus, Force Commander Indrick Boreale kept a wary eye on the armies of Farseer Caerys. Although he might have made a cautious ally of the stern Eldar leader in other circumstances, Boreale did not hesitate to attack her stronghold in the Upper Wastes when the opportunity presented itself, in order to ensure the Blood Ravens' complete subjugation of the Kaurava System.

tc_text: 波里爾知道那是個直接攻擊，他正面對一個狡猾的戰術家，而她的本能和戰場上的智慧可能遠超過波里爾自己。不過，他對自己的部隊有完全的信心來獲取勝利，並利用計謀在每個機會中來勝過神靈族。這場賭博他將會勝出，而血鴉也將會撐到勝利的那一天。
en_text: Boreale knew that in a direct attack, he was facing a shrewd tactician whose instincts and battlefield wisdom might well exceed his own. Nevertheless, he had full faith in his Space Marines to overpower and outmaneuver the Eldar at every opportunity. The gamble paid off, and the Blood Ravens took the day.

tc_text: 星際戰士找到證據指出，一支古老的神靈族部隊出現在上廢棄場。不過，他們的基地非常的小，也只有小數量的補給儲存，看來神靈族相當依賴他們的魍道。
en_text: The Space Marines found evidence suggesting an Eldar presence in the Upper Wastes that was surprisingly ancient. However, other than a small number of supply caches, the base consisted of very little, as the Eldar relied heavily on their Webway.

tc_text: 作為神聖君主的敵人：賽林娜‧阿格娜大修女就像看著其他外星人一樣的看待神靈族。她知道他們的古老文化和先進的文明，但對她來說這只會讓他們變成皇帝的首要對手。藉由對著艾克黎西亞奇教義的忠貞堅持，她面對著神靈族，聲稱他們是帝國的天敵，而許多奸詐狡猾的外星敵人都無法戰勝戰鬥修女的虔誠衝擊和破壞的烈焰。
en_text: Canoness Selena Agna viewed the Eldar as she did every other alien race: as enemies of the God-Emperor. She knew of their ancient and advanced civilization, but to her this only made them rivals to the Emperor’s primacy. Bolstered by her adherence to the doctrine of the Ecclesiarchy, the Canoness marched against the Eldar, declaring them natural enemies of the Imperium. The many ruses and deceits of the alien enemy could not prevail against the Sisters of Battle religious zeal and devastating flames.

tc_text: 跟隨著勝利、必要的禱告和洗禮，阿格娜大修女命令清除古老的神靈族堡壘。所有的神靈族科技都付之一炬，上廢棄地徹底的被洗滌，而這地方也被劃為是艾克黎西亞奇修女會跟帝國的屬地。
en_text: Following the victory, and the necessary prayers and ablutions, Canoness Agna ordered the ancient Eldar stronghold cleansed. Almost all the Eldar technology was burned and cleared away. The Upper Wastes were ritually purified and declared territory of the Imperium and dominion of the Ecclesiarchal Sisterhood.

tc_text: 因為他們逃避戰術所引起的挫敗，讓渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫察覺到心中有一股怒火直向神靈族。他渴望擊敗這些討厭的敵人，讓他可以在這片荒蕪的上廢棄地建造神殿，來增強渾沌的力量，確保阿爾發軍團在攻擊他們的堡壘時不會有任何的延遲。
en_text: Frustrated by their elusive tactics, Chaos Lord Firaeveus Carron felt a growing ire towards the Eldar. His longing to crush these troublesome foes, combined with his desire to claim the barren lands of the Upper Wastes for a great temple and testament to the powers of Chaos, ensured that the Alpha Legion would attack at their stronghold without great delay.

tc_text: 很快的卡倫大君不再等待，而他的渾沌星際戰士帶著力量和怒火開始攻擊。他們跨越了先知卡里絲所設置的陷阱和計謀，徹底的毀滅了他們的敵人。
en_text: Soon Lord Carron could wait no longer, and his Chaos Space Marines struck with deadly might and fury. They thwarted the many tricks and traps that Farseer Caerys set, unleashing havoc in their wake.

tc_text: 在敵人跟先知逃亡之後，卡倫派出他的人手來獵捕和折磨殘存的神靈族。在確認沒有任何生靈留存後，渾沌星際戰士接著剷平和毀滅了神靈族的建築和遺留物。
en_text: After the enemy was routed, and the Farseer had fled, Carron loosed his men to hunt and torture the remaining Eldar. Once nothing living was left, the Chaos Space Marines took to looting and destroying the Eldar structures and stores.

tc_text: 神靈族不會輕易的遺忘，這些在許多年前從工藝世界表親所分出來的黑暗分支，至今仍在背後用憎惡的目光來看著他們。當他們到達這個星系時，塔里爾統治者曾用警惕的眼神看著神靈族先知的行事。或許是天性使然，讓他無法克制自己，來去壓抑這個被挑撥起來的遠古仇恨。
en_text: Eldar do not easily forget. The Dark branch of their kind, who many millennia ago had split from their Craftworld cousins, still looked back on them with the kind of hatred that can only stem from personal betrayal. Since they had arrived in the system, Archon Tahril had kept a wary eye on the doings of the Eldar Farseer. Debased by nature, he could not restrain himself for long against the provocations of this ancient hatred.

tc_text: 當他發覺自己夠強壯時，他和他的嗜血隊伍襲擊了伊索‧艾坦尼的神靈族堡壘，那是帝國為上廢棄地所命定的名稱。塔里爾統治者跟先知卡里絲相互對抗、互施計謀、互相憎惡，但在最後則是暗黑神靈族得到了勝利。
en_text: When he felt he was strong enough, he and his bloodthirsty raiding band fell upon the Eldar stronghold of Essel ir-Tanil, which the Imperium had named the Upper Wastes. Archon Tahril and Farseer Caerys were pitted one against the other, speed for speed, trick for trick, evasion for evasion, but in the end it was the Dark Eldar who struck the final blow.

tc_text: 他的戰士在褻瀆被捕捉的神靈族時所得到的狂野熱趣，遠超過對待任何其他的種族。當然，那一大批人質是留下來要進貢給塔里爾跟他的上級官僚的。即使是擁有了這麼多，塔里爾仍為先知卡里絲的逃脫而深深的痛苦，而她可能永遠都沒辦法成為他的個人玩物。這仍然是個偉大的勝利，並且可以讓他驕傲的站在黑心凱柏的統治者之中。
en_text: The wild pleasure that his warriors took in defiling the captured Eldar was far greater than it could have been for any other race. Of course, the bulk of hostages were reserved for tribute to Tahril and his superiors. Yet in spite of all his bounty, Tahril was deeply pained to learn that Farseer Caerys had escaped, and might never be made his personal plaything. Still, the victory was great, and would raise his standing among the Archons of the Black Heart Kabal.

tc_text: 如果戰爭頭目戈古茲在他領導歐克蠻族跟帶領聯軍的許多年中，有學到任何的事情，那一定是神靈族、或是"尖耳朵"代表著麻煩，並且最好是趕快找到機會毀滅他們。當他的考拉瓦的孩子們發現自己身處在炙熱又多沙的上廢棄地時，他給了一段很好的談話，警告他們放亮罩子，動作迅速，做出歐克蠻族所知道的應變。
en_text: If Warboss Gorgutz had learned anything in his many years leading the Orks, it’s that the Eldar, or “pointy-ears,” were trouble, and it was best to crush them as soon as you had the chance. When his Kauravan boyz found themselves in the hot, sandy barrens of the Upper Waste, he gave them a good talk, warning them that they’d have to be the sharpest-eyed, fastest, choppiest Orks ever known.

tc_text: 或許我們不能說歐克蠻族可以跟上神靈族的靈活和多變，但他們的確證明了歐克的力量和韌性足以對抗任何的詭計。被歐克蠻族強力的壓迫，神靈族被迫瘋狂的戰鬥，接著，他們被征服、被戰勝。
en_text: While it might not be said that the Orks anticipated every move of the quick-witted and devious Eldar, they certainly proved that Orkish strength and resilience could stand up to any such trickiness. Pressed hard by the avalanche of Orks, the Eldar fought frantically, and then, overwhelmed, succumbed.

tc_text: 事實上有些神靈族，包含了先知卡里絲，其實可以在歐克蠻族戈古茲之前撤退到他們最後的魍道關口。歐克蠻族橫掃了整個區域，揭露了許多隱藏在堡壘旁的貯藏所和哨站，並且用勝利的喜悅來洗劫了這些地方。
en_text: The fact that some Eldar, including the Farseer Caerys, were able to retreat into their last Webway Gate before the advancing Orks, troubled Gorgutz very little. He had won. The Orks scoured the area, uncovered the many caches and depots hidden within the stronghold’s grounds, and smashed a great deal of it with triumphant enthusiasm.

tc_text: 自從到達了考拉瓦星系，鈦星指揮官歐耶斯卡緊緊著盯著神靈族的部隊。他們出現所帶來的問題，讓他必須抓緊他們渴求製造衝突的天性。不幸的，歐耶斯卡無法瞭解神靈族跟死靈族之間的世仇，或是理解先知卡里絲的行動，她不像鈦星人是用憑藉策略來行動，而是根據直覺，一個關於危險未來的強力幻象。對他來說，神靈族總是懷著莫名其妙的怒火。雖然他無法藉由過去對神靈族的認識來化解，但他已經察覺到他們在考拉瓦的存在，已不合乎更偉大良善的目標了。
en_text: Since arriving in the Kaurava System, the Tau Commander Or’es’Ka had watched the Eldar forces closely. Puzzled by their presence, he had endeavored to grasp the nature of their interest in the conflict. Unfortunately, Or’es’Ka was unable to know the ancient feud between the Eldar and the Necrons, or interpret the actions of Farseer Caerys, who led not by strategy, in the Tau sense, but by powerful visions of future dangers. To him, the Eldar were on an inexplicable warpath. Although he could not reconcile this with past knowledge of the Eldar, he determined that their presence in Kaurava was incompatible with the Greater Good.

tc_text: 又乾又熱的上廢棄地對歐耶斯卡指揮官的烈焰戰士來說是一個優勢，依據他們沈穩的訓練、和精心編排的戰術設計，他們將神靈族趕出了這個區域。歐耶斯卡命令他的戰士放走逃逸的神靈族，但在戰鬥之後，在這裡的魍道關口都被毀滅了。偉大的指揮官希望在這之後，神靈族可以感受到鈦星人的優越和仁慈，而能在日後的一天站在他們更大良善的旗幟之下。
en_text: The hot, dry lands of the Upper Wastes were an advantage to Commander Or’es’Ka’s Fire Warriors. With their calm discipline and well-orchestrated tactics, they drove the Eldar from the field. Or’es’Ka ordered his warriors to allow fleeting Eldar to escape, but after the battle, the land was scoured for Webway gates, all of which were destroyed. The great commander hoped that in this fashion, the Eldar would hear of the Tau superiority and benevolence, and one day join them under the banner of the Greater Good.

tc_text: 在數千年前，死靈族和神靈族在考拉瓦三號進行著史詩般的戰爭，而在那久遠的日子中神靈族獲勝了。現在同樣的戰爭上演，但是征服者和被征服者卻不同了。所有神靈族戰爭藝術的致命力量不再能對抗死靈族的猛烈攻擊，卡里絲先知所有的預知和準備，都已經無法跟她的敵人--死靈大君來對抗了。
en_text: Many millennia ago, the Necrons and Eldar had waged epic war across the lands of Kaurava III, and in that distant age the Eldar had prevailed. Now it was as if that same battle replayed itself, but vanquisher and vanquished were reversed. All the deadly might of the Eldar art of war proved useless against the Necron onslaught. All the premonitions and provisions of Farseer Caerys failed to match her adversary, the Necron Lord.

tc_text: 在死靈族逐漸的茁壯後獲得每次的勝利，考拉瓦星系上的其他戰士擾亂了神靈族的步伐。而當神靈族的力量削弱，死靈族的力量就會接著增長。
en_text: The other combatants in the Kaurava System had distracted the Eldar. The Necrons grew strong, while the Eldar’s strength was whittled away.

tc_text: 服侍著黑暗之神的死靈族大君，在勝利的奪取神靈族堡壘中作了些邪惡的報復。死靈族軍隊不斷的屠宰所有的生靈，徹底的蹂躪了所有神靈族的餘存，而在這個過程中還發現了他們許多的上古儲存物。
en_text: The Necron Lord, or the dark gods he served, surely took some malevolent satisfaction in the victory over the Eldar stronghold. The Necron army did not stop at the slaughter of all life forms, but trampled every last vestige of the Eldar presence, uncovering many of their ancient supply caches in the process.

tc_text: 廣大的鈦星部隊在考拉瓦二號的第二月球上，完成了超越目前所有戰爭的企圖。在一個鈦星人控制的太陽系中，這個成功讓其轉變成為帝國在邊界的關鍵前哨站。這個月球被命名為楠‧亞諾以，或是被稱為"劍月"，原因是在那裡建造了強大的阿卡火砲。這個武器可以對著任何在這星系的星球，發射它具毀滅性的離子射線。
en_text: The vast Tau military complex on Kaurava II’s second moon had always been intended for purposes above and beyond the current war. In a Tau-dominated solar system, this complex would become a key outpost on the Empire’s border. This moon base had been named Nan Yanoi, or “Sword Moon”, referring to the powerful Ar’Ka Cannon built there. This weapon could fire its devastating ion beam on any territory of any planet in the system.

tc_text: 重防禦工事和防空陣列對楠‧亞諾以上的大地級建築來說是不夠的，因此他們增設了一座巨大的軌道防禦系統，它可以發射類似阿卡火砲的離子射線，不過這只能用來傷害任何企圖侵犯楠‧亞諾以設施的入侵者。
en_text: Heavy fortifications and anti-aircraft arrays were not enough for the Earth Caste architects of Nan Yanoi. To these they added an ambitious orbital perimeter defense system, which would fire ion beams, similar to that of the Ar’Ka Cannon, tuned to harm only intruders and spare Nan Yanoi’s infrastructure from any damage.

tc_text: 當它完成之後，楠‧亞諾以就難以攻破了。不幸的是，在它完成之前鈦星堡壘就受到了攻擊。有許多的系統和防禦工事都還沒開始完全運作，這還包含了周邊防禦系統。一支入侵部隊或許還可以被擊退，但如果在鈦星的外圍防禦中搶立了灘頭堡，那就不是那麼容易應付了。像這樣的情況是不太容易發生的，但並非絕不可能。
en_text: When complete, Nan Yanoi would be unassailable. Unfortunately, the Tau stronghold was attacked before it was complete. Many systems and fortifications were not yet fully operational, including the perimeter defense system. An invasion fleet could be shot down, but they could not as easily protect against a small force from making a beachhead at one of the gaps in the Tau’s outer defenses. Such a feat would be extraordinarily difficult, but it might just be possible.

tc_text: 文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍在楠‧亞諾以月球的英勇事蹟，顯示了任何鈦星對考拉瓦入侵的結束。事實上，先進堡壘的攻破以及他們乙太導師的死亡，讓考拉瓦衝突成了鈦星人的痛苦記憶。如果鈦星人還試圖再度進犯考拉瓦，也會是數百年之後的事情了。
en_text: General Vance Stubbs’ heroic conquest of the Nan Yanoi moon base meant the end of any true Tau threat to the Kaurava System. In fact, the breach of their technologically advanced fortress and the death of their Ethereal rendered the Kaurava Conflict a bitter memory to the Tau. It would be centuries before the Tau would again consider any attempt to expand into Kaurava.

tc_text: 在進攻之前，史塔伯斯將軍顯露出對鈦星先進的防禦工事的鄙視。即使是當前哨站在攻擊時只有受到持續些微的傷害，對帝國來說它們都還是邪惡異端的外星人科技而已。
en_text: Before the troops, General Stubbs showed disdain for the impressive Tau fortifications and battlements. Even if the outpost had sustained little damage in the assault, it would be unbecoming of pious servants of the Imperium to show too much interest in alien and heretical technology.

tc_text: 不管怎樣，非常秘密的，史塔伯斯在區域指揮部收藏了許多鈦星的物品和武器，你必須知道他可能不是很贊成上級的看法，他們的研究或許將會揭發鈦星軍事的新秘密。當他的手下正在慶祝、洗劫和破壞外星人的設施時，史塔伯斯將軍則是微笑的想著他在個人野心事業上所開創的道路。
en_text: More quietly, however, Stubbs had many Tau artifacts and weapons secreted to Segmentum Command, knowing well that he could curry favor among his superiors if their study should reveal new insights into Tau technology. While his men celebrated, looting and vandalizing the xeno stores, General Stubbs smiled to think of the progress he was making on an undeniably ambitious career path.

tc_text: 致英德里克‧波里爾指揮官無畏的同伴血鴉，楠‧亞諾以 月球基地的防禦信心、邪惡的科技和迂迴的火力，全都是詛咒的代表。在波里爾的想法中，要擊退這樣的敵人就代表著當然他的弟兄可以征服一切的優勢。鈦星人得到了各式的挫敗，在失去了備受尊敬的乙太導師和著名的軍事指揮官之後，他們就走上了一條嚴苛的失敗之路。
en_text: To Commander Indrick Boreale’s company of intrepid Blood Ravens, the Nan Yanoi moon base‘s reliance on defense, unholy technology, and indirect fire were anathema to all they stood for. To defeat such an enemy was to prove, in Boreale’s mind, that the superiority of his men could conquer all. Of course, the Tau saw their defeat differently. The tragic loss of a revered Ethereal and famed Military Commander was interpreted, after the fact, as a failure to employ sufficiently rigorous methods.

tc_text: 為了增加靜態防禦的小小作用，波里爾只留下足夠的人手來保留他們的征服成果。指揮官認為他已經為帝國聲討了考拉瓦星系，而這個月球應該可以作為帝國工研所的一個很好的補給站。
en_text: Having little use for static defenses, Boreale left only enough men as were required to hold their conquest, no more. The Commander thought that once he had claimed the Kaurava System for the Imperium, the moon would make a fine depot for the Adeptus Mechanicus.

tc_text: 賽林娜‧阿格娜大修女感覺到鈦星人準備了一個單一的陣勢，來對付他們所有的敵人。如果讓他們完成了楠‧亞諾以月球基地，那麼鈦星人就會擁有一座堅固的城堡，這對修女會來說將會成為一個很大的威脅。
en_text: Of all their adversaries, Canoness Selena Agna felt that the Tau posed a singular threat. If allowed to complete their Nan Yanoi moon base, the Tau would have an almost impenetrable stronghold, which could do great damage to the Sisterhood’s cause.

tc_text: 為了降低她的恐懼，告解者杜格農‧馬奇建議大修女將她的信心放在皇帝的意志之中。當時機來臨時，戰鬥修女必須在月球基地完成之前，抓住機會來攻擊鈦星人。在火力和信仰的行動之下，外星勢力被消滅了，他們的指揮官和假先知被殺死，阿格娜大修女取走他們頭顱奉獻給皇帝，作為她奉獻的表徵。有一部份的外星科技被送到歐多管理局去研究，而其餘的則都被徹底的毀滅了。
en_text: Assuaging her fears, Confessor Treganum March counseled the Canoness to place her faith in the Emperor’s will. And, as it happened, the Sisters of Battle were granted the opportunity to attack the Tau before the moon base was complete. With much fire and many Acts of Faith, the alien compound was purged. Their commander and their false saint were slain. Canoness Agna took their skulls as offerings to the Emperor and tokens of her devotion. Some of the enemy’s heretical technology was sent to the Ordo Xenos for study, and much of the rest was dutifully destroyed.

tc_text: 鈦星人幾乎是毫無準備的面對渾沌勢力對楠‧亞諾以月球基地的來襲。由於沒有與異變傳送門的連結，也沒有任何的心理準備，他們沒有想到像阿爾發軍團這樣強大的對手會出現在眼前。
en_text: The Tau were wholly unprepared for the fury with which the forces of Chaos assailed their moon base on Nan Yanoi. With no innate relation to the Warp, and no psykers at their command, the Tau could not anticipate the many augmented powers that made the Alpha Legion such fearsome adversaries.

tc_text: 那些在邪惡儀式中被拷打折磨的鈦星人遠沒有比死在戰場上的人還幸運。經過在楠‧亞諾以上長時的戰鬥，基地被它自己防禦者所留下的血給遮蔽了，而他們敬愛的乙太導師的屍體則懸吊在阿卡火砲之上，這塊在卡倫大君所沒見到鈦星基地的一角被褻瀆了。
en_text: The tortures and foul ceremonies performed upon the helpless Tau that were not fortunate enough to die in battle are beyond description. Within hours of the sack of Nan Yanoi, the base was covered in its defenders’ blood, and the carcass of their beloved Ethereal hoisted upon the barrel of the Ar’Ka Cannon, the one piece of the Tau base that Lord Carron did not see fit to desecrate.

tc_text: 先知卡里絲清楚的知道她的部隊，必須盡快的攻擊楠‧亞諾以的月球基地，不然就甚麼都沒有了。當她抵達考拉瓦月球時，她瞭解到這扇窗已經被關閉了。當鈦星人完成了他們先進的堡壘之後，他們的力量就會變得無堅不摧，所以神靈族必須盡快的攻擊。卡里絲相信在一千年以來，並沒有其它的部隊在警戒監視著古老和不死的死靈族。
en_text: Farseer Caerys saw with clear sight that her forces must strike the Tau moon base of Nan Yanoi soon, or not at all. When she arrived at the Kauravan moon, she realized how close this window had been to shutting. Had the Tau completed their advanced fortifications, their mighty base would have been nearly invincible. The Eldar must strike, and swiftly. Caerys trusted no other force to keep vigil over the ancient and deathless Necrons, and be watching still a millennium hence.

tc_text: 無畏的先知曾經小心估算過她行動的結果，而有許多次她都預見到考拉瓦衝突的發生。她知道雖然鈦星人是個年輕又愚笨的種族，卻比傲慢帝國、瘋狂的渾沌軍團或是頑固的歐克蠻人擁有更大的前途。烏斯維工藝世界的總督同意儘管攻擊鈦星勢力或許會切斷任何非敵意的關係，但跟死靈族的覺醒一樣，不管在任何地方鈦星人還是不能信任的。不過，伴隨著所有在戰爭中的俘虜，安羅伊和歐耶斯卡指揮官的屍體已經歸還給鈦星人，來作為一個尊重的表徵。
en_text: The dauntless Farseer had weighed the consequences of her actions carefully and many times since she had first foreseen the coming of the Kaurava Conflict. She knew that the Tau, though a young and foolish race, showed greater promise than the haughty Imperium, the mad legions of Chaos, or the dogged Orks. The Exarchs of Craftworld Ulthwé had agreed that although brazenly striking the Tau might sever any non-hostile relations for some centuries, the Tau could not yet be trusted in any system so susceptible to Necron awakenings. Nevertheless, the bodies of Aun’Ro’Yr and Commander Or’es’Ka were returned to the Tau, along with all prisoners of war, as a token of respect.

tc_text: 南亞諾伊月球基地強大但未完成的防禦工事，乃是專為抵禦大規模侵略艦隊和重火力武器而建設。鈦星人的準備縝密有餘，卻未考慮的暗黑神靈的暴力速度，這也許是因為在先前的遭遇中全無倖存的鈦星人，未能留下任何暗黑神靈的資料。儘管如此，這場攻擊實在來得太快又太浩大，許多火焰戰士甚至沒有時間進行武裝，連光榮戰死的機會都沒有。反之，他們只能在拉庫納和卡莫拉的凌虐牢房裡迎接無法想像的地獄。
en_text: The mighty if incomplete fortifications of the Nan Yanoi moon base had been constructed to withstand masses of invasion fleets and heavy weapons. In their many careful preparations, the Tau had not considered the sheer brutal speed of the Dark Eldar, perhaps because previous encounters with the Dark Eldar had not left survivors for the Tau to learn from. Regardless, the attack was so swift and so overwhelming that many Fire Warriors did not have time to arm themselves and die nobly in combat. They would, instead, come to find themselves in a hell beyond imagining, in the torture cells of Lacunae and Commorragh.

tc_text: 在戰爭之後，阿斯德魯貝‧維克駕臨被征服的基地，並且主持了勝利夜晚所舉行的可鄙的勝利宴會，盡情的享欣賞著死去的乙太導師之心。
en_text: After the battle, Asdrubael Vect himself graced the scene of the conquered base, and presided over the vile banquet held on the night of the victory, personally feasting on the heart of the dying Ethereal.

tc_text: 鈦星人選擇在歐克的考拉瓦二號的洛克可羅山脈中建造月球基地，讓戰爭之王戈古茲把它當成是一個對個人的侮辱。更過份的是阿卡火砲，這讓鈦星人可以在一個安全的戰術距離外進行攻擊。當然，所有的事情都可能會冒犯到戈古茲，他隨時都可能攻擊鈦星人，只是因為他們就在那個地方。
en_text: The Warlord Gorgutz took it as a personal affront that the Tau had chosen a base of operations on the moon directly above the Ork enclave in the Rokclaw Mountains of Kaurava II. More offensive still was the Ar’Ka Cannon, which exemplified the Tau principle of fighting from a safe and tactical distance. Of course, almost anything could offend Gorgutz, and he would have come to attack the Tau sooner or later, just because they were there.

tc_text: 當歐耶斯卡指揮官成功的結束堡壘防衛之後，歐克就開始血腥的攻擊它的外牆。不幸的，這些城牆上的小小破壞就像水壩崩壞般的碎裂了。一旦穿過了防禦，歐克縮短了跟烈焰戰士的距離，並且用巨大的數量來擊敗他們。當歐克軍團橫掃過之後，戈古茲宣稱阿卡火砲歸他所有，並且打算將這個他前所未見的"大槍"配備在他的吼～軍團中。
en_text: Had Commander Or’es’Ka succeeded in finishing the defenses of his moon base fortress, the Orks might have beaten themselves bloody against its shielded outer walls. Unfortunately, the smallest breach in those walls was like a crack in a dam. Once through, the Orks closed the distance on the ranks of Fire Warriors and crushed them beneath their massive forms. While much was looted by the Ork hordes, Gorgutz claimed the Ar’Ka Cannon for himself, planning to use “da biggest a gunz” he had ever seen to aid his Waaagh!

tc_text: 大量死靈族在楠‧亞諾以月球基地被殘殺，是考拉瓦衝突中最血腥的一個事件。這也顯示出鈦星人完成了他們基地的先進防禦措施，而死靈族也更容易被擊敗了。不過，有說法指出，有一小部分的護牆無法對抗死靈族的全力攻擊。
en_text: The brutality with which the masses of Necrons crushed the Nan Yanoi moon base was one of the bloodiest episodes of the Kaurava Conflict. It had been suggested that had the Tau completed their advanced defenses on the base, the Necrons would have been easily deflected. However, others contend that few walls have ever withstood the full force of a Necron onslaught.

tc_text: 月球基地的挫敗是鈦星軍事領導人的痛苦教訓。他們目睹了崇敬的乙太導師的死亡，和一個著名指揮官的失敗。他們判斷，是因為速度和自大毀掉了他們的抱負。同時，死靈族冷酷的效率導致了鈦星人、克魯特步兵和胡蜂尖翅戰士的俘虜和戰亡，他們被丟給了剝皮者來練習在下一場戰鬥中的殘酷藝術。
en_text: The sack of the moon base was a bitter lesson for the leaders of the Tau Military. They saw the death of a revered Ethereal and a noted Commander as a terrible failure to embody the philosophy of the Patient Hunter. It was haste and hubris, they reasoned, that had caused the ruin of their ambitions. The Necrons, meanwhile, with cold efficiency, had gathered the dying and captive Tau, Kroot, and Vespids. They were given to the Flayed Ones to practice their ghoulish art upon in preparation for the next battle.

tc_text: 次元風暴解放考拉瓦星系第四行星的原因，有部分從沒來就被發現，而有一部分則無從知曉。每一個在那邊的防衛兵都變得腐化，並且開始信奉邪惡之神，風暴是否迅速的轉變了他們仍是個謎題。無庸置疑的是當風暴之眼找上混沌星際戰士的巢穴時，在這個巢穴中心的血腥神殿和邪惡網路，不知為什麼的跟風暴本身連結在一起。
en_text: Little was ever uncovered and little will ever be known of how the Warp Storm was unleashed on the Kaurava System’s fourth habitable planet. Whether Guardsmen there grew corrupt and turned to evil worship, or whether the Storm took them unawares is an open question. What is without doubt is that at the Storm’s eye lay the lair of the Chaos Space Marines, and at the heart of this lair, a network of unholy and bloodstained shrines, linked somehow inextricably to the storm itself.

tc_text: 雖然致命的次元風暴在四處隱現和嚎叫、閃爍的出現著，而在這些神殿之間都有一個連結著風暴的永久管道。在那邊有一個無形的旋轉力場，如果不將自己獻身給渾沌之人將會死無葬身之地。在那個光芒之中，可以見到死亡的能量力場在裡面飛舞、嘶喊、嚎叫…
en_text: Although the lethal Warp Storm would flicker and squall here and there, ever shifting, a permanent conduit to the Warp was maintained between these shrines. A charged field of Immateria whirled there, certain death to any who had not given themselves over fully to Chaos. In that radiant, deadly energy field, strange shapes could be seen dancing, screaming, howling…

tc_text: 任何嘗試成為這座邪惡城堡的征服者，一定要驅逐保護著它的渾沌力場。進入這個區域必導致死亡，而只要它還存在，沒有任何事物可以抵達隱藏在它中心的混沌勢力。
en_text: Any would-be conqueror of this unholy citadel would somehow have to dispel the Chaos field that protected it. To enter it would be certain death. And while it stood, nothing could reach the forces of Chaos that lurked at its center.

tc_text: 暗黑神靈族有一點害怕攻擊他們基地的行動，它的位置在月球的黑暗面，在中心有一個通道可以連結考拉瓦四號的次元風暴。第七遠古通道就在那個月球上，但是暗黑神靈族知道它的科技，只有在他們降臨到那邊時才會發生作用。
en_text: The Dark Eldar little feared an attack on their base of operations, situated as it was on the dark side of the moon well within the reaches of the Warp Storm of Kaurava IV. The seventh Ancient Gate lay on that moon, but the Dark Eldar, knowing its technology well, had fixed it to work only for them when they had arrived there.

tc_text: 由於傲慢的影響，以及塔里爾部隊的無政府主義的天性，讓暗黑神靈族的母城卡莫拉不規則的衍生。在主要軍營的四周散佈了小型的營地，被成堆的拷問地和牢籠給圍繞著，到處都是搶奪來的奴隸、雜物和貨品。同時，在中央密集的聚滿了強大的暗黑神靈族，以及傳說中的黑心凱柏領導者阿斯德魯貝‧維克。據說，他在那邊監督戰爭的準備工作。
en_text: The effect of this hubris, and the general anarchic nature of Archon Tahril’s soldiers, resulted in a sprawling makeshift reproduction of Commorragh, the Dark Eldar home city. Surrounding the major warcamp lay smaller camps, surrounded by miles of torture ground, a sort of cage-garden of the Haemonculus Grumenael’s making. Rich with plunder in slaves, scraps, and goods, this area had grown and sprawled. Meanwhile, the center grew dense with powerful Dark Eldar, and the legendary Asdrubael Vect, leader of Tahril’s Black Heart Kabal, was said to oversee the war preparations there.

tc_text: 要說暗黑神靈族全然沒有準備是不太對的。暗黑神靈族隨時都準備好面對戰鬥；這是他們天性中的一種熱情，沒有甚麼事情可以讓他們放下戒心。但是，一大片的刑罰花園很少保持在最佳的狀態，而且到處都是囚犯，有許多仍有能力轉身來對付他們的俘虜者。對攻擊者來說那邊可是有些微的希望…
en_text: To say that the Dark Eldar were unprepared for an attack would not be quite accurate. The Dark Eldar are ever ready for battle; it is a sport and a passion to their kind, and there is no such thing as catching them off their guard. Nonetheless, the miles of torture gardens were poorly attended at best, and full of prisoners, many still capable of turning against their captors. For an attacker there was a faint glimmer of hope…

tc_text: 比起跟其他的種族，神靈族更關注自己過去的遙遠歷史、以及日後的未來。先知卡里絲在她的預知中見到了遠古宿敵的覺醒，也就是在考拉瓦三號上的死靈族。一個已經數千年未使用過的魍道關口，在忽隱忽現之間出現。在一瞬之間，這個荒原星球的貧瘠土地變成了一座四處蔓延的行動基地，而神靈族就從中大量的湧出了。
en_text: More than any other race, the Eldar concern themselves with the distant past and the distant future. In visions, Farseer Caerys anticipated the reawakening of their ancient foes, the Necrons, on Kaurava III. A Webway gate, unused for many millennia, flickered to life. In the blink of an eye, a barren tract of the wasteland planet became a sprawling base of operations, and the Eldar army poured forth from it.

tc_text: 說時遲那時快，整座要塞就在神靈族的計謀運作之下消失得無影無蹤。神靈族早在久遠之前就了解到，無論多強大的堡壘也抵擋不住死靈族的蠶蝕推進。只有用幻術、欺騙和誤導才能達到抵禦死靈族的目標，而這些招式正是神靈族領先群倫的特長。
en_text: Just as quickly, this stronghold vanished from the naked eye, concealed by Eldar artifice. The Eldar had learned long ago that no bulwark, no matter how strong, could halt the slow, implacable progress of the Necrons. Only illusion, deceit, and misdirection could accomplish that goal – and these are things at which the Eldar are peerless.

tc_text: 神靈族為侵略者準備了一場充滿他們全力布置的偽裝和假象的煎熬試煉。這座要塞不僅是一個據點、關鍵戰略點或神靈族保存其秘密的基地。經過如此漫長的歷史，它已經變成方舟神靈的聖地，他們將會以此決心捍衛此地。
en_text: The Eldar had prepared a harrowing gauntlet for their invaders, with all the feints and deceptions they could muster. This stronghold was not just a foothold, not just a key strategic point, not just home to many Eldar secrets. No, through its long history, it had become sacred to the Craftworld Eldar, and they would defend it accordingly.

tc_text: 帝國防衛軍的總部，位於城市行星考拉瓦一號上的杜薩拉圍場，同時也是星系中主要的毀滅之劍重裝戰車生產設施。在他們新任的文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍強力領導之下，衛隊又重新的被集結、武裝、組織了起來。任何攻擊者將會發現，他們即將面臨到的是一支強大火力的武裝部隊。
en_text: The Imperial Guard’s headquarters, in the Dussala Precinct of the city-planet of Kaurava I, was also the system’s primary Baneblade production facility. Under the strong and capable leadership of their new Governor-General, Vance Stubbs, the Guardsmen were once again well supplied, armed, and organized. Any attacker would find themselves facing a formidable amount of firepower.

tc_text: 自從卡烏拉四號爆發亞空間風暴以來，帝國防衛軍經歷了一系列屈辱的挫折，而失去整整四分之三的戰鬥人員只是一個開始。史塔布斯將軍本已下定決心，勢要在這次和所有其他逆境中取得勝利。遺憾的是，一整團帝國防衛軍的裝甲超級武器「毀滅之刃」坦克卻在同一天被派往整個卡烏拉星系的各個地域。
en_text: Since the outbreak of the Warp Storm on Kaurava IV, the Imperial Guard had known a humbling series of setbacks – losing a full three quarters of their fighting men was just a start. General Stubbs was determined to triumph in the face of this and all other adversity. Unfortunately, a full regiment of Baneblade tanks, the Imperial Guard’s armored super-weapon, had that very day been dispatched to various territories throughout the Kaurava system.

tc_text: 杜薩拉圍場總部沒有留下任何毀滅之劍重裝戰車來保留他們的優勢，但他們還擁有工廠，這是生產戰車、維修零件、軍火的戰神研發總部。這些護衛隊在那時是帝國防衛軍的脆弱之處，但同時也是他們最大的希望。
en_text: The Dussala Precinct headquarters was thus left without a single Baneblade to its advantage. But they had their factories. Repair parts, munitions, and operating crews were moved via a system of convoys to the centrally located Mars Pattern buildings which produced the tanks. These convoys, then, were to be the Imperial Guard’s weakest link and also their greatest hope.

tc_text: 血鴉族從慘痛的戰場教訓學到了速度和機動性的價值。於是曾在名指揮官安傑羅麾下學習的軍隊指揮官波瑞亞，力求盡可能減少對定點式的防禦工事建築的依賴。
en_text: The Blood Ravens had learned the value of speed and mobility through hard battlefield experience. Force Commander Boreale, who had studied under the famed Commander Angelos, sought to make his reliance on stationary, defensive structures as small as possible.

tc_text: 因此，所有的部隊都被保留在考拉瓦二號的衝突之中，而不是去建造星際戰士的指揮中心。這些部隊可以用致命的速度進入任何的區域，這包括了血鴉自己的總部。如果被敵人攻擊，登陸艙將會以壓倒性的陣勢佈滿在堡壘的上方，將成群結隊的超級戰士和無畏的艦隊送到星際戰士的敵人面前。
en_text: Therefore, rather than build up the Space Marines’ central command, entire companies were reserved in the fleet above Kaurava II. These would be ready to deep strike with deadly speed into any territory, including the Blood Ravens’ own headquarters. If attacked by an enemy, drop pods would cover the Space Marines’ stronghold in a steely and thunderous hail, swarming the Space Marines’ enemies with super-soldiers and dreadnoughts.

tc_text: 部隊指揮官波里爾確信他的戰略。畢竟，他最偉大的武器就是星際戰士自身的優勢，還有誰可以面對像這樣快速又具毀滅性的的防禦戰術呢？
en_text: Force Commander Boreale was sure of his plan. His greatest weapon was, after all, the superiority of the Space Marines themselves. Who could weather such a rapid and devastating defensive tactic?

tc_text: 在考拉瓦衝突中，戰爭頭目戈古茲他自己帶領吼～軍團的事已經不是秘密了！但是他帶領歐克蠻人是誰？帝國的紀錄指出這些歐克蠻人常駐在考拉瓦--至少在一前年前就到了那裡。看來當戈古茲到達時，他們把他當成是一個長久期盼的英雄了。
en_text: It was no secret that it was the Warboss Gorgutz himself who led the Waaagh! in the Kaurava Conflict. But who were the Orks he led? Imperial records indicate that these Orks had always been in Kaurava – going back at least a millennium. It seems that when Gorgutz arrived, they welcomed him as a long-awaited hero.

tc_text: 這些粗蠻的考拉瓦歐克蠻族有時會橫行於星系的四個星球，有時也會被擊退回到他們在洛克可羅山脈的秘密堡壘中。那邊從來就沒有被攻破過，而歐克蠻族也相信沒有成功的機會。在過去，這些歐克蠻族總是在戰敗徵兆出現時就立刻撤退回到這個地方。戈古茲認為這樣的行為不是歐克蠻族作的，他堅持如果你想贏的話你就必須捨棄這樣的行為，而戈古茲天生就是為了勝利而生存的。
en_text: These rugged Kauravan Orks had sometimes overrun the system’s four planets, and sometimes been beaten back to their secret stronghold in the Rokclaw Mountains. There had never once been a successful attempt to breach the vast hideout there, and the Orks believed there never could be. But in the past these Orks had always retreated to this place in great numbers at the first sign of defeat. Gorgutz saw such behavior as un-Orky. He insisted that you had to take a bolter round or two if you wanted to win, and Gorgutz lived only to win.

tc_text: 戈古茲的戰略代表著歐克的堡壘不是不可攻破的，但這並不代表它就是沒有防備。要接近他們的巢穴或許還作得到，但想要穿破他們的防禦就是另外一回事了。
en_text: Gorgutz’ strategy meant that the Ork stronghold was not invincible, but this did not mean that it was undefended. Reaching the lair was one thing. Penetrating its defenses was entirely another.

tc_text: 戰鬥修女非常的依賴她們的信仰，那可是她們的糧食和護盾。當她們第一次來到考拉瓦的腐敗世界時，告解者杜格農‧馬奇很快的就看見了需要多少的聖光和聖火，才可以清理這四個星球。因此他帶來了活聖人阿耐絲，將她帶到他們在考拉瓦一號薩瑪的主要碉堡中。依據一個秘密又古老的修練，聖人注滿了神聖氣息--他認為這是一個可以避免任何被擊敗機會的無敵氣息。
en_text: The Sisters of Battle rely greatly on their faith; it is their sustenance and their shield. When they first came to the tainted world of Kaurava, Confessor Treganum March was quick to see how much holy light – and fire – it would take to cleanse the four planets. He therefore brought the Living Saint Anais and placed her in their primary bastion in Sama, on Kaurava I. Following a secret and ancient practice, the Living Saint was imbued with the Inviolable Aura – an aura of invincibility which would prevent any chance, he thought, of defeat.

tc_text: 最後由這個神聖氣息來守護著的戰鬥修女，終於得到了最強大的保證。在真理之中誰膽敢對抗她們呢？誰敢在她們之前大搖大擺的走過呢？在渾沌的臉孔和邪惡的異形中，戰鬥修女們不僅增強了她們的修行和禱告，然後與之作戰。她們相信，終將要來臨的只有最光輝的勝利。
en_text: Guarded at the last by this Inviolable Aura, the Sisters of Battle marched with great surety. Who in truth would dare oppose them? What adversary could faith and fire not sweep from before them? In the face of Chaos and vile aliens, the Sisters of Battle merely redoubled their fervent prayers and penances, and fought on. They came to believe that glorious victory was the only outcome.

tc_text: 任何膽敢攻擊他們強大碉堡的想法都是不可思議的。在信仰之前，他們的碉堡是不可能被攻破的。
en_text: The idea that any would dare attack their mighty bastion was unthinkable. The possibility that their bastion could fall, beyond belief.

tc_text: 到底是甚麼開始喚醒了考拉瓦三號南方海岸的死靈族軍團，成了永遠無人知曉的謎。資料顯示在衝突之前的數個月，帝國防衛軍的觀測隊可能曾經被派遣到伊摩沙海岸。其它指向了次元風暴的奇異影響，這可能是喚醒了死靈族的原因。
en_text: It may never be known what first awakened the cold legions of the Necron from their vast burial vaults in the southern coast of Kaurava III. Archives suggest that Imperial Guard survey crews may have been dispatched to Coastal Imossa several months before the conflict. Others point to the strange and unknown influence of the Warp Storm, which could somehow have roused the deathless Necrons from their slumber.

tc_text: 一個古老的建築出現在乾燥的伊摩沙沙地--部分掩埋在土地之下，部分佈滿了植物，部分在土地之上。當聖甲蟲建築者清除了沙地並且回復了建築物的動力後，顯現了它鮮明的、對稱的、死亡般的外型。它被死靈族奇特的綠色光芒能量給喚醒了--這種能量還被大量的儲存著，足以無盡的供給浮石巨塔和死靈族的士兵。
en_text: Out of the dry Imossan sands, an ancient complex emerged – part burial ground, part power plant, part staging ground. As builder scarabs removed sands and restored structures to power, its clean-cut, symmetrical, and lifeless form emerged. It pulsed with the green glow of the strange power which fuels the Necrons – vast reserves of it. Enough to drive an endless stream of monoliths and Necron soldiers.

tc_text: 任何笨到會去攻擊這座被挖掘出的墓地的人，都應該要留心到能源的流動。這些是死靈族力量的來源，如果沒被啟動，死靈族可以獲得對抗他們敵人的力量是有限的。
en_text: Anyone foolish enough to assail this unearthed necropolis would do well to heed that flow of energy. It is the source of the Necrons' power, and if unchecked, there is little limit to what strength Necrons could marshal against their foes.

tc_text: 考拉瓦三號的遠古死靈族堡壘，在考拉瓦衝突的數百年前可能就已經被喚醒了。第252守護者軍團在它前任指揮官的帶領下，是否沒有好好的執行他們的調查觀測任務？不管是不是因為他們的失敗，才引起這顆荒涼星球的事端，他們疏忽的行為在帝國歷史中一直都備受著爭議。
en_text: Had the 252nd Conservator Regiment, under its former commanders, ever taken their census and survey duties seriously, the ancient Necron stronghold on Kaurava III probably would have been awakened hundreds of years prior to the Kaurava Conflict. Whether their failure to keep any presence on this wasteland planet was remarkable luck or dismal negligence is now debated heavily by Imperial historians.

tc_text: 在優秀指揮官生氣勃勃的領導之下，帝國防衛軍顯示了他們最棒的一面，任何古老死靈族用來對抗他們的事物，都會被他們強大的火力、堅忍的意志和厚重的裝甲給打擊回去。
en_text: Invigorated under the capable command of General Stubbs, the Imperial Guard showed their best face and everything that the ancient exhumed necropolis set against them was beaten back with ample munitions, perseverance, and heavy armor.

tc_text: 根據過去在克諾努斯戰爭中的經驗，文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍將滿載的轟炸機派往伊摩沙平原，徹底的轟炸了每一個可能是死靈族墓穴的地方。當勝利來臨，史塔伯斯便禁止了未來任何在考拉瓦三號上的帝國探勘活動。
en_text: Adapting the example set in the War of Kronus, General Vance Stubbs had cargo-loads of bombs shipped to the Imossan plains, and every inch of possible Necron catacomb was subject to multiple detonations. Following the victory, Stubbs forbade any future Imperial surveys of Kaurava III.

tc_text: 著名的血鴉士兵的事蹟對恐怖的死靈族軍團來說，並不是件陌生的事情。不論如何，跟他們曾經在克諾努斯作戰過的巨大地下迷宮不一樣，星際戰士在這裡發現了一個巨大而恐怖的城市，它就掩埋在伊摩沙海岸的沙地之中。眾多的能源導管就在他們的腳底下脈動著，將能源輸送到主浮石巨塔和一支冰冷、無生命的軍隊中。波里爾指揮官已經準備好要面對這些東西，但他沒有指望要面對偉大的欺騙者—卡坦。不過這個古老的威脅也無法阻止血鴉的勝利，他們在那天的行動將會被永恆而光耀的寫在帝國的歷史之中。
en_text: The famed soldiers of the Blood Ravens chapter were no strangers to the dread Necron legions. However, unlike the vast underground labyrinth they had fought on Kronus, the Space Marines here found a vast and terrible city, buried in the sands of the Imossan coast. Vast energy conduits pulsed beneath their feet, feeding power to a host of monoliths and a cold, lifeless army. Commander Boreale had been ready for all this. What he had not counted on was having to face a manifestation of the C’tan god, the Great Deceiver. But even this ancient menace could not keep the Blood Ravens from victory. Their deeds that day would be scribed and illuminated in the Imperium histories for perpetuity.

tc_text: 之後星際戰士花了幾天的功夫來清理伊摩沙的沙地，在離開這個區域之前，來毀滅掉任何殘存的死靈族。從克諾努斯戰爭學到的經驗，每一個在海岸的嫌疑處都受到徹底的轟炸，以避免日後死靈族的再度復生。
en_text: Afterwards the Space Marines spent several days combing the sands of Imossa, destroying every last Necron, before leaving the area to special demolition crews. Taking a lesson from the Kronus War, every suspicious stretch of the coast was repeatedly detonated, to ensure against further Necron awakenings.

tc_text: 戰鬥修女鄙視任何外星的生命型態，把來自死靈族的威脅看成是最噁心的東西。戰鬥修女最大的希望是以皇帝之名來犧牲殉教，所以變成半死人、被捕以及奪去希望等來自死靈族的威脅，對她們來說都是最恐怖的驚嚇。
en_text: The Sisters of Battle, who piously hold all forms of alien life in disdain, treated the Necron threat with the greatest disgust possible. A Sister of Battle’s highest hope was martyrdom in her Emperor’s name.

tc_text: 最後，這個在死靈族的巨變燃燒了戰鬥修女在心中的戰鬥熱情，並且將她們帶向正義的勝利。死靈族的城市半掩埋在伊摩沙的沙地中，招來了每一個修女巨大而可怕的敵人。戰敗是無法被接受的，像這樣的事物絕對不允許讓它們的觸手伸往帝國。修女們的怒火和她們的信仰法則徹底的征服了死靈族，就算是他們的欺騙者卡坦神，也無法在戰鬥修女勝利之前，將他們從淨化的火焰、異族異種的屠殺中給拯救出來。
en_text: Ultimately, this revulsion at the Necrons must have fueled the Sisters’ passion in the heat of battle, and brought them to their righteous victory. The sight of a Necron city, half-uncovered from beneath the Imossan sands, conjured for each and every Sister the enormous monstrosity of their foe. Defeat was unacceptable. Such a thing could not be permitted within the reach of the Imperium. The Sisters’ fury and their inspired Acts of Faith fully overwhelmed the Necrons. Even the manifestation of one of their C’tan gods, the Deceiver, could not salvage them from the purging fire that always goes before the triumphant Sisters of Battle, burning alien, heretic, and mutant alike.

tc_text: 事實上，死靈族和渾沌勢力跟他們的敵沒有甚麼共通之處。其中一個是冷酷又沈寂的死亡軍隊，另一個則是著迷於喧鬧、次元和行動。當阿爾發軍團發現他們自己站在突然出現在伊摩沙沙地的冰冷墓地上時，他們見到的不只是敵人，在瘋狂力量跟狂熱之中，他們看到了感到害怕又嫌惡的東西：卑屈、寂靜又虛無。
en_text: In truth, the Necrons and the forces of Chaos have little in common other than their enemies. Where one is a cold and silent army of death and dominion, the other revels in wild noise, mutation, and action. When the Alpha Legion found themselves standing above the cold necropolis that had emerged from the Imossan sands, they saw not just a foe but the one thing, which, in their mad power and zeal, they feared and abhorred: subservience, silence, the void.

tc_text: 在伊摩沙之戰中，狂亂力量的渾沌之神證明了他們在各方面都優於死亡的卡坦之神：即使是這些神的其中之一，偉大的欺騙者，也被召喚轉化成肉身來對抗阿爾發軍團。當最後的時刻來臨，遠古的死靈族城市沒有留下任何東西，所有曾經存在過的事物，最後都被傾倒、剷平和毀滅了。
en_text: In the Battle of Imossa, the wild powers of the Chaos gods proved themselves in every way superior to the older C’tan gods of death – even when one of these gods, the great Deceiver, was summoned to fight in corporeal form against the Alpha Legion. By the time they were done, nothing was left of the ancient Necron city. All had been toppled, shattered, and smashed to dust.

tc_text: 因為來自死靈族的威脅，將工藝世界神靈族帶往了考拉瓦星系。對先知卡里絲來說沒有更大的犧牲了，為了勝利她領導著軍隊對抗他們，就像是她的先祖在過去所做的事情一樣。當她的部隊擊垮了伊摩沙的死靈族，殺光了每一個死靈族的戰士，她感到靈魂中有種前所未有的平靜包覆著她。未來變得清澈，她預見了這地方的烏雲從此消散。
en_text: It was the Necron threat that had originally brought the Ulthwé Eldar to the Kaurava System. There could be no greater satisfaction to Farseer Caerys, than to lead her troops to victory against them, just as her ancestors had in an age long past. As her forces spread over the necropolis of Imossa, exterminating every last stray Necron warrior, she felt a great peace come over her soul. The future grew clear, and she foresaw the lifting of a great cloud from the place.

tc_text: 卡里絲的部隊在那天的確獲取了光榮的勝利。死靈族在那時幾乎就要完整的挖掘出他們的死亡城市了，他們召喚了憎恨和咒怨之神卡坦的表徵，炫耀的加入了他們的軍隊。事實上，那天的戰鬥在今日還是歷歷在目。還有，先知知道他們的敵人太強大了，她的戰士必須封閉每一個墓穴，然後再度的將這個墮落的城市燒成灰燼。但是卡里絲知道死靈族不會永遠被擊退的，必須留下軍事戒備，和平才會出現在海岸的每個角落，這些死靈族也才會永久的長眠不醒。
en_text: The glory and renown that Caerys’ forces had won that day was great indeed. The Necrons had been allowed to nearly complete the process of exhuming their city of death. They had even summoned a manifestation of the hated and reviled C’tan god, the Deceiver, to their aid, and all in vain. Truly, the battle this day was every bit as great as that of yore. And yet, she knew this enemy far too well. Her warriors would seal the many crypts, and afterwards bury the foul city in sands once again. But Caerys knew the Necrons could never permanently be defeated. A warlike vigil must be kept, and peace brought to bear at any cost, so that the deathless ones should sleep long and undisturbed.

tc_text: 雖然他們跟工藝世界分開的時代不同，暗黑神靈族並沒有忘記在他們遠古的表親跟死靈族之間，黑暗而右血腥的戰爭。惡魔般的機器讓暗黑神靈族變成了海盜一般，他們總是武裝著，儘管他們擁有靈魂，但卻都發酸發臭了，無法禁得起折磨，而擊退死靈族會是一件必須而且艱苦的任務。
en_text: Although it was in a different age that they parted ways with their Craftworld relatives, the Dark Eldar had not forgotten the dark and bloody wars between their ancient kindred and the Necrons. The fiendish machines made poor victims of Dark Eldar piracy. They were always armed, and although their frames did encase souls, those were feeble and sour, and could not be tortured before reaping. Defeating the Necrons was a necessary and grim task.

tc_text: 雖然他們沒有很努力，但暗黑神靈族還是殘暴的作戰。他們在不死的敵人之前放肆墮落的舞動和開火，死靈組的部隊無法阻擋他們，但偉大的浮石巨塔同樣也無法阻擋他們。就算是是偉大欺騙者以肉身型態出現，也沒辦法影響到暗黑神靈族的勝利，可惜呀。他們不抓奴隸也不搶奪貨物，他們的任務完成了，塔里爾的部隊解放了這個地方，然後尋找殺死那些在痛苦中流血、哀求或是哭喊的敵人。
en_text: Although they took less joy in the endeavor, the Dark Eldar fought with no less ferocity. They danced and fired before their deathless foes with vicious abandon. The Necron legions could not stop them, and neither could the threat of the great monoliths. Not even the appearance of the Great Deceiver, summoned into corporeal form, could avert the Dark Eldar’s victory. Alas, no celebrations followed. They took no slaves and pillaged no goods. Their duty done, Tahril’s forces fled the place, in search of foes who could bleed, and plead, and cry out in pain.

tc_text: 如同戰爭頭目戈古茲所擔心的，死靈族不再是小小的技師軍隊了。事實上，有些人看起來有點害怕黑暗鋼鐵般的部隊，這些部隊就成群的聚集在伊摩沙海岸被發掘出的墓地裡。但戈古茲很簡單的就認定了他們更怕他自己，同時他們也很會作戰。
en_text: As far as Warboss Gorgutz was concerned, the Necrons were no more than a vast army of little Meks. True enough, some of the boys seemed a bit unnerved by the dark metal battalions that massed like a lake at the base of the exhumed Necropolis on the Imossan coast. But Gorgutz simply made sure that they were more frightened by him, and they fought good enough.

tc_text: 雖然他有他自己的疑慮，但是對死靈族的勝利仍是一個很好的證明，在戈古茲的眼中，考拉瓦的這些孩子們值得讚揚。他們經歷過一段艱苦的時光，在熱沙中的死亡陷阱奮戰，但如同戈古茲所形容的，歐克蠻人打了一場艱難又成功的戰爭。當然，那個騙人東西的降臨，讓他的孩子差點三心二意，但在最後他們還是好好的把他給料理掉了。
en_text: Although he’d had his doubts, the victory over the Necrons was as good a proof as any, in Gorgutz' eyes, that the Kauravan boys were worth their squigs. They'd had a tough time of it, descending into the bowl of death among the hot sands, but as Gorgutz figured these things, Orks were for fighting and there was nothing better than a good hard fight, so long as you won. Sure, that Deceivy Thing had come up and turned his boys' heads this way and that, but they beat it good in the end.

tc_text: 鈦星的烈焰氏族相信他們在克諾努斯戰爭中，學到了對死靈族的注重。這是為什麼當歐耶斯卡指揮官在伊摩沙的沙地中，發現了半掩埋的瘋狂不死敵人基地時，讓他有些驚慌和氣餒。他的烈焰戰士證明了他們可以在距離外部署慢速移動的軍團，但誰可以證明在這個陌生的墓地中敵人隱藏了甚麼東西呢？
en_text: The Tau Fire Caste believed that they had learned a great deal with regard to the Necrons in the War of Kronus. It was therefore with some dismay that Commander Or’es’Ka found the deathless and unreasoning foe headquartered in an entire city, half-exhumed from beneath the Imossan sands. His Fire Warriors had shown themselves capable of dispatching the slow-moving legions from a distance, but who could say what new forms of the enemy lurked in this strange necropolis?

tc_text: 不管怎樣，烈焰戰士很早就被訓練要忠於事實，尊崇偉大的紀律，並且沈靜的面對所有的威嚇。即使是遠古之神，偉大的欺騙者也無法擊敗他們。的確，更大良善的明智教育在這一天被證明了。依據傳統的勝利儀式，歐耶斯卡指揮官在海沙重新覆蓋之前，小心的監看了死靈族城市毀滅和封閉的過程。
en_text: A Fire Warrior, however, is trained from an early age to cleave to truth, to observe the greatest discipline, and to accept all threats with calm reserve. Even the ancient god, the Great Deceiver could not cause their rout. Indeed, the wise teachings of the Greater Good were tried and proved true on this day. Following the traditional victory ceremonies, Commander Or’es’Ka oversaw the careful destruction and sealing of the Necron city, before the sea of sand was returned to cover it.

tc_text: 或許有些人會懷疑第252守護者軍團的攻擊對渾沌星際戰士來說，充滿了不榮譽和毫無可信度。最後的審判可以等到數百年後由區域指揮部的軍事法庭來裁決，但文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍知道次元風暴籠罩了帝國防衛軍，而在他們之中出現的許多嫌疑事蹟應該是歸咎於這個原因。
en_text: There can be little doubt that the 252nd Conservator Regiment’s assault on the Chaos Space Marines was fueled by a sense of lost honor and credibility. While a final judgment could wait centuries in Segmentum’s martial courts, General Vance Stubbs knew well that the Warp Storm had erupted on the Imperial Guard’s watch, and that many suspected heresy among their ranks to be the cause.

tc_text: 不知是否是為了失敗而付出代價，或是要證明誹謗者的錯誤，252軍團勇敢的弟兄們將整個部隊、武器、和裝甲都空投到考拉瓦四號的敵人之上。在他們新指揮官嚴厲的指揮之下，弟兄們變得勇敢又機智。在這麼高的士氣下，他們期望渾沌勢力的擊退可以驅逐次元風暴。文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍宣稱這是一個慶祝之日，一個讓日後所有在考拉瓦帝國居民永遠慶祝的日子。附著在阿爾發軍團的顏色將被燒毀，衛隊列隊受勛，這些都是他們應得的。
en_text: Whether to make amends for their failures or to prove their detractors wrong, the brave men of the 252nd fell upon the enemy on Kaurava IV with all the force, armor, and firepower at their command. Under the rigorous command of their new general, the men became brave and resourceful. In such high spirits, and hoping that the defeat of Chaos would banish the Warp Storm with it, General Vance Stubbs declared it a day of celebration to be commemorated by all Imperial residents of Kaurava for ever afterward. Effigies in the Alpha Legion colors would be burned and Guardsmen paraded and honored, as was their due.

tc_text: 尋求赫魯斯異教血腥戰爭的報復，是每一個星際戰士的希望，並且在帝國與背叛的異教徒作戰的歷部隊指揮官史中為自己記錄一筆光榮的章節。英德里克‧波里爾很清楚他的弟兄的熱情可以戰鬥，並且努力讓他的戰場戰術變得更完美，讓他可以帶領他們獲得勝利和榮譽，而他認為這是他們應得的。
en_text: It is the wish of every Space Marine to seek revenge for the bloody wars of the Horus Heresy, when the loyal chapters battled the heretical traitors and earned themselves a place in the history of the Imperium. Force Commander Indrick Boreale knew well the fervor with which his men would fight, and strove to perfect his battlefield tactics, so he could grant them the victory and glory which was, he felt, their due.

tc_text: 波里爾的伙伴血鴉表現出自己的清白，多過於與阿爾發軍團的對抗。雖然他們蹣跚的穿越了腐化之地，進入了次元風暴的極中心位置，但在那裡瘋狂的邪神在飛舞和吟唱著，恐怖的幻象在空氣中飄盪，沒有任何一個戰士可放棄了他的信仰和任務。在他們指揮官的眼中，那天血鴉是驕傲的戰士，也是全帝國最驕傲的戰士。在那天，他們創造了歷史，他們創造出了榮耀。
en_text: Boreale’s company of Blood Ravens acquitted themselves more than admirably against the Alpha Legion. Although they waded through miles of corrupted land, into the very heart of the Warp Storm, where maddened cultists danced and chanted, and phantasmal horrors wafted through the air, not a single soldier swerved from his faith or duty. The Blood Ravens were proud soldiers that day, in the eyes of their commander, their order, and the entire Imperium. On that day, history was made, and they knew glory.

tc_text: 對戰鬥修女來說，前往黑暗、腐敗的混沌之心是對信仰極大的測試。她們行進在由次元所衍生出的憎恨之間，目睹了那些不幸衛兵的褻瀆模樣，戰鬥修女和星際戰士在黑暗城市中交戰，把敵人當作是勝利的獎勵。在大修女阿格娜的堅定領導下，她們仍繼續前行，淨化她們道路上的每一樣事物。
en_text: The march into the black, corrupted heart of Chaos was truly a great test of faith for the Sisters of Battle. They walked among the many abominations born of the Warp, bearing witness to the desecrated forms of unfortunate Guardsmen, Sisters of Battle, and Space Marines, hung throughout the dark city as victory trophies. But still they marched, under the firm guidance of Canoness Selena Agna, purging everything in their path.

tc_text: 最後，混沌星際戰士的虛偽力量終於無法對付戰鬥修女，她們用鋼鐵般的鞭苔之火來對付敵人。神殿被破壞了，而阿爾發軍團的成效一踏糊塗，卡倫大君和許多他的士兵被扔回曲速之中。在知道與渾沌作戰時需要注意的地方後，阿格娜大修女命令更多的區域隔離和保持遠端的監看。儘管戰爭獲勝了，還是需要保持相當的警戒。
en_text: Ultimately, the unnatural powers of the Chaos Space Marines failed to unnerve or scatter the resolve of the Sisters of Battle, who took their foes with grit, steel, and a scourge of fire. The shrines were toppled and the other works of the Alpha Legion were scattered and smashed. Lord Carron and many of his soldiers were cast back into the Warp. Knowing the caution required when combating Chaos, Canoness Agna ordered much of the region quarantined and kept under remote surveillance. Though the battle was won, there could be no vigilance too great.

tc_text: 神靈族通常寧可操縱局面，讓帝國去代替他們對抗混沌。然而，在卡烏拉衝突中，先知凱芮斯卻認為混沌的威脅太大了，除了直接攻擊之外別無他法。各帝國軍隊之間的和平合作失敗正是一種不祥之兆。而亞空間風暴的爆發，以及阿爾法軍團迅速且兇猛的擴張則是更沉重的惡兆。
en_text: The Eldar generally prefer to arrange events so that the Imperium, and not themselves, are the ones fighting against Chaos. In the Kaurava Conflict, however, Farseer Caerys believed that the Chaos threat was too great for anything but a direct assault. The failure of the various Imperial forces to peacably cooperate was one ill omen. The eruption of the Warp Storm, and the speed and ferocity of the Alpha Legion’s expansion was an even greater one.

tc_text: 神靈族與混沌星際戰士之間的戰爭難分難解而且損傷慘重，因為雙方都駕馭著強大的靈能能力來進行戰鬥。阿爾法軍團手中握有亞空間的所有力量，但儘管有此優勢，他們最終還是臣服在有先知凱芮斯力量指導的神靈族卓越戰術之下。在這次戰爭中，神靈族迅速建立了某種封鎖力場來限制亞空間風暴的危險，並將完全平息亞空間風暴的不確定作業留到神靈族如願獲勝的一段時間之後。
en_text: The war between Eldar and the Chaos Space Marines was relentless and destructive, as both sides possessed and fought with powerful psychic abilities. The Alpha Legion had all the power of the Warp at hand to call upon, but despite this advantage, they were finally overcome by superior Eldar tactics, guided by the powers of Farseer Caerys. In this time of war, the Eldar quickly erected certain containment fields, to limit the dangers of the Warp Storm, and left the uncertain work of fully disabling it for some time after a hoped-for Eldar victory.

tc_text: 當暗黑神靈族第一次來到考拉瓦星系時，每當其他的部隊在他們的掌握範圍內交戰時，他們很高興能帶領他們的突擊隊來對抗阿爾發軍團。不管怎樣，在他們月球基地下方的星際戰士勢力已經大到是一個威脅了。塔里爾執政官像笨蛋似的在考拉瓦衝突中留下了兩個領導人：先知卡里絲和卡倫大君，而這兩個人或許知道如何在暗處去尋找他的部隊。
en_text: When the Dark Eldar first arrived in the Kaurava System, they had been happy to conduct their raiding parties against the Alpha Legion as often as any of the other warring forces within their grasp. However, the Chaos Space Marines’ position directly below their moon-base stronghold was simply growing to be too great a threat. Archon Tahril took all but two leaders as fools in the Kaurava Conflict: Farseer Caerys and Lord Carron. These two alone might know where in the shadows to look for his fleets of Raiders and Ravagers.

tc_text: 當暗黑神靈族的力量變得日益強大，塔里爾大君看到了他的機會，並且決定將阿爾發軍團踢出這個星系。他的野蠻部隊出身於埃索特半島，擁有無情的速度和效率。野蠻人和混沌的厭惡者並沒有畏懼他們，反而是增加了屠殺和破壞的胃口。雖然阿爾發軍團英勇的作戰，他們還是被征服和戰敗了。黑心凱柏的突擊隊殺傷了許多的混沌星際戰士，將分發的戰利品進貢給他們的主人，並且用一個極享樂的靈魂來追尋他們的勝利。
en_text: As the Dark Eldar power grew great, Lord Tahril saw his chance, and decided to wipe the Alpha Legions from the system. With ruthless speed and efficiency, his savage forces descended upon the Peninsula of Iseult. The savageries and abominations of Chaos, rather than dismaying them, merely whetted their appetites for slaughter and mayhem. Although the Alpha Legion fought heroically, they were overwhelmed and outmaneuvered. The Black Heart Kabal raiders took Cultists and wounded Chaos Space Marines by the hundreds, dividing their spoils between tribute to their masters and a great feast of Souls to follow the victory.

tc_text: 當戰爭頭目戈古茲將目光放在考拉瓦四號時，他知道遲早他將要準備好對付阿爾發軍團。一般來說，偉大的歐克蠻人不會去注意人類軍隊的細小不同處，但他知道混沌星際戰士，在渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫的領導下揮舞著強大的力量，而他也想讓他的歐克蠻人來去對抗這樣的敵手。
en_text: When Warboss Gorgutz set his sights on Kaurava IV, he knew that sooner or later he would square off against the Alpha Legion. By and large, the great Ork did not pay much attention to the subtle differences between the different human armies. But he knew the Chaos Space Marines, under Chaos Lord Firaveus Carron, wielded great powers, and so was eager to test the strength of his Ork hordes against such a foe.

tc_text: 對戈古茲軍隊最大的挑戰，是渾沌軍團出現在他們敵人前時，那些令人恐懼的面孔。阿爾發軍團擁有渾沌的恐怖和黑暗勢力，而歐克則擁有龐大的數量、力量和身形。當戰爭開始勝利，一幅巨大的吼～軍團的旗幟升起在曾是混沌漩渦的領域中時，戈古茲便允許考拉瓦n的孩子們砍殺敵人的頭顱做為他們的戰利品。
en_text: The greatest challenge for Gorgutz’ army was the unnerving face that the legions of Chaos present to their foes. What the Alpha Legion had in horror and the dark powers of Chaos, the Orks made up for in sheer numbers, size, and strength. When the battle was won, Gorgutz allowed the Kauravan boyz to loot their skull trophies, weapons, and other prizes, while a giant Waaagh! banner was planted where once a Chaos vortex had been.

tc_text: 鈦星指揮官歐耶斯卡長久的觀察渾沌的威脅，察覺到阿爾發軍團的侵犯已經不再被忍受了。承諾讓考拉瓦變成鈦星帝國一個新而重要氏族的協議，足以用來允許像這樣的侵犯繼續存在。所有鈦星的軍事力量都被用來處理一號seult半島的事，而渾沌星際戰士雖然是可怕的戰士，卻還是被束縛在這樣的常態並堅定攻擊之下。
en_text: Tau Commander Or’es’Ka had long watched the Chaos threat, and felt that the aggressive presence of the Alpha Legion could no longer be tolerated. The promise of Kaurava as a new and important Sept in the Tau Empire was too enticing to permit such a threat to remain. All the ordered military strength of the Tau was brought to bear on the Peninsula of Iseult. The Chaos Space Marines, though fearsome warriors, buckled beneath such a constant and unswerving assault.

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官知道讓不要在渾沌之間留下生存者，遠比把他們俘虜來的好。因此，他將部隊移了開來，讓了強大的阿卡火砲可以從楠‧亞諾以的鈦星之月不斷的向堡壘發射，直到沒有任何的生命可以存活在那個地方為止。
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka knew better than to try and take prisoners, or parlay at all with the survivors among the ranks of Chaos. Instead, his army removed itself for the powerful Ar’Ka Cannon to fire repeatedly on the defeated stronghold, until it was certain that no life could possibly remain there.

tc_text: 遠古的卡坦之神，帶領著死靈族的許多行動，把渾沌之神視為對手和自負之人。死靈族的部隊漫無陣勢的行進，強勢的壓倒了阿爾發軍團...然而，空中好像瀰漫著復仇的氣息一般，他們徹底的殘殺了被征服的渾沌戰士，摧毀他們的神殿，並且夷平了他們的建築物。
en_text: The ancient C’tan gods, who guide the actions of the Necron multitudes, look bitterly upon the Chaos gods as upstarts and rivals. The Necron troops marched in mindless ranks, overwhelming the Alpha Legion just as they would any other living opponent… and yet, there was almost a vindictive air to the thoroughness with which they slaughtered the vanquished soldiers of Chaos, smashing their shrines and laying waste to their buildings.

tc_text: 帝國、神靈族和鈦星人都把死靈族當成是一股邪惡的勢力，並且想將其徹底毀滅。不論如何，當一個像弗里維斯‧卡倫大君和他的阿爾發軍團出現時，其他人就很難獲勝了。有任何人可以在死靈族散佈在考拉瓦星系之際，阻擋他們死亡的攻勢嗎？
en_text: The Imperium, Eldar, and Tau looked on as one of the forces of evil was thoroughly annihilated. However, as formidable a threat as Lord Firaveus Carron and his Alpha Legion Marines had been, their defeat was in no way encouraging. Could any living force halt the tidal wave of Necron death, as it crashed over the planets of the Kaurava System?

tc_text: 當部隊指揮官波里爾命令他的手下攻擊在考拉瓦一號 杜薩拉圍場的帝國防衛軍時，他很清楚自己在作甚麼事情。無疑的在他的想法中他的行動是正確的。首先，第252守護者軍團因為之前在次元風暴爆發時的角色爭議，承受了極大的懷疑。第二，藉由提供波里爾指揮官和血鴉的反抗，帝國防衛軍就會像正在挑戰權威。
en_text: When Force Commander Boreale ordered his men to attack the Imperial Guard in the Dussala Precinct of Kaurava I, he knew full well what he was doing. There was no doubt in his mind that his actions were in the right. First, the 252nd Conservator Regiment was under great suspicion regarding their possible role in the Warp Storm’s outbreak. Second, by offering resistance to Commander Boreale and his Blood Ravens, it was the Imperial Guard that was defying proper authority.

tc_text: 一旦血鴉的優異戰術擊敗了第252軍團和聲討了他們的指揮中，殘存的衛隊勢力將會被當成是戰時的同袍來看待。波里爾指揮官命令他們安全的返回區域指揮部，不幸的，在那裡只有一些人可能在調查審理報告中生存。而為了要聲討他們自己工廠和軍需，血鴉聲稱準備要暫時的接管考拉瓦的四個行星。
en_text: Once the superior military tactics of the Blood Ravens had overwhelmed the 252nd Regiment and laid claim to their central command, the surviving Guardsmen were treated as fellow comrades-at-arms. Commander Boreale ordered them safely returned to Segmentum Command, where, unfortunately, few were likely to survive Inquisitional debriefing. Claiming the factories and munitions for their own, the Blood Ravens made ready to assume temporary stewardship of Kaurava’s four planets.

tc_text: Sel一號na 阿格娜大修女從她在考拉瓦衝突的戰役開始，就對帝國防衛軍--第252守護者軍團有著相當的疑心。當次元風暴突然發生時他們出現在星系之中就已經足夠了。他們的倔強--可以看成是褻瀆--拒絕放下武裝加入在她的戰鬥修女的指揮之下，這則是最終的證據。
en_text: Canoness Selena Agna, from the very start of her campaign in the Kaurava Conflict, had harbored great suspicion towards the Imperial Guard, 252nd Conservator Regiment. Their presence in the system when the Warp Storm broke out was cause enough. But their stubborn – indeed, blasphemous – refusal to lay down arms and accede to the governance of her Sisters of Battle was the final proof.

tc_text: 因為這些原因，在帝國士兵身上製造戰爭的主意並沒有干擾到大修女。帶著鋼鐵般的信念、洗滌的火焰、以及厚重的裝甲，戰鬥修女壓迫著史塔伯斯將軍的部隊，直到他們潰散為止。衛隊明顯的懦弱證實了大修女過去曾有的每個懷疑，她最早的答案被放大加強了：這個腐敗星系的每一吋土地都要被淨化，被神聖之火來淨化。
en_text: For these reasons, the idea of making war on fellow Imperial soldiers did not trouble the Sisters. With steely conviction, purging flame, and heavy armor, the Sisters of Battle bore down on General Stubbs’ army until it broke and scattered. The evident cowardice of the Guardsmen confirmed every suspicion of guilt the Canoness had ever harbored. Her original resolve was then renewed and redoubled: every inch of the tainted system must be cleansed... cleansed by fire.

tc_text: 當他們到達考拉瓦四號時，在一瞬間，卡倫大君的部隊--帝國防衛軍的第253、254守護者軍團被摧毀了。接著，在橫跨整個星系的長征之後，他們停下面對第252守護者軍團的城市堡壘防禦。阿爾發軍團對他們的優勢---或是次元風暴不再感到意外，但結果還是相同的：混沌得到了完全的勝利。
en_text: With their arrival in Kaurava IV, Lord Carron’s forces had wiped out, in a single blow, the 253rd and 254th Conservator Regiments of the Imperial Guard. Then, after crossing the entire system in a warpath of blazing conquest, they came to face the 252nd Regiment in their heavily defended city stronghold. The Alpha Legion no longer had the element of complete surprise – or the Warp Storm – to their advantage, but the result was the same: utter victory for Chaos.

tc_text: 阿爾發軍團考慮到這是一個對抗帝國自己的攻擊的任務。卡倫大君讓他的渾沌星際戰士、邪教徒和其他的部隊解放了城市，並將衛隊給聚集了起來。那些沒有歸順到渾沌的人在經過一點折磨之後，馬上就這麼做了，只有極少數的人忠誠的為他們的假皇帝而死。雖然史塔伯斯他自己不曉得如何逃脫了，但他的高階軍官的屍體被懸吊了起來，作為那天勝利的象徵。
en_text: The Alpha Legion considered this conquest a strike against the Imperium itself. Lord Carron let his Chaos Space Marines, Cultists, and other forces loose upon the city. The Guardsmen were rounded up. Those that did not turn over to Chaos immediately did so out of madness after a little torture, and very few died faithful to their False Emperor. Although Stubbs himself had somehow escaped, the broken bodies of his top officers were set up high upon a stage as a token and trophy of the day.

tc_text: 先知卡里絲在抵達考拉瓦星系時，曾因為某些理由而提防著帝國防衛軍。首先，她無法忘記帝國領袖給予她的前輩--先知塔迪兒在洛恩五號和克諾努斯的遭遇。接著，帝國防衛軍喚醒了考拉瓦三號的死靈族的可能性太大了，或許連發生在考拉瓦四號的次元風暴也是他們的傑作。
en_text: Farseer Caerys, upon arriving in the Kaurava System, was wary of the Imperial Guard presence there for several reasons. First, she could not have forgotten the treatment her predecessor, Farseer Taldeer, had received on Lorn V and Kronus by the leaders of the Imperium. Second, the likelihood was far too great that the Imperial Guard had a hand in the waking of the Necrons on Kaurava III, and possibly the Warp Storm on Kaurava IV, as well.

tc_text: 很快的先知決定將第252守護者軍團從衝突中移除。雖然帝國防衛軍在杜薩拉圍場的防禦位置被證明極其堅強，但是史塔伯斯將軍的人無法與神靈族高超的戰術和戰鬥技巧相對抗，在疲憊的抗爭之後，他們被擊敗了。得到這個區域的控制之後，神靈族得以重新規劃部署和運輸計畫，大大的降低了建造和戰場部署的難度。
en_text: Soon the Farseer resolved to remove the 252nd Conservator Regiment from the Conflict. The Imperial Guard’s defensive position in the Dussala Precinct turned out to be extremely well defended, but General Stubbs’ men could not withstand the Eldar’s superior tactics and skill in battle, and, after a grueling struggle, were vanquished. In taking control of the region, the Eldar were able to re-purpose some of the manufacturing pipelines, greatly improving the ease of construction and deployment within the battle arena.

tc_text: 在暗黑神靈族的塔里爾執政官心中，帝國防衛軍是一個真正的謎題。他把他們想成是快速生長的樹林，樹上掛滿了成熟的果實。可是，在樹上長滿了討人厭的刺，而果實也包覆著一層堅硬的外殼。
en_text: To the mind of Dark Eldar Archon Tahril, the Imperial Guard were a true conundrum. He thought of them as a burgeoning tree, hanging heavy with ripe fruit. And yet, the tree bore thorns, and the fruit was cased in hard shells.

tc_text: 最後執政官終於被這些荊刺扎了太多次，而現在是他拿著刀劍向樹幹揮舞的時刻了。帝國防衛軍指揮中心厚重的裝甲和火力激怒了塔里爾的部隊，但藉由恐懼、毒藥和凶猛的速度，他們毀滅了帝國防衛軍，成功的完成了任務。當樹倒下時，它的果實全都落在地面上，塔里爾就可以輕易的拿取它們了。有一些他們留下盡情的欣賞，有些被留給他們的主人。暗黑神靈族接著就將他們的目光轉向那些殼比較軟、刺也比較少的受害者去了。
en_text: At last the Archon had been pricked one too many times by those thorns, and the time had come to take his blade to the tree’s trunk. The heavy armor and artillery of the Imperial Guard’s central command were aggravating to Tahril’s forces, but with terror, poison, and savage speed, they crushed the Imperial Guard regiment. The job was well done. With the tree felled, its fruit were all close to the ground and Tahril could gather them with ease. Some they feasted on and some they set aside for their masters. The Dark Eldar then turned their sights on victims with softer shells, and fewer thorns.

tc_text: 當戈古茲的吼～軍團來到考拉瓦一號時，他們的力量和士氣達到了一個很好的狀態。不過曾經有一小段時間，帝國防衛軍堡壘堅實的防禦、跟強大的火力撼動了他們，甚至更糟的是擊垮了軍閥的歐克蠻人。儘管這些粉紅皮膚的傢伙打了場好仗，讓戈古茲損耗了不少歐克蠻人，但是他們在最後還是都被擊敗了。考拉瓦的歐克蠻人宣稱這是他們在考拉瓦 一號的世界中，所獲得的第一場勝利。
en_text: When Gorgutz’ Waaagh! came to Kaurava I, its strength and momentum had reached truly great proportions. For a brief moment, the thick, tiered defenses and heavy munitions of the Imperial Guard’s stronghold threatened to stall, or worse yet, break the Warlord’s Orkish avalanche. And although the pink-skins put up a good fight, and cost Gorgutz many an Ork, finally they were stomped flat. This was the first victory the old Kaurava Ork clans had ever achieved on the city-world of Kaurava I.

tc_text: 這個偉大的勝利讓整個歐克軍隊的士氣達到了一個顛峰狀態，許多吼～軍團的旗幟在杜薩拉的所有地方冉冉升起。但有一小部分歐克蠻人比惡霸技師還要開心，他們在征服帝國防衛軍堡壘的過程中，奪到了一大群的坦克、槍砲等戰利品。戈古茲的技師們計畫將一部份的帝國兵工場改造給自己來使用，來為橫跨考拉瓦的部隊做好準備。
en_text: The great victory provided a huge morale boost to the entire Ork army, and many Waaagh! banners were spontaneously raised there, in Dussala and across all their Kauravan territories. But few Orks were happier than the Mek Boyz, who, in conquering the Imperial Guard’s stronghold, laid claim to a vast array of tanks, guns, and other spoils to be modified for Ork use. Gorgutz’ Meks even managed to turn some of the Imperium’s war factories to their use, promising readier and cheaper garrisons across Kaurava.

tc_text: 雖然現在已經有許多橫跨了考拉瓦星系行星的部隊，想企圖獲得控制權，但帝國防衛軍還有擁有其他人所沒有的東西。千年以來對星系的統治讓他們具有組織和建設，這對想要奪取星系的鈦星人來說，不禁讓他們感到欽佩。大地、火焰和洪水氏族一致認為在佔領收回之後，這些工廠、地圖、和通訊管道等設施將可以縮短殖民地建設數百年的時間。
en_text: Although many armies now marched across the planets of the Kaurava System in hopes of dominance, the Imperial Guard had something the others did not. Their stewardship of the system for a millennium granted them organization and infrastructure which the Tau, who looked upon Kaurava as a future addition to their empire, could not help but admire. The Earth, Fire, and Water Castes were all in agreement, that the factories, maps, and communication pathways would reduce the colonization process by hundreds of years, if captured and repurposed.

tc_text: 鈦星人對考拉瓦一號上第252守護者軍團指揮中心開戰，其實大部分是為了行政管理的目的而採取軍事行動。帶著極佳的效率，歐耶斯卡指揮官的部隊擊敗突破了帝國防衛軍。當勝利之後，鈦星人宣稱所有的軍事工業完全歸屬於他們，奪走了這些在更偉大良善之翼下逃走的帝國懦夫所遺留下的東西。
en_text: Thus, it was as much for administrative as for military purposes that the Tau made war on the 252nd Conservator Regiment’s central command on Kaurava I. With calm efficiency, Commander Or’es’Ka’s forces pierced, overwhelmed, and routed the Imperial Guard. Once victory had been achieved, the Tau claimed the vast military-industrial complex for their own, taking those Guardsmen who would renounce Imperial allegiance under the safe wing of the Greater Good.

tc_text: 當死靈族軍團抵達杜薩拉圍場時，帝國防衛軍做好了每一項抵禦他們的準備。不幸的，一小部分的互牆太薄弱了，而部分的砲台也不夠強大到可以阻擋全力進攻的死靈族。儘管史塔伯斯將軍集合了他能指揮的坦克、火砲和用上所有的戰術，他還是無法與那些如潮水般的不死族對抗，而帝國防衛軍從此被攻破。
en_text: When the Necron legions arrived in Dussala Precinct, the Imperial Guard made every preparation to rebuff their advance. Unfortunately, few walls are thick enough, and few batteries of cannon are heavy enough to stop the Necrons, once they are moving in full force. Despite all the tanks, artillery, and tactics he could muster, General Stubbs was helpless against the deathless tide, and the Imperial Guard were overwhelmed.

tc_text: 勝利來的並不快，但卻很徹底。在戰爭之後，沒有任何衛隊的屍體，只有一大群新生的死靈族士兵、和新生的浮石巨塔，出現在以前帝國碉堡豎立的地方。死靈族甚至發現了供應著許多杜薩拉圍場的工廠的大型發電機，並將能源轉換成他們自己可怕的目的之用...
en_text: The victory was not swift, but it was absolute. The day after the battle, not even the corpses of Guardsmen were to be found. Only a host of new Necron soldiers, and new monoliths where Imperial bunkers had formerly stood. The Necrons had even discovered the vast generators that had powered the many factories of the Dussala Precinct, and harnessed the energy for their own terrible purposes…

tc_text: 事實上文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍被迫直接攻擊星際戰士，對他來說這是戰爭中不幸但卻一定要作的事情。史塔伯斯對部隊指揮官波里爾非常的尊敬，在他的帝國防衛軍擊敗了血鴉之後，史塔伯斯很遺憾沒辦法保全指揮官的生命。當然，那是不可能的事情，沒有任何一個部隊指揮官會在他的同伴戰敗死亡之後，還想要去討降偷生。
en_text: The fact that General Vance Stubbs was forced to attack the Space Marines directly was, to him, merely an unfortunate necessity of the war. Stubbs had every respect for Force Commander Boreale. After his Imperial Guard forces had outgunned and overpowered the Blood Ravens, he felt great regret that the Commander’s life could not have been spared. That of course, was impossible. No Force Commander would ever flee or surrender while his company fought and died.

tc_text: 一小部分無法光榮戰死的的血鴉星際戰士被迅速的施予醫療，然後遣送回區域指揮部，而堅守崗位而死亡的戰士被賦予所有的榮耀和厚葬。不過在這些行為後，史塔伯斯將軍仍然將軍隊駐紮在孤寂之地，並且開始索討可用的軍火和其它裝備。
en_text: The few Blood Raven Space Marines who had been unable to die honorably were given prompt medical treatment and dispatched to Segmentum Command. The dead were given all the honors and funeral rites due to their station. These proceedings, however, did not for an instant deter General Stubbs from installing a company of his Guardsmen in the Lands of Solitude, or laying claim to the useable munitions and other equipment left intact.

tc_text: 史塔伯斯深深的認為，喪失這些星際戰士是非常令人惋惜的。但因為個人野心和他的軍團的權力，讓他也只能做出這樣的選擇。
en_text: The loss of good Imperial Space Marines was regrettable, General Stubbs reflected, but the charter of his regiment and his own personal ambitions had, after all, left him only one course of action.

tc_text: 因為她們和審判團長期合作的關係，戰鬥修女必須負責揭露出帝國部隊勢力中腐化的部分。在見證了渾沌在考拉瓦星系中的墮落腐敗，告解者崔格農‧馬奇向阿格娜大修女建議，所有任何拒絕向修女會交出權力的人都可以被視為異教行為的證據。
en_text: Due to their long association with the Inquisition, the Sisters of Battle have often taken it upon themselves to determine corruption among the other branches of the Imperial armed forces. After witnessing the prevalence of Chaos in the Kaurava System, Confessor Treganum March advised Canoness Agna that any refusal to cede authority to the Sisterhood was clear evidence of heresy.

tc_text: 當血鴉站上他們的土地上時，大修女便快速的行動著。她的命令很清楚：必須將異教徒消滅掉。以戰力而言，戰鬥修女或許無法與星際戰士相抗衡。不過，戰鬥修女在那天帶著她們的神聖之火和信仰的行動，任何的倖存者都直接在戰場上告解招供，這遠比審判團的審訊過程來得快而痛苦也比較輕。
en_text: When the Blood Ravens stood their ground, the Canoness acted quickly. Her mandate was clear: as heretics, they must be obliterated. Soldier for soldier, the Sisters of Battle could not compete with the Space Marines. Nevertheless, the Adepta Sororitas carried the day with their purging flames and Acts of Faith. Any survivors were shown the mercy of battlefield confession, which was far quicker and less painful than proper Inquisition proceedings.

tc_text: 這麼多的星際戰士必須死亡是令人惋惜的事情，很遺憾的他們被懷疑已經墮落腐化了。但是不管情勢如何，所有的腐化都必須全力被消滅。
en_text: It was regrettable that so many Space Marines had to die. It was regrettable that they had come under suspicion of taint. But, whatever the circumstances, corruption must be fought and, at all costs, wiped out.

tc_text: 當渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫將他的足跡，踏入孤寂之地的外圍時，他可以感覺到他偉大的勝利就要來臨了。他已經擊敗了傳奇的血鴉，並且讓他們畏縮在他們自己堡壘中。因為這些成功的激勵，阿爾發軍團緊接著向他們古老敵人的總部前進，進行戰爭。
en_text: When Chaos Lord Firaeveus Carron set foot upon the outer edge of the Lands of Solitude, he could feel his greatest of victories fast approaching. Already, he had beaten the legendary Blood Ravens back to their very door, and left them cowering in their own stronghold. Emboldened by this turn of events, the Alpha Legion pressed on towards the headquarters of their ancient enemy, and there engaged in battle.

tc_text: 如果血鴉沒有這麼英勇的作戰，卡倫大君如此品嚐著他們挫敗。他的阿爾發軍團渾沌星際戰士，帶著渾沌的暴行和尖嘯穿馳騁著，在每一回合痛擊面前的敵人，直到勝利降臨。
en_text: If the Blood Ravens had not fought so well, Lord Carron would not so thoroughly have relished their defeat. His Alpha Legion Chaos Space Marines, with Chaos coursing through their veins, with screams and great acts of barbarity, had countered the enemy at every turn, until victory was won.

tc_text: 儘管之後那些死去的星際戰士被可怕的褻瀆著，但生存下來的更值得憐憫。垂死的指揮官波里爾在他臨死之前，被迫看著這些無法用言語形容的暴行。卡倫大君將孤寂之地奉獻給了渾沌，重新將它命名為惡魔般的--塞格瑞布里特，但他的手下把這地方稱為：鴉之血，來祭祀那天那群人曾經在這片土地之上灑下的生命。
en_text: Although the dead Space Marines were horribly desecrated in the aftermath, it was those who somehow survived that were truly to be pitied. The dying Commander Boreale was forced to watch many of these unspeakable atrocities before the last trickle of life drained from his body. Lord Carron dedicated the Lands of Solitude to Chaos, renaming the land in daemonic, Segraebbliut, but his men called the place another thing entirely: Ravensblood, for all that they had shed that day.

tc_text: 先知卡里絲發現她自己預見了更多更多關於星際戰士的麻煩。血鴉是否將獲得勝利？有許多的結果都變得可能發生，而有太多的破壞性的勝利牽連著死靈族或是貪婪暗黑神靈族。不管是藉由無知還是挑釁，星際戰士都可以擊敗銀河中這些可怕的勢力。
en_text: Farseer Caerys found herself more and more troubled by visions concerning the Space Marines. Should the Blood Ravens meet with success, several outcomes were possible, and too many involved devastating victories for either the Necrons or the rapacious Dark Eldar. Either through ignorance or provocation, the Space Marines would unleash horrible forces on the galaxy.

tc_text: 儘管是令人卻步的任務，神靈族還是必須執行的非常徹底。遠古先人的智慧和她遠見的指引之下，先知讓她的部隊到達了孤寂之地，讓他們對帝國著名的部隊進行了大型的攻勢。當然，她會盡量使用迂迴的方式，只是那時也沒有其它的方式了。雖然神靈族的損失慘重，但他們的確征服了血鴉，讓他們的任務也終於被完成結束。
en_text: What the Eldar must do was clear enough, although a daunting task. Guided by her foresight and the wisdom of her ancestors, the Farseer led her army to the Lands of Solitude and there made a bold strike against the famed soldiers of the Imperium. She would, of course, have preferred less direct methods, but there was no other way. While the Eldar loss of life was terrible, they did succeed in subduing the Blood Ravens, and their duty was fulfilled.

tc_text: 當戰場被清除、神靈族的死者被祭祀時，先知卡里絲思索著她的部隊的下一個行動，仔細的思索著進入錯綜複雜未來所付出的可怕代價。
en_text: While the battlefield was being cleared, and the Eldar dead ritually lamented, Farseer Caerys pondered her army’s next move, reflecting on the terrible price that is sometimes paid for peering into the tangled skein of the future.

tc_text: 暗黑神靈族只懼怕幾件事情，但他們憎恨著更多的東西。在塔里爾執政官的眼中，這些血鴉星際戰士是個令人憎惡的大目標。他們代表著秩序、驕傲滿滿的人類種族、還有最糟糕的東西，他們宣稱自己是銀河系中獨一無二的戰士。這些令人反感的東西讓執政官感到羞辱，而這種自大的想法對他來說，是一種對他個人的輕蔑和侮辱。
en_text: There are few things the Dark Eldar fear, but many are the things they hate. In the eyes of the Archon Tahril, these Blood Raven Space Marines were a grand object of disgust. They stood for order, and the upstart human race, and, worst of all, claimed to be warriors second to none in the galaxy. To hate, the Archon added insult. The idea that any should be feared so much as his own Black Heart Kabal was a personal affront.

tc_text: 證明他的優越、和懲罰血鴉罪過的時刻到來了。當著名的士兵被塔里爾給擊敗時，他感到非常的高興，但更值得的是他證明了星際戰士是令人敬畏的敵人。容易被征服的事物會使人厭煩，而所有的暗黑精靈族都會享受從潰敗和死亡邊緣中，得到勝利所帶來的生存感。
en_text: The time had come to prove his superiority, and punish the Blood Ravens for their offense – of existing. Tahril was greatly pleased when he vanquished the famed soldiers, but was even more elated at how worthy an adversary the Space Marines proved. One can weary of docile playthings, but no Dark Eldar ever feels so alive as the moment when one stands victorious, having narrowly skirted defeat and death.

tc_text: 執政官認為將血鴉指揮官乾縮的頭別在腰帶上，是對他的最大敬意。對執政官來說，孤寂地之戰會是一個讓他長久珍惜的記憶。
en_text: The Archon considered it the greatest compliment to the slain Blood Raven commander, when he placed his severed, shrunken head on the upper tassle of his war-belt. The Battle of Solitude was a memory the Archon would cherish for many years to come.

tc_text: 戰爭頭目戈古茲曾經和血鴉作戰，他知道他們是很棒的對手，他們可以在你一眨眼之間就給你重下痛擊。不過在這個時刻，他知道眨眼的人變成了他們，而他和他的孩子們將會對血鴉給予重擊。
en_text: Warboss Gorgutz had fought the Blood Ravens before, and he knew they were good enemies. Blink your eyes and they’d give you a good stomping. This time, though, he figured it was them that had blinked, and him and his boyz who would be doing the stomping.

tc_text: 儘管當吼～軍團抵達了考拉瓦二號時，那些血鴉打了一場很漂亮的仗，在戈古茲包圍之前擊敗了不少歐克蠻人，不過那些孩子還是奪取了成堆的頭顱做為他們的戰利品，而技師們也拿到了不少人類的器具。
en_text: Still, when the Waaagh! reached the northern reaches of Kaurava II, those Blood Ravens put up a right good fight, and tore up plenty of Orks before Gorgutz closed in and squashed them good. Those boyz that made it took plenty of trophies in skulls, and the Meks got their green paws on plenty of the humans’ gear.

tc_text: 那些歐克蠻人在那天顯示了他們最大的勇氣和最佳的技巧，這讓他們得以晉升為戈古茲的個人菁英衛隊。
en_text: Those Orks that had shown the greatest bravery and skill that day were granted a true honor: promotion to Gorgutz’ elite personal guard.

tc_text: 當鈦星指揮官歐耶斯卡小心翼翼的策劃著征服考拉瓦星系的陰謀時，他發現了血鴉存在的威脅。他們的位置在考拉瓦二號，這對於楠‧亞諾以的月球基地來說實在是太靠近了，這讓歐耶斯卡感到不安。
en_text: As the Tau Commander Or’es’Ka plotted his careful strategy for the subjugation of the Kaurava System, he was troubled by the danger posed by the Blood Ravens. Their position on Kaurava II, too close to the Nan Yanoi moon-base for comfort, was only one of many reasons for his unease.

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官發覺他攻擊星際戰士的時刻來臨了，不然他們的力量將會強大到成為鈦星人的競爭對手。經過他深思熟慮的計算，他發現面對挑戰的結果將會帶來成功與繁榮。血鴉的戰鬥能力無人能比，但他們的防禦卻是混亂而無效率的。利用這個優勢，歐耶斯卡的部隊將會緊緊的壓迫星際戰士，直到他們潰敗為止。
en_text: The time had come when Commander Or’es’Ka felt he must strike the Space Marines, or risk their strength growing to rival that of the Tau. As always, he found that the cautious deliberation with which he faced the challenge resulted in prosperity and success. The Blood Ravens fought remarkably well, but their defense was disorganized and inefficient. Taking advantage of this, Or’es’Ka’s forces pressed the Space Marines until they faced defeat.

tc_text: 在歐耶斯卡跟他的部隊在戰鬥中讚頌血鴉英勇的表現，但也體認到如果不是遵循著更大良善的導引，在這場戰鬥中被擊敗的可能就是鈦星人自己了。
en_text: In Commander Or’es’Ka’s address to his troops following the battle, he praised the Blood Ravens for their valor in combat, and concluded with the admonishment that, without the guidance of the Greater Good, surely it would have been the Tau who perished in defeat.

tc_text: 在部隊指揮官波里爾生命最後的時刻，他突然瞭解了自己到底作錯了多少事情，他完全的低估了死靈族大軍的威脅。他們驚人的部隊穿越了孤寂之地的邊境，殺光了所有阻擋在他們道路上的事物。在他閉眼的那一剎那，這個偉大的星際戰士瞭解了大勢已去。他同時也看到了在死靈族穿越了他們的領域時，失敗就注定要發生了。
en_text: In his last moments of life, Force Commander Boreale suddenly understood the full extent of his error. He had completely underestimated the threat of the Necron horde. With terrifying force they had poured across the borders of the Lands of Solitude, slaughtering all in their path. As the last flicker of consciousness was dissipating from his clouded eyes, the great Space Marine reviewed all that had passed, and saw that by the time his scouts had spied the Necrons through their scopes, his defeat was already inevitable.

tc_text: 星際戰士必須修正他們的協議--波里爾突然升起了這樣的想法，他一定得要警告區域指揮部，但他冰冷無生氣的雙手卻突然被壓制住。他的靈魂尚未離去，但他現在要面對比死亡更可怕的命運，將永遠無法加入在神聖皇帝的身邊，他將會被囚禁在一個不死的軀殼，而成為一個死靈族遲鈍的奴才。
en_text: The Space Marines must revise their protocols – Segmentum must be warned – and with that single thought, Boreale tried to rise. But the fingers of a cold lifeless hand were suddenly clamped around his arm. His soul had not yet left his body, and now it was destined for a more terrible fate than death. He would never join the God-Emperor.

tc_text: 考拉瓦星系在當今的衝突之前，就經常發生歐克蠻族和帝國防衛軍之間獨立的暴動和直接戰鬥。在這之前衛隊曾經獨自面對過考拉瓦歐克蠻族，但他們都不像現在在戰爭頭目戈古茲帶領下，那麼的具有組織和侵略性。
en_text: The Kaurava System had known strife between the Orks and the Imperial Guard long before the present conflict, in the form of isolated outbreaks and outright war. But before this time, the Guardsmen had faced the Kauravan Orks alone, who were never as organized or aggressive as now, under the leadership of Warboss Gorgutz.

tc_text: 對那些不幸的歐克蠻族來說，帝國防衛軍也在新領導人的帶領下作戰。堅定的史塔伯斯將軍跟戈古茲在洛克可羅山脈中纏鬥，這是帝國防衛軍所穿越最遠的地方，在那邊人類的部隊面對了戈古茲的吼～軍團。當考拉瓦的歐克蠻人被徹底的擊敗時，卻沒有甚麼人發現偉大的歐克戰爭頭目。帝國的偵測器記錄到歐克的船隻曾經從戰鬥中逃脫，但其它的資訊則全都遺失在火熱的戰爭之中了。
en_text: Unfortunately for the Orks, the Imperial Guard was also fighting under a new leader. The determined General Stubbs dogged Gorgutz right into the Rokclaw Mountains, farther than the Imperial Guard had ever penetrated, and there dealt his Waaagh! a mortal blow. While the Orks of Kaurava were thoroughly defeated, less is known concerning the great Ork Warboss himself. Imperium scanner logs indicate that an Ork craft did take off from the scene, but any other information was lost to the heat of the battle.

tc_text: 衛隊的第252軍團曾在洛克可羅戰役中曾經奪下了傲人的"歐克血腥者"，而那座山峰現在則以史塔伯斯山峰之名而著稱。
en_text: The Guardsmen of the 252nd Regiment who had fought in the Battle of Rokclaw took on the proud moniker of “Orksblooders,” and the mountain itself came to be known as Stubb’s Peak.

tc_text: 在跟歐克蠻族的戰鬥中，血鴉發現了他們在洛克可羅山脈遭遇到了前所未有的挑戰。首先是在攻擊山脈中堡壘的難度，再來則是要面對聲名狼籍的戰爭頭目戈古茲的戰術，他無畏的作戰氣勢在他每一次戰鬥生存之後，就會持續的增長。
en_text: In terms of fighting Orks, the Blood Ravens found as great a challenge in the Rokclaw Mountains as any they had ever faced. First was the difficulty in assailing the mountain stronghold itself. Second were the tactics of the infamous Warboss Gorgutz, whose prowess grew greater with every campaign he fought and survived.

tc_text: 就如同所面對的偉大挑戰一般，血鴉證明他們自己是無畏的戰士，不會向任何敵人屈服。在擊敗歐克蠻人和征服了他們先祖的土地之後，星際戰士持續的獵殺在那些山脈中發現的倖存歐克蠻人。
en_text: As great as the challenge was, the Blood Ravens proved themselves matchless soldiers, undaunted by any foe. After overcoming the Ork hordes and laying waste to their ancient enclave, the Space Marines proceeded to hunt down every last Ork they could find in those mountains.

tc_text: 在星際戰士完美的攻勢中只有一個小瑕疵：不曉得為什麼讓戈古茲逃出了他們的手中。有些報告證明在戰爭結束時，曾經發射了一個粗陋的火箭，而有人宣稱那是一個關閉通道入口的定時炸彈，用來掩護偉大歐克蠻人的逃脫的行蹤。
en_text: There was only one blemish in the Space Marines’ otherwise flawless execution: Gorgutz himself somehow eluded their grasp. Some reports attested to a crude rocket, which took off at the battle’s end, while others claim the blast was a timed bomb, closing off a tunnel entrance to cover the great Ork’s escape.

tc_text: 事實上帝國曾經和污穢的歐克蠻族共享一個星系有數百年的時間，而不是立即的去消滅他們，這點一直讓賽林娜‧阿格娜大修女感到作噁。她的姊妹們已經無法忍受他們大量的騷擾，就像是面對著腐敗的異教徒跟異型一樣。
en_text: The fact that the Imperium had shared a planetary system with the filthy Ork barbarians for hundreds of years, rather than promptly exterminating them, filled Canoness Selena Agna with disgust. Her Sisters would tolerate such an infestation no more than the taints of heresy or mutation.

tc_text: 當然，虛弱的帝國防衛軍的失敗讓情況變得更糟。而歐克蠻族被允許進入他們危險的吼～軍團，這些都已經不再能被忽視。忠於職責、懷著淨化之火的戰鬥修女在洛克可羅山脈狠狠的擊敗了歐克蠻人，並且仔細的搜尋任一個逃脫的敵人。
en_text: Of course, the failures of the weak Imperial Guard had become compounded. The Orks had been allowed to enter the dangerous “Waaagh!” phase, and could no longer be ignored. Cleaving to their sense of duty, and with a great deal of purging fire, the Sisters of Battle stormed the ancient Ork retreat in the Rokclaw mountains, and thoroughly routed their foes.

tc_text: 大修女將她的勝利視為信仰的證明。在戰爭之後，發現戰爭頭目戈古茲不曉得為什麼逃脫了，因此她記取著皇帝要他們在勝利的時刻保持謙遜，以免讓自己變得太過驕傲。
en_text: The Canoness took her victory as a testament to their faith. When it was discovered, after the battle, that the Warboss Gorgutz had somehow escaped, she maintained that the Emperor had humbled them in their moment of victory, lest they grow too proud.

tc_text: 在數千個戰爭之後，渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫發展出了殘酷又敏銳的天性。卡倫察覺他必須盡快的擊敗歐克蠻族的威脅，不然就會冒著失去他在考拉瓦星系踏足處的風險。為了用占卜來證實他的疑慮，他便向他的首席巫師求教諮商。
en_text: Over the course of thousands of battles, the Chaos Lord Firaveus Carron had developed cruelly keen instincts. Carron felt that he must crush the Ork threat soon, or risk losing his foothold in the Kaurava System. He consulted his head Sorcerer, only to have his suspicions confirmed by a divination.

tc_text: 依渾沌而茁壯、吞噬著血腥的阿爾發軍團，擊潰了歐克蠻族的部隊，入侵了千年以來沒有人侵犯過的土地。而當卡倫大君瘋狂、凱旋的屠殺著士兵們敗退的對手時，他小心翼翼的探索著每一片土地，來尋找他的敵人戈古茲。再次的，他的本能證實了：任何地方都找不到這個偉大的歐克蠻人，不過戰爭仍然是勝利的，再也不會有任何的歐克蠻人來冒犯到混沌的優越。
