en_text: Gorged on bloodshed and strong with Chaos, the Alpha Legions crushed the Ork forces. They tore through the ancient Ork stronghold, an enclave untouched by intruders for millennia. While his crazed, victorious soldiers butchered and burned the vanquished army, Lord Carron stalked the grounds suspiciously, looking for Gorgutz, his nemesis. Again, his instincts had proved true: the great Ork was nowhere to be found. Still, the victory was won. No Orks would trouble the ascendancy of Chaos.

tc_text: 在先知卡里絲感應到歐克蠻族吼～軍團的威脅之前，她沒有在考拉瓦星系停留過很長的時間。但時機未到，她只好繼續等待和觀察。任何對一般策士看似無形的陣勢和威脅，都在她眼前顯露無遺，於是，她知道該是行動的時刻了。
en_text: She had not been long in the Kaurava System before Farseer Caerys sensed the danger posed by an Ork Waaagh! there. But the time was not right, and so she waited, and watched. Lines and threats invisible to any ordinary tactician appeared to her, and then, at last, she knew she must move.

tc_text: 雖然在數量、火力和殘暴程度上佔了優勢，但是歐克蠻人還是無法對抗神靈族的先進戰略。如同一把致命而迅速的利刃一般，卡里絲的部隊直直的攻進了歐克古老的堡壘中心，他們的勝利是俐落而明確的。
en_text: Although superior in number, strength, and barbarity, the Orks could not match the advanced strategies of the Eldar. Like a fine and deadly blade, Caerys’ forces pierced the heart of the ancient Ork stronghold. Their victory was unequivocal.

tc_text: 很不幸的，戰爭頭目戈古茲不曉得如何的逃開了神靈族的部隊。不過還是一樣的，他在這個戰爭中的角色已經結束，而對這場勝利來說已經足夠了。
en_text: Unfortunately, the Warboss Gorgutz somehow eluded the Eldar force. All the same, his role in this war was ended, and that was victory enough.

tc_text: 歐克部隊佯裝的襲擊惹惱了塔里爾執政官，讓他對於在戰場上不斷出現的歐克蠻人感到疲乏。對於暗黑精靈族靈敏的耳目來說，想要發現隱藏在山脈中的考拉瓦歐克蠻人堡壘，並不是一件困難的事情。這一大群綠色的畜生讓攻佔堡壘變得很不容易，但是塔里爾還是克服了。
en_text: The bumbling forays of the Ork armies had irritated Archon Tahril one too many times, and he grew weary of their presence in his battlefield. It was without much difficulty that the Dark Eldar, keen of eye and ear, found the supposedly secret mountain fortress of the Kauravan Orks. The sheer number of these green brutes rendered the stronghold’s sack quite difficult, but Tahril prevailed.

tc_text: 許多歐克蠻人的屍體躺臥在坦克的甲板上，即使是數量龐大的歐克部隊也都成為了塔里爾的手中玩物，並且被進貢給在卡莫拉的神靈族。而地獄獸和掠奪者快速部隊從狹窄的山路被送到戰場，來獵殺那些倖存的歐克蠻族。
en_text: Many Ork corpses festooned Raider and Ravager decks. Orks in great number were taken as playthings for Tahril, his Haemonculus Gruemenael, and as tribute to the elders of Commorragh. Hellions and Reavers were sent through the narrow mountain passes, to hunt Orks that had fled.

tc_text: 在這些過程中，塔里爾大君親自為他的敵人戈古茲準備好了帳棚--但是是懷著驕傲的期望，能親自將戰爭頭目戈古茲開腸剖肚心態，來獲得最大的樂趣。在最後他們還是讓他在恐懼中逃走了，不過對現在來說這已經足夠了。
en_text: During all these proceedings, Lord Tahril himself scoured the camp for his adversary, Gorgutz – but in vain. The Archon had looked forward with great pleasure to personally eviscerating the Ork Warboss. Still, they had sent him scurrying in fear, and that would surely suffice for now.

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官曾經親自跟歐克蠻人對抗過數次，而且從不指望他們會改邪歸正。所以，當鈦星人得知歐克堡壘的位置就在楠‧亞諾以月球基地的正下方時，他們知道只有一點點時間來將其給摧毀掉了。
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka had personally seen several engagements with the Orks, and considered them entirely beyond hope of reform. So, when the Tau learned the location of the Ork stronghold, directly beneath the Nan Yanoi moon-base, it was only a matter of time before they would need to be eliminated.

tc_text: 鈦星人不管是在近戰或是數量上都無法與歐克蠻族抗衡，不過在戰術跟武器上的優勢還是讓他們得到了完全的勝利。山脈中古老的基地從來就沒有被成功的攻破過，然而在鈦星部隊的惡霸般的攻勢下還是敞開了大門。
en_text: Although no match for the Orks in close combat or in numbers, the strategies and weaponry of the Tau allowed them to achieve complete victory. The ancient mountain base, which had never before known a successful assault, was split open under the vice-like pressure of the Tau military.

tc_text: 當歐克蠻族戰敗後，鈦星人毫不猶豫的宣稱山脈是他們的領地，而烈焰戰士和克魯特在山區巡視追擊著倖存的歐克蠻人。在對戰爭的徹底分析之後，歐耶斯卡瞭解到歐克的軍閥戈古茲逃脫了，大家仍然都相信他會於任何時間，再度出現在考拉瓦星系繼續的挑起戰爭。
en_text: The Tau did not hesitate to claim the remote mountain enclave for their own. Teams of Fire Warriors and Kroot scoured the mountains for Orks who had fled, while survey teams mapped the terrain. It was only after a thorough analysis of the battle that Or’es’Ka realized that somehow the Ork Warlord, Gorgutz, had escaped. Still, there was little doubt that he would not be waging war in Kaurava any time soon.

tc_text: 在戰爭頭目戈古茲獵頭者的吼～軍團旗幟之下，考拉瓦的歐克蠻族證明了他們自己是堅韌、徹底的戰士，而他們的數量、野獸般的力量和頑強的確就跟傳說般的一樣。但不管是戈古茲落是他的部隊，都沒有準備好去面對死靈族的不死軍團。
en_text: Under the Waaagh! banner of Warboss Gorgutz ‘Eadhunter, the Orks of Kaurava had proved themselves tough, capable warriors. Their numbers, brute strength, and tenacity could not be overestimated. Neither Gorgutz nor his army, however, was prepared for the deathless legions of the Necrons.

tc_text: 在無懼歐克蠻族的可怕聲譽下，死靈族的陰影伸進了洛克可羅山脈。他們穿越了山區裡的道路直擊著歐克蠻族神聖的古老城堡，這個地方在之前從來沒有任何入侵者踏入過。雖然歐克蠻族英勇的作戰，很多人在那天英勇的犧牲，但最後城堡還是在死靈族潮水般的攻勢下失守了。
en_text: Undaunted by the fearsome reputation of the Orks, the Necrons shadow swept in on the Rokclaw Mountains. They coursed through the mountain paths and poured into the ancient stronghold, sacred to the Kauravan Orks, which had never before known intruders. Although the Orks fought bravely, and many who died that day should have been sung heroes, all fell, crushed beneath the flood.

tc_text: 這場戰爭決定了考拉瓦歐克蠻族的末日。死靈族逐一的獵殺了僅存的歐克蠻人，大大的削減了他們的數量。很奇妙的有幾個報告指出，在死靈族勝利的那一刻，洛克可羅山脈有一具歐克火箭被發射了。即使戈古茲安全的靠著這具火箭逃脫了，對歐克蠻族來說，他們在最後還是失去了卡拉瓦。
en_text: This decisive battle spelled the end of the Kauravan Orks. The Necron methodically hunted every last Ork down. Strangely, several reports suggest that an Ork rocket blasted off from the Rokclaw Mountains just at the moment of the Necron victory. Still, even if Gorgutz were aboard this rocket, and made it to safety, the Kauravan cause was lost for the Orks.

tc_text: 當戰鬥修女抵達了考拉瓦星系，史塔伯斯將軍發現他和他的衛隊只有一個方法可以安全的存活。他們沒有任何的機會在這些艾克黎西亞奇的狂熱者手下獲取勝利，或是洗刷自己的嫌疑。在通盤分席後他知道自己不能作錯，因為不願意屈服於審判團，所以將軍準備好要面對戰爭了。
en_text: When the Sisters of Battle arrived in the Kaurava System, General Stubbs knew there was only one way he and his Guardsmen would make it through alive. No victory or act of penitence could clear them from suspicion, by the reckoning of those Ecclesiarchal zealots. Knowing that he had done no wrong, and unwilling to submit to Inquisitorial reconditioning, the General prepared for battle.

tc_text: 在一開始，史塔伯斯希望帝國的敵人，可以幫他的部隊分攤一些面對可怕的戰鬥修女的壓力。不幸的是，史塔伯斯將軍察覺到他沒有漫長的時間，來等待共同的敵人去做這份骯髒的工作。他下定決心進行一個大型的行動：在她們過來找他之前，直接的去攻擊戰鬥姊妹的總部。利用他們奇襲的優勢，雖然第252軍團雖然缺乏意志和信念，但他們的武器裝備還是比虔誠的戰鬥修女來得精良的。
en_text: At first, Stubbs had hoped that the enemies of the Imperium would spare him the unwelcome task of pitting his men against the feared and dreaded Sisters of Battle. Unfortunately, Stubbs did not feel he had the luxury of waiting for mutual enemies to do his dirty work. He resolved on a bold and desperate move: to attack the Sisters of Battle headquarters directly, before they could come to him. With the advantage of surprise on their side, the 252nd Regiment, although weak of will and faith, showed themselves stronger in arms and armor than the pious Sisters of Battle.

tc_text: 即使是史塔伯斯將軍也對這個非凡的功績感到訝異，而在向部隊道賀之後，他認為說這次的成功是皇帝希望帝國防衛軍固守考拉瓦星系的象徵。
en_text: This extraordinary feat surprised even General Stubbs, and, on congratulating his troops afterwards, he remarked that it was certain proof that the Emperor had willed the Imperial Guard to hold dominion over the Kaurava System.

tc_text: 在考拉瓦衝突中，血鴉第九連隊的目標很清楚：穩定這個星系，擊退所有渾沌的軍隊，並且瓦解任何敵對的勢力。當戰鬥修女與他們直接對抗時，他們就必須把這個對手從戰爭中給清除掉。
en_text: The charter of the Blood Ravens, 9th Company, in the Kaurava Conflict was undeniably clear: stabilize the system, defeat all forces of Chaos, and neutralize any opposing force. When the Sisters of Battle gave them direct opposition, it was necessary that they be removed from the stage of battle.

tc_text: 同樣的，戰鬥修女們也執行著屬於自己的命令，同樣的也是驅除所有的抵抗。很明顯的，在一個星系中容不下兩股帝國的勢力。很不幸的，對神聖玫瑰團的修女來說，她們並不是這些天生就是生於作戰的超級士兵的對手。雖然戰鬥修女做出了極佳的防禦表現，但在最後還是戰敗了。
en_text: The Sisters of Battle, of course, were also acting on their own orders, following similar instructions to brook no opposition. Evidently, there was not enough room for more than one Imperial force in the system. Unfortunately for the Sisters of the Order of the Sacred Rose, they were no match for the battle-hardened super-soldiers they were forced to fight. Although the Sisters of Battle defended themselves admirably, they were handily overcome.

tc_text: 在勝利之後，星際戰士用最高的敬意對待倖存的戰鬥修女，給予她們快速的醫療，並且將她們送回在奧菲麗亞七號的聖殿修道院。
en_text: Once vanquished, the Space Marines treated the surviving Sisters of Battle with the utmost deference, giving them swift medical aid and providing them with passage back to the Convent Sanctorum on Ophelia VII.

tc_text: 其次對星際戰士來說，阿爾發軍團把戰鬥修女中當成是一個天敵。如果有分別的話，那就是戰鬥修女更靠近偽皇帝，並宣誓為其犯罪。在神聖玫瑰團中，渾沌的士兵看到了更多對超過了信仰的動作，他們看到了戰鬥修女透過許多信仰的行動，來濫用皇帝力量的證據。
en_text: Second only to the Space Marines, the Alpha Legion found a natural enemy in the Sisters of Battle. If anything, the Sisters Militant stood even closer to the false Emperor whose destruction the Chaos Space Marines were sworn to perpetrate. In the Order of the Sacred Rose the soldiers of Chaos saw more than revolting, pious zeal; they saw manifest evidence of the Emperor’s powers, through the many Sisters of Battle's many Acts of Faith.

tc_text: 考慮到戰鬥修女的威脅和行動干擾，卡倫大君決定要進行一次直接攻擊，而他將會明確的證明渾沌之神的優越。在那一天，阿爾發軍團渾沌星際戰士的確證明了自己優勢，藐視著她們的力量、祈禱跟活聖人，而徹底的擊敗了戰鬥修女。
en_text: Spurred by these considerations and the active threat the Sisters of Battle posed, Lord Carron resolved on a direct attack. He would prove, definitively, the superiority of the Chaos gods. The Alpha Legion Chaos Space Marines certainly proved their own superiority that day, routing the Sisters of Battle and spurning their powers, prayers, and their Living Saint alike.

tc_text: 勝利的渾沌士兵在薩瑪行政區行使的許多殘暴行為和黑暗儀式，是無可辯白的。不管怎樣，在卡倫大君的命令之下，數個特別的可怕結果被送往宇宙，讓帝國的戰鬥部隊可以攔截到的通路之中。
en_text: Of the dark ceremonies and horrible atrocities that the victorious soldiers of Chaos perpetrated there in the Sama District, it is not best to give a full account. Under the orders of Lord Carron himself, however, several particularly horrible examples were blasted into space, in a path that would surely be intercepted by an Imperial battle fleet.

tc_text: 神靈族很清楚的知道戰鬥修女會企圖滅絕所有帝國外的戰鬥勢力，以及任何可能與其對抗的部隊。為了先作預防，先知卡里絲下令攻擊了在薩瑪行政區的戰鬥修女堡壘，在最後她的行動成功了。戰鬥修女顯示了她們當前令人畏懼的力量，如果再有任何的延遲，結果都將會造成神靈族的大災難。
en_text: The Eldar knew well that the Sisters Militant would endeavor to exterminate any army outside of the Imperium, and possibly any force within it. Farseer Caerys ordered the attack on the Sisters of Battle stronghold in the Sama District purely as a preventative measure. In the end, it was well that she acted when she did. The Battle Sisters proved formidable at their current strength. Any further delay could have resulted in disaster for the Eldar cause.

tc_text: 藉由擊敗了神聖玫瑰團，神靈族又移除了道路上的另一個障礙。帝國在這個地區中不斷的宣示主權，讓災難四處叢生。這是考拉瓦星系尋求更有智慧、更合適的領導著的最高時刻了。
en_text: By defeating the Order of the Sacred Rose, the Eldar removed yet another obstacle from their path. The Imperium had squandered its claim on the region, allowing disaster to run rampant. It was high time that Kaurava saw wiser, more capable stewardship.

tc_text: 當塔里爾執政官的突擊隊進入了薩瑪行政區開始，就是一場相互競速的復仇火焰之戰，張牙咧齒的邪惡對抗著頑固狹隘的信仰。但對戰鬥修女很不幸的，神靈族無情的勢力對她們來說實在是太強大了。
en_text: From the moment that Archon Tahril’s raiding force crossed into the Sama District, it was a contest of speed versus flame, of jagged and poisonous wickedness against stiff and narrow zeal. Unfortunately for the Sisters of Battle, the ruthless force with which the Dark Eldar struck them was simply too great.

tc_text: 黑心凱柏的掠奪者就像是一股黑暗的洪流，沖刷著整個帝國的城市，衝擊著修女會的城垛。暗黑神靈族迅速的抓到了許多戰鬥修女，讓她們來不及以身殉教，她們在最後都會變成暗黑神靈族的奴隸和玩物。他們將一個戰鬥修女折磨到神經錯亂然後將她丟回去，讓她藉由說出她所見到的恐怖，將恐懼植入其他人的心中。
en_text: The marauders of the Black Heart Kabal were like a dark torrent crashing through the Imperial city, smashing the Sisterhood’s battlements. The Dark Eldar swooped down on many of the Sisters of Battle with such speed that they had not time to make martyrs of themselves; instead they would become the slaves and playthings of the debased Dark Eldar. One lone Sister of Battle they tortured to the point of madness – then left where she could someday strike fear into the hearts of others by muttering of the horrors she had seen.

tc_text: 在歐克大軍痛擊戰鬥修女的那一天，戰爭頭目戈古茲見識到了在帝國旗幟下，他沒想像過能與之對抗的東西。雖然這些對手不是歐克蠻族，但她們戰鬥的非常好，他很確定她們不會輸給他任何的孩子。儘管你知道沒有任何人有資格可以擁有吼～軍團，但他懷疑她們甚至可能有專屬於自己的吼～軍團，只不過是雙方的旗幟不同而已。
en_text: On the day that the Ork army smashed the Sisters of Battle, Warboss Gorgutz saw such things as he had never guessed could fight under the banner of the Imperium. Although they were no Orks, they had fought heartily enough, and he was not sure that they were any less burny than his burniest boys. He suspected that they even had their own form of Waaagh!, although anyone knows you can’t have a Waaagh! without proper banners.

tc_text: 戈古茲和他的菁英衛隊宣稱許多來自於修女會的戰利品，都是他們曾經聽過、但卻從未見過的人類型式器具。之後的幾年，戈古茲著迷於活聖人曾經用來對抗他的飛行物，要求他最棒的技師做出類似的器具，讓他也可以在天空飛翔。
en_text: Gorgutz and his elite guard claimed many trophies from the gear of the Sisterhood, being a type of human soldier they had heard of, but never before encountered. For years to come, the formidable Warboss was obsessed by the winged flight of the Living Saint who had fought him, going so far as to ask his best Mek Boys to see about making him wings of a similar kind.

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官被他在戰鬥修女身上所見到的宗教熱誠所煩心，或許在他所見到的，他自己對更大良善的奉獻或許只是個扭曲的嘲諷。當鈦星人帶著他們的軍事力量加諸於戰鬥修女的堡壘時，他們發現自己正挑戰著封閉心靈和想法的一個狂熱信仰的人類表徵。儘管她們被鈦星人給威嚇到了，戰鬥修女還是展示出了無可取代的力量，即便是她們無法扭轉鈦星人洪水般的衝擊力量。
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka was perturbed by the religious zealotry, which he witnessed in the Sisters of Battle. In it he saw, perhaps, a twisted mockery of his own devotion to the Greater Good. When the Tau brought their military might to bear on the Sisters' stronghold, they found the challenge a perfect example of the closed-minded and closed-fisted approach of the fanatical humans. The remarkable powers that the Sisters of Battle displayed, though they amazed the Tau, could not turn the tide of the battle, and the Tau prevailed.

tc_text: 當鈦星人發現他們沒辦法從跟人類的戰爭中抓到俘虜時感到有些訝異，即便是他們已經跟帝國防衛軍發生過許多的衝突。那些愚蠢的人類，總是認為死亡超越了所有的行為準則。
en_text: It was with some surprise that the Tau found they could not take prisoners of war among these humans, as they had often done in conflicts with the Imperial Guard. The foolish humans insisted on dying, beyond all reason.

tc_text: 當戰爭徹底的勝利之後，歐耶斯卡指揮官下令搜查整個薩瑪行政區，讓他們可以學習到用來對抗他們的驚人科技。不過很奇妙的，這些科技都消失了，讓鈦星人無法研究它們。
en_text: When the battle was fully won, Commander Or’es’Ka ordered the city of the Sama District scoured, so that they could learn the technology that had produced invincibility and the other marvels that had been used against them. Strangely, this technology was gone, and the Tau were unable to account for it.

tc_text: 神聖玫瑰團的勇敢戰士全然的相信，她們在考拉瓦一號上大部分的堡壘可以對抗所有的攻擊。所以當死靈族的部隊用無法壓制的部隊擊敗了她們，嘲弄著她們的信仰的行動、坦克和火焰噴射器時，讓她們非常的訝異。用這些武器來對抗人類和生靈或許還夠用，但戰鬥修女們面對的卻是完全不同的敵人，一個從未被祈禱者成功避開或是擊敗的敵人。
en_text: The brave soldiers of the Order of the Sacred Rose had fully believed themselves girded and steeled against all assault, most of all in their own bastion on Kaurava I. So their surprise was great, indeed, when the Necrons came upon them with irresistible force, making mockeries of their flamers, tanks, and Acts of Faith. Those weapons might have sufficed against the mortal and the living, but alas, the Sisters of Battle faced an entirely different sort of foe. A foe which no prayers succeeded in averting or casting down.

tc_text: 死靈族成群的部隊橫跨了薩瑪行政區的城市，吞噬了所有會移動的、和摧毀了不會移動的東西。在完成了這些之後，所有的祈禱者跟聖樂都被寂靜所取代統治。除了死靈族發電機黯淡的低沈吟叫、和轟隆的雷聲之外，只有一片的寂靜，行進在整個大地之上。
en_text: The Necrons swarmed across the cities of Sama District, swallowing whole all that moved and crushing all that did not. After this was done, where prayers and organ-music had once been heard, silence reigned. Silence, except for the dull throb of the Necron generators, and the dull thunder of the horde, marching off into the distance.

tc_text: 我們很高興你的出現，安羅伊。
en_text: We welcome your gracious presence, Aun’Ro’Yr.

tc_text: 我看見我們的大地級工程師在楠‧亞諾以基地的建構上，有了很好的進展。
en_text: I see that our earth caste engineers have made splendid progress in constructing the Nan Yanoi base station.

tc_text: 是的，閣下，它已經接近完工了。現在在我們的防禦中只有一些缺口，這些地方將會用重兵防守，直到我們的軌道防禦系統完成為止。
en_text: Yes, your Eminence, it is nearly complete. There are only a few gaps remaining in our perimeter defenses, and they are heavily guarded until our orbital defense system is fully operational.

tc_text: 太好了。還有你建造的這座阿卡火砲—依我的瞭解，它真是令人感到驚訝。
en_text: Excellent. And this Ar’Ka Cannon you have built – quite a marvel, as I understand it.

tc_text: 沒錯。從這顆月球上，我們可以對考拉瓦星系中的任何區域射擊。你想要親自察看一下嗎？
en_text: Indeed. From this moon, we can fire on any habitable territory in the Kaurava System. Do you wish to inspect it yourself?

tc_text: 它只會傷害先進的生命形式，而不會去損害到建築物和星球的生命。
en_text: It harms only advanced life forms, thus avoiding damage to structures and plant life.

tc_text: 這還真是令人欽佩。
那是甚麼？
周邊不曉得為什麼被破壞了，我必須注意這點。傑出的執政官，請你回到聯盟中樞站。
en_text: The perimeter has somehow been breached. I must attend to this. Please, your Excellence, return to the Coalition Center.

tc_text: 沒錯，那樣最好。
派出尋路者，鎖定破壞的源頭，確認不能讓他們進入，要所有的烈焰戰士和克魯特掠食者小隊注意。
en_text: Dispatch Pathfinders. Locate the source of the breach and see that they do not gain entrance and establish a foothold. Notify all Fire Warriors and Kroot Carnivore squads.

tc_text: 希望我們的防禦強大到可以阻擋他們。
en_text: Let us hope that our defenses are strong enough to hold them.

tc_text: 瞧，戈古茲大老闆？這裡有史來歐克最好，最強壯地方。
en_text: Ya see, Big Boss Gorgutz? Dis 'erez da strongest an' bestest Ork'old as ever 'eld a Ork.

tc_text: 這樣，然後？
沒人進去過—沒有！洛克可羅山包我們，只有一地方進來。
en_text: Ain’t no ‘umies got in ‘ere – eva! . Wif da Rokclaw Mountins all ‘round us, deyz only one way in.

tc_text: 就算他們進來，他們要對我們。喔，有坦克，有歐克老大，他們會一團亂。
en_text: Even if they wuz ta get in, they’d have all da boyz to face. Oh, an’ da Nobz. An’ da tanks – den dere’s da Squigoffs.

tc_text: 他們打不過的。
當我們給他們轟炸，我們會搞他們稀爛。
en_text: Datz when we git ‘em wit da Fighta-Bommaz. We’d squash ‘em to a pulp!

tc_text: 哼。
我們要日夜看，除了歐克不可以有人靠近我們，我們要很快打倒他們。
en_text: We gots wochaz wochin’ day an night. Nobody but an Ork gets close to us wiffout we see ‘em and crush ‘em ta smivvereenz.

tc_text: 老大！老大！敵人在營地！
en_text: Boss! Boss! Deyz enemies in da camp!

tc_text: 啥？在營地？我們要阻止他們到致命點！打鼓—敲戰鼓！幹掉他們！
en_text: Wot? In da camp? We gotta stop ‘em afore dey getz to da Killy Spot! Da drums – beat da drums! Get 'em!!!

tc_text: 甚麼致命點？
敲戰鼓！
我們要守好致命點！
en_text: We gotz ta hold da Killy Spot!

tc_text: 哼！歐克最好的，嗯？
每件事都很好，然後？
是的，長官。
弟兄們如何？
還過得去，長官。
士氣呢？
在中心還不錯，前線的就很差了。
en_text: Good at Central, poor on the front.

tc_text: 傷亡呢？
一樣，長官。
射擊部隊呢？
今天有20個部隊，有12個部隊值勤的狀況不佳。
en_text: Twenty today. Twelve for cowardice in the line of duty.

tc_text: 毀滅之劍重型戰車的生產呢？
坦克的組員、彈藥和部件都依進度到達了，長官。如你所知的，只有最佳和高度訓練的組員可以正確的操作—
en_text: Tank crew, munitions and parts are arriving by convoy on schedule, sir. As you know it takes only the most highly trained crew to properly operate a –

tc_text: 我知道。
很好，將軍。
我們手上掌握有多少數量？
en_text: How many do we have on hand?

tc_text: 長官，很不幸的有一百輛毀滅之劍的運送剛剛出了問題—
en_text: Unfortunately, sir, a shipment of one hundred Baneblades had just gone out to serve–

tc_text: 我知道了。
看看這個。
這裡曾是一座很美好的城市，四周包圍閃爍著皇帝的光芒—工業的中心地。現在再看看它。
en_text: Once this was a fine city. Gleaming beacon of the Emperor’s light – a center of industry. Now look at it.

tc_text: 政戰官，我希望見到這座城市再度被建造起來，我希望見到閃爍著白色光芒的高塔，我很希望看到我們的弟兄在其中行軍，而不是去觀光而已。我希望見每個在這個愚蠢又不幸的星系中的城市，以皇帝之名來為帝國的工業服務。
en_text: Commissar, I would like to see this city built up again. I would like to see towers and spires of gleaming white. I would like to see our men on parade routes, not tours of duty. I would like to see every city in this planet, every colony in this besotted, miserable system turned to the service and industry of the Imperium, in the Emperor’s name.

tc_text: 以皇帝之名，長官。
為了實現我的願望，首先我們必須把這個星系中的外星人、異教徒、怪物和狂熱份子給清除掉。
en_text: But to see my dreams fulfilled, first we must wipe the system clean of these blasted xenos and heretics and monsters, and... and zealots.

tc_text: 為了達成那個目的，這座基地，我們的指揮中心，必須保護它不受危險和任何的騷擾。
en_text: And to do that, this base, our center of command, must operate free of danger or harassment.

tc_text: 我們的軍隊準備好了，包括了我們的坦克、我們的士兵。而以皇帝的意志，我們也有了毀滅之劍重型戰車。告訴我，政戰官—我們準備好了嗎？還是我們像羔羊一樣等著被人屠殺呢？
en_text: Our troops are ready. Our tanks, our sentinels, and if the Emperor wills it, we will have functioning Baneblades. Tell me, Commissar – are we prepared? Or will we be lambs taken to slaughter?

tc_text: 史塔伯斯將軍，沒有甚麼可以害怕的。我們的機器主教正準備建造一座先進的石化蜥蜴級火砲，擁有改良過的射程和火力。它—它確定可以在敵人有任何行動前先摧毀他們。
en_text: Well! We will do what we can - and pray for victory. The enhanced Basilisk cannon has been prepared by our Techpriest Enginseers, has it not? It can be fired at will?

tc_text: 它—它現在只需要一個火砲陣地。我們—我們應該要對神聖皇帝擁有信仰。
en_text: It only requires an artillery spotter. We shall place our faith in the God-Emperor.

tc_text: 那是一定的。如同以往，我們總是滿懷著對皇帝的信仰。
en_text: That will have to do the job. As always, we place faith in the Emperor.

tc_text: 波里爾指揮官—敵人的勢力進入了我們的範圍中。
en_text: Commander Boreale – enemy forces in our perimeter.

tc_text: 在哪裡？
南方的象限，但他們持續在移動中。目前的位置不明。
en_text: Southern quadrant, but they were on the move. Current location unknown.

tc_text: 已經沒有時間可以損失了。戰鬥弟兄們！
en_text: There is no time to be lost. Battle Brothers!

tc_text: 星際戰士—今天敵人就在我們的門口。
en_text: Space Marines – today the enemy is at our door.

tc_text: 我們知道我們的責任，我們會完成它。我們為了血鴉跟星際戰士的榮譽而戰…我們以皇帝之名而戰！
en_text: We know our duty, and we will do it. We fight for our honor as Blood Ravens, as Space Marines … and we fight in the name of the Emperor!

tc_text: <spirited troop rally shout>
如果我們在這個日子死了，我們將死於榮譽。我們像英雄般的死亡...但我們是不會死的，不！嚐到死亡和戰敗滋味的人將會是敵人。如你所知...
en_text: And if we die this day, we die in glory. We die heroes’ deaths … but we shall not die. No! It is the enemy who will taste death and defeat. As you know…

tc_text: 大部分的戰鬥兄弟都已經待命，準備深入打擊。
en_text: Most of our Battle Brothers are stationed in space, prepared to deep strike.

tc_text: 我們的邊界已經準備好面對大膽又愚笨的敵人。我們已經安置好了許多信標，來防禦同時間的、多重的和破壞性的深入攻擊。
en_text: Our perimeter has been prepared in the event that our enemies should be so bold and so foolish. We have placed numerous beacons, allowing for multiple, simultaneous, and devastating defensive deep strikes.

tc_text: 《阿斯塔特聖典》為此戰術命名為「鐵雨」。我們將會從敵人頭上睥睨而降，淹沒他們……我們將寸草不留。於此同時，我們的地面部隊則會確保總部的全面防禦。
en_text: The Codex Astartes names this maneuver Steel Rain. We will descend upon the foe, we will overwhelm them … we will leave none alive. Meanwhile, our ground forces will ensure the full defense of our headquarters.

tc_text: 我們是星際戰士！我們是皇帝的怒火！
en_text: We are the Space Marines! We are the Emperor’s fury!

tc_text: <cheer>
那麼，他們來了。
醒來…我把能量給你。喝下它…然後醒來。
en_text: Awake… I give you energy. Drink of it… and awake.

tc_text: 他們將走向絕路，他們將會加入死亡的部隊。
en_text: They shall meet their ends. They shall join the army of death.

tc_text: 他們靠近了，我們準備好了嗎？
是的，先知，但—
是的？
我們一定要作戰嗎？
我們將會作戰，他們絕對不會察覺到的。
en_text: We shall fight. They must never suspect.

tc_text: 他們將會來臨，明顯的、單純的、無疑的。他們將帶著混亂的心靈和不安的心衝向黑暗。同時，我們將會突然出現在每一個方位，然後每個人都做出命運的一擊。
en_text: They shall come, expecting the obvious, the simple, the artless. They shall stab at the shadows with confused minds and troubled hearts. Meanwhile, we shall appear unseen from ten directions, and from every one strike a fatal blow.

tc_text: 你知道伊索‧艾坦尼，也是被年輕種族稱為上廢棄地這地方的歷史嗎？
en_text: Do you know the history of this place, which we call Essel ir-Talith and the young races call the Upper Wastes?

tc_text: 在過去，我們神靈族在這裡建立了我們的戰鬥營地。
en_text: We the Eldar made our war camp here, in a past age?

tc_text: 是的，沒有錯。當我們的先祖以壓倒之勢橫掃世界時，來到這裡與死靈族作戰。這個星系是他們的一個毀滅舞台，一個不死族的製造廠。我們的先祖曾在這裡擊敗過他們。
en_text: Yes, that is so. Our ancestors came here to fight the Necrons when they were an overwhelming wave that swept the worlds. This system was one of their stages of destruction, their foundries of undeath. Our ancestors defeated them here.

tc_text: 我們建立了一個我們的軍事行動中心就在此處的假象。無論任何強猛的大軍，單憑軍力強攻絕對無法，而且永遠無法揭開其中奧秘。
en_text: We constructed our war operations center here as an illusion. No brute army, no simple display of force could uncover its secrets, and none ever shall.

tc_text: 不，這不只是幻象而已，我們先祖所製造的這個幻象還是一個聰明的陷阱。它就像獵人所安置的陷阱，吸引著野獸上門自投羅網，唯有在當它自己被捕捉、被陷入時，才會懇求獵人的憐憫。
en_text: No, it is more than an illusion. It is a clever trap, this place our ancestors forged. It is a net covered in leaves that the savage beast willingly stands on, tempted by a bloody morsel– only to find itself hoisted, trapped, at the hunter’s mercy.

tc_text: 不，我們該保衛著我們的秘密，沒有任何部隊可以攻擊一個找不到的地方。我們不該讓出我們在這個世界上的立足之處，考拉瓦曾經屬於我們，我們應該再將它給奪回來。
en_text: No, we shall guard our secret. No force can strike a target it cannot find. We shall not yield up our foothold on this world. Kaurava was once ours, and shall be ours again.

tc_text: 我們在很久、很久之前來到這個地方。
en_text: We came here long, long ago.

tc_text: 我們跟我們不死的敵人—死靈族作戰，也曾經勝利過。然而這一天…在這一天，我們失敗了。如果他們又像蝗蟲般的再生，其他人必定得阻擋他們。
en_text: We did battle with our deathless foes, the Necrons, and won. This day… this day we have lost. If they swarm again like locusts here, some other must stop them.

tc_text: 我們該離開了。
我戰鬥都是為了...我所有的工作！毀滅！毀滅！所有的好人都在這個詛咒中付出了他們的生命，這個枯萎的星系…
en_text: All I’ve fought for… all my work! Crushed! Crushed! All the good men who gave their lives for this cursed, this blasted system…

tc_text: 雖然我的軍隊在今日毀滅了…但我還沒停止作戰。我將會記得我的敵人是誰…
en_text: Though my army lies in ruins today… I have not done fighting. And I will remember who my enemies are….

tc_text: 他們來了！
他們來了！！！
他們來了。
是的，我們察覺到了，他們接近了。
en_text: Yes, we feel them. They approach.

tc_text: 他們來了。
他們的血將流過我的腳旁。
en_text: Their blood shall flow at our feet.

tc_text: 以血祀奉血腥之神！
他們將感受到我們的利刃穿過他們的身體攪動，他們將嚐到從未嘗受過的痛苦。他們將感受到恐懼的滋味，如同降臨在他們血肉之軀上的顫動。
en_text: They shall writhe with our blades in their gut. They shall know pain as they have never before. They shall taste fear like a chill upon their flesh.

tc_text: 我們將會滿足我們的飢渴。
是的，我們將用死亡、混沌跟恐懼來餵飽我們的飢渴，沒錯！
en_text: Yes, we shall slake our thirsts for death, for Chaos, for terror. Yes!

tc_text: 以血祀奉血腥之神！
他們接近了，讓他們過來吧。
en_text: They draw near. Let them come.

tc_text: 真實的大地將會毒害你，當你背向時惡魔將會從異變中出現。我們將會從不同的方為攻擊你，而你將會因死亡和恐懼而哭泣。
en_text: The very ground will poison you. Daemons will appear from the Warp when your back is turned. We shall lash out from every direction and yours shall be the cries of death and horror.

tc_text: 你的毀滅之聲將會縈繞在你的頭顱中、在你的靈魂中...你將因而顫抖，而你的鮮血將會奉祀給血腥之神。
en_text: The sound of your doom will ring in your skull, in your soul… you shall tremble. And your blood shall be a gift to the Blood God.

tc_text: 讓他們過來，我們準備好了。
en_text: Let them come. We are ready.

tc_text: 不！不！我們不能輸…我們不能死…我們怎麼可以？！
en_text: No! No! We cannot lose… we cannot die… how can we?!

tc_text: 沒有我們的奉獻。
沒有我們的犧牲？
渾沌的恐怖花蕾將會枯萎，將會逝去！
en_text: The horrid blossom of Chaos will wither, will die!

tc_text: 這個世界…正從我們的掌握中…溜走…
en_text: This world… is slipping… from our grasp…

tc_text: 安羅伊！尊貴的乙太導師！喔，我們失去你了—我們已經失去了所有的東西！
en_text: Aun’Ro’Yr! Noble Ethereal! Oh, we have lost you – we have lost all!

tc_text: 我的老歐克！我美麗的老歐克！
歐伊夫受夠了！
來吧孩子，我們要離開這！
我們失敗了…
…皇帝…
很好，她來了。
修女們—皇帝的活聖人，聖人阿耐絲，異教徒的天譴。
en_text: Sisters – the Living Holy Saint of the Emperor, Saint Anais, Scourge of Heretics.

tc_text: 現在，以皇帝之名！
en_text: Now, in the name of the Emperor!

tc_text: 很好。
那邊，它完成了。
願皇帝的祝福帶領我們走向勝利，修女們。
en_text: May the Emperor’s blessing carry us on to victory, Sisters.

tc_text: 我們感謝你，光榮的烈士。
那麼。
這是真的，這些神聖的神殿將會賜予我們…無畏的力量？
en_text: It is true then, these blessed shrines will confer… invincibility?

tc_text: 的確，每一座神殿都是艾克黎西亞奇真實和神聖的遺跡。現在這些建築已經被活聖人給祝福過了，它們被她所賜予神聖的氣息籠罩著，並且被偉大的喬艾克黎西亞的納西亞‧弗里斯所統治著。
en_text: Indeed. Within each shrine lies a true and sacred relic of the Ecclesiarchy. Now that the edifices have been blessed by a Living Saint, they confer upon her the Inviolable Aura, as scribed and fervently mastered by the great Ecclesiarch, Jonasiah Vuonis.

tc_text: 那麼不管她去甚麼地方，沒有任何傷害會降臨在我們身上？
en_text: And wherever she goes, no harm may befall us?

tc_text: 精確的說，不是我們的人，也不是我們的東西。
en_text: Precisely. Neither our persons nor our belongings.

tc_text: 一隻純淨而明亮的蠟燭，矗立在污穢和黑暗之中。
en_text: One pure, bright candle, amidst a sea of filth and darkness.

tc_text: 說的好，大修女。這是一個腐敗的星系，它或許已經無可救藥了。
en_text: That is well said, Canoness. This is a tainted system. It may, in fact, be irredeemable.

tc_text: 那麼我們就該用火來淨化它。在對皇帝的讚頌中，我還沒有發現任何沒有信念的餘燼。
en_text: Then we shall purge it with fire. I have yet to find a cinder that was not faithful in its praise of the Emperor.

tc_text: 所有都準備好了嗎？
是的，女士。
很好，這些即將被征服的人將會嚐到我們信念之火的滋味。皇帝將會藉由我們來懲罰他們。
en_text: Good. These would-be conquerors shall have a taste of our fire and faith. The Emperor will punish them through us.

tc_text: 修女們，我們將如烈士般的行動，我們必須在烈焰中行動！
en_text: Sisters, we must go as martyrs. WE must go in flames!

tc_text: 在烈焰之中！
哈哈！我們是來自戰鬥中的血肉，我們灑下了熱血。死亡、恐懼和痛苦的歌聲在我們耳邊甜美的吟唱。
en_text: Ha ha! We are fresh from the fight. We have shed blood. Death, terror, and anguish sang sweetly in our ears.

tc_text: 啊，但是塔里爾執政官，你有得到獎勵嗎？
en_text: Ah, but Lord Tahril, have you taken prizes?

tc_text: 你膽敢懷疑我？我們抓了許多俘虜，將他們進貢到卡莫拉，也留下許多在我們的奴隸室和你的折磨地中。
en_text: Do you doubt me, Gruemenael? Many prisoners were taken. We have our tribute to Commorragh, and many left over for our Slave Chambers and your torture grounds.

tc_text: 過來，執政官，來到我的折磨地。
en_text: Come, Archon, come to my torture grounds.

tc_text: 我們勝利，我們失敗，勝利和失敗—但總是豐盛的，豐盛的帶著奴隸和戰利品。
en_text: We win, we lose, win and lose – but always richer, richer with slaves and spoils.

tc_text: 的確！在回到卡莫拉時，我們該受到敬重—還有得到獎賞。
en_text: Indeed! We shall be well respected – and rewarded – when we return to Commorragh.

tc_text: 當我們歸來，如果我們可以歸來！從勝利中歸來…或是從失敗呢？
en_text: When we return. If we return! Return the victors… or return the vanquished?

tc_text: 我的土地，在那邊尖叫是花朵，痛苦是芬芳。我們有一個很棒很棒的窩，高掛在峭壁之上。很難被看得見，很難到達那個地方。
en_text: My grounds. Where screams are flowers, and pain their fragrance. A fine, fine nest we have. High upon the cliff. Hard to see, harder still to reach!

tc_text: <cries in pain and fury>
有任何人可以到達這個巢穴嗎？他們會奪走我的花園嗎？
en_text: Will any reach this nest? Will they take away my garden?

tc_text: 執政官：哈哈！
你在質疑我的領導權力嗎？我必定的勝利？我是致命的陰影和猛禽，我是致命的淬毒之匕。
en_text: Are you questioning my right to lead? My inevitable victory? I am the deadly shadow and the bird of prey. I am the poisoned dagger that brings swift death!

tc_text: <groans like a soldier, bearing the pain of torture>
en_text: <groans like a soldier, bearing the pain of torture>

tc_text: 這些粗魯又愚蠢的軍隊根本不懂得戰術。如果他們看到一堵牆，他們攻擊。如果看到軍隊，他們就索戰。他們如果四處注意這些事情，而忽略了我們。如果真的是這樣，那麼就太遲了。
en_text: These crude and foolish armies know nothing of strategy. If they see a wall they attack it. If they see an army, they charge at it. They will be too busy with each other to notice us, or if they do, it will be too late.

tc_text: 不必擔心。不會有事的——我們會緊密監視。若有敵人接近，我們必定能看到，然後再將之殲滅殆盡！
en_text: Worry not. And it is of no matter – we keep a keen watch. If an army approached, surely we would see it coming. Then – we would tear it to pieces!

tc_text: 塔里爾，你這個笨蛋！我會為了這個砍下你的頭！
en_text: Tahril, you fool! I will have your head for this!

tc_text: 快點，回到卡莫拉！
好吧！如果他得死，我就會取代他的位置！現在，我得先逃開。
en_text: Well! If he had died, I should have taken his place! Now, I must flee.

tc_text: 我們新的基地防禦系統是用相同的技術建造而成的，同樣都是由這裡所控制。
en_text: Our new base defense system is built using the same technology. Both are controlled from this location.

tc_text: 次元風暴突然的出現在考拉瓦星系的外圍，首先引起了帝國的注意—當然還有其他的勢力。
en_text: It was the sudden appearance of a Warp Storm at the Kaurava System’s outer edge that first caught the attention of the Imperium – and not just the Imperium.

tc_text: 在帝國防衛軍數百年來散漫的監看之後。
en_text: After hundreds of years under the neglectful watch of the Imperial Guard,

tc_text: 幾乎每一個在銀河系中的勢力都湧向了考拉瓦星系，企圖奪得控制和勝利。
en_text: nearly every force in the galaxy would descend upon the planets of Kaurava, bent only on domination and victory.

tc_text: 有三個種族長久的在那邊發展：而帝國防衛軍，則是該地被認定的統治者；
en_text: Three races had long dwelled in there: the Imperial Guard, its supposed rulers.

tc_text: 但是在考拉瓦二號的歐克蠻族，從來就沒有被帝國防衛軍給征服過；
en_text: the Ork tribes of Kaurava II, which the Guard had never successfully put down.

tc_text: 還有死靈族，他們在考拉瓦三號之下，安穩的沈睡了數千年。
en_text: and the Necron, who had slept undisturbed for untold millennia beneath Kaurava III.

tc_text: 沒有人可以說出渾沌星際戰士是從哪裡來，以及如何出現的。是不是次元風暴顯露的他們的蹤跡...或是他們帶來了次元風暴？
en_text: Where the Chaos Space Marines came from, or how, none can say. Did the Warp Storm bring them… or did they bring the Warp Storm?

tc_text: 他們都在一眨眼之間就出現在考拉瓦四號上。
en_text: Both appeared suddenly on Kaurava IV and in an eye-blink

tc_text: 一半的帝國部隊都消失了—不管是被殺害，或是被瘋狂的渾沌奪去了生命。
en_text: half the system’s Imperial forces were gone – killed or claimed by the madness of Chaos.

tc_text: 這裡原本是美好的帝國城市跟青翠的牧地，卻變成了佈滿了混沌的荒野，這個星球的轉變非常快速又殘酷。
en_text: The transformation of the planet from one of fine imperial cities and pasture-lands into the thick wilds of Chaos was almost as fast and as brutal.

tc_text: 一個接著一個的，其他種族也快速的進入了考拉瓦星系。帝國的超級士兵，星際戰士，就出現在考拉瓦二號之上，計畫要清除掉星系中煩人的歐克蠻族，和他們的人類敵人—渾沌星際戰士。
en_text: In quick succession, the others flocked to Kaurava. The Space Marines, the Imperium’s super-soldiers, descended on Kaurava II, planning to finally cleanse the system both of the troublesome Orks and the Chaos Space Marines, their sworn mortal enemies.

tc_text: 接著出現的是鈦星人，就在不遠的上方，位於行星的其中一個月球之上。
en_text: The Tau appeared next, not far above, on one of the planet’s moons.

tc_text: 為了保護自己的帝國不受愚蠢人類的影響，並且被擾亂了秩序，於是鈦星人試圖控制次元風暴，也藉此來擴張他們領域的版圖。
en_text: In the interests of protecting its ordered Empire from the effects of human folly, the Tau came seeking to contain the Warp Storm and, in so doing, expand their territory’s border.

tc_text: 在他們的月球上，他們建立了一座強大的堡壘，並且設置了一座太空火砲，可以進行行星間的毀滅攻擊。
en_text: On their moon they built a mighty fortress, and there forged a space cannon capable of interplanetary devastation.

tc_text: 在荒蕪的考拉瓦三號之中，死靈族或許是被次元風暴破壞性的力量所喚醒，然後慢慢群聚起他們的致命軍團。
en_text: Among the wastes of Kaurava III, the Necrons, perhaps awakened by the disruptive forces of the Warp Storm, slowly massed their lethal legions.

tc_text: 很快的，長久未被使用的魍道關口重新顯現，而神靈族聚眾前進，準備跟他們黑暗、死亡的敵人交手。
en_text: In quick response, Webway Gates, long unused, flickered to life, and Eldar poured forth, ready to battle their dark, death-dealing adversaries.

tc_text: 同時，在古老通道的陰影中，暗黑神靈族偷偷的潛行出陰鬱深長的魍道。
en_text: Meanwhile, in the shadow of an ancient portal gate, the Dark Eldar slipped stealthily out of the murky depths of the Webway.

tc_text: 這些瘋狂的掠奪者跟虐待者，神靈族殘忍的表親，正在考拉瓦四號的月球上建築他們的巢穴。
en_text: There, on the moon of Kaurava IV, these twisted pillagers and torturers, cruel cousins to the Eldar, built their nest.

tc_text: 他們就像食屍鳥，飛行在戰場的上方—等到戰鬥趨於平靜時，就將戰場變成了宴客廳。
en_text: They would be like carrion birds, flying above the battlefield – and, when all were weary from the fight, make the battlefield into a feasting ground.

tc_text: 最後來到這個地方，或許也是最令人畏懼的，就是戰鬥修女—神聖之女和神聖皇帝信念的奉行者。
en_text: Last to arrive, and perhaps most to be feared, were the Sisters of Battle, holy maidens and bearers of the God-Emperor’s faith.

tc_text: 她們來到這個星系清除腐化和髒污，她們的信仰讓她們執著—毫不畏懼死亡和忠誠於她們的目標。這裡幾乎沒有乾淨的地方，所有的一切都需要被淨化。
en_text: They had come to cleanse this system of corruption and filth. Their faith left them fanatical – unafraid of death and zealous in their cause. Nothing here was clean. All must be purged.

tc_text: 考拉瓦星系是很獨特的，據說這些世界是來自於古老世紀的神靈族，遠在他們分裂之前，遠在他們的移居之前。
en_text: The Kaurava System itself is unique. It is rumored that these worlds hale from a prior age of the Eldar race, before their schism, before their exodus.

tc_text: 四個地球型態的星球，六個古老的通道都是在那個時間留下的。
en_text: Four terraformed planets, and seven Ancient Gates are all that remain of that time.

tc_text: 有另一個謠傳說—這或許不是那邊第一場偉大的戰役，或者是最偉大的一場，但誰知道呢？只有勝利者才能書寫他們的歷史，也只有勝利者才能擁有考拉瓦的星球。
en_text: Now, war rages anew, and only the victorious may write their history. Only the victorious will claim the planets of Kaurava.

tc_text: 我們的軌道防禦系統是用相同的技術建造而成的，同樣都是由這裡所控制。
en_text: Our orbital defenses were built using the same technology. Both are controlled from this location.

tc_text: 衰弱並死去吧！
在戰爭頭目戈古茲夢幻的領導之下，歐克蠻族在考拉瓦星系的四個星球都得到了無與倫比的勝利。世世代代的考拉瓦歐克蠻人都夢想過這樣的一天—但從未想過他們不僅可以擊敗帝國防衛軍，還有其他的七個部隊來完成他們的目標。
en_text: Under the visionary leadership of Warboss Gorgutz, the Orks achieved a complete and unrivalled victory over all four planets of the Kaurava System. Generations of Kauravan Orks had dreamed of such a day – never imagining that they would not only overthrow the Imperial Guard, but seven other armies to achieve their aim.

tc_text: 所有的考拉瓦很快的就四處充滿了歐克蠻人。隨著歐克蠻族的到來，開始了一陣搶奪和洗劫的活動，所有的氏族都同時宣稱了自己的主權。沒有了戈古茲的警戒之眼，所有的這一切終將隨著混亂和氏族間的征戰而結束。
en_text: All Kaurava was soon overrun and teeming with Orks. A phase of wild looting and pillaging was followed by Ork settlement, wherein clans laid claim to entire territories at a time. Without the watchful eye of Gorgutz, however, all this would have ended in confusion and petty clan warfare.

tc_text: 戈古茲有另一個偉大的計畫，考拉瓦的四個星球都將成為這個計畫的目標。礦區可以開挖出有價值的金屬，而歐克蠻人工廠會生產出征戰銀河系所需要的任何東西。從這麼棒的平台和迅速的補給，還有善戰的歐克蠻族，從這樣的環境所組成的吼～軍團怎不會得到偉大的勝利和榮耀呢？他們為他們偉大的領袖—戰爭首領戈古茲而歡呼，他是考拉瓦之王。
en_text: Gorgutz had other, greater plans. The four planets of Kaurava were to be turned to this purpose. Mines yielded valuable metals and fields of Orkish factories produced everything required for a proper campaign of galactic conquest – a Great Waaagh! staged from such an excellent platform and supplied with such resilient, war-worthy Orks. How could such a Waaagh! result in anything but great victories and greater glory? They hailed their mighty leader, Warboss Gorgutz, Lord a’ all Ko-Ruvva.

tc_text: 第252考拉瓦守護者軍團明確的證明了他們統治的權力。文斯‧史塔伯斯將軍組織並改革了這支長久被區域指揮部忽視的部隊。同時，他的事業也在擔任小型星系的軍事總督後，無法再有所提昇了。
en_text: The 252nd Kauravan Conservator Regiment proved their right to rule in no uncertain terms. General Vance Stubbs ability to organize and reform this long-neglected army did not go unnoticed by the Segmentum top brass. His career could not fail to rise, in time, beyond the role of Governor-General to a small star system.

tc_text: 不管怎樣，當時刻到來之時，史塔伯斯讓他自己忙碌著，並且重建了他引以為傲的軍團。令人感謝的，次元風暴自己消失，考拉瓦四號又適合居住重建了。唯有考拉瓦三號感受不到建築、採礦和整地的喧鬧。這個星球留下了大片的荒蕪之地，誰能說在這一片沙地之下有甚麼東西在沈睡著呢？
en_text: For the time being, however, Stubbs busied himself and his proud regiment in post-war reconstruction. Thankfully, the Warp Storm vanished of its own accord. Kaurava IV was suitable for re-settlement. Only Kaurava III did not feel the commotion of construction, mining, and terraforming. This planet was left largely barren. Who could say what else slept beneath those sands?

tc_text: 在最後，星系變成了自豪的帝國中心，著名的衛隊學院生產出優秀的步兵，僅略於卡舍津的部隊。考拉瓦變成了人類的驕傲，好戰並且獻身於皇帝。在這些日子，很難想像曾經有過一場血淋淋的戰爭，而異教徒跟渾沌市立曾經涉足過這個地方。
en_text: In time, the system became a proud Imperial hub, and famed Guard academies turned out superior infantry, second only to Kasr itself. Kaurava became home to proud human populations, warlike and devoted to the Emperor. In these times, it would be hard to imagine that a bloody war had been fought, or that heresy and Chaos had ever been there.

tc_text: 在抵達了考拉瓦星系後，告解者崔格農‧馬奇曾經跟阿格娜大修女說過，如果這個地方是如此的腐敗他也不會感到訝異，而所有的一切都需要被投入火炬之中。回想起來，這些話就像預言一樣，每到任何地方，戰鬥修女都只看到了軟弱、邪惡和憎恨。
en_text: On arriving in the Kaurava System, Confessor Treganum March had remarked to Canoness Selena Agna that he would not be surprised if the place were so corrupt, that it all must be put to the torch. In retrospect, these words seemed prophetic. Everywhere they looked, the Sisters of Battle found only weakness, heresy, and abomination.

tc_text: 從第四個行星開始，渾沌幾乎吞噬了整個星系。而隨著產生的次元風暴在這股勢力被擊敗之後，也很快的就消失了。看來在這樣的局勢之中，幾乎沒有任何星際戰士或是帝國防衛軍可以避開腐化。儘管這是一個悲劇，但是還是得進行實地調查、和淨化他們每一個人。
en_text: Chaos had nearly devoured the entire system, beginning with the fourth planet. Added to this was the Warp Storm, which had vanished shortly after their defeat. It hardly seemed likely that any Imperial Guard or Space Marines could have avoided corruption in such circumstances. Although tragic, it was necessary to perform a field-inquisition and purge every one of them.

tc_text: 當戰鬥修女完成了她們的淨化工作，星系就名正言順的歸於她們的指揮之下。她們在考拉瓦衝突偉大勝利中，獲得了六座偉大的艾克黎西亞奇的城市，每一個城市都獻身於戰鬥修女會的統治。有許多信徒跨越星系前往朝聖，也有許多的修女們聚集在那些地方進行禱告和準備，在神聖考拉瓦碉堡之中。
en_text: When the Sisters of Battle had finished their cleansing, the star system was officially dedicated to their Order. Relics of their great victories during the Kaurava Conflict were placed in the founding of six great Ecclesiarchal Cities, each devoted to one of the Orders Militant of the Sisterhood. Pilgrims journeyed from across the galaxy to these retreats, and many millions of Sisters gathered there, for prayer and preparation, in the bastion of Holy Kaurava.

tc_text: 一點都不令人訝異的，只有血鴉可以渡過這樣艱難的戰鬥，並且獲得勝利，這點在考拉瓦衝突就獲得了證實。在部隊指揮官英德里克‧波里爾適切的指揮之下，血鴉第九軍團顯示了他們的完美之處。但不幸的，為了執行命令，他們被迫與帝國防衛軍和修女會對抗，因此，發生了戰爭。
en_text: It was no surprise that only the likes of the Blood Ravens should prevail in a battle so hard-fought and entrenched as the Kaurava Conflict had proved. Under the capable guidance of Force Commander Indrick Boreale, the Ravens 9th Company had acquitted themselves faultlessly. It was unfortunate that, in following their orders, they had been compelled to neutralize the armies of the Imperial Guard and Sisterhood. But such was war.

tc_text: 無疑的對血鴉來說，他們最佳的時刻就是獲得跟渾沌勢力作戰的勝利。對星際戰士來說，與那些狡猾的褻瀆者作戰、並且擊敗他們，是最榮耀的一件事了。而在血鴉獲得勝利的那些日子中，次元風暴神秘的消失了，就像它當初出現的方式一樣。
en_text: Without doubt the finest hour the Blood Ravens had known was their triumph over the vile forces of Chaos. A Space Marine can aspire to no greater honor than fighting, and defeating, those treacherous blasphemers. Within days of the Blood Ravens victory, the Warp Storm had vanished as mysteriously as it had come.

tc_text: 戰爭勝利之後，在孤寂之地發現了一個新的修道院堡壘。他們給了那個地方一個新的名稱：波里倫。同時，新的帝國防衛軍部隊被派遣到考拉瓦星系，來組成一個更新、更有規律的行星防衛勢力。艾克黎西亞奇派遣了牧師和智庫館長跟著軍團，作為預防危險邪教的額外措施。
en_text: After the war was won, a new Fortress-Monastery was founded in the Lands of Solitude. That territory was given a new name: Borealum. Meanwhile, fresh Imperial Guard troops were brought to the Kaurava System, to constitute a new and better regulated Planetary Defense Force.

tc_text: 擊敗了八個強大的軍隊，是歐耶斯卡指揮官的"強大力量、強大打擊"戰術的最佳展示。雖然他的理論在以前曾經被人懷疑過，但他的上司現在則討論著他的戰術的功績，並且將其納入鈦星人的交戰守則之中。
en_text: Defeating eight powerful armies was a potent demonstration of the “Great Strength, Great Strike” tactics which Commander Or’es’Ka espoused. Although his theories had been met with skepticism before, his superiors now debated the merits of such strategies, and ways to incorporate them into standard Tau warfare.

tc_text: 隨著考拉瓦衝突的結束，歐耶斯卡指揮官第一步小心的動作，是提昇了楠‧亞諾以堡壘的防禦能力。同時，傳說是令鈦星人進入考拉瓦星系的次元風暴，也沈靜的消逝無蹤了。
en_text: With the Kaurava Conflict definitively settled, Commander Or’es’Ka’s first cautious step was to complete and upgrade the defenses of the Nan Yanoi stronghold. Meanwhile the Warp Storm, which was the purported reason the Tau had entered the Kaurava System, silently folded in upon itself and vanished.

tc_text: 雖著次元風暴的消失，鈦星部隊開始清除他們前往考拉瓦的道路，一個龐大的殖民計畫因此開始。在更大良善降臨之後，歐耶斯卡指揮官並沒有留在星系中，取而代之的，是乙太導師安羅伊接掌了領導權，帶領著變成了茁壯的鈦星氏族往考拉瓦的道路邁進。
en_text: With the Warp Storm gone, the Tau fleets began to make their way to Kaurava untroubled, and a massive colonization project then began. Commander Or’es’Ka was not to stay in the system, which had found peace in the Greater Good. Instead, the Ethereal Aun’ro’Yr assumed leadership, guiding the way towards Kaurava becoming a full-fledged Sept of the Tau Empire.

tc_text: 在血腥的試煉之後，只剩下了神靈族的部隊。死靈族被驅回到考拉瓦三號的深處，而所有那些曾經干擾、掠奪、蔓延在銀河中的渾沌勢力也消失了。先知卡里絲完成了她的任務—她帶領著她的子民通過了未來的分歧路，向著最佳的結局前進。
en_text: At the end of the bloody contest, only the Eldar army remained standing. The Necron had been returned to the depths of Kaurava III, and all those who would meddle, pillage, or spread Chaos throughout the galaxy were gone. Farseer Caerys had succeeded in her task – she had led her people among the branching roads of the future, to the best possible of ends.

tc_text: 烏斯維神靈族在那時清除了考拉瓦星系中的星球，毀滅所有戰爭的遺留物，像是機械和士兵。所有的東西都被毀滅，只有帝國防衛軍的部隊在這次的戰敗中倖存了下來。這些存活的防衛軍在最後終於與區域指揮部聯絡上，但是當新的帝國防衛軍部隊抵達時，卻沒有發現任何勝利者的蹤跡，看不出這裡到底曾經發生了甚麼事情。
en_text: The Ulthwé Eldar then scoured the planets of the Kaurava System, destroying all vestiges of the war, machine and soldier alike. All, that is, except for those Imperial Guard troops who had somehow survived the defeat. These surviving Guardsmen eventually contacted Segmentum Command. When fresh Imperial forces arrived, no trace of the victors could be found. What had taken place could not be explained.

tc_text: 這時在偉大的艾克黎西亞奇的監看之下，新的帝國軍團成立了，並且開始重新建設。但很不幸的，所有在第三星球上的殖民工作，都遭遇了難以理解的災難。在最後，因為無法解決這個窘困的遭遇，新的軍事總督便輕易的放棄了這個星球。他爾而會收到奇怪的報告，傳說有纖細、行動快速、看起來像是異型的生物出現，然後又迅速的消逝在人們的眼前。
en_text: A new Imperial regiment was instituted, this time under greater Ecclesiarchal surveillance, and rebuilding began. Strangely however, all efforts to colonize the third planet met with inexplicable disaster. Eventually, embarrassed and unable to explain, the new Governor-General simply abandoned the planet. Occasionally, he would receive strange reports – of slender, swift-moving figures and alien-looking arches, which would appear and then vanish again, without a trace.

tc_text: 在另一個時代，死靈族曾經在考拉瓦星系中掀起了一場龐大的戰役，但同時也失敗了。在數千年之後他們再度甦醒，然後發現在身邊圍繞著了陌生又麻煩的軍隊。這次從混亂中復生的神靈族，趁著優勢絕不會再步上失敗的命運。
en_text: Once, in another age, the Necrons had fought a great war in the Kaurava Sytem, and lost. Awakened again so many millennia later, they found new, strange, and terrible armies around them. This time, however, profiting from the confusion of the living, they would not be denied victory.

tc_text: 死靈族所侍奉的暗黑眾神憎恨生命。他們穿越考拉瓦星系的每個星球，被征服的地方都變成了荒蕪之地，而死亡的士兵則毀滅了所有的生命。在他們的奴役之下，古老的眾神在力量與權力的滋潤之下逐漸成長。
en_text: The dark gods that the Necrons served hated life. Everywhere across the conquered planets of the Kaurava System, the defeated everywhere were taken up and transformed into the listless, lifeless footsoldiers who would one day finally blot out all life, everywhere. Through their servitude, the ancient gods grew in strength and power.

tc_text: 很快的，星球上就充滿了暗黑的死靈大軍。當其他人繼續遠征之途時，巨大的墓船停留守衛著。在所有的行動之中，他們的敵人都屈服在混亂和恐懼之下，而這完全不令人意外。任何考拉瓦死靈族所到之處，他們的神明—偉大的詐騙者，都會將烏雲籠罩在敵人的心中。
en_text: Soon the planets teemed with the dark forms of the Necron army. Great Tomb Ships stood guard, while others launched on excursions of conquest. In all doings, their enemies succumbed quickly in confusion and terror. This was no accident. Where the Kauravan Necrons went, their god, the Great Deceiver, ever clouded the minds of their foes.

tc_text: 曾經有一位單純的士兵，他並不曉得自己擁有潛在的通靈能力。在沒有經過訓練之下，渾沌之神在他耳邊低語，而他卻無法保護自己—這讓他陷入了瘋狂狀態。他們讓他執行一些計畫，一些黑色儀式，來產生了一個存在於時間和空間中的恐怖裂口，讓渾沌從裂口中傾洩而出。阿爾發軍團出現了，次元風暴從裂口中迸出，而眾神則為他們的作為得到了榮耀。
en_text: Once there was a simple soldier, who was ignorant that he possessed latent abilities as a psyker. Without training, he could not guard himself, and the gods of Chaos whispered to him – driving him feverishly mad. They made him carry out certain plans, perform certain black rites, so that a terrible rift in space and time was forged. Chaos poured out. The Alpha Legion appeared, and the Warp Storm blossomed from the rift. The gods gloried in their deed.

tc_text: 在渾沌大君弗里維斯‧卡倫的領導之下，阿爾發軍團四處的征服、殺戮和擴張。即使是他們的宿敵—帝國星際戰士，也無法對抗他們的狂怒。九支軍隊在考拉瓦星系相互的競爭，但混沌則證明了他們比所有人都還要強大。
en_text: Led by Chaos Lord Firaeveus Carron, the Alpha Legion spread, slaughtered, and conquered. No force, not even their mortal enemies, the Imperial Space Marines, could withstand their wrath. Nine armies vied for the Kaurava System, and Chaos proved mightiest of them all.

tc_text: 考拉瓦的四個行星現在充斥著奇特又扭曲的渾沌勢力。惡魔漫行於世，而次元風暴則日漸擴張成長。阿爾發軍團在卡倫大君的領導之下，已經準備好要面對他們最古老也最憎恨的敵人—帝國的部隊。
en_text: The four Kauravan planets now teem with the strange and twisted forms of Chaos. Daemons walk openly and a Warp Storm grows in size and strength. The Alpha Legion, under Lord Carron, make ready for a far greater war against their oldest and most hated of enemies: the Imperium of Man.

tc_text: 當最後也最重要的威脅被除掉之後，暗黑神靈族現在可以自由的在考拉瓦星系中穿梭行動，掠奪並摧毀他們所看到的東西。黑心卡柏用他們的飛船遮蔽了天空，像是一群可怕的蝗蟲一般，穿越了一個又一個區域，掠奪著俘虜和戰利品。
en_text: With the last major threat removed, the Dark Eldar were now free to roam through the Kaurava System, pillaging and laying waste as they saw fit. Like gruesome locusts, the Black Heart Kabal darkened the skies with their vehicles, descending on territory after territory, laying claim to prisoners and other spoils.

tc_text: 這些快速又貪婪的飢餓者所採取的行動是非常可怕的。沒有任何東西可以躲過他們，也沒有任何東西可以逃離他們。暗黑神靈族敏銳的知覺像是要找出他們所有的獵物一般，再過不久，整個考拉瓦星系就會貧瘠到沒有任何生命的殘存。
en_text: The speed and ravening hunger with which these raids were carried out was remarkable. Nothing could escape them. Nothing could outrun them. The keen senses of the Dark Eldar seemed to pierce all cover in search of their prey. It was not long before all Kaurava was stripped bare and devoid of life.

tc_text: 回到拉肯尼之月上，牢籠中關滿了奴隸，同時也建造了更多的牢籠。塔里爾執政官跟他的主人，維克大君，相坐對飲著敵人的靈魂，而赫蒙丘魯斯刑罰師則對著他手下犧牲者格咯的歡笑著。當次元風暴寂靜的消逝後，暗黑神靈族也消失了，他們回到了魍道中狂歡，接著又開始搜尋另一個新的世界，來繼續進行他們掠奪和奴役的行動。
en_text: Back on the moon of Lacunae, cages grew full of captives and more cages were built. Archon Tahril and his master, Lord Vect, sat and supped goblets filled with the souls of their enemies. The Haemonculus Gruemenael cackled gleefully over his victims. As the Warp Storm quietly disappeared, so too did the Dark Eldar vanish, returned to the Webway to revel, then go in search of new, fresh worlds to pillage and enslave.

tc_text: 現在！…發射！
<takes a bullet and dies>
站開。
現在，我的修女們。以皇帝之名！
en_text: Now, my Sisters. In the Emperor's name!

tc_text: <evil laughter. he's just done something terribly clever>
en_text: <evil laughter. he's just done something terribly clever>

tc_text: <savage shout of multiple warriors>
神靈族的堡壘就在我們的前方，在他們發現任何動靜之前，讓我們先發動攻擊。
en_text: The Eldar stronghold lies directly below us. Let us strike, before they suspect anything.

tc_text: 神靈族的總部就在我們的正前方。兄弟們，動作快，把所有會動的東西都把它幹掉。
en_text: The Eldar headquarters, directly below us. Move quickly men. Leave nothing standing, or moving.

tc_text: 來吧，修女，神靈族的堡壘就在那邊。我們將以皇帝之名解放這片土地，並且用聖火來淨化它。
en_text: Come, Sisters. Down there is the Eldar stronghold. We will purge it with fire, and claim this land in the Emperor’s name.

tc_text: 他們在那裡！那邊！把他們殺光！燒掉他們的基地！插上混沌的旗幟！
en_text: There they are! There! Go kill them all! Burn their base! Plant the flag of Chaos!

tc_text: 看著那邊，我們虛偽表親的堡壘，那群懦夫！讓我們用致命又寂靜的速度行動，將那群笨蛋從這個世界中除掉。
en_text: There, we gaze upon it. The stronghold of our false kin. The cowards! Let us move with deadly speed and silence, and blot out these fools from off this world.

tc_text: 看那邊小畜生，那邊，尖耳朵的大城堡。我們毀掉它，我們把它趕出考拉瓦。把該死的槍砲準備，因為我們要戰鬥，這是我們要作的。
en_text: Look ‘ere, ya zoggin’ runts. Down dere, dat’s da pointy-ear big fort. We blast that, we blast ‘em all offa Ko-ruvva. So get dem blastas and shootas ready, cuz we gots some fightin’ to do, is wot we’ve got.

tc_text: 烈焰戰士，我們就在在神靈族中央指揮部的前方，我們被命令要毀掉目標。如果我們帶著榮譽和技巧戰鬥，勝利必將屬於我們。
en_text: Fire Warriors, we stand before the Eldar central command. We are commanded to decimate the target. If we fight with skill and honor, victory will be ours.

tc_text: 我們遠古的…敵人…在那邊…摧毀他們…
en_text: Our old … foes … are there … destroy them…

tc_text: 現在！
你對神靈族的瞭解真少。你已經踏入了我們的陷阱，別想活著離開。
en_text: How little you understand the Eldar. You have stepped into our snare. Do not expect to escape it alive.

tc_text: 你想要來硬的？這對帝國防衛軍來說不是問題！
en_text: You want to do this the hard way? That is acceptable to the Imperial Guard!

tc_text: 想躲就躲吧，神靈族，我們會過來找你們的。
en_text: Hide all you want, Eldar, we will come and find you.

tc_text: 以皇帝的怒火…你們將會為這些虛偽付出代價…
en_text: By the Emperor’s wrath… you will pay for these feeble deceits…

tc_text: 甚麼？甚麼！奸計—陷阱！啊…你們會付出代價的，蠢蛋！你們會用鮮血付出代價的！
en_text: What? What! Tricked – deceived! Arrrrrgh…. You’ll pay, fools! You will pay, in blood!

tc_text: 喝！能跑就跑吧，卡里絲，我現在生氣了。我的速度比你快，當我抓到你時，會慢慢的讓你品嚐死亡的滋味…
en_text: Gah! Run while you can, Caerys. I am angry now. I am faster than you, and when I catch you, your death will be slow… and exquisite.

tc_text: 啊！他們去哪？回來戰鬥，你們這些小賊！
en_text: Aaaaugh! Where’d dey go? Come back ‘an fight, ya squiggs!

tc_text: 我們錯估了神靈族的先進戰術，我們又被愚弄了。
en_text: We have failed to anticipate the advanced Eldar tactics. We must not be fooled again.

tc_text: 找到…他們…
戰場上需要更多的遊俠和次元蜘蛛。把話傳到他們的基地營去，快點搞定。
en_text: More Warp Spiders and Rangers are needed on the field. Send word to their base-camp, and have it down immediately.

tc_text: 為什麼天上沒有更多的夜翼？需要我提醒你，現在是在戰爭嗎？快點把所有的攔截機都給派出來。
en_text: Why are there not more Nightwings in the air? Need I remind you, we are at war? Deploy all interceptors immediately.

tc_text: 甚麼？另一個堡壘？希望這是最後一個了。現在我們要怎樣過去那邊？
en_text: What, another stronghold? Let’s hope this is the last. Now just how’re we going to get over there?

tc_text: 好吧、好吧，又有另一座基地了。到處都是煙霧彈！我們也會去攻擊那邊的。
en_text: Well, well. There is another base. Smoke and mirrors! We will strike you over there, too.

tc_text: 甚麼？又發現另一座指揮中心，天啊！這些該死的傢伙真令人生氣。
en_text: What? Yet another central command discovered. Ah! These wretched xenos are infuriating.

tc_text: 更多的堡壘？那就全都幹掉！笨蛋，沒有任何東西可以阻擋我們，我們可是渾沌大軍！他們躲不過我們的…你，找出過去那邊的方法。
en_text: More strongholds? More to destroy! Fools, no stones or walls can hold us back. We are Chaos! You cannot hide from us…You, find out how to get in there.

tc_text: 那麼，又有一個隱藏的總部了。我懦弱的表親，這就是你的老詭計嗎？你以為這樣可以阻擋我們多久？
en_text: So, another hidden headquarters. Up to your old tricks, my cowardly kin? And you think that will stop us for long?

tc_text: 啥？這個不是真的基地？哼！當我到那邊，我要—我們先把孩子們派去那邊，哼？
en_text: Wot? Dat’s not da real base, neiver? Wwwwwwuh! When I get’s over dere, Ise gonna – first we gotta get all da boyz in dere, huh?

tc_text: 瞧，歐耶斯卡指揮官，那邊又有一座隱藏的堡壘。我們將會努力找出通往這個地點的路徑。
en_text: Look, Commander Or’es’Ka, there is another, concealed stronghold. We will strive to discover a path to this location.

tc_text: 找出…往那裡…的路徑...
史塔伯斯將軍，我悶偵測到奇特的能源訊號。長官，我們該瞧瞧看嗎？
en_text: General Stubbs, strange energy signatures have been detected. Sir, should we look into it?

tc_text: 波里爾指揮官，我們偵測到附近有不尋常的能源型式。我們要等待命令調查嗎？
en_text: Commander Boreale, we have detected unusual energy patterns nearby. We await orders to investigate?

tc_text: 嗯…看來在戰場上的數個區域有不明的能源型式，或許我們該過去看看這些…
en_text: Hmm… it seems there is an unknown type of energy being emitted from several locations in the field of battle. Perhaps it would be best if we shed some light on these…

tc_text: 恐怖和恐懼的大君！我們—我們發現了—在那邊有奇特的能源！我們不知道那是甚麼，它們來自於—地圖上的一些地…地方！
en_text: Most terrible and feared lord! We have – we have found – there are strange energies! We don’t know them. They come from – from just a few p-p-p-places on the map!

tc_text: 大人—我們發現了能源型式，有可能是我們奸詐表親的特別發電機所發出來的。我們已經算出來好幾個來源地。
en_text: Archon – we have detected energy sources which can be nothing, if not special field generators, employed by our devious cousins. We have scried several points of origin.

tc_text: 那是啥？能源甚麼，在我的面前閃啊閃？那可是更多尖耳朵的詭計。能源點，那是…
en_text: Wot’s dis? Ennigy wotzits, blinkerin’ right ‘ere under me nose? More pointy-eared tricks, is wot dat is! Ennigy spots, is it…

tc_text: 指揮官，我們的感應器偵測到奇異的能源型式，它們發現了多重的來源，就在這附近。
en_text: Our sensors have identified strange energy patterns of an unknown form, Commander. They have been detected at multiple sources, nearby.

tc_text: …我…感應到…隱藏的…能量…
先知，他們已經摧毀了其中一座幻象障礙設施。
en_text: Farseer, they have disabled one of the illusion barrier devices.

tc_text: 他們摧毀了所有的幻象障礙！這應該不可能被通過的！我們的機會不多了—我們必須戰鬥！我們必須勝利。
en_text: They have disabled all the illusion barriers! This never should have come to pass! We have few chances left – we must fight! We must prevail.

tc_text: 幹掉那些砲塔！嗯…一定有甚麼方法可以毀掉它們。
en_text: Blast those turrets! Hmm…must be some way to shut them down.

tc_text: 如果必要的話，我們會讓部隊直接穿越所有的這些砲塔，但要小心點，兄弟！如果有別條路，我們會試試的。
en_text: We will force our way right past all those turrets if we have to, but look sharp, brothers. If there is some other way, we will take it.

tc_text: 皇帝重擊這些砲塔！穿過這個死亡之谷是我們唯一的選擇嗎？
en_text: Emperor smite these turrets! Is our only choice to travel this valley of death?

tc_text: 砲塔！該死的砲塔！讓它們停下來！讓它們停下來，不然我沒辦法用神靈族的骷顱來裝飾我的王座！
en_text: Turrets! Cursed turrets! Make them stop! Make them stop, I will never have my throne of Eldar skulls!

tc_text: 你瞧，他們在路上裝設了這些支援平台，來為我們準備一場愚蠢的行進。不管怎樣…應該還會有其他的通路...
en_text: You see, they have prepared a fools promenade for us, with these Support Platforms lining the way. However… there may be another way…

tc_text: 太好了，都是該死的砲？我們不會通過這個該死地方！我們該怎麼辦？
en_text: Grakey, wot’s all dem shooty bits? We ain’t gunna march right through all a dem! Wot we gunna do?

tc_text: 烈焰戰士！我們的敵人都採取迂迴作戰，利用這些砲塔來對付入侵者。所以，我們也要盡可能的使用間接對付的方式。
en_text: Fire Warriors! Our enemy fights not directly, but by devious means, with this array of turrets prepared for intruders. So we must endeavor to be indirect, as well.

tc_text: 當心…砲塔…
先知！他們摧毀了支援平台陣列！入口已經沒有保護了。
en_text: Farseer! They have disabled the Support Platform Array! The entrance is no longer protected.

tc_text: 是的，我看到了。先別絕望，我的姊妹，他們還沒看到我們更厲害的地方。
en_text: Yes, I have seen this. Do not yet despair, my sister. They have not foreseen our every move.

tc_text: 他們就在我們前方，先知！時間到了嗎？
en_text: They are upon us, Farseer! Is it time?

tc_text: 快了，不過還沒。
現在！快一點—到安全地！
該死！他們現在在哪裡？我猜我們又要發現他們的另一座幻象障礙了，是嗎？
en_text: Damn them! Where are they now? I suppose we’ll have to find another one of those barrier shield generators, won’t we?

tc_text: 不見了？又一次？兄弟們，好好的搜尋這個區域中的那些障礙設施。
en_text: Gone? Again? Brothers, scour the area for another of those barrier devices.

tc_text: 這是甚麼瘋狂的事？他們以為可以永遠的逃掉嗎？他們以為皇帝的淨化光芒不會發現他們的污穢之心嗎？修女們，把更多的障礙設施給找出來。
en_text: What madness is this? Do they think they can run forever? Do they think that the purging light of the Emperor will not find and pierce their mortal hearts? Sisters, look for more of these barrier field devices.

tc_text: 不見？不見？不見了？！把他們給找出來！找出來把他們給毀掉！別站在吶！去！！！
en_text: Gone? Gone? Gone?!? Find them! Find them and break their bones! Don’t just stand there! Go!!!

tc_text: 這些詭計真是令人厭煩，一定有甚麼方法可以到達這個新區域。把另一個障礙裝置給找出來，別耽擱了！
en_text: These petty tricks grow wearisome. There must be a way to reach this new area. Seek another field generator. And do not tarry!

tc_text: 好吧，這些尖耳朵躲著歐克夠多了，我說要給他們瞧瞧吼～軍團的厲害。準備好孩子們，找方法去那邊，我們要把他們殺光！
en_text: Awwwright. Dese ‘ere pointy-ears done enough a dis ‘ere zappin’ ‘round and hidin’ from da Orks. I say it’s time ta show ‘em Waaagh! Ork-style. Ready up boyz, find da way in dere, and we’ll blast ‘em all ta zog!

tc_text: 他們又躲過了，但我們會耐心的獵殺，勝利會是我們的。烈焰戰士，我們得找出通往他們地點的通路。
en_text: They have eluded us again, but we will hunt patiently, and the quarry will be ours. Fire Warriors, we must search for a way in to their new location.

tc_text: 我們跟著…那邊…沒有人…可以逃掉…
en_text: We follow… there is … no … escape …

tc_text: 你想擊敗我們？你根本不知道要怎樣找到我們，等你找到，你早就死了。
en_text: You think to defeat us? You do not even know where to look for us. And you will be dead long before you do.

tc_text: 當你們放棄時我們將會發動攻擊。你們會試著還擊，但卻是徒勞的—我們早就不見了。
en_text: We will strike when you do not expect us. You will try to strike back, but in vain – we will not be there.

tc_text: 強固信心，戰士們，我們將會勝利的。
en_text: Be strong of heart, warriors. We shall prevail.

tc_text: 如果我們死去，那們神靈族最後的立足之處將不存在於這個古老的世界。
en_text: If we perish, so does our last Eldar foothold on this ancient world.

tc_text: 將軍，他們接近了。
哼！讓他們接近吧。我們的毀滅之劍甚麼時候會好？
en_text: Hmph! Let them. When will we have our Baneblades?

tc_text: 組員和軍備都已經隨著護衛隊到達了。在它可以運作之前，還需要…幾次的護送，長官。
en_text: Crew and munitions are arriving by convoy. It… it will be several convoys before we have one operational, sir.

tc_text: 那麼我們就先讓他們忙著吧。
en_text: So we just have to keep them busy until then.

tc_text: 毀滅之劍護衛隊派出並且上路了。
en_text: Baneblade convoy dispatched and en route.

tc_text: 將軍，第一批護衛隊的運送已經抵達了。
en_text: General, the first convoy shipment has arrived.

tc_text: 很好，我們可以準備派遣毀滅之劍了嗎？
en_text: Good. Are we ready to dispatch a Baneblade?

tc_text: 這是第55突擊連隊在西區報告，準備出發。
en_text: This is the 55th Assault Company, ready to roll, reporting from the Western Annex.

tc_text: 第17輕武裝營，報到。
en_text: 17th Light Armored Battalion, reporting for duty.

tc_text: 夏昆砲兵小隊，中區，報到。
en_text: Shakun Artillery Squad, Central Annex, reporting for duty.

tc_text: 你們的命令是部署直接對抗敵人，進行。
en_text: Your orders are to deploy directly against the enemy. Proceed.

tc_text: 將軍，第94重裝連，北區，準備戰鬥。
en_text: General, the 94th Heavy Armored Company, Northern Annex, is combat-ready.

tc_text: 告訴他們開始行動，把那些混蛋打入地獄。
en_text: Tell them to get moving, and give those bastards hell.

tc_text: 將軍，石化蜥蜴級自走炮準備行動，它現在可以射擊任何指定的座標。
en_text: The Basilisk Magnus is cleared for action, General. It can now fire at any acquired coordinates.

tc_text: 我們的觀測員呢？
待命中，長官。
派他們上場！以皇帝之名，我們沒有時間可以浪費了！
en_text: Get them on the field! In the Emperor’s name, we don’t have time to lose!

tc_text: 我們發現了一個觀測員，長官。這是他們可以射擊火砲的方法—利用滲透的觀測員。
en_text: We have uncloaked a spotter, Sir. This is how they are firing their artillery – with infiltrated spotters.

tc_text: 我們發現了一個砲兵觀測員，看來他們就是利用觀測員來瞄準他們的火砲。
en_text: An infiltrated spotter has been discovered. It seems they are using these spotters to aim their artillery fire.

tc_text: 一個小賊？一個小賊！一個人模人樣的鼠輩！很好！很好—讓我們切掉牠的尾巴，然後將這個沒尾巴又痛哭流涕的鼠輩奉面給我們的眾神！
en_text: A sneak? A sneak! With a mortar shell tied to his tail! Well! Well – we’ll cut it off. And feed the tailless sniveling little rat to our gods!

tc_text: 先知，我們發現了一個隱藏的斥候，他一定是導引他們火砲射擊的觀測員。
en_text: Farseer, a cloaked scout has been intercepted. No doubt, he was acting a spotter to direct their artillery fire.

tc_text: 哈哈！這是甚麼？他們派了隱藏的斥候來導引火砲向我們射擊，不是嗎？我們得阻止他們。
en_text: Haha! What have we here? Thought they could slip a cloaked scout in and aim their artillery on us, did they? We’ll put a stop to that.

tc_text: 甚麼？為什麼有躲起來的人，混進來讓我們被你們的大砲炸？哈哈。
en_text: Wot’s dis? Why it’s a hidy-humie, tryin’ to sneak in and get us all blowed up. Thought you could send yer big gunz our way, eh? Har har.

tc_text: 指揮官，有一個隱藏的觀測員被發現了，我們相信他負責導引那些對我們射擊的火砲，我們得要當心預防這些觀測員。
en_text: Commander, a cloaked spotter has been uncovered. We believe he was directing the aim of their giant artillery. We should take measures to prevent such spotters.

tc_text: 我看到…你…小小的觀測員。別把…你的砲火…瞄著我…
en_text: I see… you… little spotter. Do not… aim… your guns… at me…

tc_text: 鎖定目標，準備完畢後開火。
en_text: Locked on target. Fire when ready.

tc_text: 鎖定目標。
目標鎖定。
準備完畢後開火。
砲兵，備便後開火。
他們抓到我了。射擊！現在就射擊！
en_text: They’ve caught me. Fire! Fire now!

tc_text: 我被抓住了！射擊！
他們逮到我了。快點…開火！
射擊…現在。
進入警戒等級一。
進入警戒等級二。
進入警戒等級三。
進入警戒等級四。
該死！我們在那條路上失去太多的護衛隊了，派他們走另一條路。
en_text: Dammit! We’ve lost too many convoys that way. Send them on another route.

tc_text: 將軍，派出護衛隊的工研總部被敵人奪下了。
en_text: General, the Mechanized Command that the convoys were being dispatched from has been taken out.

tc_text: 好吧，那麼就用另外一個。動作快一點！
en_text: Well, use a different one, then. And quickly!

tc_text: 不，長官，還需要更多的護衛隊。
en_text: No, Sir. Several more convoys will be required.

tc_text: 好吧—
長官，已經沒有工研總部了，不再有任何的護衛隊了。
en_text: Sir, there are no more Mechanized Commands. There will be no more convoys.

tc_text: 黃金王座現在保衛著我們…
我們被攻擊了！快，部署好哨兵機械人！
en_text: We’re under attack! Quick, man the Sentinels!

tc_text: 那是我們最後的哨兵機械人了。快，再製造多一點！把你們的武器上膛，弟兄，為了帝國！
en_text: That’s our last Sentinel. Build more. Quickly! Load your lasguns, men! For the Imperium!

tc_text: 他們來了，讓這些噴火獸級裝甲車發動起來，用雙倍的數量！
en_text: Here they come. Get those Chimera up and running. On the double!

tc_text: 這些噴火獸級裝甲車真是沒用！先把它們停下來，直到我們可以製造更多出來。
en_text: These Chimera are useless! Hold them off until we can build more of them!

tc_text: 第94重武裝連！到你們的戰車上去！
en_text: 94th Heavy Armored Company! To your tanks!

tc_text: 我們的戰車！至死方休，弟兄！為了帝國，為了榮耀！
en_text: Our tanks! To the death, men! For the Imperium, and for glory!

tc_text: 啊，他們正準備走向滅亡。
en_text: Ah, they are preparing to march to their doom.

tc_text: 我正想把這些叛徒的頭給砍下來。
en_text: I’m looking forward to hacking the heads of these traitors from their useless bodies.

tc_text: 眼睛放利點，弟兄。看來在我們前方有一場艱難的城市戰了。
en_text: Look sharp, men. Looks like we have some tough, urban warfare ahead of us.

tc_text: 弟兄們，懦夫叛徒就在這座城市中，做好所有的準備。
en_text: The traitors cower within this city, Brothers. Be ever ready.

tc_text: 當心點，我的修女們，這些異教人渣可能就躲在牆或是碎石瓦礫的後方。
en_text: Be wary, my Sisters. These heretical scum may creep behind every piece of wall or rubble.

tc_text: 張大眼睛，我的親人。在這個城市的邊緣，不知道會有甚麼東西在等著我們。
en_text: Be keen of eyes, my kin. Within the confines of this city, we know not what lurks in wait.

tc_text: 這裡曾是人類的城市。呸！難道我曾經掠奪殺戮過這裡。
en_text: This was once a human city. Faugh! Would that I had burnt and pillaged here.

tc_text: 那邊是甚麼，城市，是吧？喝！太多地方可以藏，像老鼠洞一樣。
en_text: Wot’s ‘ere, a city, is it? Bah! Too many spots for ‘em ta hide like snivellin’ grots!

tc_text: 我們必須小心移動，我們的敵人可能會在這些廢墟中設陷阱或是伏擊。
en_text: We must move with caution, for our enemy could easily have traps and ambushes planted among such ruins.

tc_text: 那邊…曾有…死亡…
這座城市曾是我們的。我們在這個瘋狂當中，曾經失去過幾百萬人呢？
en_text: This city was ours. How many millions did we lose, to this – to this madness?

tc_text: 我等待這個復仇的時刻已經很久了。
en_text: Long have I waited for this moment of vengeance.

tc_text: 當我行進在敵人的朝穴時，支持我，皇帝。
en_text: Support me, Emperor, for I tread in the lair of our enemy.

tc_text: 在很久之前的夢中，我曾經見過這些濺血的街道。
en_text: Long I have seen these bloodstained streets in dream.

tc_text: 當我的刀刃劃過時，這些野蠻的蠢蛋將會發出動聽的慘叫聲。
en_text: These barbaric fools will scream just as sweetly, when I run my blade through them.

tc_text: 沒有任何軍隊可以阻擋獵頭者戈古茲，這裡是歐克的世界，這裡將是我的世界！
en_text: Ain’t no soddin’ ‘umies gonna stop ‘Eadhunter Gorgutz. Dis’ll be a Ork world. Dis’ll be my world!

tc_text: 我們不能被我們瘋狂的敵人嚇倒。
en_text: We must not be daunted by the madness of our enemy.

tc_text: 我們…帶來死亡…到…瘋狂…
他們正在射擊我的地獄爪。再製造多一點！你有沒有聽到我說的！
en_text: They are shooting down my Hell Talons. Build more! Do you hear me!

tc_text: 毀掉了！我們需要更多，再製造更多！派它們出去--派它們來對抗膽敢攻擊我們的蠢蛋。
en_text: Defilers! We need more. Make more! Send them – send them against the fools who would dare attack us.

tc_text: 你認為一座神殿就可以削弱我的力量？不！我仍然很強壯！在這裡次元是強壯的！它是我們的力量，也是你的虛弱之處，你必須死！
en_text: You think one shrine will sap my strength? No! I am strong! For here the Warp is strong! It is our power, and your weakness, and you shall DIE!

tc_text: 重擊，他們，恐虐！重擊他們，我的神！他們奪走了我們為你製造的神殿！你怎麼可以允許他們呢？我們—我們會成為你的第一擊，我們會撕裂他們的喉嚨。是的！是的！我們將會這麼做！
en_text: Smite, them, Khorne! Smite them, my god! They are taking away the shrines we made for you! How can you let them? We – we will be your fist, and we shall take them by the throat. Yes! Yes! We will!

tc_text: 另一座？另一座神殿…淪陷了？在我們作了那麼多…在那麼多的犧牲之後？
en_text: Another? Another shrine… fallen? After all our work… after all those sacrifices?

tc_text: 你會付出代價的！為了破壞我的神殿而付出！瞧，面紗已被掀起！看看我所擁有的軍隊！你們激起了我的怒火，我們要讓你血濺四方！
en_text: You will pay! Pay for tearing down my shrines! The veil is lifted, see! See the army I have! You have earned our wrath. We will spill your blood!

tc_text: 你今天就會死！
那邊！那個雕像就是我們之後的模樣。看看渾沌的漣漪是如何的穿越它？當惡魔從那裡跳出來時可別被嚇壞了。
en_text: There! That statue is what we are after. See how Chaos ripples across it? Don’t be surprised when daemons jump out of it.

tc_text: 那裡有一座他們的神殿。當心—它已經沈淪腐敗了，會跳出惡魔來攻擊我們。
en_text: There is one of their shrines. Careful – it is corrupted, and can spew daemons at us.

tc_text: 那就是異教徒的神殿。當心它是個開口：惡魔可以從那邊進出。
en_text: That is the heretical shrine. Beware! It is an opening: daemons may enter there.

tc_text: 神殿就在那邊。你看到的，我的親人，看它如何的在渾沌中閃爍？恐虐的奴僕可以透過它來進入我們的世界。
en_text: There is the shrine. Can you see, my kin, how it flickers with Chaos? The minions of Khorne may enter our world through it.

tc_text: 瞧，一座他們的神殿，他們的恐怖隊伍可以透過它來進出。
en_text: See, that is one of their shrines. Their horror squads will enter through it.

tc_text: 看，孩子們，那是混沌神殿。如果你不想死，當心，它會突然跳出惡魔…
en_text: See boyz, dat dere is da Chaos shrine. If ya’s don’t wanna get dead, lookout. It’s got daemons in it as jump out an’ getcha…

tc_text: 當心這座渾沌神殿。每一座神殿就像個小型的風暴，而渾沌的生物可以透過它現身。
en_text: Behold this shrine of Chaos. Each shrine is as a small storm, and the creatures of Chaos may issue from it.

tc_text: 神殿…惡魔…將會…從裡面…出現…
en_text: The shrine … daemons … will come … from … there…

tc_text: 伏擊！
這是陷阱！
當心，修女們。伏擊！
我們被伏擊了。
甚麼？為我們設下陷阱？
en_text: What? Lay a trap for us?

tc_text: 靠！他們哪裡出現？
我們被帶到陷阱中了！
en_text: We have been led into a trap!

tc_text: 陷阱…
嚐嚐渾沌的全部力量！嚐嚐我的法術，準備求饒吧！
en_text: Taste the full power of Chaos! Taste my magics, and beg for mercy!

tc_text: 他們正在攻擊神殿，阻止他們！
en_text: They’re attacking the shrine. Stop them!

tc_text: 他們在遺址！上來—我們攻擊！
en_text: They’re at the Relic! Get on board – we attack!

tc_text: 就是現在！就是這個時間！現在是我們在主人血神恐虐的眼中，爭取榮譽和榮耀的時刻了！
en_text: Now is the moment! Now is the hour! Now is the time we earn honor and glory in the eyes of the blood god, Khorne, who is our master!

tc_text: 我們為渾沌而戰！
殺光敵人！殺！
武裝好你自己，我的修女們，對決的時間就要到了。
en_text: Steel yourselves, my Sisters. The time of battle draws near.

tc_text: 我們的信仰是偉大的。我的孩子們，我們該組成十字軍，來對抗皇帝的敵人。跟著我，聚集並且武裝起來，我將會帶領你們走向勝利…或是光榮的犧牲。
en_text: Our faith is great. My children, we shall make a crusade against the enemies of the Emperor. Where I go, do ye gather, and take up arms, for I shall lead you to victory… or glorious martyrdom.

tc_text: 異教徒！殺死幾個傳教士並不會動搖我們的信仰，或是阻止我們的聖戰！
en_text: Infidels! Dispatching a few missionaries will not staunch our faith, or halt our crusade!

tc_text: 他們攻擊我們的修道院。很好！我們並不缺乏信仰，並且正準備作戰！
en_text: They strike at our Convents. Well! We are not yet short of the Faithful, and ready for battle!

tc_text: 皇帝，成為我們神聖戰車的導引和護盾吧！
en_text: Emperor, be the guide and shield of our sacred tanks!

tc_text: 我們的信仰再度的增強。面對聖戰，將死亡帶給敵人！
en_text: Our faith is once again strong. To the crusade, and death to the enemy!

tc_text: 不值一顧的笨蛋！你無法傷害這個神聖的地方！
en_text: Unworthy fools! You shall not harm this holy place!

tc_text: 深入打擊小隊，準備部署。弟兄們，自由攻擊。
en_text: Deep strike squads, prepare for deployment. Brothers, strike at will.

tc_text: 歡呼突擊小隊—攻擊！
長官，我們損失了一個深入打擊信標。
en_text: We have lost one of the deep strike beacons, sir.

tc_text: 嗯，我們失去了。
長官，每失去一個信標，就會降低我們在該地區的打擊能力。
en_text: Sir, every beacon we lose reduces our ability to strike on the field.

tc_text: 你以為我會在乎失去一兩個信標嗎？這可是戰爭，戰爭啊！我們需要的是在戰場上有足夠的戰鬥兄弟，任敵人可以被我們摧毀在腳下。這個才重要，星際戰士。
en_text: Do you think I care if we lose a beacon or two? This is war. War! All we need is enough Battle Brothers on the ground that we can crush them under our boot heels and destroy them with our bolters. That is what matters, Space Marine.

tc_text: 這個簡單，他們不會看到我們過來的。
en_text: This is gonna be easy. They won’t see us coming.

tc_text: 長官，我們失去了將近一半的深入打擊信標。
en_text: Sir, we have lost nearly half of our deep strike beacons.

tc_text: 該死，我們得狠一點來攻擊他們。這是指揮官波里爾的回覆…把你手上的單位都派出去，你聽見了沒有？
en_text: Damn. We have got to hit them harder. This is Commander Boreale to Relay… send us all the units you have. Do you hear?

tc_text: 知道了，指揮官。
你的殲滅者坦克不夠用嗎？
en_text: Not enough Predator Tanks for you?

tc_text: 一點也不。
濫用皇帝的恩賜，褻瀆者！
哈哈哈哈哈！
你害怕我們嗎，人類？
en_text: Do you hope to frighten us, humans?

tc_text: 一點也不。
哈哈！
我們準備好對付你的戰鬥車輛了，古拉。
en_text: We are prepared for your battle vehicles, Gue’la.

tc_text: 很好，我們會派更多的。
殲滅者坦克。嗯…如果我們找到他們的機器殿堂建築物，我們把它給除掉了。
en_text: Predator Tanks. Hmm… if we can find their Machine Cult building, we would do well to take it out of commission.

tc_text: 這些殲滅者坦克會成為威脅的，或許我們該把它們幹掉…從源頭開始。
en_text: It will not do to be flanked by these Predator tanks. Perhaps we should cut them off… at the source.

tc_text: 毀滅那些坦克！詛咒它們！把它們變成廢鐵。找到它們的生產地，毀掉它！
en_text: Blast the tanks! Curse them! Rot them with rust and metal maggots. Find their hatching ground, and set it on fire!

tc_text: 這些殲滅者坦克越來越令人心煩了，或許我們該毀掉他們的坦克工廠。
en_text: These Predator tanks grow wearisome. Perhaps it is worth our while to deprive them of their tank factories…

tc_text: 那是甚麼？坦克？誰能把這些東西從我們的路上移開，之後就可以得到第一個挑選奴隸的機會。
en_text: What is this? Tanks? Whoever can remove this nuisance from our path will have first pick of slaves, on the morrow.

tc_text: 歐伊夫以前見過人類的坦克。它們會是麻煩。我知道—我們要消滅製造它們的工廠。
en_text: Oi’ve seen dose humie tanks before. Nuffink but trouble, they is. I know wot – we oughta smash da Mek shops dose came from, is wot.

tc_text: 指揮官，在戰場上發現殲滅者坦克的蹤跡。我可以建議從源頭毀掉這些威脅嗎？
en_text: Commander, Predator class tanks have been sighted on the battlefield. May I recommend neutralizing these threats at the point of origin?

tc_text: 殲滅者坦克…從我的路上..滾開…不然…我會毀掉你們全部…
en_text: Predator tanks… stay… out of… my way… or… I will… destroy you all.

tc_text: 看來他們用犀牛裝甲運輸車來將士兵運送到戰場上。如果我們可以幹掉這些運輸車，就可以拖慢他們的速度。
en_text: Looks like they’re ferrying Marines into the field using those Rhino transports. If we could take out the transports, that would slow them down.

tc_text: 這些犀牛裝甲運輸車加快了他們行進的速度。如果我們可以找到生產它們的機器殿堂，就可以拖慢他們的速度。
en_text: Those Rhino transports are giving them the advantage of speed. If we could find the Machine Cult buildings producing them, it might slow them down.

tc_text: 瞧！犀牛！犀牛裝甲運輸車！我們的敵人躲在鐵盒子裡，懦夫！笨蛋！我們—我們得奪走他們的鐵盒子！
en_text: Look, Rhinos! Rhinos! Our enemies hide in metal boxes, the cowards! The fools! We – we should take away their metal boxes!

tc_text: 瞧，兄弟姊妹們—那些犀牛裝甲運輸車給了他們速度。如果我們毀掉它們的生產工廠，那們優勢就只屬於我們了，不是嗎？
en_text: See, sisters and brothers – those Rhino transports grant them the element of speed. If we were to destroy the vehicle bays that are producing them, then that advantage would be ours alone, would it not?

tc_text: 看看它們可憐的運輸車，不會飛，又沒有槍，它們不過是我們入侵者的模仿品罷了。不過…我們還是該毀掉它們的生產工廠，全都不放過。
en_text: Look at their pathetic transports, which cannot fly, which have no guns. They are weak mimics of our own Raiders. Still… we should tear their factories to pieces, all the same.

tc_text: 瞧瞧這些人類，躲在鐵盒子裡。哈哈！我們歐克會撬開鐵盒子，吃掉裡面的粉紅皮膚傢伙。孩子們，如果你們找到它們來的地方，擋下來你們聽見了沒？
en_text: Look at ‘dem humies, hidin’ in da steel boxes. Har har! We Orks’ll peel off da top and eat da pink-skins inside! Boyz, if youze finds where dey comin’ from, stomp ‘em ta bits. You hear?

tc_text: 你看見了嗎，烈焰戰士，他們如何用運輸車快速的將他們的人送到前線？如果我們奪下他們的運輸車工廠，我們就奪走了他們的速度和靈活性。
en_text: Do you see, Fire Warriors, how they use transports to quickly move their men to the front lines? If we take from them their transport factory, we take from them speed and agility.

tc_text: 摧毀…運輸車…工廠…
星際戰士…攻擊！
讓我們驕傲，弟兄們。
旋風坦克已經進入戰鬥！
en_text: Land Raider has entered the battle!

tc_text: 找出軌道轟炸，立刻去。
長官，他們就在我們的上方…那些—
en_text: Sir, they’re right on top of us… the collateral –

tc_text: 開火！我們是星際戰士！如果我們死了，我們的敵人也要死在我們的身旁！
en_text: Fire! We are Space Marines! If we are to die, our enemies will die beside us!

tc_text: <cheer>
史塔伯斯將軍，野戰司令部和機械主教已經完成部署，準備行動。
en_text: General Stubbs, Field Command and Techpriest have been deployed, and are ready for active duty.

tc_text: 部隊指揮官波里爾，我們顯在有了要塞和僕役，我們可以開始建造了。
en_text: Force Commander Boreale, we have a Stronghold and a Servitor. We can commence building.

tc_text: 大修女，禮拜堂和僕役已經抵達，任務可以開始進行。我想在這之前，是又長又艱難的。
en_text: Canoness, the Chapel and Servitor have arrived. The operation may commence. I suspect the road before is long and winding.

tc_text: 很好，現在我們有了要塞和異教徒，現在開始工作！
en_text: Good. We have our Stronghold and a heretic. Now get to work!

tc_text: 啊！我見到卡柏要塞被召喚了，我們必須快速的建造來保持攻擊。
en_text: Ah! I see the Kabal Fortress has been summoned. A slave, too. We shall build quickly and stay on the attack.

tc_text: 聽著孩子，我們現在有了安身地和小鬼頭，對吧？那就是說吼～軍團要行動了，那麼行動吧！！！
en_text: Lissen up, boyz. We gotz a settlement and some grots, right? Dat means its time for dis 'ere Waaagh! ta get goin’. So get goin’!!!

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官，我們的鈦總司令部和大地級建築艇已經抵達了，等候你的命令。
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka, our Cadre Headquarters and Earth Caste builders have arrived. We await your orders.

tc_text: 我的…浮石巨塔…聖甲蟲…已經...完成了...
en_text: My… Monolith… Scarabs… have come… good…

tc_text: 這些牢籠中有我們的人。讓我們將他們放出來，看看他們還可不可以戰鬥。那邊有一個牢籠就在我們的正前方，到那邊去。
en_text: Plenty of these cages have our men in them. Let’s bust some open and see if they aren’t still in condition to fight. There’s one cage just up ahead, over there.

tc_text: 弟兄們，大部分在這個象限中的囚犯都是血鴉。我們的第一任務是讓他們恢復自由，將他們武裝起來，然後繼續前進。第一座牢籠就在我們的正前方。
en_text: Men, most of the prisoners in this quadrant are Blood Ravens. Our first objective is to set them free, arm them, and push forward. The first cage is right ahead of us.

tc_text: 修女們，聽我說，這座俘虜營中關著我們許多的同伴。不管我們在那裡發現他們，就要前往解放他們。瞧？有一個牢籠就在附近的地方，這是一個訊號！
en_text: Sisters, harken to my words. This prisoner camp holds many of our comrades. We shall march forward and liberate them, wherever we find them bound. See? One cage lies nearly within reach. It is a sign!

tc_text: 他們抓走的我的人，將他們官在牢籠中，就像對待牲畜一樣！來吧！解放我們的同志！我們必須不斷的增加我們的數量，直到敵人臣服為止！在那邊就有一個牢籠，讓我們擊破它！
en_text: They have taken my men, and put them in cages, like pets! Come! Free our brethren! We shall grow our numbers until they cower before us! There’s a cage, right there. Break it!

tc_text: 我感應到這裡有許多我們的人，被人像動物一般的關著。這個折磨一定很痛苦，令人無法承受！讓我們打破牢籠來拯救他們，而還能戰鬥的人，就會在站在我們這一邊。有一個牢籠就在我們的正前方！
en_text: I sense the presence of many of our true kin here, caged like animals. Their suffering must be immense, unbearable! Let us smash the bars and free them. Those who can, shall fight by our side. One lies before us!

tc_text: 啊！我的孩子們被關在籠子裡，被那些間耳朵灰白臉的傢伙關起來！來吧，把籠子打破，就從那個開始，在那邊！
en_text: Rrrrrgh! Wots all me boyz in cages, when dey oughta be snappin’ da necks a’ dem pale-faced pointy-ears! Come on! Smash dem cages. Start wif dat one, right dere!

tc_text: 有許多鈦星帝國的戰士被野蠻的關了起來，就在這個區域。我們必須把他們找出來，並且解放這些俘虜。還有作戰能力的人，會加入我們的陣營中。第一個牢籠就在離這裡不遠的地方。
en_text: Many warriors of the Tau Empire are known to be caged, barbarously, in this area. We must seek and free these prisoners. Those that are able, shall fight by our sides. The first cage lies only at a short distance.

tc_text: 他們…把我們…關起來…但我們…要釋放…我們…從那邊…開始…
en_text: They… cage… us… but we... shall… free… us… Start… there…

tc_text: 歡迎歸隊，士兵們。
自由了，我知道血鴉戰士一定撐得住的。
en_text: Freed. I knew a Blood Raven would hold true.

tc_text: 來吧，修女們，你們自由了。
我已經解放了你們，現在是復仇的時刻了！
en_text: I have freed you. Now time for revenge!

tc_text: 我感受到你們的苦難，你們現在自由了。
en_text: I feel for your suffering. You are freed now.

tc_text: 來吧，孩子們！起來準備作戰！
en_text: Come on, boyz! Get up an’ get ready for fightin’!

tc_text: 你們自由了。來，我們必須去解放其他人。
en_text: You are liberated. Come, we must liberate the others.

tc_text: 自由…
麻煩，來了。我們可以對付他們的。
en_text: Trouble, incoming. We can deal with them.

tc_text: 看來我們被盯上了，兄弟們。
en_text: Looks like we have been spotted, men.

tc_text: 我們沒有躲開偵測，修女們。很好，那我們戰鬥吧。
en_text: We have not eluded detection, Sisters. Very well, we shall fight.

tc_text: 啊，讓暗黑神靈族血濺四方！
en_text: Ah, Dark Eldar blood to shed!

tc_text: 守衛發現我們了！準備戰鬥！
en_text: Guards have spotted us! Prepare for combat!

tc_text: 來作戰吧！
我們被發現了。勇敢的戰鬥吧，戰士們。
en_text: We have been sighted. Fight bravely, warriors.

tc_text: 守衛…殺死他們...
很好，看看甚麼從它自己的牢籠中逃了出來！讓它死！
en_text: Well, look what escaped from its cage! Now it shall die!

tc_text: 將軍，我們在附近發現了兩作暗黑神靈族的營地。他們的防衛嚴護，我們該避開他們。
en_text: General, we’ve sighted two Dark Eldar camps in the vicinity. They’ve extremely well defended, and should be avoided.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們在附近偵測到兩座敵人的營地。依據我們目前的軍力，建議不要對他們採取直接的攻擊。
en_text: Commander. Two enemy camps have been observed nearby. Given our current force, attacking them directly would be ill-advised.

tc_text: 大修女，在這附近有兩作敵人的營地。他們的防禦精良，以我們目前的能力來看，我不認為我們可以奪下它們。
en_text: Canoness, there are two camps of the enemy near to here. They are well-defended, and with our current strength, I do not think that we could take them.

tc_text: 卡倫大君，我—我看見—我看見兩座警衛營，它們就在附近。我們—我們還不夠強大，我們—我們不該攻擊。
en_text: Lord Carron, I – I saw – I saw two guard camps. They are near here. We – we aren’t strong enough yet. We – we shouldn’t attack.

tc_text: 在這附近有兩座警衛營，我感覺到還沒有足夠的力量來攻擊他們，我們必須等待適當的時機來臨。
en_text: Two guard camps lie near here. I sense that we do not yet have sufficient strength to attempt an attack. We must wait until the time is right.

tc_text: 老大！老大！有些孩子，看到兩個營地有尖耳朵！我們想打他們的話，最好有更多的孩子。
en_text: Warboss! Warboss! Some boyz, we saw dey got two camps full a pointy-ears. Lots a’ pointy-ears! We’d better ‘ave more Boyz, sure, if we wants to stomp dem.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們發現了兩座守備營，他們的力量比我們現在擁有的軍力還要強大。或許我們該避免正面衝突，然後等待時機來臨。
en_text: Commander, two guard stations have been located. Their tactical strength appears to be too great for our current force. Perhaps we should avoid a direct conflict, for the time being.

tc_text: 當心…那些…營地…等我們…更強大…
en_text: Beware… those… camps… until… we are… more…

tc_text: 好吧，我們可不是一群爛部隊。加把勁，弟兄們，加把勁。
en_text: Well, if we don’t have ourselves a ragtag army. Push on, men, push on.

tc_text: 這是一支很合適的部隊。
en_text: This is a suitable fighting force.

tc_text: 我們的數量增加了，我們準備好面對我們終極的目標。
en_text: Our numbers are increased. We grow ready for our ultimate goal.

tc_text: 我們成長！我們強壯！現在是我們攻擊的時刻了！
en_text: We grow! We are strong! The time comes for us to strike!

tc_text: 我們增加了許多的數量，現在是進行的時候了，我們必須前進攻擊！
en_text: We have rescued many. The time approaches, when we must fly forward and strike!

tc_text: 歐克們，現在是我說戰鬥的時候了。我們可以用全部的孩子，好好的攻擊他們。
en_text: Now dats wot I call some good fightin’ Orks. We could smash some stuff up, wif all dem boyz.

tc_text: 我們從小隊變成了一支大軍，很好，很快的就是前進的時刻了。
