en_text: We grow from a team into a cadre. It is well. Soon will be the time to move forward.

tc_text: 我們..有…很多…很好…
機械主教！太好了！快點，我們必須建造一座前進基地！
en_text: Techpriests! Excellent! Quickly, we must build a forward base!

tc_text: 我們現在有僕役了，建造一座要塞，用雙倍的力量！
en_text: We have Servitors. Construct a Stronghold. On the double!

tc_text: 讚美皇帝—是僕役！我們必須建造一座前進營地，動作快！
en_text: Praise the Emperor – Servitors! We must erect a forward camp. With speed!

tc_text: 我的爪牙！蟲子們！建造我們的營地，不然我會把你們關回籠子裡！
en_text: My minions! Worms! Build our camp, or you will wish you were back in that cage!

tc_text: 啊！我的吟骨者！很高興你們在這裡。快，如果我們想要打敗你的俘虜者，我們就必須召喚一座前進營地，
en_text: Ah! My Bonesingers! I am so glad to find you here. Quickly, we must summon a forward camp, if we hope to defeat your captors.

tc_text: 這是啥？小鬼頭！滾出籠子，幫我們建造一些戰鬥的東西。現在！
en_text: Wotz this? Grots! Get outta dat cage and build us some stuffs to fight wif. Nooow!

tc_text: 儘管他們殺死了我們的大地級建築艇，它們的建築兵蜂還是完好無缺的，我們可以利用它們來建造前進基地。
en_text: Although they have killed our Earth Caste engineers, their Construction Drones remain intact. We must use them to build our forward base.

tc_text: 為我…在這邊...建造…浮石巨塔…
塔里爾大君！有敵人從刑罰花園滲透進來了。
en_text: Lord Tahril! Enemies have infiltrated, by way of the torture gardens.

tc_text: 怎麼可以讓這種事發生？
en_text: How was this allowed to happen?

tc_text: 我—我不知道，大君！他們殺死了警衛。他們聚集了一支部隊，並且很快的就要完成一座戰鬥營地了。
en_text: I – I don’t know, Archon! They killed the guards. They amassed a force and will soon have a war-camp established.

tc_text: 我知道了，我將會通知維克大君。準備好靈魂牢籠，讓他們嚐嚐我們力量的全部怒火展現。
en_text: I see. I will inform Lord Vect. Have the Soul Cages readied. They shall taste the full fury of our powers!

tc_text: 維克大君在這裡？在拉肯尼？
en_text: Lord Vect is here? On Lacunae?

tc_text: 沒錯。現在去吧！準備好靈魂牢籠！
en_text: Yes. Now go! The Soul Cages!

tc_text: 這是甚麼？一場小小的暴動？對這些可憐的人來說，速死還真的算太幸運了。
en_text: And what is this? A little insurrection? Swift death is too good for such miserable wretches as these.

tc_text: 那麼，在那邊的就是他們的將軍了。如果我們可以打倒他，他們將會潰散，而我們會贏得這場戰爭。
en_text: So that’s their general, there. If we can strike him down, they’ll scatter. We’ll have this battle won.

tc_text: 啊！如果我沒弄錯的話，他們的指揮官來到戰場了...。星際戰士！那個指揮官是你們的新目標，幹掉他，這裡就會屬於我們了。
en_text: Ah! Their commander takes the field. If I am not mistaken… Space Marines! That command craft is your new target it. Take it down, and the field is ours.

tc_text: 修女們，標定好敵人的指揮官。以皇帝之名，他一定要被解決掉！
en_text: Sisters, mark well the enemy commander. It is he who must be smitten, in the Emperor’s name!

tc_text: 他—他將會付出代價的，我將會親自解決掉他！他的部隊將會潰散失敗，而我將會拿取他的頭顱來作為戰利品。
en_text: He – he will pay. I will kill him myself! His army shall fall and scatter, and I shall wear his skull as a trophy!

tc_text: 這個人就是…維克，他就是我們要殺掉的那個人。
en_text: The one known as… Vect. It is he whom we must destroy.

tc_text: 那一個—是老大，當然。我們進去，我們抓他，殺死他，這就是我說的。我說甚麼，你們就做甚麼！
en_text: Dat one – ‘e’s da Warboss, sure. We get ‘im, we got ‘em licked, is wot I say. An’ wot I say, you do!

tc_text: 很確定的，那個人一定就是這群暴徒的指揮官。如果我們殺掉他，他們的士兵就會潰敗，然後喪失所有的紀律和士氣嗎？
en_text: Surely that must be the command craft, leading their unruly mobs. If we were to strike it down, would not their soldiers scatter, devoid of all discipline or courage?

tc_text: 他…一定…得死…
甚麼？我們的一個靈魂牢籠，被摧毀了？他們會付出代價的！
en_text: What? One of our Soul Cages, destroyed? They will pay!

tc_text: 又一座靈魂牢籠？這些悲慘的混蛋！如果你不用生命來守護好最後一座靈魂牢籠，到時我會告訴你"疼痛"這個字的真正意義！
en_text: Another Soul Cage? Miserable scum! If you do not guard the last cage with your very lives, I will teach you new meanings of the word, "pain"!

tc_text: 我們全部的靈魂牢籠？毀了？我很生氣，塔里爾。有人要人頭落地了，或許是你的吧！
en_text: All our Soul Cages? Gone? I am displeased, Tahril. Heads shall roll! Perhaps yours.

tc_text: 他們嘗試計畫要摧毀我們的靈魂牢籠。快，我們必須退回防禦地點。
en_text: They have somehow managed to destroy our soul cages. Quickly, we must fall back to defensive positions.

tc_text: 我會讓你肚破腸流的！
en_text: I shall feast upon your entrails!

tc_text: 我的高臺將會摧毀你，悲慘的小蟲子！
en_text: My Dais will crush you, wretched worms!

tc_text: 你的末日接近了，就是我。
en_text: Your end approaches. It is me.

tc_text: 撤退！撤退！
撤退！我需要修復！
我的高臺損傷了，我該回去了！
en_text: My Dais is damaged. But I shall return!

tc_text: 帶我回去，你這個笨蛋，我們需要更多的火力。
en_text: Take me back, you fools. We need more firepower.

tc_text: 痛苦的滋味來臨了！
en_text: That is but a taste of the pain to come!

tc_text: 現在他們將會為自己的無恥付出代價！
en_text: Now they shall pay handsomely for their impudence!

tc_text: 你是個愛哭的笨蛋，還是暗黑神靈族的戰士？去吧—在你被殺死前，先殺掉一堆敵人，不然我會先將你給處決掉。
en_text: Are you sniveling fools, or Dark Eldar Warriors? Go – go and kill many before you are killed…Or I will kill you now!

tc_text: 塔里爾，我來這個月球不是要被困住，或是被這些無恥的奴隸攻擊的。把他們打回去，然後殺掉每一個人！
en_text: Tahril, I did not come to this moon to be trapped and shot at by impudent slaves. Beat them back, and slaughter everyone one of them!

tc_text: 我們必須找出這些入侵者，並且動作要快！
en_text: We must find the intruders, and quickly.

tc_text: 我們被攻擊了。快點，警告歐耶斯卡指揮官。
en_text: We are under attack. Quickly, alert Commander Or’es’Ka.

tc_text: 我們的通訊塔現在還不能運作。
en_text: Our communications tower is not yet operational.

tc_text: 讓它啟動起來，戰士，用最快的速度。
en_text: Get it working, warrior, and with great speed.

tc_text: 轉播，這裡是史塔伯斯指揮官。這個區域已經淨空了，你們要給我們甚麼禮物嗎？
en_text: Relay, this is General Stubbs. The area’s cleared. You have a gift for us?

tc_text: 已經包裝了，準備投遞。
en_text: Wrapped in ribbons. We’re ready to deploy.

tc_text: 幹得好，士兵，我們必須盡快的組裝好基地營，我不認為這些外星人會等我們把事情都給搞定的。
en_text: Excellent work, soldiers. We’ve got to assemble this base-camp, and quickly. I don’t think these xenos are going to wait for us to come knocking.

tc_text: 部隊指揮官波里爾向中央報告，這個區域已經淨空，部署野戰司令部。
en_text: This Force Commander Boreale to Central. Area is secured. Deploy Field Command.

tc_text: 我們收到命令了。投遞船…出發。
星際戰士，將這座基地準備好，讓那些外星人瞧瞧我們可以作些甚麼事情。
en_text: Space Marines, put together this base and get ready to show those xenos what we are made of.

tc_text: 太好了，這個區域淨空了。
en_text: Excellent, the area has been cleared.

tc_text: 修女們，聽我說，準備好戰鬥。動作要快，我們不能拖延神聖的目標。
en_text: Sisters, hear me. Make ready for war. Do so with haste. We must not tarry from our holy purpose.

tc_text: 偉大之神恐虐，濺灑在此處的血是你的血。請給我們要塞、給我們力量…給我們勝利！
en_text: Great God Khorne, the blood spilled here is your blood. Give us our Stronghold, give us our strength… grant us victory!

tc_text: 你看到了嗎？你瞧見了嗎？我們的神聽到我們的祈求了！他們為我們灌注了力量！他們在我們的敵人身上加諸了恐懼！死亡即將燃燒，而鮮血即將橫流！
en_text: Do you see? Do you see? Our gods hear our words! They fill us with might! They fill the foe with terror! Death shall blaze and blood shall flow!

tc_text: 很好，一個區域被淨空了，讓我們從魍道中召喚我們的部隊。
en_text: It is well, a space has been cleared. Let us summon our forces from the Webway.

tc_text: 我們聽從你的差遣，先知。
en_text: We are at your command, Farseer.

tc_text: 很好，我們必須快速的建立我們的部隊，並且準備攻擊。
en_text: Good. We must build our army swiftly, and prepare for the strike.

tc_text: 一個著陸點！很好，召喚卡柏要塞，還有奴隸！
en_text: A landing spot! Good. Summon a Kabal Fortress, and the slaves!

tc_text: 動作快，白癡。有這麼多的娛樂—和這麼多的靈魂—要去做，不過我們的攻擊要快一點。
en_text: Make haste, cretins. There is much sport – and many souls – to be had, but only if our attack is swift.

tc_text: 好吧，現在聽著，孩子們。我們來到這了，很好。那是因為我們是歐克，我是戈古茲，唯一的！沒有人可以擋下戈古茲！現在，給我要塞和小鬼頭。
en_text: Awright, now listen up boyz. We gots’d dis far. Dat’s good. Dat’s cuz we’s da Orks, and I’m Gorgutz, da one and only! No one stops Gorgutz! Now, bring in da Grotz and da Fort.

tc_text: <cheers>
那就是我想看到的！把東西給蓋起來，快一點，我們就可以戰鬥。
en_text: Dat’s wot I like ta see! Get ‘dem buildings put up, and quick like, so’s we can get down to the fightin’.

tc_text: 指揮官！入侵者—我們找不到他們，他們一定從我們還沒完成的通訊站中突破進來了。
en_text: Commander! The intruders – we cannot locate them. They must have breached where our comm relays are not yet operational.

tc_text: 現在…我們…建造…
現在…他們…死亡…
不！他們拿下了通訊塔，我們沒辦法跟歐耶斯卡指揮關聯繫了。
en_text: No! They have taken the communications tower. We are unable to contact Commander Or’es’Ka.

tc_text: 那麼我們必須戰鬥，為了更大良善而死。
en_text: Then we must fight, and die for the Greater Good!

tc_text: 啊！我們從圓周基地9-3-紅收到了通訊。
en_text: Ah! We have received a communication from Periphery Base 9-3-Red.

tc_text: 立即派出烈焰戰士和克魯特，我們必須在我們的軍事設施完成之前阻擋他們的入侵？
en_text: Have Fire Warriors and Kroot dispatched immediately. We must stop the enemy before they progress into our military complex.

tc_text: 立刻去，指揮官。
我們必須找出我們的安全漏洞，把斥候給派出去，讓他們搜尋每個地方，並且立刻回報。
en_text: We must find the location of our security breach. Have scouts sent. Let them scour every possible breach location, and report back immediately.

tc_text: 他們會立刻派出去。
歐耶斯卡指揮官，發現入侵者了！他們突破了我們在圓周基地9-3-紅的防禦。
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka, the intruders have been located! They breached our defenses at Periphery Base 9-3-Red.

tc_text: 幹的好，戰士。
啊！我們派出去了多少的尋路者，然後一點消息都沒有！它們最後的報告是來自哪個地方？
en_text: Ah! How many Pathfinders have we dispatched, and no news! Where did they last report from?

tc_text: 指揮官，它們全都在3-紅區域。
en_text: Commander, they have all been in sector 3-Red.

tc_text: 那我們應該把部隊給派過去那邊。
en_text: Then we should direct our forces there.

tc_text: 指揮官！我們被攻擊了！
他們終於露出馬腳了！很好，我們現在知道哪裡可以找到他們了。
en_text: Then they have shown their hand! Good, we now know where to find them.

tc_text: 歐耶斯卡指揮官，軌道防禦系統還要多久可完成？
en_text: Commander Or’es’Ka, how close to ready is this orbital defense system?

tc_text: 它—它將可以射擊了，但它還沒經過校正，同時也還沒安裝安全密碼。
en_text: It – it will fire, but it is not calibrated, and security codes have not been installed.

tc_text: 讓它準備好，那可以用來射擊入侵者了。
en_text: Have it readied. That is sufficient to fire on the intruder.

tc_text: 但是智者，它還沒有很好的準度，我們自己的部隊可能會—
en_text: But Wise One, it will not fire with great accuracy. Some of our own troops may –

tc_text: 那麼他們就是為更大良善而犧牲。照我說的去做，勝利將會屬於我們。
en_text: Then they are sacrificed for the Greater Good. Do as I say, and victory is ours.

tc_text: 指揮官—乙太導師—軌道防禦系統已經啟動，現在準備射擊了。
en_text: Commander – Ethereal – the orbital defense system has been activated and primed, and is now ready to fire.

tc_text: 敵人在我們的視線中嗎？
en_text: Is the enemy in our sights?

tc_text: 是的，歐耶斯卡指揮官。但是—不是所有的冷卻系統都備便，如果射擊太過頻繁的話火砲將會過熱。
en_text: Yes, Commander Or’es’Ka. But – not all cooling systems are in place, and the cannon will overheat if fired too often.

tc_text: 好吧，那就盡可能在安全範圍內射擊，我們必須拖住他們，直到我們的支援部隊抵達為止。
en_text: Well, fire as often as it is safe to do so. We must hold them off until our reinforcement fleet arrives.

tc_text: 史塔伯斯將軍—異星領導者"乙太導師"被發現在他們的太空火砲旁邊，異星手冊指出這些領導人都是首要的目標。
en_text: General Stubbs – the alien “Ethereal” leader has been sighted by their space cannon. The Xeno Handbook identifies these leaders as primary targets.

tc_text: 波里爾指揮官，異星領導者乙太導師，被發現在巨大太空火砲的旁邊。
en_text: Commander Boreale, the xeno leader, called an Ethereal, was been sighted by the great Space Cannon.

tc_text: 很好，現在我們知道要瞄準甚麼地方了。
en_text: Good. Now we know where to aim our guns.

tc_text: 大修女，我們發現在設施旁出現了一位強大的鈦星聯盟領導人。
en_text: Canoness, our surveillance has revealed that a powerful Tau religious leader is within the compound.

tc_text: 他在哪裡？如果我們殺死他，我們就會毀掉他們的信念和希望。
en_text: Where is he? If we kill him, we kill their faith and hope.

tc_text: 就在巨大的火砲旁邊，女士。
啊！我看到他們追隨的那個人了，那個虛偽的神！他不過是眾多渾沌之口的食物而以！就在那個大砲旁！那邊，我可以看見他了！
en_text: Ah! I see the one they all bow to. The false god! He is food for the many mouths of Chaos! By the big gun! There. I can see him!

tc_text: 我看見…我已經看見他們的先知，他對未來一無所知。他就站在他們的大砲旁。
en_text: I see… I have seen their Farseer, who knows nothing of the future. He stands by their great cannon.

tc_text: 大人！他們的乙太導師，就是他們像奴隸般侍奉的那個人。我們看到他了，他就站在他們的大砲旁。
en_text: Archon! Their Ethereal, whom they serve like the groveling slaves they are. We have seen him. He is by their great cannon.

tc_text: 我們有兩個理由，那麼，讓他瞧瞧吧。
en_text: We have two reasons, then, to pay him a visit.

tc_text: 戰爭頭目！戈古茲！
耶，甚麼事？
我們的孩子看到你說的乙太導師。
en_text: Me boyz saw dat Effereal ya said ta look out for.

tc_text: 很好，在哪邊？
就在那邊的大砲旁。
en_text: By da big big gun dey got down dere.

tc_text: 我看見…他們的大君…殺掉…他…
en_text: I see … their Lord … kill … him…

tc_text: 指揮官，他們奪取了基地防禦火砲的控制！
en_text: Commander, they have taken control of the base defense guns!

tc_text: 指揮官，我們控制了防禦系統！
en_text: Commander, the defense systems are under our control!

tc_text: 中尉，有沒有確認殺死了乙太導師？
en_text: Lieutenant, do have have a confirmed kill on the Ethereal?

tc_text: 我們…沒有，長官，沒有發現任何的血跡。
en_text: We… no sir, no body has been identified.

tc_text: 你，士兵，我們有抓到乙太導師嗎？
en_text: You, Marine, did we get the Ethereal?

tc_text: 沒有，波里爾指揮官。他消失了…我不曉得原因。
en_text: No, Commander Boreale. He vanished… I don’t know how.

tc_text: 修女們，我們有拿到異星領導者的屍體嗎？
en_text: Sisters, do we have the body of the xeno leader?

tc_text: 沒有，大修女，我們找過了，但沒有發現乙太導師的屍體。
en_text: No, Canoness. We have looked, we could not find the Ethereal’s body.

tc_text: 他去哪裡了？哪邊！？嗯…把他給找出來！
en_text: Where did he go? Where!? Hrrrgh…. find him!

tc_text: 顧問，告訴我，我們要如何殺死他們的乙太導師？
en_text: Councilor, tell me. Have we slain this Ethereal of theirs?

tc_text: 唉，先知，我不知道我們該怎麼作，他不曉得用甚麼方法消失了。
en_text: Alas, Farseer, I cannot say that we have. He seems somehow to have vanished.

tc_text: 甚麼？這個"乙太導師"從我們的手中溜走了？從我們嚴密的監視之中！當我們抓到他，我會親自撕毀他的！
en_text: What? How did this ‘Ethereal’ slip from our clutches? We, old of years and keen of sight! When we get him, I myself shall strip the flesh from his living corpse!

tc_text: 我們抓到乙太導師嗎？
啊，沒有，戰爭老大，我不知道他在哪裡。
en_text: Er, no Warboss. I donno where ‘e got to.

tc_text: 你弄丟他了？這不是一個歐克的好藉口！
en_text: ‘Ow’d you lose ‘im? Ya sotted grotty excuse for an Ork!

tc_text: 乙太導師…從我們這裡…逃脫了…
史塔伯斯將軍，我們又發現了乙太導師的蹤跡。他在他們的指揮中心被發現，進入了他們的聯盟中樞站。
en_text: General Stubbs, we have sighted the Ethereal again. He was seen in their central command, entering their Coalition Center building.

tc_text: 波里爾指揮官，看來乙太導師已經逃掉了。他被發現出現在鈦星指揮中心，進入了聯盟中樞站之中。
en_text: Commander Boreale, it appears the Ethereal did escape. He was seen entering the Coalition Center in the Tau central command.

tc_text: 大修女，我們發現了異星領導者，乙太導師不曉得用甚麼方法，安全的回到了鈦星的指揮中心。
en_text: Canoness, we have found the xeno leader. The Ethereal somehow made it safely to the Tau central command.

tc_text: 啊，那就是那個該死的乙太導師！可憐的傢伙！我將會燒毀你的建築！我會把你逐出這個世界，直到你死為止！直到你的死亡！
en_text: Ah, there is that cursed Ethereal! Wretched stripling! I will burn down your buildings! I will cast you out of that tall spire, to your death! To your death!

tc_text: 先知，我們看見了鈦星的乙太導師。他不曉得用甚麼方法逃回到他們的指揮中心，並且躲進了聯盟中樞站中。
en_text: Farseer, we have seen Tau Ethereal. He somehow escaped to their central command, and has taken refuge in their Coalition Center.

tc_text: 啊哈！我低估了這個乙太導師。瞧，他不曉得用甚麼方法讓自己安全的回到了指揮中心。我將會把它開腸剖肚，然後慢慢的享受這個樂趣…
en_text: Aha! I have underestimated this Ethereal. Look, he somehow got himself to the safety of their central command. I will take great joy in showing him his own entrails…

tc_text: 他在那邊！那個灰皮膚的乙太導師。他是怎樣過去那邊的？
en_text: Dere he is! Dere’s da grayskin Effereal. How’d he get all da way over dere?

tc_text: 我…看見…你了…乙太導師…
我們摧毀你的速度，將會是鈦星優勢的最佳證明。
en_text: The speed with which we crush you will be certain proof of Tau superiority.

tc_text: 笨蛋—更大良善的聯盟終將獲勝。
en_text: Fools – the allies of the Greater Good shall always prevail.

tc_text: 為什麼他們是如此的強大？如果我們只要完成了建造，楠‧亞諾以就不會被攻破了！
en_text: How is it that they are so strong? If we had only finished construction, Nan Yanoi would have been unassailable!

tc_text: 他們來到指揮中心了！我們必須為了保衛乙太導師而戰！
en_text: They have reached the central command! We must fight to protect our Ethereal!

tc_text: 讓我們榮耀。第55軍團。
幹掉他們、殺光他們，孩子們！讓他們知道歐克是最棒的！
en_text: Get ‘em, boyz. Smash ‘em good! Show ‘em Orkz is da best!

tc_text: 現在讓我們瞧瞧你們這群年輕的孩子，可以被稱為歐克人。
en_text: Now we seez if youz boyz is worth ta be called Orks

tc_text: 站好位置，孩子們，戰鬥，好好的作戰。喔！這個該死的地方是我們的了，我們的！
en_text: Get in place, m’boyz. Fight, an’ fight good. Oi! Da Killy Spot is ours. Ours!

tc_text: 啊！他們拿到這個該死的點！
en_text: Aaaagh! Dey gotz demselves da Killy Spot!

tc_text: 你們這個點有甚麼特別的？拿回去吧。
en_text: Wotz so speshul ‘bout dis Killy Spot o’ yours? Jus’ take it back.

tc_text: 你想拿回去！
你說話小心一點，你這個混蛋。
en_text: You wotch yer mouf dere, ya pimply grot.

tc_text: 老大。如此龐大的歐克蠻族會是個威脅，如果我們可以靠近的話，我們該除掉他們的營地。
en_text: Nobz. Such large Orks are a threat. We should remove their camp, if we can reach it.

tc_text: 歐克老大！當心，弟兄們，他們在這附近一定有個營地。如果我們先找到他們，他們就不會來找我們了。
en_text: Ork Nobz! Look sharp, men. They must have a camp somewhere. If we come to them, they will not be coming to us.

tc_text: 修女們，你們有看見歐克老大嗎，除掉他們的營地，我們就可以除掉戰場上的威脅。
en_text: Do you see these Ork Nobz, Sisters? Remove their camp, and we have taken a threat off the field of battle.

tc_text: 歐克老大！幹掉他們的營地—從源頭來阻止他們。
en_text: Ork Nobz! Kill their camp – stop them at their source.

tc_text: 發現了歐克老大的蹤跡，我們該摧毀他們的源頭之地。
en_text: The Nob strain of Ork has been sighted. We would do well to destroy their place of origin.

tc_text: 那些是被派來對抗我們的歐克老大。要直搗他們的心臟，而不是末端的地方，你們這些沒有用的混蛋！
en_text: There are Ork Nobz sent against us. Strike not the arm, but the heart, you worthless curs!

tc_text: 發現了歐克老大的蹤跡。我們應該找出他們的營地，然後將這個障礙從我們的道路上移開。
en_text: Ork Nobz have been sighted. We should find their camp, and remove this obstacle from our path.

tc_text: 歐克老大…找出營地…摧毀。
他們擁有坦克，這對我們的行動是一個直接威脅。找出並摧毀他們的技師工廠。
en_text: They have tanks. This is a direct threat to our operations. Find and destroy those Mek Shops.

tc_text: 歐克坦克，找出他們的技師工廠，來阻止那些玩意。
en_text: Ork tanks. Find their machine shops and put a stop to those contraptions.

tc_text: 歐克蠻族擁有坦克了。以皇帝之名，摧毀他們在這片土地上的工廠。
en_text: The Orks have tanks. In the name of the Emperor, purge this land of their factories.

tc_text: 派出坦克來對抗我們？對抗渾沌？你會付出代價的！我們會摧毀你小小的技師工廠！毀掉它們！
en_text: Send tanks against us? Against Chaos? You will pay! We will crush your puny little Mek Shops! Crush them!

tc_text: 他們想用坦克來跟我們作戰？如果我們除掉他們的技師工廠，他們就做不到了。
en_text: They think to fight us with tanks? If we remove their Mek Shops, then they shall not.

tc_text: 坦克，是嗎？該死的野獸。讓我們毀掉他們的工廠，然後除掉他們的機器。
en_text: Tanks, is it? The cursed beasts. Let us melt their factories, and feast on their mechanics.

tc_text: 敵人用武裝車輛來進行戰鬥。關閉它們的生產源地，他們就沒辦法成功了。
en_text: The enemy fights with armored vehicles. Disable their means of production, and they will have none.

tc_text: 找出…並且毀滅...技師工廠…阻止坦克。
en_text: Find… and destroy… Mek Shops… stop tanks.

tc_text: 我們不能允許讓更多這樣的東西出現在戰場上。我們必須找出生產它們的地方，在它們攻擊我們之前來除掉它們。
en_text: We cannot have more of those things on the battlefield. We should find where-ever they’re keeping them and kill them before they come after us.

tc_text: 我們可以對付任何他們丟過來對抗我們的東西，但如果戰場上可以少一點這些討人厭的巨獸來阻擋我們的前進，我們會輕鬆一點。
en_text: We can take anything they throw at us. But it would be less of a nuisance if we did not have these giant beasts on the field, slowing our progress.

tc_text: 修女們，找出這些討厭東西的源頭，讓它變成冒煙的灰燼！
en_text: Sisters, find the source of these abominations and leave it a smoking pile of ash!

tc_text: 那個野獸非常的巨大。我說，在它的籠子裡就先幹掉它們，總比等它們被放出來要好得多了。
en_text: That beast was huge. I say, kill it in its cage, rather than in the open!

tc_text: 如果它們有更多那樣的巨獸，那我就不樂意跟他們作戰。我們必須找出並摧毀他們製造這些東西的地方。
en_text: If they have more such giant beasts, I had fain not fight them. We should find and destroy the places where they are kept.

tc_text: 呸！我可不希望再跟這樣的東西作戰了。讓我們在歐克蠻族釋出更多這些東西之前，毀掉它們生產的地方。
en_text: Faugh! I hope never to fight such a thing again. Let us slay them in their pens, before the Orks release more of them.

tc_text: 如果有一支強大的弓箭，偉大的獵人就不用跟那樣的野獸戰鬥了。讓我們將弓瞄準這些巨獸的源頭。
en_text: With a well-aimed arrow, the great hunter need not fight such a beast. Let us draw our bow at the source of these behemoths.

tc_text: 讓…那邊…不再有…任何…史估革巨獸。
en_text: Let… there… be… no more… Squiggoths.

tc_text: 從沒去過那邊，你知道的。
你會知道，洛克可羅的孩子抵擋他們很好。
en_text: You’ll see. Da Rokclaw boyz’ll stomp ‘em good.

tc_text: 就那樣？
我們還有招數沒有用出來，你等著看。
en_text: We got tricks we ain’t showed yet, we do. You just wotch us.

tc_text: 他們現在最好小心點！我們是歐克！洛克可羅的歐克！
en_text: Dey’d better wotchout now! We’s da Orks! Da Rokclaw Orks!

tc_text: <發出咆哮>
啊！歐伊夫戰鬥比你們這些糟糕的歐克還好。
en_text: Gaah! Oi’ve stepped on grots as fought better ‘an you sorry Orks.

tc_text: <啜泣>
一面巨大的吼～軍團旗幟。嗯…如果我們燒掉它，不曉得會發生甚麼事情。
en_text: A giant Waaagh! Banner. Hmm… wonder what happens if we torch it.

tc_text: 他們的巨大旗幟在那邊。把它給弄下來—那將會瓦解他們的士氣。
en_text: That giant banner they have there. Knock it down – that will demoralize them.

tc_text: 他們升起了巨大的旗幟來維持信念。修女們，我們必須把它給弄下來！
en_text: They have erected a giant pennant of their wretched excuse for a faith. Sisters, we must cast it down!

tc_text: 旗幟就在那邊—把它給扯下來！
en_text: That banner there – tear it down!

tc_text: 你瞧，他們用那個巨大的旗幟來鼓舞士氣。把它拿下來，我們就可以直搗他們的心臟。
en_text: You see they bolster morale with that giant banner, there. Strike it down, and we strike at their heart.

tc_text: 你以為我們作了那件事後他們會怎樣—把他們巨大的旗幟轟成碎片？
en_text: What do you think they’d do if we just happened to– blast their giant banner into little pieces?

tc_text: 他們從高舉的巨大旗幟中獲得鋼鐵般的意志。毀掉它，我們的勝利就先贏得一半了。
en_text: They draw their fortitude from the great banner upon the heights. Destroy it, and our battle is half won.

tc_text: 那面旗幟…毀掉它…
吼～
我的吼～軍團旗幟。他們拿到了我的～軍團旗幟！為什麼我將…
en_text: My Waaagh! Banner. Dey gotz my Waaagh! Banner! Why I’ll…

tc_text: 他們在主基地！
我受夠你們了，現在我的孩子會讓你看看他們可以作甚麼。
en_text: I’ve ‘ad enuf a youz. Now MY boyz’ll show you ‘ow it’s done.

tc_text: 這一定會毀掉他們的！
更多的人！更多的人！更多！更多！
en_text: More sluggaz! More sluggaz! More! More!

tc_text: 喂！他們是我的特別守衛孩子！
en_text: Oi! Dem's my speshul guard boyz!

tc_text: 喔！他們繼續毀掉任何的東西！
en_text: Oooooh! They keep squashin' everything they get to!

tc_text: 幹掉他們！吼～！！！
史塔伯斯指揮官！發現了四作浮石巨塔。它—它看起來像是正在被啟動一樣。
en_text: Commander Stubbs! Four monoliths have been sighted. It – it looks as though they’re being powered up.

tc_text: 我們一定得阻止它，我們不能讓四個那樣的東西來擊敗我們。一定有甚麼方法可以切斷它們的能源傳輸…
en_text: We’ll have to put a stop to that. We can’t have four of those things bearing down on us. There must be some way to cut off their energy supply…

tc_text: 長官！我們偵察到目標區域中有四作浮石巨塔。它們—它們看來正從中央擷取能源，而我不曉得原因。
en_text: Sir! Reconnaissance had identified four monoliths at the perimeter of the target area. They – they appear to be drawing power from the center. I don’t know what for.

tc_text: 幹的好，那個區域正供給能源來為它們的能力升級。防止這些浮石巨塔獲得能源回復是我們的首要任務，那表示…我們必須切斷它們的能源。
en_text: Excellent work. That area is supplying power that is used to upgrade their capabilities. It is mission critical that we prevent these monoliths from being fully restored. Which means… we will need to cut off their power.

tc_text: 大修女，我們的斥候在中央區域的外圍偵測到四座浮石巨塔。掃瞄顯示它們正從那邊擷取能源，那些能源是被用來—用來喚醒它們的。
en_text: Canoness. Our scouts have identified four monoliths outlying the central area. Scans indicate that they are drawing power from there, which is being used to – to awaken them.

tc_text: 它們一定得被阻止下來。有兩個方法：切斷能源，或是迅速的將它們給幹掉…
en_text: They must be stopped. There are two strategies: cut off the flow, or smash them quickly…

tc_text: 主人！大君！他們有浮石巨塔，四座浮石巨塔。它們吸取、吸取能源然後持續的成長！
en_text: Master! Lord! They have monoliths, four monoliths. They drink, drink power and they grow!

tc_text: 它們一定得被阻止下來。有兩種方法：砍斷它們的靜脈，或是直接刺穿它們的頭顱。
en_text: They must be stopped. There are two strategies: cut them at the jugular, or pierce them through the skull!

tc_text: 這正是我所害怕的！能源…來自於中央，通往四座、四座…浮石巨塔。如果讓它們充能完成，那就是我們的末日了？我們一定要阻止它們，不管是從源頭還是從末端開始，它們一定得被阻止下來。
en_text: It is as I feared! Power… courses from the center, to four buds, four… monoliths. If these are allowed to reach full bloom, it is very likely our demise. They must be stopped, be it at the stem or at the bud. They must be stopped.

tc_text: 大人，我們飛越這個骯髒的城市，在四個主要的地點偵測到四座浮石巨塔。大君，它們看起來，好像正在從中央吸取能源。
en_text: Archon, we flew above this foul city. At the four cardinal points we scried four monoliths. They seemed, Lord, to draw power from the center.

tc_text: 哼！如果那是我所懼怕的東西，這些堡壘正要完全的回復了。如果讓它們達到完成的狀態，它們就會變成可怕的敵人。我們必須盡所有可能，來中斷它們的進展。
en_text: Hmph! If it is as I fear, these fortresses are being restored to fullness. If they were to reach this state, they would be fearsome foes. We must do all that we can to halt their progress.

tc_text: 這是啥？該死的浮石巨塔連接在角落。如果我們不停下它們，它們會起來，那會有四個摧毀我們的可怕東西。切斷連結，我要這樣。
en_text: Wot’s dis? Dem monoliffs in da corners is plugged in. If we don’t stomp ‘em, dey’ll go full up, dey’ll be worse ‘an four squigoffs stompin on us. Unplug ‘em, dat’s wot I say.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們的設備偵測到強大的能源流動，從中央通往他們周邊的四個設施之中。
en_text: Commander, our equipment has detected a strong flow of energy from the center towards four points at the edge of their compound.

tc_text: 那些設施是甚麼東西？
en_text: And what lies at these points?

tc_text: 浮石巨塔，指揮官。
啊，這可是一個大威脅。那個能源會讓浮石巨塔回復。當它們完全回復後，就便變成無法估計的力量，我們一定得要阻止它們。
en_text: Ah, this is a great threat. That power restores each monolith. When they are fully restored, they are a force to be reckoned with. They must be stopped.

tc_text: 把它…奪回來…
它…是我們的…再度飲取…成長…
將軍，長官，掃描器 顯示這波攻擊直接來自城市後方的召喚核心，將它毀滅或許就可以避免之後的傳送。
en_text: General, sir, scanners show that this attack came directly from a Summoning Core at the back of the city. Destroying that might prevent further teleporting.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們的掃描器顯示這個防禦勢力來自於城市後方的召喚核心，摧毀核心將可以類似的防禦傳送。
en_text: Commander. Our scanners show that this defensive force originated at the Summoning Core at the back of the compound. Dispatching the Core should prevent similar defensive teleports.

tc_text: 大修女！我們追蹤到死亡之城後方通往召喚核心的能源型式，這顯示了他們如何派遣這些防禦勢力。
en_text: Canoness! We have traced the energy pattern to a Summoning Core at the far end of the Necropolis. It appears that this is how they deploy these defensive forces.

tc_text: 詛咒這些該死的傳送惡魔！把它們給轟成碎片！你知道它們是怎麼來的嗎？不知道？？我告訴你！在這個城市的後方有一個召喚核心，讓我們用恐虐的打擊速度來消滅它！
en_text: Curse these teleporting fiends! Blast them to smithereens. Do you know how they do it? No?? I’ll tell you! There’s a Summoning Core, in the back of this, this city. Let us smash it with the speed of Khorne’s fist!

tc_text: 這些防禦配置來自於一個源頭，那就是…是的，一個在他們設施後方的召喚核心。如果我們可以毀掉這個建築物，就可以獲得極大的進展。
en_text: These defensive maneuvers originate in a single source. There is… yes, a Summoning Core behind their compound. If we can dispatch this structure, we defeat this tactic, gaining a true advantage.

tc_text: 大人，我發現了這些傳送伎倆的秘密！他們都來自一個地方—一個在這座死亡城市後方的召喚核心。摧毀它，我們就不再會有任何的麻煩了。
en_text: Archon. I have discovered the secret of these teleportation tricks! They hail from one point – a Summoning Core nestled behind this necropolis. Destroy it, and that grievance shall trouble us no more.

tc_text: 喂！我發現他們用的傳送點，就在那後面。我們一定要阻擋它們，我們一定要這樣做。
en_text: Oi! I see where da tellyporta dey usin’s at. It’s back dere. We oughta stomp that good, we ought.

tc_text: 指揮官，感應陣列偵測到這個防禦勢力的源頭，它們都來自於一個召喚核心，看來它控制著所有的防禦傳送。
en_text: Commander, sensor arrays have determined the origin of this defensive force. They all came from a Summoning Core, which it seems controls all defensive teleports.

tc_text: 長官，浮石巨塔正在吸取能量。
en_text: Sir, the monoliths are gaining power.

tc_text: 指揮官，浮石巨塔正在啟動中。
en_text: Commander, the monoliths are powering up.

tc_text: 女士，浮石巨塔正在獲取能量。
en_text: Mistress, the monoliths gain in power.

tc_text: 主人，大君！浮石巨塔在獲取能量，他們在成長！
en_text: Master! Lord! The monoliths gain, they grow!

tc_text: 我們必須快一點，浮石巨塔正在獲取能量。
en_text: We must make haste, the monoliths gain in power.

tc_text: 大人，浮石巨塔正在獲取能量，我們不能再耽擱了。
en_text: Archon, the monoliths are gaining power. We must not tarry.

tc_text: 老大！那個浮石巨塔，它們再啟動！
en_text: Boss! Da monoliffs, dey're powerin' up!

tc_text: 浮石巨塔正在獲取能量，我們必須趕快行動。
en_text: The monoliths are gaining power. We must not hesitate to act.

tc_text: 長官，有一座浮石巨塔已經部分的回復了。
en_text: Sir, one of the monoliths is partially restored.

tc_text: 指揮軍，其中一座浮石巨塔已經進入第二階段了。
en_text: Commander, one of the monoliths has reached its second phase.

tc_text: 女士，一座浮石巨塔已經回復到第二階段了。
en_text: Mistress, a monolith is in its second stage of restoration.

tc_text: 主人！有一座浮石巨塔已經部分的回復了。
en_text: Master! Now a monolith is partially restored!

tc_text: 啊！有一座浮石巨塔到了回復的一個新階段了。
en_text: Ah! A monolith has gained a new stage of restoration.

tc_text: 那座浮石巨塔再一步就接近完成了，我們必須停止它的成長。
en_text: That monolith is one step closer to complete. We must halt its growth.

tc_text: 啊喔，一具浮石巨塔提升了一個等級。
en_text: Uh oh, a monoliff jus' wen' up a level.

tc_text: 指揮官，有一座浮石巨塔已經部分的回復了。
en_text: Commander, one monolith is now partially restored!

tc_text: 另一座回復的浮石巨塔，把那個東西給搞定！
en_text: Another restored monolith. Take that thing out of commission!

tc_text: 它開始啟動了。士兵們，你們的目標是那個死亡巨塔。
en_text: It's gone active. Marines, your objective is that giant tower of death.

tc_text: 該死！那個塔啟動了。修女們，一定要把它給毀掉！
en_text: Cursed abomination! The tower has gone active. Sisters, it must be destroyed!

tc_text: 渾沌！把那個該死的浮石巨塔炸成碎片！
en_text: Choas! Blast that cursed monolith to smithereens!

tc_text: 中央的浮石巨塔已經啟動了，它是他們最後的希望。我們必須把它解決掉！就是現在！
en_text: The central monolith is now active. It is their last hope. We must finish this! Now!

tc_text: 啊！浮石巨塔啟動了！毀掉那個東西！把它炸成碎片！
en_text: Aaagh! The monolith has gone active! Destroy that thing! Blow it to pieces!

tc_text: 它在射擊我們！那個浮石巨塔在射我們！幹掉它！吼～！
en_text: It's shootin' us! Da monoliff is shootin' us! Bash it good! Waaagh!

tc_text: 中央的浮石巨塔—它已經啟動了！這是它們最後的希望，毀掉它，我們就勝利了。
en_text: The central monolith – it has gone active! This is their last stand. Destroy it, and we prevail!

tc_text: 如果我們現在進去那裡，我們就會冒著外圍浮石巨塔完全回復的風險，那可能會遠超過我們所能掌握的範圍了。
en_text: If we go in there now, we risk the outer monoliths being fully restored. That might be more than we could handle.

tc_text: 我們的首要任務是外圍正在充能的四座浮石巨塔，直接攻擊中央會讓我們輸掉這場戰爭。
en_text: Our first priority is those four outer monoliths that are powering up. Hitting the center could lose us the battle.

tc_text: 所有的東西都必須被摧毀掉…但我害怕我們會不會過份自我擴張了。
en_text: Everything must be destroyed… but I fear we will overextend ourselves if we do not destroy the outer monoliths first.

tc_text: 啊，就放過它吧！我們沒辦法同時對抗外圍的浮石巨塔和中央！
en_text: Ah, leave it be! We cannot fight the outer monoliths and the center, all at once!

tc_text: 在外圍的浮石巨塔之前先攻擊中央，是非常危險的方式，它看起來就不會成功。
en_text: Attacking the center before the outer monoliths is a path fraught with great peril. It is unlikely to succeed.

tc_text: 這是個壞念頭，嘗試著在摧毀外圍的建築之前去攻擊中央。
en_text: Tis a bad prospect, trying to take the center before we have demolished the outer structures.

tc_text: 你在幹啥？首先我們先幹掉外面的浮石巨塔，接著幹掉中間的！聽到沒？
en_text: Wotchyou doin'? First we smash da outta monaliffs, then the middle one! 'Ear that?

tc_text: 同時攻擊外圍和內部堡壘的敵人是很不明智的事情，而外圍則是最大的威脅。
en_text: It would be unwise to maintain an assault on both the outer and inner fortresses of the enemy. And the outside is a much greater threat.

tc_text: 死亡…成長…飛出…殺戮…
en_text: Death… blooms… and flies… out… to kill…

tc_text: 它完成了…現在…你將會死亡…
en_text: It is complete… now… you will die…

tc_text: 醒過來！…醒來…並且…毀滅！
它…現在…回復了…它將…征服！
en_text: It is… restored… now… it will… vanquish!

tc_text: 你…不該…到這裡。
死…入侵者…
滾…回去！…
進入…蜘蛛的…網…
擁抱…死亡…你…不可能…逃得掉…
en_text: Embrace… death… you… cannot… escape it…

tc_text: 你認為…你…贏了...你…並沒有...
en_text: You think… you… have won… you… have not…

tc_text: 偉大的詐騙者…帶領他們…走向…他們的…死亡…
en_text: Great Deceiver… lead them… to… their… deaths…

tc_text: 我們已經發現了他們的空中單位，用你全部的力量攻擊，弟兄。
en_text: We've uncovered the source of their air units. Hit it with all you've got, men.

tc_text: 指揮官！我們發現了地獄爪的生產設施，等候你的命令來摧毀它們！
en_text: Commander! We've located the production facilities for the Hell Talons. Awaiting your orders to destroy them!

tc_text: 敵人的地獄爪工廠，我們必須毀掉它們！
en_text: The enemy's Hell Talon factories. We must destroy them!

tc_text: 那些是地獄爪的生產設施。把它們毀掉，空中就只屬於我們了。
en_text: There are the Hell Talon production facilities. Destroy those, and the air will be ours alone.

tc_text: 啊！我們發現了這些地獄爪的來源，把它給燒毀！
en_text: Ah! We have found the source of these Hell Talons. Burn it down!

tc_text: 那就是戰鬥機來的地方，讓我們好好的幹掉它。
en_text: Dat's where all da fightas is comin' from. Let's blast it up good.

tc_text: 地獄爪生產設施，我們該毀掉它。
en_text: The Hell Talon production compound. We should destroy it.

tc_text: 毀掉…飛機工廠…
直到星際戰士拋下他們的槍，倒下之後才算結束。
en_text: It is not over till the last Space Marine drops his gun and falls.

tc_text: 這變得容役了，他們將不會發現我們的來臨。
en_text: This is going to be easy. They will not see us coming.

tc_text: 血鴉！準備戰鬥！
閃電戰機！如果我們不幹掉生產設施，他們將會射擊任何我們在天空中的東西。
en_text: Lightning fighters! If we don't take out production facilities, they'll shoot everything we've got out of the air.

tc_text: 他們有了閃電戰機。我知道那些戰鬥機，我們最好毀掉它們的生產工廠。
en_text: They have Lightning aircraft. I know those fighters well. We had better take out their production facilities.

tc_text: 戰鬥機，很好…我們不能讓那些衝突存在。最好是找到它們的生產設施，然後將它毀掉。
en_text: Fighter planes. Well… we can't have those interfering. Best to find and level their production facilities.

tc_text: 如果我們不毀掉它們的工廠，那些飛機就將會控制天空了。
en_text: If we don't destroy their factories, those planes will control the skies!

tc_text: 空中武力…如果它們繼續在我們的頭上飛翔，燒毀它們的巢穴！
en_text: Air power… burn the nest and see if they keep flying about our heads!

tc_text: 戰鬥機，是嗎？孩子們，如果你看到戰鬥機從哪裡來，好好的幹掉那個地方！
en_text: Fightas, is it, then? Boyz, if you see where dem fightas is comin from, smash it good!

tc_text: 毀掉他們存放戰機的地方會很有幫助的。當然，他們在附近一定有生產設施。
en_text: It would be advantageous to remove their capacity for fighter jets. Surely they must have production facilities nearby.

tc_text: 找出…飛機工廠…毀掉它們…
我們必須阻止這些暴風戰機。找出它們的來處，然後將其摧毀。
en_text: We have to stop those Tempests. Find where they're coming from, and destroy it.

tc_text: 修女們，我們必須毀掉他們生產飛機的能力。
en_text: Sisters, we must disable their ability to produce aircraft.

tc_text: 我要把他們的飛機從天空打下來，將它們的工廠炸成碎片。
en_text: I want their aircraft shot out of the sky, and their factories blown to pieces.

tc_text: 我們必須找出飛機的源頭，然後將它毀掉。
en_text: We must find the origin of their aircraft, and destroy it.

tc_text: 我不喜歡這些飛在我們頭上的飛機。找出它們的生產設施，毀掉它們。
en_text: I do not like these planes flying at us. Find their production facilities, and destroy them.

tc_text: 毀掉這些飛行人類！我們要找到他們來的地方，射它們都是洞！
en_text: Gork stomp dose flyin' humies! We gotsta find where dey's comin' from and shoot 'em fulla holes!

tc_text: 烈焰戰士，找出它們的飛機工廠並且設法阻止這些暴風戰機的攻擊，對我們來說會是件很好的事情。
en_text: Fire Warriors, it would serve us well to find their air factories and put a stop to these Tempest attacks.

tc_text: 阻止..飛行的…東西…
讓那些戰鬥轟炸機騷擾我們，我們是絕對不會成功的。我們需要找出它們來的地方，然後將它給毀滅。
en_text: We'lll never make it through with those Fighter-Bombers harassing us. We' need to find out where they're coming from, and destroy it.

tc_text: 我可不想讓我的星際戰士在那些戰鬥轟炸機中前進。找出它們的源頭，然後把它給毀滅。
en_text: I do not want my Space Marines to just trying to march through all those Fighter-Bombers. Identify their point of origin, and neutralize it.

tc_text: 這些戰鬥轟炸機讓這個通道變的非常的危險。不管它們是從哪裡來的，一定要把那個地方夷為平地。
en_text: These Fighter-Bombers have made this passage too hazardous. Wherever they are coming from must be burnt to the ground.

tc_text: 詛咒這些戰鬥轟炸機！它們太致命了！不管它們是從哪裡來的，我都要把那個地方夷為平地。
en_text: A curse upon these bombers! They are too lethal. Whereever they're coming from, I want it destroyed!

tc_text: 不！退回去，戰士。我們必須從源頭切斷這些轟炸機，不然它們會讓我們失敗的。
en_text: No! Hold back, warriors. We must cut these bombers off at the source, or they will be our undoing.

tc_text: 眼睛放亮點！這個通道到處都是戰鬥轟炸機。在我們冒險進入通道之前，必須先阻止它們的生產。
en_text: Look sharp! The pass is filled with Fighter-Bombers. We must put a stop to their production, before we venture that way.

tc_text: 指揮官！這個通道被戰鬥轟炸機守衛著。在進行之前，我們最好先摧毀它們的生產工廠。
en_text: Commander! The pass ahead is well defended by Fighter-Bombers. We would do well to stop their production, before proceeding.

tc_text: 阻止…那些…轟炸機…
衛隊們，當心點！渾沌力場仍然在作用著，進入那裡，你就永遠出不來了。
en_text: Guardsmen, look sharp! That Chaos Field is still active. Go in there, and you're not coming out again.

tc_text: 星際戰士，等到我們奪下渾沌力場，就清空他們的中央基地。
en_text: Space Marines, steer clear of their central base until we've taken out that Chaos Field.

tc_text: 小心點，修女們！圍繞著他們中央設施的渾沌力場肥長的強大。你只要進去，就別想活著出來了。
en_text: Be wary, Sisters! The Chaos Field around their central compound is strong. Enter it, and you will surely perish.

tc_text: 別靠近渾沌力場！它會讓你速死！首先，我們必須想辦法關閉這個區域。
en_text: Do not go near the Chaos Field! It is certain death! We must find a way to bring the field down, first.

tc_text: 離那裡遠一點！在中央基地的能源會殺死你的，笨蛋。當時間到時我會讓你知道的。
en_text: Stay away from there! The energies in that central base will kill you, fools. I'll tell you when the time is right.

tc_text: 離開那裡，你這個愛哭鬼。你想把頭爆掉？我們要關掉這裡，再幹掉他們。
en_text: Get outta there, ya snivvelin grots. D'ya want yer head blowed up? We gotta get that field down, then smash 'em up.

tc_text: 我們必須跟他們的中央設施保持距離。現在有危險的能量保護著它，會讓接近的人立刻死亡。
en_text: We must keep our distance from their central compound. Dangerous energies protect it now, and it is certain death to enter.

tc_text: 還…沒有…
滾，褻瀆者！
滾！
你的武器對我的存在毫無影響。
en_text: Your guns are nothing in my presence.

tc_text: 啊，他們從這裡來！派出老大！派出飛行炸彈！派出坦克！派出所有的巨獸！吼～！
en_text: Arrr. Dey's comin' dis way! Send da Bombaz! Send da Nobz! Send da tanks! Bring all da Squiggoffs! Waaagh!

tc_text: 他們…不該…有…
指揮官，我們偵測到小型的死靈族營地，在我們基地的南方和西北方。如果我們沒有防備的話，他們會造成一些危害的。
en_text: Commander, we have identified small Necron encampments South and Northwest of our base. They could do some damage, if we left it unguarded.

tc_text: 指揮官，斥候在南方和西北方偵察到小型的死靈族前哨站，他們擁有足夠的力量來對我們的基地造成威脅。
en_text: Commander, scouts have located small Necron outposts at the South and Northwest. They have got sufficient strength to threaten our base.

tc_text: 大修女，傳教士在我們基地的南方和西北方偵察到小型的死靈族哨站。他們並不強大，但如果我們毫無防備的話…
en_text: Canoness, Missionaries have spied small Necron posts South and Northwest of our base of operations. They are not strong, but if our base were left unattended…

tc_text: 敬畏的大君！在我們基地的南方和西北方有小型的死靈族營地。你想要摧毀這些麻煩嗎？
en_text: Dreaded Lord! There are small Necron camps South and Northwest of our base. Do you wish us to destroy these nuisances?

tc_text: 先知，在我們魍道關口的南方和西北方發現了小型的前哨站。當他們存在時，我們不能讓基地毫無防備。
en_text: Farseer, small outposts have been spotted South and Northwest of our Webway Assembly. While they stand, we should not leave our base unguarded.

tc_text: 呸！小型的死靈族前哨站夾在我們營地的南方和西北方…我們該防衛我們的基地，還是毀掉這些害蟲呢？
en_text: Bah! Petty Necron outposts flank our camp to the South and Northwest. …shall we guard our base, or crush these pests?

tc_text: 頭子！頭子！更多他們！南方和西北。他們不是很大！
en_text: Boss! Boss! Dey's more of 'em! Souf and Norfwest. Ain't very big, tho!

tc_text: 指揮官！在我們基地的南方和西北方偵察到小型的死靈族哨站。如果我們沒有防備的話，他們會造成一些危害的。
en_text: Commander! Small Necron outposts have been identified to the South and Northwest of our base. They could do some damage, if we left ourselves undefended

tc_text: 他們認為自己很強大，但我們的奉獻讓我們的力量超越了凡人武器所能及的範圍。
en_text: They think themselves mighty. But our devotion grants us strength beyond the scope of mortal arms!

tc_text: 開火！開火，我的修女們！不要蹣跚，直到敵人化為灰燼之前都不要眨眼！
en_text: Fire! Fire, my sisters! Do not falter, do not blink until the enemy are cinders, cinders and ash!

tc_text: 瞧！那些起身對抗皇帝之人終將動搖，他們終會失敗。在他的信仰之下，他們終將毀滅、被燃燒、被埋入可怕的虛無之中。
en_text: And lo! Those who stand against the Emperor’s will shall ever falter; and they shall ever fail. By His Faithful they shall be crushed, they shall be burned, and surely cast into the pits of horrid void.

tc_text: 要知道我們絕對不會投降。每一個修女，直到最後，寧可神聖的犧牲，也不願意垂下她的雙臂。
en_text: Know that we shall never surrender. Every Sister, to the last, would rather die a holy martyr, in a field of flame, than lay down her arms.

tc_text: 崇高偉大的聖人，我祈求你，跟我們一起作戰。
en_text: Exalted and luminous Saint. I beg you, fight by our side.

tc_text: 我們將一起戰鬥，以皇帝的意志而行，我們終將勝利。
en_text: Together we will fight,and by the Emperor's will, we will triumph.

tc_text: 那裡是閃電戰機的工廠。剷平它們，弟兄，快點！
en_text: There are the Lightning fighter factories. Level them, men. Quickly!

tc_text: 修女的飛機工廠！毀掉它，現在！
en_text: The Sisters' air factories! Destroy it. Now!

tc_text: 毀滅…飛機工廠…
閃電戰機的生產設施，就在那邊！快，為了渾沌，剷平它。
en_text: The Lightning fighter production facilities. There it is! Quickly, lay waste to it, for Chaos!

tc_text: 瞧，那裡是飛機生產設施。快，它一定得被毀滅掉。
en_text: See, there are the air production facilities. Quickly, it must be destroyed.

tc_text: 啊！他們的閃電戰機生產設施。毀掉它！
en_text: Ah! Their lightning production facilities. Destroy it!

tc_text: 那是戰鬥機的地方，為了歐克，毀掉它！
en_text: Dat's where da fightas is. Wreck it, for da Orks!

tc_text: 啊！我們發現了他們的飛機工廠，我們必須快點來解決它們。
en_text: Ah! We have found their air factories. We should make haste to decommission them.

tc_text: 戰鬥修女製造廠！讓我們想辦法將它給解決掉。
en_text: The Adepta Sororitas Manufactorums! Let's see if we can take it out.

tc_text: 瞧，戰鬥修女製造廠。我們可以一勞永逸的解決這些驅魔者裝甲車了。
en_text: Look, the Sisters of Battle Manufactorums. We can put a stop to these Exorcist Tanks once and for all.

tc_text: 毀滅…生產工廠…
生產工廠！幹掉它們！
那就是驅魔者裝甲車生產的地方，把它給變成灰燼。
en_text: That is where their Exorcist Tanks are produced. Turn it to smoke and ash.

tc_text: 哈哈！敵人的生產工廠，活不久了…
en_text: Haha! The enemy's Manufactorums. Not for long…

tc_text: 我們現在發現生產工廠，我們要毀掉它。
en_text: Now we found the da Mannifaktorimz, all we gots ta do is smash it.

tc_text: 敵人的生產工廠！讓我們擊垮這些設施。
en_text: The enemy Manufactorums! Let us put a dent in their production.

tc_text: 地雷！以皇帝之名，當心地雷！
en_text: Mines! By the Emperor, look out for the mines!

tc_text: 修女們，當心點！地底下有地雷！
en_text: Sisters, be wary! There are mines underfoot!

tc_text: 地雷！當心！地雷！
小心的行動！他們在這裡埋了地雷！
en_text: Tread lightly! They have planted mines here!

tc_text: 喝！這裡有地雷，那也是我會玩的一個把戲。
en_text: Gah! There are mines here. That's the sort of trick I would play.

tc_text: 小心！這裡有地雷！
當心，烈焰戰士！他們為我們設置了地雷！
en_text: Caution, Fire Warriors! They seek to trick us with mines!

tc_text: 地雷…
長官，我們對那邊是盲目的，在那裡只剩下了幾個信標而以。
en_text: Sir, we are blind down there, there are only a couple beacons left.

tc_text: 把我們從他們那邊拿到的丟回去，我們需要讓他們失去判斷。
en_text: Throw what we've got at them. We just need to keep them disoriented.

tc_text: 是的，長官。
防衛空中區域！
那麼那就是犀牛裝甲運輸車來的地方了。
en_text: So this is where the Rhinos were coming from.

tc_text: 啊…這就是犀牛裝甲運輸車來的地方。
en_text: Ah… this is where their Rhino Transports come from.

tc_text: 主人！瞧，那就是犀牛裝甲運輸車來的地方。
en_text: Master! Look, that's where the Rhino Transports are coming from.

tc_text: 先知，很確定的這就是他們所有運輸車來的地方。
en_text: Farseer, surely this is where all their transports have been coming from.

tc_text: 我們找到它了，所有那些裝甲運輸車來的來源地。
en_text: The source of all those armored transports. We have found it.

tc_text: 啊哈！我們找到製造運輸車的工廠。
en_text: Ahaha! We found da shops dey makin' da transports from.

tc_text: 指揮官，這一定是所有犀牛裝甲運輸車的來源地。
en_text: Commander, this must be the source of all the Rhino tanks.

tc_text: 找出…它們…
帝國防衛軍接盡了。星際戰士，做好準備，就這樣。
en_text: The Imperial Guard approaches. Space Marines, make ready. This is it.

tc_text: 戰鬥修女接盡了，準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: The Sisters of Battle approach. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 血鴉！墮落的叛徒接近了，現在要讓他們知道真正的信仰是如何產生的。
en_text: Blood Ravens! The foul traitors approach. Now they learn what the true and faithful are made of.

tc_text: 神靈族的軍隊接近了，準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: The Eldar army approaches. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 可悲的暗黑神靈族接盡了，將你自己準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: The wretched Dark Eldar draw near. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 綠皮膚正在進入我們的基地。將你自己準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: Greenskins are entering our base. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 鈦星軍隊接近了。將你自己準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: The Tau army approaches. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 死靈族接近了。將你自己準備好，血鴉戰士。
en_text: The Necrons approach. Ready yourself, Blood Ravens.

tc_text: 深入打擊，部署！部署！將你所有的東西都派出去！你聽到了沒？你所有的東西！
en_text: Deep strike, deploy! Deploy! Send everything you have got! Do you read me? Everything you've got!

tc_text: 笨蛋…你必須…釋放…更多…的能量…
en_text: Fools… you have… released… more… power…

tc_text: 更多…能量！…他們….得死！
所有…能量…去吧…我…指揮…
en_text: All … energy … go… I … command it ..

tc_text: 死。
拿…回來…
需要…能量…得到…能量！
能量…流失…
長官，我們偵測到能量正從中心外的點輸送到每一個在外圍的浮石巨塔。將軍，如果我們能夠奪下這些點，我們就可以阻止能量的傳輸。
en_text: Sir, we’ve determined that power is flowing to each of the outer monoliths at a point just outside the center. If we can take those points, General, we can stop the flow of power.

tc_text: 指揮官，感應器偵測到從中央基地傳送到四個外圍浮石巨塔的能量輸送。在每一條路徑上都有一個點，就在基地之外。如果我們控制了這些點，我們就可以關掉能源的輸送了。
en_text: Commander, sensors have identified power flow from the central base to the four outer monoliths. There is a point at each path, just outside the center. If we hold it, we can turn the power off.

tc_text: 夫人，我們偵測到在中央基地外部的四個點，每一個點負責提供每一個外圍浮石巨塔的能量。如果我們拿下這些點，就可以控制能量，我們也就可以阻止浮石巨塔了。
en_text: Mistress, we have identified four points outside the central base. Each is provides power to one of the outer monoliths. If we took those points, we could stop them from powering up.

tc_text: 阿爾發軍團，我們發現了中央基地外部的四個點，每一個點負責提供每一個外圍浮石巨塔的能量。拿下這些點，我們就可以控制能量，也就可以阻止浮石巨塔了。
en_text: Alpha Legion, we've seen four points just outside the center. Each point provides power to one of the outer monoliths. Take these points, and we control the power. We stop the monoliths.

tc_text: 先知，我們偵察到在死靈族中央基地外部的四個點，每一個點負責提供每一個外圍浮石巨塔的能量。我們可以藉由奪下這些點，來阻止能量的傳輸。
en_text: Farseer, we have located four points just outside the central Necron base. Each is a gate that provides power to one of the outer monoliths. We can stop the flow of power by taking these points.

tc_text: 戰士們！聽我說。在死靈基地的外部有四個點，用來向外圍的浮石巨塔輸送能量。如果我們想要停止浮石巨塔的回復，我們就必須奪下這些點！
en_text: Warriors! Listen to me. There are four points, just outside the central Necron base. It is through these that the outer monoliths are being powered. If we are to halt the restoration of the monoliths, we must take these points!

tc_text: 老大！老大！工程師孩子發現，看，中間外面四個點，對吧？它們傳能量到浮石巨塔。我們要幹掉它們，浮石巨塔就停！
en_text: Boss! Boss! Da Mek Boyz figgered it out. See, dey's four points near the middle, right? Dat's how da power gets to da outer monoliffs. All we gotta do is take dem, and da monoliffs stop!

tc_text: 指揮官，我們的感應器偵測到在死靈中央基地外的四個重要位置，每個位置都負責傳送能量到外圍的浮石巨塔。如果我們拿下這些點，我們就可以阻止浮石巨塔的充能動作了。
en_text: Commander, our sensors have identified four critical locations just outside the central Necron base. Each of these channels power to the outer monoliths. If we take these points, we can stop those monoliths from being powered up.

tc_text: 長官，我們的斥候發現不遠的地方有座基地，就在這個攻擊來源的方向。
en_text: Sir, our scouts have spotted a base not far off, in the direction that this attack came from.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們偵察到在攻擊來源的方向有一個小型的軍事營地。
en_text: Commander, our reconnaissance has identified a small military encampment in the direction of the attack.

tc_text: 大君！大君！我們發現了，發現了一座效忠者營地。它很近！就在他們攻擊我們的方向！
en_text: Lord! Lord! We have seen, seen a Loyalist camp. It is near! It is from there they attacked us.

tc_text: 那裡…有一座小型的戰鬥營地，離這裡非常近，我們應該從上次他們攻擊的方位去尋找。
en_text: There is… a small warcamp. Very near here. We should look for it in the direction of their last assault.

tc_text: Tahril統治者！我們的曼陀羅發現了一個營地，就在這裡不遠的地方…他們說在上次攻擊的方位。
en_text: Archon Tahril! Our Mandrakes have spied a camp, not far from here… they said it was in the direction of that last attack.

tc_text: 戰爭頭目！我的孩子看到燃燒人營地，那是基地，很近。讓我們停他！
en_text: Warboss! Me an’ some boyz saw where da burny-humies came from. Dey’s a base, an’ it’s real close. Let’s stomp it!

tc_text: 指揮官，這個攻擊來自於離我們相當近的一個營地，或許它該是我們的第一個目標？
en_text: Commander, the attack originated in a camp extremely close to our own location. Perhaps that should be our first target?

tc_text: 他們…來自附近…摧毀他們…那邊…
en_text: They came… from nearby… crush them… there…

tc_text: 我們的虔誠引領著我們作戰。召集好十字軍，我們向勝利前進！
en_text: Our piety leads us to battle. Gather the crusade, we march to victory!

tc_text: 向十字軍致敬，將死亡帶給敵人！
en_text: To the crusade, and death to the enemy!

tc_text: 充滿著信念，我們向前行！從修道院到修道院，我們的數目增長，我們的力量增強！
en_text: Full of faith, we march! From Convent to Convent, our numbers grow, and so our might!

tc_text: 這個地方是神聖的，依皇帝之名，你的足跡不該踏入這地方！
en_text: This place is sacred. You shall not set foot here, in the Emperor’s name!

tc_text: 你的褻瀆會被阻止！
修女們，我們的敵人擾亂了兩座神殿。我們必須保衛僅存的兩座神殿，來延續我們最後也最虔誠的生存！
en_text: Sisters, our foes have shattered two of the shrines. We must defend the remaining two, to our last pious breaths!

tc_text: 神殿…被毀…
我的神殿…被毀滅..！我們的悲痛！
en_text: My Shrines… in ruins! Woe unto us!

tc_text: 我們被遺棄了…全沒了？現在，我們必須戰鬥。修女們，我們必須榮耀的作戰！
en_text: We are forsaken… is all lost? And yet, we must fight. Sisters, we must fight, and go in glory!

tc_text: 好吧，兄弟們，我們必須快速的建立灘頭堡。首先，我們需要穿越這些外圍的防禦。
en_text: Alright, men. We need to make a beachhead, and fast. First, we need to break through these outer defenses.

tc_text: 血鴉！我們的目標是建立一個立足點，我們必須快速的通過這些外圍的防禦。
en_text: Blood Ravens! Our objective is to establish a foothold. We will have to blast through these perimeter defenses, and quickly.

tc_text: 修女們，我們的目標盡快的破壞這些外圍的防禦，然後在那邊須建立起灘頭堡。我們必須快速的敵動。攻擊！
en_text: Sisters, our aim is to breach these outer defenses with all due haste. From there we must establish a beachhead, from which to launch our attack.

tc_text: 聽我說，阿爾發軍團。首先，在這邊，我們衝過外圍的防禦。接著我們必須建立一個基地營。我們的動作要迅速，攻擊！
en_text: Listen to me, Alpha Legion. First, we blast through the outer defenses, here. Then we must establish a base camp. We move quickly. Attaaack!

tc_text: 我們必須用致命的速度和準度來移動。在他們發現我們之前，我們要通過外部防禦，然後在鈦星基地旁建立一個立足之處，這是很重要的一件事情。
en_text: We must prepare to move with deadly speed and accuracy. It is critical that we break through the outer defenses and establish a foothold within the Tau base, before they can pinpoint our location.

tc_text: 聽我說，你們這些狗。我們必須像一把致命的刀刃般的行動。我們必須通過前方的防禦，接著，像閃電般的迅速，清出一塊灘頭堡。你們聽清楚了嗎？聽懂了沒？很好，那我們出發吧。
en_text: Listen to me, you dogs. We must move as a single, lethal blade. We must cut through the defenses ahead of us, and then, as swift as lightning, clear a foothold for ourselves. Do you understand? Do you? Good. Then we go.

tc_text: 聽我，這計畫。我們移動，很快，懂嗎？我們快通過，我們進去。我們建一個營地，懂嗎？好。
en_text: Lissen up 'ere. Dis 'ere's da plan. We move, fast, see? We knock through 'em all fast, till we're inside. Then we build a camp. Got it? Good.

tc_text: 進入…那邊…
我們被攻擊了！烈焰戰士，守護好你的區域！我們得拖住他們，越久越好！
en_text: We are under attack! Fire Warriors, hold your ground! We must hold them back for as long as possible!

tc_text: 指揮官，這股突襲的力量讓我擔憂。告訴我，甚麼時候我才會有援軍來為我們護航？
en_text: The strength of this surprise attack is worrying to me, Commander. Tell me, when can we expect the fleet of reinforcements that followed my own ship?

tc_text: 智者，如你所知，曲速風暴讓我們的一般導航設備失去了作用。艦隊是由在Nan Yanoi的三沒信標所導引的，只要那三個信標還有作用，風暴應該不會持續太久的。
en_text: Wise One, as you know, the Warp Storm has made our normal navigation equipment useless. The fleet is guided by three beacons within Nan Yanoi. As long as all three signals operate, it should not be long.

tc_text: 很好，我怕我們還需要額外的部隊。
en_text: This is well. I fear we may yet need these extra troops.

tc_text: 軌道防禦系統準備發射。
他們正企圖奪取軌道防禦系統的控制！我們得不計任何代價來阻止他們！
en_text: They are attempting to seize the Orbital Defense controls! We must stop them at all costs!

tc_text: 指揮官。他們奪取了軌道防禦系統的控制，他們用我們的防禦系統來對付我們！
en_text: Commander, they have taken control of the Orbital Defense System. They use our defenses against us.

tc_text: 必須把它重新奪回來，別忘了！
en_text: It must be retaken. See to it.

tc_text: 我們已經奪回了軌道防禦系統！
en_text: We have reclaimed the orbital defenses!

tc_text: 不！他們把軌道火砲奪回去了！
en_text: No! They have taken back the defensive cannon!

tc_text: 他們已經毀滅了一個導引信標！
en_text: They have destroyed one of the guidance beacons!

tc_text: 啊…這真是不幸。不過，依靠著兩個導引信標的強度，我們的艦隊還不會遭遇嚴重的拖延。
en_text: Ah... this is unfortunate. Still, on the strength of two guidance signals, our fleet will not be greatly delayed.

tc_text: 指揮官！另一個導引信標被摧毀了！
en_text: Commander! Another guidance beacon was destroyed!

tc_text: 這真是一個大挫敗，只依賴一個導引信標是非常困難的事情，我們無法期待艦隊順利的到達了。
en_text: This is a great setback. To follow a single guidance beacon will be exceedingly difficult. We cannot expect the fleet any time soon.

tc_text: 所有三個信標都毀滅了，指揮官，我們沒希望了嗎？
en_text: All three guidance beacons taken out. Commander, is all hope lost?

tc_text: 我們將沒有援軍了。沒有了信標，艦隊會折返回去的，我們現在要靠自己來對抗敵人了。
en_text: We will receive no reinforcements. Without a signal, the fleet must turn back. We must defeat the enemy as we are.

tc_text: 很棒的消息，乙太導師，我們的艦隊不久就會到了。
en_text: Excellent news, Ethereal. Our fleet will not be long.

tc_text: 未來一片美好，我們現在只要守到那個時候就可以了。
en_text: It is exceedingly good fortune. We have only to hold out until then.

tc_text: 指揮官，艦隊到達了！
所有的士兵都武裝完成，準備作戰。
en_text: All soldiers are armed and ready for combat.

tc_text: 太好了，我更進一步的命令已經被收到了。來吧，是把這些入侵者趕出Nan Yanoi的時刻了！
en_text: Excellent, my advanced orders were received. Come, it is time to drive these intruders off of Nan Yanoi.

tc_text: 空級！敵人接近我們上方了，我們需要你的支援。這是我們最後的機會，攻擊我們給你的座標，別用任何理由拖延了。
en_text: Air Caste! The enemy is close upon us. We require your assistance. This is our last chance. Strike at the coordinates I give you, and do not hold fire for any reason.

tc_text: 收到座標，我們將會立刻進行！
en_text: Coordinates received. We will commence at once!

tc_text: 他們不斷的接近著我們，我命令你，用我們靈魂牢籠的所有力量來對付他們。
en_text: They have been allowed to get far too close to us. Use all the powers of our Soul Cages against them. I command it.

tc_text: 是的，維克大君。最好是用那些靈魂來毀滅這些--這些驕傲的人。
en_text: Yes, Lord Vect. It is better to use those souls, and annihilate these – these upstarts.

tc_text: 那就去吧--你最好不要失敗。
en_text: Then go – and see to it that you do not fail.

tc_text: 你以為你可以逃開我們嗎？
en_text: You thought you could elude us?

tc_text: 你無法躲在這裡，我們全都看見了，你將會死在我們的手中。
en_text: You cannot hide here. We see all, and you will die by our hands.

tc_text: 躲藏？我想不要吧。
我們的力量你無法想像。
en_text: We wield powers you cannot even imagine.

tc_text: 你受苦的時間到了！
en_text: The time of your suffering is about to begin!

tc_text: 看看你會怎樣喜歡我們…現在！
en_text: See how you like us... now!

tc_text: 進入警戒等級五。
東區向指揮中心報告，毀滅之劍重裝戰車護衛隊已經被派遣上路了。
en_text: Eastern Annex to Central Command. Baneblade convoy has been dispatched and is currently en route.

tc_text: 這個區域都是敵人，我要那些貨物被好好的守護，讓它們安全抵達是非常重要的事。
en_text: With the enemy in the area, I want those convoys well guarded. Safe delivery of those convoys is critical!

tc_text: 將軍，另一批貨物到達了。
太好了！
敵人看來已經清楚貨物正在運送中。我知道！命令兩個護衛隊同時出發，他們不可能在同個時間出現在每一個地方！
en_text: The enemy seems to have learned the routes that are convoys are taking. I know! Order two convoys dispatched at the same time. They can't be everywhere at once!

tc_text: 有誰能告訴我為什麼毀滅之劍重裝戰車還沒上場？
en_text: Someone tell me why we don't have a Baneblade out in the field, yet?

tc_text: 長官，沒有一台是可以用的，我們還需要等待另一半的貨物到達。
en_text: Sir, none are fully operational. We have about half the number of convoy shipments required.

tc_text: 將軍，有一輛毀滅之劍重裝戰車已經可以完全操作，準備上場作戰了。
en_text: General, one Baneblade is fully prepared and combat-ready.

tc_text: 終於！盡快把它派上場。讓運送繼續進行，我們將會獲得更多的火力，來讓我們對付這些混蛋。
en_text: At last! Get it onto the field as soon as possible. Keep the convoys coming. We'll take as much firepower as we can against these bastards.

tc_text: 將軍，我們有一輛毀滅之劍重裝戰車可以準備作戰了。
en_text: General, we have a Baneblade ready for combat.

tc_text: 終於！立刻派它上陣。
en_text: Finally! Its orders are to engage immediately.

tc_text: 我們的戰神研發總部！好吧…那些貨物現在對我們沒用了。
en_text: Our Mars Pattern buildings! Well… the convoys are useless to us now.

tc_text: 他們攻擊了我們的毀滅之劍重裝戰車的生產設施…我們正在失去它們！如果他們認為那只是我們唯一能作的事…軍官，我們要戰到最後一刻，你聽懂我說的嗎？
en_text: They've thrown a wrench in our Baneblade production… We're just going to have to do without them! If they think that's all we've got up our sleeves… Officer, we fight unto the last, do you understand me?

tc_text: 是的，長官。
任何棄守崗哨的士兵將殺無赦，我們仍可以獲勝的！
en_text: Any soldier caught abandoning his post is to be shot without further questioning. We can still win this!

tc_text: 拿好武器！拿好武器，弟兄！他們正在攻擊自走砲！將它防衛好！用你的生命去守衛它！
en_text: To arms! To arms, men! They're attacking the Basilisk Magnus! Defend it with your lives!

tc_text: 這些該死的惡魔！他們奪走了我們的石化蜥蜴級自走砲！
en_text: Curse these fiends! They've taken out our Basilisk Magnus!

tc_text: 我們所有的火砲觀測員都被殺了？這怎麼可能？
en_text: All our artillery spotters were killed? How can that be?

tc_text: 讓掠奪者轟炸機生產設施運作起來，我們需要用所有的東西來痛擊他們。
en_text: Get Marauder Bomber production up and running. We need to hit them with everything we've got.

tc_text: 長官，掠奪者轟炸機生產設施命令已經確認，我們的的轟炸機正在進行近距離的突襲演習。
en_text: Marauder production orders confirmed, Sir. Our bombers are closing in for close-range assault maneuvers.

tc_text: 將軍，我們的掠奪者生產設施正在遭遇攻擊！
en_text: General, our Marauder production facility is being attacked!

tc_text: 增加一些火力，把他們打回去！
en_text: Put some firepower on it. Drive them back!

tc_text: 女武神級運輸機開始進行空投。
好！很好！
準備女武神級運輸機的降落…
女武神級運輸機，進場。
嘿，嘿，我看到你了。
en_text: Heh heh. I see ya now.

tc_text: 看那邊，他們正試著偷偷越過我們。
en_text: Look here. They're tryin' to sneak past us.

tc_text: 躲躲藏藏的小…想在帝國衛隊的眼前溜過嗎？。
en_text: Sneaky little... Tryin' to use stealth on the Imperial Guard!

tc_text: 這些毀滅之劍重裝戰車到底能不能動？
en_text: Can any of these inactive Baneblades run at all?

tc_text: 將軍，只有一點點，但是它們--
我不管，把人給我丟進去。至少它們還可以射擊…至少有一些砲還可以！
en_text: I don't care. Put men in them. They can least fire... some of the guns!

tc_text: 你比不過帝國衛隊的。
en_text: You can't outgun the Imperial Guard.

tc_text: 第252防衛軍團，為了皇帝的榮耀！
en_text: 252nd Conservator Regiment, for the glory of the Imperium!

tc_text: 戰士們，為了你所有的價值而戰！我們必須贏得這場戰爭！
en_text: Fight for all you're worth, soldiers! We've got to win this!

tc_text: 快點建造，我突然有個預感，這將不會那麼的容易…
en_text: Get building immediately. I've suddenly got a feeling this won't be easy…

tc_text: 快點工作，並且準備移動，我們不曉得有甚麼東西在我們的前方。
en_text: Work quickly and prepare to mobilize. We do not know what is ahead of us.

tc_text: 立刻進行，我們現在必須準備面對最艱困的難關。
en_text: Commence immediately. We must now be prepared for the most arduous struggle.

tc_text: 那麼，我們的夜翼生產設施已經被摧毀，我看我們離勝利是越來越遠、也越困難了。不過，仍然還是有希望的。
en_text: So, our Nightwing production has been destroyed. I see our many roads to victory growing fewer and more arduous. Yet, there is still hope.

tc_text: 先知，夜翼的菁英級閃耀之鷹小隊停留在它們被指派的地方。
en_text: The elite Shining Eagle squadron of Nightwings remain where they were assigned, Farseer.

tc_text: 很好，我們必須加緊動作。
在幻象跟陰影間疲憊的射擊？我們總是可以避開你的。當你還可以時，馬上就離開吧。
en_text: Weary of firing at shadows and illusions? We will always elude you. Leave now, while you can.

tc_text: 另一個幻象障礙被清除了，先知。
en_text: Another illusion barrier was destroyed, Farseer.

tc_text: 我知道了…我們該準備面對最糟的狀況。
en_text: I see… We shall prepare for the worst.

tc_text: 那麼另一個一定也淪陷了…
en_text: Then the other ones must not fall…

tc_text: 讓我們瞧瞧他們要怎樣對付閃耀之鷹，他們可不是一般的飛行員。
en_text: Let us see how they deal with the Shining Eagles. They are no ordinary pilots.

tc_text: 即便是我們的閃耀之鷹小隊也無法阻止他們？
en_text: Even our Shining Eagle Squadron could not stop them!

tc_text: 先知，我們已經失去了遊俠和次元蜘蛛設施了。
en_text: Farseer, we have lost our Ranger and Warp Spider facilities.

tc_text: 他們高貴的死亡將會受到表彰，現在只有勝利才是最重要的了。
en_text: Their noble deaths will be honored. Only victory matters now.

tc_text: 當心那些巡邏。
小心一點，士兵，這個區域到處都是巡邏。
en_text: Look sharp, Marines. Patrols are in the area.

tc_text: 當心，修女們，我看到了巡邏小隊。
en_text: Caution, Sisters. I see guard patrols.

tc_text: 帝國衛隊巡邏小隊！現在...我們應該避免被發現。
en_text: Guard patrols! We should avoid detection… for now.

tc_text: 我們得當心這些巡邏守衛。
en_text: We must be wary of these guard patrols.

tc_text: 當心，孩子，守衛在巡邏。
en_text: Wotchout, boyz, da guards is on patrol.

tc_text: 守衛正在巡邏，戰士們，小心移動。
en_text: Guards on patrol. Move with caution, warriors.

tc_text: 當心…守衛…
觀測員備便。
長官，我們的掃描器顯示出他們只剩下了兩個信標。
en_text: Sir, our scanners show there are only two beacons left.

tc_text: 大修女，掃描器偵測到只剩下兩枚信標。
en_text: Canoness, scanners indicate only two beacons remaining.

tc_text: 只剩下兩枚信標了，我們必須毀滅它們。它們一定是被重兵防衛，這我可不會懷疑的。
en_text: Not more than two beacons remain. We must destroy them. They will be heavily defended, I do not doubt it.

tc_text: 他們只剩下兩枚信標了。是的…我可以感測到它們。
en_text: There cannot be more than a couple beacons remaining. Yes… I can sense them.

tc_text: 統治者，只剩下兩枚信標了。要摧毀兩枚信標會有多困難呢？
en_text: Archon, only two beacons remain. How hard can it be to destroy two more?

tc_text: 終於兩個信標，老大。我們幹掉它們光光。
en_text: At's all but two of 'em, Boss. We smash 'em and no more 'umies outta da sky.

tc_text: 指揮官，我們的感應器顯示只剩下兩枚信標，我們離勝利越來越近了！
en_text: Commander, our sensors show that only two beacons remain. We close in on victory!

tc_text: 只有…兩枚…留著…
目標進入視野，發射獵人搜尋者飛彈…現在。
en_text: The target is in view. Fire Hunter Seeker missile… now.

tc_text: 我要把指揮官從戰鬥中除掉，立刻派出刺客。
en_text: I want the commanders taken out of combat. Dispatch the assassins. Immediately.

tc_text: 將軍，我們的掠奪者生產設施被摧毀了！它們奪取了我們的空中支援！
en_text: General, our Marauder factories have been destroyed! They've taken out our air support!

tc_text: 使用滑鼠左擊（左鍵點擊），可以選擇單位或是建築物。到你的基地，然後選擇艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Ecclesiarchal Chapel.

tc_text: 使用滑鼠左擊（左鍵點擊），可以選擇單位或是建築物。到你的基地，然後選擇艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Ecclesiarchal Chapel.

tc_text: 選擇你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂，然後尋找位於螢幕右下角落的傳教士圖像。現在就點選這個圖像。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Chapel and look for the Missionary icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 很好！現在你擁有了傳教士。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Missionary.

tc_text: 使用傳教士來佔領一個戰略位置，佔領和解放戰略位置可以獲得更多的軍備。
en_text: Use a Missionary to capture a Strategic Point. Capturing and securing Strategic Points earns more Requisition.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠右鍵點選，來命令傳教士佔領一個戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Missionary to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 選擇你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂，來生產艾克黎西亞奇僕役。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Chapel and build an Ecclesiarchal Servitor.

tc_text: 艾克黎西亞奇僕役可以用來建造額外的建築物，艾克黎西亞奇僕役通常伴隨著艾克黎西亞禮拜堂存在。
en_text: Ecclesiarchal Servitors are required to build additional structures. These Servitors are always available from the Ecclesiarchal Chapel.

tc_text: 艾克黎西亞奇僕役已經抵達！艾克黎西亞奇僕役是戰鬥修女的建築單位，任何時候你想要建造一個新的建築，你就必須使用艾克黎西亞僕役。
en_text: The Ecclesiarchal Servitor has arrived! Ecclesiarchal Servitors are the builder unit for the Sisters of Battle. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use an Ecclesiarchal Servitor.

tc_text: 選擇艾克黎西亞奇僕役並且點選螢幕右下角的建築圖像，這樣會出現目前艾克黎西亞奇僕役所有能建造的建築物。點選監聽哨圖像，並將它安置在佔領的戰略位置之上。
en_text: Select the Servitor and click on the Build icon in the lower right area of the screen. This brings up the icons of all the structures the Servitor can construct. Click on the Listening Post icon and build it on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 點選你的僕役來製造一座電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Servitor and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 你現在擁有了電力！電漿發電機會以一個固定的速率來生產電力，要注意每一座艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂生產電漿發電場的數量限制。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Ecclesiarchal Chapel.

tc_text: 點選你的艾克黎西亞奇僕役來建造戰鬥修女修道院。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Servitor and build an Adepta Sororitas Convent.

tc_text: 修道院可以讓你製造更多戰鬥修女的步兵單位，還有她們的指揮官單位，大修女。
en_text: The Convent is the structure where you build most Sisters of Battle's infantry units, as well as their commander unit, the Canoness.

tc_text: 很好，現在戰鬥修女修道院已經完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Adepta Sororitas Convent is finished.

tc_text: 點選你的戰鬥修女修道院來建造戰鬥修女部隊。
en_text: Select your Adepta Sororitas Convent and build a Battle Sister Squad.

tc_text: 這些勇猛的部隊，是戰鬥修女的基本步兵單位。雖然她們不像她們的同盟星際戰士那般的耐用，但她們的功能更為多樣，同時還可以裝備各種不同的武器，讓她們可以執行各種不同的任務。
en_text: These fierce troops are the basic infantry of the Sisters of Battle. Although not as durable as their Space Marine allies, they are versatile and equipped with a variety of abilities and weapons that let them handle nearly any task.

tc_text: 很好，你已經完成了一支戰鬥修女小隊。
en_text: Excellent. You have built a Battle Sister Squad.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的小隊戰力提升至最高。請選取戰鬥修女部隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness. Select a Battle Sister Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 一旦有戰鬥修女不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a Sister falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 恭喜！你已經強化了戰鬥修女部隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have Reinforced your Battle Sister Squad.

tc_text: 每一個神聖圖像可以增加你可以建造載具和部隊的最大數量。當超過部隊和載具的最大數量限制後，你就無法製造任何單位。
en_text: Each Holy Icon also increases the maximum number of squads and vehicles you can build. There is always a maximum Squad and Vehicle Cap beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 信仰是戰鬥修女獨特的第三種資源。你目前的信仰等級，將會顯示在軍備資源和電力資源的下方。
en_text: Faith is a third resource type that is unique to the Sisters of Battle. Your current level of Faith is displayed slightly below your Requisition and Power resources.

tc_text: 信仰是使用「信仰行動」這種特殊能力時，所需要的資源。這些特殊能力比一般能力更為強大，可以很容易的轉變戰場上的情勢。好好的使用它們吧。
en_text: Faith is used for special abilities called Acts of Faith. These are much more powerful than normal abilities, and can easily turn the tide of a battle. Use them wisely.

tc_text: 累積信仰的主要方式，就是建造信仰單位。
en_text: The primary method of generating Faith is by creating Faithful units.

tc_text: 信仰同時可以利用傳教士在監聽哨中禮拜來獲得。
en_text: Faith can also be gained by using Missionaries to worship at Listening Posts.

tc_text: 點選你的傳教士小隊，然後右鍵點擊一座監聽哨。
en_text: Select your Missionary Squad and right-click on a Listening Post.

tc_text: 很好，傳教士現在正忙著禮拜神聖皇帝，來增加你的信仰。當心，在這個模式中，他們將無法戰鬥，甚至在遭受攻擊時也無法保護自己。
en_text: Excellent. The Missionaries are now busy worshipping the God-Emperor, increasing your Faith. Be careful, though - while in this mode, they cannot fight, and won't even defend themselves if attacked.

tc_text: 另一個獲得信仰的方法是建造信仰單位。
en_text: Another method of gathering Faith is by building Faithful units.

tc_text: 其中一個信仰單位是大修女，這是戰鬥修女的主要英雄單位。
en_text: One Faithful unit is the Canoness, the primary hero of the Sisters of Battle.

tc_text: 現在點選戰鬥修女修道院來建造一個大修女。
en_text: Select the Adepta Sororitas Convent and build a Canoness now.

tc_text: 懷著燃燒的正義復仇之心，大修女使用強大的特殊能力和沈重的近戰攻擊來傷害敵人。
en_text: Burning with righteous vengeance, the Canoness lays waste to her enemies with powerful special abilities and punishing melee attacks.

tc_text: 恭喜！你現在已經完成建造一個大修女了，你的信仰資源現在將提升到比較快的生產速率。
en_text: Congratulations! You have finished building the Canoness. Your Faith resource will now increase at a faster rate.

tc_text: 現在點選你的艾克黎西亞奇僕役來製造一座上古聖殿。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Servitor and build a Pristine Sanctuary now.

tc_text: 你必須建造一座上古聖殿來進行武器的升級。部隊可以裝備不同的武器，讓你來跟不同型式的敵人進行對抗。
en_text: You must build a Pristine Sanctuary in order to access weapon upgrades. Squads can be equipped with a variety of weaponry, allowing you to prepare them against different enemy types.

tc_text: 很好，上古聖殿現在已經完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Pristine Sanctuary is complete.

tc_text: 上古聖殿可以讓你的步兵部隊使用重型武器（升級戰鬥修女部隊使用火焰噴射器）。
en_text: The Pristine Sanctuary unlocks access to heavy weaponry for your infantry squads. Upgrade a Battle Sister Squad with Flamers.

tc_text: 點選你的戰鬥修女部隊，並點選升級：火焰噴射器圖像，來為一位部隊成員升級。
en_text: Select your Battle Sister Squad and click the Upgrade: Flamer icon to upgrade a squad member.

tc_text: 注意有一個火焰噴射器出現在你部隊的一個成員的手中，這個程序可以適用於任何現存的武器升級。
en_text: Notice that a Flamer appears in one of your squad member's hands. This procedure can be performed with any of the available weapon upgrades.

tc_text: 你只能讓一定數量的成員配備這些強力武器，但是藉由上古聖殿的升級研究，你可以升級開啟更多的武器項目。
en_text: Initially you can only upgrade a few units of each squad with heavy weapons. By doing further research at the Pristine Sanctuary you can unlock the capability to upgrade more.

tc_text: 很好，你已經為戰鬥修女完成武器升級。你可以為戰場上任何地點的部隊進行武器升級，為他們提供適合用來對付敵人的武器。
en_text: Excellent. You have upgraded your Battle Sister Squad. You can upgrade your squads anywhere on the battlefield to weapons that are well suited to counter your enemy.

tc_text: 現在是升級你的總部，艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂的時刻了。藉由研究艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂的升級，你可以獲得全新的武器、單位和力量。
en_text: It is time to upgrade the Ecclesiarchal Chapel, your headquarters. By researching the Ecclesiarchal Cathedral upgrade, you will gain access to a whole new array of weaponry, units, and powers.

tc_text: 選擇禮拜堂，並點選升級艾克黎西亞奇大教堂圖像。
en_text: Select the Chapel and click the Upgrade to Ecclesiarchal Cathedral icon.

tc_text: 有些部隊，像是戰鬥修女部隊，可以加入一位領袖。領袖是一個具有高度技巧的戰士，可以加入一些戰鬥修女小隊。如果你想要擊敗你的敵人，那麼你就需要一位強力的領袖。
en_text: Some squads, like Battle Sister Squads, can add a Leader. Leaders are highly skilled warriors that can be added to some Sisters of Battle squads. You will need strong leaders if you are to defeat your enemies.

tc_text: 選擇戰鬥修女部隊，然後點選增加領袖：資深軍官圖像。
en_text: Select a Battle Sister Squad and click the Add Leader: Veteran Superior icon.

tc_text: 資深軍官是英勇的領袖，能為你的小隊添加更多的能力。
en_text: Veteran Superiors are valiant leaders that greatly increase your squad's capabilities.

tc_text: 很好，你的資深軍官已經抵達了。注意你的領袖是隊伍的一部份，同時並不能離開隊伍。
en_text: Excellent! Your Veteran Superior has arrived. Note that your Leaders are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 確認使用你的艾克黎西亞奇僕役，在任何被佔領的戰略點上來建造監聽哨。這個防禦工事可以幫助你來對抗你的敵人。
en_text: Make sure to use your Ecclesiarchal Servitor to build Listening Posts on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 點選你的艾克黎西亞奇僕役來建造戰鬥修女製造廠。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Servitor and build a Manufactorum.

tc_text: 如同修道院建造步兵單位一般，製造廠可以用來建造車輛。
en_text: Just like the Convent is used to build infantry units, the Manufactorum is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 很好！你現在擁有了製造廠，所有戰鬥修女的車輛都來自於這個建築物。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Manufactorum. All Sisters of Battle vehicles come from this building.

tc_text: 請注意，你的作戰基地只能支援一定數目的載具，這種限制稱為「載具上限」。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 一旦抵達了你的最高數量限制，你就無法再建造任何更多的載具。你可以藉由升級你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂，來增加載具上限或是部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can increase your Vehicle Cap by researching the appropriate upgrade at your Ecclesiarchal Chapel, just like Squad Cap.

tc_text: 選擇你的製造廠來建造一輛獻祭者裝甲車。
en_text: Select your Manufactorum and build an Immolator tank.

tc_text: 獻祭者裝甲車是殘暴的戰爭機器，使用白色高熱的烈焰來淨化敵人。
en_text: Immolators are brutal war machines that purge their enemies with white hot flames.

tc_text: 獻祭者裝甲車有附加的空間可以用來裝載步兵部隊。
en_text: Additionally, Immolators have holding space for infantry squads, which can operate the Immolator's internal weapon systems to fire at enemies outside.

tc_text: 很好！現在你的獻祭者裝甲車準備戰鬥。
en_text: Excellent! Your Immolator is now ready for battle.

tc_text: 使用步兵單位來佔領戰略位置，然後用僕役在上面建造監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry squads to capture Strategic Points and Servitors to build Listening Posts on them.

tc_text: 建造額外的部隊和載具，確認在你的監聽哨上建立神聖圖像，用來升級你的部隊上限、載具上限和最大的信仰值。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure to build Holy Icons on your Listening Posts, in order to upgrade your Squad Cap, Vehicle Cap, and maximum Faith.

tc_text: 使用滑鼠左擊（左鍵點擊），可以選擇單位或是建築物。到你的基地，然後選擇卡柏要塞。
en_text: To select a unit or structure, simply click on it with the left mouse button. Go to your base and select the Kabal Fortress.

tc_text: 選擇你的卡柏要塞，然後尋找位於螢幕右下角落的曼陀羅部隊圖像。現在就點選這個圖像。
en_text: Select your Kabal Fortress and look for the Mandrake Squad icon located in the lower-right corner of the screen. Click this button now.

tc_text: 很好！現在你擁有了曼陀羅部隊。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Mandrake Squad.

tc_text: 利用滑鼠右鍵點選，來命令曼陀羅部隊佔領一個戰略位置。
en_text: Order the Mandrake Squad to capture a Strategic Point by right-clicking on the Point.

tc_text: 選擇你的卡柏要塞，建造一個痛苦奴隸。
en_text: Select your Kabal Fortress and build a Tortured Slave.

tc_text: 痛苦奴隸可以用來建造額外的建築物，痛苦奴隸通常伴隨著卡柏要塞存在。
en_text: Tortured Slaves are required to build additional structures. Tortured Slaves are always available from the Kabal Fortress.

tc_text: 痛苦奴隸已經抵達！痛苦奴隸是暗黑神靈族的建築單位，任何時候你想要建造一個新的建築，你就必須使用痛苦奴隸。
en_text: The Tortured Slave has arrived! Tortured Slaves are the Dark Eldar's builder unit. Any time you wish to build a new structure, you must use a Tortured Slave.

tc_text: 選擇痛苦奴隸並且點選螢幕右下角的建築圖像，這樣會出現目前痛苦奴隸所有能建造的建築物。點選嫌惡之塔圖像，並將它安置在佔領的戰略位置之上。
en_text: Select the Tortured Slave and click on the Build icon in the lower right area of the screen. This brings up the icons of all the structures the Slave can construct. Click on the Tower of Loathing icon and place it on the captured Strategic Point.

tc_text: 嫌惡之塔可以防衛你的戰略位置，同時也可以增加你的軍備生產速率。
en_text: The Tower of Loathing fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 請注意，跟其他的種族不同，暗黑神靈族的建築物一旦開始構建，就會自我建築。將痛苦奴隸從建築中移開，並且觀察持續的進度。
en_text: Note that, unlike other races, the Dark Eldar structures will build themselves once construction is begun. Move your Tortured Slave away from the building and observe as progress continues.

tc_text: 很好！這個位置現在可以防衛敵人的攻擊了。你應該繼續在你所有的戰為位置上建造嫌惡之塔。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Towers of Loathing on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 點選你的痛苦奴隸來製造一座電漿發電機。
en_text: Select your Tortured Slave and build a Plasma Generator.

tc_text: 你現在擁有了電力！電漿發電機會以一個固定的速率來生產電力，要注意每一座卡柏要塞生產電漿發電場的數量限制。
en_text: You now have Power! Plasma Generators will continue to produce Power at a constant rate. Note that there is a limit to how many Plasma Generators can be built per Kabal Fortress.

tc_text: 點選你的痛苦奴隸來建造血腥大廳。
en_text: Select your Tortured Slave and build a Hall of Blood.

tc_text: 血腥大廳可以讓你製造大部分暗黑神靈族的步兵單位，還有他們的指揮官單位，執政官。
en_text: The Hall of Blood is the structure where you can build most Dark Eldar infantry units, as well as the Dark Eldar commander unit, the Archon.

tc_text: 很好，血腥大廳已經完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Hall of Blood is finished.

tc_text: 點選你的血腥大廳來製造戰士部隊。
en_text: Select your Hall of Blood and build a Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 戰士是暗黑神靈族的基本步兵單位。就像大部分的暗黑神靈族單位，他們擁有特殊的火力和行動力，不過卻非常的脆弱。
en_text: Warriors are the basic infantry of the Dark Eldar. Like most Dark Eldar units, they have exceptional firepower and mobility, but are very fragile.

tc_text: 很好，你現在建造了一支戰士部隊。
en_text: Excellent. You have built a Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的小隊戰力提升至最高。請選取戰士部隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: Reinforcing is the act of calling in additional troops to bring your squad to maximum combat effectiveness. Select a Warrior Squad. Click the Reinforce Squad button to add one new unit to your squad.

tc_text: 一旦有戰士不幸在戰鬥中喪生，你就可以在戰爭期間使用增援功能來恢復戰力。
en_text: You can Reinforce during battle, in the event that a Warrior falls to the enemy.

tc_text: 恭喜！你已經強化了戰士部隊。
en_text: Congratulations! You have reinforced your Warrior Squad.

tc_text: 你可以利用建造奴隸牢房來提升部隊上限，但是在最後總還會有一個最大的上限值。
en_text: You can increase your Squad Cap by building Slave Chambers, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 點選痛苦奴力來建造三座奴隸牢房。請記得：當建造開始後就可以移開你的痛苦奴隸，建築物將會自我建造完成。
en_text: Select a Tortured Slave and build 3 Slave Chambers. Remember: the Tortured Slave can freely move away from a structure once it has begun and it will complete itself.

tc_text: 暗黑神靈族的社會非常的依賴奴隸的勞動。因此，他們藉由奴隸牢房來加強他們的軍力。奴隸牢房具有眾多的功能，可以提供很多的好處，像是擴張你的控制區域、提升你的部隊和載具上限。
en_text: Dark Eldar society is greatly dependent on the labor of slaves. As such, they rely on Slave Chambers to enhance their army. Slave Chambers are extremely versatile and provide many benefits, expanding your Control Zone, and increasing your Squad and Vehicle Caps.

tc_text: 很好！現在你完成了三座奴隸牢房。
en_text: Excellent! You have completed 3 Slave Chambers.

tc_text: 奴隸牢房可以進行一到兩項的特別升級，來提供額外的好處。
en_text: Slave Chambers can be customized with one of two Add-ons to provide additional benefits.

tc_text: 其中一項升級是拷問地窖。選擇一座奴隸牢房，然後點選拷問地窖升級圖像。
en_text: One of these Add-ons is the Torture Pit. Select a Slave Chamber and click the Torture Pit Add-on icon.

tc_text: 這座奴隸牢房現在裝備有一座拷問地窖。這會開始拷問奴隸、並生產屍體，使其可以用來作靈魂原質的採集之用。
en_text: This Slave Chamber is now equipped with a Torture Pit. This will begin the torture of Slaves, producing corpses that can be used to harvest Soul Essence.

tc_text: 靈魂原質是暗黑神靈族獨特的第三種資源，它可以從戰場所有的屍體來採集，甚至是我方的屍體。你目前的靈魂原質等級，將會顯示在軍備資源和電力資源的下方。
en_text: Soul Essence is a third resource type that is unique to the Dark Eldar. It can be harvested from all corpses on the battlefield, even your own. Your Soul Essence is displayed slightly below your Requisition and Power resources.

tc_text: 選擇一個痛苦奴隸然後點選採集靈魂原質圖像，他將會自動走到附近最新的屍體旁，開始採集像薄霧一般的靈魂原質。
en_text: Select a Tortured Slave and click the Harvest Soul Essence icon. He will automatically walk to the nearest fresh corpse and begin harvesting the mist-like Soul Essence.

tc_text: 靈魂原質是特殊能力的必需品。這些能力位於螢幕的中央，就在主界面的正上方。
en_text: Soul Essence is used for powerful abilities that are available at all times. These abilities are located in the center of the screen, directly above the primary interface.

tc_text: 現在點選侵蝕圖像，在點選任何地面目標來施展該能力。
en_text: Click the Corrosion icon now. Click again anywhere on the ground to target the ability.

tc_text: 很好！只要你的敵人待在煙霧之中，侵蝕能力將會腐蝕你的敵人的裝甲，，讓他們在戰鬥中遭受到更多的傷害。
en_text: Excellent! Corrosion will erode your enemies' armor as long as they stay within the cloud, causing them to take more damage during battle.

tc_text: 大部分的種族會有一個英雄來帶領他們的軍隊，帶領暗黑神靈族的是執政官，他是一個邪惡的近戰戰士，帶領著名為夢魔的菁英部隊。
en_text: Most races have a single hero they can build that can lead their entire force. The Dark Eldar call upon the Archon, a vicious melee warrior supported by elite troops known as the Incubi.

tc_text: 現在選擇血腥大廳還建造一位執政官。
en_text: Select the Hall of Blood and build an Archon now.

tc_text: 執政官在直接作戰中具有強大的威利，同時也可以發展眾多的能力來蹂躪敵人。在遊戲開始時他裝備有惡意靈球，它可以將敵人所訂在一個固定的地方來吸取他們的生命原質，用來治療執政官本身的生命。
en_text: The Archon is powerful in direct combat, but also can unlock a variety of special abilities to devastate the enemy. He begins the game with Animus Vitae, which can lock enemies in place in order to leech their life essence, healing the Archon.

tc_text: 恭喜！你已經完成建造執政官了。
en_text: Congratulations! You have finished building the Archon.

tc_text: 選擇你的執政官，來點選增加夢魔圖像。
en_text: Select your Archon and click the Add Incubus icon.

tc_text: 夢魔可以有效保衛相當脆弱的執政官生命。為了提供額外的火力，每一個加入部隊的夢魔，都可以提升執政官所有能力的效用時間和力量。
en_text: Incubi are vital to keeping the relatively fragile Archon effective and alive. In addition to providing extra firepower, each Incubus added to the squad increases the duration and power of all the Archon's abilities.

tc_text: 很好，你現在為你的部隊增援了強大的夢魔。為了要最大化能力的效用，試著隨時讓夢魔待在執政官的周圍。
en_text: Excellent. You have bolstered your squad with the addition of a powerful Incubus. To maximize effectiveness, try to keep your Archon surrounded by Incubi at all times.

tc_text: 現在選擇你的痛苦奴隸，然後建造一座赫蒙丘魯斯實驗室。
en_text: Select your Tortured Slave and build a Haemonculus Laboratory now.

tc_text: 你必須建造一座赫蒙丘魯斯實驗室，來獲得生產部隊領袖和其它先進單位的能力。部隊領袖是威力強大的單位，同時可以為他們的部隊提供重要的能力。
en_text: You must build a Haemonculus Laboratory to gain access to squad leaders and other advanced unit types. Squad leaders are powerful units that can also often provide valuable abilities for their squad.

tc_text: 在赫蒙丘魯斯實驗室中，同時擁有多樣的步兵升級項目。你可以透過升級研究，來改善部隊的能力。
en_text: Additionally, there are a variety of infantry upgrades available at the Haemonculus Laboratory. You can improve your troops immensely by researching these upgrades.

tc_text: 很好，現在赫蒙丘魯斯實驗室已經完成，你可以為你大部分的部隊來加入領袖單位了。
en_text: Excellent, the Haemonculus Laboratory is complete. You can now add leaders to most of your infantry squads.

tc_text: 選擇戰士小隊，然後點選升級：享樂者圖像。
en_text: Select a Warrior Squad and click the Add Leader: Sybarite icon.

tc_text: 享樂者是邪惡的領袖，裝備有震撼手榴彈，可以用來盲目和擾亂敵人。
en_text: Sybarites are vicious leaders that are equipped with Terrorfex Grenades, which can be used to blind and demoralize the enemy.

tc_text: 很好！你的享樂者已經抵達了。注意你的領袖是部隊的一部分，而且無法離隊。
en_text: Excellent! Your Sybarite has arrived. Note that your leaders are part of the squad and cannot leave it.

tc_text: 選擇你的卡柏要塞，然後點選研究行星突擊圖像。
en_text: Select your Kabal Fortress and click the Planetary Raid Research icon.

tc_text: 這項研究會讓暗黑神靈族的科技進入到下一個階段，獲得生產更強力的步兵、載具和升級項目。
en_text: This research advances the Dark Eldar to the next technology level, granting access to more powerful infantry, vehicles, and upgrades.

tc_text: 很好，行星突擊研究現在已經完成了。
en_text: Excellent, the Planetary Raid research is now complete.

tc_text: 確認使用你的痛苦奴隸，在任何的戰略位置上建造嫌惡之塔。這個防禦工事將會幫助它們對抗你的敵人。
en_text: Make sure to use your Tortured Slave to build Towers of Loathing on any captured Strategic Points. This fortifies them against your enemies.

tc_text: 很好！你現在佔領了三個戰略位置，並且在上面建造了嫌惡之塔。守護好戰略位置，是打敗你的敵人的重要關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Towers of Loathing upon them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 很好！你現在佔領了一個關鍵位置。要注意在關鍵位置上，不可以建造嫌惡之塔，你必須另外想辦法來保護它們。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Towers of Loathing built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 很好！你現在已經佔領了一個遺址。你可以在佔領的遺址上建造嫌惡之塔萊防禦它們，你同時也可以佔領對手的遺址，來阻止他們發展最佳的單位和科技。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Towers of Loathing to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 選擇你的痛苦奴隸，然後建造一座黑暗鑄造廠。
en_text: Select your Tortured Slave and build a Dark Foundry.

tc_text: 就像血腥大廳是用來建造步兵單位，黑暗鑄造廠是用來製造載具之用。
en_text: Just like the Hall of Blood is used to build infantry units, the Dark Foundry is used to build vehicles.

tc_text: 大部分的載具都很強悍，而且一般未升級的步兵幾乎無法對它進行有效用的攻擊。不過，有些暗黑神靈族的載具裝甲較薄弱，在面對標準地面部隊時是比較脆弱的。雖然有這樣的缺點，不過它們卻擁有較快速的移動能力和特殊的火力。
