en_text: Most vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. Some Dark Eldar vehicles, however, are light skimmers that are fragile even when facing standard ground troops. They compensate for this weakness with exceptional mobility and firepower.

tc_text: 很好！你現在擁有一座黑暗鑄造廠，所有的暗黑神靈族載具都是來自於這個建築。
en_text: Excellent! You now have a Dark Foundry. All Dark Eldar vehicles come from this building.

tc_text: 請注意，你的作戰基地只能支援一定數目的載具，這種限制稱為「載具上限」。
en_text: Note that your field base can only support a finite number of vehicles. This limit is known as the Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 一旦抵達了你的最大數量，你就無法在建造任何載具。你可以藉由建造奴隸牢房來提升你的載具上限，就像部隊上限一樣。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can increase your Vehicle Cap by building Slave Chambers, just like Squad Cap.

tc_text: 選擇你的黑暗鑄造廠，然後建造一個入侵者。
en_text: Select your Dark Foundry and build a Raider.

tc_text: 入侵者是快速、上開式的戰鬥平台，裝備有一挺黑暗長槍、一個強力的反載具武器，當步兵部隊駐防在上面時非常的有效率，可以提供額外的火力。
en_text: Raiders are fast, open-topped battle platforms. Although equipped with a Dark Lance, a powerful anti-vehicle weapon, they are most effective when garrisoned with an infantry squad to provide additional firepower.

tc_text: 要在行動中駐防，選擇一個戰士部隊，然後再右鍵點選入侵者。
en_text: To see this garrisoning in action, select a Warrior Squad, then right click on the Raider.

tc_text: 很好！你的入侵者現在現在已經駐防，並且準備戰鬥。
en_text: Excellent! Your Raider is now manned and ready for battle.

tc_text: 使用步兵單位來佔領戰略位置，然後用僕役在上面建造監聽哨。
en_text: Use infantry units to capture Strategic Points and Tortured Slaves to build Towers of Loathing on them.

tc_text: 建造額外的部隊和載具，確認在必要時建造奴隸牢房，來同時提升你的部隊和載具上限。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure to build Slave Chambers when necessary to increase both your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap.

tc_text: 當在掩護模式時，大部分的單位的速度會像在艱困地形中一樣的緩慢。但因為暗黑神靈族的特殊能力，他們可以在掩護模式中使用全速前進。
en_text: While in Cover, most units will slow down to navigate the difficult terrain. Due to their incredible agility, however, the Dark Eldar can move through Cover at full speed.

tc_text: 歡迎來到戰鎚：靈魂風暴的單人戰役，這些教學視窗將會導引你進行遊戲中的前兩個回合，並且介紹戰鎚戰役模式的重要內容。
en_text: Welcome to the single-player campaign of Dawn of War: Soulstorm. These tutorial windows will guide you through the first two turns of play and introduce key features of the Dawn of War campaign mode.

tc_text: 你的目標是征服考拉瓦星系中所有的四個星球。每一個星球都是由複合的區域所組成，你每次都將會征服一個區域。
en_text: Your goal is to conquer all four planets of the Kaurava system. Each planet is made up of multiple territories, which you will conquer one at a time.

tc_text: 戰役地圖是你的主要界面，用來指引你部隊的移動。而獨立的戰鬥則是在比較小比例的戰鬥地圖中進行。
en_text: The campaign map is your primary interface for directing your troops’ strategic moves. Individual battles are fought on the smaller-scaled battle map.

tc_text: 這個行省是你的堡壘，或是你的家鄉，你就是從這個地方開始征服考拉瓦星系的旅程。如果你的堡壘被征服，你將會被逐出星系，並且輸掉這場戰爭。
en_text: This province is your stronghold, or home territory. It is from here that you are launching your conquest of the Kaurava System. If your stronghold is ever conquered, you will be pushed out of the planetary system and lose the campaign.

tc_text: 從第一回合開始，這是你目前唯一所控制的區域。
en_text: Since this is the first turn, this is the only territory you currently control.

tc_text: 每個敵方陣營都有屬於自己的堡壘，它們在戰役地圖上使用專屬的旗幟來標示。要贏得戰役和考拉瓦星系，你必須征服所有八個敵人的堡壘。
en_text: The enemy factions each have their own strongholds, identified by banners on the campaign map. To win the campaign and make the entire Kaurava system yours, you must conquer all eight enemy strongholds.

tc_text: 你的指揮官圖像指出了你目前主要部隊的位置，你只能攻擊部隊所能抵達的目標，所以你在地圖上的位置就會影響你的選擇。
en_text: The icon of your commander indicates the current position of your main army. You can only attack a destination that can be reached from the province where your army is, so its position on the map defines your options.

tc_text: 敵方陣營都有屬於自己的部隊，同時都只能攻擊鄰近的區域。有些敵人擁有特別的能力，可以讓他們用不同的方式移動，所以要小心點。
en_text: The enemy factions each have armies of their own and also can only attack adjacent territories. Some of your enemies may have powers that allow them to move in different ways, so be wary.

tc_text: 這些箭頭顯示你的軍隊在這個回合中可以移動或攻擊的地方。紅色箭頭表示攻入敵人的行省。綠色箭頭表示移進友方行省。
en_text: These arrows show you where your army can move or attack this turn. Red arrows indicate attacks into enemy provinces. Green arrows indicate moves into friendly provinces.

tc_text: 這是你的第一回合，你只能控制你的堡壘，你必須攻擊一個敵人的領域。
en_text: Since this is your first turn, and you only control your stronghold, you must attack an enemy territory.

tc_text: 要移動或是攻擊，左鍵點選行省，接著再點擊右邊面版上的攻擊或是移動按鍵。開始攻擊鄰接你部隊周圍的區域，在移動或是攻擊之後，你將會結束你的回合，然後接著繼續移動或是攻擊。
en_text: To move to or attack, left-click to select that province and then click on the Attack or Move button in the right panel. Begin by attacking one of the territories adjacent to your army. After moving or attacking, you will have to end your turn in order to move or attack again.

tc_text: 這個畫面顯示你所帶領進行攻擊的部隊，如果你決定稍後再攻擊，也可以返回戰役地圖。
en_text: This screen shows you the forces you are leading into an attack and allows you to return to the campaign map if you decide you don’t want to attack yet.

tc_text: 這是你的第一次攻擊，大部分的選項現在都還沒有出現。
en_text: Since this is your first attack, most options aren't yet available.

tc_text: 當你準備攻擊時，點選攻擊按鍵。這將會讀取即時戰鬥，這是你在戰鎚中面對敵人的地方。
en_text: When you're ready to attack, just click on the Attack button. This will load the actual battle, where you will face enemies in a game of Dawn of War.

tc_text: 當你征服越來越多省時，你的指揮官就會獲得特殊裝備。這個裝備稱為戰爭裝備。
en_text: As you conquer more and more provinces, you'll be awarded pieces of special equipment for your commander. This equipment is called wargear.

tc_text: 你不會獲得特定的某一件戰爭裝備；在每次獎賞時，你必須從這個畫面的列表中選擇一項。（注意，你可能必須先拿到某些戰爭裝備，才能解開其它更具威力的版本。）
en_text: You will never be awarded a specific piece of wargear. Instead, for each award, you get to choose one piece from the list on this screen. (Note that you may have to get some pieces of wargear to unlock other, more powerful versions.)

tc_text: 恭喜！你征服了第一個行省。這場勝利給你數項獎賞，包括一件戰爭裝備，以及該行省提供的加成。
en_text: Congratulations! You have conquered your first province. This victory has given you several rewards, including a piece of wargear.

tc_text: 每一個地區再每一回合都會提供特定數量的行星軍備。有許多區域會提供特別的額外獎勵，像是榮譽護衛部隊單位。當你選擇該行省時，這項加成顯示在右側面板中。
en_text: Every territory yields a certain amount of Planetary Requisition per turn. Additionally, many territories provide special bonuses, such as honor guard units. Look for bonuses in the right-hand panel when you select a province.

tc_text: 榮譽護衛部隊是特殊單位，可以訓練在戰爭中護衛你的指揮官，你可以在指揮或是攻擊畫面中購買榮譽護衛部隊。注意當你失去提供榮譽護衛部隊的區域時，你將會失去購買該單位的能力。
en_text: The honor guard are special units that can be trained to accompany your commander in battle. Purchase honor guard units from the Commander or the Attack Screen. Take note that if you lose the territory that provided you with an honor guard unit, you will lose the ability to purchase that unit.

tc_text: 其它的行省會為戰鬥提供小型的資源獎勵，或是擁有遠古通道，讓你可以在行星間行動。
en_text: Other provinces will grant small resource bonuses for battles, or contain Ancient Gates that allow travel between the planets.

tc_text: 這就是你剛剛征服的區域。注意，它已經改變為你的顏色，現在你的軍隊在這裡。每當你征服一個行省時，你的軍隊就會移到該省。
en_text: This is the territory you've just conquered. Notice that it has changed to your color and that your army is on it. Whenever you conquer a province, your army moves there.

tc_text: 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。
en_text: You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn, new provinces will be open to attack.

tc_text: 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 敵人擊退你對該行省的攻擊。
en_text: The enemy repelled your attack on the province.

tc_text: 每一個敵方陣營會輪流行動。和你一樣，他們各自擁有自己的要塞和軍隊。他們會移動自己的軍隊，或是攻擊及增援其行省。
en_text: Each of the enemy factions will now act in turn. Like you, they each have their own strongholds and armies. They will each move their armies or attack and reinforce their territories in turn.

tc_text: 留意敵人的軍隊在什麼地方。軍隊會增援鄰近遭受攻擊的友軍，用額外的軍隊強化防禦。
en_text: Pay attention to where your enemies' armies are. Armies will reinforce nearby friendly provinces under attack, bolstering the defense with additional troops.

tc_text: 你的一個行省遭受到攻擊。
en_text: One of your territories is under attack.

tc_text: 你可以選擇在戰役地圖上進行戰鬥，或是自動計算戰役結果。但是自動計算結果可能很危險，因為它是根據行省和攻擊武力的相對力量來計算。如果你自己進行戰鬥，永遠都有較佳的獲勝機會。也有一些戰爭裝備只能透過在戰役地圖上進行防禦戰才能獲得，因此你應該好好考慮是否要使用自動計算結果。
en_text: You can choose to fight on the battle map or to auto-resolve this battle. Auto-resolving can be dangerous, however, since it depends on the relative strength of your province and the attacker's forces. You always stand a better chance of triumphing against great odds if you fight the battle yourself. There are also pieces of wargear that can only be earned by fighting defensive battles on the battle map: another advantage to fighting without auto-resolve.

tc_text: 如果你選擇戰鬥，而且你的軍隊位於該行省中，你的指揮官和其榮譽護衛就會加入防禦。如果不是，你就必須運用駐紮在該行省中的軍隊進行戰鬥。
en_text: If you choose to fight and your army is on the province, your commander and his honor guard will join the defense. If not, you'll have to make do with whatever forces are garrisoned there.

tc_text: 你會注意到，你從所控制的行省處獲得行星軍備。每個行省在每回合都會生產行星軍備。要儲存分配所有的軍備，你必須維持好補給線，這表示所有你擁有的區域都必須連結在一起，最後連接在你的堡壘旁。
en_text: You'll notice that you have gained Planetary Requisition from the provinces you control. Each province produces Planetary Requisition every turn. To garner your full allotment of Requisition, you must maintain supply lines. This means that all territories must be part of a chain of territories that you possess, tracing back to your stronghold.

tc_text: 使用行星軍備來強化行省，將部隊駐紮在該處，以及訓練榮譽護衛部隊。
en_text: Use Planetary Requisition to reinforce your provinces by stationing troops and buildings there and to train honor guard units.

tc_text: 要強化一個行省，只需在你擁有的行省上按滑鼠左鍵，再點選右側面板中的「增援」按鈕即可。
en_text: To reinforce a province, simply left-click on a province you own and then click on the Reinforce button in the right-hand panel.

tc_text: 你使用行星軍備來強化行省，將部隊駐紮在該處，以及訓練榮譽護衛部隊。當你從敵人攻擊中防禦這個行省時，這些購買都將會準備好。
en_text: This screen allows you to garrison troops and buildings in a territory. These purchases will be ready when you fight to defend this province from enemy attacks.

tc_text: 駐紮部隊和建造建築都需要花費你的行星軍備。所有的單位都在面版上，使用上方的箭頭來切換不同的選項。
en_text: Stationing troops and building buildings in a province costs you Planetary Requisition. The available units are on the panel. Use the arrows at the top to move between different options.

tc_text: 以後你可以召回這些部隊（如果該行省不再有危險）。召回部隊可以讓你獲得駐紮他們時所使用之行星軍備的半數。小心，當你接受這個畫面中的變動時，所有的購買行動都不能反悔。
en_text: Later, you can recall these troops (if the province is no longer at risk). Recalling a unit will give you back half the Planetary Requisition you spent to station it in the first place. Be careful. All your purchases will be final once you accept the changes on this screen.

tc_text: 這個畫面讓你一眼即可明白征服考拉瓦星系的進度。其中包括征戰的總數、你的指揮官的統計數據、你的榮譽護衛等等。
en_text: This screen provides you with a snapshot of your progress in the Kaurava Conflict. It includes a running tally of your conquests, your commander's statistics, your honor guard and more.

tc_text: 如果你還沒有訓練榮譽護衛（或是在戰役中失去），可以在這個畫面中進行訓練。點選其圖示即可。
en_text: If you haven't yet trained an honor guard unit (or you've lost one in battle), you can train it on this screen by simply clicking on its icon.

tc_text: 你也可以在這裡進入戰爭裝備畫面。
en_text: You can also access the Wargear Screen from here.

tc_text: 恭喜。你剛剛征服了一個敵對種族的要塞。這場勝利結束了該種族征服此星球的野心。如果你能夠征服其餘的七個敵方要塞，就可贏得遊戲。
en_text: Congratulations. You have just conquered an enemy race's stronghold. This victory ends that race's attempt to take the planetary system for themselves. If you can conquer the seven remaining enemy strongholds, you will win the game.

tc_text: 被打敗的種族可能還擁有幾個行省，但是沒有了要塞，他們就沒有軍隊，也沒有能力攻擊。你可以掃平他們殘餘的行省，獲得相關的加成；你也可以改變目標。
en_text: There may still be some provinces held by the defeated race, but without a stronghold they no longer have an army or the ability to attack. You can mop up their remaining provinces to gain the associated bonuses, or you can move on to other targets.

tc_text: 你已經獲得了一個新的獎勵能力。
en_text: You have received a new bonus power.

tc_text: 每征服一個種族，你就會獲得該種族控制的能力。
en_text: Every race you conquer will grant you the power that race possessed.

tc_text: 要學習你獲得的特殊能力，選擇被征服的堡壘，用滑鼠移動到右方面版上的獎勵圖像。你也可以在指揮官畫面中看到所有你贏得的能力。
en_text: To learn about the special ability you earned, select the conquered stronghold and mouse over the bonus icon on the right panel. You can also see all the powers you have earned on the Commander Screen.

tc_text: 你剛剛征服了一個擁有遠古通道的區域，這些遠古通道讓你可以在其它星球上特定的遠古通道間旅行。
en_text: You have just conquered a territory containing an Ancient Gate. These ancient artifacts allow you to travel to certain other Ancient Gates on other planets.

tc_text: 離開行星的箭頭顯示你可以旅行的地方，守住這些通道會是非常重要的戰略。
en_text: The arrows leading off of the planet indicate where you can travel. Holding provinces with these gates can be of great strategic importance.

tc_text: 在遠古通道間移動跟在兩個區域間移動沒甚麼不同。注意如果你要使用通道，你就必須征服通道的目的地。
en_text: Traveling between Ancient Gates is no different than moving between territories. Note that if you use it, you will have to conquer whoever owns the province at the destination.

tc_text: 超過一個以上的行省與你的主要控制區域失去了連接。所有的行省都應該與你的堡壘連接，而不用通過敵人的區域。
en_text: One or more of your provinces has become disconnected from your primary area of control. This area is defined as all the provinces that can be reached from your stronghold, without having to pass through enemy territory.

tc_text: 當這些行省失去連接，你就無法收集全部的行星軍備。你必須重新恢復補給線，來獲得全部的軍備。
en_text: While these provinces are disconnected, you cannot collect your full Planetary Requisition. Restore the supply lines to collect your full due.

tc_text: 選擇戰鬥修女時，你可以獲得建造前進基地的能力。在攻擊之前，除了榮譽護衛隊單位之外，你還可以購買建築物。
en_text: By playing as the Sisters of Battle, you possess the power to build forward bases. Before any attack, you may purchase buildings, in addition to honor guard units.

tc_text: 購買建築物的動作存在於戰鬥之外。跟榮譽護衛隊單位不同，它們將不會跟著你的指揮官進入另一場戰鬥。
en_text: Purchased buildings will be present at the outset of the battle. However, unlike honor guard units, they will not travel with your commander into other fights.

tc_text: 選擇帝國防衛軍，你所有的榮譽護衛隊和駐紮部隊的購買，將會自動獲得優惠的價格。
en_text: By playing as the Imperial Guard, all your honor guard and garrison purchases automatically come at a reduced price.

tc_text: 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇星際戰士，你可以獲得建造特殊駐防部隊—深入打擊小隊的能力。你只能從你的堡壘中獲得購買這些部隊的能力。
en_text: By playing as the Space Marines, you possess the power to build special garrison troops called Deep Strike Squads. You can only purchase these troops from your stronghold.

tc_text: 當深入打擊小隊進入你的堡壘後，他們就可以立刻被派遣到考拉瓦星系的任何地方。這表示在任何戰鬥之前，你就可以選擇使用深入打擊小隊。
en_text: While Deep Strike Squads reside in your stronghold, they can be deployed anywhere in the Kaurava System, at a moment’s notice. This means that before any battle, you can choose to use Deep Strike Squads that you had previously purchased.

tc_text: 要加入深入打擊小隊，選擇在你堡壘上的增援按鍵，接著使用左邊面板上的方向鍵來選擇深入打擊小隊，然後購買你所需要的數量。
en_text: To add Deep Strike Squads, select the Reinforce button on your stronghold. Then use the arrow buttons on the left panel to select Deep Strike Squads, and purchase as many as you see fit.

tc_text: 選擇歐克蠻族，你的駐紮部隊將會非常緩慢的自動增加。在經過遊戲的數個回合之後，你將會注意到有一些行省已經增加了自己的大小。
en_text: By playing the Orks, your garrison reserves will automatically increase, very slowly. After several turns of play, you will notice that some provinces have increased size on their own.

tc_text: 選擇鈦星人，你會獲得阿卡火砲的力量。這具強大的火砲會在你的指揮官面前進行攻擊，通常可以摧毀某些敵方行省中的駐紮部隊。
en_text: By playing the Tau, you possess the power of the Ar’Ka Cannon. This powerful cannon, is fired right before your commander makes an attack, and will usually destroy some of the garrison forces in that enemy province.

tc_text: 火砲會自動射擊，不需要你的導引。
en_text: The cannon fires automatically, and does not require your direction.

tc_text: 選擇神靈族，你會獲得迅速移動的能力。當行經友方區域時，你的指揮官可以穿越三個行省。
en_text: By playing the Eldar, you posses the Fleet of Foot power. Your commander can move up to three entire provinces when moving through friendly territory.

tc_text: 你可以在第一、第二或是第三次移動後攻擊，但是在攻擊之後就會馬上結束你的回合。
en_text: You may attack on the first, second, or third move, but attacking will always end your movement for the turn.

tc_text: 選擇死靈族，你會擁有在戰鬥之後，回復部分你的部隊的能力。這項能力不管在戰勝或是戰敗後都可以執行，直到你對抗敵人後不再有的損失為止。
en_text: By playing the Necron, you possess the ability to recover some of your troops after a battle. This power works both when you are attacking or defending, as long as you do not lose when defending against an enemy.

tc_text: 在戰鬥之後，任何回復的部隊都會自動的歸回到你的榮譽護衛部隊或是駐紮列表之中。
en_text: Any troops recovered will automatically be returned to your honor guard or garrison list, after the battle.

tc_text: 選擇混沌星際戰士，你將沒有補給線的限制。但你的敵人則必須保持他們的區域和堡壘之間的連結，來確保完整的收集行星軍備。
en_text: By playing as the Chaos Space Marines, you are not limited to supply lines. Your enemies must maintain a direct connection between all of their territories and their stronghold, in order to collect full Planetary Requisition.

tc_text: 你可以利用這項優勢來切斷他們的補給線，而無須擔憂自己的部分。
en_text: You can use this fact to your advantage by severing their supply lines without having to worry about your own.

tc_text: 很好，你現在擁有了100個靈魂原質！
en_text: Excellent, you now have 100 Soul Essence!

tc_text: 很好，你已經完成了艾克黎西亞奇大教堂！
en_text: Excellent, you have completed the Ecclesiarchal Cathedral!

tc_text: 選擇暗黑神靈族，你會獲得在遠古通道之間通行的能力。事實上，你是唯一在基地中擁有遠古通道的陣營。
en_text: By playing the Dark Eldar, you possess the ability to travel freely between Ancient Gates. In fact, you are the only faction that has an Ancient Gate in your base.

tc_text: 這些遠古通道聯繫著考拉瓦星系中的星球間的旅行。其他的種族只能用遠古通道作特定的通行，而你可以從任何行省中的遠古通道，移動到任何行省中的遠古通道去。
en_text: These ancient artifacts allow travel between the planets of the Kaurava System. While other races can only travel certain paths using the Ancient Gates, you can travel from any Ancient Gate province to any other Ancient Gate province.

tc_text: 在遠古通道間移動跟在兩個區域間移動沒甚麼不同。注意如果你要使用通道，你就必須征服通道的目的地！
en_text: Traveling between these gates is not different than traveling between territories normally. However, take note that you will have to fight whoever owns the gate province you are traveling to!

tc_text: 歡迎來到戰鎚：靈魂風暴的單人戰役，這些教學視窗將會導引你進行遊戲中的前兩個回合，並且介紹戰鎚戰役模式的重要內容。\你的目標是征服考拉瓦星系中所有的四個星球。每一個星球都是由複合的區域所組成，你每次都將會征服一個區域。 \ 戰役地圖是你的主要界面，用來指引你部隊的移動。而獨立的戰鬥則是在比較小比例的戰鬥地圖中進行。
en_text: Welcome to the single-player campaign of Dawn of War: Soulstorm. These tutorial windows will guide you through the first two turns of play and introduce key features of the Dawn of War campaign mode. \ Your goal is to conquer all four planets of the Kaurava system. Each planet is made up of multiple territories, which you will conquer one at a time. \ The campaign map is your primary interface for directing your troops’ strategic moves. Individual battles are fought on the smaller-scaled battle map.

tc_text: 這個行省是你的堡壘，或是你的家鄉，你就是從這個地方開始征服考拉瓦星系的旅程。如果你的堡壘被征服，你將會被逐出星系，並且輸掉這場戰爭。 \ 從第一回合開始，這是你目前唯一所控制的區域。 \ 每個敵方陣營都有屬於自己的堡壘，它們在戰役地圖上使用專屬的旗幟來標示。要贏得戰役和考拉瓦星系，你必須征服所有八個敵人的堡壘。
en_text: This province is your stronghold, or home territory. It is from here that you are launching your conquest of the Kaurava System. If your stronghold is ever conquered, you will be pushed out of the planetary system and lose the campaign. \ Since this is the first turn, this is the only territory you currently control. \ The enemy factions each have their own strongholds, identified by banners on the campaign map. To win the campaign and make the entire Kaurava system yours, you must conquer all eight enemy strongholds.

tc_text: 你的指揮官圖像指出了你目前主要部隊的位置，你只能攻擊你部隊所能抵達的目標而以，所以你在地圖上的位置就會影響你的選擇。 \ 敵方陣營都有屬於自己的部隊，同時都只能攻擊鄰近的區域。有些敵人擁有特別的能力，可以讓他們用不同的方式移動，所以要小心點。
en_text: The icon of your commander indicates the current position of your main army. You can only attack a destination that can be reached from the province where your army is, so its position on the map defines your options. \ The enemy factions each have armies of their own and also can only attack adjacent territories. Some of your enemies may have powers that allow them to move in different ways, so be wary.

tc_text: 這些箭頭顯示你的軍隊在這個回合中可以移動或攻擊的地方。紅色箭頭表示攻入敵人的行省。綠色箭頭表示移進友方行省。 \ 這是你的第一回合，你只能控制你的堡壘，你必須攻擊一個敵人的領域。 \ 要移動或是攻擊，左鍵點選行省，接著再點擊右邊面版上的攻擊或是移動按鍵。開始攻擊鄰接你部隊周圍的區域，在移動或是攻擊之後，你將會結束你的回合，然後接著繼續移動或是攻擊。
en_text: These arrows show you where your army can move or attack this turn. Red arrows indicate attacks into enemy provinces. Green arrows indicate moves into friendly provinces. \ Since this is your first turn, and you only control your stronghold, you must attack an enemy territory. \ To move to or attack, left-click to select that province and then click on the Attack or Move button in the right panel. Begin by attacking one of the territories adjacent to your army. After moving or attacking, you will have to end your turn in order to move or attack again.

tc_text: 這個畫面顯示你所帶領進行攻擊的部隊，如果你決定稍後再攻擊，也可以返回戰役地圖。 \ 這是你的第一次攻擊，大部分的選項現在都還沒有出現。 \ 當你準備攻擊時，點選攻擊按鍵。這將會讀取即時戰鬥，這是你在戰鎚中面對敵人的地方。
en_text: This screen shows you the forces you are leading into an attack and allows you to return to the campaign map if you decide you don’t want to attack yet. \ Since this is your first attack, most options aren't yet available. \ When you're ready to attack, just click on the Attack button. This will load the actual battle, where you will face enemies in a game of Dawn of War.

tc_text: 當你征服越來越多省時，你的指揮官就會獲得特殊裝備，這個裝備稱為戰爭裝備。  \ 你不會獲得特定的某一件戰爭裝備；在每次獎賞時，你必須從這個畫面的列表中選擇一項。（注意，你可能必須先拿到某些戰爭裝備，才能解開其它更具威力的版本。）
en_text: As you conquer more and more provinces, you'll be awarded pieces of special equipment for your commander. This equipment is called wargear. \ You will never be awarded a specific piece of wargear. Instead, for each award, you get to choose one piece from the list on this screen. (Note that you may have to get some pieces of wargear to unlock other, more powerful versions.)

tc_text: 恭喜！你征服了第一個行省。這場勝利給你數項獎賞，包括一件戰爭裝備，以及該行省提供的加成。\地圖上的每個行省都有一項特殊加成。當你選擇該行省時，這項加成顯示在右側面板中。\有些行省讓你有能力訓練一個特殊部隊，作為指揮官的榮譽護衛。在訓練完畢後，這些部隊會隨著你的指揮官進入戰役的初始階段。你可以在指揮官畫面或攻擊畫面中購買這些部隊。要注意如果你失去提供榮譽護衛隊的區域，你也將失去購買該單位的能力。\其它的行省會為戰鬥提供小型的資源獎勵，或是擁有遠古通道，讓你可以在行星間行動。
en_text: Congratulations! You have conquered your first province. This victory has given you several rewards, including a piece of wargear. \ Every territory yields a certain amount of Planetary Requisition per turn. Additionally, many territories provide special bonuses, such as honor guard units. Look for bonuses in the right-hand panel when you select a province. \ The honor guard are special units that can be trained to accompany your commander in battle. Purchase honor guard units from the Commander or the Attack Screen. Take note that if you lose the territory that provided you with an honor guard unit, you will lose the ability to purchase that unit. \ Other provinces will grant small resource bonuses for battles, or contain Ancient Gates that allow travel between the planets.

tc_text: 這就是你剛剛征服的區域。注意，它已經改變為你的顏色，現在你的軍隊在這裡。每當你征服一個行省時，你的軍隊就會移到該省。 \ 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。 \ 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: This is the territory you've just conquered. Notice that it has changed to your color and that your army is on it. Whenever you conquer a province, your army moves there. \ You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn, new provinces will be open to attack. \ When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 敵人擊退你對該行省的攻擊。 \ 在每回合中，你只能移動或攻擊一次，因此你的回合已經結束了。在下一回合中，就有新的行省可以攻擊。 \ 當你準備讓敵方陣營行動時，請點選結束回合按鈕。
en_text: The enemy repelled your attack on the province. \ You can only move or attack once per turn, so your turn is effectively over. Next turn you will be able to attack again and avenge yourself. \ When you are ready to let the enemy factions act, click on the End Turn button.

tc_text: 每一個敵方陣營會輪流行動。和你一樣，他們各自擁有自己的要塞和軍隊。他們會移動自己的軍隊，或是攻擊及增援其行省。 \ 留意敵人的軍隊在什麼地方。軍隊會增援鄰近遭受攻擊的友軍，用額外的軍隊強化防禦。
en_text: Each of the enemy factions will now act in turn. Like you, they each have their own strongholds and armies. They will each move their armies or attack and reinforce their territories in turn. \ Pay attention to where your enemies' armies are. Armies will reinforce nearby friendly provinces under attack, bolstering the defense with additional troops.

tc_text: 你的行省遭受攻擊。 \ 你可以選擇在戰役地圖上進行戰鬥，或是自動計算戰役結果。但是自動計算結果可能很危險，因為它是根據行省和攻擊武力的相對力量來計算。如果你自己進行戰鬥，永遠都有較佳的獲勝機會。也有一些戰爭裝備只能透過在戰役地圖上進行防禦戰才能獲得，因此你應該好好考慮是否要使用自動計算結果。\ 如果你選擇戰鬥，而且你的軍隊位於該行省或鄰近的行省中，你的指揮官和其榮譽護衛就會加入防禦。如果不是，你就必須運用駐紮在該行省中的軍隊進行戰鬥。
en_text: One of your territories is under attack. \ You can choose to fight on the battle map or to auto-resolve this battle. Auto-resolving can be dangerous, however, since it depends on the relative strength of your province and the attacker's forces. You always stand a better chance of triumphing against great odds if you fight the battle yourself. There are also pieces of wargear that can only be earned by fighting defensive battles on a battle map: another advantage to fighting without auto-resolve. \ If you choose to fight and your army is on the province, your commander and his honor guard will join the defense. If not, you'll have to make do with whatever forces are garrisoned there.

tc_text: 現在又輪到你行動了。 \ 你會注意到，你從所控制的行省處獲得行星軍備。每個行省在每回合都會生產行星軍備。 \ 你使用行星軍備來強化行省，將部隊駐紮在該處，以及訓練榮譽護衛部隊。 \ 要強化一個行省，只需在你擁有的行省上按滑鼠左鍵，再點選右側面板中的「增援」按鈕即可。
en_text: It is now your turn to act again. \ You'll notice that you have gained Planetary Requisition from the provinces you control. Each province produces Planetary Requisition every turn. To garner your full allotment of Requisition, you must maintain supply lines. This means that all territories must be part of a chain of territories that you possess, tracing back to your stronghold. \ Use Planetary Requisition to reinforce your provinces by stationing troops and buildings there and to train honor guard units. \ To reinforce a province, simply left-click on a province you own and then click on the Reinforce button in the right-hand panel.

tc_text: 這個畫面允許你在區域中駐紮部隊和建造建築。當你抵抗敵人侵略時，就可以運用這些部隊。 \ 將部隊駐紮在行省中，需要花費行星軍備。可使用的部隊顯示在面板上。 \ 以後當該行省不再有危險時，你可以召回這些部隊。召回部隊可以讓你獲得駐紮他們時所使用之行星軍備的半數。 小心，當你接受這個畫面中的變動時，所有的購買行動都不能反悔。
en_text: This screen allows you to garrison troops and buildings in a territory. These purchases will be ready when you fight to defend this province from enemy attacks. \ Stationing troops and building buildings in a province costs you Planetary Requisition. The available units are on the panel. Use the arrows at the top to move between different options. \ Later, you can recall these troops if the province is no longer at risk. Recalling a unit will give you back half the Planetary Requisition you spent to station it in the first place. Be careful. All your purchases will be final once you accept the changes on this screen.

tc_text: 這個畫面讓你一眼即可明白征服考拉瓦星系的進度。其中包括征戰的總數、你的指揮官的統計數據、你的榮譽護衛等等。 \ 如果你還沒有訓練榮譽護衛（或是在戰役中失去），可以在這個畫面中進行訓練。點選其圖示即可。 \ 你也可以在這裡進入戰爭裝備畫面。
en_text: This screen provides you with a snapshot of your progress in the Kaurava Conflict. It includes a running tally of your conquests, your commander's statistics, your honor guard, and more. \ If you haven't yet trained an honor guard unit (or you've lost one in battle), you can train it on this screen by simply clicking on its icon. \ You can also access the Wargear Screen from here.

tc_text: 恭喜。你剛剛征服了一個敵對種族的要塞。這場勝利結束了該種族征服此星球的野心。如果你能夠征服其餘的七個敵方要塞，就可贏得遊戲。 \ 被打敗的種族可能還擁有幾個行省，但是沒有了要塞，他們就沒有軍隊，也沒有能力攻擊。你可以掃平他們殘餘的行省，獲得相關的加成；你也可以改變目標。
en_text: Congratulations. You have just conquered an enemy race's stronghold. This victory ends that race's attempt to take the planetary system for themselves. If you can conquer the seven remaining enemy strongholds, you will win the game. \ There may still be some provinces held by the defeated race, but without a stronghold they no longer have an army or the ability to attack. You can mop up their remaining provinces to gain the associated bonuses, or you can move on to other targets.

tc_text: 你已經獲得了一個新的獎勵能力。 \ 每征服一個種族，你就會獲得該種族控制的能力。 \ 要學習你獲得的特殊能力，選擇被征服的堡壘，用滑鼠移動到右方面版上的獎勵圖像。你也可以在指揮官畫面中看到所有你贏得的能力。
en_text: You have received a new bonus power. \ Every race you conquer will grant you the power that race possessed. \ To learn about the special ability you earned, select the conquered stronghold and mouse over the bonus icon on the right panel. You can also see all the powers you have earned on the Commander Screen.

tc_text: 你剛剛征服了一個擁有遠古通道的區域，這些遠古通道讓你可以在其它星球上特定的遠古通道間旅行。 \ 離開行星的箭頭顯示你可以旅行的地方，守住這些通道會是非常重要的戰略。 \ 在遠古通道間移動跟在兩個區域間移動沒甚麼不同。注意如果你要使用通道，你就必須征服通道的目的地。
en_text: You have just conquered a territory containing an Ancient Gate. These ancient artifacts allow you to travel to certain other Ancient Gates on other planets. \ The arrows leading off of the planet indicate where you can travel. Holding provinces with these gates can be of great strategic importance. \ Traveling between Ancient Gates is no different than moving between territories. Note that if you use it, you will have to conquer whoever owns the province at the destination.

tc_text: 超過一個以上的行省與你的主要控制區域失去了連接。所有的行省都應該與你的堡壘連接，而不用通過敵人的區域。 \ 當這些行省失去連接，你就無法收集全部的行星軍備。你必須重新恢復補給線，來獲得全部的軍備。
en_text: One or more of your provinces has become disconnected from your primary area of control. This area is defined as all the provinces that can be reached from your stronghold, without having to pass through enemy territory. \ While these provinces are disconnected, you cannot collect your full Planetary Requisition. Restore the supply lines to collect your full due.

tc_text: 選擇戰鬥修女時，你可以獲得建造前進基地的能力。在攻擊之前，除了榮譽護衛隊單位之外，你還可以購買建築物。 \ 購買建築物的動作存在於戰鬥之外。跟榮譽護衛隊單位不同，它們將不會跟著你的指揮官進入另一場戰鬥。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing as the Sisters of Battle, you possess the power to build forward bases. Before any attack, you may purchase buildings, in addition to honor guard units. \ Purchased buildings will be present at the outset of the battle. However, unlike honor guard units, they will not travel with your commander into other fights. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇帝國防衛軍，你所有的榮譽護衛隊和駐紮部隊的購買，將會自動獲得優惠的價格。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing as the Imperial Guard, all your honor guard and garrison purchases automatically come at a reduced price. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇星際戰士，你可以獲得建造特殊駐防部隊—深入打擊小隊的能力。你只能從你的堡壘中獲得購買這些部隊的能力。 \ 當深入打擊小隊進入你的堡壘後，他們就可以立刻被派遣到考拉瓦星系的任何地方。這表示在任何戰鬥之前，你就可以選擇使用深入打擊小隊。 \ 要加入深入打擊小隊，選擇在你堡壘上的增援按鍵，接著使用左邊面板上的方向鍵來選擇深入打擊小隊，然後購買你所需要的數量。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing as the Space Marines, you possess the power to build special garrison troops called Deep Strike Squads. You can only purchase these troops from your stronghold. \ While Deep Strike Squads reside in your stronghold, they can be deployed anywhere in the Kaurava System, at a moment's notice. This means that before any battle, you can choose to use Deep Strike Squads that you had previously purchased. \ To add Deep Strike Squads, select the Reinforce button on your stronghold. Then use the arrow buttons on the left panel to select Deep Strike Squads, and purchase as many as you see fit. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇歐克蠻族，你的駐紮部隊將會非常緩慢的自動增加。在經過遊戲的數個回合之後，你將會注意到有一些行省已經增加了自己的大小。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing the Orks, your garrison reserves will automatically increase, very slowly. After several turns of play, you will notice that some provinces have increased size on their own. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇鈦星人，你會獲得阿卡火砲的力量。這具強大的火砲會在你的指揮官面前進行攻擊，通常可以摧毀某些敵方行省中的駐紮部隊。 \ 火砲會自動射擊，不需要你的導引。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing the Tau, you possess the power of the Ar’Ka Cannon. This powerful cannon, is fired right before your commander makes an attack, and will usually destroy some of the garrison forces in that enemy province. \ The cannon fires automatically, and does not require your direction. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇神靈族，你會獲得迅速移動的能力。當行經友方區域時，你的指揮官可以穿越三個行省。 \ 你可以在第一、第二或是第三次移動後攻擊，但是在攻擊之後就會馬上結束你的回合。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing the Eldar, you posses the Fleet of Foot power. Your commander can move up to three entire provinces when moving through friendly territory. \ You may attack on the first, second, or third move, but attacking will always end your movement for the turn. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇死靈族，你會擁有在戰鬥之後，回復部分你的部隊的能力。這項能力不管在戰勝或是戰敗後都可以執行，直到你對抗敵人後不再有的損失為止。 \ 在戰鬥之後，任何回復的部隊都會自動的歸回到你的榮譽護衛部隊或是駐紮列表之中。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing the Necron, you possess the ability to recover some of your troops after a battle. This power works both when you are attacking or defending, as long as you do not lose when defending against an enemy. \ Any troops recovered will automatically be returned to your honor guard or garrison list, after the battle. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇混沌星際戰士，你將沒有補給線的限制。但你的敵人則必須保持他們的區域和堡壘之間的連結，來確保完整的收集行星軍備。 \ 你可以利用這項優勢來切斷他們的補給線，而無須擔憂自己的部分。 \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing as the Chaos Space Marines, you are not limited to supply lines. Your enemies must maintain a direct connection between all of their territories and their stronghold, in order to collect full Planetary Requisition. \ You can use this fact to your advantage by severing their supply lines without having to worry about your own. \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 選擇暗黑神靈族，你會獲得在遠古通道之間通行的能力。事實上，你是唯一在基地中擁有遠古通道的陣營。 \ 這些遠古通道聯繫著考拉瓦星系中的星球間的旅行。其他的種族只能用遠古通道作特定的通行，而你可以從任何行省中的遠古通道，移動到任何行省中的遠古通道去。 \ 在遠古通道間移動跟在兩個區域間移動沒甚麼不同。注意如果你要使用通道，你就必須征服通道的目的地！ \ 征服敵人的堡壘來獲取他們種族的力量，並將其據為己有。
en_text: By playing the Dark Eldar, you possess the ability to travel freely between Ancient Gates. In fact, you are the only faction that has an Ancient Gate in your base. \ These ancient artifacts allow travel between the planets of the Kaurava System. While other races can only travel certain paths using the Ancient Gates, you can travel from any Ancient Gate province to any other Ancient Gate province. \ Traveling between these gates is not different than traveling between territories normally. However, take note that you will have to fight whoever owns the gate province you are traveling to! \ Conquer enemy strongholds to obtain their racial powers, added to your own.

tc_text: 歡迎來到戰鎚的教學程式。藉由聽取我的指引和閱讀訊息視窗中的文字，你將會學習到如何進行一個突擊戰鬥遊戲。
en_text: Welcome to the Dawn of War tutorial. By listening to me and reading the text that appears in this message box, you will learn how to play a Skirmish game.

tc_text: 恭喜！你剛剛學到了如何在遊戲中選擇單位和建築物。
en_text: Congratulations! You have just learned how to select units and structures in the game.

tc_text: 這時你會注意到小橫條正在逐漸填滿。你可以透過這個「進度橫條」看出某項工作還要多久才能完成。
en_text: Take note of the small bar that is gradually filling up. This Progress Bar gives you an indication of how close something is to being ready.

tc_text: 戰略位置位於戰場上具有高度戰略價值的區域之中。
en_text: Strategic Points are located in areas of high strategic value on the battlefield.

tc_text: 在戰場上占領並控制戰略位置，即可提升軍備資源。
en_text: Capturing and controlling the Strategic Points on the battlefield is how you increase your Requisition Resource.

tc_text: 占領戰略位置需要花費一些時間。在進度橫條滿格以前，請勿移開正在占領戰略位置的部隊，否則你將無法控制該戰略位置。
en_text: Capturing a Strategic Point takes time. Do not move the capturing squad away from the Strategic Point until the progress bar is full. Otherwise, you will not take control of the Strategic Point.

tc_text: 很好！你已經佔領這個戰略位置！你必須繼續占領其他戰略位置以取得更多軍備資源，用來建立更多部隊和建築物。
en_text: Excellent! The point is ours! You must continue to capture Strategic Points to get more Requisition Resource, which allows you to build more units and structures.

tc_text: 監聽哨除了能夠鞏固戰略位置的防守能力，還能提升戰略位置的軍備生產速率。
en_text: The Listening Post fortifies your hold of a Strategic Point, increasing your Requisition rate at the same time.

tc_text: 很好！這個戰略位置已經受到嚴密防護，敵人難以攻佔。你應該繼續在我方已佔領的所有戰略位置上建立監聽哨。
en_text: Excellent! The point is now protected from enemy retaliation. You should continue to build Listening Posts on all your captured Strategic Points.

tc_text: 部份建築物、載具和研發計劃需要電力才能運作。建造一座電漿發電機，以便提供軍隊運作所需的電力。
en_text: Some structures, vehicles, and research require Power to function. Building a Plasma Generator will supply you with the Power you need to keep your force going.

tc_text: 你的電漿發電機數目越多，電力資源的累積速度也會越快。
en_text: The more Plasma Generators you have, the faster you will build up the Power Resource.

tc_text: 現在我們應該來強化我們的部隊到最強戰力。
en_text: Now we should focus on bringing our squads to full strength by reinforcing them.

tc_text: 你可以透過「增援」功能徵召額外的戰士前來支援，將你的小隊戰力提升至最高。請選取一支帝國防衛軍部隊，再按一下「增援隊伍」按鈕，為該小隊新增一個部隊。
en_text: You can click the Reinforce Squad button multiple times to bring the squad to full strength.

tc_text: 你的作戰基地所具有的後勤補給可以支援一定數目的部隊，而你在特定時間所能支援的部隊數目稱為「部隊上限」。
en_text: Your field base has supplies and logistics to support a finite number of squads. The number of squads you can support at any given time is called your Squad Cap.

tc_text: 你目前的部隊上限會顯示在螢幕頂端的「資源區域」中。
en_text: You can see your current Squad Cap in the Resource Area at the top of your screen.

tc_text: 一旦達到部隊上限，你便無法繼續徵召其他部隊。因此在建立部隊的同時，請務必隨時注意自己的部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum Squad Cap, you will not be able to call in any additional troops, so it's very important to keep an eye on this as you're building up your forces.

tc_text: 占領並固守更多戰略位置，是確保我方軍備資源不虞匱乏的最佳方式。
en_text: The best way to make sure you have enough Requisition Resource is to capture and secure Strategic Points.

tc_text: 請派出帝國防衛軍部隊在我方基地周圍進行地圖探勘，並沿路占領途中發現的戰略位置。你必須占領三個戰略位置，才能達成這項目標。
en_text: Explore the map around your base with your squads and capture any Strategic Points you encounter along the way. To complete this objective you must capture 3 Strategic Points.

tc_text: 很好！你已經占領了三個戰略位置，並分別為它們建立了監聽哨。戰略位置的奪取和固守是擊敗敵人的關鍵。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured 3 Strategic Points and built Listening Posts on them. Taking and holding Strategic Points is key to defeating your enemies.

tc_text: 占領關鍵位置的方式和占領戰略位置完全相同。在部份多人遊戲模式中，能夠占領並固守一個或多個關鍵位置的玩家便能取得勝利！凡是我方固守的關鍵位置，也能為我方軍隊生產軍備資源。
en_text: You can capture Critical Locations just like Strategic Points. In some multiplayer games, capturing and holding one or more of these Critical Locations can win you the game! You also get Requisition from any Critical Locations you control.

tc_text: 請派出部隊占領一個關鍵位置。「關鍵位置」是指具有重大戰略價值的區域，會在地圖上以點標出。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Critical Location. Critical Locations are points on the map that represent locations of critical strategic importance.

tc_text: 很好！你已經占領了一個關鍵位置。請注意，你無法在關鍵位置上建立監聽哨。你必須透過其他途徑來固守關鍵位置。
en_text: Excellent! You've captured a Critical Location. Note that Critical Locations cannot have Listening Posts built on them. You must find other ways to hold them.

tc_text: 固守遺址之後，就能開始為你的軍隊建造最佳的部隊和載具。若要確保自己能夠運用最先進的科技，請全力固守遺址！
en_text: Holding Relics gives you access to your army's best units and vehicles. Hold on to them to ensure you have access to your best technology!

tc_text: 請派出一支部隊占領一處遺址。「遺址」是指具有重大價值的神聖地域。
en_text: Use a squad to capture a Relic. Relics are sacred points of great value.

tc_text: 很好！你已經占領了一處遺址。你可以建立監聽哨，以鞏固我方已占領的遺址。你也可以占領敵方的遺址，使其喪失建立最佳部隊以及運用最先進科技的能力。
en_text: Excellent! You have captured a Relic. You can build Listening Posts to fortify captured Relics. You can also capture your opponent's Relics to deny them access to their best units and technology.

tc_text: 載具十分強悍，面對尚未升級的敵方步兵時，幾乎是刀槍不入。載具會組成我方軍隊的一個基本環節，而且能用來攜帶強大的支援武器。
en_text: Vehicles are tough and nearly impervious to the attacks of non-upgraded infantry. They are a fundamental part of your army, and can carry powerful support weapons.

tc_text: 恭喜！你已經完成了教學程式的學習課程。
en_text: Congratulations! You've completed the learning session of the tutorial.

tc_text: 現在是實習你剛剛學習的時刻了。控制部隊並提升你的能力，來摧毀你的敵人。
en_text: It is time to put what you have learned to work. Take control of the force and build up your strength so you can crush your enemy!

tc_text: 繼續建造建築物，並持續進行研發計劃，以提升自己的戰力。
en_text: Continue to build structures, and carry out research that will increase your effectiveness in battle.

tc_text: 在這個戰場上取得勝利之後，請前往其他戰場，與敵人一決高下。除非你已徹底殲滅敵人，否則這場戰爭將永無終止之日。
en_text: Take this battlefield, and the next, and the next after that. The fight will never end until your enemies are crushed.

tc_text: 請記住，提升軍備資源的方法就是固守戰略位置。一旦軍備資源匱乏，你就無法建立自己需要的部隊，而且會失去自己在戰場上的優勢。
en_text: Remember, holding Strategic Points increases your Requisition Resource. Without sufficient Requisition Resource, you cannot build the force you need to ensure your dominance of the battlefield.

tc_text: 「礦渣區」是集中隱藏在行星地表下方的能源。
en_text: Slag Deposits are concentrated points of energy hidden just under the planet's surface.

tc_text: 只要迅速瀏覽一下迷你地圖，你就會發現一些表示礦渣區的小點。
en_text: Take a quick look at your Mini-Map. There are dots on the map that represent Slag Deposits.

tc_text: 請在礦渣區上建造一座熱流電漿發電機，以取得大量的電力資源。
en_text: Build a Thermo-Plasma Generator on a Slag Deposit to access large amounts of the Power Resource.

tc_text: 現在選取一支小隊，請意該小隊的體力指數上方將會出現一道藍色的橫條。這道藍色橫條代表了該小隊的士氣指數。
en_text: Now select a squad and take note of the small blue bar just over the squad's Health bar. This blue bar represents the Morale of your squad.

tc_text: 「士氣」代表我方部隊的戰力。你可以將士氣想成是專注力、勇氣和戰鬥意願的綜合指數。
en_text: Morale represents the effectiveness of your units in battle. Think of it as a combination of mental focus, courage, and the willingness to fight.

tc_text: 遊戲中有許多武器會同時折損士氣和體力指數。當小隊的士氣有所折損時，藍色小橫條的指數便會下降，就像體力指數一樣。
en_text: Various weapons in the game inflict Morale damage as well as Health damage. When your squad takes Morale damage, the small blue bar will decrease, just like the Health bar does.

tc_text: 士氣指數過低時，小隊便會潰散。潰散的小隊不但會失去戰鬥意願，戰力也會大幅下降。
en_text: When a squad's Morale becomes too low, the squad will break. A broken squad has lost the will to fight, and its combat effectiveness is drastically reduced.

tc_text: 就算小隊已經潰散，你仍然能夠對其進行控制。你可以自行決定要讓潰散的部隊繼續戰鬥，或是撤退到後方重新累積戰力。
en_text: You do not lose control of broken squads. It is your choice whether to leave them in battle, or retreat to gather strength.

tc_text: 若能妥善利用士氣指標，你將能更輕鬆地擊敗敵人。此外，某些特殊部隊具有提升小隊士氣的技能。
en_text: Morale can be an effective tool against your enemies. Also remember that certain units have abilities that can increase the Morale of a squad.

tc_text: 你可以藉由打擊敵人的士氣讓他們喪失戰力，以便更輕而易舉地殲滅敵人。如此一來，即使是小型部隊，只要裝備精良，也能擊敗人數眾多的敵方軍隊。
en_text: By destroying your enemy's Morale, you cause them to lose combat effectiveness, making them much easier to kill. In this way, a small but properly armed squad can destroy an enemy force of superior numbers.

tc_text: 記住，戰術和戰略是戰鬥中的重要關鍵。要善加利用這個道理以在戰場中取得勝利！
en_text: Remember, tactics and strategy can turn the tide of almost any battle. Make sure you use this knowledge to achieve victory on the battlefield!

tc_text: 遭受敵方火力攻擊時，某些類型的地形可以為你的部隊提供保護。這就是所謂的「掩護」。
en_text: Some types of terrain can provide your squads with protection from enemy fire. This is called Cover.

tc_text: 選取我方其中一支步兵小隊，並將其移往掩護區域之中。掩護區域是藉由「標記」加以識別。這些標記會同時顯示在小地圖和真實世界之中。
en_text: Select one of your infantry squads and move it into Cover. The area of Cover has been identified with a marker known as a Ping. It is visible on the Mini-Map as well as in the world.

tc_text: 「掩護」能夠為你的部隊提供額外的防禦能力，使其變得更難對付，因而十分有用。
en_text: Cover is useful in that it can provide your squads with additional defensive bonuses, which make them harder to kill.

tc_text: 要找到能提供掩護能力的地形並不困難 -- 當你通過城巿內部的大型彈坑，或是叢林內部的濃密植被時，滑鼠游標發生變化之處即為掩護區域。
en_text: It's easy to see Cover in the terrain -- just look for your mouse cursor to change as you pass over large bombed-out craters in cities, or patches of thick foliage in jungles.

tc_text: 將部隊移入掩護區域中時，你將會注意到部隊上方出現了小型的「掩護」圖示。這個圖示代表該部隊的防禦能力向上提升。
en_text: You'll notice that when you move your squads into an area of Cover, a small Cover icon will appear above them. This indicates they are receiving a defensive bonus.

tc_text: 很好！你的部隊已經進入掩護區域。你的部隊一旦進入掩護區域內部，敵人就難以射擊，因此遭受長程攻擊時受到的傷害也會隨之減低。請善加利用掩護區域，為我方取得戰略優勢，以有效制敵。
en_text: Excellent! Your squad is in Cover. Units in Cover are harder targets to shoot and take less damage from Ranged attacks because of this. Use Cover well to gain tactical advantages over your enemies.

tc_text: 為了持續的建設你的基地，你需要一個艾克黎西亞奇僕役。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need an Ecclesiarchal Servitor.

tc_text: 選擇你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂，然後建造一個艾克黎西亞奇僕役。
en_text: Select your Ecclesiarchal Chapel and build an Ecclesiarchal Servitor.

tc_text: 為了持續的建設你的基地，你需要一個痛苦奴隸。
en_text: In order to further establish your base you need a Tortured Slave.

tc_text: 選擇你的卡柏要塞，然後建造一個痛苦奴隸。
en_text: Select your Kabal Fortress and build a Tortured Slave.

tc_text: 要增加你的戰鬥修女的部隊數量，你需要在更多監聽哨上建造神聖圖像，來作數量升級的動作。如果你的監聽哨已經升級，那麼你就需要佔領和升級更多的監聽哨。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Sisters of Battle, you need to add the Holy Icon upgrade to more Listening Posts. If all of your Listening Posts are upgraded, you must capture and upgrade more.

tc_text: 要增加你的暗黑神靈族的部隊數量，你需要建造額外的奴隸牢房。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Dark Eldar, you need to build additional Slave Chambers.

tc_text: 你已經達到可以派出的小隊數量極限。確定你已將小隊戰力增援到最高點，達到充分利用的效果。
en_text: You've reached the maximum number of squads you're allowed to field. Be sure to Reinforce your squads to full strength to get the most out of them.

tc_text: 所有的部隊和載具都有一個體力度顯示條。體力指數就反映在這條每支小隊和載具下方的綠色小長條上。
en_text: All units and vehicles have a Health rating. Health is represented by the small green bar underneath each squad or vehicle.

tc_text: 若你在戰鬥期間失去任何部隊，請透過「增援」功能，為你的部隊恢復完整的戰力。
en_text: If you lose any units during a fight, you can Reinforce to bring your squad back to full strength.

tc_text: 在戰鬥期間，請隨時留意小隊的體力指數，並請經常使用增援功能，讓你的部隊保持最高戰力。
en_text: Make sure you watch the strength of your squad in battle. Reinforce often, to make sure your squads are as effective as possible.

tc_text: 請記住，持有重型武器的部隊陣亡時，你的小隊將不再持有該項武器。這時你必須為該小隊進行升級，才能重新取得該項重型武器。
en_text: Remember that when a unit with a heavy weapon dies, you lose that weapon from the squad. You will need to upgrade the squad to get the heavy weapon back.

tc_text: 決定建築物的建造地點時，部份建築物周圍會出現白色的光環。這就是所謂的「控制區域」。
en_text: Notice the white ring that appears around some of your structures when you are deciding where to build. This is the Control Zone.

tc_text: 大部份的建築物都只能在控制區域內部建立，而某些特定的建築物 (例如監聽哨) 則可以在控制區域以外的地點建立。
en_text: Most structures can only be constructed within the Control Zone, while others, like Listening Posts, can be built at other locations.

tc_text: 當你想要為某座新建築物決定建造位置時，在四處移動該建築物的時候，建築物的顏色會從紅色變為綠色。
en_text: When you are trying to place a new structure, its color changes from Red to Green as you move it around.

tc_text: 變成綠色時，代表你可以將建築物置於該處，並展開建造工作。
en_text: A Green color indicates that the structure can be placed at that location so that building will begin.

tc_text: 在艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂中的資源可以提升你部隊上限，但還是會有一個最大值的限制。
en_text: Researches are available at the Ecclesiarchal Chapel to increase your Squad Cap, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 建造更多的部隊和載具，當需要時記得升級你的部隊和載具上限。
en_text: Build additional squads and vehicles. Make sure to upgrade your Squad Cap and Vehicle Cap when necessary.

tc_text: 要增加戰鬥修女的部隊的數量，你需要從你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂中研究升級部隊數量。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Sisters of Battle, you need to research squad cap upgrades from your Ecclesiarchal Chapel.

tc_text: 靈魂原質是圍繞在剛剛死去屍體上的薄霧？記得要快速的採集，因為靈魂只會停留很短的時間。
en_text: Soul Essence is represented by a swirling ethereal mist that surrounds recently killed corpses. Be sure to harvest quickly, as souls only stay on this plane for a short time.

tc_text: 神聖圖像，建造在監聽哨上，可以增加你的最大信仰。
en_text: Holy Icons, built on top of Listening Posts, increase your maximum Faith.

tc_text: 現在選擇監聽哨，然後點選神聖圖像按鍵來為它升級。
en_text: Select a Listening Post now and upgrade it by clicking the Holy Icon button.

tc_text: 很好！你的監聽哨上現在已經擁有了神聖圖像，一個擁戴皇帝的神聖象徵。
en_text: Excellent! Your Listening Post is now adorned with a Holy Icon, a blessed symbol of the Emperor's favor.

tc_text: 神聖圖像是修女們在戰鬥中的生命表徵。用你的生命來守護它們—不管是你的部隊大小或是力量都必須靠它來維持，別讓它們落入敵人的手中。
en_text: Holy Icons are vital to the Sisters' war effort. Guard them with your life - both the size and power of your army depend on keeping them from falling to the enemy.

tc_text: 現在你擁有了神聖圖像，你已經開啟了你的信仰讀數的第一層。在螢幕左上方的位置是你的信仰指數，顯示了這個重要資源的目前存量。
en_text: Now that you have a Holy Icon, you have unlocked the first tier of your Faith meter. Located in the upper-left corner of the screen, the Faith Meter shows your current stores of this important resource.

tc_text: 注意目前大部分的指數仍然是關閉的—只有透過建造神聖圖像，你才可以得到更多潛在的信仰，這也可以讓你獲得更為強大的信仰行動。
en_text: Note that most of the meter is still blocked off - by building more Holy Icons, you will unlock more potential Faith, which will in turn allow you to call upon ever more powerful Acts of Faith.

tc_text: 到目前為止，你只有開啟了潛在的信仰。要獲得信仰，你必須建造信仰單位。
en_text: So far, however, you have only unlocked the potential of Faith. To generate Faith, you must make Faithful units.

tc_text: 一旦抵達了你的最高數量限制，你就無法再建造任何更多的載具。你可以藉由升級你的艾克黎西亞奇禮拜堂，來增加載具上限或是部隊上限。
en_text: Once you have reached your maximum, you cannot build any more vehicles. You can increase your Vehicle Cap by researching the appropriate upgrade at your Manufactorum, much like the Squad Cap.

tc_text: 要增加你的戰鬥修女的部隊數量，你需要在戰鬥修女修道院中研究進行適當的升級項目。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Sisters of Battle, you need to research the appropriate upgrade at the Adepta Sororitas Convent.

tc_text: 在艾克黎西亞奇修道院中的資源可以提升你部隊上限，但還是會有一個最大值的限制。
en_text: Researches are available at the Adepta Sororitas Convent to increase your Squad Cap, but there is always a maximum beyond which you cannot go.

tc_text: 要增加你的戰鬥修女的部隊數量，你需要在戰鬥修女修道院中進行部隊上限的升級研究。
en_text: To increase the number of squads you can field as the Sisters of Battle, you need to build research squad cap upgrades from your Adepta Sororitas Convent.

tc_text: 神聖圖像是修女們在戰鬥中的生命表徵。用你的生命來守護它們—你的部隊力量必須靠它維持，別讓它們落入敵人的手中。
en_text: Holy Icons are vital to the Sisters' war effort. Guard them with your life - the power of your army depends on keeping them from falling to the enemy.

tc_text: 滑鼠是你在戰鬥中的主要操作工具、選擇單位和建築物，以及用來發出命令。
en_text: The mouse is your primary method of surveying the battle, selecting units and structures, and issuing orders.

tc_text: 滑鼠控制攝影機，攝影機代表著你目前在戰場上的視角。
en_text: The mouse controls the camera. The camera represents your current view of the battlefield.

tc_text: 想要移動攝影機，只要在螢幕的角落移動滑鼠指標。現在試試看。
en_text: To pan the camera, simply move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen. Do this now.

tc_text: 想要旋轉攝影機來得到不同的戰鬥視角，按下'ALT'鍵，然後移動你的滑鼠。現在試試看。
en_text: To rotate the camera to gain a different view of the battle, press the 'ALT' key, and move your mouse. Do this now.

tc_text: 只要轉動你的滑鼠滾輪，就可以縮放畫面遠近的大小。現在試試看。
en_text: You can zoom in on something to see it up close by spinning the mouse-wheel forward. Do this now.

tc_text: 要回到遊戲預設的攝影機視角，按下鍵盤上的'Backspace'按鍵。現在試試看。
en_text: To return the camera to the game's default view, press the 'Backspace' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好，你現在回到了遊戲預設的視角。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to its default playing view.

tc_text: 你可以藉由移動、旋轉、縮放攝影機，來獲得你想要的戰場視角。
en_text: By panning, rotating, and zooming the camera in and out, you can gain whatever view of the battlefield you wish.

tc_text: 想要從戰場上的任何地方迅速的回到你的基地，按下你鍵盤上的 'Home' 鍵。現在試試看。
en_text: To quickly return the camera to your base from anywhere on the battlefield, press the 'Home' key on your keyboard. Do this now.

tc_text: 很好，你現在回到了你的基地。
en_text: Excellent, you've returned the camera to your base.

tc_text: 在螢幕左下角的菱形圖示是你的迷你地圖。
en_text: The diamond-shaped display in the lower left-hand corner of your screen is your Mini-map.

tc_text: 你可以使用迷你地圖來觀察你的單位和建築的所在地、快速的掃瞄戰場、執行快速命令和其它。
en_text: You can use the Mini-map to see where your units and structures are located, to quickly scan the battlefield, to issue quick orders, and so forth.

tc_text: 迷你地圖顯示了所有戰略位置的在戰場上的地點，還有其它重要的戰略物件。
en_text: The Mini-map displays the locations of all Strategic Points on the battlefield, as well as other items of strategic importance.

tc_text: 戰爭迷霧會讓你看不到你尚未到達的地方。當你移動到該區域，戰爭迷霧將會消失。
en_text: Fog of War prevents you from seeing things where you do not have a presence. As you move units into an area, the Fog of War will be lifted.

tc_text: 按下任務欄中央上方的骷髏按鍵，可以隱藏任務欄。
en_text: Hide the taskbar by clicking the Skull icon on the upper-middle edge of the taskbar.

tc_text: 當任務欄隱藏後，迷你地圖仍會留在畫面上。
en_text: When the taskbar is hidden, you will notice the Mini-Map stays revealed.

tc_text: 要指揮和升級你的部隊，你可以在任務欄隱藏的狀態下使用'熱鍵'。
en_text: To issue commands and upgrade your squads you can either unhide the taskbar or use the 'hotkeys'.

tc_text: 要帶回任務欄，再次點擊骷髏按鍵。
en_text: To return to the full taskbar, simply click the Skull icon again.

tc_text: 現在讓我們開啟目標選單。
en_text: Now we will bring up the Objective Menu.

tc_text: 目標選單提供了遊戲中，所有你指派的第一和第二目標列表。將滑鼠指標移動到物件上，可以得到它們的說明。
en_text: The Objective Menu provides you a list of all the Primary and Secondary Objectives assigned to you by the game. Mouse over the Objectives to get the description of each.

tc_text: 《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》的決定性體驗。
en_text: The Definitive Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War Experience.

tc_text: 《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》決定版將帶給您終極的《破曉之戰》體驗，包含原版《破曉之戰》遊戲和全部資料片，同時提升視覺畫質、改良鏡頭視角並支援64位元平台。
en_text: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.

tc_text: 《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》的所有精華全部集中在一款決定性的套組。體驗經典巨作《戰槌40,000》定義遊戲類別的血腥榮耀，包括四場完整戰役、巔峰狀態的九大陣營，以及超過200張地圖——全都在一款遊戲裡。
en_text: All of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War in one definitive package. Experience this genre-defining Warhammer 40,000 classic in all its blood-soaked glory, including four complete campaigns, nine full-fledged factions, and over 200 maps – all in one game.

tc_text: 自2004年推出起，《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》就迅速確立了史上最佳即時戰略遊戲的地位，其設定於第41個千禧年遙遠未來的故事也成為Games Workshop廣受稱頌的榮耀慶典。《決定版》將針對現代硬體來微調遊戲體驗，進行各種更新來慶祝這款《戰槌40,000》的開創性巨作，繼續傳承本遊戲的歷史。
en_text: Upon its release in 2004, Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War quickly established itself as one of the all-time great real-time strategy games and a glorious celebration of Games Workshop’s storied far future of the 41st Millennium. The Definitive Editon celebrates this seminal Warhammer 40,000 title with updates that refine the experience for modern hardware and secure the game’s legacy for years to come.

tc_text: 《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》決定版更新內容
en_text: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition Updates

tc_text: 《戰槌40,000：破曉之戰》決定版為您帶來圖像照明技術和升級過的單位紋理，提升了整體畫質表現。改良世界的照明、單位的光影反射、更細緻的陰影、表面光澤以及放射光源，呈獻卓越的遊戲體驗同時保留經典的《破曉之戰》感受。
en_text: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition delivers image-based lighting and upgraded unit textures, enhancing the overall presentation. Improved world lighting, unit reflections, more detailed shadows, surface gloss, and emissive lighting make for a superior experience, while retaining the classic Dawn of War feel.

tc_text: 此外，遊戲中的所有單位均經過比原版解析度高出至少四倍的紋理升級，呈現更細緻的單位，以及更清晰可見的體驗。
en_text: Additionally, all units in the game have received texture upscaling of at least four times their original resolution, making for more detailed units, and a more readable experience.

tc_text: 現在，為了在64位元平台上支援模組社群的持續努力，決定版也包括了更好用的遊戲內模組管理功能，充分相容超過20年來大家精心製作的社群模組。
en_text: Now on a 64-bit platform to support the ongoing efforts of the modding community, the Definitive Edition also includes better in-game mod management and is compatible with over 20 years of lovingly crafted Community Mods.

tc_text: 改良的遊戲鏡頭視角能以前所未有的角度呈現戰場，無縫接軌各種現代系統（包括4K顯示器）。增加渲染距離來呈現更接近劇院的體驗，而抬頭顯示和螢幕版面也已針對現代的寬螢幕觀看進行了最佳化。
en_text: An improved gameplay camera shows the battlefield like never before, working seamlessly on modern systems, including 4K displays. Increased draw distances make for a more cinematic experience, and the HUD and screen layout have been optimized for modern widescreen viewing.
